words.meaning: 第一个字母 A; 一个; 第一的
words.translation: 第一个字母 A; 一个; 第一的\r\nart. [计] 累加器, 加法器, 地址, 振幅, 模拟, 区域, 面积, 汇编, 组件, 异步
words.definition: n. the 1st letter of the Roman alphabet\nn. the blood group whose red cells carry the A antigen

examples.en: She has [a] dog that she walks every morning.
examples.cn: 她有[一条]狗，每天早上都带它出去散步。

examples.en: He picked up [a] stone from the road.
examples.cn: 他从路上捡起了[一块]石头。

examples.sense: art. 表示每（与数量词连用）
examples.en: The doctor told him to take the medicine twice [a] day.
examples.cn: 医生告诉他每天服药两次。

examples.sense: art. 表示某一类中的任何一个
examples.en: [A] child needs both love and care to grow up well.
examples.cn: [一个]孩子需要爱与关怀才能健康成长。

examples.en: The word "apple" starts with the letter [A].
examples.cn: 单词apple以字母[A]开头。

words.translation: n. 能力, 才干\n[经] 能力, 才能
words.definition: n. the quality of being able to perform; a quality that permits or facilitates achievement or accomplishment\nn. possession of the qualities (especially mental qualities) required to do something or get something done

examples.en: She has the [ability] to solve difficult math problems.
examples.cn: 她有解决难数学题的[能力]。

examples.en: Hard work can improve your [ability] in any subject.
examples.cn: 努力学习可以提高你在任何科目上的[能力]。

examples.en: The teacher recognized his natural [ability] for music.
examples.cn: 老师发现了他在音乐方面的天生[才能]。

examples.en: Students with strong [ability] often help their classmates.
examples.cn: 有较强[才干]的学生常常帮助同学。

examples.en: Everyone has different [abilities], so we should respect each other.
examples.cn: 每个人都有不同的[能力]，所以我们应该相互尊重。

words.translation: a. 能干的, 能够的
words.definition:
a. (usually followed by `to') having the necessary means or skill or know-how or authority to do something
s. have the skills and qualifications to do things well
s. having inherent physical or mental ability or capacity
s. having a strong healthy body

examples.en: Are you [able] to finish the homework before dinner?
examples.cn: 你能在晚饭前完成作业吗？

examples.en: After weeks of practice, she was [able] to swim across the pool.
examples.cn: 经过几周的练习，她终于能游过整个泳池了。

examples.en: She is an [able] student who always gets top grades.
examples.cn: 她是一个[能干的]学生，总是名列前茅。

examples.en: He is [able] enough to lead the whole team.
examples.cn: 他[有足够的本领]来领导整个团队。

examples.sense: a. 有能力做某事（be able to）
examples.en: With your help, I believe I will be [able] to pass the exam.
examples.cn: 有你的帮助，我相信我能通过考试。

words.translation: prep. 在...周围, 大约, 有关, 关于\nadv. 大约, 四处, 在附近, 周围
words.definition:
s. on the move
r. all around or on all sides
r. in the area or vicinity
r. used of movement to or among many different places or in no particular direction

examples.en: We had a long talk [about] our plans for the summer.
examples.cn: 我们就暑假计划进行了一番长谈。

examples.en: This book is [about] a young girl who wants to become a doctor.
examples.cn: 这本书讲的是一个想成为医生的小女孩的故事。

examples.en: It takes [about] twenty minutes to walk to school.
examples.cn: 步行去学校[大约]需要二十分钟。

examples.en: The children were running [about] the playground.
examples.cn: 孩子们在操场[四处]跑来跑去。

examples.en: She looked [about] but couldn't find her keys anywhere.
examples.cn: 她[四处]张望，但到处都找不到钥匙。

words.translation: prep. 在上方, 超出\nadv. 在上面\na. 上述的, 上面的
words.definition:
n. an earlier section of a written text
s. appearing earlier in the same text
r. at an earlier place
r. in or to a place that is higher

examples.en: The plane flew [above] the clouds.
examples.cn: 飞机在云层[上方]飞行。

examples.en: There is a picture hanging [above] the fireplace.
examples.cn: 壁炉[上方]挂着一幅画。

examples.en: Her test score was [above] the class average.
examples.cn: 她的考试成绩[高于]班级平均水平。

examples.en: The birds were circling [above] in the blue sky.
examples.cn: 鸟儿在蓝天[上面]盘旋。

examples.en: Please refer to the [above] rules before you start the test.
examples.cn: 请在开始测试前参阅[上述]规则。

words.translation: adv. 往国外, 到室外, 到处\na. 往国外的, 在室外的, 广泛四散的
words.definition: s. in a foreign country\nr. to or in a foreign country

examples.en: My uncle has been living [abroad] for more than ten years.
examples.cn: 我叔叔在[国外]生活了十多年。

examples.en: She decided to study [abroad] to improve her English.
examples.cn: 她决定去[国外]留学，以提高英语水平。

examples.en: The news spread [abroad] very quickly.
examples.cn: 这个消息很快就[到处]传开了。

examples.en: It was a sunny day, so everyone was out and [abroad].
examples.cn: 天气晴朗，所以大家都出门[在外]。

examples.en: Have you ever thought about going [abroad] for your holidays?
examples.cn: 你有没有想过去[国外]度假？

words.translation: a. 缺席的, 不在的, 缺乏的, 漫不经心的\nvt. 使缺席
words.definition: v. go away or leave\na. not being in a specified place\ns. lost in thought; showing preoccupation

examples.en: Three students were [absent] from class today because of illness.
examples.cn: 今天有三名同学因病[缺席]了课。

examples.en: She was [absent] from the meeting without any explanation.
examples.cn: 她[缺席]了会议，没有任何解释。

examples.en: A sense of humor was [absent] from his speech.
examples.cn: 他的演讲中[缺乏]幽默感。

examples.en: He had an [absent] look on his face during the whole class.
examples.cn: 他整节课都是一副[心不在焉]的表情。

examples.en: He decided to [absent] himself from the party that night.
examples.cn: 他决定当晚[缺席]那场派对。

words.translation: n. 重音, 口音, 特点, 注重点\nvt. 重读, 加重音号于, 强调
words.definition: n. distinctive manner of oral expression\nn. a diacritical mark used to indicate stress or placed above a vowel to indicate a special pronunciation

examples.en: She speaks English with a strong French [accent].
examples.cn: 她说英语带着浓重的法语[口音]。

examples.en: People from different regions often have different [accents].
examples.cn: 来自不同地区的人通常有不同的[口音]。

examples.en: In the word "hotel", the [accent] falls on the second syllable.
examples.cn: 在单词hotel中，[重音]在第二个音节上。

examples.en: The teacher put the [accent] on teamwork in this project.
examples.cn: 老师在这个项目中[强调]了团队合作。

examples.en: She [accented] the importance of reading every day.
examples.cn: 她[强调]了每天阅读的重要性。

words.translation: vt. 接受, 承认, 同意, 相信, 赞成, 承担, 承兑, 采纳, 接纳, 容忍\nvi. 同意
words.definition:
v. consider or hold as true
v. receive willingly something given or offered
v. give an affirmative reply to; respond favorably to
v. react favorably to; consider right and proper

examples.en: She was happy to [accept] the gift from her friends.
examples.cn: 她很高兴[接受]了朋友们送来的礼物。

examples.en: He finally [accepted] the job offer after thinking it over.
examples.cn: 经过深思熟虑，他最终[接受]了这份工作邀请。

examples.en: It's hard to [accept] that you made a mistake, but it's necessary.
examples.cn: [承认]自己犯了错误很难，但这是必要的。

examples.en: The school [accepted] the students' suggestion to change the lunch menu.
examples.cn: 学校[采纳]了学生们更换午餐菜单的建议。

examples.en: Good friends [accept] each other's differences.
examples.cn: 好朋友会[接纳]彼此的不同之处。

words.translation: n. 意外事件, 机遇, 事故, 次要方面\n[化] 意外事故; 事故
words.definition: n. an unfortunate mishap; especially one causing damage or injury\nn. anything that happens suddenly or by chance without an apparent cause

examples.en: There was a car [accident] near the school this morning.
examples.cn: 今天早上学校附近发生了一起交通[事故]。

examples.en: Wearing a seatbelt can protect you in an [accident].
examples.cn: 系安全带可以在[事故]中保护你。

examples.en: I broke the cup by [accident] while washing the dishes.
examples.cn: 我洗碗时不小心[意外地]打破了杯子。

examples.sense: n. 偶然（by accident 偶然地）
examples.en: They met each other by [accident] at the library.
examples.cn: 他们在图书馆[偶然]相遇了。

examples.en: The [accident] left him with a broken arm and a scar on his face.
examples.cn: 这次[意外]让他骨折，脸上也留下了疤痕。

words.translation: n. 疼痛\nvi. 痛, 哀怜, 渴望
words.definition: n. a dull persistent (usually moderately intense) pain\nv. have a desire for something or someone who is not present\nv. be the source of pain

examples.en: She had a headache and a stomach [ache] all day.
examples.cn: 她整天头痛，肚子也[疼]。

examples.en: The [ache] in his legs got worse after the long run.
examples.cn: 长跑后他腿上的[疼痛]加剧了。

examples.en: My back has been [aching] since I carried those heavy boxes.
examples.cn: 自从搬了那些重箱子，我的背一直[隐隐作痛]。

examples.en: She [ached] to see her family after being away for so long.
examples.cn: 离家太久，她[渴望]见到家人。

examples.en: His heart [ached] when he heard the sad news.
examples.cn: 听到那个悲伤的消息时，他[心痛]不已。

words.translation: vt. 完成, 达到\nvi. 如愿以偿
words.definition: v. to gain with effort

examples.en: She worked hard to [achieve] her dream of becoming a nurse.
examples.cn: 她努力工作，以[实现]成为一名护士的梦想。

examples.en: You can [achieve] great things if you never give up.
examples.cn: 只要你永不放弃，就能[取得]伟大的成就。

examples.en: He [achieved] the highest score in the class on the final exam.
examples.cn: 他在期末考试中[取得]了全班最高分。

examples.en: The team [achieved] their goal of winning the championship.
examples.cn: 这支队伍[实现]了赢得冠军的目标。

examples.sense: vi. 如愿以偿、获得成功
examples.en: With enough effort, anyone can [achieve] in life.
examples.cn: 只要付出足够的努力，任何人都能在生活中[有所成就]。

words.translation: prep. 越过, 穿过, 与...相交叉, 在...的对面\nadv. 交叉, 到另一边, 在对面, 成十字
words.definition: r. to the opposite side\nr. transversely

examples.en: They built a bridge [across] the river.
examples.cn: 他们在河上建了一座桥，[横跨]河流两岸。

examples.en: She swam [across] the lake without stopping.
examples.cn: 她不停地游，一直[游过]了整个湖。

examples.en: There is a supermarket [across] the street from our school.
examples.cn: 我们学校[对面]有一家超市。

examples.en: He waved at me from [across] the room.
examples.cn: 他从房间的[另一头]向我挥手。

examples.en: I came [across] an old photo of my grandparents in the drawer.
examples.cn: 我在抽屉里[偶然发现]了一张祖父母的老照片。

words.translation:
n. 行动, 行为, 幕, 法案
vi. 行动, 表演, 假装, 见效, 表现, 担当
vt. 扮演, 装作
[计] 先进通信技术, 先进计算机工艺, 自动代码翻译技术
words.definition:
n. a legal document codifying the result of deliberations of a committee or society or legislative body
n. something that people do or cause to happen
n. a subdivision of a play or opera or ballet
n. a short theatrical performance that is part of a longer program

examples.en: We must [act] quickly before the situation gets worse.
examples.cn: 我们必须迅速[行动]，以免局面进一步恶化。

examples.en: It's time to stop talking and start [acting].
examples.cn: 是时候停止空谈，开始[行动]了。

examples.en: Helping the old lady cross the road was a kind [act].
examples.cn: 帮助老奶奶过马路是一种善良的[行为]。

examples.en: She has been [acting] in school plays since she was eight.
examples.cn: 她从八岁起就在学校话剧中[表演]。

examples.en: The story gets more exciting in the second [act] of the play.
examples.cn: 这个故事在戏剧第二[幕]时变得更加精彩。

words.translation: n. 行动, 活动, 动作, 作用, 战斗, 行为, 诉讼\nvt. 对...起诉\n[计] 方式
words.definition:
n. something done (usually as opposed to something said)
n. the state of being active
n. the series of events that form a plot
n. the trait of being active and energetic and forceful

examples.en: We need to take [action] to protect the environment.
examples.cn: 我们需要采取[行动]来保护环境。

examples.en: Words are not enough; [action] is what matters most.
examples.cn: 言语是不够的，[行动]才是最重要的。

examples.en: The hero's [action] scenes in the movie were very exciting.
examples.cn: 这部电影里英雄的[动作]场面非常精彩。

examples.en: The charity [action] raised a lot of money for poor children.
examples.cn: 这次慈善[活动]为贫困儿童筹集了大量资金。

examples.en: The [action] of the medicine made him feel better soon.
examples.cn: 药物的[作用]让他很快感觉好多了。

words.translation: a. 活跃的, 起作用的, 积极的, 有效的, 主动的, 活性的, 现行的, 现役的\nn. 主动语态, 积极分子
words.definition:
n. a person who is a participating member of an organization
a. tending to become more severe or wider in scope
s. engaged in or ready for military or naval operations
a. disposed to take action or effectuate change

examples.en: She is always [active] in class discussions and group activities.
examples.cn: 她在课堂讨论和小组活动中总是很[积极]。

examples.en: Being [active] in sports can keep you healthy and happy.
examples.cn: [积极]参加体育运动可以让你保持健康快乐。

examples.en: The children were very [active] on the playground during recess.
examples.cn: 课间休息时，孩子们在操场上非常[活跃]。

examples.en: He took an [active] role in organizing the school event.
examples.cn: 他在组织学校活动中发挥了[主动]的作用。

examples.en: The [active] ingredient in this cream can reduce skin redness.
examples.cn: 这款面霜中的[有效]成分可以减少皮肤泛红。

words.translation: n. 活动, 行动, 活跃, 活力\n[计] 活动
words.definition: n. any specific behavior\nn. (chemistry) the capacity of a substance to take part in a chemical reaction

examples.en: The school organizes many outdoor [activities] for students.
examples.cn: 学校为学生组织了很多户外[活动]。

examples.en: Reading is one of my favourite [activities] in my free time.
examples.cn: 阅读是我空闲时间最喜欢的[活动]之一。

examples.en: There was a lot of [activity] in the market on Saturday morning.
examples.cn: 周六早上，集市上一片[活跃]热闹。

examples.sense: n. 行动（指一系列行为）
examples.en: The police kept a close eye on all criminal [activity] in the area.
examples.cn: 警方密切关注该地区的所有犯罪[行为]。

examples.en: She joined a drama [activity] after school to make new friends.
examples.cn: 她课后参加了一个戏剧[活动]，以结交新朋友。

words.translation: vt. 增加, 添加, 附带说明, 计算...总和\nvi. 做加法, 积累而成, 增添\n[计] 加法
words.definition:
v. make an addition (to); join or combine or unite with others; increase the quality, quantity, size or scope of
v. state or say further
v. make an addition by combining numbers
v. constitute an addition

examples.en: Please [add] some salt to the soup to make it taste better.
examples.cn: 请往汤里[加]些盐，让它味道更好。

examples.en: The teacher [added] two more questions to the test.
examples.cn: 老师在考试中[添加]了两道题。

examples.en: Can you [add] these numbers together and give me the total?
examples.cn: 你能把这些数字[相加]，然后告诉我总和吗？

examples.en: "Don't forget your umbrella," she [added] before I left.
examples.cn: "别忘了带雨伞，"她在我离开前[补充]道。

examples.en: All the small expenses [add] up to quite a large amount.
examples.cn: 所有的小开销[加起来]是一笔相当大的数目。

words.translation: n. 住址, 演说, 举止, 灵巧, 求爱\nvt. 发表(演说或讲话), 对付, 写地址\n[计] 地址, 寻址
words.definition:
n. (computer science) the code that identifies where a piece of information is stored
n. the place where a person or organization can be found or communicated with
n. the act of delivering a formal spoken communication to an audience
n. the manner of speaking to another individual

examples.en: Could you write down your [address] so I can send you a letter?
examples.cn: 你能写下你的[地址]，这样我就可以给你寄信了吗？

examples.en: I forgot his email [address] and couldn't contact him.
examples.cn: 我忘了他的电子邮件[地址]，无法联系他。

examples.en: The principal gave a long [address] at the opening ceremony.
examples.cn: 校长在开幕式上发表了一篇长篇[演讲]。

examples.en: She [addressed] the envelope carefully before mailing it.
examples.cn: 她在邮寄之前仔细[写好了信封上的地址]。

examples.en: Please [address] your teacher as "Mr. Wang", not by his first name.
examples.cn: 请称呼你的老师为王老师，而不是直接叫名字。

words.translation: n. 优点, 便利, 好处, 优势\nvt. 有助于
words.definition:
n. the quality of having a superior or more favorable position
n. (tennis) first point scored after deuce
n. benefit resulting from some event or action
v. give an advantage to

examples.en: One [advantage] of living near school is that I don't need to take the bus.
examples.cn: 住在学校附近的一个[好处]是我不需要坐公交车。

examples.en: Being tall is a great [advantage] in basketball.
examples.cn: 身材高大在篮球运动中是一大[优势]。

examples.en: Online shopping has the [advantage] of saving time and energy.
examples.cn: 网购有节省时间和精力的[便利]。

examples.en: You should take [advantage] of every chance to practise your English.
examples.cn: 你应该[利用]每一个机会练习英语。

examples.en: Her experience as a teacher gave her an [advantage] in the interview.
examples.cn: 她的教学经验让她在面试中占有[有利条件]。

words.translation: n. 广告, 启事, 广告宣传\n[法] 广告, 公告, 告示
words.definition: n a public promotion of some product or service

examples.en: I saw an [advertisement] for a new phone on TV last night.
examples.cn: 我昨晚在电视上看到了一则新手机的[广告]。

examples.en: The company spent a lot of money on [advertisements] in newspapers.
examples.cn: 这家公司花了大量资金在报纸上做[广告]。

examples.en: Online [advertisement] is becoming more popular than TV ads.
examples.cn: 网络[广告宣传]正变得比电视广告更受欢迎。

examples.en: She found her new job through an [advertisement] in the local newspaper.
examples.cn: 她通过当地报纸上的一则招聘[启事]找到了新工作。

examples.en: This colorful [advertisement] caught everyone's attention on the street.
examples.cn: 街上这张色彩鲜艳的[广告]吸引了所有人的目光。

words.translation: n. 忠告, 劝告, 意见, 报道, 通知\n[经] 通知书, 通知, 建议
words.definition: n. a proposal for an appropriate course of action

examples.en: My teacher gave me some useful [advice] on how to study English.
examples.cn: 我的老师给了我一些关于如何学英语的有用[建议]。

examples.en: She always asks her parents for [advice] when she has a problem.
examples.cn: 她遇到问题时总是向父母寻求[建议]。

examples.en: You should follow the doctor's [advice] and get more rest.
examples.cn: 你应该听从医生的[劝告]，多休息。

examples.en: I asked for his [advice] before making the final decision.
examples.cn: 在做最终决定之前，我征求了他的[意见]。

examples.sense: n. 建议（采纳建议 take advice）
examples.en: She took her friend's [advice] and joined the reading club.
examples.cn: 她听取了朋友的[建议]，加入了读书俱乐部。

words.translation: vt. 劝告, 给...出主意, 通知, 建议\nvi. 提意见, 商量
words.definition: v. inform (somebody) of something

examples.en: The doctor [advised] him to drink more water every day.
examples.cn: 医生[建议]他每天多喝水。

examples.en: I would [advise] you not to stay up too late before the exam.
examples.cn: 我[建议]你考试前不要熬夜太晚。

examples.en: Please [advise] us of any changes to your travel plans.
examples.cn: 请[通知]我们您的出行计划有任何变动。

examples.en: She often [advises] on how to manage time more effectively.
examples.cn: 她经常就如何更有效地管理时间[提出建议]。

examples.en: His parents [advised] him to choose a subject he was interested in.
examples.cn: 他的父母[建议]他选择自己感兴趣的科目。

words.translation: vt. 买得起, 足以, 给予
words.definition: v. be able to spare or give up\nv. have the financial means to do something or buy something\nv. afford access to

examples.en: I can't [afford] a new bicycle right now because I have no money.
examples.cn: 我现在[买不起]新自行车，因为我没有钱。

examples.en: Not every family can [afford] to send their children to private school.
examples.cn: 不是每个家庭都[负担得起]送孩子去私立学校的费用。

examples.sense: vt. 给予、提供（afford sb sth）
examples.en: The trip [afforded] us a great chance to see wild animals up close.
examples.cn: 这次旅行[给了]我们近距离观察野生动物的绝佳机会。

examples.sense: vt. 经受得起（can't afford to）
examples.en: We can't [afford] to waste time; the exam is tomorrow.
examples.cn: 我们[经受不起]浪费时间，明天就是考试了。

examples.en: This small salary can barely [afford] his daily expenses.
examples.cn: 这点薪水几乎[足以]支付他的日常开销。

words.translation: a. 害怕的, 恐怕的, 遗憾的
words.definition:
a. filled with fear or apprehension
s. filled with regret or concern; used often to soften an unpleasant statement
s. feeling worry or concern or insecurity
s. having feelings of aversion or unwillingness

examples.en: She is [afraid] of dogs ever since one bit her when she was little.
examples.cn: 自从小时候被狗咬过，她就一直[害怕]狗。

examples.en: Don't be [afraid] to ask questions if you don't understand something.
examples.cn: 如果你有不明白的地方，不要[害怕]提问。

examples.en: I'm [afraid] I can't come to your party this weekend.
examples.cn: [恐怕]我这周末没办法来参加你的聚会。

examples.en: He was [afraid] that he might fail the exam if he didn't study more.
examples.cn: 他[担心]如果不多学习，可能会考试不及格。

examples.sense: a. 遗憾地（I'm afraid so / I'm afraid not）
examples.en: "Is the library closed today?" "I'm [afraid] so."
examples.cn: "图书馆今天关门了吗？""[恐怕]是的。"

words.translation: prep. 在...之后, 由于\nconj. 在...之后\nadv. 后来
words.definition: s. located farther aft\nr. behind or in the rear

examples.en: We went for a walk [after] dinner to enjoy the cool evening air.
examples.cn: 晚饭后我们出去散步，享受凉爽的夜晚空气。

examples.en: She felt much better [after] taking the medicine.
examples.cn: 吃了药[之后]，她感觉好多了。

examples.en: [After] he finished his homework, he watched TV for an hour.
examples.cn: [做完作业后]，他看了一个小时电视。

examples.en: He left the room, and soon [after], the lights went out.
examples.cn: 他离开了房间，不久[之后]灯就灭了。

examples.en: The police ran [after] the thief down the street.
examples.cn: 警察在街上[追着]小偷跑。

words.translation: n. 午后, 下午
words.definition: n. the part of the day between noon and evening

examples.en: We have a football match this [afternoon] at three o'clock.
examples.cn: 我们今天[下午]三点有一场足球比赛。

examples.en: She usually reads books in the [afternoon] after school.
examples.cn: 她放学后通常在[下午]看书。

examples.sense: n. 下午（good afternoon 问候语）
examples.en: "Good [afternoon], everyone! Please take your seats."
examples.cn: "大家[下午]好！请坐下。"

examples.sense: n. 下午（in the afternoon 在下午）
examples.en: The weather is usually hotter in the [afternoon] than in the morning.
examples.cn: [下午]通常比上午更热。

examples.sense: n. 下午（某天下午 on + 星期 + afternoon）
examples.en: We went to the park on Saturday [afternoon] and had a great time.
examples.cn: 我们周六[下午]去了公园，玩得很开心。

words.translation: adv. 再一次, 又, 到原处
words.definition: r. anew

examples.en: I missed the bus, so I had to wait [again] for another twenty minutes.
examples.cn: 我错过了公交车，所以不得不[再]等二十分钟。

examples.en: Could you say that [again]? I didn't quite hear you.
examples.cn: 你能[再]说一遍吗？我没有完全听清楚。

examples.en: After the operation, he soon became well [again].
examples.cn: 手术后，他很快[又]康复了。

examples.en: Then [again], maybe it's not such a good idea after all.
examples.cn: 但话说回来，也许这[又]不是个好主意。

examples.en: She read the letter [again] and again, unable to believe what it said.
examples.cn: 她[一遍遍]地读那封信，无法相信信中的内容。

words.translation: prep. 反对, 对着, 倚靠
words.definition:
prep. Abreast; opposite to; facing; towards; as, against the
   mouth of a river; -- in this sense often preceded by over.
prep. From an opposite direction so as to strike or come in
   contact with; in contact with; upon; as, hail beats against the roof.
prep. In opposition to, whether the opposition is of
   sentiment or of action; on the other side; counter to; in contrariety
   to; hence, adverse to; as, against reason; against law; to run a race
   against time.
prep. By of before the time that; in preparation for; so as
   to be ready for the time when.

examples.en: Most students were [against] the idea of cancelling the school trip.
examples.cn: 大多数同学[反对]取消学校旅行的想法。

examples.en: He voted [against] the new rule because he thought it was unfair.
examples.cn: 他投票[反对]这条新规定，因为他认为不公平。

examples.en: She leaned [against] the wall and waited for her friend.
examples.cn: 她[倚靠]着墙等她的朋友。

examples.en: It was hard to walk [against] the strong wind.
examples.cn: [顶着]大风行走很困难。

examples.en: Our school played [against] the city's top team in the final.
examples.cn: 我们学校在决赛中与全市顶尖队伍[对阵]。

words.translation: n. 年龄, 老年, 成年, 寿命, 时代, 时期\nv. 变老, 成熟
words.definition:
n. how long something has existed
n. a time of life (usually defined in years) at which some particular qualification or power arises
v. begin to seem older; get older
v. make older

examples.en: Children of all [ages] are welcome at this activity centre.
examples.cn: 各种[年龄]的孩子都欢迎来这个活动中心。

examples.en: At the [age] of ten, he learned to play the guitar by himself.
examples.cn: 在十岁[那年]，他自学了吉他。

examples.en: We are living in the digital [age], where technology changes fast.
examples.cn: 我们生活在数字[时代]，科技发展日新月异。

examples.en: With [age] comes wisdom and a better understanding of life.
examples.cn: 随着[年岁]增长，人会变得更睿智、更懂生活。

examples.en: The actor has [aged] well and still looks very fit.
examples.cn: 这位演员[老得很有风韵]，看起来依然很健康。

words.translation: adv. 以前
words.definition: s. gone by; or in the past\nr. in the past

examples.en: My family moved to this city five years [ago].
examples.cn: 我们家五年[前]搬到了这座城市。

examples.en: She called me an hour [ago] to say she would be late.
examples.cn: 她一小时[前]打电话给我，说她会迟到。

examples.en: Long [ago], people used candles to light their homes at night.
examples.cn: 很久[以前]，人们用蜡烛照亮夜晚的家。

examples.en: The teacher was here just a moment [ago]; she must be nearby.
examples.cn: 老师就在片刻[前]还在这里，她一定在附近。

examples.en: Years [ago], this area was a forest with no houses at all.
examples.cn: 多年[前]，这里是一片森林，没有任何房屋。

words.translation: vi. 同意, 赞成, 应允, 适合\nvt. 承认, 认定, 同意
words.definition:
v. be in accord; be in agreement
v. consent or assent to a condition, or agree to do something
v. show grammatical agreement
v. be agreeable or suitable

examples.en: I [agree] with you that we should spend more time outdoors.
examples.cn: 我[同意]你的看法，我们应该多花时间在户外。

examples.en: We all [agreed] that the trip to the museum was a great idea.
examples.cn: 我们都[赞成]去博物馆参观是个好主意。

examples.en: After a long discussion, both sides finally [agreed] on a plan.
examples.cn: 经过长时间讨论，双方终于[就计划达成了一致]。

examples.en: Spicy food doesn't [agree] with me; it always upsets my stomach.
examples.cn: 辛辣食物不[适合]我，总会让我胃不舒服。

examples.en: Most scientists [agree] that exercise is good for mental health.
examples.cn: 大多数科学家[一致认为]锻炼有益于心理健康。

words.translation: n. 同意, 合约, 协议\n[经] 契约, 协议, 协定
words.definition:
n. the statement (oral or written) of an exchange of promises
n. compatibility of observations
n. harmony of people's opinions or actions or characters
n. the thing arranged or agreed to

examples.en: The two companies signed an [agreement] to work together.
examples.cn: 两家公司签署了一份合作[协议]。

examples.en: The peace [agreement] ended years of conflict between the two sides.
examples.cn: 和平[协议]结束了双方多年的冲突。

examples.en: There was complete [agreement] among the team members about the plan.
examples.cn: 团队成员对该计划完全[一致同意]。

examples.sense: n. 达成一致（come to / reach an agreement）
examples.en: After long talks, the two sides finally reached an [agreement].
examples.cn: 经过长时间谈判，双方终于达成了[协议]。

examples.en: The test results were in [agreement] with what the scientists had predicted.
examples.cn: 测试结果与科学家的预测[一致]。

words.translation: n. 空气, 旋律, 态度\nvt. 晾, 使通风, 夸耀
words.definition:
n. a mixture of gases (especially oxygen) required for breathing; the stuff that the wind consists of
n. the region above the ground
n. a distinctive but intangible quality surrounding a person or thing
n. once thought to be one of four elements composing the universe (Empedocles)

examples.en: The [air] in the mountains is clean and fresh.
examples.cn: 山里的[空气]清新宜人。

examples.en: Open the window to let some fresh [air] into the room.
examples.cn: 打开窗户，让新鲜[空气]进来。

examples.en: She walked into the room with an [air] of confidence.
examples.cn: 她带着一股自信的[气质]走进了房间。

examples.en: He played a sweet [air] on his violin at the concert.
examples.cn: 他在音乐会上用小提琴演奏了一支甜美的[旋律]。

examples.en: She hung the clothes outside to [air] them after washing.
examples.cn: 洗完后她把衣服挂在外面[晾干]。

words.translation: n. 航线, 航线的设备, 航空公司
words.definition: n. a hose that carries air under pressure\nn. a commercial enterprise that provides scheduled flights for passengers

examples.en: Which [airline] are you flying with on your trip to Beijing?
examples.cn: 你去北京的航班是哪家[航空公司]的？

examples.en: The [airline] offered cheap tickets during the holiday season.
examples.cn: 这家[航空公司]在节假日期间推出了特价机票。

examples.en: There are several [airlines] connecting the two major cities.
examples.cn: 有几条[航线]连接着这两座主要城市。

examples.sense: n. 航空公司（乘坐航空）
examples.en: She works as a flight attendant for an international [airline].
examples.cn: 她在一家国际[航空公司]当空乘。

examples.sense: n. 航空公司（服务质量）
examples.en: This [airline] is known for its excellent service and on-time flights.
examples.cn: 这家[航空公司]以出色的服务和准时起降著称。

words.translation: n. 飞机\n[机] 飞机
words.definition: n. an aircraft that has a fixed wing and is powered by propellers or jets

examples.en: We took an [airplane] from Shanghai to Chengdu for the holiday.
examples.cn: 我们乘[飞机]从上海飞往成都度假。

examples.en: The [airplane] landed safely despite the stormy weather.
examples.cn: 尽管天气恶劣，[飞机]还是安全着陆了。

examples.sense: n. 飞机（乘坐飞机出行）
examples.en: She had never been on an [airplane] before this trip abroad.
examples.cn: 在这次出国旅行之前，她从未坐过[飞机]。

examples.sense: n. 飞机（model airplane 模型飞机）
examples.en: He spent the weekend building a model [airplane] with his father.
examples.cn: 他和父亲花了整个周末制作了一架模型[飞机]。

examples.sense: n. 飞机（飞机上的体验）
examples.en: Looking out the [airplane] window, she saw the city lights below.
examples.cn: 从[飞机]窗口望去，她看到了下方闪烁的城市灯光。

words.translation: n. 飞机场\n[机] 航空站, 机场
words.definition: n. an airfield equipped with control tower and hangars as well as accommodations for passengers and cargo

examples.en: We arrived at the [airport] two hours before the flight.
examples.cn: 我们在航班起飞前两小时到达了[机场]。

examples.en: My parents came to the [airport] to see me off.
examples.cn: 我的父母来[机场]为我送行。

examples.en: The international [airport] in this city handles millions of passengers each year.
examples.cn: 这座城市的国际[机场]每年接待数百万旅客。

examples.en: There are plenty of shops and restaurants inside the [airport].
examples.cn: [机场]内有很多商店和餐厅。

examples.en: He took a taxi from the [airport] to his hotel in the city centre.
examples.cn: 他从[机场]打车到市中心的酒店。

words.translation: a. 活着的, 活泼的, 敏感的, 热闹的
words.definition:
a. possessing life
s. (often followed by `with') full of life and spirit
s. (followed by `to' or `of') aware of
s. capable of erupting

examples.en: Is the fish still [alive] in the bucket?
examples.cn: 桶里的鱼还[活着]吗？

examples.en: Thanks to the doctor's help, the patient is still [alive].
examples.cn: 多亏了医生的帮助，这位病人还[活着]。

examples.sense: a. 充满活力的、热闹的
examples.en: The street market comes [alive] every Saturday morning.
examples.cn: 每逢周六早上，街头集市就变得[热闹非凡]。

examples.en: She made the story come [alive] with her exciting way of telling it.
examples.cn: 她用生动的讲述方式让故事[活灵活现]。

examples.sense: a. 敏感的、意识到的（alive to）
examples.en: A good leader must be [alive] to the needs of the team.
examples.cn: 一位好的领导者必须[敏锐地]察觉到团队的需求。

words.translation:
a. 所有的, 全部的, 一切的
adv. 全部, 全然
pron. 全部
n. 全部
words.definition: a. quantifier; used with either mass or count nouns to indicate the whole number or amount of or every one of a class\ns. completely given to or absorbed by

examples.en: [All] the students in the class passed the final exam.
examples.cn: 全班[所有]学生都通过了期末考试。

examples.en: She spent [all] her pocket money on books this month.
examples.cn: 她这个月把[所有]零花钱都花在了买书上。

examples.en: He was [all] alone in the house when the storm started.
examples.cn: 暴风雨来临时，他[完全]独自在家。

examples.en: [All] I want is a quiet place to read and rest.
examples.cn: 我想要的[一切]只是一个安静的地方读书和休息。

examples.sense: n. 全力（above all / after all）
examples.en: Above [all], we should be honest with each other.
examples.cn: [最重要的是]，我们应该彼此诚实。

words.translation: vt. 允许, 同意给予, 承认\nvi. 容许, 猜想\n[计] 允许命令
words.definition:
v. let have
v. give or assign a resource to a particular person or cause
v. allow or plan for a certain possibility; concede the truth or validity of something
v. grant as a discount or in exchange

examples.en: Our school does not [allow] students to use mobile phones in class.
examples.cn: 我们学校不[允许]学生在课堂上使用手机。

examples.en: His parents [allowed] him to stay up late on Friday nights.
examples.cn: 他的父母[允许]他在周五晚上熬夜。

examples.sense: vt. 给予、拨出（时间/金钱）
examples.en: Please [allow] at least three days for the parcel to arrive.
examples.cn: 请[留出]至少三天等待包裹到达。

examples.en: We should [allow] for delays when planning our journey.
examples.cn: 规划行程时，我们应该[考虑到]可能的延误。

examples.en: I [allow] that I made a mistake, but I've already fixed it.
examples.cn: 我[承认]我犯了一个错误，但我已经改正了。

words.translation: adv. 几乎, 差不多
words.definition: r (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished; all but

examples.en: I have [almost] finished my homework; just one more question to go.
examples.cn: 我[几乎]完成了作业，只剩最后一道题了。

examples.en: It's [almost] midnight, so we should go to bed now.
examples.cn: [快]午夜了，我们应该睡觉了。

examples.sense: adv. 差一点就（almost + 动词）
examples.en: She [almost] fell off her bike on the icy road.
examples.cn: 她在结冰的路上[差点]从自行车上摔下来。

examples.en: [Almost] two hundred students signed up for the sports day.
examples.cn: [将近]两百名学生报名参加了运动会。

examples.en: The two sisters look [almost] identical; it's hard to tell them apart.
examples.cn: 这对姐妹长得[几乎]一模一样，很难分辨。

words.translation: a. 孤独的, 单独的, 独自的\nadv. 独自地
words.definition:
s. isolated from others
s. lacking companions or companionship
s. exclusive of anyone or anything else
s. radically distinctive and without equal

examples.en: She was [alone] in the house all evening while her parents were out.
examples.cn: 她父母外出时，她一个人[独自]在家待了整个晚上。

examples.en: He prefers to study [alone] rather than in a noisy group.
examples.cn: 他更喜欢[独自]学习，而不是在嘈杂的团体中。

examples.en: She travelled [alone] across the country last summer.
examples.cn: 去年夏天她[独自]一人游遍了全国。

examples.en: He often feels [alone] even when he is surrounded by people.
examples.cn: 即使身边有很多人，他也常常感到[孤独]。

examples.sense: 副词（leave sb alone 别打扰）
examples.en: Please leave me [alone]; I need some quiet time to think.
examples.cn: 请[别打扰]我，我需要安静地思考一下。

words.translation: adv. 平行地, 向前\nprep. 沿着
words.definition:
r. with a forward motion
r. in accompaniment or as a companion
r. to a more advanced state
r. in addition (usually followed by `with')

examples.en: We walked [along] the river and enjoyed the beautiful scenery.
examples.cn: 我们[沿着]河边散步，欣赏美丽的风景。

examples.en: There are many old trees planted [along] the main road.
examples.cn: 主干道[沿途]种了很多古树。

examples.en: Come [along] — we're going to be late if we don't hurry.
examples.cn: [快走]——如果不快点我们就要迟到了。

examples.en: She brought her little brother [along] to the birthday party.
examples.cn: 她把弟弟[一起]带去了生日派对。

examples.en: How are you getting [along] with your new classmates?
examples.cn: 你和新同学相处得怎么样了？

words.translation: adv. 出声地, 大声地
words.definition: r. using the voice; not silently

examples.en: The teacher asked us to read the passage [aloud] in class.
examples.cn: 老师让我们在课堂上[大声]朗读这篇文章。

examples.en: She read the story [aloud] to her younger sister at bedtime.
examples.cn: 她在睡前[出声地]给妹妹读故事。

examples.en: Please speak [aloud] so that everyone in the room can hear you.
examples.cn: 请[大声]说话，这样房间里的每个人都能听见。

examples.sense: adv. 出声地（think aloud 自言自语）
examples.en: He was thinking [aloud], going over his plan step by step.
examples.cn: 他在[自言自语]，一步一步地回顾自己的计划。

examples.sense: adv. 朗读（read aloud 帮助学习）
examples.en: Reading [aloud] every day can really improve your pronunciation.
examples.cn: 每天[大声朗读]确实可以提高你的发音。

words.translation: adv. 已经, 早已
words.definition: r. prior to a specified or implied time

examples.en: I have [already] eaten dinner, so I'm not hungry now.
examples.cn: 我[已经]吃过晚饭了，所以现在不饿。

examples.en: By the time we arrived, the film had [already] started.
examples.cn: 我们到达时，电影[已经]开始了。

examples.sense: adv. 早已（表示出乎意料）
examples.en: You're [already] here! I thought you'd be late.
examples.cn: 你[已经]来了！我以为你会迟到呢。

examples.sense: adv. 早就（强调时间之早）
examples.en: At only fifteen, she had [already] won several national competitions.
examples.cn: 她才十五岁，就[已经]赢得了好几项全国比赛。

examples.sense: adv. 迫不及待（用于否定/疑问句，表迫切）
examples.en: Is it lunchtime [already]? The morning passed so quickly!
examples.cn: [都]到午饭时间了吗？上午过得好快！

words.translation: adv. 也, 并且, 同样地
words.definition: r in addition

examples.en: She can speak French and [also] knows a little Spanish.
examples.cn: 她会说法语，[也]懂一点西班牙语。

examples.en: I enjoy reading, and I [also] like going for walks in the park.
examples.cn: 我喜欢阅读，[也]喜欢在公园里散步。

examples.en: The hotel is clean and comfortable; [also], it is very close to the beach.
examples.cn: 这家酒店干净舒适；[此外]，它离海滩也很近。

examples.sense: adv. 并且（连接两个动作）
examples.en: He is a good student and [also] a talented musician.
examples.cn: 他是一个好学生，[同时也]是一位有才华的音乐家。

examples.sense: adv. 同样地（对前文的补充）
examples.en: Exercise is important for your body; it is [also] good for your mind.
examples.cn: 锻炼对身体很重要，[同样]对心理健康也有好处。

words.translation: conj. 虽然, 尽管
words.definition: conj. Grant all this; be it that; supposing that;\n   notwithstanding; though.

examples.en: [Although] it was raining, we still went for a hike in the mountains.
examples.cn: [虽然]下雨，我们还是去山里徒步了。

examples.en: She smiled [although] she was feeling very sad inside.
examples.cn: [尽管]内心非常悲伤，她还是微笑着。

examples.en: [Although] he is young, he has a lot of experience in teaching.
examples.cn: [尽管]他年轻，他在教学方面却经验丰富。

examples.en: The food was expensive, [although] the quality was excellent.
examples.cn: 食物价格不低，[不过]质量确实很好。

examples.en: [Although] they are twins, they have very different personalities.
examples.cn: [虽说]他们是双胞胎，性格却截然不同。

words.translation: adv. 总是, 始终
words.definition: r. at all times; all the time and on every occasion\nr. at any time or in any event\nr. forever; throughout all time

examples.en: She [always] gets to school early to prepare for the day.
examples.cn: 她[总是]早早到校，为一天的学习做准备。

examples.en: My grandfather [always] tells me to be honest and work hard.
examples.cn: 我爷爷[总是]告诉我要诚实、努力工作。

examples.en: This small town has [always] been known for its beautiful lake.
examples.cn: 这座小镇[始终]以其美丽的湖泊而闻名。

examples.en: No matter what happens, I will [always] be there for you.
examples.cn: 不管发生什么，我[永远]都会在你身边。

examples.sense: adv. 随时都可以（退而求其次）
examples.en: If you're busy, you can [always] come back tomorrow.
examples.cn: 如果你忙的话，你[随时]可以明天再来。

words.translation: n. 美洲, 美国
words.definition: n. North America and South America and Central America

examples.en: She has always dreamed of visiting [America] and seeing the Statue of Liberty.
examples.cn: 她一直梦想着去[美国]参观自由女神像。

examples.en: Many international students go to [America] to study at university.
examples.cn: 许多国际学生去[美国]上大学。

examples.en: North [America] is the third largest continent in the world.
examples.cn: 北[美洲]是世界第三大洲。

examples.en: South [America] is home to the Amazon rainforest.
examples.cn: 南[美洲]拥有亚马逊热带雨林。

examples.sense: n. 美国（文化/生活方式）
examples.en: Baseball is often considered the national sport of [America].
examples.cn: 棒球常被认为是[美国]的国家运动。

words.translation: n. 美国人\na. 美国的, 美洲的
words.definition: n. a native or inhabitant of the United States\nn. a native or inhabitant of a North American or Central American or South American country\na. of or relating to the United States of America or its people or language or culture

examples.en: [American] food is popular around the world, especially hamburgers.
examples.cn: [美国]食物在世界各地广受欢迎，尤其是汉堡包。

examples.en: She is very interested in [American] history and culture.
examples.cn: 她对[美国]历史和文化非常感兴趣。

examples.en: My pen pal is an [American] from California.
examples.cn: 我的笔友是一个来自加利福尼亚的[美国人]。

examples.en: She met an [American] at the language exchange event last weekend.
examples.cn: 她上周末在语言交流活动中遇到了一位[美国人]。

examples.en: Native [American] culture has a long and rich history.
examples.cn: 美洲[原住民]文化有着悠久而丰富的历史。

words.translation: prep. 在...之中
words.definition: prep. Alt. of Amongst

examples.sense: prep. 在...之中（三者及以上）
examples.en: She sat [among] her friends and laughed all afternoon.
examples.cn: 她坐在朋友们[中间]，笑了整个下午。

examples.sense: prep. 在...之中（三者及以上）
examples.en: This song is [among] the most popular ones this year.
examples.cn: 这首歌是今年最受欢迎的歌曲[之一]。

examples.en: There is a wolf hiding [among] the sheep.
examples.cn: 羊群[中间]藏着一匹狼。

examples.en: The teacher divided the prizes [among] the top three students.
examples.cn: 老师把奖品分给了前三名学生。

examples.en: The students discussed the problem [among] themselves before asking the teacher.
examples.cn: 学生们先在[彼此之间]讨论了这个问题，再去问老师。

words.translation: a. 古代的, 古老的, 年老的, 旧的
words.definition:
n. a very old person
n. a person who lived in ancient times
s. belonging to times long past especially of the historical period before the fall of the Western Roman Empire
s. very old

examples.en: We learned about [ancient] Egypt in history class today.
examples.cn: 我们今天在历史课上学习了[古代]埃及。

examples.en: [Ancient] Chinese inventions changed the world, like paper and printing.
examples.cn: [古代]中国的发明改变了世界，如造纸术和印刷术。

examples.sense: a. 古老的、年代久远的
examples.en: There is an [ancient] temple in our town that is over a thousand years old.
examples.cn: 我们镇上有一座[古老的]寺庙，已有一千多年历史。

examples.sense: a. 古老的（用于非正式语境，形容很旧）
examples.en: That [ancient] computer in the corner is too slow to use now.
examples.cn: 角落里那台[老旧的]电脑现在慢得没法用了。

examples.en: The [ancients] believed that the earth was the centre of the universe.
examples.cn: [古人]认为地球是宇宙的中心。

words.translation: conj. 和, 与\n[计] 与
words.definition:
conj. A particle which expresses the relation of connection or
   addition. It is used to conjoin a word with a word, a clause with a
   clause, or a sentence with a sentence.
conj. In order to; -- used instead of the infinitival to,
   especially after try, come, go.
conj. It is sometimes, in old songs, a mere expletive.
conj. If; though. See An, conj.

examples.en: I had bread [and] butter for breakfast this morning.
examples.cn: 今天早上我吃了面包[和]黄油。

examples.en: My brother [and] I go to the same school.
examples.cn: 我兄弟[和]我上同一所学校。

examples.sense: conj. 然后（连接动作的先后顺序）
examples.en: She opened the door [and] walked into the classroom.
examples.cn: 她推开门，[然后]走进了教室。

examples.sense: conj. 以便（用在 go / come / try 之后）
examples.en: Come [and] see the new paintings in the school hall.
examples.cn: 来[看看]学校大厅里的新画作吧。

examples.en: He studied hard [and] still failed the exam.
examples.cn: 他努力学习了，[但]还是考试不及格。

words.translation: a. 生气的, 愤怒的
words.definition: a. feeling or showing anger\ns. (of the elements) as if showing violent anger\ns. severely inflamed and painful

examples.en: She was [angry] when she found out her brother had broken her phone.
examples.cn: 当她发现哥哥摔坏了她的手机时，她非常[生气]。

examples.en: Don't say anything when you're [angry]; wait until you've calmed down.
examples.cn: [生气]的时候不要说话，等冷静下来再说。

examples.en: The teacher was [angry] with the students who hadn't done their homework.
examples.cn: 老师对那些没完成作业的学生[生气]了。

examples.en: He was [angry] about the unfair result of the competition.
examples.cn: 他对比赛不公平的结果感到[愤怒]。

examples.sense: a. 狂怒的（形容天气/自然）
examples.en: The [angry] sea made it impossible for the boats to go out.
examples.cn: [汹涌]的大海使船只无法出行。

words.translation: n. 动物\n[医] 动物
words.definition: n. a living organism characterized by voluntary movement\ns. marked by the appetites and passions of the body

examples.en: The zoo has a wide variety of [animals] from all over the world.
examples.cn: 这家动物园里有来自世界各地的各种各样的[动物]。

examples.en: My favourite [animal] is the panda because it is so cute.
examples.cn: 我最喜欢的[动物]是熊猫，因为它太可爱了。

examples.sense: n. 野兽（贬义，指行为粗野的人）
examples.en: Some people [animal]-like behaviour is hard to forgive.
examples.cn: 有些人的[兽性]行为让人难以原谅。

examples.sense: a. 动物的、肉体的（animal instinct）
examples.en: It is [animal] instinct for a mother to protect her child.
examples.cn: 母亲保护孩子是一种[动物]本能。

examples.sense: n. 动物（野生动物保护）
examples.en: We must protect wild [animals] and their natural habitats.
examples.cn: 我们必须保护野生[动物]及其自然栖息地。

words.translation: a. 另外的, 再一的, 不同的\npron. 又一个, 另一个, 类似的另一个
words.definition: s. any of various alternatives; some other

examples.sense: a. 另一个（同类中再取一个）
examples.en: Could I have [another] glass of water, please?
examples.cn: 请问我能再要[一杯]水吗？

examples.sense: a. 另一个（同类中再取一个）
examples.en: I made a mistake; let me try [another] way to solve this problem.
examples.cn: 我犯了一个错误；让我试试[另一种]方法来解决这个问题。

examples.en: This book is interesting, but I'd like to read [another].
examples.cn: 这本书很有趣，但我想再读[另一本]。

examples.sense: a. 不同的（a completely different one）
examples.en: That is [another] matter altogether; let's deal with it separately.
examples.cn: 那完全是[另一回事]，我们单独处理吧。

examples.sense: prep. 又一（one another 互相）
examples.en: We should help one [another] and not be selfish.
examples.cn: 我们应该[互相]帮助，而不是自私自利。

words.translation:
n. 答案, 回答, 回报, 答辩
vt. 回答, 反驳, 适应, 响应, 符合
vi. 回答, 答应, 负责, 符合, 成功
[计] 用户问题及答案新闻组
words.definition:
n. a statement (either spoken or written) that is made to reply to a question or request or criticism or accusation
n. the speech act of replying to a question
n. the principal pleading by the defendant in response to plaintiff's complaint; in criminal law it consists of the defendant's plea of `guilty' or `not guilty' (or nolo contendere); in civil law it must contain denials of all allegations in the plaintiff's complaint that the defendant hopes to controvert and it can contain affirmative defenses or counterclaims
n. a nonverbal reaction

examples.en: Can anyone give me the [answer] to question five?
examples.cn: 有人能告诉我第五题的[答案]吗？

examples.en: The [answer] to the maths problem is on the last page.
examples.cn: 这道数学题的[答案]在最后一页。

examples.en: She [answered] all the questions correctly and got full marks.
examples.cn: 她[回答]了所有问题，全部正确，得了满分。

examples.en: He didn't [answer] the phone because he was in the shower.
examples.cn: 他没有[接]电话，因为他正在洗澡。

examples.en: This plan [answers] all the requirements set by the school.
examples.cn: 这个计划[符合]学校设定的所有要求。

words.translation: n. 蚂蚁
words.definition: n. social insect living in organized colonies; characteristically the males and fertile queen have wings during breeding season; wingless sterile females are the workers

examples.en: A line of [ants] was carrying food back to their nest.
examples.cn: 一排[蚂蚁]正把食物搬回巢穴。

examples.en: [Ants] can carry things many times heavier than themselves.
examples.cn: [蚂蚁]能搬运比自身重许多倍的东西。

examples.en: [Ants] live and work together in large groups called colonies.
examples.cn: [蚂蚁]以大型群体（称为蚁群）共同生活和工作。

examples.en: Be like an [ant] and work hard every day to reach your goal.
examples.cn: 要像[蚂蚁]一样，每天努力工作，朝目标前进。

examples.en: The children watched an [ant] crawl slowly across the leaf.
examples.cn: 孩子们看着一只[蚂蚁]慢慢地爬过树叶。

words.translation: a. 任何的\npron. 任何
words.definition: s. one or some or every or all without specification\nr. to any degree or extent

examples.sense: a. 任何的（疑问/否定句）
examples.en: Do you have [any] questions before we start the test?
examples.cn: 在我们开始考试之前，你们有[任何]问题吗？

examples.sense: a. 任何的（疑问/否定句）
examples.en: I don't have [any] money left after buying the books.
examples.cn: 买了书之后，我一点钱都没有了。

examples.sense: a. 任何一个（肯定句，强调随便哪个）
examples.en: [Any] student who works hard can improve their grades.
examples.cn: [任何]努力学习的学生都能提高成绩。

examples.en: I looked everywhere for my keys but couldn't find [any].
examples.cn: 我到处找钥匙，但一把也没找到。

examples.sense: adv. 一点、稍微（修饰比较级）
examples.en: Is your headache [any] better after taking the medicine?
examples.cn: 吃了药之后头痛有[好一点]吗？

words.translation: pron. 任何人\nn. 重要人物
words.definition: n. Any one out of an indefinite number of persons; anyone;\n   any person.\nn. A person of consideration or standing.

examples.sense: pron. 任何人（疑问/否定句）
examples.en: Is there [anybody] in the classroom right now?
examples.cn: 现在教室里有[任何人]吗？

examples.sense: pron. 任何人（疑问/否定句）
examples.en: I don't think [anybody] noticed that I was late.
examples.cn: 我觉得没有[任何人]注意到我迟到了。

examples.sense: pron. 任何人（肯定句，泛指所有人）
examples.en: [Anybody] can learn to cook if they try hard enough.
examples.cn: 只要足够努力，[任何人]都能学会做饭。

examples.en: [Anybody] would feel nervous before speaking in front of a large crowd.
examples.cn: 在大众面前发言，[任何人]都会紧张。

examples.sense: n. 重要人物（somebody / nobody 对比）
examples.en: He is not just [anybody]; he is the school's best athlete.
examples.cn: 他不是[普通人]；他是学校最优秀的运动员。

words.translation: pron. 任何人
words.definition: n. One taken at random rather than by selection; anybody.\n   [Commonly written as two words.]

examples.en: Has [anyone] seen my notebook? I can't find it.
examples.cn: 有[任何人]看到我的笔记本吗？我找不到了。

examples.en: Can [anyone] explain why the answer is wrong?
examples.cn: 有[人]能解释一下为什么这个答案是错的吗？

examples.en: She didn't tell [anyone] about her plan to change schools.
examples.cn: 她没有告诉[任何人]她转学的计划。

examples.sense: pron. 任何人（肯定句，泛指）
examples.en: [Anyone] who wants to join the club should sign up by Friday.
examples.cn: [任何]想加入俱乐部的人应在周五前报名。

examples.en: If [anyone] calls while I'm out, please take a message.
examples.cn: 如果我不在时有[人]打电话，请帮我留言。

words.translation: pron. 任何事
words.definition:
n. Any object, act, state, event, or fact whatever; thing of
   any kind; something or other; aught; as, I would not do it for
   anything.
n. Expressing an indefinite comparison; -- with as or like.
adv. In any measure; anywise; at all.

examples.en: Is there [anything] I can do to help you?
examples.cn: 有[什么]我可以帮你的吗？

examples.en: Did you eat [anything] for breakfast this morning?
examples.cn: 你今天早上吃[什么]了吗？

examples.en: I didn't hear [anything] unusual last night.
examples.cn: 昨晚我没有听到[任何]异常的声音。

examples.sense: pron. 任何事（肯定句，泛指）
examples.en: You can ask me [anything]; I will try my best to answer.
examples.cn: 你可以问我[任何]问题，我会尽力回答。

examples.sense: pron. 无论什么（anything but 根本不）
examples.en: The test was [anything] but easy; almost everyone found it very difficult.
examples.cn: 这次考试[根本]不简单，几乎所有人都觉得很难。

words.translation: adv. 无论如何, 至少
words.definition: r used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement; anyhow, they're quiet"; anyway, it's gone"; in any case, there was a brief scuffle"\nr in any way whatsoever

examples.en: It was raining, but we decided to go to the park [anyway].
examples.cn: 虽然下雨，但我们还是决定[无论如何]去公园。

examples.en: I'm not sure if it will work, but let's try [anyway].
examples.cn: 我不确定是否有效，但[反正]试试吧。

examples.en: The weather was bad, but we had fun [anyway].
examples.cn: 天气不好，但我们[还是]玩得很开心。

examples.sense: adv. 不管怎么说（转换话题）
examples.en: [Anyway], let's stop talking about this and focus on the task.
examples.cn: [不管怎么说]，我们别再谈这件事了，专注于任务吧。

examples.sense: adv. 无论如何（表示某事已经发生）
examples.en: I had already finished my homework, so I went out to play [anyway].
examples.cn: 我已经完成作业了，所以[反正]就出去玩了。

words.translation: adv. 无论何处
words.definition: r. at or in or to any place; (`anyplace' is used informally for `anywhere')

examples.sense: adv. 任何地方（疑问/否定句）
examples.en: Have you seen my glasses [anywhere]? I can't find them.
examples.cn: 你在[哪儿]见过我的眼镜吗？我找不到了。

examples.sense: adv. 任何地方（疑问/否定句）
examples.en: I looked [anywhere] but I couldn't find my lost cat.
examples.cn: 我[到处]找，但找不到我丢失的猫。

examples.en: With this map app, you can find your way [anywhere].
examples.cn: 有了这个地图应用，你可以在[任何地方]找到路。

examples.sense: adv. 到处（get anywhere 取得进展）
examples.en: We've been talking for hours and haven't got [anywhere].
examples.cn: 我们已经谈了好几个小时，却没有取得[任何进展]。

examples.sense: adv. 任何地方（anywhere else 其他任何地方）
examples.en: This kind of flower doesn't grow [anywhere] else in the country.
examples.cn: 这种花在全国其他[任何地方]都不生长。

words.translation: vi. 出现, 显得, 来到\n[法] 出庭, 到案, 出现
words.definition:
v. come into sight or view
v. be issued or published
v. seem to be true, probable, or apparent
v. come into being or existence, or appear on the scene

examples.en: A rainbow [appeared] in the sky after the rain stopped.
examples.cn: 雨停后，天空中[出现]了一道彩虹。

examples.en: She [appeared] at the door just as I was about to leave.
examples.cn: 就在我准备离开的时候，她[出现]在了门口。

examples.en: He [appeared] nervous before walking onto the stage.
examples.cn: 走上舞台前，他[看起来]很紧张。

examples.en: The problem [appears] to be more serious than we first thought.
examples.cn: 这个问题[似乎]比我们最初想的更严重。

examples.en: His first article [appeared] in the school magazine last month.
examples.cn: 他的第一篇文章上个月在校刊上[发表]了。

words.translation: n. 苹果, 家伙\n[医] 苹果
words.definition: n. fruit with red or yellow or green skin and sweet to tart crisp whitish flesh\nn. native Eurasian tree widely cultivated in many varieties for its firm rounded edible fruits

examples.en: She ate an [apple] every day to stay healthy.
examples.cn: 她每天吃一个[苹果]来保持健康。

examples.en: The children picked fresh [apples] from the trees in the garden.
examples.cn: 孩子们从花园里的树上摘了新鲜的[苹果]。

examples.en: Red [apples] are usually sweeter than green ones.
examples.cn: 红[苹果]通常比绿苹果更甜。

examples.sense: n. 苹果（成语：An apple a day...）
examples.en: My grandmother always says, "An [apple] a day keeps the doctor away."
examples.cn: 我奶奶常说："一天一个[苹果]，医生远离我。"

examples.sense: n. 苹果（苹果汁/苹果派等）
examples.en: I had a slice of [apple] pie and a cup of tea for dessert.
examples.cn: 我甜点吃了一片[苹果]派和一杯茶。

words.translation: n. 四月
words.definition: n. the month following March and preceding May

examples.en: My birthday is on the 15th of [April].
examples.cn: 我的生日是[四月]十五日。

examples.en: Spring weather really begins in [April] in most parts of China.
examples.cn: 在中国大部分地区，[四月]才真正进入春天。

examples.en: The first day of [April] is known as April Fool's Day.
examples.cn: [四月]一日是愚人节。

examples.sense: n. 四月（学期/节日安排）
examples.en: The spring school trip is planned for the end of [April].
examples.cn: 春季学校郊游计划安排在[四月]底。

examples.en: [April] showers bring May flowers, as the old saying goes.
examples.cn: 正如古语所说，[四月]的阵雨带来五月的鲜花。

words.translation: n. 区域, 面积, 范围, 空地\n[计] 区域
words.definition:
n. a particular geographical region of indefinite boundary (usually serving some special purpose or distinguished by its people or culture or geography)
n. a subject of study
n. a part of an animal that has a special function or is supplied by a given artery or nerve
n. a part of a structure having some specific characteristic or function

examples.en: The school is in a quiet residential [area] near the park.
examples.cn: 学校位于公园附近一个安静的住宅[区]。

examples.en: Heavy rain is expected in coastal [areas] this weekend.
examples.cn: 本周末沿海[地区]预计有大雨。

examples.en: What is the [area] of this classroom in square metres?
examples.cn: 这间教室的[面积]是多少平方米？

examples.en: She is very skilled in the [area] of computer programming.
examples.cn: 她在计算机编程[领域]非常出色。

examples.en: There is a picnic [area] near the lake where families can relax.
examples.cn: 湖边有一个野餐[区]，家庭可以在那里放松休息。

words.translation:
n. 手臂, 袖子, 狭长港湾, 武器
vt. 武装, 装备
vi. 武装起来
[计] 异步应答方式; 自动货品销路管理
words.definition:
n. a human limb; technically the part of the superior limb between the shoulder and the elbow but commonly used to refer to the whole superior limb
n. any projection that is thought to resemble a human arm
n. the part of an armchair or sofa that supports the elbow and forearm of a seated person
v. prepare oneself for a military confrontation

examples.en: She broke her [arm] when she fell off her bicycle.
examples.cn: 她从自行车上摔下来，摔断了[手臂]。

examples.en: He held the baby gently in his [arms].
examples.cn: 他轻轻地把婴儿抱在[怀里]。

examples.en: The country signed a deal to reduce [arms] production.
examples.cn: 该国签署了一项减少[武器]生产的协议。

examples.en: The soldiers were [armed] with modern equipment.
examples.cn: 士兵们装备了现代化[武器]。

examples.en: She rested her book on the [arm] of the sofa while she read.
examples.cn: 她阅读时把书放在沙发的[扶手]上。

words.translation: n. 军队, 陆军
words.definition: n. a permanent organization of the military land forces of a nation or state\nn. a large number of people united for some specific purpose

examples.en: His grandfather served in the [army] for twenty years.
examples.cn: 他的祖父在[军队]服役了二十年。

examples.en: The [army] was called in to help after the natural disaster.
examples.cn: 自然灾害发生后，[军队]被调来协助救援。

examples.sense: n. 大批、大群（an army of）
examples.en: An [army] of volunteers helped clean up the beach after the storm.
examples.cn: 暴风雨过后，[大批]志愿者帮助清理了海滩。

examples.en: He decided to join the [army] after finishing high school.
examples.cn: 他决定高中毕业后参加[陆军]。

examples.en: [Army] training is very tough and requires a lot of discipline.
examples.cn: [军事]训练非常艰苦，需要很强的纪律性。

words.translation: prep. 包围, 在...周围, 四处\nadv. 兜着圈子, 在附近, 到处
words.definition:
r. by a circular or circuitous route
r. in a circle or circular motion
r. to a particular destination either specified or understood
r. in circumference

examples.en: The children sat [around] the table and played cards together.
examples.cn: 孩子们围坐在桌子[周围]一起打牌。

examples.en: There is a fence [around] the garden to keep animals out.
examples.cn: 花园[四周]有一圈围栏，防止动物进入。

examples.en: She walked [around] the city and took lots of photos.
examples.cn: 她在城市里[到处]走走，拍了很多照片。

examples.en: There were [around] two hundred people at the school concert.
examples.cn: 学校音乐会[大约]有两百人出席。

examples.sense: adv. 在附近（turn around 转身）
examples.en: He turned [around] when he heard someone call his name.
examples.cn: 听到有人叫他的名字，他[转过身]来。

words.translation: vi. 到达, 抵达
words.definition: v. reach a destination; arrive by movement or progress\nv. succeed in a big way; get to the top

examples.en: The train [arrives] at the station at eight o'clock every morning.
examples.cn: 火车每天早上八点[到达]车站。

examples.en: They [arrived] at the hotel just before midnight.
examples.cn: 他们在午夜前刚好[抵达]了酒店。

examples.sense: vi. 来临（事件/时间到来）
examples.en: Summer finally [arrived] and the children were excited about the holidays.
examples.cn: 夏天终于[来临]，孩子们对假期感到兴奋。

examples.sense: vi. 到达（arrive in 大地方）
examples.en: She [arrived] in Shanghai after a long flight from London.
examples.cn: 经过从伦敦出发的漫长飞行，她[抵达]了上海。

examples.sense: vi. 到达（arrive at 小地点/结论）
examples.en: After hours of discussion, we finally [arrived] at a decision.
examples.cn: 经过数小时的讨论，我们终于[得出]了一个决定。

words.translation: n. 艺术, 人文科学, 技术, 巧妙, 诡计, 美术\n[计] 实际保持时间, 特许权和资源表, 平均检索时间, 平均运行时间
words.definition: n. the products of human creativity; works of art collectively\nn. the creation of beautiful or significant things\nn. a superior skill that you can learn by study and practice and observation

examples.en: She is very talented in [art] and loves painting landscapes.
examples.cn: 她在[艺术]方面很有天赋，喜欢画风景画。

examples.en: Modern [art] can be difficult to understand at first.
examples.cn: 现代[艺术]一开始可能很难理解。

examples.en: [Art] is one of my favourite subjects because I love drawing.
examples.cn: [美术]是我最喜欢的科目之一，因为我喜欢画画。

examples.sense: n. 技巧、技术（the art of）
examples.en: Cooking well is an [art] that takes years of practice.
examples.cn: 做好饭是一门[技艺]，需要多年的练习。

examples.sense: n. 人文学科（arts 复数）
examples.en: She chose to study [arts] rather than science at university.
examples.cn: 她选择在大学学习[人文学科]而不是理科。

words.translation: n. 文章, 冠词, 物品, 物件, 条款, 契约\n[计] 信件
words.definition:
n. nonfictional prose forming an independent part of a publication
n. one of a class of artifacts
n. a separate section of a legal document (as a statute or contract or will)
n. (grammar) a determiner that may indicate the specificity of reference of a noun phrase

examples.en: She wrote an interesting [article] about recycling for the school magazine.
examples.cn: 她为学校杂志写了一篇关于回收利用的有趣[文章]。

examples.en: I read an [article] online about healthy eating habits.
examples.cn: 我在网上读了一篇关于健康饮食习惯的[文章]。

examples.en: In English, "a", "an", and "the" are called [articles].
examples.cn: 在英语中，a、an和the被称为[冠词]。

examples.en: She packed all her [articles] of clothing carefully before the trip.
examples.cn: 旅行前她仔细打包了所有衣物[物品]。

examples.en: Please read [article] three of the contract before you sign it.
examples.cn: 请在签字前阅读合同第三[条款]。

words.translation:
adv. 同样地, 例如
prep. 做为, 当作
conj. 当...之时, 以...的方式, 像...一样, 因为
[计] 高级系统, 先进系统, 辅助存储器, 自治系统
words.definition:
n a very poisonous metallic element that has three allotropic forms; arsenic and arsenic compounds are used as herbicides and insecticides and various alloys; found in arsenopyrite and orpiment and realgar
n a United States territory on the eastern part of the island of Samoa
n a metric unit of length equal to one ten billionth of a meter (or 0.0001 micron); used to specify wavelengths of electromagnetic radiation
n any of several fat-soluble vitamins essential for normal vision; prevents night blindness or inflammation or dryness of the eyes
n one of the four nucleotides used in building DNA; all four nucleotides have a common phosphate group and a sugar (ribose)
n (biochemistry) purine base found in DNA and RNA; pairs with thymine in DNA and with uracil in RNA
n the basic unit of electric current adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites
n the 1st letter of the Roman alphabet
n the blood group whose red cells carry the A antigen
r to the same degree (often followed by `as')

examples.en: She sings [as] beautifully as a professional singer.
examples.cn: 她唱歌唱得[像]专业歌手一样好。

examples.en: Please do [as] I say and everything will be fine.
examples.cn: 请[按照]我说的做，一切都会好的。

examples.en: She works [as] a volunteer at the local library every Saturday.
examples.cn: 她每个周六[作为]志愿者在当地图书馆服务。

examples.en: [As] she was walking to school, it started to rain.
examples.cn: [当]她走路去学校的时候，开始下雨了。

examples.en: [As] it was getting dark, we decided to head back home.
examples.cn: [由于]天色渐暗，我们决定回家。

words.translation: n. 亚洲
words.definition: n. the largest continent with 60% of the earth's population; it is joined to Europe on the west to form Eurasia; it is the site of some of the world's earliest civilizations\nn. the nations of the Asian continent collectively

examples.en: China, Japan, and India are all countries in [Asia].
examples.cn: 中国、日本和印度都是[亚洲]的国家。

examples.en: [Asia] is the largest and most populous continent in the world.
examples.cn: [亚洲]是世界上最大、人口最多的大洲。

examples.en: Southeast [Asia] is known for its beautiful beaches and tropical climate.
examples.cn: 东南[亚]以美丽的海滩和热带气候而闻名。

examples.en: [Asia] has a rich variety of cultures, languages, and traditions.
examples.cn: [亚洲]拥有丰富多样的文化、语言和传统。

examples.en: Mount Everest, the world's highest mountain, is located in [Asia].
examples.cn: 世界最高峰珠穆朗玛峰位于[亚洲]。

words.translation: n. 亚洲人\na. 亚洲的, 亚洲人的
words.definition: n. a native or inhabitant of Asia\na. of or relating to or characteristic of Asia or the peoples of Asia or their languages or culture

examples.en: [Asian] food is popular all over the world, especially Chinese and Japanese cuisine.
examples.cn: [亚洲]食物在全世界广受欢迎，尤其是中餐和日餐。

examples.en: She is studying [Asian] history as part of her course.
examples.cn: 她正在学习[亚洲]历史，这是她课程的一部分。

examples.en: He is an [Asian] who grew up in Tokyo and now lives in London.
examples.cn: 他是一个在东京长大、现在住在伦敦的[亚洲人]。

examples.en: The class has students from many backgrounds, including several [Asians].
examples.cn: 班上有来自不同背景的学生，其中包括几位[亚洲人]。

examples.sense: a. 亚洲特色的（文化/传统）
examples.en: The festival included many [Asian] cultural performances, such as dragon dancing.
examples.cn: 节日中包含了许多[亚洲]文化表演，比如舞龙。

words.translation: vi. 问, 要求\nvt. 问, 要求, 邀请, 需要
words.definition:
v. inquire about
v. make a request or demand for something to somebody
v. direct or put; seek an answer to
v. consider obligatory; request and expect

examples.en: She [asked] the teacher why the sky is blue.
examples.cn: 她[问]老师为什么天空是蓝色的。

examples.en: Don't be afraid to [ask] questions if you don't understand.
examples.cn: 如果不明白，不要害怕[提问]。

examples.en: He [asked] his parents for permission to go on the school trip.
examples.cn: 他[请求]父母允许他参加学校旅行。

examples.en: She [asked] her classmates to her birthday party on Saturday.
examples.cn: 她[邀请]同学们参加她周六的生日派对。

examples.sense: vi. 问（ask for 请求得到）
examples.en: He went to the counter to [ask] for information about the bus schedule.
examples.cn: 他走到柜台[询问]关于公共汽车时刻表的信息。

words.translation: a. 睡着的, 长眠的, 麻木的\nadv. 熟睡地
words.definition:
a. in a state of sleep
s. lacking sensation
s. dead
r. into a sleeping state

examples.en: The baby was [asleep] in the cot when we arrived.
examples.cn: 我们到达时，婴儿正[睡着]在摇篮里。

examples.en: He was so tired that he fell [asleep] on the sofa.
examples.cn: 他太累了，在沙发上[睡着]了。

examples.en: The children were fast [asleep] by the time the film ended.
examples.cn: 电影结束时，孩子们早已[熟睡]了。

examples.en: She found it hard to fall [asleep] the night before the exam.
examples.cn: 考试前一晚，她很难[入睡]。

examples.en: My foot went [asleep] after I sat in the same position for too long.
examples.cn: 我坐了太久同一个姿势，脚[麻]了。

words.translation: prep. 在, 向, 对\n[计] 地址转换器, 异常传输, 自动订票
words.definition: n. 100 at equal 1 kip in Laos

examples.en: Let's meet [at] the school gate at half past eight.
examples.cn: 我们[在]校门口八点半见面吧。

examples.en: She was sitting [at] her desk when the phone rang.
examples.cn: 电话响起时，她正坐[在]桌边。

examples.en: The lesson starts [at] nine o'clock every morning.
examples.cn: 每天早上课程[在]九点开始。

examples.en: He threw the ball [at] the wall to practise his aim.
examples.cn: 他把球扔[向]墙壁练习瞄准。

examples.en: She is very good [at] maths and always gets high marks.
examples.cn: 她[在]数学方面很好，总是得高分。

words.translation: n. 大西洋\na. 大西洋的
words.definition: n. the 2nd largest ocean; separates North and South America on the west from Europe and Africa on the east\na. relating to or bordering the Atlantic Ocean

examples.en: The ship sailed across the [Atlantic] from England to America.
examples.cn: 这艘船从英国横渡[大西洋]驶向美国。

examples.en: The [Atlantic] Ocean separates Europe and Africa from the Americas.
examples.cn: [大西洋]将欧洲和非洲与美洲分隔开来。

examples.en: [Atlantic] storms can bring very heavy rain to the west coast of Europe.
examples.cn: [大西洋]风暴会给欧洲西海岸带来大量降雨。

examples.en: Many [Atlantic] coast countries depend on fishing as a key industry.
examples.cn: 许多[大西洋]沿岸国家依赖捕鱼作为重要产业。

examples.en: A transatlantic flight crosses the [Atlantic] in about seven to eight hours.
examples.cn: 跨[大西洋]航班大约需要七到八个小时。

words.translation: n. 注意, 注意力\n[计] 引起注意信号
words.definition:
n. the process whereby a person concentrates on some features of the environment to the (relative) exclusion of others
n. a general interest that leads people to want to know more
n. a courteous act indicating affection
n. the faculty or power of mental concentration

examples.en: Please pay [attention] to what the teacher is saying.
examples.cn: 请[注意]听老师讲的内容。

examples.en: The bright poster caught everyone's [attention] immediately.
examples.cn: 那张鲜艳的海报立刻吸引了所有人的[注意力]。

examples.en: Young children need a lot of [attention] and care from their parents.
examples.cn: 小孩子需要父母给予大量的[关心]和照料。

examples.en: The new art exhibition drew a lot of [attention] from local residents.
examples.cn: 新的艺术展览吸引了当地居民的大量[关注]。

examples.sense: n. 注意（call sb's attention to 提醒注意）
examples.en: The teacher called our [attention] to a key rule in the grammar book.
examples.cn: 老师提醒我们[注意]语法书中的一条重要规则。

words.translation: n. 八月\na. 威严的, 令人敬畏的
words.definition: n. the month following July and preceding September\ns. of or befitting a lord\ns. profoundly honored

examples.en: School usually starts again in [August] after the summer break.
examples.cn: 暑假后学校通常在[八月]重新开学。

examples.en: The weather in [August] is usually hot and sunny in most of China.
examples.cn: 在中国大部分地区，[八月]的天气通常炎热而晴朗。

examples.en: The Olympic Games in Beijing were held in [August] 2008.
examples.cn: 北京奥运会于2008年[八月]举行。

examples.en: Every [August], our family goes on a camping trip in the mountains.
examples.cn: 每年[八月]，我们全家都会去山里露营。

examples.sense: a. 威严的、令人敬畏的
examples.en: The headmaster had an [august] manner that made everyone feel respectful.
examples.cn: 校长有一种[威严]的气质，让每个人都心生敬意。

words.translation: n. 阿姨, 姨妈, 舅妈, 姑妈, 伯母
words.definition: n. the sister of your father or mother; the wife of your uncle

examples.sense: n. 姑妈/姨妈/舅妈/伯母
examples.en: My [aunt] baked a delicious cake for my birthday party.
examples.cn: 我[姨妈]为我的生日派对烤了一个美味的蛋糕。

examples.sense: n. 姑妈/姨妈/舅妈/伯母
examples.en: I visit my [aunt] and uncle every Chinese New Year.
examples.cn: 我每年春节都会去看望[姑妈]和姑父。

examples.en: My [aunt] on my father's side lives in another city.
examples.cn: 我父亲那边的[姑妈]住在另一座城市。

examples.en: My [aunt] on my mother's side teaches at a primary school.
examples.cn: 我母亲那边的[阿姨]在一所小学教书。

examples.sense: n. 阿姨（亲切称呼长辈女性）
examples.en: The kind [aunt] next door always gives us fruit from her garden.
examples.cn: 隔壁亲切的[阿姨]总是把花园里的水果送给我们。

words.translation: n. 澳洲, 澳大利亚
words.definition: n. a nation occupying the whole of the Australian continent; Aboriginal tribes are thought to have migrated from southeastern Asia 20,000 years ago; first Europeans were British convicts sent there as a penal colony\nn. the smallest continent; between the South Pacific and the Indian Ocean

examples.en: Kangaroos and koalas are animals that only live in [Australia].
examples.cn: 袋鼠和考拉是只生活在[澳大利亚]的动物。

examples.en: [Australia] is both a country and a continent in the Southern Hemisphere.
examples.cn: [澳大利亚]既是一个国家，也是南半球的一片大陆。

examples.sense: n. 澳大利亚（旅游/留学）
examples.en: She plans to study English in [Australia] for a year.
examples.cn: 她计划去[澳大利亚]学习一年英语。

examples.sense: n. 澳大利亚（气候/地理）
examples.en: The climate of [Australia] ranges from tropical in the north to desert in the centre.
examples.cn: [澳大利亚]的气候从北部的热带到中部的沙漠各有不同。

examples.en: [Australia] is famous for being very strong in swimming and cricket.
examples.cn: [澳大利亚]在游泳和板球方面以实力强劲著称。

words.translation: n. 澳大利亚人\na. 澳大利亚的, 澳洲的, 澳洲人的
words.definition: n. a native or inhabitant of Australia\nn. the Austronesian languages spoken by Australian aborigines\na. of or relating to or characteristic of Australia or its inhabitants or its languages

examples.en: [Australian] beaches are known for their clear blue water and white sand.
examples.cn: [澳大利亚]的海滩以清澈的蓝色海水和白色沙滩著称。

examples.en: She has been learning [Australian] English and loves the accent.
examples.cn: 她一直在学习[澳大利亚]英语，很喜欢那种口音。

examples.en: He met an [Australian] at the conference who worked as a marine biologist.
examples.cn: 他在会议上认识了一位从事海洋生物学研究的[澳大利亚人]。

examples.en: The [Australians] at our school are very friendly and outgoing.
examples.cn: 我们学校的[澳大利亚人]非常友善开朗。

examples.sense: a. 澳大利亚特色的（文化/食物）
examples.en: [Australian] barbecues are a popular social tradition on weekends.
examples.cn: [澳大利亚]烧烤是周末流行的社交传统。

words.translation: n. 秋天, 成熟期
words.definition: n the season when the leaves fall from the trees

examples.en: The leaves turn red and yellow in [autumn].
examples.cn: [秋天]树叶变成红色和黄色。

examples.en: We go apple picking every [autumn] in the countryside.
examples.cn: 每年[秋天]我们都去乡下摘苹果。

examples.sense: n. 秋季（in autumn 在秋季）
examples.en: The weather gets cooler and drier in [autumn] in northern China.
examples.cn: 在中国北方，[秋季]天气变得更凉爽干燥。

examples.en: The park is most beautiful in [autumn] when the trees are colourful.
examples.cn: 公园在[秋天]最美，那时树木色彩斑斓。

examples.sense: n. 成熟期（比喻人生秋天）
examples.en: He is in the [autumn] of his career but is still very productive.
examples.cn: 他正处于职业生涯的[成熟期]，但依然非常高产。

words.translation: a. 可利用的, 可获得的, 有效的\n[医] 有效的, 可得的
words.definition: a. obtainable or accessible and ready for use or service\ns. not busy; not otherwise committed\ns. convenient for use or disposal

examples.sense: a. 可获得的、可得到的
examples.en: Are there any tickets still [available] for tomorrow's concert?
examples.cn: 明天的音乐会还有[可购]的票吗？

examples.sense: a. 可获得的、可得到的
examples.en: Fresh vegetables are [available] at the market every morning.
examples.cn: 每天早上集市上都有新鲜蔬菜[供应]。

examples.en: I'm not [available] this afternoon; can we meet tomorrow instead?
examples.cn: 我今天下午没有[空]，我们能改到明天见面吗？

examples.sense: a. 可使用的、可利用的
examples.en: The school library is [available] to all students from 8 am to 6 pm.
examples.cn: 学校图书馆从早上八点到晚上六点对所有学生[开放]。

examples.en: Many useful tools are [available] online to help students learn English.
examples.cn: 网上有许多[可用]的工具帮助学生学习英语。

words.translation: vt. 避免, 防止, 撤消\n[法] 避免, 回避, 躲开
words.definition: v. stay clear from; keep away from; keep out of the way of someone or something\nv. refrain from doing something

examples.en: You should [avoid] eating too much sugar to stay healthy.
examples.cn: 为了保持健康，你应该[避免]摄入过多糖分。

examples.en: She managed to [avoid] being late by leaving home earlier.
examples.cn: 她通过早点出门成功[避免]了迟到。

examples.en: He took a different route to [avoid] the heavy traffic on the main road.
examples.cn: 他走了另一条路，[绕开]主干道上的拥堵。

examples.en: She felt something was wrong because he kept [avoiding] her gaze.
examples.cn: 她感觉有些不对劲，因为他一直[回避]她的目光。

examples.en: Washing your hands frequently can [avoid] the spread of germs.
examples.cn: 勤洗手可以[预防]细菌传播。

words.translation: a. 醒着的\nvt. 唤醒, 唤起, 使意识到\nvi. 醒来, 被唤起, 意识到
words.definition: a. not in a state of sleep; completely conscious

examples.en: Are you [awake]? I thought you had fallen asleep.
examples.cn: 你[醒着]吗？我以为你已经睡着了。

examples.en: She was still [awake] at midnight, reading by lamplight.
examples.cn: 她在午夜还[醒着]，在灯下读书。

examples.en: He [awoke] from a deep sleep to the sound of birds singing.
examples.cn: 他从熟睡中[醒来]，听到了鸟儿的歌声。

examples.en: The loud thunder [awoke] everyone in the house.
examples.cn: 震耳欲聋的雷声[惊醒]了屋里的每一个人。

examples.en: She slowly [awoke] to the fact that she needed to study harder.
examples.cn: 她慢慢[意识到]自己需要更加努力学习。

words.translation: adv. 离去
words.definition:
s. not present; having left
a. used of an opponent's ground
s. (of a baseball pitch) on the far side of home plate from the batter
r. from a particular thing or place or position (`forth' is obsolete)

examples.en: She turned and walked [away] without saying a word.
examples.cn: 她转身[走开]，一句话也没说。

examples.en: Please put your books [away] when the lesson is finished.
examples.cn: 课结束后请把书[收起来]。

examples.en: My grandparents live far [away] in the countryside.
examples.cn: 我的祖父母住在远处的农村。

examples.en: My teacher was [away] last week due to illness.
examples.cn: 我的老师上周因病[不在]。

examples.en: She worked [away] at her project until she finally finished it.
examples.cn: 她一直[不停地]做她的项目，直到最终完成。

words.translation: n. 婴孩\n[医] 婴儿
words.definition:
n. a very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk
n. the youngest member of a group (not necessarily young)
n. an unborn child; a human fetus
n. (slang) sometimes used as a term of address for attractive young women

examples.en: The [baby] smiled at her mother for the first time.
examples.cn: [婴儿]第一次对妈妈微笑了。

examples.en: The [baby] cried all night and the parents were very tired.
examples.cn: [宝宝]哭了整晚，父母都累坏了。

examples.sense: n. 婴儿（baby food/baby clothes 婴儿用品）
examples.en: She bought some [baby] clothes for her newborn nephew.
examples.cn: 她给新生侄子买了一些[婴儿]衣物。

examples.en: A [baby] panda was born at the zoo last spring.
examples.cn: 去年春天，动物园里诞生了一只[熊猫幼崽]。

examples.sense: n. 最小的成员（the baby of the family）
examples.en: She is the [baby] of the family and is spoiled by everyone.
examples.cn: 她是家里[最小的孩子]，被所有人宠着。

words.translation:
a. 后面的
vt. 使后退, 支持
vi. 倒退, 背靠
adv. 向后地
n. 背部, 后面
words.definition:
n. the posterior part of a human (or animal) body from the neck to the end of the spine
n. the part of something that is furthest from the normal viewer
n. (football) a person who plays in the backfield
n. the part of a garment that covers the back of your body

examples.en: She hurt her [back] when she was moving the heavy furniture.
examples.cn: 她在搬重家具时伤了[背部]。

examples.en: He carried the heavy bag on his [back] all the way home.
examples.cn: 他把重包一路背在[背上]走回了家。

examples.en: She sat at the [back] of the classroom so she could see the board clearly.
examples.cn: 她坐在教室[后面]，这样能看清黑板。

examples.en: He gave the book [back] to the library on time.
examples.cn: 他按时把书[还]给了图书馆。

examples.en: Her classmates [backed] her up when she presented her idea.
examples.cn: 她提出想法时，同学们[支持]了她。

words.translation: n. 背景, 背景资料\n[计] 背景, 后台
words.definition:
n. a person's social heritage: previous experience or training
n. the part of a scene (or picture) that lies behind objects in the foreground
n. information that is essential to understanding a situation or problem
n. extraneous signals that can be confused with the phenomenon to be observed or measured

examples.en: The photo shows the mountains in the [background] behind the family.
examples.cn: 照片中家人身后的[背景]是连绵的山脉。

examples.en: She chose a blue [background] for her presentation slides.
examples.cn: 她为演示幻灯片选择了蓝色[背景]。

examples.en: Students from all [backgrounds] are welcome at this school.
examples.cn: 各种[背景]的学生都受到这所学校的欢迎。

examples.sense: n. 背景资料、相关信息
examples.en: Let me give you some [background] on the topic before we begin.
examples.cn: 在开始之前，让我给你介绍一些关于这个话题的[背景]信息。

examples.sense: n. 幕后、不显眼处（in the background）
examples.en: She prefers to work in the [background] and let others take the credit.
examples.cn: 她更喜欢在[幕后]工作，让别人去出风头。

words.translation: a. 坏的\nn. 坏\nadv. 坏地
words.definition:
n. that which is below standard or expectations as of ethics or decency
a. having undesirable or negative qualities
s. very intense
s. feeling physical discomfort or pain (`tough' is occasionally used colloquially for `bad')

examples.en: The weather was so [bad] that we couldn't go outside to play.
examples.cn: 天气太[糟糕]了，我们没法出去玩。

examples.en: He got a [bad] mark on the test because he hadn't studied enough.
examples.cn: 他考试得了一个[很差]的成绩，因为他没有充分备考。

examples.en: Eating too much junk food is [bad] for your health.
examples.cn: 吃太多垃圾食品对健康[有害]。

examples.en: She had a [bad] cold and had to stay in bed for three days.
examples.cn: 她得了[严重的]感冒，不得不卧床三天。

examples.en: The milk smells [bad]; I think it has gone off.
examples.cn: 牛奶闻起来[变味了]；我觉得它已经坏了。

words.translation: n. 袋子, 袋状物\nvt. 使膨大, 装袋, 猎获
words.definition:
n. a flexible container with a single opening
n. the quantity of game taken in a particular period (usually by one person)
n. a container used for carrying money and small personal items or accessories (especially by women)
n. the quantity that a bag will hold

examples.en: She put all her books into her school [bag] and left for class.
examples.cn: 她把所有书放进书[包]，去上课了。

examples.en: He carried a heavy [bag] of groceries from the supermarket.
examples.cn: 他从超市提了一大[袋]食品杂货。

examples.en: She lost her [bag] on the bus and had to cancel her bank cards.
examples.cn: 她在公交车上丢失了手[包]，不得不挂失银行卡。

examples.en: Please pack your [bag] the night before the school trip.
examples.cn: 请在学校旅行前一晚收拾好你的[行李包]。

examples.en: The shop assistant [bagged] the items quickly and handed them over.
examples.cn: 售货员迅速将物品[装袋]并递了过来。

words.translation: n. 球, 舞会, 球状物\nv. 捏成球形
words.definition:
n. round object that is hit or thrown or kicked in games
n. an object with a spherical shape
n. the people assembled at a lavish formal dance
n. a spherical object used as a plaything

examples.en: He kicked the [ball] into the goal and the crowd cheered loudly.
examples.cn: 他把[球]踢进了球门，观众们大声欢呼。

examples.en: Can you throw the [ball] back to me? I need to practise my catching.
examples.cn: 你能把[球]扔回给我吗？我需要练习接球。

examples.en: She rolled the dough into small [balls] before putting them in the oven.
examples.cn: 她把面团揉成小[球状]再放入烤箱。

examples.en: The school held a [ball] at the end of the year to celebrate graduation.
examples.cn: 学校在年底举办了一场[舞会]庆祝毕业。

examples.sense: n. 好时光（have a ball 玩得开心）
examples.en: We had a [ball] at the amusement park last weekend.
examples.cn: 我们上周末在游乐场[玩得非常开心]。

words.translation: n. 气球\nvt. 使成气球状\nvi. 膨胀如气球, 激增
words.definition:
n. large tough nonrigid bag filled with gas or heated air
n. small thin inflatable rubber bag with narrow neck
v. ride in a hot-air balloon
v. become inflated

examples.en: The children let go of their [balloons] and watched them float into the sky.
examples.cn: 孩子们放开[气球]，看着它们飘向天空。

examples.en: The party room was decorated with colourful [balloons] and streamers.
examples.cn: 派对室里装饰着五颜六色的[气球]和彩带。

examples.en: They took a [balloon] ride over the valley at sunrise.
examples.cn: 他们在日出时乘[热气球]飞越山谷。

examples.sense: vi. 急剧增加、膨胀（balloon vi.）
examples.en: The cost of the project [ballooned] far beyond what was originally planned.
examples.cn: 项目成本[急剧膨胀]，远超原定计划。

examples.sense: n. 气球（飘起来的比喻）
examples.en: His hopes [ballooned] when he heard there was a chance to win first prize.
examples.cn: 听说有机会获得一等奖，他的希望[膨胀]了起来。

words.translation: n. 竹子\n[医] 竹类
words.definition: n. the hard woody stems of bamboo plants; used in construction and crafts and fishing poles\nn. woody tropical grass having hollow woody stems; mature canes used for construction and furniture

examples.en: Giant pandas love eating [bamboo] shoots and leaves.
examples.cn: 大熊猫喜欢吃[竹子]的嫩芽和叶子。

examples.en: [Bamboo] grows very fast and can reach full height in just a few months.
examples.cn: [竹子]生长非常快，仅需几个月就能长到全高。

examples.sense: n. 竹材（建筑/家具用途）
examples.en: The bridge was built using [bamboo], which is both strong and flexible.
examples.cn: 这座桥用[竹子]建造，既坚固又有弹性。

examples.en: Many people now use [bamboo] products instead of plastic to help the environment.
examples.cn: 现在很多人使用[竹制]品代替塑料，帮助保护环境。

examples.sense: n. 竹子（中国文化象征）
examples.en: In Chinese culture, [bamboo] represents strength and flexibility.
examples.cn: 在中国文化中，[竹子]象征着坚韧和柔韧。

words.translation: n. 香蕉
words.definition: n. any of several tropical and subtropical treelike herbs of the genus Musa having a terminal crown of large entire leaves and usually bearing hanging clusters of elongated fruits\nn. elongated crescent-shaped yellow fruit with soft sweet flesh

examples.en: She peeled a [banana] and ate it as a snack before class.
examples.cn: 她剥了一根[香蕉]，在上课前当零食吃了。

examples.en: [Bananas] are a good source of energy and are easy to carry.
examples.cn: [香蕉]是很好的能量来源，而且方便携带。

examples.en: A ripe [banana] turns yellow and soft, which means it is ready to eat.
examples.cn: 成熟的[香蕉]变成黄色且变软，说明可以吃了。

examples.en: She made a [banana] smoothie with milk and honey for breakfast.
examples.cn: 她用牛奶和蜂蜜做了一杯[香蕉]奶昔当早餐。

examples.en: [Bananas] grow in tropical countries where the weather is warm and wet.
examples.cn: [香蕉]生长在天气温暖湿润的热带国家。

words.translation: n. 银行, 堤, 岸\n[医] 库
words.definition:
n. sloping land (especially the slope beside a body of water)
n. a long ridge or pile
