n. an arrangement of similar objects in a row or in tiers
n. a supply or stock held in reserve for future use (especially in emergencies)

examples.en: She went to the [bank] to withdraw some money for the trip.
examples.cn: 她去[银行]取了一些旅行用的钱。

examples.en: He opened a savings account at the [bank] last week.
examples.cn: 他上周在[银行]开了一个储蓄账户。

examples.en: We sat on the [bank] of the river and watched the sunset.
examples.cn: 我们坐在河[岸]上，看着夕阳西下。

examples.en: The hospital has a blood [bank] that saves many lives every year.
examples.cn: 医院有一个血[库]，每年拯救了许多生命。

examples.en: He [banked] his birthday money instead of spending it straight away.
examples.cn: 他把生日收到的钱[存进了银行]，而不是马上花掉。

words.translation: n. 棒球\n[计] 棒球系统
words.definition: n. a ball game played with a bat and ball between two teams of nine players; teams take turns at bat trying to score runs\nn. a ball used in playing baseball

examples.en: He has been playing [baseball] since he was six years old.
examples.cn: 他从六岁起就开始打[棒球]了。

examples.en: [Baseball] is the most popular sport in the United States.
examples.cn: [棒球]是美国最受欢迎的运动。

examples.en: He caught the [baseball] with one hand and the crowd went wild.
examples.cn: 他单手接住了[棒球]，观众们沸腾了。

examples.en: The school [baseball] team won the regional championship this year.
examples.cn: 学校[棒球]队今年赢得了地区冠军。

examples.en: She got a [baseball] cap and glove as a birthday gift.
examples.cn: 她收到了一顶[棒球]帽和一副手套作为生日礼物。

words.translation: n. 基本原理, 要素, 基本规律\na. 基本的, 碱性的\n(计算机)BASIC语言
words.definition:
n. a popular programming language that is relatively easy to learn; an acronym for beginner's all-purpose symbolic instruction code; no longer in general use
n. (usually plural) a necessary commodity for which demand is constant
a. pertaining to or constituting a base or basis
s. reduced to the simplest and most significant form possible without loss of generality

examples.en: You need to learn the [basic] rules of grammar before writing essays.
examples.cn: 写作文之前，你需要先学习[基本]的语法规则。

examples.en: Food, water, and shelter are the most [basic] needs of humans.
examples.cn: 食物、水和住所是人类最[基本]的需求。

examples.en: This is a [basic] English course suitable for complete beginners.
examples.cn: 这是一门适合完全初学者的[基础]英语课程。

examples.en: Once you understand the [basics] of cooking, you can try harder recipes.
examples.cn: 一旦你掌握了烹饪的[基本原理]，就可以尝试更难的食谱。

examples.sense: a. 最重要的（basic to sth）
examples.en: Honesty is [basic] to building a trusting relationship.
examples.cn: 诚实是建立信任关系的[根本]。

words.translation: n. 篮, 篮子\nvt. 装入篮
words.definition:
n. a container that is usually woven and has handles
n. the quantity contained in a basket
n. horizontal circular metal hoop supporting a net through which players try to throw the basketball
n. a score in basketball made by throwing the ball through the hoop

examples.en: She carried a [basket] of fresh fruit to the market.
examples.cn: 她提着一[篮]新鲜水果去集市。

examples.en: He put all the dirty clothes into the washing [basket].
examples.cn: 他把所有脏衣服都放进了洗衣[篮]。

examples.sense: n. 篮球得分（score a basket）
examples.en: He scored the final [basket] and his team won the match.
examples.cn: 他投进了最后一个[球]，他的队伍赢得了比赛。

examples.en: The gift shop sold beautiful hand-woven [baskets] made by local artists.
examples.cn: 礼品店出售当地艺术家手工编织的精美[篮子]。

examples.en: She grabbed a shopping [basket] and walked through the supermarket.
examples.cn: 她拿起一个购物[篮]，在超市里逛了起来。

words.translation: n. 篮球
words.definition: n. a game played on a court by two opposing teams of 5 players; points are scored by throwing the ball through an elevated horizontal hoop\nn. an inflated ball used in playing basketball

examples.en: He practises [basketball] for two hours every day after school.
examples.cn: 他每天放学后练习两小时[篮球]。

examples.en: [Basketball] is one of the most popular sports among young people in China.
examples.cn: [篮球]是中国年轻人中最受欢迎的运动之一。

examples.en: She bounced the [basketball] three times before throwing it at the hoop.
examples.cn: 她在投篮前把[篮球]弹地三次。

examples.en: He joined the school [basketball] team after passing the tryout.
examples.cn: 他通过了选拔赛后加入了学校[篮球]队。

examples.en: We watched an exciting [basketball] game on TV last night.
examples.cn: 我们昨晚在电视上看了一场精彩的[篮球]比赛。

words.translation: n. 浴室, 厕所
words.definition: n. a room (as in a residence) containing a bathtub or shower and usually a washbasin and toilet

examples.en: She spent twenty minutes in the [bathroom] getting ready for school.
examples.cn: 她在[浴室]花了二十分钟准备上学。

examples.en: Could you please clean the [bathroom] before our guests arrive?
examples.cn: 客人来之前你能打扫一下[浴室]吗？

examples.en: Excuse me, could you tell me where the [bathroom] is?
examples.cn: 请问，您能告诉我[洗手间]在哪里吗？

examples.en: The new apartment has two [bathrooms], which is very convenient.
examples.cn: 这套新公寓有两个[浴室]，非常方便。

examples.sense: n. 浴室（go to the bathroom 上厕所）
examples.en: May I go to the [bathroom]? I'll be back in a minute.
examples.cn: 我可以去一下[洗手间]吗？马上回来。

words.translation: v. 是, 表示, 在\n[计] 后端, 总线允许
words.definition:
v. have the quality of being; (copula, used with an adjective or a predicate noun)
v. be identical to; be someone or something
v. occupy a certain position or area; be somewhere
v. happen, occur, take place; this was during the visit to my parents' house"

examples.en: She wants to [be] a doctor when she grows up.
examples.cn: 她长大后想[成为]一名医生。

examples.en: He is the tallest student in our class and [is] very good at sport.
examples.cn: 他[是]我们班个子最高的学生，体育也很好。

examples.en: Where will you [be] this weekend? I'd like to meet up.
examples.cn: 你这周末[在]哪里？我想约你见面。

examples.en: There will [be] a school play next Friday evening.
examples.cn: 下周五晚上将[有]一场学校话剧演出。

examples.sense: v. 构成进行时/被动语态（助动词）
examples.en: The students are [being] very quiet during the exam.
examples.cn: 考试期间，学生们都很安静。

words.translation: n. 海滩
words.definition: n. an area of sand sloping down to the water of a sea or lake\nv. land on a beach

examples.en: We spent the whole day at the [beach] swimming and playing in the sand.
examples.cn: 我们在[海滩]上游泳玩沙子，度过了整整一天。

examples.en: The [beach] was crowded with tourists during the summer holidays.
examples.cn: 暑假期间[海滩]上挤满了游客。

examples.sense: n. 海滩（沙滩日落/景色）
examples.en: They watched the sunset from the [beach] and took lots of photos.
examples.cn: 他们在[海滩]上观看日落，拍了很多照片。

examples.en: Beach volleyball is a fun sport you can play on the [beach].
examples.cn: 沙滩排球是一种可以在[海滩]上玩的有趣运动。

examples.en: The strong waves [beached] the small boat on the shore.
examples.cn: 强浪把小船[冲上]了岸边。

words.translation:
n. 心跳(声), 打, 敲打声, 拍子
v. 打, 拍打, 打败
a. 疲乏的, 颓废的
beat的过去式
[计] 拍; 节拍
words.definition:
n. a regular route for a sentry or policeman
n. a single pulsation of an oscillation produced by adding two waves of different frequencies; has a frequency equal to the difference between the two oscillations
n. the sound of stroke or blow
n. a regular rate of repetition

examples.en: Our team [beat] the other school in the final football match.
examples.cn: 我们队在决赛中[打败]了另一所学校。

examples.en: She [beat] her personal record in the swimming competition.
examples.cn: 她在游泳比赛中[打破]了自己的个人纪录。

examples.en: He [beat] the drum loudly at the school parade.
examples.cn: 他在学校游行中大声[敲打]鼓。

examples.en: She clapped her hands to the [beat] of the music.
examples.cn: 她随着音乐的[节拍]鼓掌。

examples.en: The doctor listened to the patient's heart [beat] carefully.
examples.cn: 医生仔细地听了病人的心[跳]。

words.translation: a. 美丽的
words.definition: a. delighting the senses or exciting intellectual or emotional admiration\ns. (of weather) highly enjoyable

examples.en: The garden was filled with [beautiful] flowers of all colours.
examples.cn: 花园里开满了各种颜色的[美丽]花朵。

examples.en: She wore a [beautiful] blue dress to the school concert.
examples.cn: 她穿着一条[漂亮]的蓝色连衣裙去参加学校音乐会。

examples.en: It was a [beautiful] sunny day, perfect for a picnic in the park.
examples.cn: 天气[晴朗美好]，非常适合在公园野餐。

examples.en: She has a [beautiful] singing voice that moves everyone who hears it.
examples.cn: 她有一把[美妙]的歌喉，每个听到的人都深受感动。

examples.sense: a. 令人赞叹的（品质/行为）
examples.en: What a [beautiful] thing to do — she gave all her prize money to charity.
examples.cn: 她把所有奖金都捐给了慈善机构，真是一件[美好]的事。

words.translation: conj. 因为
words.definition: conj. By or for the cause that; on this account that; for the\n   reason that.\nconj. In order that; that.

examples.en: She stayed home [because] she was feeling unwell.
examples.cn: 她留在家里，[因为]她感觉不舒服。

examples.en: He was late to school [because] he missed the bus.
examples.cn: 他上学迟到了，[因为]他没赶上公交车。

examples.sense: conj. 因为（because of 短语介词）
examples.en: The match was cancelled [because] of the heavy rain.
examples.cn: 比赛因为大雨被取消了。

examples.en: "Why did you choose this school?" "[Because] it has an excellent maths department."
examples.cn: "你为什么选择这所学校？""[因为]它有一个出色的数学系。"

examples.sense: conj. 说明原因（not because...but because）
examples.en: She studies hard not [because] she has to, but because she loves learning.
examples.cn: 她努力学习不是[因为]她必须这样做，而是因为她热爱学习。

words.translation: vi. 变成, 变得\nvt. 适合
words.definition:
v. enter or assume a certain state or condition
v. undergo a change or development
v. come into existence
v. enhance the appearance of

examples.en: She worked very hard and [became] the top student in her class.
examples.cn: 她非常努力，[成为]了班里成绩最好的学生。

examples.en: The weather [became] colder as we walked further into the mountains.
examples.cn: 随着我们走进山里，天气[变得]越来越冷。

examples.en: He [became] very nervous when he heard his name called on stage.
examples.cn: 听到自己名字在台上被叫到时，他[变得]非常紧张。

examples.en: That bright colour really [becomes] her; she looks wonderful.
examples.cn: 那种鲜艳的颜色真的很[适合]她，她看起来棒极了。

examples.en: I wonder what [became] of my old classmates from primary school.
examples.cn: 我不知道我小学的老同学们[后来怎么样]了。

words.translation: n. 床, 睡眠处, 河床, 底座, 路基, 一层\nvt. 提供宿处, 栽种, 安装\nvi. 睡, 形成坚实的一层
words.definition:
n. a piece of furniture that provides a place to sleep
n. a plot of ground in which plants are growing
n. a depression forming the ground under a body of water
n. (geology) a stratum of rock (especially sedimentary rock)

examples.en: She made her [bed] every morning before going to school.
examples.cn: 她每天早上上学前都会整理[床铺]。

examples.en: He was so tired that he went straight to [bed] after dinner.
examples.cn: 他太累了，晚饭后直接上[床]睡觉了。

examples.en: She planted roses in the flower [bed] in front of the house.
examples.cn: 她在房子前面的花[圃]里种了玫瑰。

examples.en: The river [bed] was dry because there had been no rain for months.
examples.cn: 由于数月没有降雨，河[床]干涸了。

examples.en: Scientists explored the sea [bed] to find new forms of life.
examples.cn: 科学家们探索海[床]以寻找新的生命形式。

words.translation: n. 卧室
words.definition: n. a room used primarily for sleeping

examples.en: She decorated her [bedroom] with posters of her favourite singers.
examples.cn: 她用最喜欢的歌手的海报装饰了自己的[卧室]。

examples.en: He does all his homework at the desk in his [bedroom].
examples.cn: 他所有作业都在[卧室]的书桌上完成。

examples.en: They moved to a larger house with three [bedrooms] for the growing family.
examples.cn: 他们搬到了一间有三间[卧室]的更大房子，以满足家庭需要。

examples.en: She looked out of her [bedroom] window and saw it was snowing.
examples.cn: 她望向[卧室]窗外，看到外面在下雪。

examples.en: Please knock before entering my [bedroom].
examples.cn: 进入我的[卧室]之前请先敲门。

words.translation: n. 蜜蜂, 聚会
words.definition: n. any of numerous hairy-bodied insects including social and solitary species\nn. a social gathering to carry out some communal task or to hold competitions

examples.en: A [bee] landed on the flower and started collecting nectar.
examples.cn: 一只[蜜蜂]停在花上，开始采集花蜜。

examples.en: Don't wave your arms when a [bee] is nearby; it may sting you.
examples.cn: [蜜蜂]在附近时不要挥动手臂，它可能会蜇你。

examples.en: She is as busy as a [bee], always working on several projects at once.
examples.cn: 她像[蜜蜂]一样忙碌，总是同时进行好几个项目。

examples.en: [Bees] produce honey, which is a natural and healthy sweetener.
examples.cn: [蜜蜂]产出蜂蜜，这是一种天然健康的甜味剂。

examples.sense: n. 聚会（spelling bee 拼词比赛）
examples.en: She won the school spelling [bee] by spelling every word correctly.
examples.cn: 她拼写了所有单词，赢得了学校[拼词比赛]冠军。

words.translation: n. 牛肉, 肌肉\nvt. 养(牛), 宰(牛)\nvi. 抱怨, 告发
words.definition: n. cattle that are reared for their meat\nn. meat from an adult domestic bovine

examples.en: She made a delicious [beef] stew with vegetables for dinner.
examples.cn: 她做了一道美味的蔬菜[牛肉]炖菜作晚餐。

examples.en: This restaurant is famous for its roast [beef] and Yorkshire pudding.
examples.cn: 这家餐厅以烤[牛肉]和约克郡布丁而闻名。

examples.sense: n. 牛肉（各种烹饪方式）
examples.en: He ordered a [beef] burger with chips and a cold drink.
examples.cn: 他点了一个[牛肉]汉堡，配薯条和冷饮。

examples.en: [Beef] is a good source of protein and iron for the body.
examples.cn: [牛肉]是身体蛋白质和铁的良好来源。

examples.en: He kept [beefing] about the long homework assignments.
examples.cn: 他不停地[抱怨]作业太多了。

words.translation: prep. 在...之前\nconj. 在...之前\nadv. 在前
words.definition: r earlier in time; previously\nr at or in the front

examples.en: Please wash your hands [before] eating your lunch.
examples.cn: 请在吃午饭[之前]洗手。

examples.en: She had never seen the sea [before] her family trip to Hainan.
examples.cn: 在家人去海南旅行[之前]，她从未见过大海。

examples.en: I need to finish this report [before] I go home today.
examples.cn: 我需要在今天回家[之前]完成这份报告。

examples.en: Have you been to this park [before]? It's very beautiful.
examples.cn: 你[以前]来过这个公园吗？它非常美丽。

examples.en: She stood [before] the audience and gave a wonderful speech.
examples.cn: 她站在观众[面前]，发表了一篇精彩的演讲。

words.translation: v. 开始\n[计] 开始
words.definition:
n. Israeli statesman (born in Russia) who (as prime minister of Israel) negotiated a peace treaty with Anwar Sadat (then the president of Egypt) (1913-1992)
v. have a beginning, in a temporal, spatial, or evaluative sense
v. set in motion, cause to start
v. begin to speak or say

examples.en: The lesson [begins] at eight o'clock sharp every morning.
examples.cn: 每天早上八点整课程准时[开始]。

examples.en: She [began] learning the violin when she was only five years old.
examples.cn: 她五岁就[开始]学小提琴了。

examples.sense: v. 开始（to begin with 首先）
examples.en: To [begin] with, let me introduce the main topic of today's discussion.
examples.cn: [首先]，让我介绍一下今天讨论的主要话题。

examples.en: They [began] on the project right after the meeting ended.
examples.cn: 会议结束后，他们立即[着手]开展该项目。

examples.sense: v. 开始（begin to do / begin doing）
examples.en: It [began] to rain heavily just as we arrived at the park.
examples.cn: 就在我们到达公园时，天[开始]下起了大雨。

words.translation: n. 行为, 举止\n[计] 特性, 性能, 特点, 行为, 动作, 状态
words.definition:
n the action or reaction of something (as a machine or substance) under specified circumstances
n (behavioral attributes) the way a person behaves toward other people
n (psychology) the aggregate of the responses or reactions or movements made by an organism in any situation
n manner of acting or controlling yourself

examples.en: The teacher praised the students for their good [behaviour] during the visit.
examples.cn: 老师表扬了学生们参观期间的良好[行为]。

examples.en: His [behaviour] at the dinner table was very polite and proper.
examples.cn: 他在餐桌上的[举止]非常有礼貌、得体。

examples.en: The school will not tolerate bullying or any other bad [behaviour].
examples.cn: 学校不容忍霸凌或任何其他不良[行为]。

examples.sense: n. 特性（动植物的习性）
examples.en: Scientists study the [behaviour] of animals in the wild to learn more about them.
examples.cn: 科学家研究野生动物的[习性]，以了解更多关于它们的信息。

examples.sense: n. 性能（机器/物质的反应方式）
examples.en: Engineers need to understand the [behaviour] of materials under high temperatures.
examples.cn: 工程师需要了解材料在高温下的[特性]。

words.translation: adv. 在后地\nprep. 在...背后
words.definition:
s. having the lower score or lagging position in a contest
r. in or to or toward the rear
r. remaining in a place or condition that has been left or departed from
r. of timepieces

examples.en: She hid [behind] the door to surprise her little brother.
examples.cn: 她躲在门[后面]给小弟弟一个惊喜。

examples.en: The supermarket is just [behind] the school building.
examples.cn: 超市就在学校大楼[后面]。

examples.en: The project is running [behind] because of bad weather this week.
examples.cn: 由于本周天气恶劣，项目进度[落后]了。

examples.sense: prep. 支持、赞同（the reason behind）
examples.en: What is the reason [behind] your decision to change schools?
examples.cn: 你转学决定[背后]的原因是什么？

examples.en: He forgot his book and had to go back because he left it [behind].
examples.cn: 他忘带了书，不得不回去取因为把它[落在]那里了。

words.translation: v. 相信
words.definition:
v. accept as true; take to be true
v. be confident about something
v. follow a credo; have a faith; be a believer
v. credit with veracity

examples.en: I [believe] everything he says because he never lies.
examples.cn: 我[相信]他说的一切，因为他从不说谎。

examples.en: She couldn't [believe] her eyes when she saw the surprise party.
examples.cn: 看到惊喜派对时，她简直不敢[相信]自己的眼睛。

examples.en: I [believe] that working hard is the key to success.
examples.cn: 我[认为]努力工作是成功的关键。

examples.en: She [believes] in treating everyone with kindness and respect.
examples.cn: 她[信奉]善待、尊重每一个人。

examples.sense: vi. 相信（it is believed that 据信）
examples.en: It is [believed] that regular exercise can help reduce stress.
examples.cn: [据信]经常锻炼有助于减轻压力。

words.translation: n. 铃, 钟\n[计] 响铃命令
words.definition:
n. a hollow device made of metal that makes a ringing sound when struck
n. the sound of a bell being struck
n. (nautical) each of the eight half-hour units of nautical time signaled by strokes of a ship's bell; eight bells signals 4:00, 8:00, or 12:00 o'clock, either a.m. or p.m.
n. the shape of a bell

examples.en: The school [bell] rings at half past three every afternoon.
examples.cn: 每天下午三点半学校[铃]声响起。

examples.en: She heard the [bell] ring and rushed downstairs to open the door.
examples.cn: 她听到[门铃]响，赶紧跑下楼去开门。

examples.en: The church [bells] rang loudly on Christmas morning.
examples.cn: 圣诞节早上，教堂的[钟]声响彻云霄。

examples.sense: n. 铃（ring a bell 似曾相识）
examples.en: His name rings a [bell] — I think we met at school last year.
examples.cn: 他的名字让我有点印象——我觉得我们去年在学校见过面。

examples.en: The flowers are shaped like small [bells] and smell very sweet.
examples.cn: 这些花形似小[铃铛]，气味非常香甜。

words.translation: prep. 在下面\nadv. 在下面
words.definition: r. in or to a place that is lower\nr. at a later place\nr. (in writing) see below

examples.en: The temperature dropped [below] zero last night.
examples.cn: 昨晚气温降到了零度[以下]。

examples.en: The fish are swimming [below] the surface of the water.
examples.cn: 鱼儿在水面[下面]游动。

examples.en: From the top of the hill, she could see the whole village [below].
examples.cn: 从山顶往下看，她能看到[下面]整个村庄。

examples.en: His test score was [below] average, so he decided to study harder.
examples.cn: 他的考试成绩[低于]平均水平，所以他决定更加努力学习。

examples.en: Please refer to the chart [below] for more detailed information.
examples.cn: 请参考[下面]的图表以获取更详细的信息。

words.translation: prep. 在旁边
words.definition:
n. At the side of; on one side of.
n. Aside from; out of the regular course or order of; in a
   state of deviation from; out of.
n. Over and above; distinct from; in addition to.
adv. On one side.
adv. More than that; over and above; not included in the
   number, or in what has been mentioned; moreover; in addition.

examples.en: She sat [beside] her best friend during the class.
examples.cn: 上课时，她坐在最好朋友的[旁边]。

examples.en: There is a small café [beside] the library where students often study.
examples.cn: 图书馆[旁边]有一家小咖啡馆，学生们经常在那里学习。

examples.en: [Beside] my brother, I am quite short.
examples.cn: 与我哥哥[相比]，我个子相当矮。

examples.sense: prep. 在...之外（beside the point 题外话）
examples.en: That argument is [beside] the point; let's focus on the main issue.
examples.cn: 那个论点是[题外话]；让我们专注于主要问题。

examples.sense: prep. 在...身旁（精神上的陪伴）
examples.en: She needed someone [beside] her during the difficult time.
examples.cn: 在困难时期，她需要有人[陪在]她身边。

words.translation: prep. 除...之外\nadv. 而且, 此外
words.definition: r. making an additional point; anyway; besides, we can't afford it"\nr. in addition

examples.en: [Besides] English, she can also speak French and a little Japanese.
examples.cn: [除了]英语，她还会说法语和一点日语。

examples.en: [Besides] homework, he also has piano practice every day.
examples.cn: [除了]作业，他每天还有钢琴练习。

examples.en: The film was too long; [besides], the story wasn't very interesting.
examples.cn: 这部电影太长了；[而且]，故事也不是很有趣。

examples.en: I don't want to go to the party; [besides], I have too much homework.
examples.cn: 我不想去参加派对；[此外]，我有太多作业了。

examples.en: No one [besides] her knew the answer to that difficult question.
examples.cn: [除了]她，没有人知道那道难题的答案。

words.translation: prep. 在...之间
words.definition: r. in the interval\nr. in between

examples.en: She sat [between] her two best friends at the cinema.
examples.cn: 她坐在两个好朋友[中间]看电影。

examples.en: The school is [between] the post office and the park.
examples.cn: 学校在邮局和公园[之间]。

examples.en: Can we meet [between] two and four o'clock tomorrow afternoon?
examples.cn: 我们明天下午两点到四点[之间]能见面吗？

examples.en: There is a direct train [between] Beijing and Shanghai.
examples.cn: 北京和上海[之间]有直达火车。

examples.en: Can you tell the difference [between] these two colours?
examples.cn: 你能分辨这两种颜色[之间]的区别吗？

words.translation: prep. 超过, 在那一边, 迟于\nadv. 在远处\nn. 更远处
words.definition: r. farther along in space or time or degree\nr. on the farther side from the observer\nr. in addition

examples.en: The maths problem was [beyond] my ability to solve alone.
examples.cn: 这道数学题[超出]了我独自解决的能力。

examples.en: The beauty of the landscape was [beyond] words.
examples.cn: 这片风景的美丽[超乎]言语所能描述。

examples.en: The mountains visible [beyond] the river are part of a national park.
examples.cn: 河流[那边]可见的山脉是国家公园的一部分。

examples.en: The project went [beyond] the original deadline by two weeks.
examples.cn: 该项目[超过]了原定截止日期两周。

examples.en: We could see the sea and the islands [beyond].
examples.cn: 我们能看到大海以及[更远处]的岛屿。

words.translation: n. 自行车
words.definition: n. a wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals\nv. ride a bicycle

examples.en: She rides her [bicycle] to school every day to save money.
examples.cn: 她每天骑[自行车]上学，以节省费用。

examples.en: He got a new [bicycle] as a birthday present from his parents.
examples.cn: 他收到了父母送的一辆新[自行车]作为生日礼物。

examples.en: Riding a [bicycle] is good exercise and also friendly to the environment.
examples.cn: 骑[自行车]是很好的锻炼方式，也对环境友好。

examples.en: Please lock your [bicycle] to the fence when you leave it outside.
examples.cn: 把[自行车]停在外面时，请将其锁在栅栏上。

examples.en: They [bicycled] along the riverside path on a sunny afternoon.
examples.cn: 他们在一个阳光明媚的下午骑着[自行车]沿河边小路骑行。

words.translation: a. 大的, 重要的\nadv. 大量地
words.definition:
s. significant
s. loud and firm
s. conspicuous in position or importance
s. prodigious

examples.en: They moved to a [big] house in the suburbs with a large garden.
examples.cn: 他们搬到了郊区一所带大花园的[大]房子里。

examples.en: She had a [big] smile on her face when she heard the good news.
examples.cn: 听到好消息时，她脸上露出了[大大的]笑容。

examples.en: Passing the final exam is a [big] moment in every student's life.
examples.cn: 通过期末考试是每个学生生命中的一个[重要]时刻。

examples.sense: a. 受欢迎的（big in someplace）
examples.en: Football is very [big] in Brazil; almost everyone follows it.
examples.cn: 足球在巴西非常[流行]，几乎每个人都关注它。

examples.en: If you want to succeed, you need to think [big] and set ambitious goals.
examples.cn: 如果你想成功，你需要[大胆地]思考并设定雄心勃勃的目标。

words.translation: n. 自行车, 脚踏车
words.definition: n a motor vehicle with two wheels and a strong frame\nn a wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals\nv ride a bicycle

examples.en: She jumped on her [bike] and rode to the corner shop quickly.
examples.cn: 她跳上[自行车]，迅速骑到街角的商店。

examples.en: My [bike] got a flat tyre, so I had to walk home.
examples.cn: 我的[自行车]轮胎瘪了，所以我只能走回家。

examples.en: He dreams of owning a powerful [bike] when he grows up.
examples.cn: 他梦想着长大后拥有一辆强劲的[摩托车]。

examples.en: They go [biking] in the countryside every weekend for exercise.
examples.cn: 他们每个周末都去乡村[骑车]锻炼。

examples.en: You can rent a shared [bike] using an app on your phone.
examples.cn: 你可以用手机上的应用程序租一辆共享[单车]。

words.translation: n. 帐单, 清单, 钞票, 鸟嘴, 广告, 法案, 票据\nvt. 开帐单, (用招贴)宣布
words.definition:
n. a statute in draft before it becomes law
n. an itemized statement of money owed for goods shipped or services rendered
n. a piece of paper money (especially one issued by a central bank)
n. the entertainment offered at a public presentation

examples.en: The [bill] for dinner came to over one hundred yuan.
examples.cn: 晚餐的[账单]超过了一百元。

examples.en: She pays all her [bills] online at the end of each month.
examples.cn: 她每月底在网上缴纳所有[账单]。

examples.en: He took a fifty-yuan [bill] out of his wallet to pay for the food.
examples.cn: 他从钱包里掏出一张五十元的[钞票]支付食物。

examples.en: The parliament passed a new [bill] to protect the environment.
examples.cn: 议会通过了一项新的环保[法案]。

examples.en: The bird used its [bill] to pick up seeds from the ground.
examples.cn: 那只鸟用它的[嘴]从地上啄起种子。

words.translation: n. 鸟, 羽毛球\nvi. 打鸟
words.definition: n. warm-blooded egg-laying vertebrates characterized by feathers and forelimbs modified as wings\nn. the flesh of a bird or fowl (wild or domestic) used as food\nv. watch and study birds in their natural habitat

examples.en: A colourful [bird] was singing in the tree outside our window.
examples.cn: 我们窗外树上有一只色彩鲜艳的[鸟]在歌唱。

examples.en: Many [birds] fly south in autumn to escape the cold winter.
examples.cn: 许多[鸟]在秋天向南飞，以躲避寒冬。

examples.en: She goes [bird] watching in the forest every weekend with binoculars.
examples.cn: 她每个周末都带着双筒望远镜去森林[观鸟]。

examples.en: The chef prepared several dishes using [bird] meat for the banquet.
examples.cn: 厨师用[禽肉]为宴会准备了几道菜。

examples.en: She is an early [bird] and always arrives at school before everyone else.
examples.cn: 她是个[早起的人]，总是比其他人早到学校。

words.translation: n. 出生, 起源\n[医] 生产, 分娩
words.definition: n. the time when something begins (especially life)\nn. the event of being born\nn. a baby born; an offspring

examples.en: The [birth] of her baby sister was the happiest day of her life.
examples.cn: 妹妹的[出生]是她生命中最幸福的一天。

examples.en: She weighed three kilograms at [birth] and was a healthy baby.
examples.cn: 她[出生]时体重三公斤，是个健康的宝宝。

examples.en: The [birth] of the internet changed the way people communicate.
examples.cn: 互联网的[诞生]改变了人们的沟通方式。

examples.en: He is Chinese by [birth] but grew up in Canada.
examples.cn: 他[出生]于中国，但在加拿大长大。

examples.en: The mother panda gave [birth] to two cubs in the spring.
examples.cn: 那只母熊猫在春天[产下]了两只幼崽。

words.translation: n. 生日
words.definition: n. an anniversary of the day on which a person was born (or the celebration of it)\nn. the date on which a person was born

examples.en: My [birthday] is on the 20th of March and I always have a party.
examples.cn: 我的[生日]是三月二十日，我总是举办一个派对。

examples.en: He forgot it was his mother's [birthday] and felt very guilty.
examples.cn: 他忘记了妈妈的[生日]，感到非常愧疚。

examples.en: She baked a chocolate [birthday] cake for her best friend.

examples.cn: 农民每天早上挤[牛]的奶。

examples.en: There are many [cows] in the field near the village.
examples.cn: 村子附近的田野里有很多[奶牛]。

examples.en: The [cow] gave birth to a calf last spring.
examples.cn: 那头[母牛]去年春天生了一头小牛。

examples.en: Milk comes from [cows] and is very nutritious.
examples.cn: 牛奶来自[奶牛]，非常有营养。

examples.en: We saw a [cow] standing quietly by the road.
examples.cn: 我们看到一头[牛]静静地站在路边。

words.translation: n. 蜡笔, 蜡笔画\nvt. 以蜡笔作画
words.definition: n. writing implement consisting of a colored stick of composition wax used for writing and drawing\nv. write, draw, or trace with a crayon

examples.en: She drew a rainbow with her [crayons].
examples.cn: 她用[蜡笔]画了一道彩虹。

examples.en: The young child coloured the picture with a red [crayon].
examples.cn: 那个小孩用红色[蜡笔]给图画涂色。

examples.en: He lost one [crayon] from his set.
examples.cn: 他的[蜡笔]套装丢了一支。

examples.en: She has a box of 24 [crayons] on her desk.
examples.cn: 她桌上有一盒24支的[蜡笔]。

examples.en: The children painted pictures using [crayons] and brushes.
examples.cn: 孩子们用[蜡笔]和画笔绘画。

words.translation: a. 发狂的, 狂热的
words.definition:
n. someone deranged and possibly dangerous
s. foolish; totally unsound
s. possessed by inordinate excitement
s. bizarre or fantastic

examples.en: He is [crazy] about football and watches every game.
examples.cn: 他[疯狂地]热爱足球，每场比赛都看。

examples.en: It was [crazy] weather — hot in the morning and snowing at night.
examples.cn: 天气真是[疯狂]——早上热，晚上却下雪了。

examples.en: Don't be [crazy] — you should not swim in this cold weather.
examples.cn: 别[犯傻]——这么冷的天你不应该去游泳。

examples.en: She went [crazy] over the new pop song last week.
examples.cn: 上周她为那首新流行歌曲而[狂热]了。

examples.en: They had a [crazy] time at the amusement park.
examples.cn: 他们在游乐园玩得[疯狂]极了。

words.translation: vt. 创造, 建造, 引起, 任命
words.definition:
v. bring into existence
v. pursue a creative activity; be engaged in a creative activity
v. invest with a new title, office, or rank
v. create by artistic means

examples.en: She [created] a beautiful painting for the school exhibition.
examples.cn: 她为学校展览[创作]了一幅美丽的画作。

examples.en: Teachers should [create] a positive learning environment.
examples.cn: 老师应该[营造]积极的学习环境。

examples.en: The students [created] a short film for the festival.
examples.cn: 学生们为节日[制作]了一部短片。

examples.en: Hard work and talent together [create] success.
examples.cn: 努力和才华共同[创造]成功。

examples.en: He [created] a new game for his younger brother.
examples.cn: 他为弟弟[创造]了一个新游戏。

words.translation:
n. 十字架, 十字架形物件, 交叉, 十字标, 交叉路, 磨难, 杂交
a. 生气的, 交叉的, 相反的
v. 交叉, 横过, 越过
[计] 交叉, 十字标
words.definition:
n. a wooden structure consisting of an upright post with a transverse piece
n. a representation of the structure on which Jesus was crucified; used as an emblem of Christianity or in heraldry
n. any affliction that causes great suffering
v. fold so as to resemble a cross

examples.en: Look both ways before you [cross] the road.
examples.cn: [过]马路前要先左右查看。

examples.en: They [crossed] the river by boat.
examples.cn: 他们乘船[穿过]了河流。

examples.en: Draw a [cross] in the box next to the wrong answer.
examples.cn: 在错误答案旁边的方框里画一个[叉号]。

examples.en: She was [cross] when she found her book torn.
examples.cn: 发现书被撕破时她很[生气]。

examples.en: The bridge helps people [cross] the wide river safely.
examples.cn: 桥帮助人们安全[穿越]宽阔的河流。

words.translation: a. 残酷的, 令人极痛苦的\n[法] 残忍的, 残酷的
words.definition: s (of persons or their actions) able or disposed to inflict pain or suffering

examples.en: It is [cruel] to hurt animals for fun.
examples.cn: 为了好玩而伤害动物是[残忍的]。

examples.en: The [cruel] boy was punished for hurting his classmate.
examples.cn: 那个[残忍的]男孩因伤害同学而受到了惩罚。

examples.en: It is [cruel] to bully someone who is weaker.
examples.cn: 欺负弱小的人是[残忍的]行为。

examples.en: She was shocked by the [cruel] treatment of the stray dogs.
examples.cn: 流浪狗遭受的[残酷]对待让她震惊。

examples.en: The [cruel] winter took away many lives in the old days.
examples.cn: 在过去，[严酷]的冬天夺走了很多人的生命。

words.translation: n. 叫声, 哭声, 大叫\nvi. 哭, 叫, 喊\nvt. 叫喊, 大声说, 哭出
words.definition:
n. a loud utterance; often in protest or opposition
n. a loud utterance of emotion (especially when inarticulate)
n. a fit of weeping
n. the characteristic utterance of an animal

examples.en: The baby [cried] when she was hungry.
examples.cn: 婴儿饿了就[哭]。

examples.en: She [cried] when she heard the sad news.
examples.cn: 听到那个悲伤的消息，她[哭了]。

examples.en: He [cried] out for help when he fell in the river.
examples.cn: 他落入河中后[大声呼救]。

examples.en: We heard the [cry] of a child from the next room.
examples.cn: 我们从隔壁房间听到了一个孩子的[哭声]。

examples.en: Don't [cry] — everything will be fine.
examples.cn: 别[哭]——一切都会好起来的。

words.translation: n. 文化, 修养, 耕种\nvt. 耕种, 培养
words.definition:
n. a particular society at a particular time and place
n. the tastes in art and manners that are favored by a social group
n. (biology) the growing of microorganisms in a nutrient medium (such as gelatin or agar)
n. the attitudes and behavior that are characteristic of a particular social group or organization

examples.en: China has a rich and long [culture].
examples.cn: 中国有着丰富悠久的[文化]。

examples.en: Learning about other [cultures] helps us understand the world better.
examples.cn: 了解其他[文化]有助于我们更好地理解世界。

examples.en: Food is an important part of any [culture].
examples.cn: 食物是任何[文化]的重要组成部分。

examples.en: The festival shows the traditional [culture] of the region.
examples.cn: 这个节日展示了该地区的传统[文化]。

examples.en: She studied Chinese [culture] and history at university.
examples.cn: 她在大学学习了中国[文化]和历史。

words.translation: n. 杯子, 茶杯, 优胜杯\nvt. 使成杯状, 为...拔火罐
words.definition:
n. a small open container usually used for drinking; usually has a handle
n. the quantity a cup will hold
n. any cup-shaped concavity
n. a United States liquid unit equal to 8 fluid ounces

examples.en: She drank a [cup] of tea every morning.
examples.cn: 她每天早上喝一[杯]茶。

examples.en: Could you pass me that [cup] on the shelf?
examples.cn: 你能把架子上那个[杯子]递给我吗？

examples.en: The team won a golden [cup] at the competition.
examples.cn: 队伍在比赛中赢得了一座金[杯]。

examples.en: He filled his [cup] with hot water for instant noodles.
examples.cn: 他往[杯子]里倒热水泡方便面。

examples.en: She broke a [cup] while washing the dishes.
examples.cn: 她洗碗时打碎了一个[杯子]。

words.translation:
n. 切口, 割伤, 降低, 切, 割, 砍, 削, 伤口, 削减, 缩短, 删节, 通路
a. 经切割的, 缩减的
vt. 切, 割, 减少, 刺痛, 开辟, 雕刻, 删节, 缩短, 停止, 排斥, 切断, 关, 显出
vi. 切, 割, 砍, 刺痛, 相交, 抄近路, 剪辑
[计] 剪切
words.definition:
n. a share of the profits
n. (film) an immediate transition from one shot to the next
n. a trench resembling a furrow that was made by erosion or excavation
n. a step on some scale

examples.en: She [cut] the cake into eight equal pieces.
examples.cn: 她把蛋糕[切]成了八等份。

examples.en: He [cut] his finger while chopping vegetables.
examples.cn: 他切蔬菜时[割伤]了手指。

examples.en: She [cut] her hair short for the summer.
examples.cn: 她为了夏天把头发[剪]短了。

examples.en: They [cut] the price of the shoes by half.
examples.cn: 他们把鞋子的价格[降低]了一半。

examples.en: He put a bandage on the [cut] on his hand.
examples.cn: 他在手上的[伤口]处包了一块绷带。

words.translation: n. 爸爸, 爹爹
words.definition: n. an informal term for a father; probably derived from baby talk

examples.en: My [dad] works as a doctor at the local hospital.
examples.cn: 我[爸爸]在当地医院当医生。

examples.en: She called her [dad] to say she would be late.
examples.cn: 她打电话给[爸爸]说她会晚回来。

examples.en: My [dad] teaches me how to ride a bike every weekend.
examples.cn: 每个周末我[爸爸]都教我骑自行车。

examples.en: Her [dad] cooked a big meal for the whole family.
examples.cn: 她[爸爸]为全家人做了一顿丰盛的饭菜。

examples.en: I am proud of my [dad] because he works very hard.
examples.cn: 我为我的[爸爸]感到骄傲，因为他非常努力。

words.translation: a. 每日的, 日常的\nadv. 每日地, 日常地\nn. 日报
words.definition: n. a newspaper that is published every day\ns. of or belonging to or occurring every day\nr. every day; without missing a day

examples.en: Exercise is part of her [daily] routine.
examples.cn: 锻炼是她[日常]作息的一部分。

examples.en: Reading the news is my [daily] habit.
examples.cn: 读新闻是我的[日常]习惯。

examples.en: She practises the piano [daily] for 30 minutes.
examples.cn: 她[每天]练30分钟钢琴。

examples.en: The school provides [daily] breakfast for students.
examples.cn: 学校为学生提供[每日]早餐。

examples.en: He walks to school [daily] instead of taking the bus.
examples.cn: 他[每天]步行上学，而不是坐公交车。

words.translation: n. 跳舞, 舞蹈, 舞会\nv. 跳舞
words.definition:
n. an artistic form of nonverbal communication
n. a party of people assembled for dancing
n. a party for social dancing
v. move in a graceful and rhythmical way

examples.en: She loves to [dance] to pop music with her friends.
examples.cn: 她喜欢和朋友们一起跟流行音乐[跳舞]。

examples.en: They [danced] together at the school party last Friday.
examples.cn: 上周五他们在学校派对上一起[跳舞]了。

examples.en: She learned a traditional Chinese [dance] for the performance.
examples.cn: 她为演出学了一支传统中国[舞蹈]。

examples.en: The school held a [dance] at the end of the year.
examples.cn: 学校在年末举办了一场[舞会]。

examples.en: The children [danced] happily around the Christmas tree.
examples.cn: 孩子们在圣诞树周围快乐地[跳舞]。

words.translation: n. 危险, 威胁\n[法] 危险, 危险物, 危机
words.definition: n. the condition of being susceptible to harm or injury\nn. a cause of pain or injury or loss\nn. a dangerous place

examples.en: The sign warned people of the [danger] ahead.
examples.cn: 警示牌提醒人们前方有[危险]。

examples.en: He was in great [danger] when the fire broke out.
examples.cn: 火灾发生时他处于极大[危险]之中。

examples.en: Do not swim alone — there is [danger] in the deep water.
examples.cn: 不要独自游泳——深水中有[危险]。

examples.en: She understood the [danger] of running across a busy road.
examples.cn: 她明白在繁忙道路上横冲直撞的[危险]。

examples.en: There is no [danger] if you follow the safety rules.
examples.cn: 如果你遵守安全规则，就没有[危险]。

words.translation: a. 危险的\n[法] 危险的, 危害的
words.definition: a. involving or causing danger or risk; liable to hurt or harm\ns. causing fear or anxiety by threatening great harm

examples.en: It is [dangerous] to play near the river alone.
examples.cn: 独自在河边玩耍是[危险的]。

examples.en: Driving too fast is very [dangerous].
examples.cn: 开车太快非常[危险]。

examples.en: The teacher warned us that the chemicals were [dangerous].
examples.cn: 老师警告我们那些化学品是[危险的]。

examples.en: It is [dangerous] to use your phone while crossing the road.
examples.cn: 过马路时使用手机是[危险的]。

examples.en: Wild animals can be [dangerous] if you get too close.
examples.cn: 如果你靠得太近，野生动物可能是[危险的]。

words.translation: n. 挑战, 挑动, 大胆\nv. 敢, 胆敢
words.definition: n. a challenge to do something dangerous or foolhardy\nv. to be courageous enough to try or do something

examples.en: She didn't [dare] to speak in front of the whole school.
examples.cn: 她不[敢]在全校面前发言。

examples.en: How [dare] you say something so rude!
examples.cn: 你怎么[敢]说这么无礼的话！

examples.en: He [dared] to try the difficult problem on his own.
examples.cn: 他[勇于]独自尝试那道难题。

examples.en: She [dared] her friend to jump into the cold pool.
examples.cn: 她[挑战]朋友跳进冷水池。

examples.en: Nobody [dared] to disagree with the strict teacher.
examples.cn: 没有人[敢]反对那位严格的老师。

words.translation: n. 黑暗, 夜, 黄昏, 模糊\na. 黑暗的, 暗的, 深色的, 隐密的, 模糊的, 无知的
words.definition:
n. absence of light or illumination
n. an unenlightened state
a. devoid of or deficient in light or brightness; shadowed or black
a. (used of color) having a dark hue

examples.en: She was afraid of the [dark] when she was little.
examples.cn: 她小时候害怕[黑暗]。

examples.en: It gets [dark] early in winter.
examples.cn: 冬天天色[暗]得很早。

examples.en: She wore a [dark] blue coat to the meeting.
examples.cn: 她穿了一件[深]蓝色外套参加会议。

examples.en: The children were told not to go out after [dark].
examples.cn: 孩子们被告知[天黑]后不能外出。

examples.en: The room was too [dark] to read without a light.
examples.cn: 房间太[暗]了，不开灯就没法看书。

words.translation: n. 日期, 约会, 枣椰树\nvt. 约会, 定日期\nvi. 注明日期, 过时
words.definition:
n. the specified day of the month
n. a participant in a date
n. a meeting arranged in advance
n. a particular but unspecified point in time

examples.en: What is the [date] of the exam?
examples.cn: 考试的[日期]是什么时候？

examples.en: Please write the [date] at the top of your paper.
examples.cn: 请在试卷顶部写上[日期]。

examples.en: They went on a [date] to the cinema last weekend.
examples.cn: 上周末他们去电影院[约会]了。

examples.en: The [date] of the school trip is the 20th of April.
examples.cn: 学校郊游的[日期]是4月20日。

examples.en: Check the [date] on the milk before you drink it.
examples.cn: 喝牛奶前检查一下[日期]。

words.translation: n. 女儿\na. 女儿的
words.definition: n. a female human offspring

examples.en: His [daughter] is in the same class as my sister.
examples.cn: 他的[女儿]和我姐姐在同一个班。

examples.en: Their [daughter] won a prize in the art competition.
examples.cn: 他们的[女儿]在美术比赛中获奖了。

examples.en: She is the youngest [daughter] in a family of four.
examples.cn: 她是家里四个孩子中最小的[女儿]。

examples.en: The parents were proud of their [daughter]'s hard work.
examples.cn: 父母为[女儿]的努力感到骄傲。

examples.en: Their [daughter] is studying in a school far from home.
examples.cn: 他们的[女儿]在离家很远的学校上学。

words.translation: n. 天, 日子, 白天, 工作日\n[医] 日(一昼夜), 昼, 白天
words.definition:
n. time for Earth to make a complete rotation on its axis
n. some point or period in time
n. a day assigned to a particular purpose or observance
n. the time after sunrise and before sunset while it is light outside

examples.en: She reads for one hour every [day].
examples.cn: 她每[天]读一小时书。

examples.en: It was a beautiful [day] with clear blue skies.
examples.cn: 那是个晴空万里的美好[天气]。

examples.en: She prefers to study during the [day] rather than at night.
examples.cn: 她更喜欢[白天]学习而不是晚上。

examples.en: We spent the whole [day] at the theme park.
examples.cn: 我们在主题公园度过了一整[天]。

examples.en: What [day] is your PE class?
examples.cn: 你的体育课是星期几？

words.translation: a. 死的, 不活泼的, 麻木的, 熄灭的\nn. 死者\nadv. 完全地, 直接地
words.definition:
n. people who are no longer living
n. a time when coldness (or some other quality associated with death) is intense
a. no longer having or seeming to have or expecting to have life
a. not showing characteristics of life especially the capacity to sustain life; no longer exerting force or having energy or heat

examples.en: The [dead] fish floated on the surface of the water.
examples.cn: [死去的]鱼漂浮在水面上。

examples.en: They found a [dead] bird in the garden.
examples.cn: 他们在花园里发现了一只[死去的]鸟。

examples.sense: adj. 完全的，彻底的（强调）
examples.en: The classroom was [dead] quiet during the test.
examples.cn: 考试期间教室里[死一般]安静。

examples.en: Without water, plants soon become [dead].
examples.cn: 没有水，植物很快就会[枯死]。

examples.en: My phone battery is [dead] — I need to charge it.
examples.cn: 我的手机没电了——我需要充电了。

words.translation: a. 聋的\n[医] 聋的
words.definition: n. people who have severe hearing impairments\na. lacking or deprived of the sense of hearing wholly or in part\ns. (usually followed by `to') unwilling or refusing to pay heed

examples.en: The [deaf] student uses sign language to communicate.
examples.cn: 那名[失聪的]学生用手语交流。

examples.en: She has been [deaf] since she was born.
examples.cn: 她从出生起就[失聪]了。

examples.en: The [deaf] children at the school are very talented.
examples.cn: 学校里的[失聪]孩子们非常有才华。

examples.en: Very loud music can make you temporarily [deaf].
examples.cn: 非常响的音乐会让你暂时[失聪]。

examples.en: He turned [deaf] to her advice and made the wrong choice.
examples.cn: 他对她的建议[置若罔闻]，做出了错误的选择。

words.translation:
n. 交易, 协定, 数量, 买卖, 松木板
vi. 处理, 应付, 做生意
vt. 分配, 发牌, 给予
[计] 发牌
words.definition:
n. a particular instance of buying or selling
n. a plank of softwood (fir or pine board)
n. the type of treatment received (especially as the result of an agreement)
n. the act of distributing playing cards

examples.en: She knows how to [deal] with difficult situations.
examples.cn: 她知道如何[处理]困难情况。

examples.en: How do you [deal] with stress before an exam?
examples.cn: 考试前你怎么[应对]压力？

examples.en: They made a [deal] to trade books with each other.
examples.cn: 他们达成了一个互换书本的[协议]。

examples.en: A great [deal] of hard work goes into writing a book.
examples.cn: 写一本书需要[大量]的辛苦工作。

examples.en: The doctor [dealt] with many patients every day.
examples.cn: 医生每天[处理]许多病人的事务。

words.translation:
n. 亲爱的人
a. 亲爱的, 昂贵的, 严重的, 急迫的
interj. 啊
adv. 深爱地, 高价地
words.definition: s. with or in a close or intimate relationship\ns. earnest

examples.en: She began her letter with the words [Dear] Teacher.
examples.cn: 她用[亲爱的]老师这几个字开头写信。

examples.en: My grandmother is very [dear] to me.
examples.cn: 我奶奶对我来说非常[珍贵]。

examples.en: Everything in that shop is too [dear] for us.
examples.cn: 那家店的东西对我们来说太[贵了]。

examples.en: He is a [dear] friend who always supports me.
examples.cn: 他是一位[亲爱的]朋友，总是支持我。

examples.sense: int. 哎呀（表示惊讶或遗憾）
examples.en: Oh [dear]! I forgot to bring my homework.
examples.cn: [哎呀]！我忘记带作业了。

words.translation: n. 死亡\n[医] 死亡
words.definition:
n. the event of dying or departure from life
n. the permanent end of all life functions in an organism or part of an organism
n. the absence of life or state of being dead
n. the time when something ends

examples.en: The [death] of the old tree made the park look empty.
examples.cn: 那棵老树的[死亡]让公园看起来空荡荡的。

examples.en: Smoking is one of the leading causes of [death].
examples.cn: 吸烟是[死亡]的主要原因之一。

examples.en: The hero faced [death] bravely to protect his people.
examples.cn: 英雄勇敢面对[死亡]来保护他的人民。

examples.en: After the [death] of the great scientist, his work continued.
examples.cn: 那位伟大科学家[逝世]后，他的工作仍在继续。

examples.en: The family was sad about the [death] of their pet dog.
examples.cn: 这家人为宠物狗的[死亡]而悲伤。

words.translation: n. 十二月
words.definition: n. the last (12th) month of the year

examples.en: Christmas is celebrated on the 25th of [December].
examples.cn: 圣诞节在[十二月]25日庆祝。

examples.en: It gets very cold here in [December].
examples.cn: 这里[十二月]非常寒冷。

examples.en: The school term ends in [December] for the winter holiday.
examples.cn: 学期在[十二月]结束，然后是寒假。

examples.en: My birthday is on the 10th of [December].
examples.cn: 我的生日是[十二月]10日。

examples.en: Many shops are very busy in [December] because of the holidays.
examples.cn: 由于节假日，许多商店在[十二月]非常繁忙。

words.translation: v. 决定, 判决
words.definition:
v. reach, make, or come to a decision about something
v. bring to an end; settle conclusively
v. cause to decide
v. influence or determine

examples.en: She [decided] to join the swimming team.
examples.cn: 她[决定]加入游泳队。

examples.en: It is hard to [decide] what to eat when you are hungry.
examples.cn: 饿的时候很难[决定]吃什么。

examples.en: He [decided] to study harder after failing the test.
examples.cn: 考试失败后他[决定]更加努力学习。

examples.en: Think carefully before you [decide].
examples.cn: [决定]前要仔细考虑。

examples.en: They [decided] to meet at the school gate at 8 AM.
examples.cn: 他们[决定]早上8点在学校门口见面。

words.translation: n. 决定, 决心, 决断\n[计] 判定
words.definition:
n. the act of making up your mind about something
n. a position or opinion or judgment reached after consideration
n. (boxing) a victory won on points when no knockout has occurred
n. the outcome of a game or contest

examples.en: She made the right [decision] to choose science.
examples.cn: 她选择理科的[决定]是正确的。

examples.en: It was a big [decision] to move to a new school.
examples.cn: 转到新学校是一个重大[决定]。

examples.en: Think before you make any important [decision].
examples.cn: 在做任何重要[决定]之前要先思考。

examples.en: The judge's [decision] was accepted by everyone.
examples.cn: 法官的[裁决]被所有人接受了。

examples.en: He changed his [decision] after talking with his parents.
examples.cn: 和父母谈过之后，他改变了[决定]。

words.translation: a. 深的\nadv. 深入地\nn. 深渊, 深处
words.definition:
n. the central and most intense or profound part
n. literary term for an ocean
a. relatively deep or strong; affecting one deeply
s. marked by depth of thinking

examples.en: The river is very [deep] near the bridge.
examples.cn: 桥附近的河很[深]。

examples.en: She took a [deep] breath before starting her speech.
examples.cn: 她在开始演讲前深深地吸了一口气。

examples.en: They have a [deep] friendship built over many years.
examples.cn: 他们有多年建立起来的[深厚]友谊。

examples.en: The well is too [deep] for anyone to see the bottom.
examples.cn: 这口井太[深]了，没有人能看到底部。

examples.en: He was [deep] in thought and did not hear the bell.
examples.cn: 他[深陷]沉思，没有听到铃声。

words.translation: n. 程度, 度数, 学位, 度\n[医] 度, 程度
words.definition:
n. a position on a scale of intensity or amount or quality
n. a specific identifiable position in a continuum or series or especially in a process
n. a measure for arcs and angles
n. the highest power of a term or variable

examples.en: The temperature today is 35 [degrees].
examples.cn: 今天气温是35[度]。

examples.en: Water boils at 100 [degrees] Celsius.
examples.cn: 水在100[摄氏度]时沸腾。

examples.en: She was hurt to a certain [degree] by the harsh words.
examples.cn: 那些刺耳的话在某种[程度上]伤害了她。

examples.en: She earned a [degree] in English literature.
examples.cn: 她获得了英国文学[学位]。

examples.en: A right angle is 90 [degrees].
examples.cn: 直角是90[度]。

words.translation: a. 美味的
words.definition: n. variety of sweet eating apples

examples.en: The dumplings Mom made were [delicious].
examples.cn: 妈妈做的饺子真[美味]。

examples.en: This [delicious] smell is coming from the kitchen.
examples.cn: 这股[美味]的香气是从厨房传来的。

examples.en: The food at that restaurant is always [delicious].
examples.cn: 那家餐厅的食物总是非常[美味]。

examples.en: She made a [delicious] cake for the class party.
examples.cn: 她为班级派对做了一个[美味的]蛋糕。

examples.en: Everything in this Chinese restaurant is [delicious].
examples.cn: 这家中餐厅的每样东西都很[可口]。

words.translation: n. 牙科医生\n[医] 牙医师
words.definition: n. a person qualified to practice dentistry

examples.en: She goes to the [dentist] twice a year for a check-up.
examples.cn: 她每年看两次[牙医]做检查。

examples.en: The [dentist] told him to brush his teeth after every meal.
examples.cn: [牙医]告诉他每顿饭后都要刷牙。

examples.en: Her tooth hurt, so she made an appointment with the [dentist].
examples.cn: 她牙疼，所以预约了[牙医]。

examples.en: The [dentist]'s office is on the second floor of the hospital.
examples.cn: [牙医]诊室在医院二楼。

examples.en: Many children are afraid of visiting the [dentist].
examples.cn: 许多孩子都害怕去看[牙医]。

words.translation: vi. 靠, 视...而定, 信赖
words.definition: v. be contingent upon (something that is elided)

examples.en: Young children [depend] on their parents for everything.
examples.cn: 幼小的孩子们[依靠]父母生活。

examples.en: She [depends] on her phone to manage her daily schedule.
examples.cn: 她[依靠]手机管理日程安排。

examples.en: The result [depends] on how hard you work.
examples.cn: 结果[取决于]你有多努力。

examples.en: Whether we go out [depends] on the weather.
examples.cn: 我们是否出门[取决于]天气状况。

examples.en: You should not always [depend] on others — try to be independent.
examples.cn: 你不应该总是[依赖]他人——要努力独立。

words.translation: vt. 描述, 描绘, 画
words.definition: v. give a description of

examples.en: Can you [describe] the person you saw?
examples.cn: 你能[描述]一下你看到的那个人吗？

examples.en: She [described] her holiday in great detail.
examples.cn: 她[详细描述]了她的假期经历。

examples.en: The book [describes] life in the countryside long ago.
examples.cn: 这本书[描述]了很久以前农村的生活。

examples.en: [Describe] your favourite season using three adjectives.
examples.cn: 用三个形容词[描述]你最喜欢的季节。

examples.en: Words cannot fully [describe] how beautiful the view was.
examples.cn: 言语无法完全[描述]那景色有多美。

words.translation: n. 书桌, 办公桌, 工作台
words.definition: n. a piece of furniture with a writing surface and usually drawers or other compartments

examples.en: Her [desk] is always neat and tidy.
examples.cn: 她的[书桌]总是整整齐齐的。

examples.en: He put all his books on his [desk] before class.
examples.cn: 上课前他把所有的书放在[课桌]上。

examples.en: Please sit at your [desk] and wait for the teacher.
examples.cn: 请坐在[课桌]旁等老师。

examples.en: She does her homework at her [desk] every evening.
examples.cn: 她每天晚上在[书桌]前做作业。

examples.en: Ask at the information [desk] if you need help.
examples.cn: 如果需要帮助，请到信息[台]询问。

words.translation: vt. 发展, 使发达, 进步, 洗印, 显影\nvi. 发展, 生长
words.definition:
v. make something new, such as a product or a mental or artistic creation
v. gain through experience
v. be gradually disclosed or unfolded; become manifest; 
v. grow, progress, unfold, or evolve through a process of evolution, natural growth, differentiation, or a conducive environment

examples.en: China has [developed] rapidly in the past decades.
examples.cn: 中国在过去几十年里[发展]迅速。

examples.en: Reading helps you [develop] your vocabulary.
examples.cn: 阅读帮助你[发展]词汇量。

examples.en: She [developed] a love of art during middle school.
examples.cn: 她在中学期间[培养]了对艺术的热爱。

examples.en: Scientists are working to [develop] new medicines.
examples.cn: 科学家们正在努力[开发]新药物。

examples.en: Exercise can help [develop] a strong and healthy body.
examples.cn: 锻炼有助于[发展]强健的身体。

words.translation: n. 发展\n[化] 展开
words.definition:
n. act of improving by expanding or enlarging or refining
n. a process in which something passes by degrees to a different stage (especially a more advanced or mature stage)
n. a recent event that has some relevance for the present situation
n. a district that has been developed to serve some purpose

examples.en: The [development] of technology has changed our daily lives.
examples.cn: 科技的[发展]改变了我们的日常生活。

examples.en: She is interested in the [development] of new energy sources.
examples.cn: 她对新能源的[开发]很感兴趣。

examples.en: Good education is important for a child's [development].
examples.cn: 良好的教育对孩子的[发展]非常重要。

examples.en: The new school building is a sign of the area's [development].
examples.cn: 新校舍是该地区[发展]的一个标志。

examples.en: Economic [development] has brought better living conditions.
examples.cn: 经济[发展]带来了更好的生活条件。

words.translation: n. 对话\nvi. 对话\nvt. 用对话表达
words.definition: n. a conversation between two persons\nn. the lines spoken by characters in drama or fiction\nn. a literary composition in the form of a conversation between two people

examples.en: We practised a [dialogue] between a shopkeeper and a customer.
examples.cn: 我们练习了一段售货员与顾客之间的[对话]。

examples.en: The English textbook has many [dialogues] to read aloud.
examples.cn: 英语课本里有很多[对话]需要朗读。

examples.en: The [dialogue] in the play was funny and interesting.
examples.cn: 剧本中的[对话]既幽默又有趣。

examples.en: The two countries started a [dialogue] to solve the problem.
examples.cn: 两国开始[对话]以解决问题。

examples.en: She memorised the [dialogue] and performed it on stage.
examples.cn: 她记住了[对话]内容，在舞台上进行了表演。

words.translation: n. 日记\n[经] 日记簿
words.definition: n. a daily written record of (usually personal) experiences and observations\nn. a personal journal (as a physical object)

examples.en: She writes in her [diary] every night before bed.
examples.cn: 她每天睡前都写[日记]。

examples.en: He kept a [diary] of everything that happened on the trip.
examples.cn: 他把旅途中发生的一切都记在了[日记本]里。

examples.en: Writing a [diary] helps you remember important moments.
examples.cn: 写[日记]帮助你记住重要的时刻。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to keep a [diary] in English.
examples.cn: 老师要求我们用英语写[日记]。

examples.en: Her [diary] is private and nobody else can read it.
examples.cn: 她的[日记]是私密的，没有人可以阅读。

words.translation: n. 字典, 词典\n[计] 词典
words.definition: n. a reference book containing an alphabetical list of words with information about them

examples.en: Look up the word in your [dictionary] if you don't know it.
examples.cn: 如果你不认识这个词，就在[词典]里查一查。

examples.en: She uses an English-Chinese [dictionary] to help with reading.
examples.cn: 她用英汉[词典]帮助阅读。

examples.en: He got a new [dictionary] as a birthday present.
examples.cn: 他收到了一本新[词典]作为生日礼物。

examples.en: A good [dictionary] gives examples of how words are used.
examples.cn: 好的[词典]会给出单词用法的例句。

examples.en: There is an online [dictionary] students can use for free.
examples.cn: 有一个在线[词典]可以供学生免费使用。

words.translation: vi. 死亡, 消逝, 平息, 熄灭, 漠然, 渴望\nvt. 死\nn. 骰子, 冲模
words.definition:
n. a small cube with 1 to 6 spots on the six faces; used in gambling to generate random numbers
n. a device used for shaping metal
n. a cutting tool that is fitted into a diestock and used for cutting male (external) screw threads on screws or bolts or pipes or rods
v. pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life

examples.en: The plant [died] because it did not get enough water.
examples.cn: 植物因为缺水而[枯死]了。

examples.en: Many animals [die] in winter if they cannot find food.
examples.cn: 如果找不到食物，许多动物在冬天会[死亡]。

examples.en: The candle [died] when the wind blew into the room.
examples.cn: 风吹进房间后，蜡烛[熄灭]了。

examples.en: I am [dying] to try the new restaurant near school.
examples.cn: 我[迫不及待]想去学校附近的新餐厅试试。

examples.en: Beautiful memories never [die].
examples.cn: 美好的记忆永不[消逝]。

words.translation: n. 不同, 差异\n[计] 差分
words.definition: n. the quality of being unlike or dissimilar\nn. a significant change

examples.en: What is the [difference] between a frog and a toad?
examples.cn: 青蛙和蟾蜍有什么[区别]？

examples.en: There is a big [difference] in temperature between day and night.
examples.cn: 昼夜温差很大。

examples.en: She noticed the [difference] in her English after six months.
examples.cn: 六个月后她注意到了自己英语的[变化]。

examples.en: A kind word can make a big [difference] to someone's day.
examples.cn: 一句善意的话可以对一个人的一天产生很大[影响]。

examples.en: The [difference] between the two answers is easy to spot.
examples.cn: 这两个答案的[差异]很容易看出。

words.translation: a. 不同的\n[机] 差动, 微分的, 差速器
words.definition:
a. unlike in nature or quality or form or degree
s. distinctly separate from the first
s. differing from all others; not ordinary
s. distinct or separate

examples.en: My sister and I have very [different] personalities.
examples.cn: 我和姐姐的性格非常[不同]。

examples.en: People from [different] countries have [different] customs.
examples.cn: 来自[不同]国家的人有[不同]的风俗习惯。

examples.en: The twins look the same but have [different] interests.
examples.cn: 双胞胎长相一样，但兴趣爱好[各不相同]。

examples.en: She tries a [different] approach every time she has a problem.
examples.cn: 每次遇到问题，她都会尝试[不同的]方法。

examples.en: Today's lesson is [different] from yesterday's — it is more fun.
examples.cn: 今天的课和昨天的[不同]——更有趣了。

words.translation: a. 困难的
words.definition: a. not easy; requiring great physical or mental effort to accomplish or comprehend or endure

examples.en: The maths problem was too [difficult] for me to solve alone.
examples.cn: 这道数学题太[难了]，我一个人解不出来。

examples.en: Learning a new language is [difficult] but rewarding.
examples.cn: 学一门新语言很[难]，但很值得。

examples.en: She found it [difficult] to make new friends at first.
examples.cn: 她一开始[难以]结交新朋友。

examples.en: The test was [difficult], but she passed it.
examples.cn: 考试很[难]，但她通过了。

examples.en: Don't give up when things get [difficult].
examples.cn: 当事情变得[困难]时不要放弃。

words.translation: n. 困难, 难点
words.definition: n. a factor causing trouble in achieving a positive result or tending to produce a negative result\nn. a condition or state of affairs almost beyond one's ability to deal with and requiring great effort to bear or overcome\nn. the quality of being difficult

examples.en: She had [difficulty] understanding the new grammar rule.
examples.cn: 她理解这条新语法规则有[困难]。

examples.en: He faced many [difficulties] during his first year at school.
examples.cn: 他在第一学年遇到了很多[困难]。

examples.en: With practice, you can overcome any [difficulty].
examples.cn: 通过练习，你可以克服任何[困难]。

examples.en: The teacher helped the student with the [difficulty] in writing.
examples.cn: 老师帮助学生解决写作中的[难题]。

examples.en: She solved the [difficulty] by asking her classmates for help.
examples.cn: 她通过向同学求助解决了[困难]。

words.translation:
vt. 挖, 翻土, 发掘
vi. 挖掘
n. 挖掘
[计] 数字, 数位
words.definition:
n. the site of an archeological exploration
n. a small gouge (as in the cover of a book)
n. the act of touching someone suddenly with your finger or elbow
v. turn up, loosen, or remove earth

examples.en: The dog [dug] a hole in the garden.
examples.cn: 那只狗在花园里[挖]了一个洞。

examples.en: Workers [dug] the ground to lay the pipes.
examples.cn: 工人们[挖地]铺设管道。

examples.en: She [dug] up some potatoes from the field.
examples.cn: 她从田里[挖]出了一些土豆。

examples.en: Children love to [dig] in the sand at the beach.
examples.cn: 孩子们喜欢在海滩上[挖]沙子。

examples.en: The archaeologists [dug] carefully to find the ancient objects.
examples.cn: 考古学家小心翼翼地[挖掘]，寻找古代文物。

words.translation: n. 晚餐, 正餐, 宴会
words.definition: n. the main meal of the day served in the evening or at midday\nn. a party of people assembled to have dinner together

examples.en: Our family eats [dinner] together at seven every evening.
examples.cn: 我们一家每晚七点一起吃[晚饭]。

examples.en: She cooked a special [dinner] for her mum's birthday.
examples.cn: 她为妈妈的生日做了一顿特别的[晚餐]。

examples.en: What would you like for [dinner] tonight?
examples.cn: 你今晚想吃什么[晚饭]？

examples.en: The school canteen serves [dinner] from five to seven.
examples.cn: 学校食堂从五点到七点提供[晚餐]。

examples.en: He always washes his hands before [dinner].
examples.cn: 他吃[晚饭]前总是洗手。

words.translation:
a. 直接的, 坦白的
vt. 指示, 指挥, 命令, 导演
vi. 指导, 指挥
adv. 直接地
words.definition:
v. command with authority
v. guide the actors in (plays and films)
v. be in charge of
v. give directions to; point somebody into a certain direction

examples.sense: adj. 直接的，直截了当的
examples.en: She gave a [direct] answer without beating around the bush.
examples.cn: 她给出了一个[直接的]回答，没有拐弯抹角。

examples.sense: adj. 直接的，直截了当的
examples.en: The [direct] train to Shanghai takes about three hours.
examples.cn: 去上海的[直达]列车大约需要三小时。

examples.en: The teacher [directed] us to the right page in the book.
examples.cn: 老师[引导]我们翻到书中正确的页面。

examples.en: He [directed] the school play and it was a big success.
examples.cn: 他[导演]了学校的话剧，大获成功。

examples.sense: adj. 直接的，直截了当的
examples.en: Can you give me [direct] instructions to the library?
examples.cn: 你能给我[直接的]去图书馆的指引吗？

words.translation: n. 方向, 指导, 趋势\n[计] 方向; 流向
words.definition:
n. a line leading to a place or point
n. the spatial relation between something and the course along which it points or moves
n. a general course along which something has a tendency to develop
n. a message describing how something is to be done

examples.en: She asked a stranger for [directions] to the museum.
examples.cn: 她向陌生人询问去博物馆的[方向]。

examples.en: The wind changed [direction] suddenly.
examples.cn: 风突然改变了[方向]。

examples.en: Follow the [directions] on the medicine carefully.
examples.cn: 仔细遵照药品上的[说明]服用。

examples.en: He lost his [direction] in the dark forest.
examples.cn: 他在黑暗的森林里迷失了[方向]。

examples.en: The teacher gave clear [directions] for the exam.
examples.cn: 老师就考试给出了清晰的[指示]。

words.translation: n. 主管, 导演, 董事\n[计] 寻向偶极子; 指挥仪
words.definition: n. someone who controls resources and expenditures\nn. member of a board of directors\nn. someone who supervises the actors and directs the action in the production of a show

examples.en: The [director] of the film won many awards.
examples.cn: 这部电影的[导演]获得了很多奖项。

examples.en: She wants to become a film [director] when she grows up.
examples.cn: 她长大后想成为一名电影[导演]。

examples.en: The [director] of the school welcomed the new students.
examples.cn: 学校[校长]欢迎了新生们。

examples.en: She was appointed [director] of the sports department.
examples.cn: 她被任命为体育部门的[主任]。

examples.en: The [director] told the actors how to perform each scene.
examples.cn: [导演]告诉演员如何表演每一个场景。

words.translation: a. 肮脏的, 卑鄙的\nvt. 弄脏\nvi. 变脏
words.definition:
v. make soiled, filthy, or dirty
a. soiled or likely to soil with dirt or grime
a. (of behavior or especially language) characterized by obscenity or indecency
s. vile; despicable

examples.en: His hands were [dirty] after playing in the mud.
examples.cn: 他在泥地里玩耍后手[很脏]。

examples.en: She put all the [dirty] clothes in the washing machine.
examples.cn: 她把所有[脏]衣服放进了洗衣机。

examples.en: Don't eat with [dirty] hands — go and wash them first.
examples.cn: 不要用[脏]手吃东西——先去洗手。

examples.en: The floor was [dirty] because no one had swept it all week.

words.translation: n. 讨论

words.translation: n. 盘子, 碟, 菜肴\n[医] 皿, 碟
