examples.en: Today is the [eighth] of May.
examples.cn: 今天是五月[八]日。

examples.en: He sits in the [eighth] row from the front.
examples.cn: 他坐在从前数[第八]排。

examples.en: She is the [eighth] person to finish the exam.
examples.cn: 她是[第八个]完成考试的人。

examples.en: The classroom is on the [eighth] floor.
examples.cn: 教室在[第八]层楼。

words.translation: num. 八十, 八十个
words.definition: n. the cardinal number that is the product of ten and eight\ns. being ten more than seventy

examples.en: There are [eighty] questions on the exam paper.
examples.cn: 试卷上有[八十]道题。

examples.en: Her grandmother is [eighty] years old and still very healthy.
examples.cn: 她的祖母[八十]岁了，依然非常健康。

examples.en: The school hall can hold [eighty] people.
examples.cn: 学校礼堂可以容纳[八十]人。

examples.en: He walked [eighty] steps and then stopped to rest.
examples.cn: 他走了[八十]步，然后停下来休息。

examples.en: The temperature in the desert can reach [eighty] degrees in summer.
examples.cn: 沙漠夏天的气温可以达到[八十]度。

words.translation: a. (两者之中)任一的, (两者之中)各一的\npron. (两者之中)任一\nconj. 或, 要么
words.definition: r. after a negative statement used as an intensive meaning something like `likewise' or `also'

examples.en: You can sit on [either] side of the table.
examples.cn: 你可以坐在桌子[任一]边。

examples.en: [Either] answer is acceptable for this question.
examples.cn: 这道题[两个]答案都可以接受。

examples.en: You can choose [either] the red pen or the blue one.
examples.cn: 你可以选择红笔[或者]蓝笔。

examples.en: She doesn't like coffee and I don't [either].
examples.cn: 她不喜欢咖啡，我[也]不喜欢。

examples.en: I haven't read [either] of the two books yet.
examples.cn: 这两本书我[都]还没有读过。

words.translation: n. 年长者, 老人, 前辈\na. 年长的, 资深的
words.definition:
n. a person who is older than you are
n. any of numerous shrubs or small trees of temperate and subtropical northern hemisphere having white flowers and berrylike fruit
n. any of various church officers
s. used of the older of two persons of the same name especially used to distinguish a father from his son

examples.en: My [elder] sister is three years older than me.
examples.cn: 我[姐姐]比我大三岁。

examples.en: He asked his [elder] brother for advice.
examples.cn: 他向[哥哥]征询意见。

examples.en: We should always respect our [elders].
examples.cn: 我们应该尊重[长辈]。

examples.en: The [elders] in the village gathered to discuss the problem.
examples.cn: 村子里的[长辈们]聚在一起讨论这个问题。

examples.en: Her [elder] brother helped her move to the new school.
examples.cn: 她[哥哥]帮她转到了新学校。

words.translation: a. 电的, 导电的, 电动的\n[医] 电的
words.definition:
n. a car that is powered by electricity
a. using or providing or producing or transmitting or operated by electricity
s. (of a situation) exceptionally tense
s. affected by emotion as if by electricity; thrilling

examples.en: We use an [electric] fan to cool down in summer.
examples.cn: 夏天我们用[电]扇降温。

examples.en: She rides an [electric] bike to school every day.
examples.cn: 她每天骑[电动]自行车上学。

examples.en: The kitchen has an [electric] cooker instead of gas.
examples.cn: 厨房用的是[电]炉而不是燃气炉。

examples.en: The atmosphere at the sports event was [electric].
examples.cn: 体育赛事的气氛令人[激动兴奋]。

examples.en: An [electric] car uses no petrol at all.
examples.cn: [电动]汽车完全不耗油。

words.translation: n. 象
words.definition: n. five-toed pachyderm\nn. the symbol of the Republican Party; introduced in cartoons by Thomas Nast in 1874

examples.en: The [elephant] is the largest land animal.
examples.cn: [大象]是最大的陆地动物。

examples.en: She saw a family of [elephants] at the wildlife park.
examples.cn: 她在野生动物园看到了一群[大象]。

examples.en: The [elephant] used its long trunk to drink water.
examples.cn: [大象]用长长的鼻子喝水。

examples.en: Young children love to draw [elephants] with their big ears.
examples.cn: 小孩子喜欢画有大耳朵的[大象]。

examples.en: In some countries, [elephants] are used for carrying heavy loads.
examples.cn: 在一些国家，[大象]被用来搬运重物。

words.translation: num. 十一, 十一个
words.definition: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of ten and one\ns. being one more than ten

examples.en: The school starts at [eleven] on Saturday morning.
examples.cn: 周六早上[十一]点学校开始上课。

examples.en: She has been in this school for [eleven] months.
examples.cn: 她在这所学校已经[十一]个月了。

examples.en: There are [eleven] players on a football team.
examples.cn: 足球队有[十一]名球员。

examples.en: He finished his homework at [eleven] o'clock at night.
examples.cn: 他在晚上[十一]点完成了作业。

examples.en: She won [eleven] gold medals in her sports career.
examples.cn: 她在运动生涯中共赢得了[十一]枚金牌。

words.translation: a. 别的, 其他的\nadv. 另外, 否则, 不然
words.definition:
a. & pron. Other; one or something beside; as, Who else is
   coming? What else shall I give? Do you expect anything else?
adv. & conj. Besides; except that mentioned; in addition; as,
   nowhere else; no one else.
adv. & conj. Otherwise; in the other, or the contrary, case; if
   the facts were different.

examples.en: Is there anything [else] I can help you with?
examples.cn: 还有什么[别的]我可以帮你的吗？

examples.en: He forgot his pencil — can anyone [else] lend him one?
examples.cn: 他忘带铅笔了——有[其他]人能借给他吗？

examples.en: She didn't want anything [else] to eat.
examples.cn: 她不想再[多]吃其他东西了。

examples.en: Do your homework now, or [else] you will get in trouble.
examples.cn: 现在做作业，[否则]你会有麻烦的。

examples.en: Who [else] wants to come to the library with me?
examples.cn: 还有谁[想]和我一起去图书馆？

words.translation: n. 电子信函
words.definition: n (computer science) a system of world-wide electronic communication in which a computer user can compose a message at one terminal that can be regenerated at the recipient's terminal when the recipient logs in\nv communicate electronically on the computer

examples.en: She sent an [email] to her teacher to ask about the homework.
examples.cn: 她给老师发了一封[电子邮件]询问作业。

examples.en: He checked his [email] every morning before school.
examples.cn: 他每天上学前都查看[电子邮件]。

examples.en: Please [email] me the report when it is ready.
examples.cn: 报告准备好后请[发邮件]给我。

examples.en: The school sent an [email] to all parents about the trip.
examples.cn: 学校向所有家长发了一封关于旅行的[电子邮件]。

examples.en: She [emailed] her friend abroad every week.
examples.cn: 她每周给国外的朋友[发邮件]。

words.translation:
a. 空的, 空虚的, 空腹的, 空洞的
n. 空的东西, 空车
vt. 倒空, 使变空, 使排出
vi. 流空
[计] 空
words.definition:
n. a container that has been emptied
v. make void or empty of contents
v. become empty or void of its content
v. remove

examples.en: The classroom was [empty] — all the students had gone home.
examples.cn: 教室是[空的]——所有学生都回家了。

examples.en: She drank all the water and the bottle was [empty].
examples.cn: 她喝完了所有的水，瓶子[空了]。

examples.en: Please [empty] the bin before leaving the classroom.
examples.cn: 离开教室前请把垃圾桶[清空]。

examples.en: The park was [empty] because it was raining.
examples.cn: 因为下雨，公园里是[空的]。

examples.en: Her stomach felt [empty] because she skipped lunch.
examples.cn: 她没吃午饭，肚子感觉[空空的]。

words.translation: vt. 鼓励, 支持, 激励\n[法] 怂恿, 煽动, 助长
words.definition: v. inspire with confidence; give hope or courage to\nv. spur on

examples.en: The teacher [encouraged] us to read more books.
examples.cn: 老师[鼓励]我们多读书。

examples.en: Her parents always [encourage] her to try new things.
examples.cn: 她的父母总是[鼓励]她尝试新事物。

examples.en: He [encouraged] his friend not to give up after the loss.
examples.cn: 他[鼓励]朋友在失败后不要放弃。

examples.en: The coach [encouraged] the team before the big match.
examples.cn: 大赛前教练[鼓励]了队员们。

examples.en: She was [encouraged] by the kind words of her teacher.
examples.cn: 老师的善意言语[鼓励]了她。

words.translation: n. 结束, 终点, 目标, 末端, 梢, 死亡, 残余\nv. 结束, 终结, 终止\n[计] 端; 结束
words.definition:
n. either extremity of something that has length
n. the point in time at which something ends
n. the concluding parts of an event or occurrence
n. a final part or section

examples.en: The [end] of the film made everyone cry.
examples.cn: 电影的[结尾]让所有人都哭了。

examples.en: She sat at the [end] of the row during the exam.
examples.cn: 考试期间她坐在那排的[末端]。

examples.en: The class [ended] early because the teacher was ill.
examples.cn: 由于老师生病，课提前[结束]了。

examples.en: There is a small park at the [end] of our street.
examples.cn: 我们街道[尽头]有一个小公园。

examples.en: The sports day [ended] with a wonderful firework show.
examples.cn: 运动会以精彩的烟火表演[结束]。

words.translation: n. 敌人, 仇敌, 敌军\na. 敌人的
words.definition: n. an opposing military force\nn. an armed adversary (especially a member of an opposing military force)\nn. any hostile group of people

examples.en: In the story, the hero defeats his [enemy] in the end.
examples.cn: 在故事中，英雄最终打败了[敌人]。

examples.en: Laziness is the greatest [enemy] of success.
examples.cn: 懒惰是成功最大的[敌人]。

examples.en: She turned her [enemy] into a friend through kindness.
examples.cn: 她用善意把[敌人]变成了朋友。

examples.en: In the game, you need to avoid the [enemies] to win.
examples.cn: 在游戏中，你需要避开[敌人]才能获胜。

examples.en: Disease is the [enemy] of good health.
examples.cn: 疾病是健康的[大敌]。

words.translation: n. 精力, 精神, 活力, 能量\n[化] 能; 能量
words.definition:
n. (physics) a thermodynamic quantity equivalent to the capacity of a physical system to do work; the units of energy are joules or ergs
n. forceful exertion
n. enterprising or ambitious drive
n. an imaginative lively style (especially style of writing)

examples.en: She had a lot of [energy] after a good night's sleep.
examples.cn: 睡了一个好觉后，她精力充沛。

examples.en: Running uses a lot of physical [energy].
examples.cn: 跑步需要消耗大量体力[能量]。

examples.en: Solar [energy] is clean and good for the environment.
examples.cn: 太阳[能]清洁，对环境有益。

examples.en: We should save [energy] by turning off lights we don't need.
examples.cn: 我们应该关掉不需要的灯来节省[能源]。

examples.en: Children have a lot of [energy] and love to run around.
examples.cn: 孩子们[精力]充沛，喜欢跑来跑去。

words.translation: n. 工程师, 工兵\nvt. 设计, 监造, 精明地处理, 策划
words.definition: n. a person who uses scientific knowledge to solve practical problems\nn. the operator of a railway locomotive\nv. design as an engineer

examples.en: Her father is an [engineer] who designs bridges.
examples.cn: 她父亲是一名设计桥梁的[工程师]。

examples.en: He wants to become a software [engineer] in the future.
examples.cn: 他未来想成为一名软件[工程师]。

examples.en: The [engineer] fixed the problem with the school's heating system.
examples.cn: [工程师]修好了学校供暖系统的问题。

examples.en: Civil [engineers] build roads, tunnels, and dams.
examples.cn: 土木[工程师]建造道路、隧道和水坝。

examples.en: She studied hard because she dreamed of being an [engineer].
examples.cn: 她努力学习，因为她梦想成为一名[工程师]。

words.translation: n. 英格兰\n[法] 英格兰, 英国
words.definition: n. a division of the United Kingdom

examples.en: She went to [England] to study English for a year.
examples.cn: 她去[英格兰]学了一年英语。

examples.en: [England] is the largest country in the United Kingdom.
examples.cn: [英格兰]是英国最大的组成部分。

examples.en: London is the capital city of [England].
examples.cn: 伦敦是[英格兰]的首都。

examples.en: The [England] football team has many talented players.
examples.cn: [英格兰]足球队有很多有才华的球员。

examples.en: He learned about the history of [England] in his class.
examples.cn: 他在课堂上学习了[英格兰]的历史。

words.translation: n. 英语\na. 英文的, 英国人的
words.definition: n. an Indo-European language belonging to the West Germanic branch; the official language of Britain and the United States and most of the commonwealth countries\nn. the people of England\nn. the discipline that studies the English language and literature

examples.en: She studies [English] every evening to improve her skills.
examples.cn: 她每天晚上学习[英语]以提高水平。

examples.en: He can speak [English] and Mandarin fluently.
examples.cn: 他能流利地说[英语]和普通话。

examples.en: We read an [English] poem in class today.
examples.cn: 我们今天在课堂上读了一首[英国]诗。

examples.en: [English] is taught in most schools around the world.
examples.cn: 全世界大多数学校都教[英语]。

examples.en: Her [English] has improved a lot since joining the club.
examples.cn: 自从加入俱乐部后，她的[英语]进步了很多。

words.translation: vt. 享受, 喜欢, 欣赏\n[法] 享受, 享有, 获得某种利益
words.definition: v. derive or receive pleasure from; get enjoyment from; take pleasure in\nv. have benefit from\nv. have for one's benefit

examples.en: I [enjoy] playing football with my friends after school.
examples.cn: 我放学后[喜欢]和朋友们踢足球。

examples.en: She [enjoys] reading novels in her spare time.
examples.cn: 她空闲时[喜欢]读小说。

examples.en: Did you [enjoy] your trip to Beijing last summer?
examples.cn: 你去年夏天去北京的旅行[玩得开心]吗？

examples.en: We [enjoyed] a delicious meal at the restaurant.
examples.cn: 我们在餐厅[享用]了一顿美味的饭菜。

examples.en: Everyone should [enjoy] equal rights in society.
examples.cn: 每个人都应该在社会中[享有]平等的权利。

words.translation:
n. 充足, 够, 很多
a. 充足的, 足够
adv. 足够
interj. 够了
words.definition: n. an adequate quantity; a quantity that is large enough to achieve a purpose\nr. as much as necessary; (`plenty' is nonstandard) "I've had plenty, thanks"

examples.en: Is there [enough] food for everyone at the party?
examples.cn: 聚会上有[足够的]食物给每个人吗？

examples.en: I don't have [enough] time to finish my homework tonight.
examples.cn: 我今晚没有[足够的]时间完成作业。

examples.en: She is old [enough] to go to school by herself.
examples.cn: 她[足够]大了，可以自己上学。

examples.en: I have had [enough] of your complaints, please stop.
examples.cn: 我已经受[够了]你的抱怨，请停下来。

examples.en: [Enough]! Please stop arguing and calm down.
examples.cn: [够了]！请停止争吵，冷静下来。

words.translation: vt. 进入, 参加, 开始, 输入, 回车\nvi. 进去, 参加\n[计] 输入, 回车
words.definition: v. to come or go into\nv. become a participant; be involved in\nv. come on stage

examples.en: Please knock before you [enter] the classroom.
examples.cn: 请在[进入]教室前敲门。

examples.en: The students [entered] the hall quietly for the ceremony.
examples.cn: 学生们静静地[进入]大厅参加典礼。

examples.en: She decided to [enter] the singing competition this year.
examples.cn: 她决定今年[参加]歌唱比赛。

examples.en: Please [enter] your password to log into the system.
examples.cn: 请[输入]密码以登录系统。

examples.en: The country has [entered] a new period of development.
examples.cn: 这个国家[进入]了一个新的发展时期。

words.translation: n. 环境, 外界, 围绕\n[计] 环境
words.definition: n. the totality of surrounding conditions\nn. the area in which something exists or lives

examples.en: We should protect the [environment] from pollution.
examples.cn: 我们应该保护[环境]不受污染。

examples.en: Planting trees helps improve the natural [environment].
examples.cn: 植树有助于改善自然[环境]。

examples.en: Children grow better in a happy home [environment].
examples.cn: 孩子们在快乐的家庭[环境]中成长得更好。

examples.en: A quiet [environment] is important for studying.
examples.cn: 安静的[环境]对学习很重要。

examples.en: Animals must adapt to their [environment] to survive.
examples.cn: 动物必须适应它们的[生存环境]才能存活。

words.translation: n. 擦子
words.definition: n. an implement used to erase something

examples.en: Can I borrow your [eraser]? I made a mistake.
examples.cn: 我能借你的[橡皮擦]吗？我写错了。

examples.en: She used an [eraser] to fix the mistake in her drawing.
examples.cn: 她用[橡皮擦]修改了她画中的错误。

examples.en: I always keep a pencil and an [eraser] in my pencil case.
examples.cn: 我总是在铅笔盒里放一支铅笔和一块[橡皮擦]。

examples.en: The teacher told us to write in pen, so we couldn't use an [eraser].
examples.cn: 老师告诉我们用钢笔写字，所以我们不能用[橡皮擦]。

examples.en: My [eraser] is so small that I need to buy a new one.
examples.cn: 我的[橡皮擦]太小了，我需要买一块新的。

words.translation: adv. 尤其, 特别, 格外
words.definition: r to a distinctly greater extent or degree than is common\nr in a special manner

examples.en: I love all sports, [especially] swimming.
examples.cn: 我喜欢所有运动，[尤其]是游泳。

examples.en: She is [especially] good at drawing and painting.
examples.cn: 她[特别]擅长画画和绘画。

examples.en: I bought this gift [especially] for you.
examples.cn: 我[特地]为你买了这份礼物。

examples.en: Drink more water, [especially] in summer.
examples.cn: 多喝水，[尤其是]在夏天。

examples.en: Be [especially] careful when crossing the road.
examples.cn: 过马路时要[特别]小心。

words.translation: n. 欧洲
words.definition: n. the 2nd smallest continent (actually a vast peninsula of Eurasia); the British use `Europe' to refer to all of the continent except the British Isles\nn. the nations of the European continent collectively

examples.en: Many tourists visit [Europe] every year.
examples.cn: 每年有许多游客参观[欧洲]。

examples.en: France and Germany are countries in [Europe].
examples.cn: 法国和德国是[欧洲]的国家。

examples.en: My uncle went on a trip to [Europe] last summer.
examples.cn: 我叔叔去年夏天去[欧洲]旅行了。

examples.en: Football is very popular in [Europe].
examples.cn: 足球在[欧洲]非常流行。

examples.en: She dreams of studying in [Europe] one day.
examples.cn: 她梦想有一天去[欧洲]留学。

words.translation: n. 欧洲人\na. 欧洲的, 欧洲人的
words.definition: n. a native or inhabitant of Europe\na. of or relating to or characteristic of Europe or the people of Europe

examples.en: He is interested in [European] history and culture.
examples.cn: 他对[欧洲]历史和文化很感兴趣。

examples.en: Many [European] countries use the euro as their currency.
examples.cn: 许多[欧洲]国家使用欧元作为货币。

examples.en: She studies [European] art and architecture at university.
examples.cn: 她在大学学习[欧洲]艺术和建筑。

examples.en: The hotel was full of [Europeans] during the holiday season.
examples.cn: 节假日期间，这家酒店住满了[欧洲人]。

examples.en: He married a [European] and moved to France.
examples.cn: 他娶了一位[欧洲人]并搬到了法国。

words.translation:
a. 平坦的, 相等的, 连贯的, 均等的, 公平的, 偶数的, 平均的, 平衡的, 恰好的
vt. 使平坦, 使相等
vi. 变平, 成为相等
adv. 甚至, 实际上, 完全, 十分
n. 偶数, 偶校验
[计] 偶数, 偶校验
words.definition:
v. become even or more even
v. make even or more even
a. divisible by two
s. equal in degree or extent or amount; or equally matched or balanced

examples.en: [Even] young children can learn to use a computer.
examples.cn: [甚至]小孩子也能学会使用电脑。

examples.en: She didn't [even] say goodbye when she left.
examples.cn: 她离开时[连]再见都没说。

examples.en: We need an [even] surface to play table tennis.
examples.cn: 我们需要一个[平整的]表面来打乒乓球。

examples.en: The scores were [even] at the end of the first half.
examples.cn: 上半场结束时比分[持平]。

examples.en: Two, four, and six are all [even] numbers.
examples.cn: 2、4和6都是[偶数]。

words.translation: n. 傍晚, 晚间, 末期
words.definition: n. the latter part of the day (the period of decreasing daylight from late afternoon until nightfall)\nn. a later concluding time period\nn. the early part of night (from dinner until bedtime) spent in a special way

examples.en: We usually have dinner together in the [evening].
examples.cn: 我们通常在[晚上]一起吃晚饭。

examples.en: She goes for a walk every [evening] after dinner.
examples.cn: 她每天[晚上]饭后都去散步。

examples.en: The sky turns red and orange in the [evening].
examples.cn: [傍晚]时，天空变成红色和橙色。

examples.en: There will be a music [evening] at school on Friday.
examples.cn: 周五学校将举办一场音乐[晚会]。

examples.en: Good [evening]! Welcome to our show.
examples.cn: [晚上好]！欢迎来到我们的节目。

words.translation: adv. 曾经, 究竟, 永远
words.definition: r. at any time\nr. (intensifier for adjectives) very

examples.en: Have you [ever] visited the Great Wall?
examples.cn: 你[曾经]去过长城吗？

examples.en: That was the best meal I have [ever] had.
examples.cn: 那是我[有史以来]吃过的最美味的一餐。

examples.en: I will [ever] be grateful for your help and kindness.
examples.cn: 我将[永远]感激你的帮助和善意。

examples.en: Why did you [ever] think that was a good idea?
examples.cn: 你[究竟]为什么认为那是个好主意？

examples.en: This is the fastest train that has [ever] been built.
examples.cn: 这是[有史以来]建造过的最快的火车。

words.translation: a. 每一, 所有的
words.definition: s. (used of count nouns) each and all of the members of a group considered singly and without exception\ns. each and all of a series of entities or intervals as specified

examples.en: [Every] student must bring their textbook to class.
examples.cn: [每个]学生都必须带课本来上课。

examples.en: She practices piano [every] day after school.
examples.cn: 她[每天]放学后练习钢琴。

examples.en: The bus comes [every] fifteen minutes.
examples.cn: 公共汽车[每隔]十五分钟来一次。

examples.en: I checked [every] drawer but couldn't find my key.
examples.cn: 我检查了[每一个]抽屉，但找不到我的钥匙。

examples.en: They gave us [every] chance to succeed.
examples.cn: 他们给了我们[一切可能的]成功机会。

words.translation: pron. 每个人, 人人
words.definition: n. Every person.

examples.en: [Everybody] in the class passed the exam.
examples.cn: 班上[每个人]都通过了考试。

examples.en: [Everybody] knows that the earth goes around the sun.
examples.cn: [人人]都知道地球绕着太阳转。

examples.en: [Everybody] stand up and greet the teacher.
examples.cn: [大家]起立向老师问好。

examples.en: [Everybody] should take responsibility for their actions.
examples.cn: [每个人]都应该为自己的行为负责。

examples.en: [Everybody] has been invited to the school sports day.
examples.cn: [所有人]都被邀请参加学校运动会。

words.translation: a. 每天的, 日常的, 平常的
words.definition: s. found in the ordinary course of events\ns. commonplace and ordinary

examples.en: Washing hands is an [everyday] habit we should all have.
examples.cn: 洗手是我们都应该养成的[日常]习惯。

examples.en: He wore his [everyday] clothes to the picnic.
examples.cn: 他穿着[日常]服装去野餐。

examples.en: This is just an [everyday] problem that anyone might face.
examples.cn: 这只是一个[普通的]任何人都可能遇到的问题。

examples.en: Her [everyday] language is simple and easy to understand.
examples.cn: 她[日常]说话语言简单易懂。

examples.en: These are [everyday] objects that we use in the kitchen.
examples.cn: 这些是我们在厨房里使用的[日常]物品。

words.translation: pron. 每个人, 人人\n[计] 系统中的一个组名
words.definition: n. Everybody; -- commonly separated, every one.

examples.en: [Everyone] in my family loves cooking Chinese food.
examples.cn: 我家里[每个人]都喜欢做中国菜。

examples.en: [Everyone] should be treated with respect and kindness.
examples.cn: [每个人]都应该受到尊重和善待。

examples.en: [Everyone] gathered in the school gym for the assembly.
examples.cn: [大家]聚集在学校体育馆参加集会。

examples.en: [Everyone] agreed that the movie was very exciting.
examples.cn: [所有人]都认为这部电影非常精彩。

examples.en: Not [everyone] finds mathematics easy to learn.
examples.cn: 并非[人人]都觉得数学容易学。

words.translation: pron. 每件事物, 所有事物
words.definition: n. Whatever pertains to the subject under consideration;\n   all things.

examples.en: [Everything] on this menu looks delicious.
examples.cn: 这份菜单上的[每样东西]看起来都很美味。

examples.en: She packed [everything] she needed for the camping trip.
examples.cn: 她收拾好了露营旅行所需的[一切东西]。

examples.en: Money isn't [everything]; happiness matters more.
examples.cn: 金钱不是[一切]；幸福更重要。

examples.en: [Everything] was quiet in the village after midnight.
examples.cn: 午夜过后，村里[一切]都很安静。

examples.en: Is [everything] all right? You look worried.
examples.cn: [一切]都好吗？你看起来很担心。

words.translation: adv. 各处, 到处
words.definition: r. to or in any or all places; (`everyplace' is used informally for `everywhere')

examples.en: Children were playing [everywhere] in the park.
examples.cn: 孩子们在公园里[到处]玩耍。

examples.en: You can find fast food restaurants [everywhere] in the city.
examples.cn: 在这座城市里，[处处]都可以找到快餐店。

examples.en: Plastic waste can be found [everywhere] in the ocean.
examples.cn: 塑料废物[随处可见]于海洋中。

examples.en: He looked [everywhere] but couldn't find his glasses.
examples.cn: 他[到处]找但找不到他的眼镜。

examples.en: [Everywhere] she went, people recognized her.
examples.cn: 无论她走到[哪里]，人们都认出了她。

words.translation: n. 考试, 测验
words.definition: n a set of questions or exercises evaluating skill or knowledge

examples.en: We have a math [exam] at the end of this week.
examples.cn: 我们本周末有一场数学[考试]。

examples.en: She stayed up late to prepare for the [exam].
examples.cn: 她熬夜备战[考试]。

examples.en: Did you pass the English [exam]?
examples.cn: 你通过英语[考试]了吗？

examples.en: The [exam] results will be announced next Monday.
examples.cn: [考试]成绩将于下周一公布。

examples.en: The doctor gave him a thorough physical [exam].
examples.cn: 医生给他做了一次全面的身体[检查]。

words.translation: n. 考试, 测验, 审查\n[医] 检查, 诊察
words.definition: n. the act of examining something closely (as for mistakes)\nn. a set of questions or exercises evaluating skill or knowledge\nn. the act of giving students or candidates a test (as by questions) to determine what they know or have learned

examples.en: The final [examination] will be held on the last day of term.
examples.cn: 期末[考试]将在学期最后一天举行。

examples.en: He passed the entrance [examination] and got into a top school.
examples.cn: 他通过了入学[考试]，进入了一所顶尖学校。

examples.en: The police did a careful [examination] of the crime scene.
examples.cn: 警方对犯罪现场进行了仔细的[检查]。

examples.en: A medical [examination] is required before joining the sports team.
examples.cn: 加入运动队前需要进行体格[检查]。

examples.en: The lawyer called for a closer [examination] of the evidence.
examples.cn: 律师要求对证据进行更仔细的[审查]。

words.translation: v. 检查, 调查, 考试
words.definition: v. observe, check out, and look over carefully or inspect\nv. question closely

examples.en: The doctor will [examine] your eyes to check your vision.
examples.cn: 医生将[检查]你的眼睛以检测视力。

examples.en: The teacher [examined] the students' homework carefully.
examples.cn: 老师仔细[检查]了学生的作业。

examples.en: The committee will [examine] the new proposal next week.
examples.cn: 委员会将于下周[审查]新提案。

examples.en: The interview will [examine] your communication skills.
examples.cn: 面试将[考查]你的沟通能力。

examples.en: The nurse [examined] the patient and took her temperature.
examples.cn: 护士[诊察]了病人并量了她的体温。

words.translation: n. 例子, 样本, 实例\n[化] 实例
words.definition: n. an item of information that is typical of a class or group\nn. punishment intended as a warning to others

examples.en: Can you give me an [example] of how to use this word?
examples.cn: 你能给我一个如何使用这个词的[例子]吗？

examples.en: The teacher showed us several [examples] of good writing.
examples.cn: 老师给我们展示了几个好文章的[例子]。

examples.en: My father is a great [example] of a hardworking person.
examples.cn: 我父亲是一个勤劳的好[榜样]。

examples.en: She set a good [example] for the younger students.
examples.cn: 她为低年级同学树立了好[榜样]。

examples.sense: n. 例子（for example 用法）
examples.en: For [example], lions and tigers are both wild animals.
examples.cn: [例如]，狮子和老虎都是野生动物。

words.translation: a. 优良的, 杰出的, 出色的
words.definition: s. very good; of the highest quality

examples.en: She got an [excellent] score on her science test.
examples.cn: 她在科学考试中取得了[优秀的]成绩。

examples.en: The food at that restaurant is [excellent].
examples.cn: 那家餐厅的食物[非常出色]。

examples.en: What an [excellent] idea! Let's do it right away.
examples.cn: 真是个[极好的]主意！我们马上行动吧。

examples.en: He is an [excellent] player on the basketball team.
examples.cn: 他是篮球队里一名[出色的]球员。

examples.en: The teacher praised her for her [excellent] English pronunciation.
examples.cn: 老师表扬了她[优秀的]英语发音。

words.translation:
vt. 除, 除外
vi. 反对
prep. 除了...之外, 若不是, 除非
conj. 只是
words.definition: v take exception to\nv prevent from being included or considered or accepted

examples.en: Everyone came to the party [except] Tom.
examples.cn: 大家都来参加了聚会，[除了]汤姆。

examples.en: I like all vegetables [except] onions.
examples.cn: 我喜欢所有蔬菜，[除了]洋葱。

examples.en: The house is perfect [except] that it is too small.
examples.cn: 这所房子很完美，[只是]太小了。

examples.en: The store is open every day [except] Sunday.
examples.cn: 这家商店每天都开门，[除了]星期天。

examples.sense: prep. 除…之外（用于否定词后）
examples.en: Nothing was lost [except] a few coins.
examples.cn: 没有任何东西丢失，[除了]几枚硬币。

words.translation: vt. 刺激, 使兴奋, 激励
words.definition: v. arouse or elicit a feeling\nv. raise to a higher energy level\nv. produce a magnetic field in

examples.en: The news about the school trip [excited] all the students.
examples.cn: 关于学校旅行的消息让所有学生都[兴奋]起来。

examples.en: The match between the two teams really [excited] the crowd.
examples.cn: 两支球队之间的比赛真的让观众[激动不已]。

examples.en: This topic really [excites] my interest in science.
examples.cn: 这个话题真的[激发]了我对科学的兴趣。

examples.en: The beautiful landscape [excited] admiration in everyone.
examples.cn: 美丽的风景在每个人心中[激起]了赞叹。

examples.en: Seeing his favorite singer [excited] him so much that he couldn't sleep.
examples.cn: 看到他最喜欢的歌手让他[激动]得睡不着觉。

words.translation: vt. 原谅, 申辩, 做为...的托辞\nn. 致歉, 理由, 饶恕, 借口
words.definition:
n. a defense of some offensive behavior or some failure to keep a promise etc.
n. a note explaining an absence
v. accept an excuse for
v. grant exemption or release to

examples.en: He always makes up an [excuse] when he is late for class.
examples.cn: 他上课迟到时总是找[借口]。

examples.en: That is a very poor [excuse] for not finishing your homework.
examples.cn: 那是一个不完成作业的很差劲的[借口]。

examples.en: Please [excuse] me for being late; the traffic was terrible.
examples.cn: 请[原谅]我迟到；交通状况太糟糕了。

examples.en: [Excuse] me, could you tell me where the library is?
examples.cn: [打扰]一下，请问图书馆在哪里？

examples.en: There is no [excuse] for being rude to your teachers.
examples.cn: 对老师无礼是没有任何[理由]的。

words.translation: n. 行使, 执行, 运动, 练习, 作业\nvt. 运用, 练习, 运动\nvi. 练习, 锻炼
words.definition:
n. the activity of exerting your muscles in various ways to keep fit
n. systematic training by multiple repetitions
n. a task performed or problem solved in order to develop skill or understanding
n. (usually plural) a ceremony that involves processions and speeches

examples.en: Regular [exercise] is important for staying healthy.
examples.cn: 定期[锻炼]对保持健康很重要。

examples.en: She does [exercise] for thirty minutes every morning.
examples.cn: 她每天早上[锻炼]三十分钟。

examples.en: Please complete the grammar [exercises] on page ten.
examples.cn: 请完成第十页的语法[练习]。

examples.en: You should [exercise] more to improve your fitness.
examples.cn: 你应该多[锻炼]以提高体能。

examples.en: It is important to [exercise] your right to vote.
examples.cn: [行使]投票权是很重要的。

words.translation: vt. 预期, 盼望, 期待
words.definition:
v. regard something as probable or likely
v. look forward to the probable occurrence of
v. consider reasonable or due
v. look forward to the birth of a child

examples.en: I [expect] you to finish your homework before dinner.
examples.cn: 我[期望]你在晚饭前完成作业。

examples.en: She [expects] to receive a letter from her pen pal soon.
examples.cn: 她[期待]很快收到笔友的来信。

examples.en: We [expect] it to rain tomorrow, so bring an umbrella.
examples.cn: 我们[预计]明天会下雨，所以带把伞。

examples.en: The project is [expected] to be completed by the end of the month.
examples.cn: 该项目[预计]将在月底前完成。

examples.en: I [expect] he will come to the meeting if he has time.
examples.cn: 我[认为]如果他有时间，他会来参加会议的。

words.translation: a. 贵的, 奢华的, 费用浩大的, 乱化钱的\n[经] 高价的, 昂贵的, 浪费的
words.definition: a. high in price or charging high prices

examples.en: That new phone is too [expensive] for me to buy.
examples.cn: 那款新手机对我来说太[贵]了，买不起。

examples.en: Eating at that restaurant is quite [expensive].
examples.cn: 在那家餐厅吃饭相当[昂贵]。

examples.en: Keeping a car is [expensive] because of fuel and repairs.
examples.cn: 养一辆车很[费钱]，因为要付油费和维修费。

examples.en: She bought an [expensive] dress for her sister's wedding.
examples.cn: 她为姐姐的婚礼买了一件[昂贵的]礼服。

examples.en: The most [expensive] seat in the theater is at the front row.
examples.cn: 剧院里最[贵]的座位在第一排。

words.translation: n. 经历, 经验, 体验\nvt. 经历, 经验, 体验
words.definition:
n. the accumulation of knowledge or skill that results from direct participation in events or activities
n. the content of direct observation or participation in an event
n. an event as apprehended
v. go or live through

examples.en: She has a lot of [experience] in teaching young children.
examples.cn: 她在教幼儿方面有丰富的[经验]。

examples.en: Work [experience] is very important when looking for a job.
examples.cn: 找工作时，工作[经验]非常重要。

examples.en: Traveling to another country is an exciting [experience].
examples.cn: 去另一个国家旅行是一次令人兴奋的[经历]。

examples.en: I hope you [experience] great joy in your new school.
examples.cn: 希望你在新学校[体验]到极大的快乐。

examples.en: Many people [experienced] difficulties during the cold winter.
examples.cn: 许多人在寒冷的冬天[经历]了困难。

words.translation: n. 实验, 试验, 实验仪器\nvi. 实验, 尝试
words.definition:
n. the act of conducting a controlled test or investigation
n. the testing of an idea
n. a venture at something new or different
v. to conduct a test or investigation

examples.en: We did a science [experiment] with water and vinegar.
examples.cn: 我们用水和醋做了一个科学[实验]。

examples.en: The chemistry [experiment] showed how heat changes matter.
examples.cn: 化学[实验]展示了热量如何改变物质。

examples.en: The new drug is still in the [experiment] stage.
examples.cn: 新药仍处于[试验]阶段。

examples.en: Scientists [experiment] with new materials to develop better products.
examples.cn: 科学家们用新材料[做实验]以开发更好的产品。

examples.en: They [experimented] with different teaching methods in the classroom.
examples.cn: 他们在课堂上[尝试]了不同的教学方法。

words.translation: v. 解释, 说明
words.definition: v. make plain and comprehensible\nv. define

examples.en: Can you [explain] how this machine works?
examples.cn: 你能[解释]这台机器是如何工作的吗？

examples.en: The teacher [explained] the new grammar rule to the class.
examples.cn: 老师向全班[解释]了新语法规则。

examples.en: Please [explain] why you were absent from school yesterday.
examples.cn: 请[说明]你昨天为什么没来上学。

examples.en: He couldn't [explain] where he had been all night.
examples.cn: 他无法[解释]他整晚去了哪里。

examples.en: The scientist tried to [explain] the cause of the earthquake.
examples.cn: 科学家试图[阐明]地震的原因。

words.translation: n. 快车, 快递, 专使\na. 明确的, 丝毫不差的, 专门的, 快的\nvt. 表达, 表示, 表露
words.definition:
n. mail that is distributed by a rapid and efficient system
n. public transport consisting of a fast train or bus that makes only a few scheduled stops
n. rapid transport of goods
v. give expression to

examples.en: It is important to [express] your feelings to your friends.
examples.cn: 向朋友[表达]你的感受是很重要的。

examples.en: She [expressed] her thanks to the teacher with a card.
examples.cn: 她用一张卡片向老师[表达]了谢意。

examples.en: He sent the parcel by [express] to make sure it arrived on time.
examples.cn: 他用[快递]寄送包裹以确保准时到达。

examples.en: We took the [express] train from Beijing to Shanghai.
examples.cn: 我们乘坐[快车]从北京到上海。

examples.en: The delivery company offers an [express] service for urgent packages.
examples.cn: 快递公司为紧急包裹提供[快速]服务。

words.translation: n. 眼睛, 视力, 看\nvt. 看, 注视
words.definition:
n. the organ of sight
n. good discernment (either visually or as if visually)
n. attention to what is seen
n. a small hole or loop (as in a needle)

examples.en: She has beautiful blue [eyes] that shine in the sunlight.
examples.cn: 她有一双在阳光下闪耀的漂亮蓝[眼睛]。

examples.en: Close your [eyes] and get some rest.
examples.cn: 闭上[眼睛]休息一会儿。

examples.en: She has a good [eye] for color and design.
examples.cn: 她对色彩和设计有很好的[眼光]。

examples.en: The cat [eyed] the fish on the table hungrily.
examples.cn: 猫[盯着]桌上的鱼，眼睛里满是渴望。

examples.en: Thread the string through the [eye] of the needle.
examples.cn: 把线穿过针[孔]。

words.translation:
n. 脸, 面容, 正面, 外观
vt. 面对, 朝, 正视, 面临
vi. 朝, 向
[计] 现场可改变的控制元件
words.definition:
n. the front of the human head from the forehead to the chin and ear to ear
n. the general outward appearance of something
n. the striking or working surface of an implement
n. a part of a person that is used to refer to a person

examples.en: She washed her [face] before going to bed.
examples.cn: 她睡觉前洗了[脸]。

examples.en: He has a friendly [face] that makes people feel welcome.
examples.cn: 他有一张友善的[面孔]，让人感到受欢迎。

examples.en: We must [face] the problems bravely instead of running away.
examples.cn: 我们必须勇敢地[面对]问题，而不是逃避。

examples.en: The window [faces] the garden, so the room gets lots of light.
examples.cn: 窗户[朝向]花园，所以房间里有很多光线。

examples.en: She [faced] many challenges when she moved to a new school.
examples.cn: 她转到新学校时[面临]了许多挑战。

words.translation: n. 事实, 真实性, 真相, 细节, 论据
words.definition:
n. a piece of information about circumstances that exist or events that have occurred
n. a statement or assertion of verified information about something that is the case or has happened
n. an event known to have happened or something known to have existed
n. a concept whose truth can be proved

examples.en: It is a [fact] that exercise is good for your health.
examples.cn: 锻炼有益健康是一个[事实]。

examples.en: You should base your argument on [facts], not opinions.
examples.cn: 你应该把论点建立在[事实]上，而不是观点上。

examples.en: In [fact], he had never been to that city before.
examples.cn: [事实上]，他以前从未去过那座城市。

examples.en: Tell me the [facts] about what happened at school today.
examples.cn: 告诉我今天在学校发生的[实情]。

examples.sense: n. 事实（in fact 用法）
examples.en: He looks young, but in [fact] he is over forty years old.
examples.cn: 他看起来很年轻，但[实际上]他已经四十多岁了。

words.translation: n. 工厂, 产生地, 代理店\n[经] 工厂, 代理店, 商行在国外的代理处
words.definition: n. a plant consisting of one or more buildings with facilities for manufacturing

examples.en: My father works at a car [factory] outside the city.
examples.cn: 我父亲在城外的一家汽车[工厂]工作。

examples.en: The [factory] produces thousands of shoes every day.
examples.cn: 这家[工厂]每天生产数千双鞋子。

examples.en: The old [factory] was turned into an art museum.

words.translation: prep. 为, 因为, 至于\nconj. 因为\n[计] DOS批处理命令:对一组参数重复执行指定的命令
words.definition:
prep. In the most general sense, indicating that in consideration
   of, in view of, or with reference to, which anything is done or takes
   place.
prep. Indicating the antecedent cause or occasion of an action;
   the motive or inducement accompanying and prompting to an act or state;
   the reason of anything; that on account of which a thing is or is done.
prep. Indicating the remoter and indirect object of an act; the
   end or final cause with reference to which anything is, acts, serves,
   or is done.
prep. Indicating that in favor of which, or in promoting which,
   anything is, or is done; hence, in behalf of; in favor of; on the side
   of; -- opposed to against.
prep. Indicating that toward which the action of anything is
   directed, or the point toward which motion is made; /ntending to go to.
prep. Indicating that on place of or instead of which anything
   acts or serves, or that to which a substitute, an equivalent, a
   compensation, or the like, is offered or made; instead of, or place of.
prep. Indicating that in the character of or as being which
   anything is regarded or treated; to be, or as being.
prep. Indicating that instead of which something else controls in
   the performing of an action, or that in spite of which anything is
   done, occurs, or is; hence, equivalent to notwithstanding, in spite of;
   -- generally followed by all, aught, anything, etc.
prep. Indicating the space or time through which an action or
   state extends; hence, during; in or through the space or time of.
prep. Indicating that in prevention of which, or through fear of
   which, anything is done.
conj. Because; by reason that; for that; indicating, in Old
   English, the reason of anything.
conj. Since; because; introducing a reason of something before
   advanced, a cause, motive, explanation, justification, or the like, of
   an action related or a statement made. It is logically nearly
   equivalent to since, or because, but connects less closely, and is
   sometimes used as a very general introduction to something suggested by
   what has gone before.
n. One who takes, or that which is said on, the affrimative side;
   that which is said in favor of some one or something; -- the antithesis
   of against, and commonly used in connection with it.

words.translation: prep. 从, 来自, 根据
words.definition:
prep. Out of the neighborhood of; lessening or losing proximity

   are to be expressed. It is construed with, and indicates, the point of
   space or time at which the action, state, etc., are regarded as setting
   out or beginning; also, less frequently, the source, the cause, the
   occasion, out of which anything proceeds; -- the aritithesis and
   correlative of to; as, it, is one hundred miles from Boston to
   Springfield; he took his sword from his side; light proceeds from the
   sun; separate the coarse wool from the fine; men have all sprung from
   Adam, and often go from good to bad, and from bad to worse; the merit
   of an action depends on the principle from which it proceeds; men judge
   of facts from personal knowledge, or from testimony.

words.translation: n. 手势, 姿态\nvi. 作手势, 作姿态
words.definition: n. motion of hands or body to emphasize or help to express a thought or feeling\nn. the use of movements (especially of the hands) to communicate familiar or prearranged signals\nn. something done as an indication of intention

examples.en: She made a [gesture] with her hand to call the waiter over.
examples.cn: 她用手做了一个[手势]示意服务员过来。

examples.en: A thumbs-up is a [gesture] that means approval or agreement.
examples.cn: 竖起大拇指是一个表示赞同或同意的[手势]。

examples.en: Sending flowers was a kind [gesture] to show his appreciation.
examples.cn: 送花是他表示感谢的善意[姿态]。

examples.en: Shaking hands is a common [gesture] of greeting in many cultures.
examples.cn: 握手是许多文化中常见的问候[姿态]。

examples.en: The teacher [gestured] for us to be quiet.
examples.cn: 老师[做了个手势]让我们安静。

words.translation:
vt. 得到, 获得, 变成, 使得, 收获, 接通, 抓住, 染上
vi. 到达, 成为, 变得
n. (网球等)救球, 生殖, 幼兽
[计] 取得指令, 获取文件
words.definition:
n. a return on a shot that seemed impossible to reach and would normally have resulted in a point for the opponent
v. come into the possession of something concrete or abstract
v. cause to move; cause to be in a certain position or condition
v. succeed in catching or seizing, especially after a chase

examples.en: She worked hard and [got] first prize in the competition.
examples.cn: 她努力工作，在比赛中[获得]了一等奖。

examples.en: Can I [get] some help with this math problem?
examples.cn: 我能[得到]一些关于这道数学题的帮助吗？

examples.en: It is [getting] dark; we should go home soon.
examples.cn: 天[变]暗了；我们应该快点回家了。

examples.en: He [got] to school just before the bell rang.
examples.cn: 他在铃声响起前刚好[到达]学校。

examples.en: Can you [get] your brother to help carry these boxes?
examples.cn: 你能[让]你哥哥帮忙搬这些箱子吗？

words.translation: n. 礼物, 赠予, 天才\nvt. 赋予
words.definition: n. something acquired without compensation

examples.en: She received many beautiful [gifts] on her birthday.
examples.cn: 她生日时收到了许多美丽的[礼物]。

examples.en: He bought a [gift] for his teacher to thank her for her help.
examples.cn: 他为老师买了一份[礼物]，感谢她的帮助。

examples.en: She has a natural [gift] for music and plays piano beautifully.
examples.cn: 她有音乐方面的天生[天赋]，钢琴弹得很漂亮。

examples.en: Being able to make friends easily is a [gift].
examples.cn: 能够轻松交朋友是一种[天赋]。

examples.en: The [gift] from my grandparents was a beautiful handmade scarf.
examples.cn: 祖父母给我的[礼物]是一条美丽的手工围巾。

words.translation: n. 长颈鹿, 鹿豹座
words.definition: n. tallest living quadruped; having a spotted coat and small horns and very long neck and legs; of savannahs of tropical Africa

examples.en: The [giraffe] is the tallest animal on land.
examples.cn: [长颈鹿]是陆地上最高的动物。

examples.en: We saw a [giraffe] eating leaves from the top of a tall tree.
examples.cn: 我们看到一只[长颈鹿]正在吃高树顶端的树叶。

examples.en: The children were excited to see the [giraffe] at the zoo.
examples.cn: 孩子们看到动物园里的[长颈鹿]非常兴奋。

examples.en: A [giraffe] uses its long neck to reach leaves that other animals cannot.
examples.cn: [长颈鹿]用它的长脖子够到其他动物够不到的树叶。

examples.en: The [giraffe] has a very long tongue that helps it eat tough leaves.
examples.cn: [长颈鹿]有一条很长的舌头，帮助它吃坚硬的树叶。

words.translation: n. 女孩, 少女, 女佣
words.definition: n. a young woman\nn. a friendly informal reference to a grown woman

examples.en: The little [girl] in the red dress is my cousin.
examples.cn: 穿红裙子的那个小[女孩]是我的表妹。

examples.en: The [girls] in my class love playing basketball.
examples.cn: 我班上的[女孩们]喜欢打篮球。

examples.en: She has been my best friend since we were [girls].
examples.cn: 从我们还是小[女孩]时，她就是我最好的朋友了。

examples.en: They have two [girls] and one boy in their family.
examples.cn: 他们家有两个[女儿]和一个儿子。

examples.en: Have you met Tom's new [girl]? She seems very nice.
examples.cn: 你见过汤姆的新[女朋友]了吗？她看起来很好。

words.translation: n. 弹性, 适应性\nvt. 给, 授予, 供给, 产生, 发表, 付出, 献出, 让出\nvi. 捐赠, 支持不住, 让步
words.definition:
n. the elasticity of something that can be stretched and returns to its original length
v. cause to have, in the abstract sense or physical sense
v. transfer possession of something concrete or abstract to somebody
v. convey or reveal information

examples.en: She [gave] her friend a birthday present yesterday.
examples.cn: 她昨天[给了]朋友一份生日礼物。

examples.en: Please [give] your homework to the class monitor.
examples.cn: 请把作业[交给]班长。

examples.en: Can you [give] me some advice on learning English?
examples.cn: 你能[给我]一些学习英语的建议吗？

examples.en: The teacher will [give] a speech at the opening ceremony.
examples.cn: 老师将在开幕式上[发表]演讲。

examples.en: Don't [give] up even when things are difficult.
examples.cn: 即使困难重重，也不要[放弃]。

words.translation: a. 高兴的, 喜欢的, 情愿的
words.definition: a. showing or causing joy and pleasure; especially made happy\ns. eagerly disposed to act or to be of service\ns. feeling happy appreciation

examples.en: I am so [glad] you came to my birthday party.
examples.cn: 我很[高兴]你来参加我的生日聚会。

examples.en: She was [glad] to hear that her friend had recovered from illness.
examples.cn: 她听说朋友从病中康复后[感到高兴]。

examples.en: I would be [glad] to help you with your homework.
examples.cn: 我[很乐意]帮你做作业。

examples.en: We were all [glad] when the long holiday finally arrived.
examples.cn: 当漫长的假期终于到来时，我们都[高兴]极了。

examples.en: He is [glad] that he chose to study in this school.
examples.cn: 他[庆幸]自己选择在这所学校学习。

words.translation: n. 玻璃, 玻璃杯, 透镜\nvt. 装玻璃于, 反射, 反映\nvi. 成玻璃状
words.definition:
n. a brittle transparent solid with irregular atomic structure
n. a container for holding liquids while drinking
n. the quantity a glass will hold
n. glassware collectively

examples.en: She poured juice into a [glass] for her brother.
examples.cn: 她给弟弟倒了一[杯]果汁。

examples.en: He drank a [glass] of warm milk before going to bed.
examples.cn: 他睡前喝了一[杯]温牛奶。

examples.en: Be careful not to break the [glass] window.
examples.cn: 小心不要打破[玻璃]窗。

examples.en: She wears [glasses] because she is nearsighted.
examples.cn: 她因为近视而戴[眼镜]。

examples.en: She checked her appearance in the looking [glass] before leaving.
examples.cn: 她离开前在[镜子]里检查了自己的外貌。

words.translation: n. 手套\nvt. 给...戴手套
words.definition: n. handwear: covers the hand and wrist

examples.en: She put on [gloves] to keep her hands warm in winter.
examples.cn: 她戴上[手套]在冬天保持双手温暖。

examples.en: The doctor wore rubber [gloves] when examining the patient.
examples.cn: 医生在检查病人时戴着橡胶[手套]。

examples.en: He lost one [glove] on the way home and had to buy a new pair.
examples.cn: 他回家途中丢失了一只[手套]，不得不买一副新的。

examples.en: The boxer put on his [gloves] before the match started.
examples.cn: 拳击手在比赛开始前戴上了[手套]。

examples.en: The baseball player caught the ball with his [glove].
examples.cn: 棒球运动员用[手套]接住了球。

words.translation: vi. 去, 走, 达到, 运转, 查阅, 消失, 结束, 放弃, 花费, 流传, 趋于, 打算, 剩下\nvt. 以...打赌, 对付, 忍受, 出产, 为被捕者出(保释金)\nn. 去, 尝试, 进行
words.definition:
n. a time for working (after which you will be relieved by someone else)
n. a board game for two players who place counters on a grid; the object is to surround and so capture the opponent's counters
v. follow a procedure or take a course
v. move away from a place into another direction

examples.en: Let's [go] to the park and play football this afternoon.
examples.cn: 今天下午我们[去]公园踢足球吧。

examples.en: She [went] to the library to borrow some books.
examples.cn: 她[去]图书馆借了一些书。

examples.en: The milk [went] sour because it was left out too long.
examples.cn: 牛奶因为放置太久而[变酸]了。

examples.en: Everything is [going] well; no need to worry.
examples.cn: 一切[进行得]很顺利；不用担心。

examples.en: All the food [went] quickly at the school party.
examples.cn: 学校聚会上所有食物很快就[用完]了。

words.translation: n. 山羊, 替罪羊, 色鬼
words.definition: n. any of numerous agile ruminants related to sheep but having a beard and straight horns

examples.en: The farmer has several [goats] that he keeps for milk.
examples.cn: 农民养了几只[山羊]用于产奶。

examples.en: A [goat] can climb very steep rocky hills with ease.
examples.cn: [山羊]可以轻松攀爬非常陡峭的岩石山丘。

examples.en: The children loved feeding the [goats] at the petting zoo.
examples.cn: 孩子们喜欢在互动动物园里喂[山羊]。

examples.en: The [goat] chewed on everything it could find in the yard.
examples.cn: [山羊]啃着院子里它能找到的一切东西。

examples.en: He became the [scapegoat] and was blamed for the team's failure.
examples.cn: 他成了[替罪羊]，被指责为团队失败的原因。

words.translation: n. 上帝, 神像, 偶像\nvt. 使神化
words.definition: n. the supernatural being conceived as the perfect and omnipotent and omniscient originator and ruler of the universe; the object of worship in monotheistic religions\nn. a man of such superior qualities that he seems like a deity to other people

examples.en: Many people believe that [God] created the universe.
examples.cn: 许多人相信[上帝]创造了宇宙。

examples.en: Oh my [God]! I can't believe I won the competition.
examples.cn: 我的[天]！我不敢相信我赢得了比赛。

examples.en: The ancient Greeks worshipped many [gods].
examples.cn: 古希腊人崇拜许多[神明]。

examples.en: Thank [God] everyone was safe after the accident.
examples.cn: 感谢[上帝]，事故发生后每个人都安然无恙。

examples.en: To his fans, the singer is like a [god].
examples.cn: 对他的粉丝来说，这位歌手就像一个[神]。

words.translation: n. 黄金, 钱财, 金块, 金色, 宝贵\na. 金的, 似金的, 金色的, 金制的
words.definition:
n. coins made of gold
n. a soft yellow malleable ductile (trivalent and univalent) metallic element; occurs mainly as nuggets in rocks and alluvial deposits; does not react with most chemicals but is attacked by chlorine and aqua regia
n. great wealth
n. something likened to the metal in brightness or preciousness or superiority etc.

examples.en: The ring is made of pure [gold] and is very valuable.
examples.cn: 这枚戒指是由纯[金]制成的，非常珍贵。

examples.en: China won several [gold] medals at the Olympic Games.
examples.cn: 中国在奥运会上赢得了几枚[金]牌。

examples.en: She wore a beautiful [gold] bracelet on her wrist.
examples.cn: 她手腕上戴着一条漂亮的[金色]手镯。

examples.en: His advice was worth its weight in [gold].
examples.cn: 他的建议是无价之[宝]。

examples.en: The autumn leaves turned a beautiful shade of [gold].
examples.cn: 秋叶变成了美丽的[金]色。

words.translation: a. 金的, 含金的, 金色的, 贵重的, 繁盛的\n[法] 金制的, 金色的, 兴隆的
words.definition: s. marked by peace and prosperity\ns. suggestive of gold\ns. presaging or likely to bring good luck

examples.en: The sunset painted the sky a beautiful [golden] color.
examples.cn: 夕阳将天空染成了美丽的[金色]。

examples.en: She has long [golden] hair that shines in the sunlight.
examples.cn: 她有一头在阳光下闪耀的长[金色]头发。

examples.en: This is a [golden] opportunity to improve your English skills.
examples.cn: 这是提高英语技能的[黄金]机会。

examples.en: She looks back on her childhood as her [golden] years.
examples.cn: 她回顾童年时，称之为她的[黄金]岁月。

examples.en: The [golden] eagle is one of the most powerful birds in the sky.
examples.cn: [金]雕是天空中最强大的鸟类之一。

words.translation: n. 善行, 好处, 利益\na. 好的, 优良的, 上等的, 愉快的, 有益的, 好心的, 慈善的, 虔诚的
words.definition:
n. benefit
n. moral excellence or admirableness
n. that which is pleasing or valuable or useful
a. having desirable or positive qualities especially those suitable for a thing specified

examples.en: She is a [good] student who always works hard in class.
examples.cn: 她是一个在课堂上总是努力学习的[好]学生。

examples.en: This is a [good] book; you should read it.
examples.cn: 这是一本[好书]；你应该读一读。

examples.en: He is very [good] at drawing and often wins art prizes.
examples.cn: 他很[擅长]绘画，经常赢得艺术奖项。

examples.en: She is a [good] person who always helps others.
examples.cn: 她是一个总是帮助别人的[善良]的人。

examples.en: Exercise is [good] for your health and mental well-being.
examples.cn: 锻炼对你的健康和心理健康[有益]。

words.translation: interj. 再见
words.definition: n a farewell remark

examples.en: She waved and said [goodbye] to her friends at the gate.
examples.cn: 她在校门口挥手向朋友们说[再见]。

examples.en: It was hard to say [goodbye] when the summer camp ended.
examples.cn: 当夏令营结束时，说[再见]真的很难。

examples.en: He hugged his mother and said [goodbye] before boarding the train.
examples.cn: 他上火车前拥抱了母亲，说了[再见]。

examples.en: We said our [goodbyes] at the airport before she flew overseas.
examples.cn: 她飞往海外之前，我们在机场[告别]。

examples.en: [Goodbye] for now! I'll see you again next week.
examples.cn: 暂时[再见]！我下周再见你。

words.translation: n. 鹅, 雌鹅, 鹅肉, 弯把熨斗\nvt. 与...性交, 突然加大油门, 使生色, 喝倒彩
words.definition:
n. web-footed long-necked typically gregarious migratory aquatic birds usually larger and less aquatic than ducks
n. flesh of a goose (domestic or wild)
v. pinch in the buttocks
v. prod into action

examples.en: The children fed bread to the [geese] by the lake.
examples.cn: 孩子们在湖边喂[鹅]吃面包。

examples.en: A [goose] can be quite aggressive if you get too close.
examples.cn: 如果你靠得太近，[鹅]可能会相当有攻击性。

examples.en: The famous story is about a [goose] that laid golden eggs.
examples.cn: 那个著名的故事是关于一只会下金蛋的[鹅]。

examples.en: Don't be such a [goose]; there is nothing to be afraid of.
examples.cn: 不要这么[胆小]；没什么可怕的。

examples.en: Wild [geese] fly south in V-shaped formations every autumn.
examples.cn: 野[鹅]每年秋天以V字形编队向南飞翔。

words.translation: n. 政府, 内阁\n[经] 政府, 政治, 政体
words.definition: n. the organization that is the governing authority of a political unit\nn. the act of governing; exercising authority\nn. (government) the system or form by which a community or other political unit is governed

examples.en: The [government] announced new policies to improve education.
examples.cn: [政府]宣布了新政策以改善教育。

examples.en: Local [government] is responsible for building roads and parks.
examples.cn: 地方[政府]负责建设道路和公园。

examples.en: The [government] provides free education for all children.
examples.cn: [政府]为所有儿童提供免费教育。

examples.en: Good [government] requires honesty and transparency.
examples.cn: 好的[治理]需要诚实和透明度。

examples.en: The central [government] passed a law protecting the environment.
examples.cn: 中央[政府]通过了一项保护环境的法律。

words.translation: n. 等级, 年级, 阶段, 成绩, 程度, 坡度, 斜坡\nvt. 分等, 分级, 评分\nvi. 属于某等级, 逐渐变化
words.definition:
n. a relative position or degree of value in a graded group
n. the gradient of a slope or road or other surface
n. a degree of ablaut
n. the height of the ground on which something stands

examples.en: She is in the seventh [grade] and studies very hard.
examples.cn: 她上七年[级]，学习非常努力。

examples.en: My brother is one [grade] above me in the same school.
examples.cn: 我哥哥在同一所学校比我高一个[年级]。

examples.en: She got top [grades] in all her subjects this semester.
examples.cn: 她这学期所有科目都取得了最高[成绩]。

examples.en: This is a high-[grade] material that is very durable.
examples.cn: 这是一种高[品质]的材料，非常耐用。

examples.en: The teacher [graded] our essays and returned them the next day.
examples.cn: 老师给我们的作文[评了分]并在第二天还给我们。

words.translation: n. 语法学, 入门书\n[计] 语法检查
words.definition: n. the branch of linguistics that deals with syntax and morphology (and sometimes also deals with semantics)

examples.en: She studied [grammar] carefully to improve her writing skills.
examples.cn: 她仔细学习了[语法]以提高写作技能。

examples.en: Learning [grammar] rules helps you speak English correctly.
examples.cn: 学习[语法]规则有助于你正确地说英语。

examples.en: The teacher corrected the [grammar] mistakes in her essay.
examples.cn: 老师纠正了她文章中的[语法]错误。

examples.en: This [grammar] book has clear explanations and many exercises.
examples.cn: 这本[语法书]有清晰的解释和许多练习。

examples.en: Chinese and English [grammar] are very different from each other.
examples.cn: 汉语和英语的[语法]彼此非常不同。

words.translation: n. 孙, 外孙女, 外孙, 孙女, 孙子
words.definition: n. a child of your son or daughter

examples.sense: n. 孙子/孙女，外孙/外孙女
examples.en: My grandfather loves spending time with his [grandchildren].
examples.cn: 我爷爷喜欢和他的[孙子孙女]们在一起。

examples.en: She became a [grandchild] of the village after being adopted.
examples.cn: 她被收养后成了这个村子的[孙辈]成员。

examples.en: The old woman read stories to her [grandchild] every night.
examples.cn: 这位老妇人每晚给她的[孙子]讲故事。

examples.en: She knitted sweaters for all her [grandchildren] as New Year gifts.
examples.cn: 她为所有的[孙子孙女]们编织毛衣作为新年礼物。

examples.en: Being a [grandchild] of this famous artist made her proud.
examples.cn: 作为这位著名艺术家的[孙女]让她感到自豪。

words.translation: n. 孙女, 外孙女
words.definition: n. a female grandchild

examples.en: His [granddaughter] visits him every weekend and reads to him.
examples.cn: 他的[孙女]每个周末都来看望他并给他读书。

examples.en: The old lady is very proud of her talented [granddaughter].
examples.cn: 这位老太太非常为她有才华的[孙女]感到骄傲。

examples.en: She is the only [granddaughter] in a family of boys.
examples.cn: 她是一个满是男孩的家庭里唯一的[孙女]。

examples.en: My grandmother called her [granddaughter] to wish her happy birthday.
examples.cn: 我奶奶打电话给她的[外孙女]祝她生日快乐。

examples.en: The old man taught his [granddaughter] how to play chess.
examples.cn: 老人教他的[孙女]下象棋。

words.translation: n. 祖父, 始祖\n[电] 原始资料组
words.definition: n. the father of your father or mother

examples.en: My [grandfather] taught me how to fish when I was young.
examples.cn: 我[祖父]小时候教我如何钓鱼。

examples.en: Her [grandfather] celebrated his eightieth birthday last month.
examples.cn: 她的[外祖父]上个月庆祝了八十岁生日。

examples.en: His [grandfather] was a soldier who fought bravely in the war.
examples.cn: 他的[祖父]是一位在战争中英勇作战的士兵。

examples.en: My [grandfather] on my mother's side lives in the countryside.
examples.cn: 我母亲那边的[外祖父]住在乡下。

examples.en: He is considered the [grandfather] of modern computer science.
examples.cn: 他被认为是现代计算机科学的[鼻祖]。

words.translation: n. 奶奶, 外婆
words.definition: n. the mother of your father or mother

examples.en: My [grandma] makes the best dumplings in the family.
examples.cn: 我[奶奶]做的饺子是家里最好吃的。

examples.en: I always call my [grandma] on her birthday to wish her well.
examples.cn: 我总是在[奶奶]生日时给她打电话祝她身体健康。

examples.en: [Grandma] told us stories about her childhood every evening.
examples.cn: [奶奶]每天晚上都给我们讲她童年的故事。

examples.en: She stayed at her [grandma]'s house for the whole summer.
examples.cn: 她在[外婆]家住了整整一个夏天。

examples.cn: 他一看到[奶奶]进门就跑过去拥抱她。

words.translation: n. 祖母, 女祖先
words.definition: n the mother of your father or mother

examples.cn: 我[祖母]七十岁了，仍然非常活跃。

examples.cn: 她的[外祖母]为她编织了一件冬天穿的暖和毛衣。

examples.cn: 他的[祖母]来自北方的一个小村庄。

examples.en: She learned traditional cooking from her [grandmother].
examples.cn: 她从[外祖母]那里学会了传统烹饪。

examples.en: [Grandmother], can you tell me more about the old days?
examples.cn: [祖母]，你能告诉我更多关于以前的事吗？

words.translation: 爷爷, 老太爷, 外公
words.definition: n the father of your father or mother

examples.en: My [grandpa] takes me fishing every Saturday morning.
examples.cn: 我[爷爷]每个星期六早上带我去钓鱼。

examples.en: [Grandpa] always has candy in his pocket for us.
examples.cn: [爷爷]口袋里总是有糖果给我们。

examples.cn: 她打电话给[外公]祝他新年快乐。

examples.en: My [grandpa] used to be a teacher before he retired.
examples.cn: 我[爷爷]退休前是一名老师。

examples.en: [Grandpa], will you play chess with me this afternoon?
examples.cn: [爷爷]，今天下午你陪我下象棋好吗？

words.translation: n. 祖父母
words.definition: n. a parent of your father or mother

examples.en: My [grandparents] live in the countryside and visit us twice a year.
examples.cn: 我的[祖父母]住在乡下，每年来看我们两次。

examples.en: Children often feel very close to their [grandparents].
examples.cn: 孩子们通常与[祖父母]非常亲近。

examples.en: Both of her [grandparents] on her father's side are teachers.
examples.cn: 她父亲那边的两位[祖父母]都是老师。

examples.en: She takes care of her [grandparents] when they are sick.
examples.cn: 她在[祖父母]生病时照顾他们。

examples.en: Her [grandparents] came to watch her school performance.
examples.cn: 她的[祖父母]来观看她的学校表演。

words.translation: n. 孙子, 外孙
words.definition: n. a male grandchild

examples.en: He is very proud of his [grandson] who won a science award.
examples.cn: 他非常为赢得科学奖的[孙子]感到骄傲。

examples.en: The old woman taught her [grandson] how to cook traditional food.
examples.cn: 老妇人教她的[外孙]如何烹饪传统食物。

examples.en: Her [grandson] comes to visit every Sunday without fail.
examples.cn: 她的[孙子]每个星期天都必来探望她。

examples.en: The grandfather and [grandson] have a very special bond.
examples.cn: 祖父和[孙子]之间有一种非常特殊的感情。

examples.en: As the only [grandson], he will inherit the family business.
examples.cn: 作为唯一的[孙子]，他将继承家族生意。

words.translation: n. 奶奶, 老奶奶, 老婆婆, 外婆, 婆婆妈妈的人, 唠叨挑剔的人, 接生婆
words.definition: n. an old woman

examples.sense: n. 奶奶，外婆（亲切口语）
examples.en: My [granny] always bakes cookies for us when we visit.
examples.cn: 每次我们拜访时，我[奶奶]总是为我们烤饼干。

examples.en: [Granny], can you tell me a bedtime story tonight?
examples.cn: [奶奶]，你今晚能给我讲一个睡前故事吗？

examples.en: She lived with her [granny] while her parents worked abroad.
examples.cn: 她父母在国外工作时，她和[奶奶]住在一起。

examples.en: Her [granny] taught her how to knit when she was seven.
examples.cn: 她七岁时，[外婆]教她如何编织。

examples.en: [Granny] smiled warmly and hugged the children as they arrived.
examples.cn: [奶奶]温暖地微笑着，在孩子们到来时拥抱了他们。

words.translation: n. 葡萄, 葡萄树\n[医] 葡萄
words.definition: n. any of various juicy fruit of the genus Vitis with green or purple skins; grow in clusters\nn. any of numerous woody vines of genus Vitis bearing clusters of edible berries

examples.en: She picked a bunch of [grapes] from the vine in the garden.
examples.cn: 她从花园里的葡萄藤上摘了一串[葡萄]。

examples.cn: 我喜欢吃[葡萄]，因为它们又甜又多汁。

examples.cn: 市场上以优惠的价格出售红[葡萄]和绿[葡萄]。

examples.cn: 晒干的[葡萄]叫做葡萄干，用于烘焙。

words.translation: n. 草, 草原, 牧场\n[医] 草, 禾本
words.definition:

n. German writer of novels and poetry and plays (born 1927)
v. shoot down, of birds
v. cover with grass

examples.cn: 孩子们在公园柔软的绿[草地]上玩耍。

examples.cn: 请不要踩[草坪]；它是新种的。

examples.cn: 牛和羊在田野里吃[草]。

examples.cn: 他每个星期六早上修剪花园里的[草坪]。

examples.en: The snake was hiding in the long [grass] by the path.
examples.cn: 蛇藏在小路旁长长的[草丛]中。

words.translation: a. 大的, 非常的, 主要的, 重大的, 崇高的, 伟大的\nadv. 顺利地, 得意地\nn. 全部, 大人物, 大师
words.definition:
n. a person who has achieved distinction and honor in some field
s. relatively large in size or number or extent; larger than others of its kind
s. of major significance or importance
s. remarkable or out of the ordinary in degree or magnitude or effect

examples.en: He is one of the [greatest] scientists in history.
examples.cn: 他是历史上最[伟大的]科学家之一。

examples.en: It was a [great] honor to meet the school's founder.
examples.cn: 见到学校创始人是一种[极大的]荣誉。

examples.en: We had a [great] time at the summer camp last year.
examples.cn: 我们去年在夏令营度过了一段[美好的]时光。

examples.en: She made a [great] effort to pass the entrance exam.
examples.cn: 她付出了[巨大的]努力通过入学考试。

examples.en: She is [great] at swimming and has won many competitions.
examples.cn: 她[非常擅长]游泳，赢得了许多比赛。

words.translation: n. 绿色, 绿色颜料\na. 绿色的, 未成熟的, 新鲜的, 青春的, 无经验的, 脸色发青的

n. green color or pigment; resembling the color of growing grass

n. an environmentalist who belongs to the Green Party
n. a river that rises in western Wyoming and flows southward through Utah to become a tributary of the Colorado River

examples.en: She wore a [green] dress to the school play.
examples.cn: 她穿着一件[绿色的]连衣裙参加学校戏剧演出。

examples.en: The traffic light turned [green] and the cars moved forward.
examples.cn: 交通灯变[绿]了，汽车向前驶去。

examples.cn: 我们应该养成更多[绿色]习惯来保护环境。

examples.sense: adj. 未成熟的，无经验的
examples.en: He made many mistakes because he was still [green] on the job.
examples.cn: 他犯了很多错误，因为他在工作上还很[缺乏经验]。

examples.en: The children played football on the village [green].
examples.cn: 孩子们在村子的[绿地]上踢足球。

words.translation: n. 祝贺, 问候
words.definition: n. (usually plural) an acknowledgment or expression of good will (especially on meeting)

examples.en: He waved his hand as a [greeting] when he saw his friend.
examples.cn: 他看到朋友时挥手[打招呼]。

examples.en: She sent her teacher a card with warm [greetings] on Teachers' Day.
examples.cn: 她在教师节给老师寄了一张有温暖[问候]的卡片。

examples.cn: 我想向你全家人表达我的[问候]。

examples.cn: 在中国，一种常见的[问候语]是：你吃了吗？

examples.en: The teacher began the class with a friendly [greeting] to all students.
examples.cn: 老师以友好的[问候]开始了对所有学生的课程。

words.translation:
n. 土地, 战场, 场地, 地面, 范围
a. 土地的, 地面上的
vt. 放在地上, 使搁浅, 打基础, 给...以训练

n. (art) the surface (as a wall or canvas) prepared to take the paint for a painting

examples.cn: 她坐在[地上]仰望星空。

examples.cn: 苹果从树上掉到了[地面]上。

examples.cn: 这是将要建造新学校的[土地]。

examples.cn: 所有学生聚集在[操场]上参加活动。

examples.cn: 没有[理由]惩罚她；她没有做错任何事。

words.translation: n. 团体, 组, 团, 群\nv. 聚合, 成群\n[计] 创建组; 组, 用户组
words.definition:
n. any number of entities (members) considered as a unit

examples.cn: 我们的[小组]合作完成了科学项目。

examples.cn: 一[群]学生在教室门外等候。

examples.cn: 老师按年龄把孩子们[分组]进行活动。

examples.cn: 我最喜欢的音乐[乐团]下周将举办音乐会。

examples.cn: 我们分成两[组]，沿不同的路上山。

words.translation: vt. 种植, 使长满\nvi. 生长, 变成, 发展
words.definition:
v. become larger, greater, or bigger; expand or gain
v. increase in size by natural process
v. cause to grow or develop

examples.cn: 孩子们在早年[成长]得非常快。

examples.cn: 这些花在阳光充足的地方[生长]得最好。

examples.cn: 我爷爷每年在他的花园里[种植]蔬菜。

examples.cn: 今年我们学校的学生人数[增长]了很多。

words.translation: n. 守卫者, 警戒, 护卫队, 防护装置\nvt. 保卫, 看守, 当心\nvi. 防止, 警惕, 警卫, 看守

n. a person who keeps watch over something or someone
n. the person who plays that position on a football team

examples.cn: 士兵们日夜[守卫]宫殿的大门。

examples.cn: 这只狗[守护]房子，对陌生人吠叫。

examples.cn: [警卫]在入口处检查了每个人的票。

examples.cn: 他打篮球时戴着护齿[防护]牙齿。

n. a message expressing an opinion based on incomplete evidence
n. an estimate based on little or no information

examples.cn: 你能[猜]出我奶奶多大了吗？

examples.cn: 我的[猜测]是明天下午会下雨。

examples.cn: 我[认为]她长途旅行后很累了。

examples.cn: [猜猜]看——我给你买了什么生日礼物？

words.translation: n. 客人, 来宾, 旅客\n[化] 客体

examples.cn: 我们在[客人]到来之前打扫了房子。

examples.cn: [客座]演讲者讲述了保护环境的话题。

words.translation: n. 吉他

examples.cn: 她已经学习弹[吉他]两年了。

examples.en: He played a beautiful song on his [guitar] at the school concert.
examples.cn: 他在学校音乐会上用[吉他]弹奏了一首美妙的歌曲。

examples.cn: 我哥哥得到了一把新[吉他]作为生日礼物。

examples.cn: 你想让我教你一些基本的[吉他]和弦吗？

examples.cn: 警察携带[枪]保护公众。

words.translation: n. +体育馆, 体育训练, 体育课, 体操

examples.cn: 我们学校的[体育馆]用于篮球和排球比赛。

examples.cn: 她每天早上上学前在[健身房]锻炼。

words.translation: n. 习惯, 嗜好, 习性\nvt. 使穿衣

examples.en: We ordered a [hamburger] and some fries at the fast food restaurant.

examples.cn: 她为家庭烧烤制作了自制[汉堡包]。

examples.cn: 老师把试卷[发]给所有学生。

words.translation: a. 英俊的, 大方的, 慷慨的, 相当可观的, 美观的, 灵敏的

examples.en: The [handsome] young man smiled at everyone he met.
examples.cn: 那个[英俊]的年轻人对遇到的每个人都微笑。

examples.cn: 我姐姐认为那个演员非常[英俊]。

examples.cn: 她因归还丢失的钱包而获得了[丰厚]的报酬。

words.translation: n. 笔迹
words.definition: n. something written by hand\nn. the activity of writing by hand

examples.cn: 老师要求我们每天练习来改善[书写]。

examples.cn: 我立刻认出了信封上他的[笔迹]。

examples.cn: 好的[书写]在中国文化中仍然被认为是重要的。

examples.cn: 他的[笔迹]非常潦草，没有人能看懂他的笔记。

words.translation: n. 悬挂, 诀窍, 意义\nvt. 悬挂, 附着, 装饰, 垂下, 踌躇, 绞死, 使悬而未决\nvi. 悬着, 垂下, 被绞死, 悬而不决

examples.cn: 请把你的外套[挂]在门旁边的钩子上。

examples.cn: 她在卧室墙上[挂]了一幅漂亮的画。

v. come to pass

v. chance to be or do something, without intention or causation

examples.cn: 今天学校里[发生]了令人兴奋的事情——我们赢得了知识竞赛！

examples.cn: 我昨天[碰巧]在书店遇见了老朋友。

examples.cn: 你的手臂怎么了？摔倒了吗？

examples.cn: 她[碰巧]知道我问题的答案。

words.translation: a. 快乐的, 幸福的, 愉快的, 恰当的

examples.en: She felt very [happy] when she heard the good news.
examples.cn: 她听到好消息时感到非常[快乐]。

examples.cn: 我[乐意]帮助你做作业。

s. very strong or vigorous

examples.cn: 他整个早上都在[头痛]，无法集中注意力工作。

examples.cn: 医生通过几项检查了解了病人的[健康状况]。

examples.cn: 吸烟对你的[健康]危害非常大。

examples.cn: 每晚睡眠充足对你的[健康]很重要。

words.translation: a. 健康的, 有益健康的, 卫生的\n[医] 健康的

s. financially secure and functioning well
s. promoting health; healthful

examples.cn: 她在户外度过夏天后看起来非常[健康]。

examples.cn: 游泳是对各年龄段人都非常[有益健康]的运动。

words.translation: vt. 听到, 倾听, 听说, 审理\nvi. 听见, 听
