examples.en: National Day is a public [holiday] in China every October.
examples.cn: 国庆节是中国每年十月的公共[假日]。

examples.en: She went to Yunnan for her summer [holiday] with her family.
examples.cn: 她和家人去云南度过了暑[假]。

examples.en: Christmas is an important [holiday] celebrated around the world.
examples.cn: 圣诞节是全世界庆祝的重要[节日]。

examples.sense: adj. 假日的（形容词用法）
examples.en: The [holiday] traffic on the motorway was very heavy.
examples.cn: 高速公路上的[假日]交通非常拥挤。

examples.en: They booked a two-week [holiday] to a seaside resort.
examples.cn: 他们预订了去海滨度假村的两周[假期]。

words.translation:
n. 家, 避难所, 故乡
a. 家庭的, 国内的, 打中目标的
adv. 在家, 在本国, 打中目标地
[计] 返回始位
words.definition:
n. where you live at a particular time
n. the country or state or city where you live
n. place where something began and flourished
n. an environment offering affection and security

examples.en: She can't wait to get [home] after a long day at school.
examples.cn: 漫长的一天学习后，她迫不及待地想回[家]。

examples.en: Beijing is [home] to over twenty million people.
examples.cn: 北京是两千多万人的[家园]。

examples.en: He stayed [home] to look after his little sister.
examples.cn: 他留在[家]照顾他的小妹妹。

examples.en: She volunteers at a children's [home] on weekends.
examples.cn: 她周末在一家儿童[福利院]做志愿者。

examples.en: Her [home] cooking is always better than restaurant food.
examples.cn: 她的[家常]烹饪总是比餐厅食物好。

words.translation: n. 故乡, 家乡
words.definition: n. the town (or city) where you grew up or where you have your principal residence

examples.en: He always feels happy when he returns to his [hometown].
examples.cn: 每次回到[家乡]，他总感到快乐。

examples.en: She wrote a beautiful essay about life in her [hometown].
examples.cn: 她写了一篇关于[家乡]生活的美文。

examples.en: His [hometown] is a small village in the mountains of Sichuan.
examples.cn: 他的[家乡]是四川山区的一个小村庄。

examples.en: He loves the [hometown] food that his grandmother cooks.
examples.cn: 他喜欢祖母烹制的[家乡]食物。

examples.en: No matter how far she travels, she always misses her [hometown].
examples.cn: 无论走多远，她总是思念[家乡]。

words.translation: n. 家庭作业, 家里做的工作\n[经] 家庭作业
words.definition: n. preparatory school work done outside school (especially at home)

examples.sense: n. 家庭作业；课外作业
examples.en: She finished all her [homework] before dinner.
examples.cn: 她在晚饭前完成了所有[家庭作业]。

examples.en: We had a lot of [homework] this week because of the upcoming exam.
examples.cn: 因为即将到来的考试，我们这周有很多[作业]。

examples.en: Before the interview, he did his [homework] on the company.
examples.cn: 面试前，他做好了关于公司的[功课]。

examples.en: Heavy [homework] can sometimes cause stress for students.
examples.cn: 繁重的[作业]有时会给学生带来压力。

examples.en: The teacher checked our [homework] at the beginning of class.
examples.cn: 老师在课堂开始时检查了我们的[作业]。

words.translation: a. 诚实的, 坦直的, 可靠的
words.definition:
a. not disposed to cheat or defraud; not deceptive or fraudulent
s. without dissimulation; frank
s. without pretensions
s. marked by truth

examples.en: An [honest] person always tells the truth even when it is hard.
examples.cn: [诚实]的人即使在困难时也总是说真话。

examples.en: She gave an [honest] opinion about my drawing.
examples.cn: 她对我的画给出了[真诚]的意见。

examples.en: We need [honest] leaders who work for the good of everyone.
examples.cn: 我们需要[正直]的领导者，为大家的利益工作。

examples.en: He is known as an [honest] businessman who never cheats.
examples.cn: 他以[诚实]的商人著称，从不欺骗。

examples.en: [Honest]ly, I don't think this plan will work.
examples.cn: [老实说]，我认为这个计划行不通。

words.translation: n. 荣誉, 头衔, 信用, 尊敬, 名誉, 阁下, 勋章\nvt. 尊敬, 授予荣誉, 承兑, 实践
words.definition:
n the state of being honored
n a tangible symbol signifying approval or distinction
n the quality of being honorable and having a good name
n a woman's virtue or chastity
v bestow honor or rewards upon
v show respect towards
v accept as pay

examples.en: Winning the gold medal was a great [honour] for the whole team.
examples.cn: 赢得金牌对整个团队来说是莫大的[荣誉]。

examples.en: It is an [honour] to meet such a talented writer.
examples.cn: 见到如此有才华的作家是一种[荣幸]。

examples.en: We should [honour] our teachers for their hard work and dedication.
examples.cn: 我们应该[尊敬]老师，感谢他们的辛勤付出。

examples.en: A man of [honour] keeps his promises no matter what.
examples.cn: 一个有[信誉]的人无论如何都会信守承诺。

examples.en: The ceremony was held to [honour] the students' achievements.
examples.cn: 典礼是为了[表彰]学生的成就而举办的。

words.translation: n. 希望, 信心, 期待\nv. 希望, 期望, 信赖
words.definition:
n. a specific instance of feeling hopeful
n. the general feeling that some desire will be fulfilled
n. someone (or something) on which expectations are centered
n. United States comedian (born in England) who appeared in films with Bing Crosby (1903-2003)

examples.en: She [hopes] to get into a good university next year.
examples.cn: 她[希望]明年能考入一所好大学。

examples.en: The team had great [hope] of winning the championship.
examples.cn: 球队对赢得冠军充满[希望]。

examples.en: Education is the best [hope] for children in poor areas.
examples.cn: 教育是贫困地区孩子们最大的[希望]。

examples.en: We [hope] the weather will be fine for the school trip.
examples.cn: 我们[希望]学校旅行时天气晴朗。

examples.en: She is the [hope] of her family — everyone counts on her.
examples.cn: 她是家里的[希望]——每个人都寄望于她。

words.translation: n. 马, 骑兵, 脚架\nvi. 骑马, 取笑\nvt. 使骑马, 系马于
words.definition: n. solid-hoofed herbivorous quadruped domesticated since prehistoric times\nn. a padded gymnastic apparatus on legs\nv. provide with a horse or horses

examples.en: She learned to ride a [horse] at the farm last summer.
examples.cn: 她去年夏天在农场学会了骑[马]。

examples.en: Farmers used [horses] to pull carts before tractors were invented.
examples.cn: 在发明拖拉机之前，农民用[马]拉车。

examples.en: He practised his vault on the pommel [horse] every afternoon.
examples.cn: 他每天下午在鞍[马]上练习跳马。

examples.en: The [horse] piece in Chinese chess can jump over other pieces.
examples.cn: 中国象棋中的[马]棋可以跳过其他棋子。

examples.en: The knight rode his white [horse] into battle.
examples.cn: 骑士骑着他的白[马]冲入战场。

words.translation: n. 医院\n[医] 医院
words.definition: n. a health facility where patients receive treatment\nn. a medical institution where sick or injured people are given medical or surgical care

examples.en: She was taken to the [hospital] after she broke her arm.
examples.cn: 她手臂骨折后被送往[医院]。

examples.en: He spent a week in [hospital] recovering from his operation.
examples.cn: 他在[医院]住了一周，从手术中恢复。

examples.en: The [hospital] ward was clean and well-organised.
examples.cn: [医院]病房干净而整洁。

examples.en: The new [hospital] in our city has the most modern equipment.
examples.cn: 我们城市的新[医院]拥有最现代化的设备。

examples.en: Children's [hospitals] are specially designed for young patients.
examples.cn: 儿科[医院]是专为年轻患者设计的。

words.translation: a. 热的, 热心的, 辣的, 热情的, 激动的, 猛烈的, 紧迫的\nadv. 热, 紧迫地
words.definition:
a. used of physical heat; having a high or higher than desirable temperature or giving off heat or feeling or causing a sensation of heat or burning
s. characterized by violent and forceful activity or movement; very intense
a. extended meanings; especially of psychological heat; marked by intensity or vehemence especially of passion or enthusiasm
s. (color) bold and intense

examples.en: Be careful — the soup is very [hot] and might burn you.
examples.cn: 小心——汤很[烫]，可能会烫伤你。

examples.en: It was so [hot] in July that everyone stayed indoors.
examples.cn: 七月天气太[炎热]，大家都待在室内。

examples.en: He loves eating [hot] chilli sauce with his meals.
examples.cn: 他喜欢用餐时搭配[辣]椒酱。

examples.en: This new singer is very [hot] right now.
examples.cn: 这位新歌手现在非常[火爆]。

examples.en: The debate became [hot] when both sides refused to agree.
examples.cn: 当双方都不肯让步时，辩论变得[激烈]起来。

words.translation: v. 卖弄
words.definition: n. someone who performs dangerous stunts to attract attention to himself\nn. a frankfurter served hot on a bun

examples.en: She bought a [hotdog] from the stall near the sports ground.
examples.cn: 她从运动场附近的摊位买了一个[热狗]。

examples.en: He ate a [hotdog] with mustard and ketchup at the fair.
examples.cn: 他在集市上吃了一个涂了芥末和番茄酱的[热狗]。

examples.en: [Hotdogs] are popular fast food at sports events in America.
examples.cn: [热狗]是美国体育赛事上流行的快餐。

examples.en: The [hotdog] was grilled over charcoal and smelled delicious.
examples.cn: [热狗]在炭火上烤制，香气诱人。

examples.en: They set up a [hotdog] stand outside the stadium.
examples.cn: 他们在体育场外设了一个[热狗]摊。

words.translation: n. 旅馆, 客栈
words.definition: n. a building where travelers can pay for lodging and meals and other services

examples.en: They stayed at a comfortable [hotel] near the train station.
examples.cn: 他们住在火车站附近一家舒适的[酒店]。

examples.en: The [hotel] provides free breakfast for all guests.
examples.cn: [酒店]为所有客人提供免费早餐。

examples.en: They booked a five-star [hotel] for their anniversary trip.
examples.cn: 他们为周年纪念旅行预订了一家五星级[酒店]。

examples.en: The [hotel] room had a beautiful view of the ocean.
examples.cn: [酒店]房间有美丽的海景。

examples.en: Budget travellers often choose a cheaper [hotel] to save money.
examples.cn: 预算旅行者通常选择更便宜的[旅馆]来省钱。

words.translation: n. 小时, 钟头, 时间, ...点钟, 课时
words.definition:
n. a period of time equal to 1/24th of a day
n. clock time
n. a special and memorable period
n. distance measured by the time taken to cover it

examples.en: The flight from Beijing to Shanghai takes about two [hours].
examples.cn: 从北京到上海的飞行大约需要两个[小时]。

examples.en: The library opens at nine o'clock and closes after [hours].
examples.cn: 图书馆九点开门，[营业时间]后关闭。

examples.en: Rush [hour] in the city starts at around seven in the morning.
examples.cn: 城市的早高[峰]时段从早上七点左右开始。

examples.en: She practises piano for one [hour] every day.
examples.cn: 她每天练习钢琴一[小时]。

examples.en: In his darkest [hours], music helped him feel better.
examples.cn: 在他最黑暗的[时刻]，音乐帮助他感觉好多了。

words.translation: n. 房子, 住宅, 机构, 议院, 家族, 家庭\nvt. 给...房子住, 收藏\nvi. 住, 躲藏
words.definition:
n. a dwelling that serves as living quarters for one or more families
n. the members of a religious community living together
n. the audience gathered together in a theatre or cinema
n. an official assembly having legislative powers

examples.en: They moved into a new [house] near the school last month.
examples.cn: 他们上个月搬进了学校附近的新[房子]。

examples.en: There were twelve people in the [house] for the New Year dinner.
examples.cn: 新年晚宴时[家里]有十二个人。

examples.en: The bill was passed by the [House] of Representatives.
examples.cn: 该法案由[众议院]通过。

examples.en: The dormitory [houses] over two hundred students.
examples.cn: 宿舍楼[容纳]了两百多名学生。

examples.en: The performance drew a full [house] on opening night.
examples.cn: 首演之夜，剧院[座无虚席]。

words.translation: n. 家事, 家务
words.definition: n. the work of cleaning and running a house

examples.en: The whole family shared the [housework] every Saturday morning.
examples.cn: 每周六早上全家人分担[家务]。

examples.en: She does most of the [housework] because both parents work.
examples.cn: 因为父母都工作，她做大部分[家务]。

examples.en: Doing [housework] teaches children responsibility and teamwork.
examples.cn: 做[家务]教会孩子责任感和团队合作。

examples.en: After school, he helped with the [housework] before studying.
examples.cn: 放学后，他在学习前帮忙做[家务]。

examples.en: Cooking, cleaning, and washing are all forms of [housework].
examples.cn: 烹饪、打扫和洗衣都是[家务]的形式。

words.translation: adv. 如何, 怎样, 多少, 多么\nn. 方式
words.definition:
adv. In what manner or way; by what means or process.
adv. To what degree or extent, number or amount; in what
   proportion; by what measure or quality.
adv. For what reason; from what cause.
adv. In what state, condition, or plight.
adv. By what name, designation, or title.
adv. At what price; how dear.

examples.en: [How] do you say 'hello' in French?
examples.cn: '你好'用法语[怎么]说？

examples.en: [How] beautiful the sunset looks from the top of the hill!
examples.cn: 从山顶看日落[多么]美丽啊！

examples.en: [How] much does this book cost at the school bookshop?
examples.cn: 这本书在学校书店要多少钱？

examples.en: She didn't know [how] to solve the maths problem.
examples.cn: 她不知道[如何]解决这道数学题。

examples.en: [How] are you feeling after your long journey?
examples.cn: 长途旅行后你感觉[怎么样]？

words.translation: adv. 然而, 无论如何, 究竟怎样\nconj. 然而, 可是
words.definition:
r. despite anything to the contrary (usually following a concession)
r. by contrast; on the other hand; the second, however, took hours"
r. to whatever degree or extent
r. in whatever way or manner

examples.en: She studied hard; [however], the exam was still difficult.
examples.cn: 她努力学习；[然而]，考试仍然很难。

examples.sense: conj. 不管多么；无论怎样
examples.en: [However] hard he tries, he can't seem to improve his grades.
examples.cn: [不管]他多么努力，他的成绩似乎都无法提高。

examples.en: The weather was cold. [However], they enjoyed the trip.
examples.cn: 天气很冷。[但是]，他们还是享受了旅行。

examples.en: You can decorate the poster [however] you like.
examples.cn: 你可以[按照任何方式]装饰海报。

examples.en: [However] the story ends, she will finish reading it.
examples.cn: [无论]故事如何结尾，她都会读完它。

words.translation: a. 极大的, 巨大的, 无限的
words.definition: s. unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope

examples.en: The [huge] stadium could hold fifty thousand spectators.
examples.cn: 这个[巨大]的体育场可以容纳五万名观众。

examples.en: She received a [huge] amount of support from her classmates.
examples.cn: 她得到了同学们[大量]的支持。

examples.en: Passing the national exam was a [huge] achievement for him.
examples.cn: 通过全国考试对他来说是一项[巨大]的成就。

examples.en: The elephant was [huge] — bigger than anything she had ever seen.
examples.cn: 大象[巨大]无比——比她见过的任何东西都大。

examples.en: The school concert was a [huge] success this year.
examples.cn: 今年学校音乐会取得了[巨大]成功。

words.translation: n. 人, 人类\na. 人类的, 似人类的, 人性的, 有同情心的
words.definition: a. characteristic of humanity\na. relating to a person\na. having human form or attributes as opposed to those of animals or divine beings

examples.en: Every [human] being deserves to be treated with kindness.
examples.cn: 每一个[人类]都应该得到善待。

examples.en: A [human] can walk on two legs unlike most other animals.
examples.cn: 与大多数其他动物不同，[人类]能用两条腿行走。

examples.sense: adj. 人道的；有人情味的
examples.en: It is [human] to make mistakes — nobody is perfect.
examples.cn: 犯错误是[人之常情]——没有人是完美的。

examples.en: Protecting the environment is the responsibility of all [humans].
examples.cn: 保护环境是所有[人类]的责任。

examples.en: [Human] history stretches back millions of years.
examples.cn: [人类]历史可以追溯到数百万年前。

words.translation: a. 富幽默感的, 滑稽的, 诙谐的
words.definition: a. full of or characterized by humor

examples.en: His [humorous] speech made everyone in the hall laugh.
examples.cn: 他[幽默]的演讲让大厅里的每个人都笑了。

examples.en: She has a [humorous] way of describing everyday situations.
examples.cn: 她以[风趣]的方式描述日常生活。

examples.en: The [humorous] cartoon in the newspaper amused the whole family.
examples.cn: 报纸上[滑稽]的漫画逗乐了全家人。

examples.en: The teacher told a [humorous] story to help the class relax.
examples.cn: 老师讲了一个[幽默]故事帮助班级放松。

examples.en: His [humorous] personality makes him popular with his classmates.
examples.cn: 他[幽默]的个性使他在同学中很受欢迎。

words.translation: n. 百, 百个东西\nnum. 百, 百个\na. 一百的, 许多的
words.definition: n. ten 10s\ns. being ten more than ninety

examples.en: There are one [hundred] students in the school choir.
examples.cn: 学校合唱团有一[百]名学生。

examples.en: [Hundreds] of people came to watch the school performance.
examples.cn: [数百]人来观看学校的演出。

examples.en: She scored one [hundred] percent on the spelling test.
examples.cn: 她在拼写测试中得了一[百]分。

examples.en: I've told you a [hundred] times to tidy your room.
examples.cn: 我已经告诉你[无数次]要整理你的房间了。

examples.en: The book costs two [hundred] yuan at the bookstore.
examples.cn: 这本书在书店里售价两[百]元。

words.translation: a. 饥饿的, 荒年的, 渴望的, 不毛的\n[化] 欠鞣皮
words.definition: a. feeling hunger; feeling a need or desire to eat food

examples.en: The children were very [hungry] after playing sports all morning.
examples.cn: 孩子们运动了一个上午后非常[饥饿]。

examples.sense: adj. 渴望的；渴求的（引申义）
examples.en: She is [hungry] for knowledge and reads every book she can find.
examples.cn: 她[渴望]知识，读所有她能找到的书。

examples.sense: adj. 饥荒的；食物不足的
examples.en: Many children in poor areas go to bed [hungry] every night.
examples.cn: 许多贫困地区的孩子每晚[饿着肚子]入睡。

examples.en: He was [hungry] for success and practised every single day.
examples.cn: 他[渴望]成功，每天都坚持练习。

examples.en: The [hungry] soil needed fertiliser before planting.
examples.cn: [贫瘠]的土壤在种植前需要施肥。

words.translation: n. 匆忙, 急忙, 急促\nvt. 急派, 催促\nvi. 匆忙, 赶快
words.definition: n. a condition of urgency making it necessary to hurry

examples.en: [Hurry] up or we'll miss the school bus!
examples.cn: [快点]，否则我们会错过校车！

examples.en: He left home in a [hurry] and forgot his lunch box.
examples.cn: 他匆忙离家，忘了带饭盒。

examples.en: The teacher [hurried] the students to finish the exam.
examples.cn: 老师催促学生[赶快]完成考试。

examples.en: There is no [hurry] — we still have plenty of time.
examples.cn: 不用[着急]——我们还有足够的时间。

examples.en: She [hurried] to the classroom when she heard the bell ring.
examples.cn: 听到铃声她[匆忙赶]到教室。

words.translation: n. 伤害, 创伤, 损害\nv. 伤害, (使)伤心, 危害, 刺痛
words.definition:
v. give trouble or pain to
v. cause damage or affect negatively
v. hurt the feelings of
v. feel physical pain

examples.en: He [hurt] his knee when he fell off his bike.
examples.cn: 他从自行车上摔下来时[伤]了膝盖。

examples.en: Her unkind words [hurt] his feelings deeply.
examples.cn: 她刻薄的话深深地[伤害]了他的感情。

examples.en: She looked [hurt] when no one clapped after her performance.
examples.cn: 她表演结束后没有人鼓掌，她看起来很[受伤]。

examples.en: Staying up late every night will [hurt] your health over time.
examples.cn: 每晚熬夜会随着时间的推移[损害]你的健康。

examples.en: The [hurt] in her eyes told everyone she was disappointed.
examples.cn: 她眼中的[痛苦]告诉大家她很失望。

words.translation: n. 丈夫, 管理人, 节俭的人\nvt. 节俭, 使成丈夫, 持有
words.definition: n. a married man; a woman's partner in marriage

examples.en: Her [husband] cooks dinner every evening when she works late.
examples.cn: 她工作到很晚时，[丈夫]每天晚上做晚饭。

examples.en: She introduced her [husband] to her colleagues at the party.
examples.cn: 她在聚会上把[丈夫]介绍给同事。

examples.en: They have been [husband] and wife for thirty years.
examples.cn: 他们做了三十年的[丈夫]和妻子。

examples.en: He carefully [husbanded] his savings to buy a new bicycle.
examples.cn: 他仔细[节约]积蓄买了一辆新自行车。

examples.en: He became a stay-at-home [husband] after losing his job.
examples.cn: 失业后，他成为了家庭主[夫]。

words.translation: pron. 我\n[计] 电流, 中断, 指令, 指示符
words.definition: n. the 9th letter of the Roman alphabet

examples.en: [I] finished all my homework before dinner tonight.
examples.cn: [我]今晚在晚饭前完成了所有作业。

examples.en: [I] would like to join the school science club.
examples.cn: [我]想加入学校科学俱乐部。

examples.en: It was [I] who suggested the idea to the teacher.
examples.cn: 是[我]向老师提出了这个想法。

examples.en: The poet writes: '[I] wandered lonely as a cloud.'
examples.cn: 诗人写道：'[我]像一朵孤独的云漫游。'

examples.en: The concept of '[I]' in philosophy refers to one's sense of self.
examples.cn: 哲学中'[我]'的概念指的是一个人的自我意识。

words.translation: n. 冰, 冰淇淋, 糖衣, 冷若冰霜, 矜持, 贿赂\nvt. 使结冰, 冰镇, 覆以糖衣\nvi. 结冰
words.definition:
n. water frozen in the solid state
n. the frozen part of a body of water
n. diamonds
n. a frozen dessert with fruit flavoring (especially one containing no milk)

examples.en: She put some [ice] in her drink to keep it cold.
examples.cn: 她在饮料里放了一些[冰块]保持凉爽。

examples.en: The pond was covered with thin [ice] in winter.
examples.cn: 冬天池塘表面覆盖着薄薄的[冰]层。

examples.en: The roads [iced] over overnight making driving dangerous.
examples.cn: 路面一夜之间[结冰]，驾车变得危险。

examples.en: She bought a strawberry [ice] lolly on the hot day.
examples.cn: 炎热的天气里她买了一根草莓[冰棒]。

examples.en: He [iced] his injured ankle to reduce the swelling.
examples.cn: 他用[冰]敷受伤的脚踝以消肿。

words.translation: 冰淇淋\n[化] 冰淇淋

examples.en: She treated herself to a chocolate [ice cream] after the exam.
examples.cn: 考试后她买了一个巧克力[冰淇淋]犒劳自己。

examples.en: He ordered two scoops of vanilla [ice cream] at the parlour.
examples.cn: 他在冰淇淋店点了两球香草[冰淇淋]。

examples.sense: n. 冰淇淋（形容词用法）
examples.en: The [ice cream] truck played music as it drove through the neighbourhood.
examples.cn: [冰淇淋]车边开车边播放音乐穿过街区。

examples.en: [Ice cream] is a popular dessert enjoyed by people of all ages.
examples.cn: [冰淇淋]是各个年龄段的人都喜爱的热门甜品。

examples.en: What is your favourite [ice cream] flavour — chocolate or strawberry?
examples.cn: 你最喜欢的[冰淇淋]口味是什么——巧克力还是草莓？

words.translation: n. 主意, 办法, 理想, 思想, 概念, 意见\n[医] 观念, 思想
words.definition: n. the content of cognition; the main thing you are thinking about\nn. a personal view

examples.en: She had a great [idea] for the school science project.
examples.cn: 她对学校科学项目有一个很好的[想法]。

examples.en: The [idea] of recycling is important for protecting the environment.
examples.cn: 回收利用的[概念]对保护环境很重要。

examples.en: His [idea] is to start a reading club after school.
examples.cn: 他的[想法]是在放学后创办一个读书俱乐部。

examples.en: I have no [idea] what the answer to this question is.
examples.cn: 我完全不[知道]这道题的答案。

examples.en: The [idea] behind the project is to help young students learn coding.
examples.cn: 这个项目的[目的]是帮助年轻学生学习编程。

words.translation: conj. 如果, 是否, 无论何时, 假设, 即使\nn. 条件\n[计] DOS批处理命令:根据所测试的条件决定是否执行另一条命令
words.definition: conj. In case that; granting, allowing, or supposing that; --\n   introducing a condition or supposition.\nconj. Whether; -- in dependent questions.

examples.en: [If] you study hard, you will pass the exam.
examples.cn: [如果]你努力学习，你就会通过考试。

examples.en: She asked [if] I had finished my homework yet.
examples.cn: 她问[是否]我已经完成了作业。

examples.en: [If] it rains, we will still hold the sports day indoors.
examples.cn: [即使]下雨，我们也会在室内举办运动日。

examples.en: [If] you press this button, the machine will start.
examples.cn: [只要]你按这个按钮，机器就会启动。

examples.en: It was a small gift, [if] a very thoughtful one.
examples.cn: 这是一个小礼物，[虽然]非常用心。

words.translation: n. 疾病, 坏事, 罪恶, 灾难\na. 生病的, 邪恶的, 不吉利的, 敌意的, 不良的, 不顺利的\nadv. 有害地, 不幸地, 几乎不
words.definition:
a. affected by an impairment of normal physical or mental function
s. resulting in suffering or adversity
s. distressing
s. indicating hostility or enmity

examples.en: She felt [ill] after eating the bad food at lunch.
examples.cn: 午饭后吃了变质食物，她感到[生病]了。

examples.en: The medicine had some [ill] effects on his stomach.
examples.cn: 这种药对他的胃有一些[不良]影响。

examples.en: The school can [ill] afford to lose such a talented teacher.
examples.cn: 学校[很难]承受失去这么有才华的老师。

examples.en: He bears no [ill] will towards anyone who disagrees with him.
examples.cn: 他对任何不同意他的人都没有[恶意]。

examples.en: The doctor worked tirelessly to cure the [ills] of the community.
examples.cn: 医生不知疲倦地工作，治愈社区的[疾病]。

words.translation: n. 疾病, 恶意\n[医] 病
words.definition: n. impairment of normal physiological function affecting part or all of an organism

examples.en: She missed a week of school due to a serious [illness].
examples.cn: 她因严重[疾病]缺课了一周。

examples.en: His [illness] prevented him from taking part in the sports day.
examples.cn: 他的[病情]使他无法参加运动日。

examples.en: Proper diet and exercise can help prevent many [illnesses].
examples.cn: 适当的饮食和运动可以帮助预防许多[疾病]。

examples.en: A mild [illness] kept her home from school for two days.
examples.cn: 轻微的[病症]让她在家休息了两天没上学。

examples.en: Mental [illness] is just as important to treat as physical illness.
examples.cn: 心理[疾病]和身体疾病一样需要得到治疗。

words.translation: vt. 想像, 设想, 猜测\nvi. 想像起来
words.definition: v. form a mental image of something that is not present or that is not the case

examples.en: [Imagine] how different life would be without electricity.
examples.cn: [想象]一下没有电的生活会有多不同。

examples.en: I [imagine] the journey will take about three hours by train.
examples.cn: 我[猜想]乘火车大约需要三个小时。

examples.en: As a child, she would [imagine] herself as a famous explorer.
examples.cn: 小时候，她会[幻想]自己是一位著名的探险家。

examples.en: Can you [imagine] living without your mobile phone?
examples.cn: 你能[想象]没有手机的生活吗？

examples.en: The author [imagined] a world where animals could speak.
examples.cn: 作者[构想]了一个动物会说话的世界。

words.translation: adv. 直接地, 立刻, 立即
words.definition: r. without delay or hesitation; with no time intervening\nr. near or close by\nr. bearing an immediate relation

examples.en: She [immediately] called her parents when she heard the news.
examples.cn: 听到消息后，她[立即]打电话给父母。

examples.en: He sat down [immediately] after the teacher asked him to.
examples.cn: 老师请他坐下后，他[立刻]坐了下来。

examples.en: The fire alarm rang and everyone left the building [immediately].
examples.cn: 火警响起，每个人[立刻]离开了大楼。

examples.en: [Immediately] after the exam, students discussed the answers.
examples.cn: 考试[一结束]，学生们就讨论答案。

examples.en: The second mistake followed [immediately] after the first.
examples.cn: 第二个错误[紧接着]第一个出现。

words.translation: a. 重要的, 有地位的, 大量的, 显要的, 自负的\n[计] 要点
words.definition: a. of great significance or value\ns. having or suggesting a consciousness of high position

examples.en: It is [important] to eat breakfast before going to school.
examples.cn: 上学前吃早饭是[重要]的。

examples.en: Time management is an [important] skill for every student.
examples.cn: 时间管理是每个学生的[重要]技能。

examples.en: She is an [important] figure in the history of Chinese literature.
examples.cn: 她是中国文学史上的[重要]人物。

examples.en: The doctor said it was [important] to take the medicine every day.
examples.cn: 医生说每天按时服药非常[重要]。

examples.en: He plays an [important] role in organising the school events.
examples.cn: 他在组织学校活动方面扮演着[重要]角色。

words.translation: a. 不可能的, 难以置信的, 令人无法忍受的
words.definition:
n. something that cannot be done
a. not capable of occurring or being accomplished or dealt with
s. totally unlikely
s. used of persons or their behavior

examples.sense: adj. 不可能的；做不到的
examples.en: It is [impossible] to learn a language overnight.
examples.cn: 一夜之间学会一门语言是[不可能]的。

examples.en: The task seemed [impossible] at first, but they succeeded.
examples.cn: 这项任务起初看似[不可能]，但他们成功了。

examples.en: His behaviour in class was simply [impossible] to tolerate.
examples.cn: 他在课堂上的行为简直[令人无法接受]。

examples.en: Finishing the project in one day was nearly [impossible].
examples.cn: 一天内完成这个项目几乎是[不可能]的。

examples.en: She believes in doing the [impossible] when others give up.
examples.cn: 当别人放弃时，她相信可以做到[不可能]的事。

words.translation: vt. 改良, 提高...的价值, 改善, 利用\nvi. 变得更好, 增加
words.definition: v to make better\nv get better

examples.en: She practises speaking English every day to [improve] her fluency.
examples.cn: 她每天练习英语口语以[提高]流利度。

examples.en: The teacher suggested ways to [improve] his essay.
examples.cn: 老师建议了[改进]他文章的方法。

examples.en: His grades [improved] a lot after he changed his study habits.
examples.cn: 改变学习习惯后，他的成绩大幅[提高]了。

examples.en: Regular exercise can [improve] both physical and mental health.
examples.cn: 定期锻炼可以[改善]身心健康。

examples.en: She [improved] her free time by learning to draw.
examples.cn: 她利用空闲时间[提高]自己，学习绘画。

words.translation:
prep. 在...期间, 在...之内, 处于...之中, 从事于, 按照, 穿着
adv. 进入, 朝里, 在里面, 在屋里
a. 在里面的, 在朝的
n. 执政者, 交情
words.definition:
s. holding office
s. directed or bound inward
s. currently fashionable
r. to or toward the inside of

examples.en: The books are [in] the bag on the desk.
examples.cn: 书[在]桌上的包里。

examples.en: We have a big exam [in] the third week of May.
examples.cn: 我们五月第三周[有]一次大考。

examples.en: Please write your answers [in] pencil, not pen.
examples.cn: 请用铅笔[写]答案，不要用钢笔。

examples.en: Stay [in] if the weather is too cold outside.
examples.cn: 如果外面太冷，就待[在家里]。

examples.en: She walked [in] wearing a beautiful red dress.
examples.cn: 她穿着漂亮的红裙子走[进来]。

words.translation: n. 英寸, 身高, 小岛\nvi. 慢慢前进, 慢慢移动\nvt. 使缓慢地移动
words.definition: n. a unit of length equal to one twelfth of a foot

examples.en: The ruler measures twelve [inches], which is one foot.
examples.cn: 这把尺子长十二[英寸]，即一英尺。

examples.en: She didn't move an [inch] when the dog barked at her.
examples.cn: 狗对她叫时，她一[动]都没动。

examples.en: The caterpillar [inched] slowly along the leaf.
examples.cn: 毛毛虫沿着叶子缓慢地[爬]行。

examples.en: The ball missed the goal by just an [inch].
examples.cn: 球差[一点点]就进门了。

examples.en: Only two [inches] of rain fell in the whole month of July.
examples.cn: 整个七月只降了两[英寸]的雨。

words.translation: vt. 包括, 把...算入, 包住\n[计] DOS内部命令:在CONFIG.SYS文件的一个配置块中包含另一配置块的内容
words.definition: v. have as a part, be made up out of\nv. consider as part of something\nv. add as part of something else; put in as part of a set, group, or category

examples.en: The price [includes] breakfast and dinner every day.
examples.cn: 价格[包括]每天的早餐和晚餐。

examples.en: Please [include] your name and class number on the form.
examples.cn: 请在表格上[填写]你的姓名和班级编号。

examples.en: The teacher [included] a fun game in the lesson plan.
examples.cn: 老师在教学计划中[加入]了一个有趣的游戏。

examples.en: The report [includes] information about air and water pollution.
examples.cn: 报告[涵盖]了空气和水污染的信息。

examples.en: Don't forget to [include] all team members in the group photo.
examples.cn: 别忘了把所有队员都[包括]在集体照里。

words.translation: n. 增加, 增进, 利益\nvt. 增加, 加大\nvi. 增加, 繁殖
words.definition:
n. a change resulting in an increase
n. a process of becoming larger or longer or more numerous or more important
n. the amount by which something increases
n. the act of increasing something

examples.en: Exercise can [increase] your energy and improve your mood.
examples.cn: 锻炼可以[增加]你的精力并改善心情。

examples.en: The school [increased] the number of library books this year.
examples.cn: 学校今年[增加]了图书馆书籍的数量。

examples.en: There has been a big [increase] in the number of students joining clubs.
examples.cn: 加入俱乐部的学生人数有了大幅[增加]。

examples.en: Reading regularly can [increase] your vocabulary greatly.
examples.cn: 定期阅读能大大[增加]你的词汇量。

examples.en: The temperature [increase] this summer was higher than expected.
examples.cn: 今年夏天的温度[涨幅]高于预期。

words.translation: n. 印度
words.definition: n. a republic in the Asian subcontinent in southern Asia; second most populous country in the world; achieved independence from the United Kingdom in 1947

examples.en: [India] is the second most populous country in the world.
examples.cn: [印度]是世界上第二人口大国。

examples.en: Yoga originated in [India] thousands of years ago.
examples.cn: 瑜伽起源于数千年前的[印度]。

examples.en: [India] gained independence from Britain in 1947.
examples.cn: [印度]于1947年从英国获得独立。

examples.en: Bollywood films from [India] are popular all over the world.
examples.cn: 来自[印度]的宝莱坞电影在全世界都很受欢迎。

examples.en: The Ganges River flows through the heart of [India].
examples.cn: 恒河流经[印度]的中心地带。

words.translation: n. 印度人, 印第安人, 印第安语\na. 印度的, 印度群岛的, 印第安语的
words.definition: n. a member of the race of people living in America when Europeans arrived\nn. a native or inhabitant of India\na. of or relating to or characteristic of India or the East Indies or their peoples or languages or cultures

examples.en: She loves [Indian] food, especially curry and naan bread.
examples.cn: 她喜欢[印度]食物，尤其是咖喱和印度烤饼。

examples.en: My classmate is an [Indian] who moved to China last year.
examples.cn: 我的同学是一位去年来到中国的[印度人]。

examples.en: The museum has a special exhibition on [Indian] art and history.
examples.cn: 博物馆有一个关于[印度]艺术和历史的特别展览。

examples.en: Many [Indians] living abroad still celebrate traditional festivals.
examples.cn: 许多海外[印度人]仍然庆祝传统节日。

examples.en: The [Indian] culture of North America has a rich oral tradition.
examples.cn: 北美[印第安]文化有着丰富的口述传统。

words.translation: n. 勤劳, 工业, 企业, 产业, 有组织的劳动\n[经] 工业, 实业
words.definition: n. the people or companies engaged in a particular kind of commercial enterprise\nn. the organized action of making of goods and services for sale

examples.en: The car [industry] is one of the most important in China.
examples.cn: 汽车[工业]是中国最重要的产业之一。

examples.en: She wants to work in the film [industry] after graduation.
examples.cn: 她毕业后想在电影[行业]工作。

examples.en: His [industry] and dedication helped him succeed at school.
examples.cn: 他的[勤勉]和奉献精神帮助他在学校取得了成功。

examples.en: Heavy [industry] such as steel production requires a lot of energy.
examples.cn: 钢铁生产等重[工业]需要大量能源。

examples.en: Tourism is a growing [industry] in many developing countries.
examples.cn: 旅游业是许多发展中国家不断增长的[产业]。

words.translation: n. 影响力, 权力, 势力\nvt. 影响, 改变
words.definition:
n. a power to affect persons or events especially power based on prestige etc
n. causing something without any direct or apparent effort
n. a cognitive factor that tends to have an effect on what you do
n. the effect of one thing (or person) on another

examples.en: Good teachers have a lasting [influence] on their students.
examples.cn: 好老师对学生有持久的[影响]。

examples.en: The book greatly [influenced] her decision to study medicine.
examples.cn: 这本书极大地[影响]了她学医的决定。

examples.en: She has a lot of [influence] in the local community.
examples.cn: 她在当地社区有很大的[影响力]。

examples.en: His parents [influenced] him to pursue a career in science.
examples.cn: 他的父母[影响]他去追求科学事业。

examples.en: She credits her grandmother as her greatest [influence].
examples.cn: 她认为祖母是对她影响最大的[榜样]。

words.translation: n. 消息, 知识, 通知, 情报, 信息, 问讯处, 起诉\n[计] 信息
words.definition:
n. a message received and understood
n. knowledge acquired through study or experience or instruction
n. formal accusation of a crime
n. (communication theory) a numerical measure of the uncertainty of an outcome

examples.en: The internet is a great source of [information] on any topic.
examples.cn: 互联网是任何话题的重要[信息]来源。

examples.en: She asked the teacher for more [information] about the project.
examples.cn: 她向老师询问更多关于项目的[信息]。

examples.en: The brochure contains useful [information] about the museum.
examples.cn: 手册包含有关博物馆的有用[信息]。

examples.en: We need more [information] before we can make a decision.
examples.cn: 在做决定之前，我们需要更多[信息]。

examples.en: For more [information], please visit the school website.
examples.cn: 如需更多[信息]，请访问学校网站。

words.translation: n. 墨水, 墨汁\nvt. 涂墨水于, 签署, 加墨水
words.definition:
n. a liquid used for printing or writing or drawing
n. dark protective fluid ejected into the water by cuttlefish and other cephalopods
v. append one's signature to
v. mark, coat, cover, or stain with ink

examples.en: The pen ran out of [ink] in the middle of the exam.
examples.cn: 钢笔在考试中途没有[墨水]了。

examples.en: She dipped her brush in black [ink] to write Chinese calligraphy.
examples.cn: 她把毛笔蘸上黑[墨汁]练习书法。

examples.en: The [ink] in the printer needs to be replaced soon.
examples.cn: 打印机里的[墨水]快要换了。

examples.en: He carefully [inked] his name on the official document.
examples.cn: 他小心地用[墨水]在官方文件上签了名。

examples.en: The design was drawn in permanent [ink] on paper first.
examples.cn: 设计先用永久性[墨水]画在纸上。

words.translation:
n. 内部, 内脏, 内幕
a. 内部的, 秘密的, 户内的
adv. 在里面
prep. 在...之内
words.definition:
n. the region that is inside of something
n. the inner or enclosed surface of something
a. relating to or being on the side closer to the center or within a defined space
s. being or applying to the inside of a building

examples.en: Please wait [inside] the classroom until the teacher arrives.
examples.cn: 请在老师来之前待在教室[里面]。

examples.en: It was raining, so everyone stayed [inside].
examples.cn: 外面在下雨，所以每个人都待在[室内]。

examples.en: The [inside] of the bag was full of books and notebooks.
examples.cn: 书包的[内部]装满了书本和笔记本。

examples.en: She wiped the [inside] surface of the window clean.
examples.cn: 她擦干净了窗户的[内侧]面。

examples.en: Finish the exercise [inside] twenty minutes.
examples.cn: 在二十分钟[以内]完成练习。

words.translation: v. 坚持, 坚决主张, 强调
words.definition: v. be emphatic or resolute and refuse to budge\nv. assert to be true

examples.en: She [insisted] on paying for her own lunch.
examples.cn: 她[坚持]要自己付午饭钱。

examples.en: He [insisted] that he had seen the lost book in the library.
examples.cn: 他[坚持]说他在图书馆看到了那本丢失的书。

examples.en: The student [insisted] on his answer even when the teacher disagreed.
examples.cn: 即使老师不同意，学生仍[坚持]他的答案。

examples.en: Her parents [insist] that she comes home before nine o'clock.
examples.cn: 她父母[坚持]要她九点前回家。

examples.en: The coach [insisted] on punctuality during every training session.
examples.cn: 教练在每次训练时都[强调]要守时。

words.translation: adv. 作为替代, 反而

examples.en: She couldn't attend the meeting, so her friend went [instead].
examples.cn: 她不能参加会议，所以朋友[代替]她去了。

examples.en: He didn't study for the exam; [instead], he played games all day.
examples.cn: 他没有备考；[反而]整天打游戏。

examples.en: Try walking to school [instead] of taking the bus tomorrow.
examples.cn: 明天试着步行上学，[代替]乘公共汽车。

examples.en: [Instead] of complaining, try to find a solution.
examples.cn: [不要]抱怨，试着找到解决办法。

examples.en: She decided to study Chinese [instead] of French.
examples.cn: 她决定学汉语，[而不是]法语。

words.translation: n. 指令, 教导, 命令\n[计] 指令
words.definition: n. (computer science) a line of code written as part of a computer program

examples.en: Read the [instructions] carefully before starting the experiment.
examples.cn: 在开始实验之前仔细阅读[说明]。

examples.en: She received [instruction] in piano from a professional teacher.
examples.cn: 她接受了专业老师的钢琴[指导]。

examples.en: Follow the teacher's [instructions] during the fire drill.
examples.cn: 消防演习期间遵从老师的[指令]。

examples.en: He read the [instruction] manual before assembling the furniture.
examples.cn: 他在组装家具之前阅读了[操作说明书]。

examples.en: The course provides [instruction] in basic computer skills.
examples.cn: 这门课程提供基本电脑技能的[培训]。

words.translation: n. 意图, 目的, 含义\n[医] 愈合, 意向
words.definition: n. (usually plural) the goal with respect to a marriage proposal\nn. an act of intending; a volition that you intend to carry out

examples.en: Her [intention] was to finish the project before the holiday.
examples.cn: 她的[意图]是在假期前完成这个项目。

examples.en: He had no [intention] of giving up, no matter how hard it got.
examples.cn: 他没有[打算]放弃，无论有多难。

examples.en: The [intention] behind the gift was to show appreciation.
examples.cn: 送礼背后的[用意]是表达感谢。

examples.en: She announced her [intention] to join the school debate team.
examples.cn: 她宣布了[意愿]加入学校辩论队。

examples.en: He acted with good [intentions] but made a mistake anyway.
examples.cn: 他出于好[意图]行事，但还是犯了错误。

words.translation: n. 兴趣, 嗜好, 利息, 利益, 爱好, 趣味, 势力\nvt. 使感兴趣, 与...有关系
words.definition:
n. a sense of concern with and curiosity about someone or something
n. the power of attracting or holding one's attention (because it is unusual or exciting etc.)
n. a fixed charge for borrowing money; usually a percentage of the amount borrowed
n. (law) a right or legal share of something; a financial involvement with something

examples.en: She has a strong [interest] in science and technology.
examples.cn: 她对科学技术有浓厚的[兴趣]。

examples.en: The documentary [interested] him so much that he watched it twice.
examples.cn: 这部纪录片让他非常[感兴趣]，他看了两遍。

examples.en: The bank pays [interest] on money you save in an account.
examples.cn: 银行对储蓄账户的存款支付[利息]。

examples.en: The new science exhibit attracted great [interest] from students.
examples.cn: 新的科学展览引起了学生们的极大[关注]。

examples.en: The school acts in the best [interests] of all its students.
examples.cn: 学校以所有学生的最大[利益]为出发点行事。

words.translation: a. 有趣的
words.definition: a. arousing or holding the attention

examples.sense: adj. 有趣的；令人感兴趣的
examples.en: The science lesson was very [interesting] because of the experiments.
examples.cn: 科学课因为实验而非常[有趣]。

examples.en: She gave an [interesting] presentation about life under the ocean.
examples.cn: 她做了一个关于海洋生物的[引人入胜]的演讲。

examples.en: He has an [interesting] hobby — he collects antique maps.
examples.cn: 他有一个[有趣]的爱好——收集古地图。

examples.en: What an [interesting] question — I have never thought about it before.
examples.cn: 多么[有趣]的问题——我以前从未想过这个问题。

examples.sense: adj. 新奇的；出人意料的
examples.en: The [interesting] part of the story comes near the end.
examples.cn: 故事中最[有趣]的部分出现在接近结尾处。

words.translation: a. 国际的\nn. 国别设定\n[计] 国别设定
words.definition: n. any of several international socialist organizations\na. concerning or belonging to all or at least two or more nations

examples.en: She won a gold medal at an [international] piano competition.
examples.cn: 她在[国际]钢琴比赛中获得了金牌。

examples.en: English is an [international] language used all over the world.
examples.cn: 英语是全世界使用的[国际]语言。

examples.en: The [international] student exchange programme runs every summer.
examples.cn: [国际]学生交流项目每年夏天举办。

examples.en: The [international] conference was attended by scientists from fifty countries.
examples.cn: 这次[国际]会议有来自五十个国家的科学家出席。

examples.sense: n. 国际比赛；国际赛事
examples.en: Playing for the national team in an [international] is her dream.
examples.cn: 在[国际]比赛中为国家队出战是她的梦想。

words.translation: [计] 因特网, 国际互连网, 网际网络, 互连网络, 广域网
words.definition: n. a computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the TCP/IP network protocols to facilitate data transmission and exchange

examples.en: She uses the [internet] to research topics for her school projects.
examples.cn: 她使用[互联网]为学校项目研究话题。

examples.en: Our school has fast [internet] access in every classroom.
examples.cn: 我们学校每间教室都有快速的[互联网]连接。

examples.en: He spends too much time on the [internet] instead of studying.
examples.cn: 他花了太多时间上[网]而不是学习。

examples.sense: n. 互联网（形容词用法）
examples.en: [Internet] shopping has become very popular in recent years.
examples.cn: 近年来[网络]购物变得非常流行。

examples.en: The [internet] has changed the way people communicate and learn.
examples.cn: [互联网]改变了人们的交流和学习方式。

words.translation: n. 面谈, 访问, 接见, 面试\nvt. 接见, 对...进行面谈(试)
words.definition:
n. the questioning of a person (or a conversation in which information is elicited); often conducted by journalists
v. conduct an interview in television, newspaper, and radio reporting
v. discuss formally with (somebody) for the purpose of an evaluation
v. go for an interview in the hope of being hired

examples.en: She prepared carefully for the job [interview] at the company.
examples.cn: 她为公司的工作[面试]做了认真准备。

examples.en: The reporter conducted an [interview] with the school principal.
examples.cn: 记者对学校校长进行了[采访]。

examples.en: The teacher [interviewed] each student before selecting the team.
examples.cn: 老师在选队之前[面试]了每位学生。

examples.en: She passed the [interview] and was accepted into the top school.
examples.cn: 她通过了[面试]，被顶尖学校录取。

examples.en: The police [interviewed] witnesses about what they had seen.
examples.cn: 警察[询问]目击者关于他们所见到的情况。

words.translation: prep. 进入...之内, 朝..., 深入...之中, 成为...状况
words.definition:
prep. To the inside of; within. It is used in a variety of
   applications.
prep. Expressing entrance, or a passing from the outside of a
   thing to its interior parts; -- following verbs expressing motion; as,
   come into the house; go into the church; one stream falls or runs into
   another; water enters into the fine vessels of plants.
prep. Expressing penetration beyond the outside or surface, or
   access to the inside, or contents; as, to look into a letter or book;
   to look into an apartment.
prep. Indicating insertion; as, to infuse more spirit or
   animation into a composition.
prep. Denoting inclusion; as, put these ideas into other words.
prep. Indicating the passing of a thing from one form,
   condition, or state to another; as, compound substances may be resolved
   into others which are more simple; ice is convertible into water, and
   water into vapor; men are more easily drawn than forced into
   compliance; we may reduce many distinct substances into one mass; men
   are led by evidence into belief of truth, and are often enticed into
   the commission of crimes'into; she burst into tears; children are
   sometimes frightened into fits; all persons are liable to be seduced
   into error and folly.

examples.en: She walked [into] the classroom and took her seat.
examples.cn: 她走[进]教室，坐到了自己的座位上。

examples.en: The caterpillar turned [into] a beautiful butterfly.
examples.cn: 毛毛虫变[成]了一只美丽的蝴蝶。

examples.en: He walked [into] the door because he wasn't looking.
examples.cn: 他没看路，撞[上]了门。

examples.en: She is really [into] reading science fiction novels.
examples.cn: 她非常[热衷于]阅读科幻小说。

examples.en: Let's look [into] the causes of the problem more carefully.
examples.cn: 让我们更仔细地[深入研究]问题的原因。

words.translation: vt. 介绍, 引入, 采用, 输入\n[法] 引进, 输入, 介绍
words.definition:
v. cause to come to know personally
v. bring something new to an environment
v. bring in or establish in a new place or environment
v. bring before the public for the first time, as of an actor, song, etc.

examples.en: The teacher [introduced] the new student to the whole class.
examples.cn: 老师把新同学[介绍]给全班同学。

examples.en: The school [introduced] a new reading programme this year.
examples.cn: 学校今年[引进]了一个新的阅读项目。

examples.en: She [introduced] a new topic into the class discussion.
examples.cn: 她在课堂讨论中[提出]了一个新话题。

examples.en: This scientist [introduced] the theory of evolution.
examples.cn: 这位科学家[提出]了进化论。

examples.en: He [introduced] the speaker before the lecture began.
examples.cn: 他在演讲开始前[介绍]了主讲人。

words.translation: n. 介绍, 传入, 采用, 初步
words.definition:
n. the act of beginning something new
n. the first section of a communication
n. a basic or elementary instructional text
n. a new proposal

examples.en: The teacher gave a brief [introduction] of herself on the first day.
examples.cn: 老师在第一天做了简短的自我[介绍]。

examples.en: The [introduction] of the book explains the main ideas inside.
examples.cn: 书的[引言]解释了书中的主要思想。

examples.en: The [introduction] of computers changed education greatly.
examples.cn: 电脑的[引进]极大地改变了教育。

examples.en: This course is an [introduction] to basic programming skills.
examples.cn: 这门课程是对基本编程技能的[入门]介绍。

examples.en: His [introduction] to the speech was both funny and informative.
examples.cn: 他演讲的[开场白]既有趣又富含信息。

words.translation: vt. 发明, 创作, 虚构\n[机] 发明
words.definition: v. come up with (an idea, plan, explanation, theory, or principle) after a mental effort

examples.en: Thomas Edison [invented] the electric light bulb.
examples.cn: 托马斯·爱迪生[发明]了电灯泡。

examples.en: He [invented] an excuse for being late to class.
examples.cn: 他[编造]了一个上课迟到的借口。

examples.en: She [invented] a clever system for organising her notes.
examples.cn: 她[想出]了一个聪明的方法整理笔记。

examples.en: Who [invented] the printing press that changed history?
examples.cn: 是谁[发明]了改变历史的印刷机？

examples.en: Ancient people [invented] stories to explain natural events.
examples.cn: 古代人[编造]故事来解释自然现象。

words.translation: n. 发明, 创作能力, 虚构的故事\n[经] 发明
words.definition: n. the creation of something in the mind\nn. a creation (a new device or process) resulting from study and experimentation\nn. the act of inventing

examples.en: The telephone was a remarkable [invention] that changed communication.
examples.cn: 电话是一项改变通信方式的卓越[发明]。

examples.en: The [invention] of the computer took many years of research.
examples.cn: 电脑的[发明]经历了多年的研究。

examples.en: That story is pure [invention] — none of it actually happened.
examples.cn: 那个故事纯属[虚构]——实际上什么都没发生。

examples.en: Modern medicine is full of wonderful [inventions].
examples.cn: 现代医学充满了美妙的[发明]。

examples.en: Necessity is said to be the mother of [invention].
examples.cn: 人们说需求是[发明]之母。

words.translation: vt. 邀请, 请求, 引起, 招致\nn. 邀请
words.definition:
n. a colloquial expression for invitation
v. increase the likelihood of
v. invite someone to one's house
v. ask someone in a friendly way to do something

examples.cn: 她[邀请]所有同学参加她的生日派对。

examples.en: Leaving food uncovered [invites] insects into the kitchen.
examples.cn: 把食物放着不盖好会[招来]厨房里的虫子。

examples.en: The teacher [invited] students to share their opinions.
examples.cn: 老师[邀请]学生分享他们的意见。

examples.en: The warm weather [invites] people to spend time outdoors.
examples.cn: 温暖的天气[吸引]人们在户外活动。

words.translation: n. 铁, 熨斗, 铁器, 坚强, 烙铁, 镣铐\nvt. 烫平, 熨, 用铁包\nvi. 烫平

n. a golf club that has a relatively narrow metal head
n. implement used to brand live stock
n. home appliance consisting of a flat metal base that is heated and used to smooth cloth

examples.en: The gate is made of [iron] and is very heavy.
examples.cn: 这扇门是由[铁]制成的，非常重。

examples.en: She used the [iron] to press the wrinkles out of her shirt.
examples.cn: 她用[熨斗]把衬衫上的皱纹熨平。

examples.en: He [ironed] his school uniform the night before the ceremony.
examples.cn: 他在典礼前一天晚上[熨]好了校服。

examples.en: She has an [iron] determination to succeed in her studies.
examples.cn: 她有[钢铁]般的决心在学习上取得成功。

examples.en: Foods rich in [iron] include spinach, beans, and red meat.
examples.cn: 富含[铁]元素的食物包括菠菜、豆类和红肉。

words.translation: n. 岛, 岛屿, 孤立地区, 安全岛\nvt. 使成岛状, 孤立
words.definition: n. a land mass (smaller than a continent) that is surrounded by water\nn. a zone or area resembling an island

examples.cn: 海南是中国南部一个美丽的热带[岛屿]。

examples.cn: 图书馆是繁忙学校中一个宁静的[孤岛]。

examples.cn: 行人在穿越马路前在交通[安全岛]等候。

examples.cn: 厨房[中岛台]为备餐提供了额外空间。

examples.en: The Philippines is made up of over seven thousand [islands].
examples.cn: 菲律宾由七千多个[岛屿]组成。

words.translation: pron. 它\n[计] 信息论, 输入终端, 智能终端, 内捕获
words.definition: n the branch of engineering that deals with the use of computers and telecommunications to retrieve and store and transmit information

examples.en: The cat is hungry — please feed [it].
examples.cn: 猫饿了——请喂[它]。

examples.en: She lost her pen and couldn't find [it] anywhere.
examples.cn: 她丢了钢笔，到处找[它]都找不到。

examples.en: [It] is raining heavily outside right now.
examples.cn: 外面现在下着大雨。

examples.en: [It] is important to exercise every day.
examples.cn: 每天锻炼是很重要的。

examples.en: [It] was so exciting when our team won the match!
examples.cn: 我们队赢得比赛时[真]令人兴奋！

words.translation: pron. 它的

examples.cn: 狗看到主人时摇动了[它的]尾巴。

examples.cn: 每株植物都有[其]自己特殊的水和光需求。

examples.cn: 鸟在古老橡树高处筑起了[它的]巢。

words.translation: pron. 它本身, 它自己

examples.cn: 机器在三十分钟后会[自动]关闭。

examples.cn: 问题[本身]并不难——只是耗费时间。

words.translation: n. 夹克, 外套, 护套\nvt. 给...穿夹克, 给...装护套

n. a short coat
n. an outer wrapping or casing

examples.cn: 冬天她在校服外面穿了一件暖和的[夹克]。

examples.cn: 书的[封套]上显示着一座山的图片。

examples.cn: 她用土豆[连皮]烤制了晚餐。

words.translation: n. 一月

examples.cn: 中国新年通常在[一月]或二月。

examples.cn: 这部[日本]动画系列在全世界的孩子中很受欢迎。

words.translation: n. 工装裤, 牛仔裤
words.definition: n (usually plural) close-fitting trousers of heavy denim for manual work or casual wear\nn a coarse durable twill-weave cotton fabric

examples.en: She wore blue [jeans] and a white T-shirt to the outing.
examples.cn: 她穿着蓝色[牛仔裤]和白色T恤去郊游。

examples.en: His [jeans] had a small hole in the knee from playing football.
examples.cn: 他的[牛仔裤]膝盖处有个小洞，是踢足球时弄破的。

examples.en: [Jeans] are not allowed in the school uniform policy.
examples.cn: 校服规定不允许穿[牛仔裤]。

examples.en: She bought a new pair of [jeans] for the school trip.
examples.cn: 她为学校旅行买了一条新[牛仔裤]。

examples.en: [Jeans] are durable and comfortable for everyday wear.
examples.cn: [牛仔裤]耐穿舒适，适合日常穿着。

words.translation:
n. 工作, 零活, 职业, 事情
vi. 做零工, 打杂, 做股票经纪, 假公济私
vt. 代客买卖, 批发, 承包, 欺骗
[计] 作业
words.definition:
n. a specific piece of work required to be done as a duty or for a specific fee
n. a workplace; as in the expression "on the job"; 
n. an object worked on; a result produced by working
n. the responsibility to do something

examples.en: Her dream [job] is to become a doctor and help sick people.
examples.cn: 她梦想的[工作]是成为医生，帮助病人。

examples.en: It is every student's [job] to study hard and do their best.
examples.cn: 努力学习、尽力而为是每个学生的[职责]。

examples.en: He did a good [job] fixing the broken chair in class.
examples.cn: 他[很好地]完成了修理班级破椅子的任务。

examples.en: She applied for a summer [job] at the local bookshop.
examples.cn: 她申请了当地书店的暑期[工作]。

examples.en: It was a hard [job] to finish the project in just two days.
examples.cn: 在短短两天内完成这个项目是一项艰巨的[任务]。

words.translation:
vi. 参加, 结合, 加入
vt. 连接, 结合, 参加, 加入
n. 连接, 结合, 接合点
[计] 连接; 汇合指令
words.definition:
v. become part of; become a member of a group or organization
v. cause to become joined or linked
v. come into the company of
v. make contact or come together

examples.en: She decided to [join] the school swimming team.
examples.cn: 她决定[加入]学校游泳队。

examples.en: The bridge [joins] the two sides of the river.
examples.cn: 这座桥[连接]了河流两岸。

examples.en: Please [join] us for dinner after the school performance.
examples.cn: 学校演出结束后请[加入]我们共进晚餐。

examples.en: The two rivers [join] near the old town.
examples.cn: 这两条河在古镇附近[汇合]。

examples.en: He [joined] the library as a member to borrow more books.
examples.cn: 他[注册]成为图书馆会员以借阅更多书籍。

words.translation: n. 笑话, 玩笑, 笑柄\nv. 开玩笑, 取笑, 作弄
words.definition:
n. a humorous anecdote or remark intended to provoke laughter
n. a triviality not to be taken seriously
v. tell a joke; speak humorously
v. act in a funny or teasing way

examples.en: He told a funny [joke] that made the whole class laugh.
examples.cn: 他讲了一个有趣的[笑话]，让全班都笑了。

examples.en: She was only [joking] when she said she didn't want any cake.
examples.cn: 她说不想要蛋糕只是在[开玩笑]。

examples.en: Hiding someone's bag is not a funny [joke] — it's unkind.
examples.cn: 藏别人的包不是有趣的[恶作剧]——这是不友善的。

examples.en: When the plan failed, it became a [joke] to everyone.
examples.cn: 计划失败后，它成为了所有人的[笑柄]。

examples.sense: v. 轻描淡写；不当回事
examples.en: Don't [joke] about serious matters like people's feelings.
examples.cn: 不要把别人的感受等严肃事情当[笑话]。

words.translation: n. 欢喜, 乐事, 高兴\nvt. 使快乐, 令人高兴\nvi. 欢喜
words.definition: n. the emotion of great happiness\nn. something or someone that provides a source of happiness

examples.en: She felt great [joy] when she heard she had passed the exam.
examples.cn: 听说通过了考试，她感到非常[喜悦]。

examples.en: Reading is one of her greatest [joys] in life.
examples.cn: 阅读是她生活中最大的[乐趣]之一。

examples.sense: n. 高兴的事；令人开心的人
examples.en: The baby was a [joy] to the whole family.
examples.cn: 这个婴儿是全家的[开心果]。

examples.en: The children screamed with [joy] when they saw the snow.
examples.cn: 孩子们看到雪时[欣喜]地尖叫起来。

examples.en: She [joyed] in her success after years of hard work.
examples.cn: 经过多年努力，她[欣喜]于自己的成功。

words.translation: n. 汁, 活力, 体液\nvt. 挤出汁来, 加汁
words.definition:
n. the liquid part that can be extracted from plant or animal tissue by squeezing or cooking
n. energetic vitality
n. electric current
n. any of several liquids of the body

examples.en: She drinks a glass of orange [juice] every morning at breakfast.
examples.cn: 她每天早餐时喝一杯橙[汁]。

examples.en: The [juice] from the roasted chicken smelled wonderful.
examples.cn: 烤鸡的[肉汁]闻起来很香。

examples.en: She squeezed the lemon to get the [juice] out.
examples.cn: 她挤柠檬取出[汁液]。

examples.en: The battery has no more [juice] — please charge the phone.
examples.cn: 电池没[电]了——请给手机充电。

examples.en: Fresh [juice] is much healthier than sugary drinks.
examples.cn: 新鲜[果汁]比含糖饮料健康得多。

words.translation: n. 七月
words.definition: n. the month following June and preceding August

examples.en: The summer holiday begins in [July] and lasts two months.
examples.cn: 暑假从[七月]开始，持续两个月。

examples.en: China's national day falls on the first of [July] for some organisations.
examples.cn: 部分机构将建党节定在[七月]一日。

examples.en: [July] is usually the hottest month of the year.
examples.cn: [七月]通常是一年中最热的月份。

examples.en: She was born on the twenty-third of [July].
examples.cn: 她出生在[七月]二十三日。

examples.en: In [July], the city is full of tourists visiting the beach.
examples.cn: [七月]，城市里到处是来海滩游玩的游客。

words.translation:
n. 跳跃, 跳动, 暴涨, 惊跳
vt. 跳跃, 跃过, 突升, 使跳跃
vi. 跳跃, 跳, 跳动, 暴涨
[计] 转移, 跳转
words.definition:
n. a sudden and decisive increase
n. (film) an abrupt transition from one scene to another
n. descent with a parachute
n. the act of jumping; propelling yourself off the ground

examples.en: He [jumped] over the puddle to keep his shoes dry.
examples.cn: 他[跳]过水坑以保持鞋子干燥。

examples.en: She [jumped] when she heard the loud bang outside.
examples.cn: 听到外面的巨响，她[猛地一跳]。

examples.en: He won the long [jump] competition at the school sports day.
examples.cn: 他在学校运动日的跳远比赛中获胜。

examples.en: The temperature [jumped] from fifteen to thirty degrees in one week.
examples.cn: 气温在一周内从十五度[骤升]至三十度。

examples.en: Don't [jump] to conclusions without knowing all the facts.
examples.cn: 在不了解所有事实的情况下不要[轻易]下结论。

words.translation: n. 六月
words.definition: n. the month following May and preceding July

examples.en: The school year usually ends in [June] with graduation ceremonies.
examples.cn: 学年通常在[六月]以毕业典礼结束。

examples.en: The international exam is scheduled for the second week of [June].
examples.cn: 国际考试定于[六月]第二周举行。

examples.en: [June] brings warm weather and occasional rain.
examples.cn: [六月]带来温暖的天气和偶尔的降雨。

examples.en: The Dragon Boat Festival usually falls in [June].
examples.cn: 端午节通常在[六月]。

examples.en: Her name is [June] because she was born in that month.
examples.cn: 她叫[June]，因为她出生在那个月。

words.translation: a. 正直的, 合理的, 正确的, 应得的\nadv. 刚刚, 正好, 仅仅
words.definition:
a. used especially of what is legally or ethically right or proper or fitting
r. only a moment ago
r. absolutely
r. exactly at this moment or the moment described;

examples.en: She has [just] finished her homework and is ready for dinner.
examples.cn: 她[刚刚]完成了作业，准备吃晚饭了。

examples.en: He was [just] trying to help when he moved her bag.
examples.cn: 他移动她的包[只是]想帮忙。

examples.en: That is [just] the kind of book I was looking for.
examples.cn: 那[正是]我在寻找的那种书。

examples.en: The teacher gave a [just] punishment to the student who cheated.
examples.cn: 老师对作弊的学生给予了[公正]的惩罚。

examples.en: She [just] managed to catch the last bus home.
examples.cn: 她[勉强]赶上了最后一班回家的公共汽车。

words.translation: n. 生计, 维持, 保持\nvt. 保持, 保存, 遵守, 看守, 整理, 维持, 履行, 经营, 拘留, 记帐\nvi. 保持, 继续不断
words.definition:
n. the main tower within the walls of a medieval castle or fortress
v. keep in a certain state, position, or activity; e.g., "keep clean"
v. retain possession of
v. look after; be the keeper of; have charge of

examples.en: Please [keep] your desk tidy during the exam.
examples.cn: 考试期间请保持桌面[整洁]。

examples.en: She decided to [keep] the old letters her grandfather wrote.
examples.cn: 她决定[保留]祖父写的旧信件。

examples.en: [Keep] practising and your piano skills will improve greatly.
examples.cn: 继续[坚持]练习，你的钢琴技能会大幅提高。

examples.en: They [keep] chickens and rabbits on the farm.
examples.cn: 他们在农场[饲养]鸡和兔子。

examples.en: Always [keep] your promises — it builds trust with others.
examples.cn: 要始终[遵守]承诺——这能建立与他人的信任。

words.translation:
n. 钥匙, 键, 解答, 关键, 要害, 基调, 线索, 答案, 暗礁
vt. 调音, 锁上, 提供线索
vi. 使用钥匙
[计] 键, 密钥
words.definition:
n. metal device shaped in such a way that when it is inserted into the appropriate lock the lock's mechanism can be rotated
n. something crucial for explaining
n. pitch of the voice
n. any of 24 major or minor diatonic scales that provide the tonal framework for a piece of music

examples.en: She couldn't find her [key] and was locked out of her room.
examples.cn: 她找不到[钥匙]，被锁在房间外面了。

examples.en: Hard work is the [key] to success in any subject.
examples.cn: 努力是任何科目取得成功的[关键]。

examples.en: She played a [key] role in organising the school concert.
examples.cn: 她在组织学校音乐会中扮演了[关键]角色。

examples.en: The teacher handed out the answer [key] after the test.
examples.cn: 测试后老师发了[答案]表。

examples.en: She pressed the wrong [key] on the piano and laughed.
examples.cn: 她按错了钢琴的[琴键]，然后笑了起来。

words.translation: n. 键盘\n[计] 键盘
words.definition: n. device consisting of a set of keys on a piano or organ or typewriter or typesetting machine or computer or the like\nn. holder consisting of an arrangement of hooks on which keys or locks can be hung

examples.en: She types very fast on the computer [keyboard].
examples.cn: 她在电脑[键盘]上打字非常快。

examples.en: He plays [keyboard] in the school band every Friday.
examples.cn: 他每周五在学校乐队里弹奏[键盘乐器]。

examples.en: The [keyboard] of a standard piano has eighty-eight keys.
examples.cn: 标准钢琴的[琴键]有八十八个键。

examples.en: She bought a portable [keyboard] to practise music at home.
examples.cn: 她买了一个便携式[电子琴]在家练习音乐。

examples.en: Learning proper [keyboard] skills helps students work faster.
examples.cn: 学习正确的[键盘]操作技能帮助学生更快地工作。

words.translation: n. 踢, 反冲, 后座力, 凹底\nvi. 踢, 反抗, 反冲\nvt. 踢, 反冲
words.definition:
n. the act of delivering a blow with the foot
n. the sudden stimulation provided by strong drink (or certain drugs)
n. a rhythmic thrusting movement of the legs as in swimming or calisthenics
v. drive or propel with the foot

examples.en: He [kicked] the ball hard and it went straight into the goal.
examples.cn: 他用力[踢]球，球直接进了球门。

examples.en: She accidentally [kicked] her bag under the desk.
examples.cn: 她不小心把包[踢]到了桌子下面。

examples.en: He gave the ball a strong [kick] towards the goal.
examples.cn: 他朝球门方向给球一脚有力的[踢]。

examples.en: She gets a real [kick] out of solving difficult maths problems.
examples.cn: 解决难题让她感到真正的[兴奋]。

examples.en: He is trying to [kick] the habit of staying up too late.
examples.cn: 他正在努力[戒掉]熬夜太晚的习惯。

words.translation: n. 小山羊, 小山羊肉, 小孩, 欺骗\na. 小山羊皮制的\nv. 哄骗, 嘲弄
words.definition: n. soft smooth leather from the hide of a young goat\nn. young goat\nv. be silly or tease one another

examples.en: The [kids] in the neighbourhood love playing in the park.
examples.cn: 街区里的[孩子们]喜欢在公园玩耍。

examples.en: He was just [kidding] when he said he failed the test.
examples.cn: 他说自己考试不及格只是在[开玩笑]。

examples.en: The baby goat is called a [kid].
examples.cn: 小山羊叫做[羊羔]。

examples.en: When I was a [kid], I wanted to become an astronaut.
examples.cn: 当我还是个[孩子]时，我想成为宇航员。

examples.en: Don't try to [kid] me — I know you ate my sandwich!
examples.cn: 别想[骗]我——我知道你吃了我的三明治！

words.translation:
n. 杀, 杀戮, 小河
vt. 杀, 破坏, 消灭, 使终止, 抵消, 否决
vi. 杀死
[计] 删除
words.definition:
n. the destruction of an enemy plane or ship or tank or missile
v. cause to die; put to death, usually intentionally or knowingly
v. thwart the passage of
v. be fatal

examples.en: The strong pesticide [killed] all the insects in the garden.
examples.cn: 强力农药[杀死]了花园里所有的昆虫。

examples.en: The antibiotics [killed] the bacteria causing the infection.
examples.cn: 抗生素[消灭]了引起感染的细菌。

examples.en: She read a magazine to [kill] time before the flight.
examples.cn: 她在飞机起飞前阅读杂志来[打发]时间。

examples.en: My feet are [killing] me after walking all day.
examples.cn: 走了一整天，我的脚[痛死]了。

examples.en: The director decided to [kill] the project due to lack of funding.
examples.cn: 由于缺乏资金，导演决定[终止]这个项目。

words.translation: n. 千\n[计] 千
words.definition: n one thousand grams; the basic unit of mass adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites

examples.sense: n. 千克；公斤（口语缩写）
examples.en: She bought two [kilos] of apples at the market.
examples.cn: 她在市场上买了两[公斤]苹果。

examples.en: The baby weighed three [kilos] when it was born.
examples.cn: 婴儿出生时重三[公斤]。

examples.en: A [kilo]metre is one thousand metres.
examples.cn: 一[千]米等于一千米。

examples.en: She lost two [kilos] after exercising for a month.
examples.cn: 锻炼了一个月后，她减了两[公斤]。

examples.en: The butcher sold the meat for fifty yuan per [kilo].
examples.cn: 屠夫以每[公斤]五十元的价格出售肉。

words.translation: n. 千克, 公斤\n[医] 千克, 公斤
words.definition: n. one thousand grams; the basic unit of mass adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites

examples.en: One [kilogram] is equal to one thousand grams.
examples.cn: 一[千克]等于一千克。

examples.en: The doctor said he needed to gain two [kilograms].
examples.cn: 医生说他需要增重两[千克]。

examples.en: She asked for half a [kilogram] of strawberries at the market.
examples.cn: 她在市场上要了半[千克]草莓。

examples.en: The mass of the object was recorded as five [kilograms].
examples.cn: 该物体的质量被记录为五[千克]。

examples.en: The recipe requires one [kilogram] of flour to make the bread.
examples.cn: 食谱需要一[千克]面粉来制作面包。

words.translation: n. 公里, 千米
words.definition: n a metric unit of length equal to 1000 meters (or 0.621371 miles)

examples.en: The school is about two [kilometres] from my home.
examples.cn: 学校距我家约两[公里]。

examples.en: She ran ten [kilometres] in the school charity race.
examples.cn: 她在学校慈善赛跑中跑了十[公里]。

examples.en: The Great Wall stretches for thousands of [kilometres].
examples.cn: 长城绵延数千[公里]。

examples.en: The bus travels about fifty [kilometres] every hour on the highway.
examples.cn: 公共汽车在高速公路上每小时行驶约五十[公里]。

examples.en: Light travels about three hundred thousand [kilometres] per second.
examples.cn: 光每秒传播约三十万[公里]。

words.translation: n. 种类, 性质, 方式\na. 亲切的, 仁慈的, 和蔼的
words.definition:
n. a category of things distinguished by some common characteristic or quality
a. having or showing a tender and considerate and helpful nature; used especially of persons and their behavior
s. agreeable, conducive to comfort
s. tolerant and forgiving under provocation

examples.en: She was very [kind] to help the new student find the classroom.
examples.cn: 她帮新同学找到教室，非常[善良]。

examples.en: What [kind] of music do you enjoy listening to?
examples.cn: 你喜欢听什么[种类]的音乐？

examples.en: The teacher was [kind] and patient with all her students.
examples.cn: 老师对所有学生都[友善]和耐心。

examples.en: Problems of this [kind] require careful thinking.
examples.cn: 这[类]问题需要仔细思考。

examples.sense: adv. 有点；某种程度上（kind of）
examples.en: That was [kind of] a difficult question, wasn't it?
examples.cn: 那道题[有点]难，不是吗？

words.translation: n. 国王, 君主\nvt. 使...成为君主\nvi. 君临, 统治
words.definition:
n. a male sovereign; ruler of a kingdom
n. a competitor who holds a preeminent position
n. preeminence in a particular category or group or field
n. United States woman tennis player (born in 1943)

examples.en: The [king] made laws to protect his people from harm.
examples.cn: [国王]制定法律保护人民免受伤害。

examples.en: Protect your [king] or the game will be over.
examples.cn: 保护好你的[王]棋，否则游戏就结束了。

examples.en: The lion is called the [king] of the jungle.
examples.cn: 狮子被称为丛林之[王]。

examples.en: She drew the [king] of hearts from the deck of cards.
examples.cn: 她从牌组里抽出了红心[K]。

examples.en: He is considered the [king] of table tennis in his school.
examples.cn: 他被认为是学校乒乓球[王者]。

words.translation: n. 吻\nvt. 吻\nvi. 接吻
words.definition:
n. the act of caressing with the lips (or an instance thereof)
n. a cookie made of egg whites and sugar
n. any of several bite-sized candies
n. a light glancing touch

examples.en: She [kissed] her grandmother on the cheek as a greeting.
examples.cn: 她[亲吻]祖母的脸颊作为问候。

examples.en: The mother gave her child a [kiss] before he went to school.
examples.cn: 母亲在孩子上学前给了他一个[吻]。

examples.en: The breeze gently [kissed] her face as she walked outside.
examples.cn: 微风轻轻[抚摸]她在外面行走时的脸。

examples.en: She unwrapped a chocolate [kiss] from the bag.
examples.cn: 她从袋子里拿出一块巧克力[糖]。

examples.en: He [kissed] his parents goodbye at the airport.
examples.cn: 他在机场[亲吻]父母道别。

words.translation: n. 厨房, 全套炊具\n[医] 厨房
words.definition: n. a room equipped for preparing meals

examples.en: She helped her mother prepare dinner in the [kitchen].
examples.cn: 她在[厨房]帮母亲准备晚餐。

examples.en: Please put the dirty dishes in the [kitchen] sink.
examples.cn: 请把脏碗碟放在[厨房]水槽里。

examples.en: The school [kitchen] produces meals for five hundred students daily.
examples.cn: 学校[厨房]每天为五百名学生提供餐食。

examples.en: A well-organised [kitchen] makes cooking much easier.
examples.cn: 整理有序的[厨房]让烹饪变得容易许多。

examples.en: The smell of fresh bread from the [kitchen] filled the house.
examples.cn: [厨房]里新鲜面包的香味充满了整个房子。

words.translation: n. 风筝, 筝帆, 空头支票, 骗子\nvi. 象风筝一样飞, 轻快地移动, 使用空头支票\nvt. 使上升, 骗钱
words.definition:

examples.cn: 报纸[头版]文章讨论了教育改革。

words.translation: n. 叶, 树叶, 花瓣, 页\nvi. 生叶, 翻书页\nvt. 在...上长叶, 翻...的页
words.definition:
n. the main organ of photosynthesis and transpiration in higher plants
n. a sheet of any written or printed material (especially in a manuscript or book)
n. hinged or detachable flat section (as of a table or door)
v. turn over pages

examples.en: A dry [leaf] fell from the tree and landed on her book.
examples.cn: 一片干[叶子]从树上落下，落在她的书上。

examples.en: She turned each [leaf] of the old photo album carefully.
examples.cn: 她小心地翻阅旧相册的每一[页]。

examples.en: He [leafed] through the magazine while waiting for class.
examples.cn: 他在等待上课时[翻阅]了杂志。

examples.en: The [leaf] uses sunlight to make food for the plant.
examples.cn: [叶片]利用阳光为植物制造食物。

examples.en: The book cover was decorated with gold [leaf].
examples.cn: 书封面用金[箔]装饰。

words.translation: vt. 学习；认识到；得知
words.definition: v. gain knowledge or skills\nv. get to know or become aware of, usually accidentally\nv. be a student of a certain subject

examples.en: She works hard every day to [learn] new English vocabulary.
examples.cn: 她每天努力[学习]新的英语词汇。

examples.en: He was surprised to [learn] that his friend had won the prize.
examples.cn: 他得知朋友获奖时感到惊讶。

examples.en: Students must [learn] the multiplication table by heart.
examples.cn: 学生必须[记住]乘法表。

examples.en: We should [learn] from our mistakes and not repeat them.
examples.cn: 我们应该从错误中[吸取教训]，不要重蹈覆辙。

examples.en: It takes time to [learn] how to write Chinese characters beautifully.
examples.cn: 需要时间来[学会]如何写出漂亮的汉字。

words.translation: n. 最少, 最小, 最小限度\na. 最少的, 最小的\nadv. 最小, 最少
words.definition: n. something that is of no importance\na. the superlative of `little' that can be used with mass nouns and is usually preceded by `the'; a quantifier meaning smallest in amount or extent or degree\nr. used to form the superlative

examples.en: She ate the [least] amount of food at dinner because she was tired.
examples.cn: 她在晚餐时吃得[最少]，因为她累了。

examples.en: That was the [least] he could do to help his classmate.
examples.cn: 那是他能为同学做的[最少]的事情了。

examples.en: Spelling was the [least] of his worries before the big exam.
examples.cn: 在大考前，拼写是他[最不担心]的事情。

examples.en: You should drink at [least] eight glasses of water a day.
examples.cn: 你每天[至少]应该喝八杯水。

examples.en: She spoke the [least] during the group discussion.
examples.cn: 她在小组讨论中说话[最少]。

words.translation: n. 许可, 告别, 请假, 休假\nvt. 离开, 剩下, 遗忘, 委托, 丢弃\nvi. 出发, 离开, 生叶
words.definition:
n. the period of time during which you are absent from work or duty
n. permission to do something
v. go away from a place
v. go and leave behind, either intentionally or by neglect or forgetfulness

examples.en: She [leaves] for school at seven o'clock every morning.
examples.cn: 她每天早上七点[离开]去上学。

examples.en: He [left] his umbrella on the bus this morning.
examples.cn: 他今天早上把雨伞[留]在了公共汽车上。

examples.en: [Leave] those books on the shelf — I'll need them later.
examples.cn: 把那些书[留]在书架上——我以后会用到。

examples.en: The teacher applied for two days of sick [leave].
examples.cn: 老师申请了两天病[假]。

examples.en: She [left] all her books to the school library when she retired.
examples.cn: 她退休时把所有书[留给]了学校图书馆。

words.translation:

adv. 在左面
n. 左, 左面, 左派
leave的过去式和过去分词
words.definition:
n. location near or direction toward the left side; i.e. the side to the north when a person or object faces east
n. those who support varying degrees of social or political or economic change designed to promote the public welfare
n. the hand that is on the left side of the body
n. a turn toward the side of the body that is on the north when the person is facing east

examples.en: Turn [left] at the traffic lights to find the school.
examples.cn: 在交通灯处向[左]转就能找到学校。

examples.en: There are only three questions [left] on the exam paper.
examples.cn: 试卷上只[剩下]三道题了。

examples.en: Please sit on the [left] side of the classroom today.
examples.cn: 今天请坐在教室的[左]侧。

examples.en: She [left] her notebook at home by mistake.
examples.cn: 她不小心把笔记本[留]在了家里。

examples.en: The [left] wing of the party supports more equal education policies.
examples.cn: 该党的[左]翼支持更平等的教育政策。

words.translation: n. 腿, 假腿, 路程\nvi. 走, 跑
words.definition:
n. a human limb; commonly used to refer to a whole limb but technically only the part of the limb between the knee and ankle
n. a structure in animals that is similar to a human leg and used for locomotion
n. one of the supports for a piece of furniture
n. the limb of an animal used for food

examples.en: He hurt his [leg] during the football match and had to rest.
examples.cn: 他在足球比赛中伤了[腿]，不得不休息。

examples.en: One [leg] of the old table was broken and needed fixing.
examples.cn: 旧桌子的一条[腿]坏了，需要修理。

examples.en: The first [leg] of the journey was from Beijing to Shanghai.
examples.cn: 旅程的第一[段]是从北京到上海。

examples.en: She rolled up the [legs] of her trousers before paddling.
examples.cn: 她在涉水前卷起了裤[腿]。

examples.en: Our team won the first [leg] of the relay race.
examples.cn: 我们队赢得了接力赛的第一[棒]。

words.translation: n. 柠檬水\n[医] 柠檬水
words.definition: n. sweetened beverage of diluted lemon juice

examples.en: She made fresh [lemonade] with lemons from the garden.
examples.cn: 她用花园里的柠檬做了新鲜的[柠檬水]。

examples.cn: 冰镇[柠檬水]是炎热夏日里的清凉饮品。

examples.en: He bought a bottle of [lemonade] from the school canteen.
examples.cn: 他从学校食堂买了一瓶[柠檬水]。

examples.en: The children sold [lemonade] to raise money for charity.
examples.cn: 孩子们卖[柠檬水]为慈善事业筹款。

examples.en: The restaurant offered [lemonade] as a non-alcoholic drink option.
examples.cn: 餐厅提供[柠檬水]作为非酒精饮品选项。

words.translation: vt. 借, 贷款给, 增添, 提供, 出租\nvi. 贷款
words.definition: v. bestow a quality on\nv. give temporarily; let have for a limited time\nv. have certain characteristics of qualities for something; be open or vulnerable to

examples.en: Can you [lend] me your pen? Mine has run out of ink.
examples.cn: 你能把你的笔[借]给我吗？我的墨水用完了。

examples.en: She [lent] her support to the school environmental project.
examples.cn: 她为学校环保项目[提供]了支持。

examples.en: The colourful decorations [lend] the hall a festive atmosphere.
examples.cn: 五彩缤纷的装饰[赋予]大厅节日气氛。

examples.en: He [lent] his jacket to his friend who felt cold.
examples.cn: 他把外套[借]给感觉冷的朋友。

examples.en: The bank agreed to [lend] money to build the new library.
examples.cn: 银行同意[贷款]给建造新图书馆的项目。

words.translation: n. 课, 课业, 教训
words.definition: n. a unit of instruction\nn. a task assigned for individual study

examples.en: The English [lesson] starts at eight o'clock every morning.
examples.cn: 英语[课]每天早上八点开始。

examples.en: Failing the test taught him a valuable [lesson] about preparation.
examples.cn: 考试失败给他上了一堂关于准备的宝贵[教训]。

examples.en: Today's [lesson] is about the water cycle in science.
examples.cn: 今天的[课]讲的是科学中的水循环。

examples.en: She has piano [lessons] every Wednesday after school.
examples.cn: 她每周三放学后上钢琴[课]。

examples.sense: n. 有教育意义的经历
examples.en: The difficult project was a [lesson] in teamwork and patience.
examples.cn: 这个艰难的项目是一堂关于团队合作和耐心的[课]。

words.translation: vt. 让, 假设, 出租, 排放, 妨碍\nvi. 出租, 被承包\nn. 出租屋, 障碍
words.definition:
n. a serve that strikes the net before falling into the receiver's court; the ball must be served again
v. make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen
v. actively cause something to happen
v. leave unchanged

examples.cn: 老师[让]学生在考试结束后提前离开。

examples.cn: 他们把空余的房间[出租]给一名大学生。

examples.cn: 如果你需要帮助做作业，请[让]我知道。

examples.cn: [让]我们明天早上七点在校门口见面。

examples.en: Don't [let] small problems grow into big ones.
examples.cn: 不要[让]小问题变成大问题。

words.translation:
n. 信, 字母, 证书, 字面意义, 铅字, 学问, 出租人

words.definition:
n. a written message addressed to a person or organization
n. the conventional characters of the alphabet used to represent speech
n. owner who lets another person use something (housing usually) for hire
n. a strictly literal interpretation (as distinct from the intention)

examples.cn: 她给她在澳大利亚的笔友写了一封[信]。

examples.cn: 英文字母表有二十六个[字母]。

examples.cn: 学校向家长发送了一封关于新时间表的[信件]。

examples.sense: n. 文字；原文（to the letter）

examples.cn: 他按[字面]严格遵照了老师的指示。

examples.sense: n. 校队荣誉字母（美式）
examples.en: She earned her school [letter] for outstanding athletic performance.
examples.cn: 她因出色的运动表现而获得了学校的荣誉[字母]徽章。

words.translation:
n. 水平, 水准, 平地
a. 同高的, 平坦的, 齐平的, 水平的
vt. 弄平, 夷平, 使同等, 瞄准, 对准
vi. 变平, 拉平
[计] 级别
words.definition:
n. height above ground
n. indicator that establishes the horizontal when a bubble is centered in a tube of liquid
n. an abstract place usually conceived as having depth
v. aim at

examples.en: Her English [level] has improved a lot this year.
examples.cn: 她今年的英语[水平]有了很大提高。

examples.cn: 图书馆在学校大楼的第二[层]。

examples.cn: 建造新教室之前地面必须是[平坦]的。

examples.en: Workers [levelled] the ground before laying the sports court.
examples.cn: 工人们在铺设运动场之前[整平]了地面。

words.translation: n. 图书馆, 藏书, 库\n[计] 库

n. a room where books are kept
n. a collection of literary documents or records kept for reference or borrowing

examples.cn: 她每周从学校[图书馆]借两本书。

examples.cn: 他的祖父家里有一个大型私人[藏书室]。

examples.cn: 学校[图书馆]有各科数千册书籍。

examples.en: The city [library] opens early on weekday mornings.
examples.cn: 城市[图书馆]工作日早晨早早开门。

examples.cn: 她使用在线[图书馆]获取电子书和期刊。

words.translation: n. 执照, 许可证, 特许\nvt. 许可, 特许

n. a legal document giving official permission to do something

n. the act of giving a formal (usually written) authorization

examples.cn: 在公共道路上开车需要[驾照]。

examples.en: The restaurant applied for a [license] to sell food.
examples.cn: 餐厅申请了销售食品的[营业执照]。

examples.en: She passed the test and got her teaching [license].
examples.cn: 她通过了考试并获得了教学[资格证书]。

examples.en: The government [licensed] the company to produce medicine.
examples.cn: 政府[授权]该公司生产药品。

examples.en: Artistic [license] allows writers to change facts in fiction.
examples.cn: 艺术[自由]允许作家在虚构中改变事实。

words.translation: n. 谎言, 假象, 位置\nvi. 躺着, 说谎, 位于, 展现, 存在, 停泊\nvt. 谎骗
words.definition:
n. a statement that deviates from or perverts the truth
n. Norwegian diplomat who was the first Secretary General of the United Nations (1896-1968)
n. position or manner in which something is situated
v. be located or situated somewhere; occupy a certain position

examples.en: She [lay] on the grass and looked up at the stars.
examples.cn: 她[躺]在草地上仰望星空。

examples.en: It is wrong to [lie] even when the truth is difficult.
examples.cn: 即使真相很难说，[撒谎]也是不对的。

examples.en: He told a [lie] to avoid getting into trouble.
examples.cn: 他撒了一个[谎]以避免惹麻烦。

examples.cn: 学校[坐落]在一座缓坡的底部。

examples.cn: 问题的答案[在于]仔细阅读。

words.definition:

examples.cn: 饮食均衡和锻炼对健康的[生活]很重要。

examples.en: The doctor worked hard to save the patient's [life].
examples.cn: 医生努力拯救病人的[生命]。

examples.en: He spent his whole [life] devoted to teaching children.
examples.cn: 他[一生]都致力于教育儿童。

examples.en: She brought new [life] to the school drama club.
examples.cn: 她给学校戏剧俱乐部带来了新的[活力]。

examples.en: Scientists discovered signs of [life] in the deep ocean.
examples.cn: 科学家在深海发现了[生命]的迹象。

words.translation: n. 举起, 帮助, 昂扬, 电梯\nvt. 升高, 提高, 鼓舞, 清偿, 空运, 举起, 剽窃\nvi. 升起, 消散, 耸立

n. the act of giving temporary assistance
n. a wave that lifts the surface of the water or ground

n. one of the layers forming the heel of a shoe or boot

examples.en: He [lifted] the heavy box and put it on the shelf.
examples.cn: 他[举起]沉重的箱子放到书架上。

examples.cn: 她乘[电梯]到建筑的第五层。

examples.en: Her kind words [lifted] his spirits after the disappointing result.
examples.cn: 她善意的话语在他失望的结果后[鼓舞]了他的精神。

examples.en: Could you give me a [lift] to the train station?
examples.cn: 你能[送]我一程到火车站吗？

examples.en: The fog [lifted] by ten o'clock and the sun came out.
examples.cn: 雾在十点钟[消散]，太阳出来了。

words.translation:
n. 光, 光亮, 灯, 日光, 发光体, 光源, 杰出人物, 火花, 眼光
a. 轻的, 少量的, 轻微的, 轻快的, 轻浮的, 明亮的, 淡色的, 容易的
vt. 点燃, 照亮
vi. 点着, 变亮, 突降, 偶然碰到
adv. 轻地
words.definition:
n. (physics) electromagnetic radiation that can produce a visual sensation
n. any device serving as a source of illumination
n. a particular perspective or aspect of a situation
n. an illuminated area

examples.en: She opened the curtains to let the morning [light] in.
examples.cn: 她拉开窗帘让早晨的[光线]照进来。

examples.en: The school bag was [light] because she only had one book.
examples.cn: 书包很[轻]，因为她只带了一本书。

examples.cn: 他点燃了生日蛋糕上的蜡烛。

examples.en: She painted her bedroom wall a [light] blue colour.
examples.cn: 她把卧室墙壁涂成[浅]蓝色。

examples.en: We stopped at the red [light] and waited for it to turn green.
examples.cn: 我们在红[灯]处停下，等待变绿灯。

words.translation:

n. 爱好, 同样的人(或物)
prep. 象, 如同
adv. 可能

n. a similar kind
n. a kind of person
v. find enjoyable or agreeable
v. be fond of

examples.cn: 她在空闲时间[喜欢]阅读冒险故事。

words.translation:

examples.en: She memorised all her [lines] for the school play.
examples.cn: 她把学校话剧的所有[台词]都记住了。

examples.en: The metro [line] connects the school to the city centre.

words.translation:
