words.definition:
n. a database containing an ordered array of items (names or topics)
v. give or make a list of; name individually; give the names of
v. include in a list
v. cause to lean to the side

examples.en: The teacher read out the [list] of students who had passed.
examples.cn: 老师念出了通过考试的学生[名单]。

examples.en: Please [list] three reasons why you want to join the club.
examples.cn: 请[列出]你想加入俱乐部的三个原因。

examples.en: She checked the shopping [list] before going to the supermarket.
examples.cn: 她去超市之前检查了购物[清单]。

examples.en: He made a [list] of everything he needed to do before the exam.
examples.cn: 他列了一份考试前需要做的所有事情的[清单]。

examples.en: The school [lists] all club activities on the notice board.
examples.cn: 学校在公告栏上[列出]所有俱乐部活动。

words.translation: vi. 听, 倾听, 听从\nn. 听, 倾听
words.definition: v. hear with intention\nv. listen and pay attention

examples.en: Please [listen] carefully when the teacher explains the rules.
examples.cn: 老师解释规则时请仔细[听]。

examples.en: She [listened] to the music with her eyes closed.
examples.cn: 她闭着眼睛[聆听]音乐。

examples.en: He should [listen] to his parents' advice more often.
examples.cn: 他应该更多地[听从]父母的建议。

examples.en: They [listened] to the news on the radio every morning.
examples.cn: 他们每天早上[收听]收音机上的新闻。

examples.en: She [listened] carefully and understood the teacher's explanation.
examples.cn: 她仔细[聆听]并理解了老师的解释。

words.translation: n. 垃圾, 杂乱, 轿, 担架\nvt. 乱丢, 铺草, 弄乱\nvi. 产仔, 乱丢垃圾
words.definition:
n. the offspring at one birth of a multiparous mammal
n. rubbish carelessly dropped or left about (especially in public places)
n. conveyance consisting of a chair or bed carried on two poles by bearers
v. strew

examples.en: Students must not drop [litter] in the school playground.
examples.cn: 学生不得在学校操场乱扔[垃圾]。

examples.en: Don't [litter] the street — use the rubbish bin.
examples.cn: 不要在街上乱[扔垃圾]——使用垃圾桶。

examples.en: The cat gave birth to a [litter] of five kittens.
examples.cn: 猫生了一[窝]五只小猫。

examples.en: Dead [litter] on the forest floor helps the soil stay healthy.
examples.cn: 森林地面的枯[叶层]有助于保持土壤健康。

examples.en: The injured player was carried off the field on a [litter].
examples.cn: 受伤的球员被抬上[担架]离开球场。

words.translation: n. 一点点, 少许, 一会儿, 短时间\na. 小的, 很少的, 幼小的, 琐碎的, 短暂的, 矮小的\nadv. 很少, 稍微, 完全不
words.definition:
n. a small amount or duration
a. (quantifier used with mass nouns) small in quantity or degree; not much or almost none or (with `a') at least some
s. (of children and animals) young, immature
s. (of a voice) faint

examples.en: A [little] bird sat on the branch outside the classroom window.
examples.cn: 一只[小]鸟坐在教室窗外的树枝上。

examples.en: There is very [little] time left, so we need to hurry.
examples.cn: 剩下的时间[很少]了，所以我们需要赶紧。

examples.en: She slept [little] the night before the big exam.
examples.cn: 重要考试前一晚她[几乎没]睡觉。

examples.en: Could I have a [little] more soup, please?
examples.cn: 请问我可以再来[一点]汤吗？

examples.en: The new student felt a [little] nervous on his first day.
examples.cn: 新同学第一天[有点]紧张。

words.translation:
a. 活的, 生动的, 精力充沛的, 实况转播的
vi. 活, 生存, 居住
vt. 过着, 度过, 经历
adv. 实况地
words.definition:
v. lead a certain kind of life; live in a certain style
v. pursue a positive and satisfying existence
a. actually being performed at the time of hearing or viewing
a. exerting force or containing energy

examples.en: My grandparents [live] in a small village near the mountains.
examples.cn: 我的祖父母[居住]在山附近的一个小村庄。

examples.en: The old tree has [lived] for over five hundred years.
examples.cn: 这棵老树已经[存活]了五百多年。

examples.en: We watched a [live] concert on television last night.
examples.cn: 我们昨晚在电视上观看了[现场]音乐会。

examples.en: The science lesson used [live] insects to show how they move.
examples.cn: 科学课用[活]昆虫来展示它们的运动方式。

examples.en: He hopes to [live] a healthy life by eating well and exercising.
examples.cn: 他希望通过好好饮食和锻炼来[过]健康的生活。

words.translation: a. 活泼的, 鲜明的, 生动的
words.definition: a. full of life and energy\ns. full of zest or vigor\ns. filled with events or activity

examples.en: The [lively] puppy jumped around the yard all afternoon.
examples.cn: 那只[活泼的]小狗整个下午都在院子里跳来跳去。

examples.sense: adj. 热闹的；充满活力的
examples.en: The market was [lively] with music, laughter, and colourful stalls.
examples.cn: 市场上音乐、笑声和彩色摊位让气氛[热闹]非凡。

examples.en: The teacher used [lively] examples to make the lesson more interesting.
examples.cn: 老师用[生动]的例子使课程更有趣。

examples.en: She wore a [lively] red dress to the school party.
examples.cn: 她穿着一件[鲜艳]的红色连衣裙去参加学校派对。

examples.sense: adj. 积极的；富有朝气的
examples.en: The class had a [lively] debate about protecting the environment.
examples.cn: 班级就保护环境进行了[积极]的辩论。

words.translation: n. 锁, 刹车, 水闸, 一缕头发\nvt. 锁, 锁上, 拘禁, 隐藏, (用锁等)拴住, 刹住\nvi. 锁住, (齿轮等)啮合, (船)过闸
words.definition:
n. a fastener fitted to a door or drawer to keep it firmly closed
n. a strand or cluster of hair
n. a mechanism that detonates the charge of a gun
n. enclosure consisting of a section of canal that can be closed to control the water level; used to raise or lower vessels that pass through it

examples.en: Remember to [lock] the door before you leave the house.
examples.cn: 离开房子前记得[锁]上门。

examples.en: The old [lock] on the gate was rusty and hard to open.
examples.cn: 大门上的旧[锁]生锈了，很难打开。

examples.en: He [locked] his bicycle to the fence outside the library.
examples.cn: 他把自行车[锁]在图书馆外的栅栏上。

examples.en: A [lock] of her hair fell across her face in the breeze.
examples.cn: 微风中，一[绺]头发飘落在她脸上。

examples.en: The two wrestlers [locked] arms and struggled for balance.
examples.cn: 两名摔跤手[紧握]双臂，努力保持平衡。

words.translation: n. 伦敦
words.definition: n. the capital and largest city of England; located on the Thames in southeastern England; financial and industrial and cultural center\nn. United States writer of novels based on experiences in the Klondike gold rush (1876-1916)

examples.en: [London] is famous for its red double-decker buses and Big Ben.
examples.cn: [伦敦]以红色双层巴士和大本钟而闻名。

examples.en: My family visited [London] last summer and toured the British Museum.
examples.cn: 我的家人去年夏天参观了[伦敦]，游览了大英博物馆。

examples.en: [London] has been a major city for over two thousand years.
examples.cn: [伦敦]作为主要城市已有两千多年历史。

examples.en: Many world-class theatres and galleries are found in [London].
examples.cn: 许多世界级的剧院和画廊都位于[伦敦]。

examples.en: [London] stands on the River Thames in southeast England.
examples.cn: [伦敦]位于英格兰东南部泰晤士河畔。

words.translation: a. 孤单的, 孤寂的, 荒凉的
words.definition: s. marked by dejection from being alone\ns. devoid of creatures

examples.en: She felt very [lonely] after moving to a new city without any friends.
examples.cn: 搬到一个没有朋友的新城市后，她感到非常[孤独]。

examples.en: The farmhouse stood on a [lonely] hill far from the nearest town.
examples.cn: 农舍孤零零地立在远离最近城镇的[偏僻]山丘上。

examples.en: The [lonely] old man sat on the park bench feeding the pigeons every day.
examples.cn: 那位[孤单]的老人每天坐在公园长椅上喂鸽子。

examples.en: Rainy Sunday afternoons can feel [lonely] when there is nothing to do.
examples.cn: 下雨的周日下午无事可做时会感到[孤寂]。

examples.en: The new student looked [lonely] until her classmates invited her to join them.
examples.cn: 新同学看起来[孤独]，直到同学们邀请她加入他们。

words.translation:
a. 长的, 长久的, 冗长的, 做多头的
vi. 渴望, 热望, 极想
adv. 长久, 始终
n. 长时间, 长信号, 长整型
[计] 长, 长整型
words.definition:
a. primarily temporal sense; being or indicating a relatively great or greater than average duration or passage of time or a duration as specified
a. primarily spatial sense; of relatively great or greater than average spatial extension or extension as specified
s. of relatively great height
a. holding securities or commodities in expectation of a rise in prices

examples.en: It was a [long] journey, so we brought snacks for the road.
examples.cn: 这是一段[漫长]的旅程，所以我们带了路上吃的零食。

examples.en: We had a [long] discussion about how to improve the school canteen.
examples.cn: 我们就如何改善学校食堂进行了[长时间]的讨论。

examples.en: How [long] have you been studying English?
examples.cn: 你学英语多[久]了？

examples.en: She [longed] to see her best friend again after the summer break.
examples.cn: 暑假后她[渴望]再次见到她最好的朋友。

examples.en: The explorer had a [long] way to go before reaching the summit.
examples.cn: 探险家在到达山顶之前还有[很远]的路要走。

words.translation: n. 一看, 神色, 样子, 面容\nvi. 看, 注意, 朝着, 显得\nvt. 打量, 看上去与...一样, 以眼色(或脸色)显示, 期待
words.definition:
n. the act of directing the eyes toward something and perceiving it visually
n. physical appearance
v. perceive with attention; direct one's gaze towards
v. give a certain impression or have a certain outward aspect

examples.en: [Look] at the blackboard and copy down the homework.
examples.cn: [看]黑板，把作业抄下来。

examples.en: You [look] tired today — did you sleep well last night?
examples.cn: 你今天[看起来]很疲倦——昨晚睡得好吗？

examples.en: I've been [looking] for my keys everywhere but can't find them.
examples.cn: 我到处[找]我的钥匙，但找不到。

examples.en: The new classroom has a fresh, modern [look] after the renovation.
examples.cn: 翻新后，新教室有了清新、现代的[外观]。

examples.en: The hotel room [looks] out onto a beautiful garden.
examples.cn: 酒店房间[朝向]一个美丽的花园。

words.translation: vt. 遗失, 损失, 丢失, 使失去, 错过, 浪费, 迷失, 使迷路, 输去, 使沉溺于\nvi. 受损失, 失败
words.definition:
v. fail to keep or to maintain; cease to have, either physically or in an abstract sense
v. fail to win
v. suffer the loss of a person through death or removal
v. miss from one's possessions; lose sight of

examples.en: Be careful not to [lose] your student ID card at school.
examples.cn: 注意不要在学校[丢失]你的学生证。

examples.en: Our football team [lost] the match by two goals yesterday.
examples.cn: 我们的足球队昨天以两球之差[输掉]了比赛。

examples.en: She did not want to [lose] the trust of her classmates.
examples.cn: 她不想[失去]同学们的信任。

examples.en: The doctor advised him to [lose] some weight through exercise.
examples.cn: 医生建议他通过锻炼来[减轻]体重。

examples.en: We [lost] our way in the forest and had to use a map.
examples.cn: 我们在森林里[迷路]了，不得不使用地图。

words.translation: n. 运气, 签, 抽签, 份额, 许多, 一堆\nvt. 划分\nvi. 抽签, 抓阄
words.definition: n. a parcel of land having fixed boundaries\nn. (Old Testament) nephew of Abraham; God destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah but chose to spare Lot and his family who were told to flee without looking back at the destruction\nv. divide into lots, as of land, for example

examples.en: There is a [lot] of homework this week because of the upcoming exam.
examples.cn: 因为即将到来的考试，这周有[大量]作业。

examples.en: The teacher divided the books into three [lots] for different groups.
examples.cn: 老师把书分成三[批]分给不同的小组。

examples.en: He accepted his [lot] in life and worked hard to improve it.
examples.cn: 他接受了自己的[命运]，并努力改变它。

examples.en: There is a large parking [lot] behind the shopping centre.
examples.cn: 购物中心后面有一个大[停车场]。

examples.en: She likes reading a [lot] and spends most evenings with a book.
examples.cn: 她[非常]喜欢阅读，大多数晚上都捧着一本书。

words.translation: a. 大声的, 不断的, 喧吵的\nadv. 高声地, 大声地
words.definition: a. characterized by or producing sound of great volume or intensity

examples.en: Please do not play [loud] music in the library — others are studying.
examples.cn: 请不要在图书馆播放[响亮]的音乐——其他人在学习。

examples.en: The playground was [loud] with the sound of children laughing.
examples.cn: 操场上充满了孩子们笑声，十分[喧闹]。

examples.en: She had to speak [loud] so everyone in the hall could hear her.
examples.cn: 她不得不[大声]说话，这样大厅里的每个人都能听到她。

examples.sense: adj. 鲜艳的；刺眼的（颜色）
examples.en: His [loud] yellow jacket made him easy to spot in the crowd.
examples.cn: 他那件[鲜艳]的黄色夹克让他在人群中很容易被发现。

examples.en: There was a [loud] cheer from the audience when the team scored.
examples.cn: 当球队得分时，观众发出了[热烈]的欢呼声。

words.translation: n. 爱, 恋爱, 爱情, 爱好, 性爱\nvt. 爱, 爱好, 爱慕\nvi. 爱
words.definition:
n. a strong positive emotion of regard and affection
n. any object of warm affection or devotion; 
n. a deep feeling of sexual desire and attraction
n. a score of zero in tennis or squash

examples.en: I [love] reading science fiction novels in my spare time.
examples.cn: 我[热爱]在业余时间阅读科幻小说。

examples.en: The story is about the [love] between a young prince and a village girl.
examples.cn: 这个故事讲述了一位年轻王子和一个村姑之间的[爱情]。

examples.en: She [loves] cooking new recipes on weekends with her mother.
examples.cn: 她[很喜欢]在周末和母亲一起烹饪新菜谱。

examples.en: His grandmother always called him [love] when she greeted him.
examples.cn: 他的祖母见到他时总称他为[亲爱的]。

examples.en: The score is forty-[love], meaning one player has zero points.
examples.cn: 比分是四十比[零]，意味着一方得了零分。

words.translation: a. 可爱的, 有趣的
words.definition: s. appealing to the emotions as well as the eye

examples.en: The park looks [lovely] in spring when all the flowers bloom.
examples.cn: 春天所有花朵盛开时，公园看起来[美丽]极了。

examples.sense: adj. 令人愉快的；美好的
examples.en: We had a [lovely] picnic by the river on Sunday afternoon.
examples.cn: 周日下午我们在河边进行了一次[愉快]的野餐。

examples.en: She wore a [lovely] blue dress to the graduation ceremony.
examples.cn: 她穿着一件[迷人]的蓝色连衣裙参加毕业典礼。

examples.sense: adj. 友善的；讨人喜欢的
examples.en: The new neighbours are [lovely] people who always say hello.
examples.cn: 新邻居是[友善]的人，总是打招呼。

examples.en: What a [lovely] idea to plant a vegetable garden at school!
examples.cn: 在学校种菜园真是个[极好]的主意！

words.translation:
n. 低点, 低价, 低, 牛叫声
a. 低的, 消沉的, 低等的, 浅的, 卑贱的
adv. 低下地, 谦卑地, 低
vi. 牛叫
words.definition:
n. an air mass of lower pressure; often brings precipitation
n. British political cartoonist (born in New Zealand) who created the character Colonel Blimp (1891-1963)
n. a low level or position or degree
a. less than normal in degree or intensity or amount

examples.en: The shelf was too [low] for the tall books to stand upright.
examples.cn: 书架太[低]了，高大的书无法直立放置。

examples.en: The fuel in the car was getting [low], so they stopped at a petrol station.
examples.cn: 车里的燃油[不足]了，所以他们在加油站停了下来。

examples.en: She spoke in a [low] voice so as not to wake the baby.
examples.cn: 她用[低沉]的声音说话，以免吵醒婴儿。

examples.en: The plane flew [low] over the fields as it prepared to land.
examples.cn: 飞机准备降落时在田野上[低低地]飞行。

examples.en: He felt [low] after failing the test but decided to study harder.
examples.cn: 他考试失败后感到[低落]，但决定更加努力学习。

words.translation: n. 运气, 幸运, 好运, 侥幸\nvi. 靠好运成功
words.definition: n. an unknown and unpredictable phenomenon that causes an event to result one way rather than another\nn. an unknown and unpredictable phenomenon that leads to a favorable outcome

examples.en: Good [luck] on your exam tomorrow — you have prepared well.
examples.cn: 祝你明天考试[好运]——你已经准备得很好了。

examples.en: It was bad [luck] that it rained on the day of the school trip.
examples.cn: 真倒[霉]，学校春游那天下雨了。

examples.en: Finding a taxi so quickly was a piece of [luck] on a rainy day.
examples.cn: 在雨天这么快找到出租车真是[幸运]。

examples.en: Success comes not just from [luck] but also from hard work.
examples.cn: 成功不仅来自[运气]，还来自努力工作。

examples.en: In China, the number eight is considered a symbol of [luck].
examples.cn: 在中国，数字八被认为是[好运]的象征。

words.translation: a. 幸运的, 吉祥的, 好运的, 侥幸的
words.definition: s. occurring by chance\na. having or bringing good fortune

examples.en: She felt [lucky] to win first prize in the drawing competition.
examples.cn: 她感到很[幸运]，在绘画比赛中赢得了一等奖。

examples.en: He always carries a [lucky] coin in his pocket before exams.
examples.cn: 他考试前总是在口袋里装一枚[幸运]硬币。

examples.en: It was [lucky] that I remembered to bring an umbrella today.
examples.cn: 真[碰巧]，我今天记得带了雨伞。

examples.en: Guessing the right answer was a [lucky] chance, not knowledge.
examples.cn: 猜对答案是[运气]，不是知识。

examples.en: We had a [lucky] escape when the storm missed our town.
examples.cn: 暴风雨没有袭击我们的城镇，我们真是[幸运]地逃过了。

words.translation: n. 午餐
words.definition: n. a midday meal\nv. take the midday meal\nv. provide a midday meal for

examples.en: We have [lunch] in the school canteen at half past twelve.
examples.cn: 我们在十二点半在学校食堂吃[午餐]。

examples.en: During [lunch], students can read, play, or chat with friends.
examples.cn: 在[午餐时间]，学生可以阅读、玩耍或和朋友聊天。

examples.en: The teachers [lunch] together in the staff room every weekday.
examples.cn: 老师们每个工作日在教职员休息室一起[吃午饭]。

examples.en: She packed a healthy [lunch] with a sandwich, fruit, and juice.
examples.cn: 她打包了一份健康的[午饭]，包括三明治、水果和果汁。

examples.sense: n. 午间聚会；工作午餐
examples.en: The principal held a [lunch] meeting with the class representatives.
examples.cn: 校长与班级代表举行了一次[午餐]会议。

words.translation: n. 机器, 机械装置, 机构, 自动售货机, 机械般工作的人\nvt. 以机器制造
words.definition:
n. any mechanical or electrical device that transmits or modifies energy to perform or assist in the performance of human tasks
n. an efficient person
n. an intricate organization that accomplishes its goals efficiently
n. a device for overcoming resistance at one point by applying force at some other point

examples.en: The factory uses a [machine] to pack the products quickly.
examples.cn: 工厂使用[机器]快速包装产品。

examples.en: A washing [machine] saves a lot of time compared to washing by hand.
examples.cn: 洗衣[机]与手洗相比节省了大量时间。

examples.en: I bought a bottle of water from the vending [machine] in the corridor.
examples.cn: 我从走廊里的自动售卖[机]买了一瓶水。

examples.en: The government [machine] works to provide services to all citizens.
examples.cn: 政府[机构]致力于为所有公民提供服务。

examples.en: My [machine] crashed and I lost all my homework files.
examples.cn: 我的[电脑]崩溃了，我丢失了所有作业文件。

words.translation: a. 疯狂的, 发疯的, 生气的, 愚蠢的, 狂欢的\nn. 狂怒
words.definition:
s roused to anger
s affected with madness or insanity
s marked by uncontrolled excitement or emotion
s very foolish

examples.en: She was [mad] at her brother for breaking her favourite mug.
examples.cn: 她对哥哥[生气]，因为他打碎了她最喜欢的杯子。

examples.en: It seems [mad] to go swimming in such cold weather.

examples.en: [May] you have a wonderful and happy new year!
examples.cn: [祝]你新年快乐！

words.translation: adv. 也许, 大概\nn. 可能性
words.definition: r by chance

examples.en: [Maybe] we can go to the park if the weather is good tomorrow.
examples.cn: 如果明天天气好，[也许]我们可以去公园。

examples.en: I am not sure, but [maybe] he forgot about the meeting.
examples.cn: 我不确定，但[也许]他忘了开会这件事。

examples.en: [Maybe] she is still in the library — let us go and check.
examples.cn: [也许]她还在图书馆——我们去看看吧。

examples.en: [Maybe] fifty students attended the special lecture.
examples.cn: [大概]有五十名学生参加了这次特别讲座。

examples.en: [Maybe] you should ask the teacher if you do not understand.
examples.cn: 如果你不理解，[也许]应该去问老师。

words.translation: pron. 我
words.definition: n a state in New England

examples.en: Can you help [me] carry these heavy books to the classroom?
examples.cn: 你能帮[我]把这些重书搬到教室吗？

examples.en: She gave [me] a beautiful birthday card yesterday.
examples.cn: 她昨天给了[我]一张漂亮的生日贺卡。

examples.en: Tell [me] about your summer vacation — where did you go?
examples.cn: 告诉[我]你的暑假情况——你去哪里了？

examples.en: It was [me] who broke the window by accident while playing.
examples.cn: 是[我]玩耍时不小心打破了窗户。

examples.en: Please wait for [me] — I will be ready in five minutes.
examples.cn: 请等[我]——我五分钟后就好。

words.translation: n. 一餐, 膳食, 粗粉\nvi. 进餐
words.definition: n. the food served and eaten at one time\nn. any of the occasions for eating food that occur by custom or habit at more or less fixed times\nn. coarsely ground foodstuff; especially seeds of various cereal grasses or pulse

examples.en: Breakfast is the most important [meal] of the day.
examples.cn: 早餐是一天中最重要的[一餐]。

examples.en: The family sat together and enjoyed a warm [meal] after a long day.
examples.cn: 一家人在漫长的一天后坐在一起享用了一顿温馨的[饭]。

examples.en: She cooked a delicious [meal] for her parents on their anniversary.
examples.cn: 她在父母结婚纪念日为他们做了一顿美味的[饭]。

examples.en: School lunch is the main [meal] of the day for many students.
examples.cn: 学校午餐是许多学生一天中的主要[一餐]。

examples.en: He always washes his hands before every [meal].
examples.cn: 他每[餐]饭前都会洗手。

words.translation:
a. 低劣的, 卑贱的, 简陋的, 吝啬的, 惭愧的, 平均的, 中间的, 普通的
vt. 意谓, 想要, 意欲, 预定
vi. 用意, 有意义
n. 平均数, 中间, 中庸
words.definition:
n. an average of n numbers computed by adding some function of the numbers and dividing by some function of n
v. mean or intend to express or convey
v. denote or connote
v. have a specified degree of importance

examples.en: What does this word [mean] in Chinese?
examples.cn: 这个词用中文[是什么意思]？

examples.en: A red traffic light [means] you must stop.
examples.cn: 红色交通灯[表示]你必须停下来。

examples.en: I did not [mean] to hurt your feelings — I am sorry.
examples.cn: 我不是[故意]伤害你的感情——我很抱歉。

examples.en: He is too [mean] to share his snacks with anyone.
examples.cn: 他太[小气]了，不愿与任何人分享零食。

examples.en: It is [mean] to laugh at someone for making a mistake.
examples.cn: 嘲笑别人犯错是[刻薄]的行为。

words.translation: n. 意义, 含义, 目的, 意图\na. 意味深长的
words.definition: n. the message that is intended or expressed or signified\nn. the idea that is intended\ns. rich in significance or implication

examples.en: Please look up the [meaning] of this new word in the dictionary.
examples.cn: 请在词典中查找这个新词的[意思]。

examples.en: The [meaning] of this poem is not easy to understand.
examples.cn: 这首诗的[含义]不容易理解。

examples.en: Helping others gives [meaning] to our lives.
examples.cn: 帮助他人给我们的生活带来[意义]。

examples.en: I do not understand the [meaning] behind his words.
examples.cn: 我不理解他话语背后的[含义]。

examples.en: Words can have more than one [meaning] depending on the context.
examples.cn: 根据语境，词语可以有不止一个[意思]。

words.translation: n. 肉, 餐, 食物\n[经] 肉类
words.definition: n. the flesh of animals (including fishes and birds and snails) used as food

examples.en: She does not eat [meat] because she is a vegetarian.
examples.cn: 她不吃[肉]，因为她是素食者。

examples.en: The [meat] at the market was very fresh today.
examples.cn: 今天市场上的[肉]非常新鲜。

examples.en: He prefers chicken [meat] to pork because it is less fatty.
examples.cn: 他更喜欢鸡[肉]而不是猪肉，因为脂肪含量较少。

examples.en: The soup is made with vegetables and a little bit of [meat].
examples.cn: 这道汤是用蔬菜和一点点[肉]做成的。

examples.en: The [meat] of the coconut is sweet and delicious.
examples.cn: 椰子的[果肉]甜美可口。

words.translation: n. 医生, 体格检查\na. 医学的, 内科的, 药的
words.definition: a. relating to the study or practice of medicine\na. requiring or amenable to treatment by medicine especially as opposed to surgery

examples.en: She wants to study [medical] science at university.
examples.cn: 她想在大学学习[医学]。

examples.en: He received excellent [medical] care at the hospital.
examples.cn: 他在医院接受了出色的[医疗]护理。

examples.en: All students must bring their [medical] records to the school checkup.
examples.cn: 所有学生必须带[医学]记录去学校体检。

examples.en: The [medical] team arrived quickly to help the injured player.
examples.cn: [医疗]团队迅速赶到帮助受伤的球员。

examples.en: [Medical] research has helped people live longer and healthier lives.
examples.cn: [医学]研究帮助人们活得更长、更健康。

words.translation: n. 药, 医学, 内科\nvt. 给...用药
words.definition: n. the branches of medical science that deal with nonsurgical techniques\nn. (medicine) something that treats or prevents or alleviates the symptoms of disease\nn. the learned profession that is mastered by graduate training in a medical school and that is devoted to preventing or alleviating or curing diseases and injuries

examples.en: The doctor gave him some [medicine] to help with his cold.
examples.cn: 医生给了他一些[药]帮助治疗感冒。

examples.en: Remember to take your [medicine] after meals.
examples.cn: 记得饭后服[药]。

examples.en: She decided to study [medicine] because she wants to save lives.
examples.cn: 她决定学习[医学]，因为她想救死扶伤。

examples.en: Do not take too much [medicine] — follow the doctor's instructions.
examples.cn: 不要服用太多[药]——遵医嘱服用。

examples.en: Modern [medicine] has found cures for many serious diseases.
examples.cn: 现代[医学]已经找到了许多严重疾病的治疗方法。

words.translation:
n. 会, 集会
a. 适宜的, 合适的
vt. 遇见, 引见, 认识, 满足, 对付
vi. 相遇, 接触
words.definition:
n. a meeting at which a number of athletic contests are held
v. come together
v. get together socially or for a specific purpose
v. fill or meet a want or need

examples.cn: 我八点钟在学校大门口[见你]。

examples.cn: 她在书店偶然[遇见]了她最好的朋友。

examples.en: Nice to [meet] you! I have heard a lot about you.
examples.cn: 很高兴[认识]你！我听说了很多关于你的事。

examples.en: The students worked hard to [meet] the teacher's expectations.
examples.cn: 学生们努力工作以[满足]老师的期望。

examples.en: My parents came to the airport to [meet] me when I returned home.
examples.cn: 我回家时父母来机场[迎接]我。

words.translation: n. 会议, 会面\n[法] 会议, 会谈, 集会
words.definition:
n. a formally arranged gathering
n. a small informal social gathering
n. a casual or unexpected convergence
n. the social act of assembling for some common purpose

examples.en: The class [meeting] is held every Friday afternoon.
examples.cn: 班会每周五下午举行。

examples.en: She arrived late to the [meeting] because of the traffic jam.
examples.cn: 她因为堵车迟到了[会议]。

examples.en: All the parents are invited to a [meeting] at school next week.
examples.cn: 所有家长被邀请参加下周在学校举行的[会议]。

examples.en: Our [meeting] at the library changed my life.
examples.cn: 我们在图书馆的[相遇]改变了我的生活。

examples.en: The school principal called a [meeting] to discuss the new rules.
examples.cn: 校长召开了一次[会议]讨论新规定。

words.translation: n. 成员, 会员\n[医] │肢, 肢体
words.definition: n. one of the persons who compose a social group (especially individuals who have joined and participate in a group organization)\nn. anything that belongs to a set or class\nn. an organization that is a member of another organization (especially a state that belongs to a group of nations)

examples.en: She is a [member] of the school basketball team.
examples.cn: 她是学校篮球队的[成员]。

examples.cn: 俱乐部的每位[会员]每年必须缴纳少量费用。

examples.en: As a [member] of the group, you must follow the rules.
examples.cn: 作为小组的[成员]，你必须遵守规则。

examples.en: Every [member] of our family has a different hobby.
examples.cn: 我们家庭的每个[成员]都有不同的爱好。

examples.en: He became a [member] of the reading club after the summer.
examples.cn: 暑假后他成为了读书俱乐部的[会员]。

words.translation: n. 记忆, 记忆力, 回忆, 纪念, 存储\nn. 内存\n[计] 存储器, 内存, 查看内存实用程序
words.definition:
n. something that is remembered
n. the cognitive processes whereby past experience is remembered
n. the power of retaining and recalling past experience
n. an electronic memory device

examples.en: Grandma has a very good [memory] and remembers everything.
examples.cn: 奶奶的[记忆力]非常好，什么都记得。

examples.en: Reading books every day can improve your [memory].
examples.cn: 每天读书可以提高你的[记忆力]。

examples.en: She has happy [memories] of her childhood in the countryside.
examples.cn: 她对在农村的童年有美好的[回忆]。

examples.en: We planted a tree in [memory] of our beloved teacher.
examples.cn: 我们种了一棵树以[纪念]我们敬爱的老师。

examples.en: This computer needs more [memory] to run the new software.
examples.cn: 这台电脑需要更多[内存]来运行新软件。

words.translation: n. 改进, 修补, 好转\nvt. 修改, 改进, 加快, 修理\nvi. 好转, 改善
words.definition: n. sewing that repairs a worn or torn hole (especially in a garment)\nv. heal or recover

examples.en: Grandma [mended] the torn shirt with a needle and thread.
examples.cn: 奶奶用针线[缝补]了那件破了的衬衫。

examples.en: Can you [mend] the hole in my school bag?
examples.cn: 你能[修补]我书包上的破洞吗？

examples.en: He stayed at home to rest so his cold would [mend] quickly.
examples.cn: 他待在家里休息，这样感冒会[好]得快些。

examples.en: She decided to [mend] her ways and become a more responsible student.
examples.cn: 她决定[改正]自己的行为，成为一个更有责任心的学生。

examples.en: Dad [mended] the broken fence in the garden last weekend.
examples.cn: 爸爸上周末[修补]了花园里破损的栅栏。

words.translation: n. 提到, 言及, 陈述\nvt. 提到, 提及

n. a remark that calls attention to something or someone
n. an official recognition of merit
v. make reference to
v. commend

examples.cn: 老师有[提到]考试日期吗？

examples.cn: 她[提到]她去年夏天去过北京。

examples.cn: 他谈到最好的学生时[提到]了我的名字。

examples.cn: 一[提到]食物，孩子们都兴奋起来。

examples.cn: 不要向汤姆[提及]惊喜派对——这是个秘密！

words.translation: n. 菜单, (功能)选择单\n[计] 菜单

n. a list of dishes available at a restaurant
n. the dishes making up a meal
n. (computer science) a list of options available to a computer user
n. an agenda of things to do

examples.cn: 我们一坐下，服务员就递给我们[菜单]。

examples.cn: 餐厅的[菜单]上有中西两种食物。

examples.cn: 点击屏幕顶部的[菜单]找到设置。

examples.en: Is there a children's [menu] at this restaurant?
examples.cn: 这家餐厅有儿童[菜单]吗？

examples.en: She studied the [menu] carefully before ordering her food.
examples.cn: 她在点餐前仔细研究了[菜单]。

words.translation:

vi. 通报, 报告, 报信

words.definition:
n. a communication (usually brief) that is written or spoken or signaled
n. what a communication that is about something is about
v. send a message to
v. send as a message

examples.cn: 她发了一条[信息]告诉他她会迟到。

examples.cn: 公告栏上有一条给你的[信息]。

examples.cn: 这个故事的[寓意]是善良总会获胜。

examples.en: Can you leave a [message] for the teacher if she is not in?
examples.cn: 如果老师不在，你能给她[留言]吗？

examples.en: He checked his phone and found five new [messages].
examples.cn: 他检查手机，发现了五条新[信息]。

words.translation: n. 金属, 金属制品, 合金, 本质, 质料\na. 金属制的\nvt. 以金属覆盖

examples.cn: 这座桥由坚固的[金属]建成，能承受重型卡车。

examples.cn: 黄金和白银都是[金属]的一种。

examples.en: The old coins were made of a shiny [metal].
examples.cn: 这些古钱币是由闪亮的[金属]制成的。

examples.cn: 她找到了一种快速记忆英语词汇的新[方法]。

examples.cn: 解决这道数学题最好的[方法]是什么？

examples.cn: 老师用新的教学[方法]使课堂变得有趣。

examples.en: Different students may use different [methods] to study for exams.
examples.cn: 不同学生可能用不同的[方法]备考。

words.translation: n. 公尺, 格律, 韵律\n[医] 米, 公尺

examples.cn: 游泳池长五十[米]。

examples.cn: 他能在十二秒内跑完一百[米]。

examples.cn: 这棵树大约十[米]高，很容易攀爬。

examples.en: The classroom is eight [metres] wide and twelve [metres] long.
examples.cn: 教室宽八[米]，长十二[米]。

examples.en: She jumped over a bar that was one [metre] and forty centimetres high.
examples.cn: 她跳过了一根一[米]四十厘米高的横杆。

words.translation: n. 中央, 中间, 腰部\na. 中央的, 中庸的, 中间的

n. an intermediate part or section
n. the middle area of the human torso (usually in front)
n. time between the beginning and the end of a temporal period

examples.cn: 她坐在教室的[中间]，两边都是朋友。

examples.cn: 公园位于城市的[中间]，被高楼大厦所包围。

examples.cn: 他是[中间]的孩子，上有哥哥，下有妹妹。

examples.cn: 她小心地抱住婴儿的[腰部]。

words.translation: n. 力量, 权力\naux. 可能, 也许

examples.cn: 今天下午[可能]会下雨，所以带把伞吧。

words.translation: n. 奶, 乳状物\nvt. 挤乳, 榨取\nvi. 产乳

examples.cn: 她每天早上上学前喝一杯[牛奶]。

examples.cn: 这家店的[牛奶]很新鲜，来自当地农场。
