examples.en: [Mind] the step — it is very slippery after the rain.
examples.cn: [注意]台阶——下雨后很滑。

examples.en: Could you [mind] my bag while I go to the toilet?
examples.cn: 我去卫生间时你能帮我[看]一下包吗？

words.translation: n. 分, 分钟, 片刻, 备忘录, 笔记\nvt. 记录, 摘录, 测定时间\na. 微小的, 详细的
words.definition:
n. a unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour
n. a unit of angular distance equal to a 60th of a degree
n. a short note
s. characterized by painstaking care and detailed examination

examples.en: Please wait just a [minute] — I will be right back.
examples.cn: 请等一[分钟]——我马上回来。

examples.en: It takes about twenty [minutes] to walk from here to school.
examples.cn: 从这里步行到学校大约需要二十[分钟]。

examples.en: The scientist looked at the [minute] details under a microscope.
examples.cn: 科学家在显微镜下观察[微小]的细节。

examples.en: She will join us in a [minute] — she is just finishing her work.
examples.cn: 她[一会儿]就来加入我们——她正在完成工作。

examples.en: The exam is ninety [minutes] long, so use your time wisely.
examples.cn: 考试时间为九十[分钟]，所以要合理利用时间。

words.translation: n. 镜子, 写真, 典范\nvt. 反映, 映出
words.definition:
n. polished surface that forms images by reflecting light
n. a faithful depiction or reflection
v. reflect as if in a mirror
v. reflect or resemble

examples.en: She looked in the [mirror] before going out to check her hair.
examples.cn: 她出门前照了一下[镜子]检查自己的头发。

examples.en: The bathroom [mirror] was covered in steam after his shower.
examples.cn: 他洗澡后浴室[镜子]蒙上了水蒸气。

examples.en: The calm lake [mirrored] the mountains perfectly.
examples.cn: 平静的湖水完美地[映照]出群山。

examples.en: The [mirror] on the wall showed him his tired face.
examples.cn: 墙上的[镜子]映出了他疲惫的脸。

examples.en: His actions [mirror] what his teacher taught him.
examples.cn: 他的行为[反映]了老师教他的东西。

words.translation: n. 失误, 避免, 失败, 小姐\nvt. 未得到, 未达到, 未听到, 未觉察, 逃脱, 遗漏, 错过, 思念\nvi. 失败, 击不中
words.definition:
n. a failure to hit (or meet or find etc)
n. a form of address for an unmarried woman
v. fail to perceive or to catch with the senses or the mind
v. feel or suffer from the lack of

examples.en: He ran fast but still [missed] the last bus home.
examples.cn: 他跑得很快，但还是[错过]了最后一班回家的公共汽车。

examples.en: She [misses] her friends a lot since she moved to a new city.
examples.cn: 自从搬到新城市以来，她非常[想念]她的朋友们。

examples.en: The player [missed] the goal by just a few centimetres.
examples.cn: 球员仅差几厘米就[射偏]了球门。

examples.en: She [missed] three days of school because of a fever.
examples.cn: 她因发烧[缺席]了三天学校。

examples.en: [Miss] Wang is our new English teacher this semester.
examples.cn: [王]老师是我们这学期的新英语老师。

words.translation:
n. 错误, 误会
vi. 犯错, 误认
vt. 误解, 弄错
[计] 错误
words.definition: n. a wrong action attributable to bad judgment or ignorance or inattention\nn. an understanding of something that is not correct\nv. identify incorrectly

examples.en: Everyone makes [mistakes] — the important thing is to learn from them.
examples.cn: 每个人都会犯[错误]——重要的是从中学习。

examples.en: She found a [mistake] in her essay and corrected it before handing it in.
examples.cn: 她在作文中发现了一个[错误]，并在交上去之前改正了。

examples.en: I [mistook] her for her twin sister — they look exactly alike.
examples.cn: 我把她[误认]为她的双胞胎姐妹——她们长得一模一样。

examples.en: By [mistake], he took the wrong bag from the classroom.
examples.cn: 他[错误地]从教室拿走了别人的包。

examples.en: The [mistake] in the report was noticed by the teacher immediately.
examples.cn: 老师立即注意到了报告中的[错误]。

words.translation:
n. 模型, 模范, 模特儿
a. 模范的, 作模型用的
vi. 做模型, 做模特儿
vt. 使模仿, 塑造
[计] 模型
words.definition:
n. a hypothetical description of a complex entity or process
n. a type of product
n. a person who poses for a photographer or painter or sculptor
n. representation of something (sometimes on a smaller scale)

examples.en: He built a [model] of the solar system for the science fair.
examples.cn: 他为科学展览制作了一个太阳系[模型]。

examples.en: She is a [model] student who is hardworking and always polite.
examples.cn: 她是一名[模范]学生，勤奋且始终有礼貌。

examples.en: She worked as a fashion [model] when she was young.
examples.cn: 她年轻时是一名时装[模特]。

examples.en: This is the latest [model] of the smartphone.
examples.cn: 这是智能手机的最新[型号]。

examples.en: The students [modelled] their handmade clothes at the school show.
examples.cn: 学生们在学校演出上[展示]了他们自制的衣服。

words.translation: n. 现代人, 有思想的人\na. 现代的, 时髦的
words.definition:
n. a contemporary person
n. a typeface (based on an 18th century design by Gianbattista Bodoni) distinguished by regular shape and hairline serifs and heavy downstrokes
a. belonging to the modern era; since the Middle Ages
s. characteristic of present-day art and music and literature and architecture

examples.en: The city has many [modern] buildings made of glass and steel.
examples.cn: 这座城市有许多由玻璃和钢铁建成的[现代]建筑。

examples.en: [Modern] technology has changed the way we communicate.
examples.cn: [现代]技术改变了我们的通信方式。

examples.sense: adj. 现代风格的，时髦的
examples.en: The classroom was redecorated with [modern] furniture and bright colors.
examples.cn: 教室用[现代]家具和明亮色彩重新装修了。

examples.en: She studies [modern] Chinese history at school this year.
examples.cn: 她今年在学校学习[现代]中国历史。

examples.en: [Modern] medicine can treat many diseases that were once fatal.
examples.cn: [现代]医学可以治疗许多曾经致命的疾病。

words.translation: n. 妈妈
words.definition: n informal terms for a mother

examples.en: [Mom] made my favorite dumplings for dinner tonight.
examples.cn: [妈妈]今晚做了我最喜欢的饺子。

examples.en: I called my [mom] to let her know I would be late.
examples.cn: 我打电话给[妈妈]告诉她我会晚点到。

examples.en: My [mom] always helps me with my homework when I have problems.
examples.cn: 我遇到问题时，[妈妈]总是帮我做作业。

examples.en: [Mom], can you please sign this permission slip for the school trip?
examples.cn: [妈妈]，你能帮我签一下学校旅行的许可单吗？

examples.en: She looked just like her [mom] — same smile, same eyes.
examples.cn: 她看起来和[妈妈]一模一样——相同的微笑，相同的眼睛。

words.translation: n. 片刻, 瞬间, 重要, 阶段, 力矩\n[医] 片刻, 瞬间, 时机, 因素, 矩
words.definition:
n. a particular point in time
n. an indefinitely short time
n. a turning force produced by an object acting at a distance (or a measure of that force)
n. the n-th moment of a distribution is the expected value of the n-th power of the deviations from a fixed value

examples.en: Please wait a [moment] while I look for the information.
examples.cn: 请稍等[片刻]，我去找一下资料。

examples.en: She paused for a [moment] before answering the difficult question.
examples.cn: 她在回答这个难题之前停顿了[片刻]。

examples.en: The [moment] she stepped onto the stage, everyone started clapping.
examples.cn: 她踏上舞台的那一[刻]，每个人都开始鼓掌。

examples.en: Winning the award was the most exciting [moment] of her life.
examples.cn: 获奖是她生命中最激动人心的[时刻]。

examples.en: At the [moment], she is studying hard for her final exams.
examples.cn: [此刻]，她正在努力备考期末考试。

words.translation: n. 星期一
words.definition: n. the second day of the week; the first working day

examples.en: School starts again on [Monday] after the weekend.
examples.cn: 周末之后，学校在[星期一]重新开始上课。

examples.en: We have a math test every [Monday] morning this term.
examples.cn: 本学期我们每[周一]早上都有数学测验。

examples.en: The school library opens at eight o'clock on [Monday].
examples.cn: 图书馆[周一]八点开门。

examples.en: [Monday] is usually the busiest day of the week at school.
examples.cn: [星期一]通常是学校一周中最忙的一天。

examples.en: The trip has been postponed from Friday to [Monday].
examples.cn: 旅行已经从周五推迟到了[周一]。

words.translation: n. 金钱, 一笔款, 财富, 货币, 金额\n[经] 货币, 金钱, 财产
words.definition: n. the most common medium of exchange; functions as legal tender\nn. wealth reckoned in terms of money\nn. the official currency issued by a government or national bank

examples.en: She saved her pocket [money] to buy a birthday gift for her mother.
examples.cn: 她把零花[钱]攒起来给妈妈买生日礼物。

examples.en: He worked part-time to earn extra [money] for his studies.
examples.cn: 他兼职打工为学习赚取额外的[钱]。

examples.en: [Money] alone cannot buy happiness or good health.
examples.cn: 仅凭[金钱]无法买到幸福或健康。

examples.en: Please count the [money] carefully before putting it in your wallet.
examples.cn: 把[钱]放进钱包之前请仔细数好。

examples.en: They raised [money] for the school library by organizing a book sale.
examples.cn: 他们通过组织书展为学校图书馆筹集[资金]。

words.translation: n. 监督器, 级长, 监听员, 班长, 监视器, 告诫物\nv. 监视, 监听, 监督\n[计] 监视器, 监视程序; 监视
words.definition:
n. an ironclad vessel built by Federal forces to do battle with the Merrimac
n. display produced by a device that takes signals and displays them on a television screen or a computer monitor
n. electronic equipment that is used to check the quality or content of electronic transmissions
n. a piece of electronic equipment that keeps track of the operation of a system continuously and warns of trouble

examples.en: The class [monitor] helped the teacher hand out the test papers.
examples.cn: [班长]帮助老师分发试卷。

examples.en: Our [monitor] keeps the class quiet when the teacher steps out.
examples.cn: 当老师出去时，我们的[班长]让班级保持安静。

examples.en: Please adjust the brightness of your computer [monitor].
examples.cn: 请调整一下电脑[显示器]的亮度。

examples.en: The teacher [monitors] students' progress with weekly quizzes.
examples.cn: 老师通过每周测验[监控]学生的学习进度。

examples.en: Scientists [monitor] air quality in the city every day.
examples.cn: 科学家每天[监测]城市的空气质量。

words.translation: n. 猴子, 猿, 打桩锤\nvi. 淘气, 胡闹\nvt. 嘲弄
words.definition: n. any of various long-tailed primates (excluding the prosimians)

examples.en: The [monkey] swung from branch to branch in the tall trees.
examples.cn: [猴子]在高大的树木上从一根树枝荡到另一根树枝。

examples.en: The children laughed at the [monkey] making funny faces at the zoo.
examples.cn: 孩子们在动物园里看[猴子]做鬼脸时笑了起来。

examples.en: The [monkey] stole the tourist's snack right out of her hand.
examples.cn: [猴子]直接从游客手中偷走了她的零食。

examples.en: Stop being a little [monkey] and sit still for the photo!
examples.cn: 别做小[猴子]了，拍照时要坐好！

examples.en: In the story, the clever [monkey] outsmarted the tiger every time.
examples.cn: 故事里，聪明的[猴子]每次都比老虎更机智。

words.translation: n. 月\n[经] 月
words.definition: n. a time unit of approximately 30 days

examples.en: There are twelve [months] in a year.
examples.cn: 一年有十二个[月]。

examples.en: She studied English for one [month] and made great progress.
examples.cn: 她学了一个[月]的英语，取得了很大的进步。

examples.en: The school trip is planned for next [month].
examples.cn: 学校旅行计划在下个[月]进行。

examples.en: Which [month] is your birthday? Mine is in July.
examples.cn: 你的生日是哪个[月]？我的是七月。

examples.en: He practiced piano every day for three [months] to prepare for the concert.
examples.cn: 他每天练习钢琴三个[月]，为音乐会做准备。

words.translation: n. 月亮, 月球, 月光\nvi. 闲荡\nvt. 虚度
words.definition:
n. the natural satellite of the Earth
n. any object resembling a moon
n. United States religious leader (born in Korea) who founded the Unification Church in 1954; was found guilty of conspiracy to evade taxes (born in 1920)
n. any natural satellite of a planet

examples.en: The [moon] was so bright last night that I could read outside.
examples.cn: 昨晚[月亮]太亮了，我可以在外面看书。

examples.en: Children enjoy looking at the full [moon] during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
examples.cn: 孩子们喜欢在中秋节欣赏圆[月亮]。

examples.en: Astronauts first landed on the [moon] in 1969.
examples.cn: 宇航员于1969年首次登上[月球]。

examples.en: The [moon] rises in the east and sets in the west, just like the sun.
examples.cn: [月亮]像太阳一样从东方升起，从西方落下。

examples.en: Jupiter has many [moons] orbiting around it.
examples.cn: 木星有许多[卫星]围绕它运行。

words.translation:
n. 更多
a. 多的, 程度较大的, 更大的
adv. 多, 更多, 进一步
[计] DOS外部命令:显示满屏后自动暂停, 并显示:"--More--", 按任意键继续
words.definition:
n. English statesman who opposed Henry VIII's divorce from Catherine of Aragon and was imprisoned and beheaded; recalled for his concept of Utopia, the ideal state
a. (comparative of `much' used with mass nouns) a quantifier meaning greater in size or amount or extent or degree
a. (comparative of `many' used with count nouns) quantifier meaning greater in number
r. used to form the comparative of some adjectives and adverbs

examples.en: She wanted [more] time to finish her drawing.
examples.cn: 她想要[更多]时间来完成她的画。

examples.en: Please speak [more] slowly so I can understand you better.
examples.cn: 请说[慢一些]，这样我能更好地理解你。

examples.en: She is [more] talented than anyone else in the class.
examples.cn: 她比班上任何人都[更]有才华。

examples.en: Would you like some [more] tea? There is plenty left.
examples.cn: 你想再来点[茶]吗？还剩很多。

examples.en: He needs to practice [more] if he wants to win the competition.
examples.cn: 他需要[更多地]练习才能赢得比赛。

words.translation: n. 早晨, 早上, 初期
words.definition: n. the time period between dawn and noon

examples.en: She goes jogging in the [morning] before school every day.
examples.cn: 她每天上学前在[早晨]跑步。

examples.en: Good [morning], class! Let us start today's lesson.
examples.cn: 同学们，早上好！我们开始今天的课程吧。

examples.en: The exam will be held on [morning] of the last day of school.
examples.cn: 考试将在学校最后一天的[上午]举行。

examples.en: In the [morning], the birds sing and the air smells fresh.
examples.cn: [清晨]，鸟儿鸣唱，空气清新。

examples.en: I finished all my homework in the [morning] and played in the afternoon.
examples.cn: 我在[上午]完成了所有作业，下午去玩了。

words.translation: n. 最多, 最大\na. 大多数的, 几乎全部的, 最多的\nadv. 最, 最多, 极其
words.definition:
a. (superlative of `many' used with count nouns and often preceded by `the') quantifier meaning the greatest in number
a. the superlative of `much' that can be used with mass nouns and is usually preceded by `the'; a quantifier meaning the greatest in amount or extent or degree
r. used to form the superlative
r. very

examples.en: She got the [most] votes in the class election.
examples.cn: 她在班级选举中获得了[最多]票。

examples.en: This is the [most] interesting book I have ever read.
examples.cn: 这是我读过的[最]有趣的书。

examples.en: The trip to Beijing was [most] enjoyable for the whole class.
examples.cn: 北京之行对全班同学来说[非常]愉快。

examples.en: [Most] students like doing sports activities after school.
examples.cn: [大多数]学生喜欢课后进行体育活动。

examples.en: Who scored [most] points in the basketball game?
examples.cn: 篮球比赛中谁得了[最多]分？

words.translation: n. 母亲, 修女院长\nvt. 产生, 照看, 收养
words.definition:
n. a woman who has given birth to a child (also used as a term of address to your mother)
n. a stringy slimy substance consisting of yeast cells and bacteria; forms during fermentation and is added to cider or wine to produce vinegar
n. a term of address for an elderly woman
n. a term of address for a mother superior

examples.en: Her [mother] cooked a special meal to celebrate her birthday.
examples.cn: 她的[母亲]做了一顿特别的饭来庆祝她的生日。

examples.en: His [mother] always encourages him to work hard at school.
examples.cn: 他的[母亲]总是鼓励他在学校努力学习。

examples.en: The [mother] bird fed her young ones in the nest.
examples.cn: [母]鸟在巢中喂养她的幼鸟。

examples.en: She became a [mother] for the first time when she was twenty-six.
examples.cn: 她二十六岁第一次成为[母亲]。

examples.en: Happy [Mother]'s Day! I made this card just for you.
examples.cn: [母亲]节快乐！这张卡片是我特意为你做的。

words.translation: n. 摩托车\n[机] 机动车, 机踏车, 摩托车
words.definition: n. a motor vehicle with two wheels and a strong frame

examples.en: He rides a [motorcycle] to work every day because it is faster.
examples.cn: 他每天骑[摩托车]上班，因为更快。

examples.en: The police officer on the [motorcycle] stopped the speeding car.
examples.cn: 骑[摩托车]的警察拦住了超速的汽车。

examples.en: You must wear a helmet when riding a [motorcycle] for safety.
examples.cn: 为了安全，骑[摩托车]时必须戴头盔。

examples.en: She learned how to ride a [motorcycle] when she was eighteen.
examples.cn: 她十八岁时学会了骑[摩托车]。

examples.en: The loud sound of the [motorcycle] woke everyone up early.
examples.cn: [摩托车]的巨大声音把所有人都早早吵醒了。

words.translation: n. 山, 山脉, 大堆
words.definition: n. a land mass that projects well above its surroundings; higher than a hill

examples.en: We climbed the [mountain] and enjoyed the beautiful view from the top.
examples.cn: 我们爬上了[山]，欣赏了山顶的美丽景色。

examples.en: The village is surrounded by tall [mountains] on three sides.
examples.cn: 这个村庄三面被高[山]所围绕。

examples.en: Snow covers the top of the [mountain] all year round.
examples.cn: [山]顶终年积雪。

examples.en: She had a [mountain] of homework to finish before Monday.
examples.cn: 她在周一之前要完成[大量]作业。

examples.en: The hikers camped on the side of the [mountain] for the night.
examples.cn: 徒步者在[山]坡上露营过夜。

words.translation:
n. 老鼠, 胆小羞怯的人, 鼠标
vi. 捕鼠, 窥探
vt. 探出
[计] 鼠标
words.definition:
n. any of numerous small rodents typically resembling diminutive rats having pointed snouts and small ears on elongated bodies with slender usually hairless tails
n. person who is quiet or timid
n. a hand-operated electronic device that controls the coordinates of a cursor on your computer screen as you move it around on a pad; on the bottom of the device is a ball that rolls on the surface of the pad
v. manipulate the mouse of a computer

examples.en: Click the left button of the [mouse] to select the file.
examples.cn: 点击[鼠标]左键选择文件。

examples.en: The cat chased a [mouse] around the kitchen.
examples.cn: 猫在厨房里追着一只[老鼠]转。

examples.en: A small [mouse] ran across the floor and frightened everyone.
examples.cn: 一只小[老鼠]跑过地板，吓了大家一跳。

examples.en: My computer [mouse] stopped working, so I could not click anything.
examples.cn: 我的电脑[鼠标]坏了，我什么都无法点击。

examples.en: The [mouse] in the fable was kind enough to help the lion.
examples.cn: 寓言里的[老鼠]善良地帮助了狮子。

words.translation: n. 嘴, 口, 口腔, 口状物\nvi. 装腔作势说话, 做鬼脸\nvt. 说出, 做作地说
words.definition:
n. the opening through which food is taken in and vocalizations emerge
n. the externally visible part of the oral cavity on the face and the system of organs surrounding the opening
n. an opening that resembles a mouth (as of a cave or a gorge)
n. the point where a stream issues into a larger body of water

examples.en: Please close your [mouth] when you are chewing food.
examples.cn: 咀嚼食物时请闭上[嘴]。

examples.en: She opened her [mouth] wide to sing the high note.
examples.cn: 她张大[嘴巴]唱出高音。

examples.en: The river flows into the sea at its [mouth].
examples.cn: 河流在[河口]处流入大海。

examples.en: The dentist asked me to open my [mouth] as wide as possible.
examples.cn: 牙医让我尽可能地张大[嘴]。

examples.en: Do not put too much food in your [mouth] at once.
examples.cn: 不要一次在[嘴]里放太多食物。

words.translation:
n. 移动, 迁居, 步骤
vt. 移动, 开动, 感动, 搬(家)
vi. 移动, 离开, 运行, 迁移, 摇动, 搬家, 交往, 进展, 脱手
[计] 移动; 传送; DOS外部命令:移动文件, 它可将文件移动到指定的地方
words.definition:
n. the act of deciding to do something
n. the act of changing your residence or place of business
n. (game) a player's turn to take some action permitted by the rules of the game
v. cause to move or shift into a new position or place, both in a concrete and in an abstract sense

examples.en: Please [move] your chair so everyone can see the board.
examples.cn: 请[移动]你的椅子，这样大家都能看到黑板。

examples.en: He [moved] to a new city for work last year.
examples.cn: 他去年为了工作[搬到]了一个新城市。

examples.en: The sad story [moved] everyone in the room to tears.
examples.cn: 这个悲伤的故事[感动]了房间里所有人，他们都流下了眼泪。

examples.en: The slow traffic made it impossible to [move] quickly.
examples.cn: 缓慢的交通使得快速[前进]成为不可能。

examples.en: Her next [move] was to study hard for the final exams.
examples.cn: 她下一步的[行动]是努力备考期末考试。

words.translation: n. 电影
words.definition: n. a form of entertainment that enacts a story by sound and a sequence of images giving the illusion of continuous movement

examples.en: We went to see a [movie] at the cinema on Saturday afternoon.
examples.cn: 我们周六下午去电影院看了一部[电影]。

examples.en: Her favorite [movie] is about a young girl who loves dancing.
examples.cn: 她最喜欢的[电影]讲述了一个热爱跳舞的年轻女孩的故事。

examples.en: The [movie] was so exciting that the children did not want it to end.
examples.cn: 这部[电影]太令人兴奋了，孩子们不想让它结束。

examples.en: I watched a funny [movie] with my family last weekend.
examples.cn: 上周末我和家人一起看了一部搞笑[电影]。

examples.en: The school organized a free [movie] night for all the students.
examples.cn: 学校为所有学生组织了一个免费的[电影]之夜。

words.translation: 阁下, 先生
words.definition: n a form of address for a man

examples.en: [Mr.] Chen is our new science teacher this semester.
examples.cn: [陈]老师是我们这学期的新科学老师。

examples.en: Good morning, [Mr.] Smith! Are you ready for today's class?
examples.cn: 早上好，[史密斯]先生！你准备好今天的课了吗？

examples.en: Please hand your homework to [Mr.] Li at the front desk.
examples.cn: 请把作业交给前台的[李]老师。

examples.en: [Mr.] Wang gave us very useful advice about choosing a career.
examples.cn: [王]先生给了我们关于职业选择的非常有用的建议。

examples.en: The students greeted [Mr.] Johnson as he walked into the room.
examples.cn: 学生们在[约翰逊]先生走进房间时向他问好。

words.translation: 女士
words.definition: n a form of address for a woman

examples.en: [Ms.] Zhang is our head teacher and she is very strict but fair.
examples.cn: [张]老师是我们的班主任，她非常严格但公正。

examples.en: Good morning, [Ms.] Lee! Thank you for teaching us English.
examples.cn: 早上好，[李]老师！谢谢你教我们英语。

examples.en: [Ms.] Brown helped me improve my writing skills this year.
examples.cn: [布朗]女士今年帮助我提高了写作技巧。

examples.en: Please address all letters to [Ms.] Liu, the school librarian.
examples.cn: 请将所有信件寄给学校图书馆员[刘]女士。

examples.en: [Ms.] Wang told us an interesting story about her travels abroad.
examples.cn: [王]女士给我们讲了一个关于她在国外旅行的有趣故事。

words.translation: n. 大量, 许多, 重要的事\na. 很多的, 重要的\nadv. 多, 甚, 几乎
words.definition:
n. a great amount or extent
a. (quantifier used with mass nouns) great in quantity or degree or extent
r. to a great degree or extent
r. very

examples.en: Thank you so [much] for helping me with my project.
examples.cn: 非常[感谢]你帮助我完成项目。

examples.en: There is not [much] time left, so let us hurry up.
examples.cn: 剩下的时间不[多]了，我们快点吧。

examples.en: She feels [much] better after resting for two days.
examples.cn: 休息两天后，她感觉好[多]了。

examples.en: How [much] homework did the teacher give you today?
examples.cn: 老师今天给你布置了[多少]作业？

examples.en: I enjoyed the trip very [much] and want to go back someday.
examples.cn: 我非常[喜欢]这次旅行，希望有朝一日能再去。

words.translation: n. 谋杀\nvt. 谋杀, 损毁, 破坏\nvi. 犯杀人罪
words.definition: n. unlawful premeditated killing of a human being by a human being\nv. kill intentionally and with premeditation

examples.en: The police investigated the [murder] that took place in the city.
examples.cn: 警察调查了发生在城市里的[谋杀]案。

examples.en: The detective solved the [murder] mystery in three days.
examples.cn: 侦探在三天内破解了[谋杀]之谜。

examples.en: In the crime novel, the villain [murdered] the witness to hide the truth.
examples.cn: 在犯罪小说中，反派[谋杀]了证人以隐瞒真相。

examples.en: The judge sentenced the criminal for the [murder] he committed.
examples.cn: 法官因其所犯的[谋杀]罪判处了罪犯。

examples.en: He [murdered] the song by singing it completely out of tune.
examples.cn: 他把那首歌唱得完全走调，简直是[糟蹋]了它。

words.translation: n. 博物馆
words.definition: n. a depository for collecting and displaying objects having scientific or historical or artistic value

examples.en: We visited the history [museum] as part of our school trip.
examples.cn: 我们参观了历史[博物馆]，作为学校旅行的一部分。

examples.en: The [museum] has a wonderful collection of ancient Chinese art.
examples.cn: [博物馆]收藏了大量精美的中国古代艺术品。

examples.en: Students can learn a lot about science at the natural history [museum].
examples.cn: 学生可以在自然历史[博物馆]学到很多关于科学的知识。

examples.en: The [museum] is open every day except Monday.
examples.cn: [博物馆]除周一外每天开放。

examples.en: She spent the whole afternoon exploring the science [museum].
examples.cn: 她花了整整一个下午探索科学[博物馆]。

words.translation: n. 音乐, 乐曲
words.definition:
n. an artistic form of auditory communication incorporating instrumental or vocal tones in a structured and continuous manner
n. any agreeable (pleasing and harmonious) sounds
n. musical activity (singing or whistling etc.)
n. (music) the sounds produced by singers or musical instruments (or reproductions of such sounds)

examples.en: She listens to [music] while doing her homework.
examples.cn: 她在做作业时听[音乐]。

examples.en: [Music] class is her favorite subject at school.
examples.cn: [音乐]课是她在学校最喜欢的科目。

examples.en: She can read [music] and play several instruments.
examples.cn: 她能读[乐谱]，还会演奏几种乐器。

examples.en: The soft [music] in the cafe made everyone feel relaxed.
examples.cn: 咖啡馆里轻柔的[音乐]让每个人都感到放松。

examples.en: His love of [music] started when he heard his grandmother sing.
examples.cn: 他对[音乐]的热爱始于听到祖母唱歌的时候。

words.translation: n. 必须, 未发酵葡萄汁, 绝对必要的事物\naux. 必须
words.definition: n. a necessary or essential thing\nn. grape juice before or during fermentation\ns. highly recommended

examples.en: You [must] finish your homework before watching TV.
examples.cn: 你[必须]完成作业才能看电视。

examples.en: Students [must] wear their school uniform every day.
examples.cn: 学生每天[必须]穿校服。

examples.en: You [must] be very tired after running so far.
examples.cn: 跑了这么远，你[一定]很累了。

examples.en: We [must] protect the environment for future generations.
examples.cn: 我们[必须]为后代保护环境。

examples.en: Sunscreen is a [must] when you spend the day at the beach.
examples.cn: 在海滩度过一天时，防晒霜是[必须]的。

words.translation: pron. 我的\n[医] 迈尔(热容单位)
words.definition: a. Of or belonging to me; -- used always attributively; as, my\n   body; my book; -- mine is used in the predicate; as, the book is mine.\n   See Mine.

examples.en: [My] best friend and I have known each other since kindergarten.
examples.cn: [我的]最好的朋友和我从幼儿园就认识了。

examples.en: [My] favorite subject at school is biology.
examples.cn: [我]在学校最喜欢的科目是生物。

examples.en: I left [my] lunch box at home and had to buy food at school.
examples.cn: 我把[我的]午餐盒忘在家里，不得不在学校买食物。

examples.en: [My] teacher told me I have improved a lot this semester.
examples.cn: [我的]老师告诉我这学期我进步了很多。

examples.en: This is [my] first time visiting Beijing and I am very excited.
examples.cn: 这是[我]第一次来北京，我非常兴奋。

words.translation: pron. 我自己, 我亲自, 我独自
words.definition:
pron. I or me in person; -- used for emphasis, my own self or
   person; as I myself will do it; I have done it myself; -- used also
   instead of me, as the object of the first person of a reflexive verb,
   without emphasis; as, I will defend myself.

examples.en: I made this birthday cake by [myself] without any help.
examples.cn: 我[自己]做了这个生日蛋糕，没有任何帮助。

examples.en: I hurt [myself] when I fell off my bicycle yesterday.
examples.cn: 我昨天从自行车上摔下来时伤了[自己]。

examples.en: I will do the presentation [myself] because I want to practice speaking.
examples.cn: 我将[亲自]做演示，因为我想练习口语。

examples.en: I am proud of [myself] for finishing the marathon.
examples.cn: 我为[自己]完成马拉松而感到自豪。

examples.en: I saw the famous singer [myself] at the concert last night.
examples.cn: 我昨晚在音乐会上[亲眼]看到了那位著名歌手。

words.translation:
n. 名字, 名称, 姓名, 名义, 名誉, 文件名
vt. 命名, 称呼, 任命, 提名, 列举
a. 姓名的, 据以取名的
[计] 名称, 文件名, 姓名
words.definition:
n. a language unit by which a person or thing is known
n. a person's reputation
n. family based on male descent
n. a well-known or notable person

examples.en: My [name] is Li Ming and I am twelve years old.
examples.cn: 我的[名字]是李明，我十二岁。

examples.en: Please write your [name] at the top of the exam paper.
examples.cn: 请把你的[名字]写在试卷的顶部。

examples.en: They [named] their new puppy Lucky because it survived the accident.
examples.cn: 他们把新小狗[命名]为幸运，因为它在事故中存活了下来。

examples.en: She made a [name] for herself by winning many science competitions.
examples.cn: 她通过赢得许多科学竞赛为自己赢得了[名声]。

examples.en: Can you [name] the capital cities of five countries in Europe?
examples.cn: 你能[说出]欧洲五个国家的首都吗？

words.translation: a. 国家的, 国立的, 全国性的, 民族的\n[经] 全国性的, 国家的, 国民的
words.definition:
n. a person who owes allegiance to that nation
a. of or relating to or belonging to a nation or country
a. limited to or in the interests of a particular nation
a. concerned with or applicable to or belonging to an entire nation or country

examples.en: The [national] flag of China is red with yellow stars.
examples.cn: 中国的[国家]旗帜是红色的，上面有黄色星星。

examples.en: She won first prize in the [national] English speaking competition.
examples.cn: 她在[全国]英语演讲比赛中获得了一等奖。

examples.en: Every country has its own [national] traditions and customs.
examples.cn: 每个国家都有自己的[民族]传统和习俗。

examples.en: The [national] holiday gives everyone a chance to rest and celebrate.
examples.cn: [国家]假日给每个人提供了休息和庆祝的机会。

examples.en: The [national] exam results will be announced next week.
examples.cn: [全国]考试成绩将在下周公布。

words.translation: n. 白痴\na. 自然的, 自然界的, 本能的, 天然的, 物质的, 正常的, 原始的, 自然数的
words.definition:
n. someone regarded as certain to succeed
n. a notation cancelling a previous sharp or flat
n. (craps) a first roll of 7 or 11 that immediately wins the stake
a. in accordance with nature; relating to or concerning nature

examples.en: The park is full of [natural] beauty, with rivers and forests.
examples.cn: 公园充满了[自然]之美，有河流和森林。

examples.en: Honey is a [natural] sweetener that is better than sugar.
examples.cn: 蜂蜜是一种比糖更健康的[天然]甜味剂。

examples.sense: adj. 正常的，理所当然的
examples.en: It is [natural] to feel nervous before a big exam.
examples.cn: 在大考前感到紧张是[正常的]。

examples.en: She has a [natural] talent for music and learned quickly.
examples.cn: 她有[天生的]音乐才能，学得很快。

examples.en: The documentary showed many [natural] wonders from around the world.
examples.cn: 这部纪录片展示了世界各地的许多[自然]奇观。

words.translation: n. 自然, 大自然, 本性, 性格, 性质\n[医] 自然, 大自然; 本性, 性能
words.definition:
n. the essential qualities or characteristics by which something is recognized
n. a causal agent creating and controlling things in the universe
n. the natural physical world including plants and animals and landscapes etc.
n. the complex of emotional and intellectual attributes that determine a person's characteristic actions and reactions

examples.en: She loves spending time in [nature], hiking and watching birds.
examples.cn: 她喜欢在[大自然]中度过时光，徒步旅行和观鸟。

examples.en: We should all work together to protect [nature] for future generations.
examples.cn: 我们都应该共同努力为后代保护[大自然]。

examples.en: It is in a cat's [nature] to hunt small animals.
examples.cn: 狩猎小动物是猫的[天性]。

examples.en: The [nature] of the problem is more complex than it looks.
examples.cn: 这个问题的[性质]比看起来更复杂。

examples.en: The class went on a field trip to study plants in [nature].
examples.cn: 全班去郊游，在[大自然]中研究植物。

words.translation:
a. 近的, 近亲的, 近似的
adv. 接近, 亲近
prep. 靠近, 近似于
v. 接近, 走近
words.definition:
a. not far distant in time or space or degree or circumstances
s. being on the left side
s. closely resembling the genuine article
r. near in time or place or relationship

examples.en: There is a small shop [near] our school where we buy snacks.
examples.cn: 我们学校[附近]有一家我们买零食的小商店。

examples.en: Please sit [near] the front if you want to hear the teacher clearly.
examples.cn: 如果你想清楚地听到老师说话，请坐在[靠近]前面的地方。

examples.en: The [near] future will bring many changes to our school.
examples.cn: 在不远的[未来]，我们的学校将发生很多变化。

examples.en: As the exam date [neared], she studied harder every day.
examples.cn: 随着考试日期的[临近]，她每天学习得更加努力。

examples.en: He lives [near] the city centre and can walk to school.
examples.cn: 他住在市中心[附近]，可以步行上学。

words.translation: adv. 几乎, 密切地
words.definition: r (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished; all but\nr in a close manner

examples.en: She has [nearly] finished reading the whole book.
examples.cn: 她[几乎]读完了整本书。

examples.en: It is [nearly] midnight — you should go to bed now.
examples.cn: 现在[差不多]是午夜了——你现在应该去睡觉了。

examples.en: [Nearly] a hundred students attended the science exhibition.
examples.cn: [将近]一百名学生参加了科学展览。

examples.en: I [nearly] missed my stop on the bus because I fell asleep.
examples.cn: 我在公共汽车上睡着了，[差点]错过我的站。

examples.en: She has [nearly] mastered all the vocabulary words on the list.
examples.cn: 她[差不多]已经掌握了表上所有的词汇。

words.translation: a. 必要的；必然的；必需的
words.definition: a. absolutely essential\ns. unavoidably determined by prior circumstances

examples.en: It is [necessary] to bring your student ID card to the exam.
examples.cn: 考试时[必须]带学生证。

examples.en: Regular exercise is [necessary] for maintaining good health.
examples.cn: 定期锻炼对于保持良好健康是[必要的]。

examples.en: It is [necessary] to review your notes after each lesson.
examples.cn: 每节课后复习笔记是[必要的]。

examples.en: Food, water, and shelter are [necessary] for survival.
examples.cn: 食物、水和住所是生存的[必需品]。

examples.en: Is it [necessary] to book seats in advance for the school concert?
examples.cn: 学校音乐会是否[必要]提前预订座位？

words.translation: n. 脖子, 衣领, 颈\nvi. 拥抱, 拥吻, 收缩\nvt. 割颈
words.definition:
n. the part of an organism (human or animal) that connects the head to the rest of the body
n. a narrow elongated projecting strip of land
n. a cut of meat from the neck of an animal
n. a narrow part of an artifact that resembles a neck in position or form

examples.en: She wore a beautiful necklace around her [neck].
examples.cn: 她脖子上戴着一条漂亮的项链。

examples.en: He had a sore [neck] after sleeping in a bad position.
examples.cn: 他睡姿不好，[脖子]酸痛。

examples.en: The [neck] of the bottle was too narrow for a spoon.
examples.cn: 瓶子的[瓶颈]太窄，勺子放不进去。

examples.en: Giraffes have very long [necks] to help them reach tall trees.
examples.cn: 长颈鹿有很长的[脖子]帮助它们够到高大的树木。

examples.en: Please turn your [neck] slowly to the left and then to the right.
examples.cn: 请慢慢地把你的[脖子]转向左边，再转向右边。

words.translation:
n. 需要, 必须, 缺乏
vt. 需要, 必需
vi. 贫困, 有必要
aux. 需要
words.definition: n. a condition requiring relief\nn. anything that is necessary but lacking\nv. have or feel a need for

examples.en: I [need] more time to finish this essay properly.
examples.cn: 我[需要]更多时间来好好完成这篇文章。

examples.en: Plants [need] sunlight and water to grow well.
examples.cn: 植物[需要]阳光和水才能生长良好。

examples.en: There is no [need] to worry — the exam is not until next week.
examples.cn: 不[必要]担心——考试到下周才有。

examples.en: You [need] to practice speaking English every day to improve.
examples.cn: 你[需要]每天练习说英语才能提高。

examples.en: The school provides books to students in [need].
examples.cn: 学校为有[需要]的学生提供书籍。

words.translation: n. 邻居, 邻接的东西, 邻国, 邻座, 邻人, 世人\na. 邻接的, 邻近的\nvi.vt. 邻近, 与...结邻, 邻接
words.definition:
n a person who lives (or is located) near another
n a nearby object of the same kind
v live or be located as a neighbor
v be located near or adjacent to

examples.en: Our [neighbour] always waves hello when she sees us in the morning.
examples.cn: 我们的[邻居]每天早上看到我们时总是挥手打招呼。

examples.en: We helped our [neighbour] carry her groceries up the stairs.
examples.cn: 我们帮助[邻居]把她的杂货搬上楼梯。

examples.en: China and Russia are [neighbours] — they share a long border.
examples.cn: 中国和俄罗斯是[邻国]——它们共有一条很长的边界。

examples.en: Being a good [neighbour] means being kind and helpful to those near you.
examples.cn: 做一个好[邻居]意味着对身边的人友善和乐于助人。

examples.en: My [neighbour] in class always shares notes when I am absent.
examples.cn: 我班上的[邻桌]在我缺席时总是分享笔记给我。

words.translation:
adv. 皆不, 两个都不
a. (两者)都不的
pron. 两者都不
conj. 既非, 既不
words.definition: s. not either; not one or the other

examples.en: [Neither] of the two answers is correct — try again.
examples.cn: 两个答案都[不]正确——再试一次。

examples.en: I like [neither] coffee nor tea — I prefer water.
examples.cn: 我[既不]喜欢咖啡[也不]喜欢茶——我更喜欢水。

examples.en: She does not play basketball, and [neither] does her sister.
examples.cn: 她不打篮球，她姐姐[也不]打。

examples.en: [Neither] student remembered to bring the permission slip.
examples.cn: 两个学生[都没有]记得带许可单。

examples.en: He could [neither] read nor write when he first started school.
examples.cn: 他刚上学时[既]不会读[也]不会写。

words.translation: a. 神经紧张的, 不安的, 神经的\n[医] 神经的; 神经质的, 神经过敏的
words.definition: s. easily agitated\na. of or relating to the nervous system

examples.en: She felt very [nervous] before going on stage to perform.
examples.cn: 她在上台表演之前感到非常[紧张]。

examples.en: He was [nervous] about meeting new people at the school party.
examples.cn: 他对在学校派对上认识新朋友感到[紧张]。

examples.sense: adj. 神经质的，容易紧张的
examples.en: The [nervous] cat hid under the bed when it heard loud thunder.
examples.cn: [紧张的]猫听到响亮的雷声时躲在床底下。

examples.en: Take a deep breath if you feel [nervous] before the speech.
examples.cn: 如果演讲前感到[紧张]，深呼吸一下。

examples.en: The brain is the centre of the [nervous] system.
examples.cn: 大脑是[神经]系统的中枢。

words.translation: adv. 从不, 决不, 不曾\n[法] 永不, 决不, 从来没有
words.definition: r. not ever; at no time in the past or future\nr. not at all; certainly not; not in any circumstances

examples.en: She [never] forgets to do her homework before going to bed.
examples.cn: 她睡前[从不]忘记做作业。

examples.en: I have [never] been to a foreign country before.
examples.cn: 我[从未]去过外国。

examples.en: [Never] give up on your dreams, no matter how hard it gets.
examples.cn: [绝不]放弃你的梦想，无论多么艰难。

examples.en: He has [never] missed a single day of school in three years.
examples.cn: 他三年来[从未]缺席过一天学校。

examples.en: [Never] be rude to your teachers or elders.
examples.cn: [绝不]对老师或长辈无礼。

words.translation: a. 新的, 陌生的, 最近的, 不熟悉的\n[法] 新发现的, 新的, 重新开始的
words.definition:
a. not of long duration; having just (or relatively recently) come into being or been made or acquired or discovered
s. having no previous example or precedent or parallel
s. other than the former one(s); different
a. unaffected by use or exposure

examples.en: She got a [new] bicycle for her birthday and rode it all day.
examples.cn: 她生日时得到了一辆[新]自行车，骑了一整天。

examples.en: The school opened a [new] library with thousands of books.
examples.cn: 学校开设了一座拥有数千本书的[新]图书馆。

examples.en: The [new] student sat quietly and listened carefully in class.
examples.cn: [新来的]学生安静地坐着，在课堂上认真听讲。

examples.en: The teacher tried a [new] method to explain the difficult grammar rule.
examples.cn: 老师尝试了一种[新颖的]方法来解释这个难的语法规则。

examples.en: Happy [New] Year! I hope this year brings you good luck.
examples.cn: [新]年快乐！希望今年给你带来好运。

words.translation: n. 新闻, 消息, 报导\n[法] 新闻, 消息, 新闻报导
words.definition: n. information about recent and important events\nn. information reported in a newspaper or news magazine\nn. informal information of any kind that is not previously known to someone

examples.en: Have you heard the [news]? Our school won the national science award!
examples.cn: 你听说了吗？我们学校获得了全国科学奖！

examples.en: My parents watch the evening [news] every day after dinner.
examples.cn: 我父母每天晚饭后看晚间[新闻]。

examples.en: She called her family to share the good [news] about her exam results.
examples.cn: 她打电话给家人分享关于考试成绩的好[消息]。

examples.en: The [news] reported that a new park would be built in our area.
examples.cn: [新闻]报道说我们地区将建一个新公园。

examples.en: No [news] is good news — don't worry if you haven't heard back yet.
examples.cn: 没[消息]就是好消息——如果你还没收到回复，不要担心。

words.translation: n. 报纸
words.definition:
n. a daily or weekly publication on folded sheets; contains news and articles and advertisements
n. a business firm that publishes newspapers
n. the physical object that is the product of a newspaper publisher
n. cheap paper made from wood pulp and used for printing newspapers

examples.en: My grandfather reads the [newspaper] every morning with his tea.
examples.cn: 我爷爷每天早上喝茶时看[报纸]。

examples.en: She wrapped the fragile gift in old [newspaper] to protect it.
examples.cn: 她用旧[报纸]包裹了易碎的礼物以保护它。

examples.en: The school publishes a [newspaper] written entirely by students.
examples.cn: 学校出版一份完全由学生撰写的[报纸]。

examples.en: He found an interesting article in today's [newspaper] about space travel.
examples.cn: 他在今天的[报纸]上发现了一篇关于太空旅行的有趣文章。

examples.en: She dreams of working for a big [newspaper] when she grows up.
examples.cn: 她梦想长大后为一家大[报社]工作。

words.translation:
n. 下一个
a. 下一个的, 其次的, 贴近的
adv. 然后, 下次, 次于
[计] 近邻干扰
words.definition: r. at the time or occasion immediately following

examples.en: The [next] lesson will be about the water cycle.
examples.cn: [下一节]课将讲水循环。

examples.en: She finished first and [next] came her best friend.
examples.cn: 她第一个完成，[接下来]是她的最好朋友。

examples.en: The [next] classroom is for Grade Seven students.
examples.cn: [隔壁]教室是七年级学生的。

examples.en: First, read the instructions. [Next], complete the exercises.
examples.cn: 首先，阅读说明。[接下来]，完成练习。

examples.en: I am looking forward to our [next] meeting with the science club.
examples.cn: 我期待着我们[下一次]科学俱乐部的会议。

words.translation: a. 美好的, 和蔼的, 正派的, 做得好的, 精密的, 细微的, 挑剔的, 谨慎的
words.definition: n. a city in southeastern France on the Mediterranean; the leading resort on the French Riviera\na. pleasant or pleasing or agreeable in nature or appearance\ns. done with delicacy and skill

examples.en: What a [nice] day! Let us have lunch outside in the garden.
examples.cn: 多么[好]的天气！我们去花园里在外面吃午饭吧。

examples.en: She had a [nice] time at the birthday party with her classmates.
examples.cn: 她和同学们在生日派对上玩得很[开心]。

examples.en: He is very [nice] to everyone and always ready to help.
examples.cn: 他对每个人都很[友善]，随时乐于帮忙。

examples.en: There is a [nice] difference between the two words that learners often miss.
examples.cn: 这两个词之间有一个学习者经常忽略的[微妙]区别。

examples.en: You look very [nice] in your new school uniform today.
examples.cn: 你今天穿新校服看起来非常[好看]。

words.translation: n. 夜, 夜晚, 晚上, 黑暗, 夜晚的工作\n[法] 夜, 黑夜, 黑暗
words.definition:
n. the time after sunset and before sunrise while it is dark outside
n. a period of ignorance or backwardness or gloom
n. the period spent sleeping
n. the dark part of the diurnal cycle considered a time unit

examples.en: She stays up late at [night] to study for her exams.
examples.cn: 她[夜晚]熬夜学习备考。

examples.en: Last [night], I had a very strange dream about flying.
examples.cn: 昨[晚]，我做了一个关于飞翔的奇怪梦。

examples.en: The sky is full of stars on a clear [night] in the countryside.
examples.cn: 在农村晴朗的[夜晚]，天空布满了星星。

examples.en: Good [night]! Sleep well and rest for tomorrow's big game.
examples.cn: 晚[安]！好好休息，为明天的大比赛养精蓄锐。

examples.en: Owls are active at [night] and sleep during the day.
examples.cn: 猫头鹰在[夜晚]活动，白天睡觉。

words.translation: num. 九, 九个
words.definition: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of eight and one\ns. denoting a quantity consisting of one more than eight and one less than ten

examples.en: She has [nine] goldfish in a large tank in her bedroom.
examples.cn: 她卧室里的大鱼缸里有[九]条金鱼。

examples.en: Class starts at [nine] o'clock sharp every morning.
examples.cn: 每天早上[九]点整开始上课。

examples.en: There are [nine] players on each side in a baseball game.
examples.cn: 棒球比赛中每队有[九]名球员。

examples.en: She scored [nine] out of ten on her spelling test.
examples.cn: 她拼写测试得了十分之[九]。

examples.en: The library closes at [nine] in the evening on weekdays.
examples.cn: 图书馆工作日晚上[九]点关门。

words.translation: num. 十九, 十九个
words.definition: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of eighteen and one\ns. being one more than eighteen

examples.en: She is [nineteen] years old and just started university.
examples.cn: 她[十九]岁，刚开始上大学。

examples.en: He needs [nineteen] more points to win the game.
examples.cn: 他还需要[十九]分才能赢得比赛。

examples.en: There are [nineteen] students in our small English class.
examples.cn: 我们小英语班里有[十九]名学生。

examples.en: He finished reading the book in just [nineteen] days.
examples.cn: 他在[十九]天内读完了这本书。

examples.en: The bus arrives at [nineteen] minutes past eight every morning.
examples.cn: 公共汽车每天早上八点[十九]分到达。

words.translation: num. 九十, 九十个
words.definition: n. the cardinal number that is the product of ten and nine\ns. being ten more than eighty

examples.en: My great-grandfather is [ninety] years old but still very healthy.
examples.cn: 我曾祖父[九十]岁了，但仍然非常健康。

examples.en: The exam lasts [ninety] minutes, so manage your time carefully.
examples.cn: 考试持续[九十]分钟，所以要仔细安排时间。

examples.en: The school has [ninety] teachers and over a thousand students.
examples.cn: 学校有[九十]名老师和一千多名学生。

examples.en: She read [ninety] English books during the summer vacation.
examples.cn: 她在暑假期间读了[九十]本英文书。

examples.en: The temperature reached [ninety] degrees Fahrenheit in summer.
examples.cn: 夏天气温达到了[九十]华氏度。

words.translation: num. 第九, 九分之一
words.definition: n. position nine in a countable series of things\ns. coming next after the eighth and just before the tenth in position

examples.en: She came [ninth] in the running race out of fifty students.
examples.cn: 她在五十名学生的跑步比赛中获得了[第九]名。

examples.en: Today is the [ninth] of October, which is a national holiday.
examples.cn: 今天是十月[九]日，是国家假日。

examples.en: The [ninth] chapter of the book is the most exciting part.
examples.cn: 这本书的[第九]章是最令人兴奋的部分。

examples.en: He sat in the [ninth] row from the front in the cinema.
examples.cn: 他坐在电影院从前面数[第九]排。

examples.en: This is the [ninth] time she has won the first prize in the art contest.
examples.cn: 这是她[第九]次赢得艺术比赛一等奖。

words.translation: n. 不, 拒绝, 否决票\na. 没有, 不是, 绝非\nadv. 不
words.definition:
n. a negative
a. quantifier; used with either mass nouns or plural count nouns for indicating a complete or almost complete lack or zero quantity of
r. referring to the degree to which a certain quality is present
r. not in any degree or manner; not at all

examples.en: There is [no] water left in the bottle — please buy more.
examples.cn: 瓶子里[没有]水了——请再买一些。

examples.en: [No], I have not finished my homework yet.
examples.cn: [不]，我还没有完成作业。

examples.en: I have [no] idea what the answer to this question is.
examples.cn: 我[不知道]这个问题的答案是什么。

examples.en: The sign says [No] Smoking inside the school building.
examples.cn: 标志上写着学校大楼内[禁止]吸烟。

examples.en: She said [no] when asked if she wanted more food.
examples.cn: 当被问到是否想要更多食物时，她说[不]。

words.translation: n. 小人物, 无名小卒\npron. 无人, 没有人
words.definition: n a person of no influence

examples.en: [Nobody] in the class knew the answer to the teacher's question.
examples.cn: 班里[没有人]知道老师问题的答案。

examples.en: [Nobody] wants to be left out when the class does activities together.
examples.cn: 全班一起活动时，[没有人]愿意被排除在外。

examples.en: I knocked on the door but [nobody] answered.
examples.cn: 我敲了门，但[没有人]回应。

examples.en: [Nobody] told me that the exam had been moved to Thursday.
examples.cn: [没有人]告诉我考试已改到周四。

examples.en: He started from [nobody] and worked hard to become a champion.
examples.cn: 他从[无名小卒]起步，努力奋斗成为了冠军。

words.translation: n. 点头, 打盹, 晃动\nvi. 点头, 打盹\nvt. 点头表示, 点(头)
words.definition:
n. a sign of assent or salutation or command
n. the act of nodding the head
v. express or signify by nodding
v. lower and raise the head, as to indicate assent or agreement or confirmation

examples.en: She [nodded] to show that she understood what the teacher said.
examples.cn: 她[点头]表示理解老师说的话。

examples.en: He [nodded] in agreement when the teacher asked if everyone was ready.
examples.cn: 当老师问大家是否准备好时，他[点头]表示同意。

examples.en: He [nodded] off during the long lecture and missed the important point.
examples.cn: 他在长时间的讲座中[打盹]，错过了重要的内容。

examples.en: With a [nod] of his head, the teacher gave permission to leave.
examples.cn: 老师[点头]表示允许离开。

examples.en: She [nodded] at her friend to signal that it was time to go.
examples.cn: 她向朋友[点头]示意，表示该走了。

words.translation:
n. 噪音, 杂音, 响声, 喧闹
vt. 谣传
vi. 喧闹
[计] 噪声
words.definition:
n. sound of any kind (especially unintelligible or dissonant sound)
n. the auditory experience of sound that lacks musical quality; sound that is a disagreeable auditory experience
n. electrical or acoustic activity that can disturb communication
n. a loud outcry of protest or complaint

examples.en: The [noise] from the construction outside made it hard to study.
examples.cn: 外面施工的[噪音]让学习变得很困难。

examples.en: Please stop making so much [noise] — people are trying to sleep!
examples.cn: 请不要制造这么多[噪音]——人们正在试图入睡！

examples.en: I heard a strange [noise] coming from the kitchen last night.
examples.cn: 我昨晚听到厨房里传来一个奇怪的[声响]。

examples.en: The crowd made a lot of [noise] when the team scored a goal.
examples.cn: 球队进球时，人群发出了很大的[欢呼声]。

examples.en: [Noise] pollution in cities can affect people's health and sleep.
examples.cn: 城市中的[噪音]污染会影响人们的健康和睡眠。

words.translation: adv. 一点也不, 毫不\npron. 没有人, 无一物, 并无一个\na. 没有的
words.definition:
n. a canonical hour that is the ninth hour of the day counting from sunrise
n. a service in the Roman Catholic Church formerly read or chanted at 3 PM (the ninth hour counting from sunrise) but now somewhat earlier
s. not any
r. not at all or in no way

examples.en: [None] of the students forgot to bring their textbooks today.
examples.cn: 今天[没有]一个学生忘记带课本。

examples.en: I wanted some cake, but [none] was left after the party.
examples.cn: 我想要一些蛋糕，但派对后[什么也没有]剩下。

examples.en: [None] of my friends have ever visited another country.
examples.cn: 我的朋友中[没有一个]曾经去过其他国家。

examples.en: She tried all the solutions but [none] of them worked.
examples.cn: 她尝试了所有的解决方案，但[没有一个]有效。

examples.en: There is [none] of the homework left — I finished it all last night.
examples.cn: 作业[一点也没有]剩下——我昨晚全都做完了。

words.translation: n. 面条, 笨蛋
words.definition: n. a ribbonlike strip of pasta

examples.en: I had a bowl of hot [noodle] soup for breakfast this morning.
examples.cn: 我今天早上吃了一碗热[面条]汤。

examples.en: Mom cooked [noodles] with vegetables and chicken for dinner.
examples.cn: 妈妈做了蔬菜鸡肉[面条]当晚餐。

examples.en: In China, eating long [noodles] on birthdays is a tradition.
examples.cn: 在中国，生日时吃长[面条]是一种传统。

examples.en: Instant [noodles] are quick to cook but not very nutritious.
examples.cn: 方便[面条]煮起来快，但营养不太丰富。

examples.en: She made homemade [noodles] by hand with her grandmother.
examples.cn: 她和奶奶一起手工制作了[面条]。

words.translation: n. 正午, 中午, 全盛期
words.definition: n. the middle of the day

examples.en: We have a one-hour lunch break at [noon] every school day.
examples.cn: 每个上学日[中午]我们有一小时的午休。

examples.en: The school gates open at [noon] for students to go home for lunch.
examples.cn: 学校大门在[中午]打开，供学生回家吃午饭。

examples.en: The sun is at its highest point in the sky at [noon].
examples.cn: [正午]时太阳在天空中处于最高点。

examples.en: They agreed to meet at the school gate at [noon] on Saturday.
examples.cn: 他们同意周六[中午]在学校门口见面。

examples.en: By [noon], the temperature had risen to thirty degrees.
examples.cn: 到[中午]，气温已经上升到三十度。

words.translation: conj. 也不, 也没有\n[计] 或非
words.definition:
conj. A negative connective or particle, introducing the second
   member or clause of a negative proposition, following neither, or not,
   in the first member or clause (as or in affirmative propositions
   follows either). Nor is also used sometimes in the first member for
   neither, and sometimes the neither is omitted and implied by the use of
   nor.

examples.en: She can [neither] swim [nor] ride a bicycle yet.
examples.cn: 她[既]不会游泳[也]不会骑自行车。

examples.en: He did not eat breakfast, [nor] did he eat lunch that day.
examples.cn: 他那天没有吃早饭，[也]没有吃午饭。

examples.en: I do not like spicy food, [nor] does my little sister.
examples.cn: 我不喜欢辣食，我妹妹[也不]喜欢。

examples.en: The package was [neither] large [nor] heavy, so I carried it easily.
examples.cn: 这个包裹[既]不大[也]不重，所以我轻松地搬运了它。

examples.en: She did not complain, [nor] did she ask for help.
examples.cn: 她没有抱怨，[也]没有寻求帮助。

words.translation: n. 常态, 标准, 正常, 普通\na. 正常的, 正规的, 标准的, 师范的, 正态的\n[计] 标准, 普通
words.definition:
a. conforming with or constituting a norm or standard or level or type or social norm; not abnormal
a. in accordance with scientific laws
a. being approximately average or within certain limits in e.g. intelligence and development
s. forming a right angle

examples.en: It is [normal] to feel tired after a long day at school.
examples.cn: 在学校度过漫长的一天后感到疲惫是[正常的]。

examples.en: His temperature is back to [normal] after the fever broke.
examples.cn: 发烧退后，他的体温恢复到了[正常]水平。

examples.en: Under [normal] conditions, the bus arrives on time.
examples.cn: 在[正常]情况下，公共汽车准时到达。

examples.en: It is [normal] for children to be curious about everything.
examples.cn: 孩子们对一切事物感到好奇是[正常的]。

examples.en: Life returned to [normal] after the long holidays ended.
examples.cn: 漫长的假期结束后，生活恢复了[正常]。

words.translation: n. 北方, 北\na. 北的, 北方的\nadv. 向北方, 在北方
words.definition:
n. the region of the United States lying to the north of the Mason-Dixon line
n. the cardinal compass point that is at 0 or 360 degrees
n. a location in the northern part of a country, region, or city
n. the direction corresponding to the northward cardinal compass point

examples.en: Beijing is in the [north] of China.
examples.cn: 北京在中国的[北方]。

examples.en: The wind is blowing from the [north] and it feels very cold.
examples.cn: 风从[北方]吹来，感觉非常冷。

examples.en: The birds fly [north] when spring arrives.
examples.cn: 春天到来时，鸟儿向[北方]飞去。

examples.en: The [north] gate of the school is usually closed after six.
examples.cn: 学校的[北]门通常在六点后关闭。

examples.en: Snow is common in the [north] during winter.
examples.cn: 冬天[北方]经常下雪。

words.translation: n. 北方人\na. 北方的, 向北的, 自北方来的
words.definition: n. a dialect of Middle English that developed into Scottish Lallans\na. in or characteristic of a region of the United States north of (approximately) the Mason-Dixon line\na. situated in or coming from regions of the north

examples.en: [Northern] China has cold winters with heavy snow.
examples.cn: [北方]中国有寒冷、大雪纷飞的冬天。

examples.en: The [northern] part of the city has many old historical buildings.
examples.cn: 城市的[北部]有许多古老的历史建筑。

examples.en: People in [northern] regions often eat dumplings in winter.
examples.cn: [北方]地区的人在冬天常常吃饺子。

examples.en: The [northern] border of the country is covered with dense forests.
examples.cn: 这个国家的[北部]边界覆盖着茂密的森林。

examples.en: The [northern] dialect is very different from the southern one.
examples.cn: [北方]方言与南方方言非常不同。

words.translation: n. 鼻子, 突出部分, 嗅觉\nvt. 嗅到, 探出, 用鼻子触\nvi. 闻, 嗅, 探听, 告密
words.definition:
n. the organ of smell and entrance to the respiratory tract; the prominent part of the face of man or other mammals
n. a front that resembles a human nose (especially the front of an aircraft)
n. the front or forward projection of a tool or weapon
n. a small distance

examples.en: She blew her [nose] into a tissue because she had a cold.
examples.cn: 她因为感冒用纸巾擤了[鼻子]。

examples.en: The dog followed the scent with its [nose] to find the hidden toy.
examples.cn: 狗用[鼻子]追踪气味，找到了藏起来的玩具。

examples.en: She has a good [nose] for finding the freshest fruit at the market.
examples.cn: 她有敏锐的[嗅觉]，善于在市场上找到最新鲜的水果。

examples.en: The clown had a round red [nose] that made all the children laugh.
examples.cn: 小丑有一个圆圆的红[鼻子]，让所有孩子都笑了。

examples.en: Cover your [nose] and mouth when you sneeze or cough.
examples.cn: 打喷嚏或咳嗽时要遮住[鼻子]和嘴巴。

words.translation: adv. 不, 非, 未\n[计] 非
words.definition: r. negation of a word or group of words

examples.en: She did [not] finish her dinner because she was not hungry.
examples.cn: 她[没有]吃完晚饭，因为她不饿。

examples.en: Do [not] run in the school corridor — it is dangerous.
examples.cn: [不要]在学校走廊里跑——这很危险。

examples.en: He is [not] very good at drawing, but he enjoys it.
examples.cn: 他不太擅长画画，但他很喜欢。

examples.en: Why [not] try a different approach to solve the problem?
examples.cn: 为什么[不]尝试用不同的方法来解决问题？

examples.en: She told me [not] to worry about the exam results.
examples.cn: 她告诉我[不要]担心考试成绩。

words.translation: n. 笔记, 记录, 注解, 票据, 符号, 显要, 注重, 便笺, 照会\nvt. 记录, 注解, 注意
words.definition:
n. a brief written record
n. a short personal letter
n. a notation representing the pitch and duration of a musical sound
n. a tone of voice that shows what the speaker is feeling

examples.en: She took careful [notes] during the science lecture.
examples.cn: 她在科学讲座期间认真地做了[笔记]。

examples.en: He left a [note] on the desk for his teacher explaining his absence.
examples.cn: 他在桌子上留了一张[便条]给老师，解释他缺席的原因。

examples.en: Please [note] that the exam will start at exactly nine o'clock.
examples.cn: 请[注意]考试将在九点整开始。

examples.en: She played the wrong [note] during the piano performance.
examples.cn: 她在钢琴演奏中弹错了一个[音符]。

examples.en: He paid for the book with a fifty-yuan [note].
examples.cn: 他用一张五十元的[钞票]买了这本书。

words.translation: n. 笔记本, 手册, 期票簿
words.definition: n. a book with blank pages for recording notes or memoranda\nn. a small compact portable computer

examples.en: She writes all new vocabulary words in her [notebook].
examples.cn: 她把所有新词汇写在[笔记本]里。

examples.en: Please buy a new [notebook] for the new school term.
examples.cn: 请为新学期买一本新[笔记本]。

examples.en: He uses a [notebook] computer to do his homework every evening.
examples.cn: 他每天晚上用[笔记本]电脑做作业。

examples.en: The teacher checked our [notebooks] to make sure we had done the work.
examples.cn: 老师检查了我们的[笔记本]，确保我们已经完成了作业。

examples.en: She filled her [notebook] with drawings and poems during the holiday.
examples.cn: 假期里，她在[笔记本]上画了很多画，写了很多诗。

words.translation: n. 无, 不关紧要之事, 零\nadv. 毫不, 决不\ninterj. 什么也没有, 无
words.definition: n. a quantity of no importance\nr. in no respect; to no degree

examples.sense: pron. 没有什么，什么也没有
examples.en: There was [nothing] left in the fridge after the party.
examples.cn: 派对结束后，冰箱里[什么都没有]了。

examples.en: I have [nothing] to do this afternoon, so I will read a book.
examples.cn: 今天下午我[没有]什么事情，所以我要读本书。

examples.sense: pron. 没什么，不重要的事
examples.en: It is [nothing] serious — just a small cut on my finger.
examples.cn: 这[没什么]大不了——只是手指上的一个小伤口。

examples.en: She heard a loud noise but found [nothing] unusual in the room.
examples.cn: 她听到一声响，但在房间里发现[什么也没有]异常。

examples.en: Do [nothing] until the teacher gives you the signal to start.
examples.cn: 在老师发出开始信号之前[什么都不要]做。

words.translation: n. 注意, 布告, 通知, 预告, 短评\nvt. 注意, 通知, 评论, 提及, 关注\nvi. 注意
words.definition:
n. an announcement containing information about an event
n. the act of noticing or paying attention
n. advance notification (usually written) of the intention to withdraw from an arrangement of contract
n. polite or favorable attention

examples.en: Did you [notice] that the teacher changed the seating arrangement?
examples.cn: 你[注意到]老师改变了座位安排了吗？

examples.en: I [noticed] that she looked sad, so I asked if she was okay.
examples.cn: 我[注意到]她看起来很难过，所以我问她是否还好。

examples.en: There is a [notice] on the board about the school sports day.
examples.cn: 公告栏上有一张关于学校运动日的[通知]。

examples.en: The exam was cancelled at short [notice], which surprised everyone.
examples.cn: 考试在短时间内被取消，这让所有人都感到惊讶。

examples.en: Please [notice] the difference between these two similar words.
examples.cn: 请[注意]这两个相似单词之间的区别。

words.translation: n. 十一月
words.definition: n. the month following October and preceding December

examples.en: Her birthday is on the fifteenth of [November].
examples.cn: 她的生日是[十一月]十五日。

examples.en: In [November], the leaves turn yellow and fall from the trees.
examples.cn: [十一月]，树叶变黄从树上落下。

examples.en: The school concert is scheduled for the last Friday of [November].
examples.cn: 学校音乐会定于[十一月]的最后一个星期五举行。

examples.en: [November] is the eleventh month of the year.
examples.cn: [十一月]是一年中的第十一个月。

examples.en: The weather gets much colder in [November] in northern China.
examples.cn: 在中国北方，[十一月]天气变得更加寒冷。

words.translation:
adv. 现在, 刚才, 目前
n. 现在
a. 现在的
conj. 由于
words.definition:
n. the momentary present
r. in the historical present; at this point in the narration of a series of past events
r. used to preface a command or reproof or request
r. at the present moment

examples.en: I am studying English [now] and will play outside later.
examples.cn: 我[现在]在学英语，等一会儿再出去玩。

examples.en: [Now] is the best time to review your notes before the exam.
examples.cn: [现在]是考试前复习笔记的最佳时机。

examples.en: Please come to the teacher's office right [now].
examples.cn: 请[立刻]来老师的办公室。

examples.en: [Now] that you have finished eating, please help wash the dishes.
examples.cn: [既然]你已经吃完了，请帮忙洗碗。

examples.en: She was [now] confident enough to speak English in front of everyone.
examples.cn: 她[现在]有足够的信心在所有人面前说英语了。

words.translation:
n. 数, 数字, 数目, 号码
vt. 数, 计算, 共计
vi. 计算, 报数
[计] 数字
words.definition:
n. the property possessed by a sum or total or indefinite quantity of units or individuals
n. a concept of quantity involving zero and units
n. a select company of people
n. a numeral or string of numerals that is used for identification

examples.en: Please write your student [number] at the top of the exam paper.
examples.cn: 请把你的学生[编号]写在试卷的顶部。

examples.en: The [number] of students in our class is thirty-two.
examples.cn: 我们班的学生[人数]是三十二人。

examples.en: Do you have the phone [number] for the school office?
examples.cn: 你有学校办公室的电话[号码]吗？

examples.en: The teacher [numbered] the questions from one to twenty.
examples.cn: 老师将问题从一到二十进行了[编号]。

examples.en: A [number] of students stayed after class to ask questions.
examples.cn: [一些]学生留下来课后提问。

words.translation: n. 护士, 保姆, 奶妈\nvt. 看护, 照顾, 培养\nvi. 喂奶, 看护病人
words.definition:
n. one skilled in caring for young children or the sick (usually under the supervision of a physician)
v. try to cure by special care of treatment, of an illness or injury
v. serve as a nurse; care for sick or handicapped people
v. treat carefully

examples.en: The school [nurse] helped me when I hurt my knee during PE class.
examples.cn: 体育课时我膝盖受伤，学校[护士]帮助了我。

examples.en: She wants to become a [nurse] because she loves taking care of people.
examples.cn: 她想成为一名[护士]，因为她热爱照顾人。

examples.en: She [nursed] her sick cat back to health with great care.
examples.cn: 她悉心[护理]她生病的猫，使其康复。

examples.en: The [nurse] took my temperature and blood pressure at the clinic.
examples.cn: [护士]在诊所给我量了体温和血压。

examples.en: He [nursed] a cold for a week by resting and drinking hot tea.
examples.cn: 他通过休息和喝热茶[调养]了一周的感冒。

words.translation:
n. 物体, 目标, 目的, 对象, 宾语, 客体
vi. 反对, 抱反感
vt. 提出...来反对
[计] 对象
words.definition:
n. a tangible and visible entity; an entity that can cast a shadow
n. (grammar) a constituent that is acted upon
n. the focus of cognitions or feelings
n. (computing) a discrete item that provides a description of virtually anything known to a computer

examples.en: The teacher placed several [objects] on the table for us to describe.
examples.cn: 老师在桌子上放了几个[物体]让我们描述。

examples.en: The [object] of this game is to collect as many points as possible.
examples.cn: 这个游戏的[目标]是尽可能多地收集积分。

examples.en: Several parents [objected] to the new school rules about phones.
examples.cn: 几位家长[反对]关于手机的新校规。

examples.en: In the sentence, the word me is the [object] of the verb.
examples.cn: 在这个句子中，单词me是动词的[宾语]。

examples.en: She [objected] when her brother took her book without asking.
examples.cn: 她的兄弟未经询问就拿走了她的书，她表示[反对]。

words.translation: n. 海洋, 广阔, 许多, 一大片\n[法] 海洋, 海
words.definition: n. a large body of water constituting a principal part of the hydrosphere\nn. anything apparently limitless in quantity or volume

examples.en: The Pacific is the largest [ocean] in the world.
examples.cn: 太平洋是世界上最大的[海洋]。

examples.en: Many sea creatures live deep in the [ocean] where light cannot reach.
examples.cn: 许多海洋生物生活在光线无法到达的[海洋]深处。

examples.en: Plastic pollution is a serious threat to our [oceans].
examples.cn: 塑料污染对我们的[海洋]是严重威胁。

examples.en: She had an [ocean] of ideas for her school science project.
examples.cn: 她对学校科学项目有[无数]的想法。

examples.en: The fishermen sailed far out to [ocean] to find fish.
examples.cn: 渔民们远航到[海洋]中寻找鱼。

words.translation: n. 十月
words.definition: n. the month following September and preceding November

examples.en: China's National Day is on the first of [October].
examples.cn: 中国国庆节在[十月]一日。

examples.en: The weather gets cooler in [October] and leaves start to change color.
examples.cn: [十月]天气变凉，树叶开始变色。

examples.en: The school exams are usually held in [October] and April each year.
examples.cn: 学校考试通常每年在[十月]和四月举行。

examples.en: [October] is the tenth month of the year.
examples.cn: [十月]是一年中的第十个月。

examples.en: My family goes on a trip every year during the [October] holiday.
examples.cn: 我家每年在[十月]长假期间都会出去旅行。

words.translation: prep. 的, 属于
words.definition:
prep. In a general sense, from, or out from; proceeding from;
   belonging to; relating to; concerning; -- used in a variety of
   applications; as:
prep. Denoting that from which anything proceeds; indicating
   origin, source, descent, and the like; as, he is of a race of kings; he
   is of noble blood.
prep. Denoting possession or ownership, or the relation of subject
   to attribute; as, the apartment of the consul: the power of the king; a
   man of courage; the gate of heaven.
prep. Denoting the material of which anything is composed, or that
   which it contains; as, a throne of gold; a sword of steel; a wreath of
   mist; a cup of water.
prep. Denoting part of an aggregate or whole; belonging to a
   number or quantity mentioned; out of; from amongst; as, of this little
   he had some to spare; some of the mines were unproductive; most of the
   company.
prep. Denoting that by which a person or thing is actuated or
   impelled; also, the source of a purpose or action; as, they went of
   their own will; no body can move of itself; he did it of necessity.
prep. Denoting reference to a thing; about; concerning; relating
   to; as, to boast of one's achievements.
prep. Denoting nearness or distance, either in space or time;
   from; as, within a league of the town; within an hour of the appointed
   time.
prep. Denoting identity or equivalence; -- used with a name or
   appellation, and equivalent to the relation of apposition; as, the
   continent of America; the city of Rome; the Island of Cuba.
prep. Denoting the agent, or person by whom, or thing by which,
   anything is, or is done; by.
prep. Denoting relation to place or time; belonging to, or
   connected with; as, men of Athens; the people of the Middle Ages; in
   the days of Herod.
prep. Denoting passage from one state to another; from.
prep. During; in the course of.

examples.en: The colour [of] the sky is bright blue today.
examples.cn: 今天天空[的]颜色是明亮的蓝色。

examples.en: She is one [of] the best students in our class.
examples.cn: 她是我们班最优秀[的]学生之一。

examples.en: This necklace is made [of] silver and looks very beautiful.
examples.cn: 这条项链是[由]银制成的，看起来非常漂亮。

examples.en: She told us a story [of] a brave boy who saved his village.
examples.cn: 她给我们讲了一个关[于]一个勇敢男孩拯救村庄的故事。

examples.en: He is the tallest [of] all the boys in his grade.
examples.cn: 他是他年级所有男生[中]最高的。

words.translation:
a. 关着的, 不再生效的, 处于...境况的, 休假的, 空闲的
adv. 走开, ...掉, ...下, 休息, 出发, 隔断
prep. 离开, 脱落, 不在从事......, 在...之外
vi. 离开, 滚开
vt. 杀死
n. 关闭状态
[计] 关闭, 清屏命令
words.definition:
a. not in operation or operational
s. below a satisfactory level
a. (of events) no longer planned or scheduled
s. in an unpalatable state

examples.en: Please turn [off] the lights when you leave the classroom.
examples.cn: 离开教室时请关[掉]灯。

examples.en: Take [off] your shoes before entering the house.
examples.cn: 进屋前请脱[掉]你的鞋子。

examples.en: They set [off] early in the morning to catch the first train.
examples.cn: 他们一大早就出发，赶第一班火车。

examples.en: The button fell [off] my school jacket during PE class.
examples.cn: 体育课时，我校服上的纽扣掉[落]了。

examples.en: She has a day [off] school tomorrow because of a doctor's appointment.
examples.cn: 她明天因为要看医生而[休一天]学。

words.translation: n. 给予(物), 出价, 提议, 意图, 报价\nvt. 提供, 出价, 奉献, 试图, 使出现, 演出\nvi. 出现, 献祭, 提议, 求婚
words.definition:
n. the verbal act of offering
n. something offered (as a proposal or bid)
v. make available or accessible, provide or furnish
v. present for acceptance or rejection

examples.en: He [offered] to help carry the heavy boxes for his teacher.
examples.cn: 他主动[提出]帮老师搬沉重的箱子。

examples.en: The school [offers] many clubs for students to join after class.
examples.cn: 学校[提供]许多课后社团供学生参加。

examples.en: She accepted his [offer] to share notes from the missed lesson.
examples.cn: 她接受了他分享缺课笔记的[提议]。

examples.en: I [offered] to water the plants while my classmate was on holiday.
examples.cn: 我[主动提出]在同学度假期间给植物浇水。

examples.en: The bookstore had a special [offer] — buy two books and get one free.
examples.cn: 书店有特别[优惠]——买两本书送一本。

words.translation: n. 办公室, 部, 公职, 职责\n[化] 办公室
words.definition:
n. place of business where professional or clerical duties are performed
n. (of a government or government official) holding an office means being in power
n. professional or clerical workers in an office
n. a religious rite or service prescribed by ecclesiastical authorities

examples.en: Please go to the school [office] if you need a late slip.
examples.cn: 如果你需要迟到条，请去学校[办公室]。

examples.en: The principal's [office] is at the end of the corridor.
examples.cn: 校长[办公室]在走廊的尽头。

examples.en: She held the [office] of class president for two years.
examples.cn: 她担任了两年班长的[职务]。

examples.en: He works at the tax [office] and helps people fill out forms.
examples.cn: 他在税务[局]工作，帮助人们填写表格。

examples.en: She designed a small home [office] where she can study quietly.
examples.cn: 她设计了一个小的家庭[办公室]，可以在那里安静地学习。

words.translation: n. 军官, 主管, 官员, 公务员\nvt. 指挥
words.definition: n. a person authorized to serve in a position of authority on a vessel\nv. direct or command as an officer

examples.en: The police [officer] helped the lost child find his parents.
examples.cn: 警察[官员]帮助迷路的孩子找到了他的父母。

examples.en: The [officer] gave clear instructions to the team before the mission.
examples.cn: [官员]在任务前给队伍提供了明确的指示。

examples.en: A traffic [officer] stood at the crossroads to direct the cars.
examples.cn: 一名交通[警官]站在十字路口指挥车辆。

examples.en: The young [officer] led his troops bravely across the river.
examples.cn: 年轻的[军官]勇敢地带领部队渡河。

examples.en: She was elected as the student welfare [officer] of the school.
examples.cn: 她被选为学校学生福利[负责人]。

words.translation: adv. 时常, 常常
words.definition: r. in many cases or instances

examples.en: She [often] visits the library after school to read books.
examples.cn: 她放学后[经常]去图书馆看书。

examples.en: How [often] do you practice playing the piano each week?
examples.cn: 你每周[多久]练习一次钢琴？

examples.en: He [often] helps his classmates with difficult math problems.
examples.cn: 他[经常]帮助同学解决难的数学题。

examples.en: It [often] rains in our city during spring.
examples.cn: 我们城市春天[经常]下雨。

examples.en: She is [often] the first student to arrive at school every morning.
examples.cn: 她每天早上[经常]是第一个到达学校的学生。

words.translation: n. 油, 石油, 油画颜料\nvt. 涂油于, 使融化成油状, 加油于\nvi. 加燃油, 融化
words.definition: n. a slippery or viscous liquid or liquefiable substance not miscible with water\nn. oil paint containing pigment that is used by an artist\nv. cover with oil, as if by rubbing

examples.en: She fried the vegetables in a little [oil] in the pan.
examples.cn: 她在锅里放了一点[油]炒蔬菜。

examples.cn: 许多国家依靠[石油]为汽车和工厂提供动力。

examples.en: He [oiled] the bicycle chain to make it run more smoothly.
examples.cn: 他给自行车链条[上油]使其运转更顺畅。

examples.en: The famous painting was created in [oil] by a master artist.
examples.cn: 这幅著名的画是一位大师用[油画]颜料创作的。

examples.en: It is important to change the [oil] in a car regularly.
examples.cn: 定期更换汽车[机油]非常重要。

words.translation:
a. 好, 不错, 可以
adv. 好, 不错, 可以
n. 批准, 认可
[计] 确定
words.definition:
n a state in south central United States
k an endorsement
s being satisfactory or in satisfactory condition
r an expression of agreement normally occurring at the beginning of a sentence

examples.cn: 我借用你的尺子一下[可以]吗？

examples.cn: 你[还好]吗？你今天看起来有点苍白。

examples.cn: [好的]，我们现在开始上课。请打开你们的书。

examples.en: The test result was [OK] — not great but not bad either.
examples.cn: 测试结果[还行]——不算很好但也不差。

words.translation: n. 以前, 往昔\na. 老的, 旧的, 古老的, 年长的, 老练的

examples.cn: 那位[年老的]老师在执教三十年后退休了。

examples.en: She keeps [old] photos of her family in a special box.
examples.cn: 她把家人的[旧]照片保存在一个特别的盒子里。

examples.en: How [old] are you? I am thirteen years old.
examples.cn: 你[多大]了？我十三岁。

examples.en: He met his [old] classmates at a reunion last summer.

examples.cn: 我们镇上那座[古老的]寺庙已有五百多年历史。

words.translation:
