a. 从前的
words.definition: r. on one occasion\nr. as soon as\nr. at a previous time;

examples.en: I have [once] visited the Great Wall and it was amazing.
examples.cn: 我[曾经]去过长城一次，太壮观了。

examples.en: He goes to the gym [once] a week to stay fit.
examples.cn: 他每周去健身房[一次]保持健康。

examples.en: [Once] you understand the rule, grammar becomes much easier.
examples.cn: [一旦]你理解了规则，语法就会变得容易很多。

examples.en: [Once] upon a time, there lived a kind and clever girl.
examples.cn: [从前]，有一个善良聪明的女孩。

examples.en: Please come here at [once] — it is very important!
examples.cn: 请[立刻]来这里——非常重要！

words.translation:
n. 一(个)
pron. 一, 任何人
num. 一, 一个
a. 一致的, 完整的
words.definition:
n. the smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number
n. a single person or thing
s. used of a single unit or thing; not two or more
s. having the indivisible character of a unit

examples.en: She has [one] older brother and two younger sisters.
examples.cn: 她有[一]个哥哥和两个妹妹。

examples.en: I forgot my pen — can I borrow [one] from you?
examples.cn: 我忘带笔了——我可以向你借[一支]吗？

examples.en: [One] should always be polite and respectful to teachers.
examples.cn: [人]应该总是对老师礼貌和尊重。

examples.en: She came back [one] afternoon with a big smile on her face.
examples.cn: [某一]个下午，她带着大大的微笑回来了。

examples.en: [One] plus [one] equals two — this is the simplest math fact.
examples.cn: [一]加[一]等于二——这是最简单的数学事实。

words.translation: pron. 自己, 亲自
words.definition: pron. A reflexive form of the indefinite pronoun one.\n   Commonly writen as two words, one's self.

examples.en: One should learn to take care of [oneself] before helping others.
examples.cn: 一个人应该先学会照顾[自己]，然后再帮助别人。

examples.en: It is important to believe in [oneself] to succeed.
examples.cn: 相信[自己]是成功的重要因素。

examples.en: One can improve [oneself] by reading widely every day.
examples.cn: 每天广泛阅读可以提升[自己]。

examples.en: Doing things by [oneself] builds independence and confidence.
examples.cn: 独立做事可以培养独立性和自信心。

examples.en: To express [oneself] clearly is an important life skill.
examples.cn: 清楚地表达[自己]是一项重要的生活技能。

words.translation: a. 唯一的, 仅有的, 最佳的\nadv. 只有, 仅仅, 只能\nconj. 但是, 不过
words.definition:
r. with nevertheless the final result
r. in the final outcome
r. except that; only this time she came out better"
r. never except when

examples.en: She is [only] twelve years old but she speaks three languages.
examples.cn: 她[只有]十二岁，但会说三种语言。

examples.en: I have [only] five minutes left to finish the exam.
examples.cn: 我[只]剩五分钟完成考试。

examples.en: She is the [only] student in the class who speaks both French and Chinese.
examples.cn: 她是班里[唯一]一个会说法语和中文的学生。

examples.en: I would love to come, [only] I have too much homework to do.
examples.cn: 我很想来，[可是]我有太多作业要做。

examples.en: He [only] started learning English last year and is already very good.
examples.cn: 他去年[才]开始学英语，现在已经非常好了。

words.translation:
n. 公开, 户外, 空旷
a. 开着的, 开放的, 开阔的, 营业着的, 公开的, 悬而未决的
vt. 打开, 公开, 开放
vi. 展开, 开始, 展现
[计] 打开指令; 打开语句
words.definition:
n. a clear or unobstructed space or expanse of land or water
n. a tournament in which both professionals and amateurs may play
n. information that has become public
v. cause to open or to become open

examples.en: Please [open] the window — it is very stuffy in here.
examples.cn: 请[打开]窗户——这里很闷。

examples.en: The new library [opens] at eight o'clock every morning.
examples.cn: 新图书馆每天早上八点[开放]。

examples.en: Leave the door [open] so the breeze can come in.
examples.cn: 让门[开着]，这样微风可以进来。

examples.en: The teacher had an [open] discussion with students about the rules.
examples.cn: 老师与学生就规则进行了[公开的]讨论。

examples.en: She [opened] the letter carefully and read it with excitement.
examples.cn: 她小心地[打开]信，兴奋地读了起来。

words.translation: n. 操作, 动作, 手术, 运算, 作用, 业务\n[计] 运算
words.definition:
n. the state of being in effect or being operative
n. a business especially one run on a large scale
n. a planned activity involving many people performing various actions
n. (computer science) data processing in which the result is completely specified by a rule (especially the processing that results from a single instruction)

examples.en: The doctor performed a successful [operation] on the patient.
examples.cn: 医生成功地为病人做了一次[手术]。

examples.en: The [operation] of this machine is simple — just press the button.
examples.cn: 这台机器的[操作]很简单——只需按下按钮。

examples.en: The rescue [operation] saved three people trapped in the building.
examples.cn: 救援[行动]救出了被困在大楼里的三个人。

examples.en: Addition and subtraction are basic math [operations].
examples.cn: 加法和减法是基本的数学[运算]。

examples.en: The [operation] of the school canteen improved after the new manager arrived.
examples.cn: 新经理到来后，学校食堂的[经营]有所改善。

words.translation: conj. 或, 或者\n[计] 或
words.definition: n a state in northwestern United States on the Pacific\nn a room in a hospital equipped for the performance of surgical operations

examples.en: Would you like tea [or] coffee with your breakfast?
examples.cn: 你早餐想要茶[还是]咖啡？

examples.en: Hurry up, [or] we will miss the school bus.
examples.cn: 快点，[否则]我们会错过校车。

examples.en: You can call [or] email the teacher with your questions.
examples.cn: 你可以打电话[或]发邮件向老师提问。

examples.en: She does not eat meat [or] fish — she is a vegetarian.
examples.cn: 她不吃肉[也]不吃鱼——她是素食主义者。

examples.en: Is the answer A, B, C, [or] D? Take your time to decide.
examples.cn: 答案是A、B、C[还是]D？慢慢考虑。

words.translation: n. 柑橘, 桔子, 橘色\na. 橘色的
words.definition:
n. round yellow to orange fruit of any of several citrus trees
n. orange color or pigment; any of a range of colors between red and yellow
n. any citrus tree bearing oranges
n. any pigment producing the orange color

examples.en: She peeled an [orange] and shared it with her classmates.
examples.cn: 她剥了一个[橙子]，与同学们分享。

examples.en: He drinks a glass of fresh [orange] juice every morning.
examples.cn: 他每天早上喝一杯新鲜[橙]汁。

examples.en: She wore an [orange] scarf that matched her yellow coat perfectly.
examples.cn: 她戴了一条[橙色]围巾，与她的黄色外套完美搭配。

examples.en: The autumn leaves turned shades of red, yellow, and [orange].
examples.cn: 秋天的叶子变成了红色、黄色和[橙色]的色调。

examples.en: Oranges are rich in vitamin C which is good for your health.
examples.cn: [橙子]富含维生素C，对健康有益。

words.translation:
n. 次序, 规则, 命令
vi. 命令, 定货
vt. 整理, 命令, 定购
n. 顺序, 阶数
[计] 顺序, 阶数
words.definition:
n. (often plural) a command given by a superior (e.g., a military or law enforcement officer) that must be obeyed
n. a degree in a continuum of size or quantity
n. established customary state (especially of society)
n. a commercial document used to request someone to supply something in return for payment and providing specifications and quantities

examples.en: Please line up in [order] from the tallest to the shortest.
examples.cn: 请按从高到低的[顺序]排队。

examples.en: The teacher [ordered] the students to be quiet during the exam.
examples.cn: 老师[命令]学生在考试期间保持安静。

examples.en: She [ordered] a bowl of noodles and a glass of juice at the canteen.
examples.cn: 她在食堂[点了]一碗面条和一杯果汁。

examples.en: The soldier followed the [order] from his commander without question.
examples.cn: 士兵毫不迟疑地服从了指挥官的[命令]。

examples.en: The library keeps its books in [order] so readers can find them easily.
examples.cn: 图书馆将书籍保持[有序]排列，方便读者查找。

words.translation: a. 其他的, 另外的, 从前的\npron. 其他的, 他人, 另外一个
words.definition: a. not the same one or ones already mentioned or implied\ns. recently past\ns. very unusual; different in character or quality from the normal or expected

examples.en: Some students like science, while [other] students prefer art.
examples.cn: 有些学生喜欢科学，而[其他]学生更喜欢艺术。

examples.en: I left one book at school and the [other] at home.
examples.cn: 我把一本书留在学校，把[另一本]留在家里。

examples.en: Are there any [other] questions before we move on?
examples.cn: 在我们继续之前有[其他]问题吗？

examples.en: She cares about [others] and always tries to help when needed.
examples.cn: 她关心[他人]，总是在需要时伸出援手。

examples.en: The teacher's desk is on the [other] side of the classroom.
examples.cn: 老师的桌子在教室的[另一侧]。

words.translation: pron. 我们的
words.definition: pl.  of I\npossessive pron. Of or pertaining to us; belonging to us; as, our\n   country; our rights; our troops; our endeavors. See I.

examples.en: [Our] school has a beautiful garden full of flowers.
examples.cn: [我们的]学校有一个开满鲜花的美丽花园。

examples.en: [Our] class is going on a trip to the science museum next week.
examples.cn: [我们的]班级下周要去科学博物馆参观。

examples.en: We should protect [our] environment and keep it clean.
examples.cn: 我们应该保护[我们的]环境，保持其整洁。

examples.en: [Our] teacher taught us a new song for the school concert.
examples.cn: [我们的]老师教了我们一首新歌为学校音乐会准备。

examples.en: [Our] team won the basketball championship this semester.
examples.cn: [我们的]队伍本学期赢得了篮球冠军。

words.translation: pron. 我们的
words.definition: pl.  of I\npossessive pron. See Note under Our.

examples.en: That classroom on the right is [ours] — we just moved in this week.
examples.cn: 右边那间教室是[我们的]——我们这周刚搬进去。

examples.en: Their school has a swimming pool, but [ours] does not.
examples.cn: 他们学校有游泳池，但[我们的]没有。

examples.en: The blue team won, but [ours] put up a great fight.
examples.cn: 蓝队赢了，但[我们队]表现得也很好。

examples.en: Is this bag [ours] or theirs? They look exactly the same.
examples.cn: 这个包是[我们的]还是他们的？它们看起来完全一样。

examples.en: The idea for the school project was [ours] from the very beginning.
examples.cn: 学校项目的想法从一开始就是[我们的]。

words.translation: pron. 我们自己
words.definition:
pl.  of Myself
pron. ; sing. Ourself (/). An emphasized form of the
   pronoun of the first person plural; -- used as a subject, usually with
   we; also, alone in the predicate, in the nominative or the objective
   case.

examples.sense: pron. 我们自己（反身代词）
examples.en: We painted the classroom by [ourselves] during the holiday.
examples.cn: 我们在假期里[自己]粉刷了教室。

examples.en: We should be proud of [ourselves] for finishing such a difficult project.
examples.cn: 我们应该为[自己]完成了这么困难的项目而感到自豪。

examples.en: We need to ask [ourselves] if we are truly working our hardest.
examples.cn: 我们需要问[自己]是否真的在尽力而为。

examples.en: We built the bookshelf [ourselves] using wood and tools.
examples.cn: 我们[亲自]用木材和工具制作了书架。

examples.en: We enjoyed [ourselves] at the school party last Friday.
examples.cn: 上周五我们在学校派对上玩得很[开心]。

words.translation: a. 外面的, 熄灭的, 结束的\nadv. 在外, 熄灭, 出现\nprep. 出自, 离去, 向
words.definition:
n. (baseball) a failure by a batter or runner to reach a base safely in baseball
v. reveal (something) about somebody's identity or lifestyle
v. be made known; be disclosed or revealed
a. not allowed to continue to bat or run

examples.en: It is warm today, so let us eat lunch [out] in the garden.
examples.cn: 今天天气暖和，我们[去外面]花园里吃午饭吧。

examples.en: She went [out] for a walk after finishing her homework.
examples.cn: 她完成作业后出去[散步]了。

examples.en: He was [out] in the first round of the singing competition.
examples.cn: 他在歌唱比赛的第一轮就被[淘汰]了。

examples.en: Speak [out] clearly so that everyone in the room can hear you.
examples.cn: 大声地[说出]，这样房间里的每个人都能听到你。

examples.en: She took a book [out] of her bag and started reading.
examples.cn: 她从包里[拿出]一本书，开始阅读。

words.translation: n. 外面, 外表, 外界\na. 外面的, 外表的, 外界的\nadv. 外面, 外表, 外界
words.definition:
n. the region that is outside of something
n. the outer side or surface of something
a. relating to or being on or near the outer side or limit
s. originating or belonging beyond some bounds:"the outside world"

examples.en: The students played [outside] during the break between lessons.
examples.cn: 学生们在课间休息时在[外面]玩耍。

examples.en: It is raining [outside], so we cannot have PE class in the field.
examples.cn: [外面]在下雨，所以我们不能在操场上体育课。

examples.cn: 把盒子的[外面]涂成红色，里面涂成蓝色。

examples.en: The school has an [outside] reading area with benches and trees.
examples.cn: 学校有一个带椅子和树木的[户外]阅读区。

examples.cn: 请在房间[外面]等候，直到叫到你的名字。

words.translation:
adv. 结束, 越过, 从头到尾
prep. 在...之上, 遍于...之上, 越过
a. 上面的
vt. 越过
words.definition:
n. (cricket) the division of play during which six balls are bowled at the batsman by one player from the other team from the same end of the pitch
r. at or to a point across intervening space etc.
r. throughout an area
r. throughout a period of time

examples.en: The clouds floated [over] the mountains all afternoon.
examples.cn: 下午云朵漂浮在山脉的[上方]。

examples.en: She has read [over] a hundred books this year.
examples.cn: 她今年读了[超过]一百本书。

examples.en: When the exam was [over], everyone felt relieved.
examples.cn: 考试[结束]后，每个人都感到轻松。

examples.en: The bird flew [over] the fence into the school garden.
examples.cn: 鸟儿飞[越]过栅栏，进入学校花园。

examples.en: She read the essay [over] twice to check for mistakes.
examples.cn: 她把作文[重新]读了两遍，检查是否有错误。

words.translation: n. 外套大衣
words.definition: n. an additional protective coating (as of paint or varnish)

examples.en: She put on a warm [overcoat] before going out into the cold wind.
examples.cn: 她穿上一件暖和的[大衣]才出门迎着寒风。

examples.en: He hung his [overcoat] on the hook by the classroom door.
examples.cn: 他把[大衣]挂在教室门旁边的钩子上。

examples.en: Her grandmother gave her a beautiful wool [overcoat] as a gift.
examples.cn: 奶奶送给她一件漂亮的羊毛[大衣]作为礼物。

examples.en: The long [overcoat] kept him warm during the cold winter months.
examples.cn: 这件长[大衣]在寒冷的冬季让他保持温暖。

examples.en: She bought a new [overcoat] in dark blue for the cold season.
examples.cn: 她为寒冷的季节买了一件深蓝色的新[大衣]。

words.translation:
n. 自己的
a. 自己的, 嫡亲的, 同胞的
vt. 拥有, 支配, 自认, 承认, 顺从于
vi. 承认, 供认
words.definition: v. have ownership or possession of\ns. belonging to or on behalf of a specified person (especially yourself); preceded by a possessive

examples.en: She has her [own] room where she can study quietly.
examples.cn: 她有[自己的]房间，可以安静地学习。

examples.en: He made his [own] decision to study harder this semester.
examples.cn: 他做出了[自己的]决定，这学期要更加努力学习。

examples.en: Her family [owns] a small farm in the countryside.
examples.cn: 她的家庭在农村[拥有]一个小农场。

examples.cn: 他[承认]打破了窗户并道了歉。

examples.en: She baked the birthday cake with her [own] hands.
examples.cn: 她亲手制作了生日蛋糕。

words.translation: n. 拥有者, 物主, 所有人\n[经] 所有者, 物主, 业主
words.definition: n. (law) someone who owns (is legal possessor of) a business\nn. a person who owns something

examples.cn: 失踪狗狗的[主人]在附近贴了寻狗启事。

examples.en: The restaurant [owner] greeted every customer with a warm smile.
examples.cn: 餐厅[老板]用温暖的微笑迎接每一位顾客。

examples.en: Could you tell me who the [owner] of this bag is?
examples.cn: 你能告诉我这个包的[主人]是谁吗？

examples.en: She became the [owner] of a small bookshop after she retired.
examples.cn: 退休后，她成为了一家小书店的[所有者]。

examples.en: The car [owner] was fined for parking in the wrong place.
examples.cn: 那辆车的[车主]因停车违规被罚款。

words.translation: n. 太平洋\na. 太平洋的, 太平洋沿岸的, 爱好和平的, 安静的, 平息的
words.definition: n. the largest ocean in the world\na. relating to or bordering the Pacific Ocean\ns. disposed to peace or of a peaceful nature

examples.en: Many countries border the [Pacific] Ocean.
examples.cn: 许多国家与[太平洋]相邻。

examples.en: She has a [pacific] nature and never gets into arguments.
examples.cn: 她性格[平和]，从不与人争吵。

examples.en: The [Pacific] is the deepest ocean on Earth.
examples.cn: [太平洋]是地球上最深的海洋。

examples.cn: 许多[太平洋]岛屿有美丽的海滩和清澈的海水。

examples.en: The [pacific] talks between the two sides ended the conflict.
examples.cn: 双方之间的[和平]谈判结束了冲突。

words.translation:
n. 包裹, 套装软件, 包, 包装用物, 程序包
vt. 包装, 打包
a. 一揽子的
[计] 包, 软件包, 包装
words.definition: n. a collection of things wrapped or boxed together\nn. a wrapped container

examples.cn: 她收到了来自加拿大姑姑的一个[包裹]。

examples.cn: [包裹]用棕色纸包裹，用绳子捆扎。

examples.en: She carefully [packaged] the fragile gift before sending it.
examples.cn: 她在寄出易碎礼物之前仔细地[打包]了。

examples.cn: 学校旅行提供全包[套餐]。

words.translation:
n. 页, 记录, 事件, 专栏, 男侍

[计] 页; 页面
words.definition:
n. one side of one leaf (of a book or magazine or newspaper or letter etc.) or the written or pictorial matter it contains

n. United States diplomat and writer about the Old South (1853-1922)
n. a boy who is employed to run errands

examples.cn: 请翻开课本第四十五[页]。

examples.en: She read five [pages] of her novel before going to sleep.
examples.cn: 她睡觉前读了五[页]小说。

examples.cn: 访问学校的官方网[页]了解更多信息。

examples.en: The receptionist [paged] the doctor over the hospital speaker.
examples.cn: 前台通过医院广播[呼叫]了医生。

examples.en: The answer to the question is at the bottom of the [page].
examples.cn: 问题的答案在[页面]底部。

n. a substance used as a coating to protect or decorate a surface (especially a mixture of pigment suspended in a liquid); dries to form a hard coating
v. make a painting
v. apply paint to; coat with paint
v. make a painting of

examples.cn: 她为艺术展[画]了一幅美丽的山景画。

examples.en: The students [painted] the classroom walls in bright yellow.
examples.cn: 学生们把教室的墙壁[涂]成了明亮的黄色。

examples.en: She bought some new [paint] to create an art project.
examples.cn: 她买了一些新[颜料]来创作艺术作品。

words.translation: n. 钢笔, 笔, 笔调, 笔杆子, 作家, 围栏, 栅栏, 禽畜\nvt. 写, 关入栏中, 囚禁\nvi. 动笔, 写作
words.definition: n. a writing implement with a point from which ink flows\nn. an enclosure for confining livestock\nn. female swan

examples.en: May I borrow your [pen]? I forgot to bring mine today.
examples.cn: 我可以借你的[笔]吗？我今天忘记带了。

examples.en: She always writes with a blue [pen] in her diary.
examples.cn: 她总是用蓝色[笔]写日记。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to write the essay in [pen], not pencil.
examples.cn: 老师要求我们用[笔]而不是铅笔写作文。

examples.en: The farmer kept the sheep in a wooden [pen] near the barn.
examples.cn: 农夫把羊关在谷仓附近的木制[围栏]里。

examples.en: She clicked the top of her [pen] nervously before the interview.
examples.cn: 面试前她紧张地按了按[笔]的顶部。

words.translation: pl. (非正式)copper便士, (美)分, 分币
words.definition: n a fractional monetary unit of Ireland and the United Kingdom; equal to one hundredth of a pound\nn a coin worth one-hundredth of the value of the basic unit

examples.sense: n. 便士（英国货币单位）
examples.en: The snack cost fifty [pence] at the school tuck shop.
examples.cn: 这个零食在学校小卖部卖五十[便士]。

examples.en: She saved every [pence] she found to buy a new notebook.
examples.cn: 她把找到的每一[便士]都存起来买新笔记本。

examples.en: There are one hundred [pence] in one British pound.
examples.cn: 一英镑等于一百[便士]。

examples.en: He only had a few [pence] left in his pocket after buying lunch.
examples.cn: 买完午饭后，他口袋里只剩几[便士]了。

examples.en: The charity collected many [pence] from students in the fundraiser.
examples.cn: 慈善机构在募捐活动中从学生那里收集了许多[便士]。

words.translation: n. 铅笔, 色笔, 眉笔, 画笔, 光线束\nvt. 用铅笔写或涂, 草拟
words.definition:
n. a thin cylindrical pointed writing implement; a rod of marking substance encased in wood
n. graphite (or a similar substance) used in such a way as to be a medium of communication
n. a figure formed by a set of straight lines or light rays meeting at a point
n. a cosmetic in a long thin stick; designed to be applied to a particular part of the face

examples.en: She drew a picture with her [pencil] in art class.
examples.cn: 她在美术课上用[铅笔]画了一幅画。

examples.en: Please use a [pencil] for the drawing test so you can erase mistakes.
examples.cn: 绘画测验时请用[铅笔]，这样可以擦掉错误。

examples.en: He sharpened his [pencil] before starting to write the essay.
examples.cn: 他在开始写作文之前削了[铅笔]。

examples.en: My [pencil] broke in the middle of the exam, which was very unlucky.
examples.cn: 我的[铅笔]在考试中间折断了，真的很不幸。

examples.en: She lent her spare [pencil] to her classmate who had forgotten theirs.
examples.cn: 她把备用[铅笔]借给了忘记带的同学。

words.translation: n. 便士, 一分, 小钱, 点滴\n[经] 便士
words.definition: n. a fractional monetary unit of Ireland and the United Kingdom; equal to one hundredth of a pound\nn. a coin worth one-hundredth of the value of the basic unit

examples.sense: n. 便士（英美货币单位）
examples.en: He found a shiny [penny] on the pavement and picked it up.
examples.cn: 他在人行道上发现了一枚闪亮的[便士]并捡了起来。

examples.en: She saved every [penny] she earned from doing chores at home.
examples.cn: 她把在家做家务赚来的每一[便士]都存了起来。

examples.en: A [penny] saved is a penny earned — start saving from now.
examples.cn: [省一分钱]就是赚一分钱——从现在开始储蓄。

examples.en: He did not have a [penny] left after buying all his school supplies.
examples.cn: 买完所有学习用品后，他一[分钱]都不剩了。

examples.en: The old machine only accepts coins — do you have a [penny]?
examples.cn: 这台旧机器只接受硬币——你有[便士]吗？

words.translation: n. 人, 人民, 民族, 平民\nvt. 使住满人, 居住于
words.definition:
n. (plural) any group of human beings (men or women or children) collectively
n. members of a family line
v. fill with people
v. furnish with people

examples.en: Many [people] gathered in the square to watch the performance.
examples.cn: 许多[人们]聚集在广场观看表演。

examples.en: Kind [people] always help those in need without expecting anything.
examples.cn: 善良的[人们]总是帮助有需要的人，不求回报。

examples.en: China is home to fifty-six different [peoples] with unique cultures.
examples.cn: 中国有五十六个不同的[民族]，各有独特文化。

examples.en: The [people] of this village are known for their kindness and generosity.
examples.cn: 这个村子的[人们]以友善和慷慨著称。

examples.en: [People] from all over the world come to visit the Great Wall.
examples.cn: 来自世界各地的[人们]来参观长城。

words.translation: n. 百分比, 百分数, 部分\n[机] 百分率
words.definition: n a proportion in relation to a whole (which is usually the amount per hundred)

examples.en: She scored ninety [percent] on her final English exam.
examples.cn: 她期末英语考试得了九十[%]。

examples.en: About thirty [percent] of students in our class walk to school.
examples.cn: 我们班大约有三十[%]的学生步行上学。

examples.en: The bank offers an interest rate of five [percent] per year.
examples.cn: 银行提供每年五[%]的利率。

examples.en: Sales of electric bikes increased by twenty [percent] this year.
examples.cn: 今年电动自行车销量增加了二十[%]。

examples.en: One hundred [percent] effort is needed to succeed in this project.
examples.cn: 这个项目需要百[%]的努力才能成功。

words.translation: n. 完成时\na. 完美的, 完好的, 理想的, 熟练的, 精确的, 完成式的\nvt. 使完美, 修改, 使精通, 改善, 使熟练
words.definition: v. make perfect or complete\na. being complete of its kind and without defect or blemish\ns. precisely accurate or exact

examples.en: She gave a [perfect] performance at the school concert.
examples.cn: 她在学校音乐会上有一场[完美的]演出。

examples.en: Nobody is [perfect] — everyone makes mistakes sometimes.
examples.cn: 没有人是[完美的]——每个人有时都会犯错。

examples.en: She has [perfect] understanding of all the grammar rules.
examples.cn: 她对所有语法规则有[完全的]理解。

examples.en: He spent the whole summer trying to [perfect] his swimming technique.
examples.cn: 他整个夏天都在努力[完善]他的游泳技术。

examples.en: This rainy day is [perfect] for staying in and reading a book.
examples.cn: 这个雨天[非常适合]待在室内读书。

words.translation: adv. 也许, 大概
words.definition: r by chance

examples.en: [Perhaps] we can finish the project by Thursday if we work hard.
examples.cn: 如果我们努力工作，[也许]我们可以在周四前完成项目。

examples.en: [Perhaps] she forgot about the meeting — let us send a reminder.
examples.cn: [也许]她忘了会议——让我们发个提醒吧。

examples.en: That is [perhaps] the most interesting story I have ever heard.
examples.cn: 那[或许]是我听过的最有趣的故事。

examples.en: [Perhaps] it is time to take a short break and have some water.
examples.cn: [也许]现在是时候休息一下，喝点水了。

examples.en: [Perhaps] the most important lesson is learning how to learn.
examples.cn: [也许]最重要的一课是学会如何学习。

words.translation: n. 时期, 节段, 节, 句点, 学时, 周期\na. 当时特有的, 过去某段时期的\ninterj. 就是这话, 就是这么回事
words.definition:
n. the interval taken to complete one cycle of a regularly repeating phenomenon
n. (ice hockey) one of three divisions into which play is divided in hockey games
n. a unit of geological time during which a system of rocks formed
n. the end or completion of something

examples.en: She studied very hard during the [period] before the final exam.
examples.cn: 她在期末考试前的那段[时期]非常努力地学习。

examples.en: The Tang Dynasty was a great [period] in Chinese history.
examples.cn: 唐朝是中国历史上一个伟大的[时期]。

examples.en: We have six [periods] of class every day from Monday to Friday.
examples.cn: 我们每天周一到周五有六个[节]课。

examples.en: Remember to put a [period] at the end of every sentence.
examples.cn: 记得在每个句子末尾加[句号]。

examples.en: We are going through an important [period] of growth in our studies.
examples.cn: 我们正在经历学业上一个重要的[成长时期]。

words.translation: n. 人, 人身, 人称\n[法] 人, 法人, 人身
words.definition: n. a human being\nn. a human body (usually including the clothing)\nn. a grammatical category used in the classification of pronouns, possessive determiners, and verb forms according to whether they indicate the speaker, the addressee, or a third party

examples.en: She is the kindest [person] I have ever met in my life.
examples.cn: 她是我一生中遇到过的最善良的[人]。

examples.en: Every [person] in the class is responsible for keeping it tidy.
examples.cn: 班里的每个[人]都有责任保持整洁。

examples.en: In English, the first [person] is I, the second is you.
examples.cn: 在英语中，第一[人称]是I，第二是you。

examples.en: Please deliver this letter in [person] to the principal.
examples.cn: 请[亲自]将这封信交给校长。

examples.en: She is a very cheerful [person] who always makes others smile.
examples.cn: 她是一个非常开朗的[人]，总是让别人微笑。

words.translation: a. 私人的, 涉及隐私的, 有人性的, 人称的, 亲自的, 身体的\n[医] 人的; 个人的, 自身的
words.definition:
n. a short newspaper article about a particular person or group
a. concerning or affecting a particular person or his or her private life and personality
s. particular to a given individual
a. of or arising from personality

examples.en: Please do not touch other people's [personal] belongings.
examples.cn: 请不要触碰他人的[个人]物品。

examples.en: She keeps her diary in a safe place because it is very [personal].
examples.cn: 她把日记放在安全的地方，因为它非常[私人]。

examples.en: He made a [personal] visit to thank the teacher for her help.
examples.cn: 他[亲自]登门感谢老师的帮助。

examples.sense: adj. 个人的，有关个人的
examples.en: It is important to protect your [personal] information online.
examples.cn: 在网上保护你的[个人]信息是很重要的。

examples.en: The teacher gave [personal] feedback to each student after the test.
examples.cn: 考试后，老师给每个学生提供了[个人]反馈。

words.translation:
n. 宠物, 受宠爱的人, 宠坏的孩子, 不悦, 生气
a. 宠爱的, 表示亲昵的, 养着观赏的, 特别珍爱的, 格外的
vt. 宠爱, 溺爱, 抚摸
vi. 拥抱, 爱抚, 生气, 发脾气
words.definition:
n. a domesticated animal kept for companionship or amusement
n. a fit of petulance or sulkiness (especially at what is felt to be a slight)
v. stroke or caress gently
v. stroke or caress in an erotic manner, as during lovemaking

examples.en: Her favourite [pet] is a golden retriever named Sunny.
examples.cn: 她最喜欢的[宠物]是一只叫Sunny的金毛猎犬。

examples.en: Taking care of a [pet] teaches children about responsibility.
examples.cn: 照顾[宠物]教会孩子们责任感。

examples.en: She gently [petted] the rabbit to calm it down.
examples.cn: 她轻轻地[抚摸]兔子，让它平静下来。

examples.en: Reading is his [pet] activity on rainy weekends.
examples.cn: 阅读是他雨天周末的[最爱]活动。

examples.en: The class has a [pet] hamster that everyone takes turns feeding.
examples.cn: 班级有一只[宠物]仓鼠，大家轮流喂养。

words.translation: n. 电话, 受话器, 耳机\nvt. 打电话给\nvi. 打电话
words.definition: n. (phonetics) an individual sound unit of speech without concern as to whether or not it is a phoneme of some language

examples.en: She called her mom on the [phone] when she arrived at school.
examples.cn: 她到学校后打[电话]给妈妈。

examples.en: Students are not allowed to use their [phones] in class.
examples.cn: 学生上课时不允许使用[手机]。

examples.en: Please [phone] the school if your child is going to be absent.
examples.cn: 如果你的孩子要缺席，请[打电话]给学校。

examples.en: The school has a public [phone] for students to use in emergencies.
examples.cn: 学校有一部公共[电话]供学生在紧急情况下使用。

examples.en: He forgot to charge his [phone] and it died in the middle of the day.
examples.cn: 他忘记给[手机]充电，手机在半天就没电了。

words.translation: n. 相片, 照片, 逼真的描绘\nv. 照相\na. 照相的, 摄影用的, 详细记录的, 逼真的, 酷似的
words.definition: n a representation of a person or scene in the form of a print or transparent slide; recorded by a camera on light-sensitive material

examples.en: She took a [photo] of her friends at the end of school year.
examples.cn: 她在学年结束时给朋友们拍了一张[照片]。

examples.en: He keeps a [photo] of his family on his desk to remind him of home.
examples.cn: 他把家人的[照片]放在桌子上，提醒自己家的感觉。

examples.en: Please bring a [photo] of yourself for the school ID card.
examples.cn: 请带一张你的[照片]用于制作学生证。

examples.en: She printed the [photo] and put it in a nice frame.
examples.cn: 她把[照片]打印出来，放进了一个好看的相框里。

examples.en: The class [photo] was taken on the last day before summer holidays.
examples.cn: 班级[合影]在暑假前的最后一天拍摄。

words.translation: n. 相片, 照片, 逼真的描绘\nv. 照相, 摄影
words.definition: n. a representation of a person or scene in the form of a print or transparent slide; recorded by a camera on light-sensitive material\nv. record on photographic film\nv. undergo being photographed in a certain way

examples.en: She took a beautiful [photograph] of the sunset from her window.
examples.cn: 她从窗户拍了一张美丽的日落[照片]。

examples.en: The old [photograph] on the wall shows the school fifty years ago.
examples.cn: 墙上的旧[照片]显示了五十年前的学校。

examples.en: He [photographed] the rare bird he spotted in the park.
examples.cn: 他[拍摄]了他在公园里发现的珍稀鸟类。

examples.en: The [photograph] in her passport was taken when she was fifteen.
examples.cn: 她护照上的[照片]是她十五岁时拍的。

examples.en: The journalist [photographed] the award ceremony for the newspaper.
examples.cn: 记者为报纸[拍摄]了颁奖典礼。

words.translation: n. 物理学, 物理过程, 物理现象\n[化] 物理; 物理学
words.definition: n. the science of matter and energy and their interactions\nn. the physical properties, phenomena, and laws of something

examples.en: She finds [physics] challenging but very interesting.
examples.cn: 她觉得[物理]有挑战性，但非常有趣。

examples.en: [Physics] helps us understand how the world and universe work.
examples.cn: [物理学]帮助我们了解世界和宇宙是如何运作的。

examples.en: Our [physics] teacher did an exciting experiment with magnets today.
examples.cn: 我们的[物理]老师今天用磁铁做了一个激动人心的实验。

examples.en: He scored top marks in [physics] and wants to study engineering.
examples.cn: 他[物理]成绩最高，想学工程学。

examples.en: [Physics] and chemistry are both important science subjects at school.
examples.cn: [物理]和化学都是学校的重要理科科目。

words.translation: n. 钢琴
words.definition:
n. a keyboard instrument that is played by depressing keys that cause hammers to strike tuned strings and produce sounds
n. (music) low loudness
a. used chiefly as a direction or description in music
r. used as a direction in music; to be played relatively softly

examples.en: She has been playing the [piano] since she was five years old.
examples.cn: 她从五岁起就开始弹[钢琴]了。

examples.en: He performed a beautiful [piano] piece at the school concert.
examples.cn: 他在学校音乐会上演奏了一首美妙的[钢琴]曲。

examples.en: Practising [piano] every day requires a lot of patience and dedication.
examples.cn: 每天练习[钢琴]需要极大的耐心和投入。

examples.en: The school has a grand [piano] in the music room for students to use.
examples.cn: 学校音乐室里有一架供学生使用的大[钢琴]。

examples.en: She plays [piano] to relax when she feels stressed about exams.
examples.cn: 当她因考试感到压力时，弹[钢琴]可以帮她放松。

words.translation: n. 精选, 选择, 掘, 精华, 牙签, 鹤嘴锄\nv. 摘, 掘, 凿, 挖, 挑选\n[计] 拾取
words.definition:
n. a small thin device (of metal or plastic or ivory) used to pluck a stringed instrument
n. a thin sharp implement used for removing unwanted material
n. a heavy iron tool with a wooden handle and a curved head that is pointed on both ends
n. a basketball maneuver; obstructing an opponent with one's body

examples.en: They [picked] fresh strawberries at the farm during the trip.
examples.cn: 他们在农场旅游时[采摘]了新鲜草莓。

examples.en: She [picked] the blue notebook from the shelf to use for science.
examples.cn: 她从书架上[选了]蓝色笔记本用于科学课。

examples.en: Please [pick up] any litter you see on the school grounds.
examples.cn: 请[捡起]你在校园里看到的任何垃圾。

examples.en: Mom said she would [pick] me up from school at five o'clock.
examples.cn: 妈妈说她会在五点钟[接]我放学。

examples.en: This book is my [pick] for the class reading challenge.
examples.cn: 这本书是我为班级阅读挑战[选择]的。

words.translation: n. 野餐, 远足, 愉快的经历\nvi. 去野餐, 远足
words.definition: n. any informal meal eaten outside or on an excursion\nv. eat alfresco, in the open air

examples.en: The class went on a [picnic] in the park to celebrate the end of term.
examples.cn: 全班去公园[野餐]庆祝学期结束。

examples.en: She packed sandwiches and fruit for the [picnic] by the river.
examples.cn: 她为河边的[野餐]准备了三明治和水果。

examples.en: They [picnicked] under the big oak tree every Sunday in summer.
examples.cn: 他们每个夏天的星期天都在大橡树下[野餐]。

examples.en: The sudden rain ruined our [picnic] in the garden.
examples.cn: 突如其来的大雨破坏了我们在花园里的[野餐]。

examples.en: Bring a blanket and some snacks for our [picnic] in the countryside.
examples.cn: 为我们在乡间的[野餐]带一张毯子和一些零食。

words.translation: n. 图画, 照片, 景色, 美丽如画的人(或物), 化身, 生动的描述, 想像, 形象思维\nvt. 画, 拍摄, 用图说明, 描写, 想像\n[计] 图象; 形象; 字形
words.definition:
n. a visual representation (of an object or scene or person or abstraction) produced on a surface
n. a situation treated as an observable object
n. illustrations used to decorate or explain a text
n. a typical example of some state or quality

examples.en: She drew a [picture] of her family for the art homework.
examples.cn: 她为美术作业画了一张家人的[图画]。

examples.en: He showed me a [picture] of his new puppy on his phone.
examples.cn: 他在手机上给我看了他新小狗的[照片]。

examples.en: They went to see a [picture] at the cinema on Friday night.
examples.cn: 他们周五晚上去电影院看了一部[电影]。

examples.en: Can you [picture] what life will be like in fifty years?
examples.cn: 你能[想象]五十年后的生活是什么样子吗？

examples.en: The [picture] of the school's future looks very bright.
examples.cn: 学校未来的[前景]看起来非常光明。

words.translation: n. 馅饼, 财富, 总额, 贪污受贿, 杂乱, 喜鹊\n[计] 饼图
words.definition: n. dish baked in pastry-lined pan often with a pastry top

examples.en: She baked an apple [pie] for the class party.
examples.cn: 她为班级派对烤了一个苹果[馅饼]。

examples.en: Mom made a chicken [pie] for dinner and it smelled wonderful.
examples.cn: 妈妈为晚餐做了一个鸡肉[馅饼]，闻起来香极了。

examples.en: Each slice of the [pie] was shared equally among the students.
examples.cn: [馅饼]的每一片都平均分给了学生们。

examples.en: We used a [pie] chart to show the results of our class survey.
examples.cn: 我们用[饼图]显示了我们班级调查的结果。

examples.en: She bought a small [pie] from the bakery near the school.
examples.cn: 她从学校附近的面包店买了一个小[馅饼]。

words.translation: n. 块, 片, 篇, 碎片, 部分, 部件, 标准量\nvt. 修补, 修理, 拼合, 接线头\nvi. 吃零食
words.definition:
n. a separate part of a whole
n. an item that is an instance of some type; 
n. an instance of some kind
n. an artistic or literary composition

examples.en: She cut the cake into eight equal [pieces] for the class.
examples.cn: 她把蛋糕切成八等[份]分给全班。

examples.en: Can I have another [piece] of bread, please?
examples.cn: 请问我可以再来一[片]面包吗？

examples.sense: n. 一篇，一首，一件（作品）
examples.en: She played a [piece] of classical music at the school concert.
examples.cn: 她在学校音乐会上演奏了一首古典音乐[作品]。

examples.en: He swept up the [pieces] of broken glass from the floor.

words.translation:

examples.cn: [飞行员]宣布飞机将在三十分钟内降落。

examples.cn: 他安全地[驾驶]小飞机穿过暴风雨。

examples.en: The school ran a [pilot] programme for online learning last term.
examples.cn: 学校上学期进行了一项[试验性]在线学习项目。

examples.cn: 她穿了一件[粉红色]的裙子参加学校派对。

examples.cn: 她最喜欢的颜色是[粉红色]，因为它看起来很欢快。

examples.cn: 春天[粉红色]的樱花非常美丽。

words.translation:

examples.cn: 居里夫人是科学领域的[先驱]。

examples.cn: 作为一名少年[先锋队员]，她每天自豪地戴着红领巾。

examples.cn: 航空的早期[先驱]使空中旅行成为可能。

words.translation: n. 遗憾, 同情, 怜悯, 憾事, 可惜\nvt. 同情, 怜悯\nvi. 觉得可怜, 有同情心

examples.cn: 她对流浪猫感到[怜悯]，给了它一些食物。

examples.cn: 他没有为考试更加努力学习，真[可惜]。

words.translation: n. 地方, 地点, 位置, 住所, 座位, 地位, 处境, 特权, 空间, 余地, 职务, 位\nvt. 放置, 寄予, 认出, 评定, 任命\nvi. 名次列前
words.definition:
n. any area set aside for a particular purpose

examples.cn: 图书馆是一个可以安静阅读和学习的好[地方]。

examples.cn: 阅读后请将书放回书架上的[位置]。

examples.cn: 她小心地把花瓶[放置]在窗旁的桌子上。

examples.cn: 她在英语写作比赛中获得了第一[名]。

examples.en: What [place] would you most like to visit in China?
examples.cn: 你最想去中国的哪个[地方]参观？

words.translation:
n. 平原, 草原, 朴实无华的东西, 无格式

examples.cn: 她穿了一件[朴素的]白衬衫，看起来非常整洁。

examples.cn: 请把你的意思表达得[清楚]，这样大家都能理解。

examples.cn: 广阔的[平原]一望无际。

examples.sense: adj. 无味的，不加装饰的

examples.cn: 他更喜欢不加任何酱汁或调味料的[白]米饭。

examples.cn: 我们为老师的生日[策划]了一个惊喜派对。

examples.cn: 在开始写作文之前，要先有一个[计划]。
