words.definition: n. an expression of approval and commendation\nn. offering words of homage as an act of worship\nv. express approval of

examples.en: The teacher [praised] Tom for his excellent test results.
examples.cn: 老师[表扬]了汤姆优异的考试成绩。

examples.en: She received a lot of [praise] for her beautiful artwork.
examples.cn: 她的美丽艺术作品获得了许多[称赞]。

examples.en: The coach [praised] the team for their hard work during training.
examples.cn: 教练[赞扬]了队员们在训练中的努力。

examples.en: Words of [praise] can encourage students to do better.
examples.cn: [表扬]的话语能激励学生做得更好。

examples.en: The audience [praised] the young singer's wonderful performance.
examples.cn: 观众[称赞]了这位年轻歌手精彩的表演。

words.translation: vt. 准备, 筹备, 使在思想上有准备, 制造, 调制\nvi. 预备
words.definition: v. to prepare verbally, either for written or spoken delivery\nv. educate for a future role or function\nv. lead up to and soften by sounding the dissonant note in it as a consonant note in the preceding chord

examples.en: Mother is [preparing] dinner in the kitchen right now.
examples.cn: 妈妈现在正在厨房[准备]晚饭。

examples.en: Students should [prepare] for the exam by reviewing their notes carefully.
examples.cn: 学生应该通过仔细复习笔记来[备考]。

examples.en: The chef [prepared] a special meal for the guests.
examples.cn: 厨师为客人[准备]了一顿特别的餐食。

examples.en: We need to [prepare] for the cold weather by buying warm clothes.
examples.cn: 我们需要通过购买暖和的衣服来为寒冷天气[做准备]。

examples.en: She [prepared] a speech carefully before standing up to talk to the class.
examples.cn: 她在起身向全班发言前认真[准备]了一篇演讲稿。

words.translation:
n. 现在, 礼品, 瞄准
a. 现在的, 出席的
vt. 介绍, 引见, 赠送, 提出, 呈现, 上演
vi. 举枪瞄准
words.definition:
n. the period of time that is happening now; any continuous stretch of time including the moment of speech
n. something presented as a gift
n. a verb tense that expresses actions or states at the time of speaking
v. bring forward and present to the mind

examples.en: All the students were [present] at the morning assembly.
examples.cn: 所有学生都[出席]了早会。

examples.en: He gave his mother a beautiful [present] on her birthday.
examples.cn: 他在妈妈生日时送了她一份漂亮的[礼物]。

examples.en: At [present], I am studying hard for my final examinations.
examples.cn: [目前]，我正在为期末考试努力复习。

examples.en: The principal [presented] certificates to the top students at the ceremony.
examples.cn: 校长在典礼上向优秀学生[颁发]了证书。

examples.en: The [present] situation requires everyone to work together.
examples.cn: [当前]的形势需要每个人共同努力。

words.translation: n. 总统, 总裁, 董事长, (学院)院长, (大学)校长, 主管人, 主持人\n[经] 总经理, 董事长, 总裁
words.definition:
n. an executive officer of a firm or corporation
n. the chief executive of a republic
n. the officer who presides at the meetings of an organization
n. the head administrative officer of a college or university

examples.en: The [president] made an important speech on national television.
examples.cn: [总统]在全国电视台发表了重要演讲。

examples.en: She was elected [president] of the student council last month.
examples.cn: 她上个月当选为学生会[主席]。

examples.en: The [president] met with foreign leaders to discuss trade and cooperation.
examples.cn: [总统]与外国领导人会面讨论贸易与合作问题。

examples.en: He has been [president] of the sports club for three years.
examples.cn: 他担任体育俱乐部[会长]已经三年了。

examples.en: The new [president] promised to improve education and healthcare for all citizens.
examples.cn: 新[总统]承诺为所有公民改善教育和医疗条件。

words.translation: a. 漂亮的, 优美的, 机灵的, 狡猾的, 恰当的\nadv. 相当, 颇
words.definition: s. pleasing by delicacy or grace; not imposing\ns. (used ironically) unexpectedly bad

examples.en: She wore a [pretty] dress to the school dance.
examples.cn: 她穿了一件[漂亮的]裙子参加学校舞会。

examples.en: The test was [pretty] difficult, but I managed to finish it.
examples.cn: 这次考试[相当]难，但我还是完成了。

examples.en: The garden looked [pretty] with all the colorful flowers in bloom.
examples.cn: 花园里五颜六色的花盛开，看起来[好看]极了。

examples.en: I am [pretty] sure that she will win the singing competition.
examples.cn: 我[相当]确定她会赢得歌唱比赛。

examples.en: The village is [pretty] with its old stone houses and green hills.
examples.cn: 这个村庄有古老的石屋和绿色的山丘，[漂亮]极了。

words.translation: v. 预防, 防止, 阻止, 妨碍
words.definition: v. keep from happening or arising; make impossible\nv. stop (someone or something) from doing something or being in a certain state

examples.en: The police blocked the road to [prevent] cars from entering the area.
examples.cn: 警察封锁道路以[阻止]汽车进入该区域。

examples.en: Wearing a mask can help [prevent] the spread of illness.
examples.cn: 戴口罩有助于[防止]疾病传播。

examples.en: Regular exercise can [prevent] many health problems.
examples.cn: 经常锻炼可以[预防]许多健康问题。

examples.en: Nothing could [prevent] him from achieving his dream.
examples.cn: 没有什么能[阻止]他实现梦想。

examples.en: We should [prevent] pollution by reducing waste and recycling more.
examples.cn: 我们应该通过减少浪费和更多回收来[防止]污染。

words.translation: n. 价格, 代价, 价值\nvt. 定...的价格
words.definition:
n. the amount of money needed to purchase something
n. value measured by what must be given or done or undergone to obtain something
n. the high value or worth of something
n. a monetary reward for helping to catch a criminal

examples.en: The [price] of vegetables has gone up this month.
examples.cn: 这个月蔬菜的[价格]上涨了。

examples.en: What is the [price] of this jacket?
examples.cn: 这件夹克的[价钱]是多少？

examples.en: The shop offers good quality at a reasonable [price].
examples.cn: 这家商店以合理的[价格]提供优质商品。

examples.en: The new phone is [priced] at three thousand yuan.
examples.cn: 这款新手机[定价]为三千元。

examples.en: Success comes at a [price] — you have to work very hard.
examples.cn: 成功是有[代价]的——你必须非常努力。

words.translation: n. 骄傲, 自尊心, 自豪, 精华, 勇气\nvt. 以...自豪
words.definition:
n. a feeling of self-respect and personal worth
n. satisfaction with your (or another's) achievements
n. the trait of being spurred on by a dislike of falling below your standards
n. a group of lions

examples.en: Her parents felt great [pride] when she won the gold medal.
examples.cn: 当她赢得金牌时，她的父母感到极大的[自豪]。

examples.en: He took great [pride] in keeping his room clean and tidy.
examples.cn: 他以保持房间整洁而感到非常[自豪]。

examples.en: She [prides] herself on always being honest with others.
examples.cn: 她[以]自己对别人总是诚实[为荣]。

examples.en: The team captain accepted the trophy with great [pride].
examples.cn: 队长带着极大的[自豪感]接受了奖杯。

examples.en: Too much [pride] can stop you from accepting help when you need it.
examples.cn: 过多的[骄傲]会使你在需要时无法接受帮助。

words.translation: n. 最主要者, 原色\na. 主要的, 初期的, 根本的, 原始的, 首要的, 基本的\n[计] 初等量; 主要的; 一次的
words.definition:
n. a preliminary election where delegates or nominees are chosen
n. one of the main flight feathers projecting along the outer edge of a bird's wing
n. (astronomy) a celestial body (especially a star) relative to other objects in orbit around it
a. of first rank or importance or value; direct and immediate rather than secondary

examples.en: The [primary] goal of education is to help students learn and grow.
examples.cn: 教育的[首要]目标是帮助学生学习和成长。

examples.en: She teaches mathematics at a [primary] school in the town.
examples.cn: 她在镇上的一所[小学]教数学。

examples.en: Reading and writing are [primary] skills that children learn first.
examples.cn: 读和写是孩子们最先学习的[基础]技能。

examples.en: Health is the [primary] concern when choosing food to eat.
examples.cn: 选择食物时，健康是[首要]考虑因素。

examples.en: After finishing [primary] school, students move on to middle school.
examples.cn: 完成[小学]学业后，学生升入中学。

words.translation: n. 打印, 版, 印刷物, 痕迹, 印刷业, 印刷字体, 图片, 印花布, 印章\nv. 打印, 印刷, 铭记, 留印记于, 用印刷体写\n[计] DOS外部命令:在打印机上打印文件, 可一边打印文件一边执行其他工作
words.definition:
n. the text appearing in a book, newspaper, or other printed publication
n. a picture or design printed from an engraving
n. availability in printed form
n. a copy of a movie on film (especially a particular version of it)

examples.en: Please [print] the document before the meeting starts.
examples.cn: 请在会议开始前[打印]这份文件。

examples.en: The newspaper is [printed] early every morning and delivered to homes.
examples.cn: 报纸每天清晨[印刷]出来并送到家中。

examples.en: The [print] in this book is very small and hard to read.
examples.cn: 这本书的[字体]很小，很难阅读。

examples.en: She [printed] her name clearly at the top of the form.
examples.cn: 她在表格顶部用印刷体清楚地[写]上了自己的名字。

examples.en: The museum has beautiful [prints] of famous paintings for sale.
examples.cn: 博物馆有精美的名画[印刷品]出售。

words.translation: n. 监狱, 监禁, 拘留所\nvt. 监禁
words.definition: n. a correctional institution where persons are confined while on trial or for punishment\nn. a prisonlike situation; a place of seeming confinement

examples.en: The thief was sent to [prison] for stealing money from the shop.
examples.cn: 小偷因从商店偷钱而被送进了[监狱]。

examples.en: He spent three years in [prison] before he was released.
examples.cn: 他在[监狱]里待了三年才被释放。

examples.en: The [prison] had high walls and strict security guards.
examples.cn: [监狱]有高墙和严格的安保人员。

examples.en: Breaking the law could lead to going to [prison].
examples.cn: 违法可能导致身陷[监狱]。

examples.en: The government announced plans to build a new [prison] outside the city.
examples.cn: 政府宣布了在城市郊区建设新[监狱]的计划。

words.translation: n. 囚犯, 犯人, 战俘\n[法] 犯人, 囚犯, 扣押犯
words.definition: n. a person who is confined; especially a prisoner of war

examples.en: The [prisoner] was given a chance to speak in front of the judge.
examples.cn: [囚犯]获得了在法官面前发言的机会。

examples.en: During the war, many soldiers became [prisoners] of the enemy.
examples.cn: 战争期间，许多士兵成了敌方的[俘虏]。

examples.en: The [prisoner] worked hard to show he deserved early release.
examples.cn: [囚犯]努力表现，以证明自己值得提前释放。

examples.en: Every [prisoner] has the right to be treated with basic dignity.
examples.cn: 每位[犯人]都有权享受基本的尊严待遇。

examples.en: The [prisoner] was moved to a different jail far from the city.
examples.cn: [囚犯]被转移到远离城市的另一座监狱。

words.translation: a. 私人的, 秘密的, 私立的, 隐蔽的\nn. 士兵, 隐士, 阴部\n[计] 私人的
words.definition: n. an enlisted man of the lowest rank in the Army or Marines\na. confined to particular persons or groups or providing privacy\ns. concerning things deeply private and personal

examples.en: This is a [private] matter and I do not want to discuss it in public.
examples.cn: 这是一件[私人]事情，我不想公开讨论。

examples.en: He studies at a [private] school that charges high fees.
examples.cn: 他就读于一所学费高昂的[私立]学校。

examples.en: They had a [private] conversation after class.
examples.cn: 他们在课后进行了一次[私下]交谈。

examples.en: Please do not read my [private] letters without my permission.
examples.cn: 请不要未经我的允许阅读我的[私人]信件。

examples.en: The hotel offers [private] rooms with their own bathrooms.
examples.cn: 这家酒店提供带有独立浴室的[私人]房间。

words.translation: n. 奖赏, 奖金, 奖品, 战利品, 捕获\na. 得奖的\nvt. 珍视, 估价, 捕获, 撬, 撬动
words.definition: n. something given for victory or superiority in a contest or competition or for winning a lottery\nv. hold dear

examples.en: She won first [prize] in the school painting competition.
examples.cn: 她在学校绘画比赛中获得了[一等奖]。

examples.en: The [prize] for winning the quiz was a new bicycle.
examples.cn: 赢得知识竞赛的[奖励]是一辆新自行车。

examples.en: He [prizes] his friendship with Tom above everything else.
examples.cn: 他[最珍视]自己与汤姆的友谊。

examples.en: The author received a famous literary [prize] for his new novel.
examples.cn: 这位作家因新小说获得了著名的文学[奖项]。

examples.en: Every student who finished the race received a small [prize].
examples.cn: 每个完成比赛的学生都获得了一份小[奖品]。

words.translation: adv. 大概, 或许
words.definition: r. with considerable certainty; without much doubt

examples.en: It will [probably] rain tomorrow, so bring an umbrella.
examples.cn: 明天[可能]会下雨，所以带把雨伞。

examples.en: She has [probably] already left for school by now.
examples.cn: 她现在[大概]已经去学校了。

examples.en: This is [probably] the best meal I have ever eaten.
examples.cn: 这[可能]是我吃过的最好的一顿饭。

examples.en: He [probably] forgot about the meeting again.
examples.cn: 他[大概]又忘记这次会议了。

examples.en: [Probably] the most important thing in life is good health.
examples.cn: [可能]生命中最重要的事情是拥有健康。

words.translation: n. 问题, 难题\na. 成问题的, 难处理的
words.definition: n. a state of difficulty that needs to be resolved\nn. a question raised for consideration or solution

examples.en: We need to work together to solve this [problem].
examples.cn: 我们需要共同努力来解决这个[问题]。

examples.en: The math [problem] was so difficult that nobody could solve it.
examples.cn: 这道数学[难题]太难了，没有人能解出来。

examples.en: There is a [problem] with the computer — it keeps shutting down.
examples.cn: 电脑出现了[问题]——它一直自动关机。

examples.en: Air pollution is a serious [problem] in many big cities today.
examples.cn: 空气污染是当今许多大城市的严重[问题]。

examples.en: If you have any [problems], please ask the teacher for help.
examples.cn: 如果你有任何[问题]，请向老师寻求帮助。

words.translation: n. 生产品, 物产, 后代\nvt. 产生, 生产, 提出, 出示\nvi. 生产, 制造
words.definition:
n. fresh fruits and vegetable grown for the market
v. bring forth or yield
v. create or manufacture a man-made product
v. cause to happen, occur or exist

examples.en: This factory [produces] thousands of cars every year.
examples.cn: 这家工厂每年[生产]数千辆汽车。

examples.en: China [produces] a large amount of rice and vegetables.
examples.cn: 中国[出产]大量的大米和蔬菜。

examples.en: Exercise [produces] chemicals in the brain that make you feel happy.
examples.cn: 运动会在大脑中[产生]让人感到快乐的化学物质。

examples.en: The market sells fresh [produce] from local farms every morning.
examples.cn: 市场每天早晨出售来自当地农场的新鲜[农产品]。

examples.en: He [produced] a letter from his pocket and handed it to the teacher.
examples.cn: 他从口袋里[拿出]一封信递给老师。

words.translation: n. 节目, 节目单, 程序, 纲要, 大纲, 计划\nvt. 规划, 拟...计划\nvi. 安排节目, 编程序
words.definition:
n an announcement of the events that will occur as part of a theatrical or sporting event
n an integrated course of academic studies
n a radio or television show
n (computer science) a sequence of instructions that a computer can interpret and execute
n a system of projects or services intended to meet a public need
n a series of steps to be carried out or goals to be accomplished
n a performance (or series of performances) at a public presentation
v write a computer program
v arrange a program of or for

examples.en: My favourite TV [programme] is on at eight o'clock tonight.
examples.cn: 我最喜欢的电视[节目]今晚八点播出。

examples.en: The government has a new [programme] to plant more trees in cities.
examples.cn: 政府有一项在城市种植更多树木的新[计划]。

examples.en: Please take a [programme] when you enter the theatre.
examples.cn: 进入剧院时请拿一份[节目单]。

examples.en: The school started a reading [programme] to encourage students to read more.
examples.cn: 学校启动了一项阅读[方案]以鼓励学生多阅读。

examples.en: The sports [programme] showed highlights from last night's match.
examples.cn: 体育[节目]播出了昨晚比赛的精彩片段。

words.translation: n. 进步, 发展, 前进\nvi. 进步, 进行
words.definition: n. the act of moving forward (as toward a goal)\nn. a movement forward\nv. develop in a positive way

examples.en: She has made great [progress] in her English since last year.
examples.cn: 她自去年以来在英语方面取得了很大[进步]。

examples.en: The building work is making good [progress] and will finish soon.
examples.cn: 建筑工程进展顺利，很快就会完工。

examples.en: As the story [progresses], the mystery slowly becomes clearer.
examples.cn: 随着故事[发展]，谜团慢慢变得越来越清晰。

examples.en: Hard work and daily practice are the keys to making [progress].
examples.cn: 努力和每日练习是取得[进步]的关键。

examples.en: The doctor was pleased with the patient's recovery [progress].
examples.cn: 医生对病人的康复[进展]感到满意。

words.translation: n. 诺言, 约定的事情, 有指望\nvt. 允诺, 约定, 预示\nvi. 允诺, 有前途, 有指望
words.definition:
n. a verbal commitment by one person to another agreeing to do (or not to do) something in the future
n. grounds for feeling hopeful about the future
v. make a promise or commitment
v. promise to undertake or give

examples.en: She [promised] to help me with my homework after dinner.
examples.cn: 她[答应]晚饭后帮我做作业。

examples.en: A [promise] is something you should always keep.
examples.cn: [诺言]是你应该始终遵守的事。

examples.en: I [promise] I will never lie to you again.
examples.cn: 我[保证]再也不会对你撒谎了。

examples.en: He kept his [promise] and visited his grandparents every weekend.
examples.cn: 他遵守[诺言]，每周末都去看望祖父母。

examples.en: The teacher [promised] to announce the exam results the next day.
examples.cn: 老师[承诺]第二天公布考试成绩。

words.translation: v. 发音, 宣告, 断言
words.definition: v. speak, pronounce, or utter in a certain way\nv. pronounce judgment on

examples.en: How do you [pronounce] this difficult English word?
examples.cn: 这个难的英语单词怎么[发音]？

examples.en: It is hard to [pronounce] some Chinese words correctly at first.
examples.cn: 起初正确[发音]某些中文词语很难。

examples.en: The doctor [pronounced] the patient healthy and ready to go home.
examples.cn: 医生[宣布]病人已康复，可以回家了。

examples.en: She [pronounced] every word clearly so everyone could understand her.
examples.cn: 她清晰地[发音]每个单词，让每个人都能听懂。

examples.en: The teacher asked the students to [pronounce] the new vocabulary aloud.
examples.cn: 老师要求学生大声[朗读]新词汇。

words.translation: n. 发音, 读法
words.definition: n. the manner in which someone utters a word\nn. the way a word or a language is customarily spoken

examples.en: His English [pronunciation] has improved a lot this term.
examples.cn: 这学期他的英语[发音]进步了很多。

examples.en: The [pronunciation] of this word is different from what I expected.
examples.cn: 这个单词的[读音]和我预想的不同。

examples.en: Good [pronunciation] helps people understand you more clearly.
examples.cn: 良好的[发音]有助于别人更清楚地理解你。

examples.en: She practises her [pronunciation] by listening to English songs every day.
examples.cn: 她每天通过听英文歌曲练习[发音]。

examples.en: The dictionary shows the [pronunciation] of each word with phonetic symbols.
examples.cn: 词典用音标标注每个词的[发音]。

words.translation: a. 适当的, 固有的, 高尚的, 专属的\nadv. 完全地, 彻底地
words.definition:
a. marked by suitability or rightness or appropriateness
s. having all the qualities typical of the thing specified; not just a snack"
s. limited to the thing specified
s. appropriate for a condition or purpose or occasion or a person's character, needs

examples.en: You should wear [proper] clothes for cold weather.
examples.cn: 你在寒冷天气里应该穿[适当的]衣服。

examples.en: It is important to learn the [proper] way to use chopsticks.
examples.cn: 学习[正确]使用筷子的方法很重要。

examples.en: Without [proper] rest, your body cannot recover well from illness.
examples.cn: 没有[适当的]休息，你的身体无法很好地从疾病中恢复。

examples.en: The teacher showed students the [proper] way to write each character.
examples.cn: 老师向学生展示了[规范]书写每个汉字的方法。

examples.en: You need to eat [proper] meals to stay healthy and strong.
examples.cn: 你需要吃[适当的]餐食来保持健康和强壮。

words.translation: vt. 防卫, 保护, 警戒\n[法] 庇护, 保护, 警戒
words.definition: v. shield from danger, injury, destruction, or damage\nv. use tariffs to favor domestic industry

examples.en: We should [protect] the environment by recycling waste.
examples.cn: 我们应该通过回收废物来[保护]环境。

examples.en: Sunscreen helps [protect] your skin from the sun's harmful rays.
examples.cn: 防晒霜有助于[保护]皮肤免受阳光有害射线的伤害。

examples.en: The mother bird [protects] her eggs from danger in the nest.
examples.cn: 母鸟在巢中[保护]她的蛋免受危险。

examples.en: Laws are made to [protect] citizens from harm.
examples.cn: 法律的制定是为了[保护]公民免受伤害。

examples.en: Wearing a helmet can [protect] your head when riding a bicycle.
examples.cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔可以[保护]你的头部。

words.translation: a. 骄傲的, 自大的, 自豪的, 辉煌的, 壮丽的
words.definition: a. feeling self-respect or pleasure in something by which you measure your self-worth; or being a reason for pride

examples.en: Her parents were very [proud] of her achievements in school.
examples.cn: 她的父母对她在学校的成就感到非常[自豪]。

examples.en: He was too [proud] to ask for help when he was in trouble.
examples.cn: 他太[骄傲]了，遇到麻烦时不愿寻求帮助。

examples.en: I am [proud] to be a student at this excellent school.
examples.cn: 我为能成为这所优秀学校的学生而感到[自豪]。

examples.en: The coach was [proud] of the team for training so hard all week.
examples.cn: 教练对团队整周刻苦训练感到[自豪]。

examples.en: She felt [proud] when her painting was displayed in the school hall.
examples.cn: 当她的画作展示在学校大厅时，她感到[自豪]。

words.translation: vt. 证明, 查验, 检验, 勘探, 显示\nvi. 证明是
words.definition:
v. be shown or be found to be
v. establish the validity of something, as by an example, explanation or experiment
v. prove formally; demonstrate by a mathematical, formal proof
v. take a trial impression of

examples.en: He worked hard to [prove] that he could succeed.
examples.cn: 他努力工作来[证明]自己能够成功。

examples.en: Scientists need data to [prove] their theories are correct.
examples.cn: 科学家需要数据来[证明]他们的理论是正确的。

examples.en: The exam results [proved] that she was the top student in the class.
examples.cn: 考试成绩[证实]她是班上最优秀的学生。

examples.en: It is difficult to [prove] who is right without any evidence.
examples.cn: 没有任何证据很难[证明]谁是对的。

examples.en: Time will [prove] whether this was the right decision.
examples.cn: 时间会[证明]这个决定是否正确。

words.translation: vt. 提供, 供应, 规定, 预备\nvi. 作准备, 抚养, 规定
words.definition:
v. give what is desired or needed, especially support, food or sustenance
v. determine (what is to happen in certain contingencies), especially by including a proviso condition or stipulation
v. supply means of subsistence; earn a living
v. take measures in preparation for

examples.en: The school [provides] free lunches for students from poor families.
examples.cn: 学校为贫困家庭的学生[提供]免费午餐。

examples.en: The solar panels [provide] electricity for the whole building.
examples.cn: 太阳能板为整栋楼[供给]电力。

examples.en: Please [provide] your name and telephone number on the form.
examples.cn: 请在表格上[提供]你的姓名和电话号码。

examples.en: The library [provides] a quiet place to study and read.
examples.cn: 图书馆[提供]一个安静的学习和阅读场所。

examples.en: Parents work hard to [provide] food and shelter for their children.
examples.cn: 父母努力工作以[供养]孩子食物和住所。

words.translation: n. 公众, 民众\na. 公众的, 公共的, 公立的, 公用的
words.definition: n. a body of people sharing some common interest\na. not private; open to or concerning the people as a whole\ns. affecting the people or community as a whole

examples.en: There is a [public] library near our school that anyone can use.
examples.cn: 学校附近有一个任何人都可以使用的[公共]图书馆。

examples.en: The new park is now open to the [public].
examples.cn: 新公园现在向[公众]开放了。

examples.en: He is a famous singer and always performs in [public].
examples.cn: 他是一位著名歌手，经常在[公开]场合表演。

examples.en: Many people use [public] transport to travel around the city.
examples.cn: 许多人乘坐[公共]交通出行。

examples.en: The government listens to the opinions of the [public].
examples.cn: 政府听取[民众]的意见。

words.translation: vt. 拉, 拖, 拔, 牵, 撕开, 吸引\nvi. 拉, 拖, 拔, 有吸引力\nn. 拉, 拖, 拔, 拉力, 牵引力, 划船, 吸引
words.definition:
n. the act of pulling; applying force to move something toward or with you
n. the force used in pulling
n. special advantage or influence
n. a device used for pulling something

examples.en: He [pulled] the heavy cart up the steep hill with great effort.
examples.cn: 他用力[拉]着那辆沉重的推车上了陡峭的山坡。

examples.en: Please [pull] the curtains open so the sunlight can come in.
examples.cn: 请把窗帘[拉]开，让阳光进来。

examples.en: The dentist had to [pull] out his broken tooth very carefully.
examples.cn: 牙医不得不小心地[拔]掉他断裂的牙齿。

examples.en: She [pulled] her younger brother away from the busy road.
examples.cn: 她把弟弟从繁忙的马路旁[拉]开。

examples.en: The colorful window display [pulled] many customers into the shop.
examples.cn: 色彩缤纷的橱窗展示[吸引]了许多顾客进入店内。

words.translation: vt. 处罚, 惩罚, 严厉对待\nvi. 惩罚
words.definition: v. impose a penalty on; inflict punishment on

examples.en: The teacher [punished] the students who cheated on the test.
examples.cn: 老师[惩罚]了那些在考试中作弊的学生。

examples.en: Parents should [punish] children fairly, not harshly or angrily.
examples.cn: 父母应该公平地[处罚]孩子，而不是严酷或愤怒地对待。

examples.en: The law [punishes] people who drive dangerously on the road.
examples.cn: 法律[惩处]在道路上危险驾驶的人。

examples.en: He was [punished] for arriving late to class three times in a row.
examples.cn: 他因连续三次迟到而受到了[惩罚]。

examples.en: Breaking the school rules will result in being [punished] by the headteacher.
examples.cn: 违反校规将会受到校长的[惩罚]。

words.translation: n. 学生, 门生, 未成年人, 瞳孔\n[医] 瞳孔
words.definition: n. the contractile aperture in the center of the iris of the eye; resembles a large black dot

examples.en: Every [pupil] in the class was asked to read a paragraph aloud.
examples.cn: 班上的每位[学生]都被要求大声朗读一段话。

examples.en: The teacher knows each [pupil] by name in her class.
examples.cn: 老师知道班上每位[学生]的名字。

examples.en: In the dark, the [pupils] of your eyes get bigger to let in more light.
examples.cn: 在黑暗中，眼睛的[瞳孔]会变大以让更多光线进入。

examples.en: The [pupils] lined up quietly outside the classroom door.
examples.cn: [学生们]安静地在教室门外排好队。

examples.en: As a [pupil], it is your responsibility to study and learn every day.
examples.cn: 作为一名[学生]，你每天学习是你的责任。

words.translation: n. 紫色, 帝位\na. 紫色的, 帝王的, 华而不实的\nv. (使)成紫色
words.definition:
n. a purple color or pigment
n. of imperial status
v. become purple
v. color purple

examples.en: She painted the walls of her bedroom [purple].
examples.cn: 她把卧室的墙壁涂成了[紫色]。

examples.en: The sunset turned the sky beautiful shades of [purple] and orange.
examples.cn: 夕阳将天空染成美丽的[紫色]和橙色。

examples.en: He wore a [purple] tie to the school presentation day.
examples.cn: 他在学校展示日佩戴了一条[紫色]领带。

examples.en: [Purple] is often associated with royalty and power throughout history.
examples.cn: [紫色]在历史上常与皇室和权力联系在一起。

examples.en: The flowers in the garden included red, pink and [purple] roses.
examples.cn: 花园里的花卉包括红色、粉色和[紫色]玫瑰。

words.translation: n. 目的, 意向, 决心, 用途, 效果, 论题\nvt. 意欲, 企图, 计划
words.definition: n. an anticipated outcome that is intended or that guides your planned actions\nv. reach a decision

examples.en: The [purpose] of this exercise is to improve your writing skills.
examples.cn: 这项练习的[目的]是提高你的写作技能。

examples.en: She came here on [purpose] to apologise for what she had said.
examples.cn: 她[特意]来这里为自己说过的话道歉。

examples.en: Having a clear [purpose] in life helps you stay focused and motivated.
examples.cn: 拥有明确的人生[目标]有助于你保持专注和积极性。

examples.en: This old room now serves the [purpose] of a storage space.
examples.cn: 这个旧房间现在作为储藏空间发挥着新的[用途]。

examples.en: What is the [purpose] of your visit to our school today?
examples.cn: 你今天来访我们学校的[目的]是什么？

words.translation: n. 钱包, 小钱袋, 金钱, 募捐款, 囊状物\nv. 缩拢, 皱起
words.definition:
n. a sum of money spoken of as the contents of a money purse
n. a small bag for carrying money
n. a sum of money offered as a prize
v. contract one's lips into a rounded shape

examples.en: She opened her [purse] and took out some coins to buy a ticket.
examples.cn: 她打开[钱包]取出一些硬币买票。

examples.en: He found a [purse] on the ground and handed it to the police.
examples.cn: 他在地上发现了一个[钱包]，并将其交给了警察。

examples.en: She put her phone, keys and cards in her [purse] before leaving home.
examples.cn: 离家前她把手机、钥匙和卡片放进了[手提包]里。

examples.en: My mother always keeps a small [purse] inside her bag.
examples.cn: 我妈妈总是在包里放一个小[钱包]。

examples.en: The stolen [purse] was returned to its owner by an honest student.
examples.cn: 被盗的[钱包]被一位诚实的学生归还给了失主。

words.translation: n. 推, 推动, 奋斗, 攻击, 进取心\nvt. 推, 推动, 使伸出, 推行, 逼迫, 增加\nvi. 推, 推进, 增加, 努力争取
words.definition:
n. the act of applying force in order to move something away
n. the force used in pushing
n. an effort to advance
v. move with force, "He pushed the table into a corner"

examples.en: He [pushed] the door open and walked inside the room.
examples.cn: 他[推]开门走进了房间。

examples.en: They [pushed] the broken car to the side of the road.
examples.cn: 他们把坏掉的车[推]到了路边。

examples.en: His mother always [pushes] him to study harder.
examples.cn: 他的妈妈总是[督促]他更努力学习。

examples.en: Do not [push] in the queue — everyone is waiting their turn.
examples.cn: 不要在队伍里[挤]——大家都在等候。

examples.en: She [pushed] the shopping trolley around the supermarket.
examples.cn: 她在超市里[推]着购物车走来走去。

words.translation:
vt. 放, 摆, 安置, 移动, 发射, 投掷, 写上, 表达, 使从事, 使受到, 驱使, 赋予
vi. 出发, 航行, 发芽
n. 掷, 股票出售权, 笨蛋
a. 固定不动的
[计] 发送文件
words.definition:
v. put into a certain place or abstract location
v. cause to be in a certain state; cause to be in a certain relation
v. attribute or give
v. cause (someone) to undergo something

examples.en: Please [put] your books on the desk before class begins.
examples.cn: 请在课前把书[放]在桌子上。

examples.en: She [put] the flowers in a vase and placed them by the window.
examples.cn: 她把花[放]进花瓶，摆在窗边。

examples.en: He [put] his ideas clearly in the essay he wrote for homework.
examples.cn: 他在家庭作业的作文中清楚地[表达]了自己的想法。

examples.en: Do not [put] rubbish on the floor — use the bin instead.
examples.cn: 不要把垃圾[扔]在地上——请用垃圾桶。

examples.en: She [put] a lot of effort into preparing for the school concert.
examples.cn: 她[投入]了大量精力准备学校音乐会。

words.translation: n. 四分之一, 一刻钟, 季度, 地区\nvt. 四等分, 肢解\nvi. 驻扎, 住宿
words.definition:
n. a district of a city having some distinguishing character
n. (football, professional basketball) one of four divisions into which some games are divided
n. a unit of time equal to 15 minutes or a quarter of an hour
n. one of four periods into which the school year is divided

examples.en: A [quarter] of the students in our class are from other cities.
examples.cn: 我们班四分之一的学生来自其他城市。

examples.en: It is a [quarter] past seven, so we need to hurry.
examples.cn: 现在是七点[一刻]，所以我们需要快点。

examples.en: She ate only a [quarter] of the pizza because she was not very hungry.
examples.cn: 她只吃了四分之一的披萨，因为她不太饿。

examples.en: The company reports its earnings every [quarter] of the year.
examples.cn: 公司每[季度]报告一次收益。

examples.en: We have a [quarter] of an hour left to finish the test.
examples.cn: 我们还有[一刻钟]时间完成测试。

words.translation: n. 王后, 女王\nvt. 立为女王\nvi. 做女王
words.definition:
n. the only fertile female in a colony of social insects such as bees and ants and termites; its function is to lay eggs
n. a female sovereign ruler
n. the wife or widow of a king
n. something personified as a woman who is considered the best or most important of her kind

examples.en: The [queen] waved to the crowd from the palace balcony.
examples.cn: [女王]从宫殿阳台向人群挥手致意。

examples.en: The king and [queen] attended the royal ceremony together.
examples.cn: 国王和[王后]一同出席了皇家典礼。

examples.en: The [queen] ruled the country wisely for many years.
examples.cn: [女王]英明地统治这个国家许多年。

examples.en: In chess, the [queen] is the most powerful piece on the board.
examples.cn: 在象棋中，[王后]是棋盘上最强大的棋子。

examples.en: The [queen] opened the new library and spoke to the local children.
examples.cn: [女王]为新图书馆揭幕，并与当地的孩子们交谈。

words.translation: n. 问题, 询问\nv. 询问, 审问, 怀疑\n[计] 询问
words.definition:
n. an instance of questioning
n. the subject matter at issue
n. a sentence of inquiry that asks for a reply
n. an informal reference to a marriage proposal

examples.en: The teacher asked the class a difficult [question].
examples.cn: 老师向全班提出了一个难[问题]。

examples.en: The police [questioned] the witness about what he had seen.
examples.cn: 警察[询问]了目击者所看到的情况。

examples.en: If you have any [questions], please raise your hand.
examples.cn: 如果你有任何[问题]，请举手。

examples.en: There is no [question] that she is the best student in the school.
examples.cn: 毫无[疑问]，她是学校里最优秀的学生。

examples.en: He answered every [question] on the exam correctly.
examples.cn: 他正确回答了考试中的每一道[问题]。

words.translation: a. 快的, 迅速的, 敏捷的, 灵敏的, 急速的\nadv. 快\nn. 新长出的肉, 要害, 核心, 感觉敏锐部位
words.definition:
n. any area of the body that is highly sensitive to pain (as the flesh underneath the skin or a fingernail or toenail)
s. accomplished rapidly and without delay
s. apprehending and responding with speed and sensitivity
s. easily aroused or excited

examples.en: She is a [quick] learner and understands new ideas easily.
examples.cn: 她学习[快]，很容易理解新知识。

examples.en: Please make a [quick] decision because we do not have much time.
examples.cn: 请快速做出决定，因为我们没有多少时间了。

examples.en: We had a [quick] breakfast and then rushed to school.
examples.cn: 我们快速吃了早饭然后冲向学校。

examples.en: The goalkeeper made a [quick] save to stop the ball from going in.
examples.cn: 守门员做了一个[敏捷的]扑救，阻止了球入门。

examples.en: Taking the train is the [quickest] way to get to the city centre.
examples.cn: 乘火车是到达市中心[最快的]方式。

words.translation:
n. 安静, 闲适, 平静
a. 安静的, 静止的, 寂静的, 朴素的, 从容的, 暗中的
vi. 平静下来
vt. 使平静, 使平息, 使安心, 安慰
words.definition:
a. characterized by an absence or near absence of agitation or activity
a. free of noise or uproar; or making little if any sound
s. not showy or obtrusive
a. of the sun characterized by a low level of surface phenomena like sunspots e.g.

examples.en: Please be [quiet] in the library so others can study.
examples.cn: 请在图书馆保持[安静]，让其他人能够学习。

examples.en: The village was very [quiet] early in the morning.
examples.cn: 清晨，村庄非常[寂静]。

examples.en: She spoke in a [quiet] voice so as not to wake the baby.
examples.cn: 她用[轻柔]的声音说话，以免吵醒婴儿。

examples.en: He is a [quiet] boy who prefers reading to playing outside.
examples.cn: 他是一个喜欢阅读胜过户外玩耍的[安静]男孩。

examples.en: The countryside is [quiet] and peaceful compared to the noisy city.
examples.cn: 与嘈杂的城市相比，乡村是[宁静]而祥和的。

words.translation: adv. 相当, 完全, 十分
words.definition:
r. to a degree (not used with a negative)
r. to the greatest extent; completely
r. of an unusually noticeable or exceptional or remarkable kind (not used with a negative)
r. actually or truly or to an extreme

examples.en: The film was [quite] good, though not the best I have seen.
examples.cn: 这部电影[相当]不错，尽管不是我看过最好的。

examples.en: I am not [quite] sure what time the meeting starts.
examples.cn: 我[不太]确定会议几点开始。

examples.en: Learning a new language is [quite] challenging but very rewarding.
examples.cn: 学一门新语言[相当]有挑战性，但非常有价值。

examples.en: The room was [quite] different from what I had imagined.
examples.cn: 这个房间与我想象的[完全]不同。

examples.en: She speaks English [quite] well for someone who has studied for only one year.
examples.cn: 对于只学了一年的人来说，她英语说得[相当]好。

words.translation: n. 兔子\nvi. 猎兔\nvt. 让...见鬼去
words.definition: n. any of various burrowing animals of the family Leporidae having long ears and short tails; some domesticated and raised for pets or food\nn. flesh of any of various rabbits or hares (wild or domesticated) eaten as food\nv. hunt rabbits

examples.en: The children were excited to see a [rabbit] hopping in the garden.
examples.cn: 孩子们很兴奋地看到一只[兔子]在花园里跳来跳去。

examples.en: She keeps a white [rabbit] as a pet in her bedroom.
examples.cn: 她在卧室里养了一只白色[兔子]作为宠物。

examples.en: The [rabbit] hid behind the bush when it heard a loud noise.
examples.cn: [兔子]听到一声巨响后躲到了灌木丛后面。

examples.en: Wild [rabbits] can run very fast when they sense danger.
examples.cn: 野[兔子]感到危险时跑得非常快。

examples.en: The farmer built a fence to stop [rabbits] from eating his vegetables.
examples.cn: 农民建了一道栅栏，阻止[兔子]吃他的蔬菜。

words.translation:
n. 种族, 人种, 赛跑, 比赛, 急流, 人类, 同道, 姜根
vi. 赛跑, 竞赛, 疾走
vt. 与...赛跑, 使疾走, 使猛转
[计] 竞争; 追赶; 欧州高级通信研究开发计划
words.definition:
n. any competition
n. a contest of speed
n. people who are believed to belong to the same genetic stock
v. compete in a race

examples.en: She won the [race] and received a gold medal.
examples.cn: 她赢得了[赛跑]并获得了金牌。

examples.en: The children [raced] each other to the end of the playground.
examples.cn: 孩子们互相[赛跑]到操场尽头。

examples.en: It was a close [race] and the winner was decided at the last moment.
examples.cn: 这是一场激烈的[竞赛]，胜负在最后一刻才决出。

examples.en: People of every [race] should be treated with equal respect.
examples.cn: 各个[种族]的人都应该受到平等的尊重。

examples.en: He trained every day to prepare for the swimming [race].
examples.cn: 他每天训练，为游泳[比赛]做准备。

words.translation: n. 无线电, 收音机, 无线电报, 无线电广播, 无线电台\nv. 用无线电发送
words.definition:
n. medium for communication
n. a communication system based on broadcasting electromagnetic waves
v. transmit messages via radio waves
a. indicating radiation or radioactivity

examples.en: My grandfather listens to the [radio] every morning while eating breakfast.
examples.cn: 我爷爷每天早上吃早饭时听[收音机]。

examples.en: The weather forecast came on the [radio] at noon.
examples.cn: 中午[广播]里播出了天气预报。

examples.en: They heard the news about the earthquake on the [radio].
examples.cn: 他们在[收音机]上听到了地震的消息。

examples.en: The ship sent a message by [radio] to the coast guard.
examples.cn: 船只通过[无线电]向海岸警卫队发送了消息。

examples.en: She often sings along to the songs played on the [radio].
examples.cn: 她经常跟着[广播]里播放的歌曲一起唱。

words.translation: n. 铁路, 轨道\n[经] 铁路
words.definition: n. line that is the commercial organization responsible for operating a system of transportation for trains that pull passengers or freight

examples.en: The new [railway] connects the city to the airport in twenty minutes.
examples.cn: 新[铁路]在二十分钟内将城市与机场连接起来。

examples.en: Workers are building a [railway] through the mountains.
examples.cn: 工人们正在穿越山脉修建[铁路]。

examples.en: The [railway] station is just a short walk from our school.
examples.cn: [铁路]车站离我们学校只有几步之遥。

examples.en: Children should never play near [railway] tracks as it is very dangerous.
examples.cn: 孩子们绝不应该在[铁道]附近玩耍，因为非常危险。

examples.en: The high-speed [railway] has made travel between cities much faster.
examples.cn: 高速[铁路]使城市间的旅行快多了。

words.translation: n. 雨, 下雨, 雨天\nvi. 下雨\nvt. 使大量落下
words.definition:
n. water falling in drops from vapor condensed in the atmosphere
n. drops of fresh water that fall as precipitation from clouds
n. anything happening rapidly or in quick successive
v. precipitate as rain

examples.en: The [rain] fell heavily all afternoon and flooded the streets.
examples.cn: [雨]整个下午都下得很大，街道被淹了。

examples.en: It started to [rain] just as we left the house.
examples.cn: 就在我们离开家时开始[下雨]了。

examples.en: Please come inside — the [rain] is getting heavier.
examples.cn: 请进来——[雨]越下越大了。

examples.en: It [rains] a lot in this region during the summer months.
examples.cn: 这个地区夏季[雨]水很多。

examples.en: Farmers welcome the [rain] because it helps their crops grow.
examples.cn: 农民欢迎[雨水]，因为它有助于庄稼生长。

words.translation: n. 雨衣
words.definition: n. a water-resistant coat

examples.en: She put on her yellow [raincoat] before going out in the rain.
examples.cn: 她在雨中出门前穿上了黄色的[雨衣]。

examples.en: Do not forget to bring your [raincoat] — it might rain this afternoon.
examples.cn: 别忘了带上[雨衣]——今天下午可能会下雨。

examples.en: He bought a new [raincoat] to stay dry during the rainy season.
examples.cn: 他买了一件新[雨衣]，以便在雨季保持干燥。

examples.en: The [raincoat] kept her completely dry during the heavy shower.
examples.cn: [雨衣]让她在大雨中保持完全干燥。

examples.en: Children at the school all wore colourful [raincoats] on the rainy day.
examples.cn: 雨天学校的孩子们都穿着五颜六色的[雨衣]。

words.translation: a. 下雨的, 多雨的
words.definition: s (of weather) wet by periods of rain

examples.en: It was a cold and [rainy] day, so we stayed indoors.
examples.cn: 那是一个寒冷而[多雨]的天气，所以我们留在室内。

examples.en: On [rainy] days, the students eat lunch inside the classroom.
examples.cn: 在[下雨]的日子，学生们在教室里吃午饭。

examples.en: April is often the most [rainy] month of the year here.
examples.cn: 这里四月份通常是全年[雨水]最多的月份。

examples.en: She always carries an umbrella in case of a [rainy] day.
examples.cn: 她总是带着雨伞以防[下雨]。

examples.en: The [rainy] season lasts from June to August in this region.
examples.cn: 这个地区的[雨季]从六月持续到八月。

words.translation: n. 上升, 高地, 增高\nvt. 升起, 举起, 唤起, 提高, 使出现, 使复活, 提出, 筹集, 饲养
words.definition:
n. the amount a salary is increased
n. increasing the size of a bet (as in poker)
v. raise the level or amount of something
v. raise from a lower to a higher position

examples.en: Please [raise] your hand if you know the answer.
examples.cn: 如果你知道答案，请[举]手。

examples.en: The school decided to [raise] the level of the English exam.
examples.cn: 学校决定[提高]英语考试的难度。

examples.en: She was [raised] by her grandparents in a small village.
examples.cn: 她在一个小村庄被祖父母[抚养]长大。

examples.en: The students [raised] money for the school charity event.
examples.cn: 学生们为学校慈善活动[筹集]了资金。

examples.en: He [raised] an important question during the class discussion.
examples.cn: 他在课堂讨论中[提出]了一个重要问题。

words.translation: a. 迅速的, 飞快的, 急促的, 陡的\nn. 急流
words.definition: n. a part of a river where the current is very fast\ns. done or occurring in a brief period of time\ns. characterized by speed; moving with or capable of moving with high speed

examples.en: The country made [rapid] progress in science and technology.
examples.cn: 这个国家在科学技术方面取得了[迅速]的进步。

examples.en: Her [rapid] improvement in English surprised everyone.
examples.cn: 她英语的[迅速]进步让所有人都感到惊讶。

examples.en: The city experienced [rapid] growth over the past twenty years.
examples.cn: 这座城市在过去二十年经历了[快速]增长。

examples.en: A [rapid] response is needed when there is a fire emergency.
examples.cn: 发生火灾紧急情况时需要[迅速]响应。

examples.en: Thanks to [rapid] transport, we can travel between cities in a few hours.
examples.cn: 得益于[快速]交通，我们可以在几个小时内城市间往来。

words.translation: n. 鼠, 卑鄙的人, 破坏者, 变节者\nvi. 捕鼠, 变节\nvt. 弄蓬松
words.definition:
n. any of various long-tailed rodents similar to but larger than a mouse
n. a pad (usually made of hair) worn as part of a woman's coiffure
v. desert one's party or group of friends, for example, for one's personal advantage
v. employ scabs or strike breakers in

examples.en: The farmer set traps to catch the [rats] in the barn.
examples.cn: 农夫在谷仓里设置陷阱捕捉[老鼠]。

examples.en: A [rat] ran across the kitchen floor and frightened everyone.
examples.cn: 一只[老鼠]跑过厨房地板，吓到了所有人。

examples.en: Scientists sometimes use [rats] in laboratory experiments.
examples.cn: 科学家有时在实验室实验中使用[老鼠]。

examples.en: The cat chased the [rat] all around the garden.
examples.cn: 猫在花园里追赶那只[老鼠]。

examples.en: They heard [rats] scratching inside the walls at night.
examples.cn: 他们晚上听到[老鼠]在墙壁内抓挠的声音。

words.translation: adv. 宁可, 稍微, 相当
words.definition: r. on the contrary; rather (or instead), he wrote her a letter"\nr. to some (great or small) extent

examples.en: The homework was [rather] difficult, but I finished it by myself.
examples.cn: 作业[相当]难，但我自己完成了。

examples.en: I would [rather] walk than take the bus on such a fine day.
examples.cn: 在这么好的天气里，我[宁愿]走路而不坐公共汽车。

examples.en: She felt [rather] nervous before going on stage to perform.
examples.cn: 她在上台表演前感到[相当]紧张。

examples.en: He is my friend, or [rather], my best friend.
examples.cn: 他是我的朋友，[更确切地说]，是我最好的朋友。

examples.en: The weather is [rather] cold today, so dress warmly.
examples.cn: 今天天气[相当]冷，所以要穿暖和点。

words.translation: n. 伸出, 延伸, 区域, 范围, 流域, 岬\nvt. 到达, 达到, 伸出, 延伸, 影响\nvi. 达到, 延伸, 伸出手, 传到
words.definition:
n. the act of physically reaching or thrusting out
v. reach a destination, either real or abstract
v. reach a point in time, or a certain state or level
v. move forward or upward in order to touch; also in a metaphorical sense

examples.en: We [reached] the top of the mountain after three hours of climbing.
examples.cn: 爬了三个小时后，我们[到达]了山顶。

examples.en: She stood on a chair to [reach] the book on the top shelf.
examples.cn: 她站在椅子上去[够]最上层架子上的书。

examples.en: The train [reaches] the station at half past nine.
examples.cn: 火车九点半[抵达]车站。

examples.en: I tried to [reach] you by phone but there was no answer.
examples.cn: 我试着打电话[联系]你，但没有人接。

examples.en: Her score [reached] ninety-five in the final examination.
examples.cn: 她在期末考试中的分数[达到]了九十五分。

words.translation:
v. 读, 阅读, 理解
a. 有学问的
n. 读取, 阅读
[计] 读取
words.definition:
n. something that is read
v. interpret something that is written or printed
v. have or contain a certain wording or form
v. look at, interpret, and say out loud something that is written or printed

examples.en: She likes to [read] novels before going to sleep at night.
examples.cn: 她喜欢在晚上睡觉前[阅读]小说。

examples.en: The teacher asked him to [read] the passage aloud to the class.
examples.cn: 老师让他向全班大声[朗读]这段文章。

examples.en: I cannot [read] his handwriting — it is too messy.
examples.cn: 我看不[懂]他的字迹——太潦草了。

examples.en: He [reads] the newspaper every morning to stay informed.
examples.cn: 他每天早上[阅读]报纸以了解时事。

examples.en: The thermometer [reads] thirty-seven degrees.
examples.cn: 温度计[显示]三十七度。

words.translation:
n. 预备好的状态, 现款
a. 准备好的, 备用的, 可以使用的
adv. 预先, 迅速
vt. 使准备好
words.definition:
n. poised for action
a. completely prepared or in condition for immediate action or use or progress
s. (of especially money) immediately available
s. mentally disposed

examples.en: Are you [ready] to start the exam? The teacher is waiting.
examples.cn: 你[准备好]开始考试了吗？老师在等着。

examples.en: Dinner is [ready] — please come to the table.
examples.cn: 晚饭[准备好]了——请来餐桌。

examples.en: She is always [ready] to help her classmates with their problems.
examples.cn: 她总是[乐意]帮助同学解决问题。

examples.en: Get [ready] quickly or we will miss the school bus.
examples.cn: 快[准备好]，不然我们会错过校车的。

examples.en: There is no [ready] answer to such a difficult question.
examples.cn: 这样一个难题没有[现成的]答案。

words.translation: a. 真的, 真实的, 实际的, 实在的, 不动(产)的, 实数的\nn. 实数, 现实\nadv. 真正地
words.definition:
n. the basic unit of money in Brazil; equal to 100 centavos
n. an old small silver Spanish coin
a. being or occurring in fact or actuality; having verified existence; not illusory; not ghosts"
a. no less than what is stated; worthy of the name

examples.en: Is this a [real] diamond or just a piece of glass?
examples.cn: 这是[真正的]钻石还是只是一块玻璃？

examples.en: The story is based on [real] events that happened in the city.
examples.cn: 这个故事基于发生在这座城市的[真实]事件。

examples.en: She has a [real] talent for painting and drawing.
examples.cn: 她在绘画方面有[真正的]天赋。

examples.en: The film looks so realistic that it is hard to believe it is not [real].
examples.cn: 这部电影看起来非常逼真，让人难以相信它不是[真实的]。

examples.en: Finding a [real] friend who supports you through difficult times is precious.
examples.cn: 找到一位在困难时期支持你的[真正]朋友是珍贵的。

words.translation: vt. 实现, 认识到, 体会到, 了解, 认清, 使显得逼真, 变卖财产为现钱
words.definition:
v earn on some commercial or business transaction; earn as salary or wages
v convert into cash; of goods and property
v expand or complete (a part in a piece of baroque music) by supplying the harmonies indicated in the figured bass
v make real or concrete; give reality or substance to
v be fully aware or cognizant of
v perceive (an idea or situation) mentally

examples.en: She [realised] that she had left her bag on the bus.
examples.cn: 她[意识到]自己把包落在公共汽车上了。

examples.en: He did not [realise] how important sleep was until he felt ill.
examples.cn: 他生病之前没有[意识到]睡眠有多重要。

examples.en: I [realised] that learning English takes a lot of patience and practice.
examples.cn: 我[认识到]学英语需要很多耐心和练习。

examples.en: She worked hard to [realise] her dream of becoming a doctor.
examples.cn: 她努力工作以[实现]成为一名医生的梦想。

examples.en: Did you [realise] that today is the last day to submit the homework?
examples.cn: 你[意识到]今天是提交作业的最后一天了吗？

words.translation: adv. 实际上, 真实地, 实在
words.definition:
r in accordance with truth or fact or reality
r in actual fact
r in fact (used as intensifiers or sentence modifiers)
r used as intensifiers; `real' is sometimes used informally for `really'; `rattling' is informal

examples.en: I [really] enjoyed the science lesson today — it was fascinating.
examples.cn: 我今天[真的]很享受科学课——太有趣了。

examples.en: The weather is [really] hot today, so drink plenty of water.
examples.cn: 今天天气[非常]热，所以要多喝水。

examples.en: Do you [really] want to go hiking in the rain?
examples.cn: 你[真的]想在雨中去徒步吗？

examples.en: She looks young but she is [really] thirty-five years old.
examples.cn: 她看起来年轻，但她[实际上]三十五岁了。

examples.en: He [really] cares about his students and always helps them.
examples.cn: 他[真正]关心他的学生，总是帮助他们。

words.translation: n. 理由, 原因, 理智, 道理, 前提, 理性\nvt. 说服, 推论, 辩论\nvi. 推论, 劝说, 思考
words.definition:
n. a rational motive for a belief or action
n. an explanation of the cause of some phenomenon
n. the capacity for rational thought or inference or discrimination
n. a fact that logically justifies some premise or conclusion

examples.en: The [reason] she was late was that the bus broke down.
examples.cn: 她迟到的[原因]是公共汽车坏了。

examples.en: Is there a good [reason] why you did not hand in your homework?
examples.cn: 你有什么好[理由]没有交作业吗？

examples.en: For some [reason], he decided not to attend the party.
examples.cn: 由于某种[原因]，他决定不参加聚会。

examples.en: We should use our ability to [reason] before making any big decision.
examples.cn: 在做任何重大决定之前，我们应该运用[推理]能力。

examples.en: There is no [reason] to give up when things get difficult.
examples.cn: 当事情变得困难时，没有[理由]放弃。

words.translation: vt. 收到, 接到, 得到, 接待, 迎接, 承受\nvi. 收到, 会客\n[计] 接收
words.definition:
v. get something; come into possession of
v. receive a specified treatment (abstract)
v. express willingness to have in one's home or environs
v. accept as true or valid

examples.cn: 她很高兴[收到]来自法国笔友的信。

examples.en: He [received] an award for being the most helpful student of the year.
examples.cn: 他[获得]了年度最热心助人学生奖。

examples.en: Did you [receive] my message? I sent it an hour ago.
examples.cn: 你[收到]我的消息了吗？我一个小时前发的。

examples.en: The principal [received] the guests at the entrance to the school.
examples.cn: 校长在学校入口处[迎接]了来宾。

examples.en: The charity [received] thousands of donations from kind people.
examples.cn: 慈善机构[收到]了来自善心人士的数千笔捐款。

words.translation: a. 最近的, 近代的, 最新的\n[经] 最近的, 新进的
words.definition: s. new

examples.en: Have you seen any [recent] news about the football championship?
examples.cn: 你看到关于足球锦标赛的[最近]新闻了吗？

examples.en: The [recent] cold weather has affected many people's health.
examples.cn: [最近]的寒冷天气影响了许多人的健康。

examples.en: In [recent] years, technology has changed our lives greatly.
examples.cn: [近年来]，科技极大地改变了我们的生活。

examples.en: She has made great progress in her [recent] piano lessons.
examples.cn: 她在[最近]的钢琴课中取得了很大进步。

examples.en: The [recent] changes to the school timetable surprised many students.
examples.cn: 学校课程表的[最新]变化让许多学生感到惊讶。

words.translation: v. 背诵, 朗读, 叙述
words.definition: v. repeat aloud from memory\nv. render verbally, "recite a poem"

examples.en: The students had to [recite] the poem in front of the whole class.
examples.cn: 学生们必须在全班面前[背诵]这首诗。

examples.en: Can you [recite] all the multiplication tables without making a mistake?
examples.cn: 你能不出错地[背诵]所有乘法表吗？

examples.en: She [recited] the speech she had memorised for the school event.
examples.cn: 她[朗诵]了她为学校活动记住的演讲稿。

examples.en: Learning to [recite] classical poems is part of the Chinese curriculum.
examples.cn: 学习[背诵]古典诗歌是中文课程的一部分。

examples.en: He [recited] the main points of the lesson to prepare for the test.
examples.cn: 他[复述]了课文要点来备考。

words.translation:
n. 记录, 履历, 档案, 审判记录, 最高纪录, 唱片
vt. 记录, 记载, 标明, 将...录音
vi. 记录, 录音, 可被录音
a. 创纪录的
[计] 录制, 记录
words.definition:
n. anything (such as a document or a phonograph record or a photograph) providing permanent evidence of or information about past events
n. the number of wins versus losses and ties a team has had
n. the sum of recognized accomplishments
n. a compilation of the known facts regarding something or someone

examples.en: She broke the school [record] for the one-hundred-metre race.
examples.cn: 她打破了学校百米赛跑[纪录]。

examples.en: The teacher [recorded] the students' scores in a notebook.
examples.cn: 老师把学生的成绩[记录]在笔记本里。

examples.en: He has a large collection of music [records] at home.
examples.cn: 他家里有大量音乐[唱片]收藏。

examples.en: She [recorded] the concert on her phone to watch again later.
examples.cn: 她用手机[录制]了音乐会，以便以后再看。

examples.en: The doctor keeps a careful [record] of each patient's medical history.
examples.cn: 医生仔细[记录]每位病人的病史。

words.translation: n. 记录员, 录音机\nn. 记录器\n[计] 宏录制器, 记录器
words.definition: n. equipment for making records\nn. a barrister or solicitor who serves as part-time judge in towns or boroughs

examples.en: The teacher played a story on the [recorder] for the class to listen to.
examples.cn: 老师在[录音机]上播放了一个故事让全班听。

examples.en: All students in Year 4 learn to play the [recorder].
examples.cn: 四年级的所有学生都学习吹[竖笛]。

examples.en: She used a [recorder] to practise her English pronunciation.
examples.cn: 她用[录音机]练习英语发音。

examples.en: He played a beautiful tune on his [recorder] at the school concert.
examples.cn: 他在学校音乐会上用[竖笛]吹奏了一首优美的曲子。

examples.en: The security [recorder] captured the whole incident on video.
examples.cn: 安全[录像机]录下了整个事件的视频。

words.translation: a. 红的, 红色的, 红肿的, 流血的\nn. 红色, 红颜料, 赤字\n[计] 简化, 减少

examples.en: She wore a [red] dress to the New Year party.
examples.cn: 她穿了一件[红色]裙子参加新年聚会。

examples.en: [Red] is a symbol of good luck in Chinese culture.
examples.cn: 在中国文化中，[红色]是好运的象征。

examples.en: The traffic light turned [red] so all the cars stopped.
examples.cn: 交通灯变成了[红色]，所有车辆都停了下来。

examples.en: Her cheeks were [red] from running in the cold wind.
examples.cn: 她的脸颊因在冷风中跑步而变得[红红的]。

examples.en: The children drew [red] apples in their art class.
examples.cn: 孩子们在美术课上画了[红色]苹果。

words.translation:
vt. 拒绝, 谢绝
vi. 拒绝
n. 废物
a. 扔掉的, 无用的
words.definition: v. show unwillingness towards\nv. refuse to accept

examples.cn: 即使任务非常困难，她也[拒绝]放弃。

examples.en: He [refused] the invitation because he was too busy.
examples.cn: 他[拒绝]了邀请，因为他太忙了。

examples.en: The teacher [refused] to accept late homework without a good reason.
examples.cn: 老师[拒绝]接受没有正当理由的迟交作业。

examples.en: She [refused] the offer of help because she wanted to do it alone.
examples.cn: 她[拒绝]了帮助的提议，因为她想自己做。

words.translation: n. 关心, 注意, 尊敬, 关系, 问候\nvt. 视为, 注意, 考虑, 和...有关, 看待\nvi. 注视, 注意
words.definition: n. (usually plural) a polite expression of desire for someone's welfare\nn. a feeling of friendship and esteem\nv. look at attentively

examples.en: He is [regarded] as one of the best teachers in the school.
examples.cn: 他被[认为]是学校里最优秀的老师之一。

examples.en: She has great [regard] for her parents and always listens to their advice.
examples.cn: 她非常[尊重]父母，总是听从他们的建议。

examples.en: We should [regard] every person with kindness and respect.
examples.cn: 我们应该以善意和尊重[对待]每个人。

examples.en: Please give my [regards] to your family when you get home.
examples.cn: 回家时请代我向你的家人[问好]。

examples.en: With [regard] to your question, I will send you the answer tomorrow.
examples.cn: [关于]你的问题，我明天会把答案发给你。

words.translation: n. 遗憾, 后悔, 悔恨, 抱歉, 歉意\nvt. 为...感到遗憾, 后悔, 惋惜, 懊悔, 抱歉\nvi. 感到抱歉
words.definition: v. feel sad about the loss or absence of\nv. decline formally or politely\nv. express with regret

examples.en: She [regretted] not studying harder when she got a low score.
examples.cn: 当她得了低分时，她[后悔]没有更努力学习。

examples.en: He felt deep [regret] for having hurt his friend's feelings.
examples.cn: 他为伤害了朋友的感情而感到深深的[遗憾]。

examples.en: I [regret] to tell you that you have not passed the test.
examples.cn: 我[遗憾地]告诉你，你没有通过考试。

examples.en: Do not [regret] your decisions — learn from them instead.
examples.cn: 不要[后悔]你的决定——从中学习才对。

examples.en: She expressed [regret] for missing the important meeting.
examples.cn: 她对错过重要会议表示[遗憾]。

words.translation: n. 关系, 联系, 叙述, 故事, 家属, 亲戚\n[计] 关系
words.definition: n. an abstraction belonging to or characteristic of two entities or parts together\nn. an act of narration\nn. (usually plural) mutual dealings or connections among persons or groups

examples.en: There is a close [relation] between good sleep and good health.
examples.cn: 良好的睡眠和健康之间有密切的[关系]。

examples.en: She has many [relations] living in the countryside.
examples.cn: 她有很多[亲戚]住在乡下。

examples.en: The [relation] between the two countries has improved in recent years.
examples.cn: 近年来两国之间的[关系]得到了改善。

examples.en: Can you explain the [relation] between pollution and climate change?
examples.cn: 你能解释污染和气候变化之间的[关联]吗？

examples.en: We often visit our [relations] during the Spring Festival holiday.
examples.cn: 我们经常在春节假期拜访[亲属]。

words.translation: vi. 放松, 松懈, 松弛, 变从容, 休息, 休养\nvt. 使松弛, 缓和, 使松懈, 使休息
words.definition:
v. become less tense, rest, or take one's ease
v. make less taut
v. cause to feel relaxed
v. become less tense, less formal, or less restrained, and assume a friendlier manner

examples.en: After the exam, the students were happy to [relax] and have fun.
examples.cn: 考试结束后，学生们很高兴能[放松]玩耍。

examples.en: Listening to soft music helps me [relax] before sleeping.
examples.cn: 听轻柔的音乐帮助我在睡前[放松]。

examples.en: She [relaxed] on the sofa after a long and tiring day at work.
examples.cn: 在漫长而疲惫的一天工作后，她在沙发上[放松]了一下。

examples.en: The school [relaxed] its strict rules about uniforms on sports day.
examples.cn: 学校在运动会那天[放宽]了对制服的严格规定。

examples.en: Take a deep breath and [relax] — everything will be fine.
examples.cn: 深呼吸然后[放松]——一切都会好的。

words.translation: vi. 保持, 逗留, 剩余\n[法] 停留, 居住, 继续
words.definition: v. be left; of persons, questions, problems, results, evidence, etc.

examples.en: Please [remain] in your seats until the teacher says you can leave.
examples.cn: 请[待在]座位上，直到老师允许你离开。

examples.en: She [remained] calm even though everyone around her was panicking.
examples.cn: 即使周围的人都在恐慌，她[仍然]保持冷静。

examples.en: Only a few pages of the old book [remain] after the fire.
examples.cn: 大火之后，那本旧书只[剩下]几页了。

examples.en: The weather [remains] cold throughout the winter months here.
examples.cn: 这里整个冬季天气[仍然]寒冷。

examples.en: After the party, only a few friends [remained] to help clean up.
examples.cn: 聚会结束后，只有几个朋友[留下来]帮忙打扫。

words.translation: vt. 记得, 回忆起, 记住, 铭记, 纪念\nvi. 记得
words.definition:
v. recall knowledge from memory; have a recollection
v. keep in mind for attention or consideration
v. recapture the past; indulge in memories
v. show appreciation to

examples.en: Do you [remember] the name of our first English teacher?
examples.cn: 你[记得]我们第一位英语老师的名字吗？

examples.en: [Remember] to bring your sports shoes for PE class tomorrow.
examples.cn: [记得]明天带运动鞋上体育课。

examples.en: She suddenly [remembered] that she had left the oven on.
examples.cn: 她突然[想起]自己忘记关烤箱了。

examples.en: I [remember] reading that story when I was in primary school.
examples.cn: 我[记得]小学时读过那个故事。

examples.en: Please [remember] me to your parents when you get home.
examples.cn: 回家时请代我[问候]你的父母。

words.translation: n. 修理, 补救, 修复\nvt. 修理, 修补, 补救, 恢复, 补偿\nvi. 修理, 修补, 补救, 恢复, 去, 常去, 集合
words.definition:
n. the act of putting something in working order again
n. a formal way of referring to the condition of something
v. restore by replacing a part or putting together what is torn or broken
v. move, travel, or proceed toward some place

examples.en: The mechanic [repaired] the bicycle in less than an hour.
examples.cn: 机修工在不到一个小时内[修好]了自行车。

examples.en: The car is in the garage for [repair] after the accident.
examples.cn: 汽车在事故后送到车库进行[修理]。

examples.en: My father [repaired] the broken window himself on the weekend.
examples.cn: 我父亲周末自己[修理]了破损的窗户。

examples.en: The school is closed this week because they are [repairing] the roof.
examples.cn: 学校本周关闭，因为他们正在[修缮]屋顶。

examples.en: It is not easy to [repair] a friendship once trust has been broken.
examples.cn: 一旦信任被破坏，[修复]友谊并不容易。

words.translation:
n. 重复, 反复
vt. 重做, 重复, 复述, 使再现, 复制
vi. 重复
[计] 重复
words.definition:
n. an event that repeats
v. to say, state, or perform again
v. to say again or imitate
v. do over

examples.en: Could you please [repeat] that? I did not hear you clearly.
examples.cn: 你能[重复]一下吗？我没有清楚地听到你说的话。

examples.en: Please do not [repeat] the same mistake next time.
examples.cn: 请下次不要[重复]同样的错误。

examples.en: The teacher asked the class to [repeat] the new words after her.
examples.cn: 老师让全班跟她[重复]新单词。

examples.en: History sometimes [repeats] itself if people do not learn from the past.
examples.cn: 如果人们不从过去学习，历史有时会[重复]。

examples.en: Can you [repeat] the main idea of the story in your own words?
examples.cn: 你能用自己的话[复述]这个故事的主要内容吗？

words.translation:
n. 答复, 回答, 答辩
vi. 答复, 回答, 回击, 反响, 答辩
vt. 回答
[计] 答复
words.definition: n. the speech act of continuing a conversational exchange

examples.en: She did not [reply] to my message until the next morning.
examples.cn: 她直到第二天早上才[回复]我的消息。

examples.en: I am still waiting for a [reply] to my email.
examples.cn: 我还在等待对我电子邮件的[回复]。

examples.en: He thought carefully before [replying] to the tricky question.
examples.cn: 他在[回答]这个棘手问题之前仔细思考了一番。

examples.en: She sent a [reply] to the invitation saying she would attend.
examples.cn: 她发了[回信]说她会出席邀请活动。

examples.en: When the teacher called his name, he [replied] loudly and clearly.
examples.cn: 当老师叫他名字时，他大声而清晰地[回应]了。

words.translation:
n. 报告, 报道, 传说, 案情报告, 爆炸声, 成绩单
vt. 报告, 汇报, 转述, 报道, 揭发, 使报到
vi. 报告, 写报道, 报到
[计] 报告
words.definition:
n. a written document describing the findings of some individual or group
n. the act of informing by verbal report
n. a short account of the news
n. a sharp explosive sound (especially the sound of a gun firing)

examples.en: The student wrote a [report] about the effects of pollution on the sea.
examples.cn: 这名学生写了一篇关于污染对海洋影响的[报告]。

examples.en: The journalist [reported] the news from the scene of the accident.
examples.cn: 记者在事故现场[报道]了新闻。

examples.en: His school [report] showed excellent results in every subject.
examples.cn: 他的学校[成绩单]显示每门科目都有优秀成绩。

examples.en: Students are encouraged to [report] bullying to their teachers.
examples.cn: 鼓励学生向老师[举报]欺凌行为。

examples.en: She gave a [report] to the class about her science experiment.
examples.cn: 她向全班做了关于科学实验的[报告]。

words.translation: vt. 需要, 命令, 要求\n[法] 需要, 要求, 命令
words.definition:
v require as useful, just, or proper
v consider obligatory; request and expect
v make someone do something
v have need of

examples.en: This job [requires] a lot of patience and attention to detail.
examples.cn: 这项工作[需要]很多耐心和对细节的关注。

examples.en: All students are [required] to wear their school uniform every day.
examples.cn: 所有学生都被[要求]每天穿校服。

examples.en: The recipe [requires] three eggs and two cups of flour.
examples.cn: 这个食谱[需要]三个鸡蛋和两杯面粉。

examples.en: The law [requires] drivers to wear seat belts at all times.
examples.cn: 法律[规定]驾驶员必须始终系安全带。

examples.en: Learning a new skill [requires] time and regular practice.
examples.cn: 学习新技能[需要]时间和定期练习。

words.translation: n. 研究, 调查, 考察\nvi. 研究, 调查
words.definition: n. systematic investigation to establish facts\nv. attempt to find out in a systematically and scientific manner\nv. inquire into

examples.en: Scientists are doing [research] to find a cure for the disease.
examples.cn: 科学家们正在进行[研究]以寻找治疗该疾病的方法。

examples.en: She spent months [researching] the topic for her school project.
examples.cn: 她花了几个月[研究]学校项目的主题。

examples.en: The [research] showed that regular exercise improves memory.
examples.cn: [研究]表明，定期锻炼可以改善记忆力。

examples.en: Before writing the essay, he did careful [research] on the internet.
examples.cn: 在写文章之前，他在网上做了认真的[调查]。

examples.en: The team [researched] ancient Chinese history for their project.
examples.cn: 该团队为他们的项目[研究]了中国古代历史。

words.translation: n. 休息, 睡眠, 安息, 稍息, 静止, 支架, 休息处, 其余者, 剩余部分\nvi. 休息, 睡, 长眠, 安心, 静止, 停止, 安置, 依赖\nvt. 使休息, 使支撑, 把...寄托于
words.definition:
n. freedom from activity (work or strain or responsibility)
n. a state of inaction
n. euphemisms for death (based on an analogy between lying in a bed and in a tomb)
n. a support on which things can be put

examples.en: After the long run, he sat down for a [rest].
examples.cn: 长跑结束后，他坐下来[休息]了一会儿。

examples.en: The doctor told her to [rest] at home for a few days.
examples.cn: 医生叫她在家[休息]几天。

examples.en: I finished the first chapter and will read the [rest] tonight.
examples.cn: 我读完了第一章，今晚会读[剩下的]部分。

examples.en: She [rested] her head on the desk when she felt tired.
examples.cn: 感到疲惫时她把头[靠]在桌子上。

examples.en: A good night's [rest] helps you feel refreshed and ready to learn.
examples.cn: 良好的夜间[休息]有助于你感到精神焕发，准备好学习。

words.translation: n. 餐馆, 饭店
words.definition: n. a building where people go to eat

examples.en: Our family went to a Chinese [restaurant] to celebrate my birthday.
examples.cn: 我们全家去了一家中式[餐厅]庆祝我的生日。

examples.en: The [restaurant] near the school sells delicious dumplings.
examples.cn: 学校附近的[餐馆]卖美味的饺子。

examples.en: The [restaurant] was fully booked on Saturday evening.
examples.cn: 那家[餐厅]周六晚上已经全部订满了。

examples.en: She works as a waitress in a small [restaurant] after school.
examples.cn: 她放学后在一家小[饭店]做服务员。

examples.en: The new [restaurant] on the high street has a very long waiting list.
examples.cn: 大街上新开的[餐厅]等位名单很长。

words.translation: n. 结果, 成绩, 答案\nvi. 产生, 结果, 致使\n[计] 结果
words.definition: n. something that results\nv. issue or terminate (in a specified way, state, etc.); end\nv. come about or follow as a consequence

examples.en: The [results] of the science experiment were very surprising.
examples.cn: 科学实验的[结果]非常令人惊讶。

examples.en: She was excited when she saw her exam [results].
examples.cn: 当她看到考试[成绩]时非常兴奋。

examples.en: Hard work often [results] in great success.
examples.cn: 努力往往会[带来]巨大的成功。

examples.en: As a [result] of the heavy rain, the sports day was cancelled.
examples.cn: 由于大雨的[结果]，运动会被取消了。

examples.en: The [results] of the survey showed that most students enjoy science class.
examples.cn: 调查[结果]显示，大多数学生喜欢科学课。

words.translation: vt. 再讲, 重复, 重说
words.definition: v render verbally, "recite a poem"\nv make into fiction\nv to say, state, or perform again

examples.en: The teacher asked students to [retell] the story in their own words.
examples.cn: 老师要求学生用自己的话[复述]这个故事。

examples.en: Can you [retell] what happened at the beginning of the book?
examples.cn: 你能[复述]这本书开头发生的事情吗？

examples.en: He [retold] the legend to his younger sister before bedtime.
examples.cn: 他在睡觉前向小妹妹[重讲]了这个传说。

examples.en: After reading the passage, students practised [retelling] the main events.
examples.cn: 阅读短文后，学生们练习[复述]主要事件。

examples.en: She [retold] the joke so well that everyone laughed again.
examples.cn: 她把那个笑话[重述]得很好，让大家又笑了一遍。

words.translation:
n. 回来, 返回, 来回票, 归还, 报答, 利润率, 报告书
a. 返回的, 回程的, 报答的, 反向的, 重现的, 复原的
vi. 返回, 归还, 回来
vt. 归还, 还, 回报, 产生, 反射, 报告, 申报, 退回
[计] 返回
words.definition:
n. a coming to or returning home
n. the occurrence of a change in direction back in the opposite direction
n. the act of going back to a prior location
n. the income or profit arising from such transactions as the sale of land or other property

examples.en: He [returned] home after spending a week at summer camp.
examples.cn: 在夏令营度过一周后，他[回到]了家。

examples.en: Please [return] the library books before the due date.
examples.cn: 请在到期日前[归还]图书馆的书。

examples.en: Everyone was happy at the [return] of the warm spring weather.
examples.cn: 大家都为温暖春天天气的[回归]而高兴。

examples.en: She [returned] to her hometown after working in the city for years.
examples.cn: 在城市工作多年后，她[回到]了家乡。

examples.en: He bought a [return] ticket because he planned to come back the same day.
examples.cn: 他买了一张[回程票]，因为他打算当天返回。

words.translation: n. 检讨, 复习, 回顾, 检阅, 评论\nvt. 温习, 检讨, 评论, 再检察, 复审\nvi. 复习功课, 写评论
words.definition:
n. an essay or article that gives a critical evaluation (as of a book or play)
n. (accounting) a service (less exhaustive than an audit) that provides some assurance to interested parties as to the reliability of financial data
n. a periodical that publishes critical essays on current affairs or literature or art
n. (law) a judicial reexamination of the proceedings of a court (especially by an appellate court)

examples.en: Students should [review] their notes before the examination.
examples.cn: 学生应该在考试前[复习]笔记。

examples.en: She wrote a [review] of the book for the school magazine.
examples.cn: 她为校刊写了一篇书的[评论]。

examples.en: The manager [reviewed] everyone's work at the end of the week.
examples.cn: 经理在周末[审查]了所有人的工作。

examples.en: The teacher gave a [review] of last week's lessons before the test.
examples.cn: 老师在考试前对上周的课程做了[回顾]。

examples.en: He [reviewed] all the vocabulary words the night before the test.
examples.cn: 他在考试前一晚[复习]了所有词汇。

words.translation: n. 米, 米饭, 稻\nvt. 将...压成米粒状
words.definition:
n. grains used as food either unpolished or more often polished
n. annual or perennial rhizomatous marsh grasses; seed used for food; straw used for paper
n. English lyricist who frequently worked with Andrew Lloyd Webber (born in 1944)
n. United States playwright (1892-1967)

examples.en: She cooked a pot of [rice] to go with the vegetable soup.
examples.cn: 她煮了一锅[米饭]配蔬菜汤。

examples.en: Many people in Asia eat [rice] every day as their main food.
examples.cn: 亚洲很多人每天吃[米饭]作为主食。

examples.en: Farmers planted [rice] in the flooded fields during spring.
examples.cn: 农民在春天的水田里种植[水稻]。

examples.en: Fried [rice] with egg and vegetables is a popular dish in China.
examples.cn: 蛋炒[饭]加蔬菜是中国一道受欢迎的菜肴。

examples.en: China is one of the largest producers of [rice] in the world.
examples.cn: 中国是世界上最大的[大米]生产国之一。

words.translation: a. 富裕的, 富饶的, 浓厚的, 贵重的
words.definition:
a. possessing material wealth
a. having an abundant supply of desirable qualities or substances (especially natural resources)
s. of great worth or quality
s. very productive

examples.en: The [rich] businessman donated a lot of money to the school.
examples.cn: 这位[富有的]商人向学校捐赠了大量资金。

examples.en: The soil in this region is very [rich] and good for farming.
examples.cn: 这个地区的土壤非常[肥沃]，适合耕种。

examples.en: Vegetables are [rich] in vitamins and good for your health.
examples.cn: 蔬菜[富含]维生素，有益于你的健康。

examples.en: The cake had a [rich] chocolate flavour that everyone enjoyed.
examples.cn: 蛋糕有一种[浓郁的]巧克力味道，大家都喜欢。

examples.en: China has a [rich] history and culture going back thousands of years.
examples.cn: 中国拥有数千年的[丰富]历史和文化。

words.translation: n. 谜, 谜语, 粗筛\nvt. 解谜, 给...出谜, 筛, 寻根究底地检验, 充满于\nvi. 出谜
words.definition:
n. a difficult problem
n. a coarse sieve (as for gravel)
v. pierce with many holes
v. set a difficult problem or riddle

examples.en: The teacher told the class a funny [riddle] to start the lesson.
examples.cn: 老师给全班讲了一个有趣的[谜语]来开始课程。

examples.en: Can you guess the answer to this [riddle]?
examples.cn: 你能猜出这个[谜语]的答案吗？

examples.en: The disappearance of the ancient city remains a [riddle] to historians.
examples.cn: 这座古城的消失对历史学家来说仍是一个[谜]。

examples.en: She enjoys making up [riddles] to share with her friends.
examples.cn: 她喜欢编[谜语]与朋友分享。

examples.en: The children spent the afternoon solving [riddles] in the garden.
examples.cn: 孩子们在花园里度过了一个下午，解答[谜语]。

words.translation: n. 骑马, 乘坐, 乘车, 搭便车\nvt. 骑, 乘坐, 压迫, 控制\nvi. 骑马, 乘车, 漂游
words.definition:
n. a mechanical device that you ride for amusement or excitement
v. sit and travel on the back of animal, usually while controlling its motions
v. be carried or travel on or in a vehicle
v. continue undisturbed and without interference

examples.en: She [rides] her bicycle to school every morning.
examples.cn: 她每天早上骑自行车上学。

examples.en: We enjoyed the [ride] through the countryside on the old train.
examples.cn: 我们享受了乘旧火车穿越乡村的[旅程]。

examples.en: He learned to [ride] a horse at the summer camp.
