examples.en: He [scored] two goals in the football match yesterday.
examples.cn: 他昨天在足球比赛中[进了]两球。

examples.en: The final [score] of the game was three to one.
examples.cn: 比赛的最终[比分]是三比一。

examples.en: She [scored] ninety-five marks out of one hundred in the English exam.
examples.cn: 她在英语考试中[取得了]一百分中的九十五分。

examples.en: The conductor studied the musical [score] before the rehearsal.
examples.cn: 指挥在排练前研究了音乐[乐谱]。

words.translation:
n. 幕, 银幕, 屏风, 掩蔽物, 屏蔽, 筛子
vt. 掩蔽, 放映, 拍摄, 掩护, 筛, 甄别
vi. 拍电影
[计] 筛选; 屏幕
words.definition:
n. a white or silvered surface where pictures can be projected for viewing
n. the display that is electronically created on the surface of the large end of a cathode-ray tube
n. a covering that serves to conceal or shelter something
n. a protective covering consisting of netting; can be mounted in a frame

examples.en: The teacher displayed the answers on the [screen] at the front of the class.
examples.cn: 老师把答案显示在教室前面的[屏幕]上。

examples.en: The film looked amazing on the large cinema [screen].
examples.cn: 这部电影在大型电影院[荧幕]上看起来令人惊叹。

examples.en: All passengers were [screened] at the airport for security reasons.
examples.cn: 出于安全原因，所有乘客在机场都受到了[安检]。

examples.en: She spends too much time looking at her phone [screen] every day.
examples.cn: 她每天花太多时间盯着手机[屏幕]。

examples.en: A [screen] was placed around the patient's bed to give privacy.
examples.cn: 病人的床周围放置了[屏风]以保护隐私。

words.translation: n. 海, 海洋, 海浪, 大量\n[法] 海, 海洋
words.definition: n. a division of an ocean or a large body of salt water partially enclosed by land\nn. turbulent water with swells of considerable size

examples.en: They spent the holiday swimming and relaxing by the [sea].
examples.cn: 他们在[海边]游泳和放松度过了假期。

examples.en: The [sea] was calm and blue on the warm summer morning.
examples.cn: 温暖的夏日早晨，[大海]平静而湛蓝。

examples.en: Many animals and plants live deep in the [sea].
examples.cn: 许多动植物生活在[海]洋深处。

examples.en: Pollution is causing serious damage to life in the [sea].
examples.cn: 污染正在对[海洋]生物造成严重破坏。

examples.en: She stood on the cliff and looked out across the [sea].
examples.cn: 她站在悬崖上望着[大海]。

words.translation: n. 搜寻, 查究\nv. 搜寻, 搜查, 探求, 调查, 搜索\n[计] 搜索, 路径检索程序
words.definition:
n. the activity of looking thoroughly in order to find something or someone
n. an investigation seeking answers
n. an operation that determines whether one or more of a set of items has a specified property
n. the examination of alternative hypotheses

examples.en: She [searched] the whole house for her missing keys.
examples.cn: 她在整个房子里[搜寻]丢失的钥匙。

examples.en: The [search] for the missing child lasted three days.
examples.cn: [搜寻]失踪孩子的行动持续了三天。

examples.en: He [searched] the internet for information about volcanoes.
examples.cn: 他在网上[搜索]了关于火山的信息。

examples.en: The police [searched] the building for evidence.
examples.cn: 警察[搜查]了建筑物以寻找证据。

examples.en: After a long [search], she finally found the book she wanted.
examples.cn: 经过长时间的[寻找]，她终于找到了她想要的书。

words.translation: n. 季节, 时节, 当令期, 时期\nvt. 给...调味, 使成熟, 使老练, 缓和\nvi. 变干燥
words.definition:
n. a period of the year marked by special events or activities in some field
n. one of the natural periods into which the year is divided by the equinoxes and solstices or atmospheric conditions
n. a recurrent time marked by major holidays
v. lend flavor to

examples.en: Spring is her favourite [season] because of all the beautiful flowers.
examples.cn: 春天是她最喜欢的[季节]，因为有许多美丽的花。

examples.en: Each [season] brings different weather and activities.
examples.cn: 每个[季节]带来不同的天气和活动。

examples.en: The football [season] starts in August and ends in May.
examples.cn: 足球[赛季]从八月开始，到五月结束。

examples.en: She [seasoned] the soup with salt and pepper.
examples.cn: 她用盐和胡椒粉给汤[调味]。

examples.en: The tourist [season] brings many visitors to the coastal town.
examples.cn: 旅游[旺季]为这座海滨小镇带来许多游客。

words.translation: n. 座, 座位, 位子, 席位, 所在地\nvt. 使坐下, 使就座, 为...设座于, 使就职\nvi. 安装在底座上
words.definition:
n. a space reserved for sitting (as in a theater or on a train or airplane)
n. furniture that is designed for sitting on
n. any support where you can sit (especially the part of a chair or bench etc. on which you sit)
n. a center of authority (as a city from which authority is exercised)

examples.en: Please take your [seat] before the lesson begins.
examples.cn: 请在课程开始前就[座]。

examples.en: She saved a [seat] for her friend near the front of the cinema.
examples.cn: 她在电影院前排为朋友保留了一个[座位]。

examples.en: The usher [seated] the guests in their assigned places.
examples.cn: 引座员将客人带到指定位置[就座]。

examples.en: All [seats] on the bus were taken during the rush hour.
examples.cn: 高峰时段公共汽车上所有[座位]都坐满了人。

examples.en: He wore out the [seat] of his trousers from sitting on rough ground.
examples.cn: 由于坐在粗糙地面上，他的裤子[裤臀]磨破了。

words.translation:
n. 秒, 瞬间, 第二名, 支持者, 助手
a. 第二的, 其次的, 次要的, 附加的, 辅助的
num. 第二
vt. 当...助手, 支持
words.definition:
n. 1/60 of a minute; the basic unit of time adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites
n. following the first in an ordering or series
n. a 60th part of a minute of arc
n. the official attendant of a contestant in a duel or boxing match

examples.en: She finished in [second] place in the swimming competition.
examples.cn: 她在游泳比赛中获得[第二]名。

examples.en: He ran one hundred metres in less than twelve [seconds].
examples.cn: 他在不到十二[秒]的时间内跑了一百米。

examples.en: May I have a [second] helping of rice, please?
examples.cn: 请问我可以再来[第二碗]米饭吗？

examples.en: She [seconded] his suggestion to have a class picnic.
examples.cn: 她[支持]了他举办班级野餐的建议。

examples.en: [Second] language learning is an important part of modern education.
examples.cn: [第二]语言学习是现代教育的重要组成部分。

words.translation: n. 秘密, 机密, 秘诀, 秘方\na. 秘密的, 极机密的, 隐蔽的, 暗中的, 神秘的, 偏僻的
words.definition:
n. something that should remain hidden from others (especially information that is not to be passed on)
n. information known only to a special group
s. not open or public; kept private or not revealed
s. communicated covertly

examples.en: She told her best friend a [secret] and asked her not to tell anyone.
examples.cn: 她告诉了最好的朋友一个[秘密]，并要求她不要告诉任何人。

examples.en: They had a [secret] meeting in the library after school.
examples.cn: 他们放学后在图书馆进行了一次[秘密]会面。

examples.en: The [secret] to success is hard work and never giving up.
examples.cn: 成功的[诀窍]是努力工作，永不放弃。

examples.en: The spy kept a [secret] identity so no one knew who he really was.
examples.cn: 间谍保持着[秘密]身份，没有人知道他真实是谁。

examples.en: Keeping a [secret] can be difficult when you want to share good news.
examples.cn: 当你想分享好消息时，保守[秘密]可能很困难。

words.translation: n. 秘书, 书记, 大臣\n[经] 秘书
words.definition: n. a person who is head of an administrative department of government\nn. an assistant who handles correspondence and clerical work for a boss or an organization\nn. a desk used for writing

examples.en: The [secretary] typed the letters and organised the manager's schedule.
examples.cn: [秘书]打印信件并整理了经理的日程安排。

examples.en: She was elected [secretary] of the school student council.
examples.cn: 她当选为学校学生会[书记]。

examples.en: The [secretary] of education announced new changes to the curriculum.
examples.cn: 教育[部长]宣布了课程的新变化。

examples.en: The [secretary] greeted visitors and directed them to the right office.
examples.cn: [秘书]迎接访客并引导他们到正确的办公室。

examples.en: The club [secretary] kept notes of everything discussed at the meeting.
examples.cn: 俱乐部[书记]记录了会议上讨论的所有事项。

words.translation: vt. 看见, 查看, 参观, 游览, 理解, 知道, 同意\nvi. 看, 观看, 注意, 知道, 考虑\nn. 主教的职位
words.definition:
n. the seat within a bishop's diocese where his cathedral is located
v. perceive by sight or have the power to perceive by sight
v. deem to be
v. be careful or certain to do something; make certain of something

examples.en: She could [see] the mountains clearly from the top of the hill.
examples.cn: 她从山顶可以清楚地[看到]远处的山脉。

examples.en: Now I [see] what you mean — it makes sense.
examples.cn: 现在我[明白]你的意思了——很有道理。

examples.en: I will [see] you at the library tomorrow afternoon.
examples.cn: 我明天下午会在图书馆[见到]你。

examples.en: This old building has [seen] many changes over the past hundred years.
examples.cn: 这栋老建筑在过去一百年间[经历]了许多变化。

examples.en: Please [see] that all the windows are closed before you leave.
examples.cn: 请[确保]离开前所有窗户都关好了。

words.translation: vi. 象是, 似乎
words.definition: v. appear to exist\nv. appear to one's own mind or opinion

examples.en: She [seems] tired today — she keeps yawning in class.
examples.cn: 她今天[似乎]很疲惫——她一直在课堂上打哈欠。

examples.en: It [seems] like it is going to rain this afternoon.
examples.cn: 今天下午[看起来]要下雨了。

examples.en: He [seemed] nervous before getting on the stage to perform.
examples.cn: 他在上台表演前[显得]很紧张。

examples.en: Everything [seems] much harder when you are tired.
examples.cn: 疲惫时，一切[似乎]都更加困难。

examples.en: The teacher [seemed] pleased when all the students passed the test.
examples.cn: 当所有学生都通过考试时，老师[显得]很高兴。

words.translation: a. 不常的, 稀少的\nadv. 很少, 不常
words.definition: r not often

examples.en: She [seldom] misses school because she loves learning.
examples.cn: 她[很少]缺课，因为她热爱学习。

examples.en: He [seldom] watches TV — he prefers reading books.
examples.cn: 他[难得]看电视——他更喜欢读书。

examples.en: It [seldom] snows in this part of the country.
examples.cn: 这个地区[很少]下雪。

examples.en: They [seldom] see each other since they moved to different cities.
examples.cn: 自从他们搬到不同城市后，他们[不常]见面了。

examples.en: She [seldom] complains even when things are difficult.
examples.cn: 即使事情困难，她也[很少]抱怨。

words.translation: vt. 卖, 背叛, 销售, 出卖\nvi. 卖, 销售\nn. 卖, 推销术, 失望
words.definition:
n. the activity of persuading someone to buy
v. exchange or deliver for money or its equivalent
v. be sold at a certain price or in a certain way
v. persuade somebody to accept something

examples.en: The shop [sells] fresh bread and cakes every morning.
examples.cn: 这家商店每天早上[出售]新鲜面包和蛋糕。

examples.en: She [sold] her old bicycle to a classmate for fifty yuan.
examples.cn: 她以五十元的价格把旧自行车[卖给]了同学。

examples.en: The tickets for the concert [sold out] within an hour.
examples.cn: 音乐会的门票在一小时内[售完]了。

examples.en: This book [sells] very well in schools across the country.
examples.cn: 这本书在全国各地的学校里[销售]非常好。

examples.en: He tried to [sell] the idea of a class trip to the teacher.
examples.cn: 他试图向老师[推销]组织班级旅行的想法。

words.translation:
vt. 发送, 使进入, 寄, 派遣, 发射, 使陷于
vi. 寄信, 派人, 播送
n. (船的)上升运动
[计] 发送
words.definition: v. cause to go somewhere\nv. to cause or order to be taken, directed, or transmitted to another place\nv. transfer

examples.en: She [sent] a birthday card to her grandmother by post.
examples.cn: 她通过邮寄[寄]了一张生日卡给祖母。

examples.en: Please [send] me the information by email when you can.
examples.cn: 请方便时通过电子邮件[发送]信息给我。

examples.en: The school [sent] two students to represent them at the competition.
examples.cn: 学校[派遣]两名学生代表参加比赛。

examples.en: The loud noise [sent] the birds flying away from the trees.
examples.cn: 巨大的声音[使]鸟儿从树上飞走了。

examples.en: Please [send] my greetings to your teacher when you see her.
examples.cn: 见到你的老师时，请[转达]我的问候。

words.translation: n. 感应, 感觉, 感官, 意识, 观念, 情理, 知觉, 理智\nvt. 感觉, 觉察, 检测\n[计] 阅读; 检测
words.definition:
n. a general conscious awareness
n. the meaning of a word or expression; the way in which a word or expression or situation can be interpreted
n. the faculty through which the external world is apprehended
n. a natural appreciation or ability

examples.en: The dog has a very strong [sense] of smell.
examples.cn: 狗有非常强烈的嗅觉[感觉]。

examples.en: She has a good [sense] of direction and never gets lost.
examples.cn: 她有很好的方向[感]，从不迷路。

examples.en: Can you explain the [sense] of this difficult word?
examples.cn: 你能解释这个难词的[意思]吗？

examples.en: She [sensed] that something was wrong when the teacher looked serious.
examples.cn: 当老师表情严肃时，她[察觉到]有什么不对劲。

examples.en: It makes [sense] to study a little each day rather than all at once.
examples.cn: 每天学习一点而不是一次性学完更有[道理]。

words.translation: n. 句子, 命题, 宣判\nvt. 宣判, 判决\n[计] 句子
words.definition: n. a string of words satisfying the grammatical rules of a language\nv. pronounce a sentence on (somebody) in a court of law

examples.en: Write three [sentences] to describe your favourite hobby.
examples.cn: 写三个[句子]描述你最喜爱的爱好。

examples.en: The judge gave the thief a [sentence] of two years in prison.
examples.cn: 法官判处小偷两年监禁的[判决]。

examples.en: A [sentence] must have a subject and a verb to be complete.
examples.cn: 一个完整的[句子]必须有主语和谓语。

examples.en: The court [sentenced] him to pay a large fine.
examples.cn: 法院[判决]他缴纳一大笔罚款。

examples.en: She wrote a beautiful opening [sentence] to begin her story.
examples.cn: 她写了一个美丽的开头[句子]来开始她的故事。

words.translation:
n. 独立件, 抽印本
a. 分开的, 各别的, 单独的, 分隔的
vi. 分开, 隔开, 分居
vt. 使分离, 使分开, 区分, 使分居
words.definition:
n. a garment that can be purchased separately and worn in combinations with other garments
v. act as a barrier between; stand between
v. force, take, or pull apart
v. divide into components or constituents

examples.en: The teacher [separated] the two students who kept talking in class.
examples.cn: 老师把两个一直在课堂上说话的学生[分开]了。

examples.en: The boys and girls have [separate] changing rooms at the swimming pool.
examples.cn: 男生和女生在游泳池有[分开的]更衣室。

examples.en: Oil and water [separate] if you leave them together in a glass.
examples.cn: 如果你把油和水放在一个杯子里，它们会[分离]。

examples.en: Please keep your personal items in a [separate] bag.
examples.cn: 请把个人物品放在[单独的]包里。

examples.en: The children were [separated] into two groups for the activity.
examples.cn: 孩子们被[分成]两组进行活动。

words.translation: n. 九月
words.definition: n. the month following August and preceding October

examples.en: School in China usually starts in [September] every year.
examples.cn: 中国学校通常每年[九月]开学。

examples.en: Her birthday is on the fifteenth of [September].
examples.cn: 她的生日是[九月]十五日。

examples.en: The weather becomes cooler in [September] after the hot summer.
examples.cn: 炎热的夏天过后，[九月]天气变凉爽了。

examples.en: In [September], the leaves on the trees start to change colour.
examples.cn: 在[九月]，树上的叶子开始变色。

examples.en: The new school year brings new challenges and excitement every [September].
examples.cn: 每年[九月]，新学年带来新挑战和新的激动。

words.translation: a. 严肃的, 认真的, 重要的, 严重的\n[电] 严重的
words.definition: a. concerned with work or important matters rather than play or trivialities\ns. of great consequence\ns. requiring effort or concentration; complex and not easy to answer or solve

examples.en: The accident caused [serious] injuries to several people.
examples.cn: 这次事故造成了几个人的[严重]伤害。

examples.en: She is a [serious] student who always completes her homework on time.
examples.cn: 她是一个[认真]的学生，总是按时完成作业。

examples.en: The teacher looked [serious] when he announced the exam results.
examples.cn: 老师宣布考试成绩时看起来很[严肃]。

examples.en: Air pollution is a [serious] problem that needs urgent attention.
examples.cn: 空气污染是一个需要紧急关注的[严重]问题。

examples.en: Are you [serious] about wanting to join the school team?
examples.cn: 你[认真]打算加入学校队伍吗？

words.translation: n. 仆人, 有用物, 公务员, 雇员\n[法] 受雇人, 服务者, 公务员
words.definition: n. a person working in the service of another (especially in the household)

examples.en: In the old story, the prince had many [servants] in his palace.
examples.cn: 在那个古老的故事里，王子的宫殿里有很多[仆人]。

examples.en: A good leader sees themselves as a [servant] of the people.
examples.cn: 一位好领导者把自己视为人民的[公仆]。

examples.en: The [servants] prepared the feast for the king's birthday banquet.
examples.cn: [仆人们]为国王的生日宴会准备了盛宴。

examples.en: Public [servants] work for the government to serve society.
examples.cn: 公务员为政府工作以服务社会。

examples.en: She read a story about a kind [servant] who helped the poor villagers.
examples.cn: 她读了一个关于一个善良的[仆人]帮助贫苦村民的故事。

words.translation: vt. 可作...用, 服务, 经历, 招待, 供应, 送交, 对待\nvi. 服务, 服役, 侍应, 适合, 有用, 开球\nn. 发球, 轮到发球
words.definition:
n. (sports) a stroke that puts the ball in play
v. serve a purpose, role, or function
v. do duty or hold offices; serve in a specific function
v. contribute or conduce to

examples.en: She [served] the customers quickly and politely at the café.
examples.cn: 她在咖啡馆快速礼貌地为顾客[服务]。

examples.en: Dinner will be [served] at seven o'clock in the evening.
examples.cn: 晚餐将在晚上七点[供应]。

examples.en: He [served] in the army for five years before returning home.
examples.cn: 他在军队[服役]五年后回到家乡。

examples.en: This library [serves] the needs of thousands of readers each year.
examples.cn: 这座图书馆每年为数千名读者的需求[提供服务]。

examples.en: She [served] the ball perfectly to start the tennis match.
examples.cn: 她完美地[发球]开始了网球比赛。

words.translation:
n. 服务, 贡献, 雇佣, 公职, 服役, 功劳, 仪式, 送达, 行政部门
vt. 保养, 维修
a. 武装部队的, 服务性的, 仆人的, 耐用的
[计] 服务, 业务
words.definition:
n. work done by one person or group that benefits another
n. an act of help or assistance
n. the act of public worship following prescribed rules
n. a company or agency that performs a public service; subject to government regulation

examples.en: The hotel is famous for its excellent [service] and friendly staff.
examples.cn: 这家酒店以其出色的[服务]和友好的员工而闻名。

examples.en: Bus [service] in this city runs from six in the morning to midnight.
examples.cn: 这座城市的公共汽车[服务]从早上六点运营到午夜。

examples.en: She has given twenty years of [service] to the school as a teacher.
examples.cn: 她作为教师为学校[服务]了二十年。

examples.en: The family attended a memorial [service] for their grandfather.
examples.cn: 这家人参加了祖父的追悼[仪式]。

examples.en: Good customer [service] is very important for any business.
examples.cn: 良好的客户[服务]对任何企业都非常重要。

words.translation:

words.translation: aux. 将
words.definition:
v. i. & auxiliary. To owe; to be under obligation for.
v. i. & auxiliary. To be obliged; must.
v. i. & auxiliary. As an auxiliary, shall indicates a duty or
   necessity whose obligation is derived from the person speaking; as, you
   shall go; he shall go; that is, I order or promise your going. It thus
   ordinarily expresses, in the second and third persons, a command, a
   threat, or a promise. If the auxillary be emphasized, the command is
   made more imperative, the promise or that more positive and sure. It is
   also employed in the language of prophecy; as, "the day shall come when
   . . . , " since a promise or threat and an authoritative prophecy
   nearly coincide in significance. In shall with the first person, the
   necessity of the action is sometimes implied as residing elsewhere than
   in the speaker; as, I shall suffer; we shall see; and there is always a
   less distinct and positive assertion of his volition than is indicated
   by will. "I shall go" implies nearly a simple futurity; more exactly, a
   foretelling or an expectation of my going, in which, naturally enough,
   a certain degree of plan or intention may be included; emphasize the
   shall, and the event is described as certain to occur, and the
   expression approximates in meaning to our emphatic "I will go." In a
   question, the relation of speaker and source of obligation is of course
   transferred to the person addressed; as, "Shall you go?" (answer, "I
   shall go"); "Shall he go?" i. e., "Do you require or promise his
   going?" (answer, "He shall go".) The same relation is transferred to
   either second or third person in such phrases as "You say, or think,
   you shall go;" "He says, or thinks, he shall go." After a conditional
   conjunction (as if, whether) shall is used in all persons to express
   futurity simply; as, if I, you, or he shall say they are right. Should
   is everywhere used in the same connection and the same senses as shall,
   as its imperfect. It also expresses duty or moral obligation; as, he
   should do it whether he will or not. In the early English, and hence in
   our English Bible, shall is the auxiliary mainly used, in all the
   persons, to express simple futurity. (Cf. Will, v. t.) Shall may be
   used elliptically; thus, with an adverb or other word expressive of
   motion go may be omitted.

   to express moral obligation (see Shall); e. g.: they should have come
   last week; if I should go; I should think you could go.

examples.en: You [should] drink more water every day to stay healthy.
examples.cn: 你每天[应该]多喝水以保持健康。

examples.en: Students [should] respect their teachers and classmates.
examples.cn: 学生[应当]尊重老师和同学。

examples.en: You look tired — you [should] go to bed earlier tonight.
examples.cn: 你看起来很疲惫——你今晚[应该]早点睡觉。

examples.en: He [should] have studied more carefully before the exam.
examples.cn: 他考试前本[应该]更认真地学习。

examples.en: The bus [should] arrive in about five minutes.
examples.cn: 公共汽车[应该]大约五分钟后到达。

words.translation: n. 肩, 肩膀, 衣肩\nvt. 肩负, 负担, 担任\nvi. 用肩推挤
words.definition:
n. the part of the body between the neck and the upper arm
n. a cut of meat including the upper joint of the foreleg
n. a ball-and-socket joint between the head of the humerus and a cavity of the scapula
n. the part of a garment that covers or fits over the shoulder

examples.en: She carried her schoolbag on her [shoulder] all day.
examples.cn: 她整天把书包背在[肩膀]上。

examples.en: He put his hand on his friend's [shoulder] to comfort him.
examples.cn: 他把手放在朋友的[肩]上安慰他。

examples.en: She [shouldered] the responsibility of looking after her younger siblings.
examples.cn: 她[承担]了照顾弟弟妹妹的责任。

examples.en: The player injured his [shoulder] during the basketball game.
examples.cn: 那名球员在篮球比赛中伤了[肩部]。

examples.en: He [shouldered] his way through the crowd to reach the front.
examples.cn: 他[用肩膀挤]开人群到达前面。

words.translation: n. 呼喊, 喊声\nvi. 呼喊, 喊叫, 嚷\nvt. 高喊
words.definition: v. utter in a loud voice; talk in a loud voice (usually denoting characteristic manner of speaking)\nv. utter a sudden loud cry

examples.en: She [shouted] to her friend across the playground.
examples.cn: 她在操场上对朋友[大喊]。

examples.en: We heard a [shout] from the other side of the wall.
examples.cn: 我们从墙的另一边听到了一声[喊叫]。

examples.en: Please do not [shout] in the library — keep your voice down.
examples.cn: 请不要在图书馆[大声喊叫]——保持低声说话。

examples.en: The coach [shouted] instructions to the players during the match.
examples.cn: 教练在比赛中向球员[喊出]指令。

examples.en: The children [shouted] with joy when they saw the snow falling.
examples.cn: 当孩子们看到雪花飘落时，[欢呼雀跃]。

words.translation:
n. 显示, 表现, 展览, 卖弄, 炫耀, 外观, 演出, 洋相
vt. 表示, 显示, 展现, 陈列, 演出, 表明, 指出, 带领
vi. 露面, 显现, 演出
[计] 显示
words.definition:
n. the act of publicly exhibiting or entertaining
n. a social event involving a public performance or entertainment
v. give an exhibition of to an interested audience
v. make visible or noticeable

examples.en: She [showed] her drawings to the art teacher for feedback.
examples.cn: 她把画作[展示]给美术老师看，征求意见。

examples.en: The school put on a wonderful talent [show] at the end of term.
examples.cn: 学校在学期末举办了一场精彩的才艺[表演]。

examples.en: The results [showed] that most students had improved their scores.
examples.cn: 结果[显示]大多数学生提高了分数。

examples.en: We visited a science [show] at the museum during the holiday.
examples.cn: 我们在假期参观了博物馆的科学[展览]。

examples.en: He [showed] the new student around the school on her first day.
examples.cn: 他在新同学第一天[带领]她参观了学校。

words.translation: n. 阵雨, 淋浴, 一阵, 展出者, 显示者\nvi. 淋浴, 下阵雨\nvt. 淋湿, 倾注
words.definition:
n. a plumbing fixture that sprays water over you
n. washing yourself by standing upright under water sprayed from a nozzle
n. a brief period of precipitation
n. a sudden downpour (as of tears or sparks etc) likened to a rain shower

examples.en: He takes a [shower] every morning before going to school.
examples.cn: 他每天早上上学前洗[淋浴]。

examples.en: There will be a few [showers] in the afternoon, so bring an umbrella.
examples.cn: 下午会有几场[阵雨]，所以带上雨伞。

examples.en: She [showered] and changed into clean clothes after exercise.
examples.cn: 运动后她[洗了淋浴]，换上干净的衣服。

examples.en: After the match, the winner received a [shower] of congratulations.
examples.cn: 比赛结束后，获胜者收到了如潮水般的[祝贺]。

examples.en: The school gym has [showers] for students to use after PE class.
examples.cn: 学校体育馆有[淋浴间]供学生体育课后使用。

words.translation: n. 关闭\nvt. 关上, 闭起, 幽禁, 合拢, 轧住\nvi. 关上, 停止营业
words.definition: a. not open

examples.en: Please [shut] the window — it is getting cold.
examples.cn: 请[关上]窗户——天气越来越冷了。

examples.en: She [shut] her eyes and took a deep breath before the exam.
examples.cn: 她在考试前[闭上]眼睛深吸一口气。

examples.en: The library is [shut] on Sundays and public holidays.
examples.cn: 图书馆在周日和公共假日[关闭]。

examples.en: The old bookshop [shut down] after forty years in business.
examples.cn: 那家老书店经营了四十年后[关门停业]了。

examples.en: He [shut] the door quietly so as not to wake the baby.
examples.cn: 他轻轻[关上]了门，以免吵醒婴儿。

words.translation:
n. 惊跳, 惊避
a. 胆怯的, 畏缩的, 迟疑的, 羞怯的
vi. 惊退, 乱投, 乱掷, 厌恶, 避开
vt. 乱投, 乱掷
words.definition:
n. a quick throw
v. start suddenly, as from fright
v. throw quickly
s. short

examples.en: The new student was very [shy] and sat quietly at the back of the class.
examples.cn: 新同学非常[害羞]，安静地坐在教室后面。

examples.en: She felt [shy] when the teacher asked her to speak in front of everyone.
examples.cn: 当老师要她在所有人面前发言时，她感到[羞怯]。

examples.en: He is [shy] with strangers but very funny with his close friends.
examples.cn: 他对陌生人很[腼腆]，但和亲密朋友在一起时非常有趣。

examples.en: The [shy] girl slowly gained confidence after joining the drama club.
examples.cn: 这个[害羞的]女孩加入戏剧俱乐部后慢慢地建立了自信。

examples.en: Do not be [shy] about asking questions in class — there are no silly questions.
examples.cn: 不要[胆怯]地在课堂上提问——没有愚蠢的问题。

words.translation: n. 病人\na. 不舒服, 有病的, 恶心的, 厌恶的, 渴望的, 病态的\nvt. 呕吐, 追击, 使(狗)去攻击
words.definition: n. people who are sick\ns. deeply affected by a strong feeling

examples.en: She stayed home from school because she felt [sick].
examples.cn: 她因为感到[生病]而留在家里没有上学。

examples.en: The bumpy car ride made him feel [sick] to his stomach.
examples.cn: 颠簸的车程让他感到[恶心]。

examples.en: I am [sick] of eating the same food every single day.
examples.cn: 我[厌倦了]每天吃同样的食物。

examples.en: The teacher asked the [sick] student to rest in the medical room.
examples.cn: 老师让[生病的]学生去医务室休息。

examples.en: The thought of failing the exam made her feel [sick] with worry.
examples.cn: 想到考试不及格让她担忧得感到[难受]。

words.translation:
n. 旁边, 侧, 方面, 胁, 侧边, 血统
a. 旁的, 侧的, 次要的
vt. 同意, 支持
vi. 支持, 赞助
words.definition:
n. a place within a region identified relative to a center or reference location
n. one of two or more contesting groups
n. either the left or right half of a body
n. a surface forming part of the outside of an object

examples.en: Please write your name on the right [side] of the paper.
examples.cn: 请把名字写在纸的右[边]。

examples.en: Both [sides] agreed to work together to solve the problem.
examples.cn: 双方都同意合作解决这个问题。

examples.en: There is a positive [side] to every difficult situation.
examples.cn: 每个困难情况都有积极的[一面]。

examples.en: She walked by his [side] all the way to the school gate.
examples.cn: 她一路走在他的[旁边]直到学校大门。

examples.en: The [side] entrance to the building is near the car park.
examples.cn: 建筑物的[侧面]入口靠近停车场。

words.translation:
n. 景观, 视力, 眼界, 阅读, 见解, 意见
vt. 看见, 瞄准
vi. 瞄准, 观看
a. 即席的, 见票即付的
words.definition:
n. an instance of visual perception
n. anything that is seen
n. the ability to see; the visual faculty
n. a range of mental vision

examples.en: She wears glasses because her [sight] is not very good.
examples.cn: 她戴眼镜是因为她的[视力]不太好。

examples.en: The view from the mountain top was a wonderful [sight].
examples.cn: 从山顶看到的景色是一幅美妙的[景象]。

examples.en: Keep the ball in [sight] so you do not lose it during the game.
examples.cn: 比赛中保持球在[视野]内，这样你就不会丢失它。

examples.en: Tourists come from around the world to see the famous [sights] of Beijing.
examples.cn: 游客从世界各地来参观北京著名的[名胜]。

examples.en: She fell in love with the old library at first [sight].
examples.cn: 她[一见]那座古老的图书馆就爱上了它。

words.translation: n. 沉默, 无声, 静寂, 湮没, 无声息\nvt. 使缄默\ninterj. 安静
words.definition: n. the state of being silent (as when no one is speaking)\nn. the absence of sound\nv. keep from expression, for example by threats or pressure

examples.en: The [silence] in the exam room was broken only by pencils writing.
examples.cn: 考场里的[寂静]只被铅笔书写声打破。

examples.en: Please observe a minute of [silence] to respect those who passed away.
examples.cn: 请默哀一分钟，以[沉默]表示对逝者的敬意。

examples.en: After the argument, there was an uncomfortable [silence] between them.
examples.cn: 争论之后，他们之间出现了一段令人不舒服的[沉默]。

examples.en: She enjoyed the [silence] of the countryside after the noisy city.
examples.cn: 在嘈杂的城市之后，她享受乡村的[寂静]。

examples.en: The teacher [silenced] the noisy class with a serious look.
examples.cn: 老师用严肃的眼神让吵闹的班级[安静]下来。

words.translation: a. 沉默的, 安静的, 无声的, 静止的\n[医] 静止的, 无症状的
words.definition:
s. marked by absence of sound
s. implied by or inferred from actions or statements
s. not made to sound
s. having a frequency below or above the range of human audibility

examples.en: The classroom became [silent] when the headteacher walked in.
examples.cn: 当校长走进来时，教室变得[安静]了。

examples.en: He remained [silent] during the argument and let others speak first.
examples.cn: 争论中他保持[沉默]，让别人先说。

examples.en: She sent a [silent] prayer for her friend who was ill.
examples.cn: 她为生病的朋友默默地发出了[无声的]祈祷。

examples.en: The forest was [silent] except for the sound of the wind in the trees.
examples.cn: 森林里[寂静]无声，只有树间风声。

examples.en: The letter k in the word knife is [silent].
examples.cn: knife这个词中字母k是[不发音的]。

words.translation: n. 丝, 绸, 绸锻类, 丝织品\na. 丝的, 丝织的
words.definition: n. a fabric made from the fine threads produced by certain insect larvae\nn. animal fibers produced by silkworms and other larvae that spin cocoons and by most spiders

examples.en: China has a long history of producing fine [silk] fabric.
examples.cn: 中国有悠久的生产优质[丝绸]的历史。

examples.en: She wore a beautiful [silk] dress to the formal dinner.
examples.cn: 她穿了一件漂亮的[丝绸]裙子参加正式晚宴。

examples.en: The ancient Silk Road was a trade route famous for transporting [silk].
examples.cn: 古老的丝绸之路是以运输[丝绸]著称的贸易路线。

examples.en: The feel of [silk] against your skin is smooth and soft.
examples.cn: [丝绸]贴在皮肤上的感觉光滑柔软。

examples.en: The [silk] scarf was a special gift from her grandmother.
examples.cn: 这条[丝质]围巾是祖母送的特别礼物。

words.translation: a. 愚蠢的, 糊涂的
words.definition: n. a word used for misbehaving children

examples.en: He made a [silly] mistake by forgetting to write his name on the test.
examples.cn: 他犯了一个[愚蠢的]错误，忘了在试卷上写名字。

examples.en: The children laughed at the clown's [silly] jokes and funny faces.
examples.cn: 孩子们被小丑[可笑的]笑话和搞笑表情逗得哈哈大笑。

examples.en: She felt [silly] when she realised she had been going the wrong way.
examples.cn: 当她意识到自己走错了方向时，感到[傻乎乎的]。

examples.en: Stop asking [silly] questions and focus on the lesson.
examples.cn: 停止提[无聊的]问题，专注于课程。

examples.en: It would be [silly] to go out in the rain without an umbrella.
examples.cn: 在雨中出门不带雨伞是[愚蠢的]。

words.translation:
n. 银, 银币, 银器
a. 银的, 银制的, 银器的
vt. 镀银
vi. 变银白色
words.definition:
n. a soft white precious univalent metallic element having the highest electrical and thermal conductivity of any metal; occurs in argentite and in free form; used in coins and jewelry and tableware and photography
n. coins made of silver
v. coat with a layer of silver or a silver amalgam
v. make silver in color

examples.en: She won a [silver] medal in the swimming competition.
examples.cn: 她在游泳比赛中赢得了[银牌]。

examples.en: The ring was made of [silver] and had a small blue stone.
examples.cn: 这枚戒指由[银]制成，上面有一颗小蓝宝石。

examples.en: She wore [silver] earrings that matched her grey dress.
examples.cn: 她戴着[银色]耳环，与灰色裙子相配。

examples.en: The family kept their best [silver] for special occasions.
examples.cn: 这家人把最好的[银器]留到特殊场合使用。

examples.en: His grandfather had beautiful [silver] hair that shone in the sunlight.
examples.cn: 他祖父有一头在阳光下闪闪发亮的美丽[银白色]头发。

words.translation: a. 相似的, 类似的\nn. 相似的东西
words.definition: a. marked by correspondence or resemblance\ns. (of words) expressing closely related meanings

examples.en: The twins look very [similar] but have different personalities.
examples.cn: 这对双胞胎看起来非常[相似]，但性格不同。

examples.en: My opinion is [similar] to yours — I agree with most of what you said.
examples.cn: 我的观点和你的[相近]——我同意你说的大部分内容。

examples.en: The two stories have a [similar] theme about friendship and loyalty.
examples.cn: 两个故事有[类似的]关于友谊和忠诚的主题。

examples.en: The test results were [similar] for most students in the class.
examples.cn: 班上大多数学生的考试成绩都[差不多]。

examples.en: [Similar] problems often have [similar] solutions if you think carefully.
examples.cn: 如果你仔细思考，[相似的]问题往往有[相似的]解决方法。

words.translation: a. 简单的, 普通的, 朴素的, 单纯的, 绝对的, 初级的, 原始的, 迟钝的\nn. 出身低微者, 傻子
words.definition:
n. any herbaceous plant having medicinal properties
a. having few parts; not complex or complicated or involved
a. (botany) of leaf shapes; of leaves having no divisions or subdivisions
s. unornamented

examples.en: The instructions were [simple] enough for young children to follow.
examples.cn: 这些说明[简单]到年幼的孩子都能理解。

examples.en: She prefers [simple] clothes without too many patterns or colours.
examples.cn: 她喜欢没有太多图案或颜色的[朴素]衣服。

examples.en: The answer to the question was surprisingly [simple].
examples.cn: 这道题的答案出乎意料地[简单]。

examples.en: He has a [simple] and honest personality that everyone likes.
examples.cn: 他有着大家都喜欢的[单纯]诚实的个性。

examples.en: Eating a [simple] meal of rice and vegetables is healthy and cheap.
examples.cn: 吃一顿[简单]的米饭和蔬菜餐既健康又便宜。

words.translation: prep. 自...以后, 自...以来\nadv. 自那时以后\nconj. 既然, 自...以后, 自...以来
words.definition:
adv. From a definite past time until now; as, he went a month
   ago, and I have not seen him since.
adv. In the time past, counting backward from the present;
   before this or now; ago.
adv. When or that.
prep. From the time of; in or during the time subsequent to;
   subsequently to; after; -- usually with a past event or time for the
   object.
conj. Seeing that; because; considering; -- formerly followed
   by that.

examples.en: She has been studying English [since] she was six years old.
examples.cn: 她[从]六岁起就开始学英语了。

examples.en: [Since] you have finished your homework, you can go out and play.
examples.cn: [既然]你已经完成了作业，你可以出去玩了。

examples.en: He moved to the new city two years ago and has lived there ever [since].
examples.cn: 他两年前搬到了新城市，[此后]一直住在那里。

examples.en: Things have changed a lot [since] the invention of the smartphone.
examples.cn: 自从智能手机发明[以来]，很多事情都变了。

examples.en: [Since] it was raining, they decided to stay indoors and watch a film.
examples.cn: [由于]下着雨，他们决定留在室内看电影。

words.translation: vi. 唱, 唱歌, 演唱, 鸣, 啼\nvt. 唱, 歌颂\nn. 嗖嗖声
words.definition: v. deliver by singing\nv. produce tones with the voice\nv. to make melodious sounds

examples.en: She loves to [sing] along to her favourite songs on the radio.
examples.cn: 她喜欢跟着收音机里最喜欢的歌曲[唱]。

examples.en: He [sang] a beautiful song at the school talent show.
examples.cn: 他在学校才艺表演上[演唱]了一首动人的歌。

examples.en: The birds [sang] cheerfully in the trees every morning.
examples.cn: 鸟儿每天早上在树上[歌唱]，欢快地叫着。

examples.en: Everyone [sang] the national anthem before the sports competition began.
examples.cn: 体育比赛开始前，大家[唱]了国歌。

examples.en: She was asked to [sing] a song at her friend's birthday party.
examples.cn: 她被邀请在朋友的生日派对上[唱]一首歌。

words.translation:
a. 单身的, 单程的, 单一的, 个别的, 孤独的, 专一的
n. 一个, 单打, 单程票
vt. 选出
vi. 击出一垒打
[计] 单精度型
words.definition:
n. a base hit on which the batter stops safely at first base
v. hit a single
a. used of flowers having usually only one row or whorl of petals
a. existing alone or consisting of one entity or part or aspect or individual

examples.en: Not a [single] student was absent on the day of the school photo.
examples.cn: 学校拍照那天没有[一个]学生缺席。

examples.en: She booked a [single] room at the hotel for one night.
examples.cn: 她在酒店预订了一间[单人]客房住一晚。

examples.en: He is still [single] and not ready to get married yet.
examples.cn: 他还是[单身]，还没准备好结婚。

examples.en: He bought a [single] ticket to the city because he was not coming back.
examples.cn: 他买了一张去城市的[单程票]，因为他不回来了。

examples.en: She reads for thirty minutes every [single] day without fail.
examples.cn: 她每[一天]都坚持阅读三十分钟，从不间断。

words.translation: n. 先生, 阁下
words.definition: n. term of address for a man\nn. a title used before the name of knight or baronet

examples.sense: n. 先生（对男性的尊称）
examples.en: Excuse me, [sir], could you tell me the way to the station?
examples.cn: 打扰了，[先生]，您能告诉我去车站的路吗？

examples.sense: n. 老师（对男教师的称呼）
examples.en: Yes, [sir], I have finished all the homework you set.
examples.cn: 是的，[老师]，我已经完成了您布置的所有作业。

examples.en: The students stood up and said Good morning, [sir] when he entered.
examples.cn: 当他进来时，学生们站起来说早上好，[老师]。

examples.en: [Sir] Walter Scott was a famous Scottish writer.
examples.cn: [爵士]沃尔特·斯科特是一位著名的苏格兰作家。

examples.en: Dear [Sir] or Madam is a formal way to start a letter.
examples.cn: 尊敬的[先生]或女士是开始一封信的正式方式。

words.translation: n. 姐妹, 姐, 妹, 护士, 修女\nvt. 姐妹般对待
words.definition: n. a female person who has the same parents as another person\nn. (Roman Catholic Church) a title given to a nun (and used as a form of address)\nn. a female person who is a fellow member of a sorority or labor union or other group

examples.en: Her older [sister] helps her with maths homework every evening.
examples.cn: 她的姐姐每天晚上帮她做数学作业。

examples.en: She has a younger [sister] who is five years old.
examples.cn: 她有一个五岁的小[妹妹]。

examples.en: Her [sister] is studying at the same school but in a different year.
examples.cn: 她的[姐姐]在同一所学校读书，但年级不同。

examples.en: The kind [sister] at the hospital helped the patients every day.
examples.cn: 医院里善良的[修女]每天帮助病人。

examples.en: They are best friends as well as [sisters].
examples.cn: 她们既是好朋友，也是[姐妹]。

words.translation: vi. 坐, 就座, 坐落\nvt. 使就座, 骑\nn. 坐, 衣服合身
words.definition:
v. be seated
v. be around, often idly or without specific purpose
v. be in session
v. be located or situated somewhere

examples.en: Please [sit] down and open your textbooks to page twenty.
examples.cn: 请[坐下]，翻开教科书第二十页。

examples.en: She [sat] at the front of the classroom to see the board clearly.
examples.cn: 她[坐]在教室前排以便清楚地看到黑板。

examples.en: He will [sit] his final examinations next week.
examples.cn: 他下周将[参加]期末考试。

examples.en: The old church [sits] at the top of the hill overlooking the village.
examples.cn: 那座古老的教堂[坐落]在山顶，俯瞰着村庄。

examples.en: The cat [sat] on the warm windowsill watching the birds outside.
examples.cn: 猫[坐]在温暖的窗台上看着外面的鸟儿。

words.translation: n. 情形, 境遇, 位置\n[医] 情境, 处境
words.definition: n. the general state of things; the combination of circumstances at a given time\nn. a condition or position in which you find yourself\nn. a complex or critical or unusual difficulty

examples.en: The teacher handled the difficult [situation] calmly and fairly.
examples.cn: 老师冷静公平地处理了这个困难的[情况]。

examples.en: He found himself in a [situation] where he had to make a hard choice.
examples.cn: 他发现自己处于一个必须做出艰难选择的[处境]。

examples.en: The [situation] at the school improved after new rules were introduced.
examples.cn: 新规定出台后，学校的[局势]有所改善。

examples.en: In that [situation], staying calm is the most important thing.
examples.cn: 在那种[情形]下，保持冷静是最重要的。

examples.en: She assessed the [situation] quickly and decided what to do.
examples.cn: 她迅速评估了[形势]，决定该怎么做。

words.translation: num. 六, 六个
words.definition: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of five and one\ns. denoting a quantity consisting of six items or units

examples.en: There are [six] apples left in the basket after everyone took one.
examples.cn: 每人拿了一个后，篮子里还剩[六]个苹果。

examples.en: She wakes up at [six] o'clock every morning to exercise.
examples.cn: 她每天早上[六]点起床锻炼。

examples.en: The team has [six] players and needs one more to be complete.
examples.cn: 这个队伍有[六]名球员，还需要再一名才完整。

examples.en: He finished the puzzle in [six] minutes without any help.
examples.cn: 他在没有任何帮助的情况下，[六]分钟内完成了拼图。

examples.en: A primary school child is usually between [six] and twelve years old.
examples.cn: 小学生通常在[六]到十二岁之间。

words.translation: num. 十六, 十六个
words.definition: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of fifteen and one\ns. being one more than fifteen

examples.en: She will turn [sixteen] next month and is planning a big party.
examples.cn: 她下个月就满[十六]岁了，正在计划一个大型聚会。

examples.en: There are [sixteen] teams taking part in the school football league.
examples.cn: 有[十六]支队伍参加学校足球联赛。

examples.en: He started learning the guitar at the age of [sixteen].
examples.cn: 他在[十六]岁时开始学吉他。

examples.en: The concert hall can hold up to [sixteen] hundred people.
examples.cn: 音乐厅最多可容纳[一千六]百人。

examples.en: She scored [sixteen] out of twenty in the vocabulary test.
examples.cn: 她在词汇测验中得了二十分中的[十六]分。

words.translation: num. 第六, 六分之一
words.definition: n. position six in a countable series of things\nn. the musical interval between one note and another six notes away from it\ns. coming next after the fifth and just before the seventh in position

examples.en: She finished in [sixth] place in the school cross-country race.
examples.cn: 她在学校越野赛中获得了[第六]名。

examples.en: The [sixth] lesson of the day is always my favourite — it is art.
examples.cn: 一天中[第六]节课总是我最喜欢的——是美术课。

examples.en: Only a [sixth] of the students chose the science topic for their project.
examples.cn: 只有[六分之一]的学生为项目选择了科学主题。

examples.en: June is the [sixth] month of the year.
examples.cn: 六月是一年中的[第六]个月。

examples.en: He was the [sixth] person to cross the finishing line in the race.
examples.cn: 他是比赛中[第六]个冲过终点线的人。

words.translation: num. 六十, 六十个
words.definition: n. the cardinal number that is the product of ten and six\ns. being ten more than fifty

examples.en: My grandmother is [sixty] years old and still very energetic.
examples.cn: 我祖母[六十]岁了，但依然精力充沛。

examples.en: The speed limit in the town centre is [sixty] kilometres per hour.
examples.cn: 市中心的速度限制是每小时[六十]公里。

examples.en: There are [sixty] seconds in one minute and sixty minutes in one hour.
examples.cn: 一分钟有[六十]秒，一小时有六十分钟。

examples.en: The exam lasted [sixty] minutes and had thirty questions.
examples.cn: 考试持续了[六十]分钟，共有三十道题。

examples.en: He ran [sixty] metres in the warm-up before the main race.
examples.cn: 他在主赛前热身跑了[六十]米。

words.translation:
n. 大小, 尺寸, 规模, 尺码, 能力, 浆料
vt. 上浆, 依大小排列
vi. 可比拟
a. 一定大小的, 一定尺寸的
words.definition:
n. the physical magnitude of something (how big it is)
n. the property resulting from being one of a series of graduated measurements (as of clothing)
n. any glutinous material used to fill pores in surfaces or to stiffen fabrics
n. the actual state of affairs

examples.en: What [size] shoes do you wear? I need to buy you a pair.
examples.cn: 你穿几[码]的鞋？我需要给你买一双。

examples.en: The [size] of the new school library surprised everyone.
examples.cn: 新学校图书馆的[规模]让所有人都感到惊讶。

examples.en: She tried on three different [sizes] before finding one that fitted.
examples.cn: 她试了三个不同[尺码]，才找到一件合适的。

examples.en: The [size] of the problem grew bigger the longer they waited.
examples.cn: 问题的[规模]随着等待时间的增加而变得更大。

examples.en: Please check the [size] of the box before trying to fit it in the cupboard.
examples.cn: 在尝试把箱子放进柜子之前，请检查一下[尺寸]。

words.translation: n. 溜冰, 冰鞋\nvi. 滑冰, 滑过
words.definition: n. sports equipment that is worn on the feet to enable the wearer to glide along and to be propelled by the alternate actions of the legs\nn. large edible rays having a long snout and thick tail with pectoral fins continuous with the head; swim by undulating the edges of the pectoral fins\nv. move along on skates

examples.en: She learned to [skate] on the frozen lake during the winter holiday.
examples.cn: 她在寒假期间在结冰的湖面上学会了[溜冰]。

examples.en: He put on his [skates] and glided gracefully across the ice rink.
examples.cn: 他穿上[溜冰鞋]，在溜冰场上优雅地滑行。

examples.en: The boys [skated] in the park after school every Friday.
examples.cn: 男孩们每周五放学后在公园里[玩滑板]。

examples.en: Can you teach me how to [skate]? I have never tried before.
examples.cn: 你能教我怎么[溜冰]吗？我以前从没试过。

examples.en: She wore her new [skates] to the ice rink for the first time.
examples.cn: 她第一次穿着新[冰鞋]去了溜冰场。

words.translation: n. 技术, 技巧, 技能, 熟练, 熟练工人\n[化] 技能
words.definition: n. an ability that has been acquired by training\nn. ability to produce solutions in some problem domain

examples.en: Reading is one of the most important [skills] for a student to develop.
examples.cn: 阅读是学生需要培养的最重要[技能]之一。

examples.en: She has excellent [skills] in drawing and painting.
examples.cn: 她有出色的绘画[技术]。

examples.en: Learning a foreign language is a very useful life [skill].
examples.cn: 学习外语是一项非常有用的生活[技能]。

examples.en: The chef's [skill] with a knife was impressive to watch.
examples.cn: 厨师用刀的[技巧]令人印象深刻。

examples.en: With practice, you can develop [skills] that will help you in the future.
examples.cn: 通过练习，你可以培养将来帮助你的[技能]。

words.translation: n. 裙子, 下摆, 边缘, 郊区\nvt. 位于...边缘, 绕过, 回避\nvi. 位于边缘
words.definition:
n. cloth covering that forms the part of a garment below the waist
n. a garment hanging from the waist; worn mainly by girls and women
v. pass around or about; move along the border
v. form the edge of

examples.en: She wore a blue [skirt] and a white blouse to the school concert.
examples.cn: 她穿着蓝色[裙子]和白色上衣参加学校音乐会。

examples.en: The [skirt] she bought was too long and needed to be shortened.
examples.cn: 她买的[半身裙]太长了，需要改短。

examples.en: She chose a [skirt] with a floral pattern for the spring festival.
examples.cn: 她为春节选了一条花卉图案的[裙]子。

examples.en: He tried to [skirt] around the difficult question during the interview.
examples.cn: 他在面试中试图[回避]那个棘手的问题。

examples.en: In summer, many girls prefer wearing [skirts] because they are cool.
examples.cn: 夏天，许多女生更喜欢穿[裙子]，因为凉快。

words.translation: n. 天空, 天色, 天堂\nvt. 击向空中, 挂在高处\nvi. 高涨
words.definition: n. the atmosphere and outer space as viewed from the earth

examples.en: The [sky] was bright blue with no clouds in sight.
examples.cn: [天空]湛蓝，一片云也看不见。

examples.en: They lay on the grass and watched the stars in the [sky] at night.
examples.cn: 他们躺在草地上，夜晚仰望[天空]中的星星。

examples.en: The [sky] turned red and orange as the sun set over the hills.
examples.cn: 太阳落山时，[天空]变成了红色和橙色。

examples.en: Birds flew across the clear [sky] during the warm spring morning.
examples.cn: 温暖的春天早晨，鸟儿飞过晴朗的[天空]。

examples.en: The fireworks lit up the dark [sky] on New Year's Eve.
examples.cn: 除夕夜，烟花照亮了黑暗的[天空]。

words.translation: n. 睡眠, 静止, 昏迷, 麻木, 长眠, 冬眠\nvi. 睡觉, 睡眠, 静止\nvt. 睡
words.definition:
n. a natural and periodic state of rest during which consciousness of the world is suspended
n. a torpid state resembling deep sleep
n. a period of time spent sleeping
v. be asleep

examples.en: She could not [sleep] because she was too excited about the trip.
examples.cn: 她因为对旅行太兴奋而无法[入睡]。

examples.en: A good night's [sleep] is very important for your health.
examples.cn: 良好的夜间[睡眠]对健康非常重要。

examples.en: The baby [slept] for three hours in the afternoon.
examples.cn: 婴儿在下午[睡]了三个小时。

examples.en: He went to [sleep] early because he had an important test the next morning.
examples.cn: 他早早[入睡]，因为第二天早上有重要考试。

examples.en: She [slept] in on Saturday morning and missed breakfast.
examples.cn: 她周六早上[睡懒觉]，错过了早餐。

words.translation: a. 困乏的, 欲睡的
words.definition: s. ready to fall asleep

examples.sense: adj. 困倦的，昏昏欲睡的
examples.en: She felt very [sleepy] during the maths lesson after lunch.
examples.cn: 午饭后的数学课上她感到非常[困倦]。

examples.en: He became [sleepy] after reading for two hours without a break.
examples.cn: 他连续阅读两小时后变得[困倦]了。

examples.en: The warm classroom made the students feel [sleepy] on a cold afternoon.
examples.cn: 寒冷的下午，温暖的教室让学生感到[昏昏欲睡]。

examples.en: If you feel [sleepy] during the day, you probably need more sleep at night.
examples.cn: 如果你白天感到[困乏]，你可能需要晚上多睡一点。

examples.en: The small [sleepy] town came alive during the annual festival.
examples.cn: 这个[冷清的]小镇在一年一度的节日期间变得热闹起来。

words.translation: a. 慢的, 缓慢的, 迟缓的, 迟钝的, 冷漠的, 落后的\nadv. 慢地, 迟缓地\nv. (使)慢下来
words.definition:
v. become slow or slower
v. cause to proceed more slowly
a. not moving quickly; taking a comparatively long time
a. at a slow tempo

examples.en: The old car was very [slow] on the steep mountain road.
examples.cn: 那辆旧车在陡峭的山路上走得很[慢]。

examples.en: He was a little [slow] at first but became one of the best students.
examples.cn: 他起初有点[迟钝]，但后来成为最优秀的学生之一。

examples.en: Please [slow] down when driving near the school in the morning.
examples.cn: 早上在学校附近开车时请[减速]。

examples.en: Progress was [slow] at first, but she improved quickly after a month.
examples.cn: 起初进展[缓慢]，但一个月后她迅速进步了。

examples.en: She walked [slow]ly through the garden, admiring every flower.
examples.cn: 她[慢慢地]走过花园，欣赏着每朵花。

words.translation: a. 小的, 少的, 小型的, 低微的, 小气的, 细微的\nadv. 些微地\nn. 狭小部分
words.definition:
n. the slender part of the back
n. a garment size for a small person
a. limited or below average in number or quantity or magnitude or extent
s. slight or limited; especially in degree or intensity or scope

examples.en: She lives in a [small] flat with two rooms near the school.
examples.cn: 她住在学校附近一间有两个房间的[小]公寓里。

examples.en: He ate a [small] amount of food because he was not very hungry.
examples.cn: 他吃了[少量]食物，因为他不太饿。

examples.en: She noticed a [small] crack in the cup but used it anyway.
examples.cn: 她注意到杯子上有一道[细小的]裂缝，但还是用了。

examples.en: When she was [small], she used to collect insects in the garden.
examples.cn: 当她还[幼小]时，她常在花园里收集昆虫。

examples.en: There is a [small] chance of rain, so take an umbrella just in case.
examples.cn: 有[一点点]下雨的可能，所以带把雨伞以防万一。

words.translation: a. 聪明的, 漂亮的, 刺痛的, 剧烈的, 敏捷的, 巧妙的, 伶俐的, 潇洒的\nn. 刺痛, 痛苦\nvi. 刺痛
words.definition:
n. a kind of pain such as that caused by a wound or a burn or a sore
a. showing mental alertness and calculation and resourcefulness
s. painfully severe
s. quick and brisk

examples.en: She is a very [smart] student who always solves problems quickly.
examples.cn: 她是一个非常[聪明的]学生，总是能快速解决问题。

examples.en: He looked very [smart] in his new school uniform.
examples.cn: 他穿着新校服看起来非常[整洁]。

examples.en: The [smart] dog learned new tricks in just a few days.
examples.cn: 那只[聪明的]狗仅用几天就学会了新把戏。

examples.en: His eyes [smarted] from the smoke coming from the fire.
examples.cn: 他的眼睛因火堆冒出的烟而[刺痛]。

examples.en: [Smart] devices like phones and tablets are now used in many classrooms.
examples.cn: 手机和平板电脑等[智能]设备现在在许多教室中使用。

words.translation: n. 味道, 气味, 嗅觉, 嗅, 臭味, 气息\nvt. 闻, 探出, 察觉, 发出...的气味\nvi. 嗅, 散发气味, 发臭
words.definition:
n. the sensation that results when olfactory receptors in the nose are stimulated by particular chemicals in gaseous form
n. the faculty that enables us to distinguish scents
n. the act of perceiving the odor of something
v. inhale the odor of; perceive by the olfactory sense

examples.en: She could [smell] the fresh bread as soon as she entered the bakery.
examples.cn: 她一进面包店就[闻到]了新鲜面包的香味。

examples.en: The [smell] of flowers filled the garden in spring.
examples.cn: 春天花朵的[香味]弥漫了整个花园。

examples.en: The dog [smelled] every corner of the room looking for the toy.
examples.cn: 狗[嗅]遍了房间的每个角落寻找玩具。

examples.en: There was a strange [smell] coming from the kitchen.
examples.cn: 厨房里散发出一种奇怪的[气味]。

examples.en: These flowers [smell] wonderful — what kind are they?
examples.cn: 这些花[闻起来]真香——它们是什么品种？

words.translation: n. 微笑, 喜色, 笑容\nvi. 微笑, 觉得好笑\nvt. 微笑着表示
words.definition: n. a facial expression characterized by turning up the corners of the mouth; usually shows pleasure or amusement\nv. change one's facial expression by spreading the lips, often to signal pleasure\nv. express with a smile

examples.en: She [smiled] when the teacher praised her work in front of the class.
examples.cn: 当老师在全班面前表扬她的作业时，她[微笑]了。

examples.en: He greeted everyone with a warm [smile] every morning.
examples.cn: 他每天早上用温暖的[微笑]向大家打招呼。

examples.en: The baby [smiled] for the first time and made everyone happy.
examples.cn: 婴儿第一次[微笑]，让所有人都高兴了。

examples.en: Her [smile] is so bright that it makes others feel happy too.
examples.cn: 她的[笑容]如此灿烂，也让别人感到快乐。

examples.en: Even on difficult days, she always manages to [smile] and stay positive.
examples.cn: 即使在困难的日子里，她总是设法[微笑]，保持积极。

words.translation: n. 烟, 雾气, 烟熏剂, 抽烟, 烟色\nvi. 吸烟, 冒烟, 弥漫\nvt. 以烟熏, 抽烟而导致...
words.definition:
n. a cloud of fine particles suspended in a gas
n. a hot vapor containing fine particles of carbon being produced by combustion
n. an indication of some hidden activity
n. something with no concrete substance

examples.en: Black [smoke] rose into the sky from the burning building.
examples.cn: 燃烧的建筑物里升起了黑色的[烟]。

examples.en: Smoking is bad for your health and [smoking] is not allowed at school.
examples.cn: 抽烟对健康有害，学校不允许[吸烟]。

examples.en: The campfire produced thick [smoke] that stung our eyes.
examples.cn: 篝火产生了刺眼睛的浓[烟雾]。

examples.en: The old engine [smoked] badly and needed to be repaired.
examples.cn: 那台旧发动机大量[冒烟]，需要修理。

examples.en: Where there is [smoke], there is fire — this old saying means there is usually a reason for rumours.
examples.cn: 无[烟]不起火——这句老话意思是谣言通常有一定原因。

words.translation:
a. 平滑的, 平稳的, 流畅的, 和蔼的, 安祥的, 圆滑的, 调匀的, 无毛的
vt. 使光滑, 烫平, 使平和, 消除
vi. 变平滑, 变平静
n. 一块平地, 平滑部分
words.definition:
n. the act of smoothing
v. make smooth or smoother, as if by rubbing
v. free from obstructions
a. having a surface free from roughness or bumps or ridges or irregularities

examples.en: The surface of the table was [smooth] and easy to write on.
examples.cn: 桌子的表面[光滑]，很容易写字。

examples.en: The journey was [smooth] with no traffic jams or delays.
examples.cn: 旅途[顺利]，没有堵车或延误。

examples.en: The pilot made a very [smooth] landing at the airport.
examples.cn: 飞行员在机场做了非常[平稳的]着陆。

examples.en: She [smoothed] the wrinkles out of her shirt before putting it on.
examples.cn: 她穿上衬衫前把皱纹[抚平]了。

examples.en: His [smooth] speaking style made the presentation very enjoyable.
examples.cn: 他[流畅的]说话风格让演示非常愉快。

words.translation: n. 蛇, 阴险的人\nvi. 曲折行进\nvt. 迂回, 拉, 急抽
words.definition:
n. limbless scaly elongate reptile; some are venomous
n. a deceitful or treacherous person
n. a tributary of the Columbia River that rises in Wyoming and flows westward; discovered in 1805 by the Lewis and Clark Expedition
n. something long, thin, and flexible that resembles a snake

examples.en: The children were surprised to see a [snake] in the school garden.
examples.cn: 孩子们在学校花园里看到[蛇]感到很惊讶。

examples.en: Some [snakes] are dangerous, but most are harmless to people.
examples.cn: 有些[蛇]是危险的，但大多数对人无害。

examples.en: The zookeeper explained how to handle a [snake] safely.
examples.cn: 动物园管理员解释了如何安全地处理[蛇]。

examples.en: The river [snaked] through the valley between the mountains.
examples.cn: 河流在山间的山谷中[蜿蜒]流淌。

examples.en: In the Chinese zodiac, the [snake] is one of the twelve animals.
examples.cn: 在中国生肖中，[蛇]是十二种动物之一。

words.translation: n. 雪, 积雪, 下雪, 雪花形干扰\nvi. 下雪, 似雪般落下\nvt. 使雪白, 用雪覆盖, 使像雪般落下
words.definition:
n. precipitation falling from clouds in the form of ice crystals
n. a layer of snowflakes (white crystals of frozen water) covering the ground
n. English writer of novels about moral dilemmas in academe (1905-1980)
v. fall as snow

examples.en: The children played in the [snow] and built a snowman.
examples.cn: 孩子们在[雪]里玩耍，堆了一个雪人。

examples.en: It [snowed] heavily last night and school was cancelled in the morning.
examples.cn: 昨晚[下了]大雪，早上学校停课了。

examples.en: The first [snow] of winter always excites the children.
examples.cn: 冬天的第一场[雪]总是让孩子们兴奋。

examples.en: It rarely [snows] in southern China during the winter.
examples.cn: 冬天，中国南方很少[下雪]。

examples.en: Deep [snow] covered the roads and made driving very difficult.
examples.cn: 厚厚的[积雪]覆盖了道路，使驾驶非常困难。

words.translation: a. 多雪的, 雪的, 被雪所覆盖着的, 下雪的
words.definition: s marked by the presence of snow\ns covered with snow\ns of the white color of snow

examples.en: It was a cold and [snowy] morning when school started after winter break.
examples.cn: 冬假结束后，上学那天是一个寒冷的[雪天]早晨。

examples.en: The [snowy] mountains looked beautiful in the early morning light.
examples.cn: [积雪覆盖的]山脉在清晨的光线下非常美丽。

examples.en: On [snowy] days, the children wear boots and thick coats to school.
examples.cn: [下雪天]，孩子们穿着靴子和厚大衣上学。

examples.en: The north of the country has long and [snowy] winters.
examples.cn: 这个国家北部的冬天漫长而[多雪]。

examples.en: The rabbit had [snowy] white fur and bright pink eyes.
examples.cn: 这只兔子有[雪白的]毛和明亮的粉色眼睛。

words.translation: adv. 如此, 如是, 如...那样\nconj. 所以, 因此\npron. 这样
words.definition:
r. to a very great extent or degree
r. in a manner that facilitates
r. in such a condition or manner, especially as expressed or implied
r. to a certain unspecified extent or degree

examples.en: The film was [so] exciting that we did not want it to end.
examples.cn: 这部电影[如此]令人兴奋，我们不希望它结束。

examples.en: He studied hard, [so] he passed the exam with a high score.
examples.cn: 他努力学习，[所以]以高分通过了考试。

examples.en: She likes reading, and [so] does her brother.
examples.cn: 她喜欢阅读，她弟弟[也]是。

examples.en: I did not know it was [so] cold outside, so I forgot my coat.
examples.cn: 我不知道外面[这么]冷，所以忘了带外套。

examples.en: She woke up early [so] that she would not miss the school bus.
examples.cn: 她早早起床，[以便]不错过校车。

words.translation: n. 肥皂, 阿谀\nvt. 以肥皂洗, 阿谀\n[计] 评语
words.definition:
n. a cleansing agent made from the salts of vegetable or animal fats
n. money offered as a bribe
n. street names for gamma hydroxybutyrate
v. rub soap all over, usually with the purpose of cleaning

examples.en: Always wash your hands with [soap] and water before eating.
examples.cn: 饭前总是要用[肥皂]和水洗手。

examples.en: She bought a bar of [soap] with a pleasant lavender scent.
examples.cn: 她买了一块有淡淡薰衣草香味的[肥皂]。

examples.en: My mother enjoys watching [soap] operas on television in the evening.
examples.cn: 我妈妈喜欢晚上在电视上看[肥皂剧]。

examples.en: There is liquid [soap] in the dispenser next to the sink.
examples.cn: 水槽旁边的分配器里有液体[洗手液]。

examples.en: Using [soap] regularly helps prevent the spread of germs and illness.
examples.cn: 定期使用[肥皂]有助于防止细菌和疾病的传播。

words.translation: a. 社会的, 群居的, 社交的\nn. 联欢会
words.definition:
a. relating to human society and its members
a. living together or enjoying life in communities or organized groups
a. relating to or belonging to or characteristic of high society
s. composed of sociable people or formed for the purpose of sociability

examples.en: Good [social] skills help you make friends and work well with others.
examples.cn: 良好的[社交]技能帮助你结交朋友并与他人合作。

examples.en: [Social] studies teaches students about history, geography and culture.
examples.cn: [社会]研究课教学生历史、地理和文化。

examples.en: She is a very [social] person who enjoys meeting new people.
examples.cn: 她是一个非常[爱社交的]人，喜欢结识新朋友。

examples.en: Bees are [social] insects that live and work together in large groups.
examples.cn: 蜜蜂是[群居]昆虫，成群地生活和工作在一起。

examples.en: Many young people spend a lot of time on [social] media every day.
examples.cn: 许多年轻人每天花大量时间使用[社交]媒体。

words.translation: n. 社会；社交界；交往；社团
words.definition: n. an extended social group having a distinctive cultural and economic organization\nn. the fashionable elite

examples.en: Everyone should follow rules to make [society] a better place.
examples.cn: 每个人都应该遵守规则，让[社会]变得更美好。

examples.en: She joined the school drama [society] and performed in three plays.
examples.cn: 她加入了学校戏剧[协会]，参演了三部话剧。

examples.en: Technology has changed [society] in many ways over the past century.
examples.cn: 在过去一个世纪里，科技在许多方面改变了[社会]。

examples.en: The school chess [society] meets every Thursday lunchtime.
examples.cn: 学校象棋[社团]每周四午餐时间聚会。

examples.en: Education plays a key role in shaping a healthy and fair [society].
examples.cn: 教育在塑造健康公平的[社会]方面起着关键作用。

words.translation: 短袜, 袜子, 鞋内的衬垫, 轻软鞋, 巨款, 存款, 存钱处, 银箱, 拳打, 一击, 重击
words.definition: n hosiery consisting of a cloth covering for the foot; worn inside the shoe; reaches to between the ankle and the knee\nn a truncated cloth cone mounted on a mast; used (e.g., at airports) to show the direction of the wind\nv hit hard

examples.en: She put on a clean pair of [socks] before wearing her school shoes.
examples.cn: 她在穿学校鞋子前穿上了一双干净的[袜子]。

examples.en: He lost one of his [socks] in the washing machine.
examples.cn: 他在洗衣机里丢了一只[短袜]。

examples.en: Her favourite [socks] have little cartoon characters on them.
examples.cn: 她最喜欢的[袜子]上面有小卡通人物。

examples.en: Wearing thick [socks] helps keep your feet warm in cold weather.
examples.cn: 穿厚[袜子]有助于在寒冷天气里保暖。

examples.en: She folded all her clean [socks] and put them in the drawer.
examples.cn: 她把所有干净的[袜子]叠好放进抽屉里。

words.translation: n. 沙发
words.definition: n. an upholstered seat for more than one person

examples.en: The family sat on the [sofa] together to watch the film.
examples.cn: 一家人坐在[沙发]上一起看电影。

examples.en: She fell asleep on the [sofa] while reading her book.
examples.cn: 她边读书边在[沙发]上睡着了。

examples.en: The new [sofa] was so comfortable that nobody wanted to get up.
examples.cn: 新[沙发]太舒适了，没有人想站起来。

examples.en: He moved the [sofa] to make more space in the living room.
examples.cn: 他移动了[沙发]，在客厅里腾出更多空间。

examples.en: The cat always curls up on the [sofa] when it is cold outside.
examples.cn: 天气冷时，猫总是蜷缩在[沙发]上。

words.translation: a. 软的, 温和的, 柔和的, 柔滑的, 温柔的, 软弱的, 坡度小的, 笨的, 纸币的\nn. 柔软的东西, 笨人, 纸币\nadv. 柔软地, 温和地
words.definition:
a. yielding readily to pressure or weight
a. compassionate and kind; conciliatory
a. (of sound) relatively low in volume
a. not protected against attack (especially by nuclear weapons)

examples.en: The kitten has very [soft] fur that is pleasant to touch.
examples.cn: 这只小猫有非常[柔软的]毛，摸起来很舒服。

examples.en: She spoke in a [soft] voice so as not to disturb the others.
examples.cn: 她用[轻柔的]声音说话，以免打扰其他人。

examples.en: A [soft] breeze blew through the window on the warm afternoon.
examples.cn: 温暖的下午，一阵[温和的]微风吹过窗口。

examples.en: The pillow was too [soft] and did not support her neck properly.
examples.cn: 枕头太[软]了，不能很好地支撑她的脖子。

examples.en: She is [soft]-hearted and finds it hard to say no to anyone.
examples.cn: 她心地[善良]，很难对任何人说不。

words.translation: n. 军人, 士兵, 兵蚁\nvi. 从军, 尽职, 偷懒, 磨洋工
words.definition: n. an enlisted man or woman who serves in an army\nn. a wingless sterile ant or termite having a large head and powerful jaws adapted for defending the colony\nv. serve as a soldier in the military

examples.en: The brave [soldiers] protected the country during the war.
examples.cn: 勇敢的[士兵们]在战争中保卫国家。

examples.en: The young [soldier] wrote letters home to his family every week.
examples.cn: 年轻的[战士]每周给家人写信。

examples.en: After leaving the army, the [soldier] became a teacher.
examples.cn: 离开军队后，那名[军人]成了一名教师。

examples.en: The [soldiers] stood guard at the entrance to the palace.
examples.cn: [士兵们]在宫殿入口站岗。

examples.en: People respect [soldiers] who give up their comfort to serve their country.
examples.cn: 人们尊重那些为国家服务而牺牲舒适的[军人]。

words.translation: n. 固体\na. 坚硬的, 稳固的, 固体的, 实心的, 纯质的, 立体的, 立方的\n[计] 原色
words.definition:
n. matter that is solid at room temperature and pressure
n. the state in which a substance has no tendency to flow under moderate stress; resists forces (such as compression) that tend to deform it; and retains a definite size and shape
n. a three-dimensional shape
s. characterized by good substantial quality

examples.en: Ice is a [solid] form of water that melts when heated.
examples.cn: 冰是水的[固体]形态，受热后融化。

examples.en: The bridge was built on [solid] foundations and would last for centuries.
examples.cn: 这座桥建在[坚固的]地基上，可以屹立数百年。

examples.en: She gave a [solid] performance in the exam and passed easily.
examples.cn: 她在考试中表现[出色]，轻松通过了。

examples.en: At room temperature, butter changes from a [solid] to a liquid.
examples.cn: 在室温下，黄油从[固体]变成液体。

examples.en: He chose a [solid] blue tie to go with his white shirt.
examples.cn: 他选了一条纯[蓝色]领带配白衬衫。

words.translation: pron. 一些, 一部分, 若干\nadv. 大约\na. 一些的, 少许的, 某一的
words.definition:
a. quantifier; used with either mass nouns or plural count nouns to indicate an unspecified number or quantity
s. relatively much but unspecified in amount or extent
s. relatively many but unspecified in number
s. remarkable

examples.en: She ate [some] fruit and drank a glass of water for breakfast.
examples.cn: 她早餐吃了[一些]水果，喝了一杯水。

examples.en: [Some] students find maths easy while others find it difficult.
examples.cn: [某些]学生觉得数学容易，而另一些觉得难。

examples.en: Would you like [some]? There is enough for everyone.
examples.cn: 你要[一些]吗？够每个人都有的。

examples.en: [Some] two hundred students attended the school event.
examples.cn: [大约]两百名学生参加了学校活动。

examples.en: She needs [some] time to think before making her decision.
examples.cn: 她在做决定之前需要[一些]时间思考。

words.translation: n. 了不起的人, 大人物\npron. 有人, 某人
words.definition: n a human being

examples.en: [Somebody] left their bag in the classroom after school.
examples.cn: 放学后[有人]把书包落在了教室里。

examples.en: I need [somebody] to help me carry these heavy boxes.
examples.cn: 我需要[某人]帮我搬这些重箱子。

examples.en: She heard [somebody] knocking at the door late at night.
examples.cn: 她深夜听到[有人]在敲门。

examples.en: He always believed he would become [somebody] famous one day.
examples.cn: 他一直相信自己有一天会成为[重要人物]。

examples.en: [Somebody] must have taken my pen from my desk.
examples.cn: [一定有人]拿了我桌上的笔。

words.translation: pron. 有人, 某人
words.definition: n a human being

examples.en: [Someone] called for you while you were out of the classroom.
examples.cn: 你不在教室的时候[有人]来找你了。

examples.en: She is looking for [someone] to practise English conversation with.
examples.cn: 她在找[某人]一起练习英语对话。

examples.en: Is there [someone] who can explain this grammar rule clearly?
examples.cn: 有[没有人]可以清楚地解释这条语法规则？

examples.en: [Someone] left a kind note on her desk to cheer her up.
examples.cn: [有人]在她桌上留了一张善意的便条给她加油。

examples.en: She knew from an early age that she wanted to be [someone] special.
examples.cn: 她很早就知道自己想成为[一个特别的人]。

words.translation: pron. 某事, 某物
words.definition:
n. Anything unknown, undetermined, or not specifically
   designated; a certain indefinite thing; an indeterminate or unknown
   event; an unspecified task, work, or thing.
n. A part; a portion, more or less; an indefinite quantity
   or degree; a little.
n. A person or thing importance.
adv. In some degree; somewhat; to some extent; at some
   distance.

examples.en: She had [something] important to tell her teacher after class.
examples.cn: 她课后有[一些重要的事情]要告诉老师。

examples.en: Would you like [something] to eat after your long journey?
examples.cn: 长途旅行后你想要[些什么]吃吗？

examples.en: He is [something] of an expert when it comes to computers.
examples.cn: 说到电脑，他算是[有点]专家了。

examples.en: Every day you should try to do [something] kind for others.
examples.cn: 每天你应该试着为别人做[一些]善事。

examples.en: There is [something] wrong with this sentence — can you find the mistake?
examples.cn: 这个句子有[些地方]不对——你能找出错误吗？

words.translation: adv. 有时, 时常, 往往
words.definition: r. on certain occasions or in certain cases but not always; at other times for six months"

examples.en: She [sometimes] walks to school and [sometimes] takes the bus.
examples.cn: 她[有时]步行上学，[有时]坐公共汽车。

examples.en: [Sometimes] it is better to listen carefully than to speak.
examples.cn: [有时候]，认真倾听比说话更好。

examples.en: He [sometimes] forgets to bring his homework but always apologises.
examples.cn: 他[偶尔]忘记带作业，但总是道歉。

examples.en: Learning a language is [sometimes] difficult, but always rewarding.
examples.cn: 学习一门语言[有时]很困难，但总是值得的。

examples.en: She [sometimes] reads before bed to help her relax.
examples.cn: 她[有时]在睡前阅读以帮助放松。

words.translation: adv. 到某处, 在某处
words.definition: n. an indefinite or unknown location\nr. in or at or to some place; (`someplace' is used informally for `somewhere')

examples.en: She left her keys [somewhere] in the school and cannot find them.
examples.cn: 她把钥匙落在学校[某处]，找不到了。

examples.en: The journey takes [somewhere] around two hours by train.
examples.cn: 乘火车旅程大约需要[大约]两个小时。

examples.en: Let us go [somewhere] quiet to talk about the problem.
examples.cn: 我们找个[安静的地方]谈谈这个问题吧。

examples.en: He wanted to travel [somewhere] far away for the school holiday.
examples.cn: 他想在学校假期去[某个遥远的地方]旅行。

examples.en: I have seen that face [somewhere] before but cannot remember where.
examples.cn: 我以前在[某处]见过那张脸，但想不起在哪里了。

words.translation: n. 儿子, 女婿, 子孙\n[法] 儿子, 女婿, 养子
words.definition: n. a male human offspring\nn. the divine word of God; the second person in the Trinity (incarnate in Jesus)

examples.en: Their [son] is twelve years old and loves playing football.
examples.cn: 他们的[儿子]十二岁，喜欢踢足球。

examples.en: She is very proud of her [son] who won first prize in the competition.
examples.cn: 她对在比赛中获得一等奖的[儿子]非常自豪。

examples.en: The father took his [son] to football practice every Saturday.
examples.cn: 父亲每个周六带[儿子]去练习足球。

examples.en: His parents hope their [son] will study hard and go to university.
examples.cn: 他的父母希望[儿子]努力学习并上大学。

examples.en: The old man smiled proudly as his [son] received the award.
examples.cn: 当[儿子]领奖时，老人骄傲地笑了。

words.translation: n. 歌, 曲, 鸣声, 歌唱, 歌曲, 诗歌
words.definition:
n. a short musical composition with words
n. a distinctive or characteristic sound
n. the act of singing
n. a very small sum

examples.en: She sang her favourite [song] at the school talent show.
examples.cn: 她在学校才艺表演上唱了她最喜欢的[歌曲]。

examples.en: The children learned a new [song] about the seasons in music class.
examples.cn: 孩子们在音乐课上学了一首关于四季的新[歌]。

examples.en: The [song] of the birds in the garden woke her up in the morning.
examples.cn: 花园里鸟儿的[鸣叫]在早晨叫醒了她。

examples.en: That old [song] always makes me feel happy and nostalgic.
examples.cn: 那首老[歌]总是让我感到快乐和怀念。

examples.en: The class worked together to perform a [song] at the graduation ceremony.
examples.cn: 全班合作在毕业典礼上表演了一首[歌曲]。

words.translation: adv. 不久, 早, 快, 宁可
words.definition: r. in the near future

examples.en: The bus will arrive [soon] — we only have to wait five more minutes.
examples.cn: 公共汽车[很快]就会到——我们只需再等五分钟。

examples.en: She arrived [soon] after the lesson started and apologised for being late.
examples.cn: 她在课程开始后不久到达，并为迟到道歉。

examples.en: The new school building will be ready [soon] after the summer break.
examples.cn: 新教学楼将在暑假结束后[不久]准备好。

examples.en: As [soon] as the bell rang, the students ran out to the playground.
examples.cn: 铃声一响，学生们[立刻]跑到操场上。

examples.en: She would just as [soon] stay home and read as go to the party.
examples.cn: 她[宁可]待在家里读书也不愿去参加聚会。

words.translation: a. 难过的, 悲哀的, 遗憾的
words.definition:
a feeling or expressing regret or sorrow or a sense of loss over something done or undone
s bad; unfortunate
s without merit
s causing dejection

examples.en: She said she was [sorry] for arriving late to the lesson.
examples.cn: 她说她为上课迟到感到[抱歉]。

examples.en: I am [sorry] to hear that you failed the test. I hope you do better next time.
examples.cn: 听说你没通过考试，我感到很[遗憾]。希望你下次做得更好。

examples.en: She felt [sorry] for the student who had no one to sit with at lunch.
examples.cn: 她为午饭时没有人陪坐的同学感到[同情]。

examples.en: I am [sorry], could you repeat what you just said? I did not hear clearly.
examples.cn: [对不起]，你能重复一下你说的话吗？我没有听清楚。

examples.en: The garden looked a [sorry] sight after the storm.
examples.cn: 暴风雨后，花园看起来很[凄惨]。

words.translation:
n. 种类, 方式, 品质, 态度, 举止
vt. 分类, 排序, 挑选
vi. 交往, 协调
[计] 排序; DOS外部命令:从标准输入设备接收数据, 整个数据输入完后
对它以行为单位进行排序, 然后在标准输出设备上输出
words.definition: n. an approximate definition or example\nn. a person of a particular character or nature\nn. an operation that segregates items into groups according to a specified criterion

examples.en: What [sort] of music do you enjoy listening to most?
examples.cn: 你最喜欢听哪[种]音乐？

examples.en: She [sorted] her books by subject before putting them on the shelf.
examples.cn: 她把书按科目[整理]好再放到书架上。

examples.en: This [sort] of problem requires careful thinking and patience.
examples.cn: 这[类]问题需要仔细思考和耐心。

examples.en: The teacher helped the students [sort out] their misunderstanding.
examples.cn: 老师帮助学生们[解决]了误会。

examples.en: She felt [sort of] nervous before giving her speech.
examples.cn: 演讲前她感到[有些]紧张。

words.translation:
n. 声音, 语音, 吵闹, 声调, 听力范围, 探条, 海峡
a. 健全的, 可靠的, 合理的, 健康的, 彻底的, 资金充实的
adv. 彻底地, 充分地
vi. 发出声音, 回响, 测深, 试探, 听起来
vt. 使发声, 宣告, 听诊, 测...深, 试探
[计] 声音
words.definition:
n. the particular auditory effect produced by a given cause
n. the subjective sensation of hearing something
n. mechanical vibrations transmitted by an elastic medium
n. the sudden occurrence of an audible event

examples.en: She heard a strange [sound] outside her window late at night.
examples.cn: 她深夜听到窗外传来一种奇怪的[声音]。

examples.cn: 船穿过两座岛屿之间狭窄的[海峡]航行。

words.translation: n. 汤, 马力\nvt. 加速, 增加马力

n. any composition having a consistency suggestive of soup

examples.cn: 她祖母自制的[汤]比罐装的好喝多了。

examples.en: On cold winter days, a warm bowl of [soup] is the best comfort food.
examples.cn: 在寒冷的冬天，一碗热[汤]是最好的慰藉食物。

words.translation:

examples.cn: 柠檬汁喝起来很[酸]，但很清爽。

examples.cn: 争吵后，两位同学之间的关系变得[不好]了。

words.translation:

adv. 在南方
vi. 转向南方
words.definition:
n. the region of the United States lying to the south of the Mason-Dixon line
n. the cardinal compass point that is at 180 degrees

n. the direction corresponding to the southward cardinal compass point

examples.en: The birds fly [south] in autumn to escape the cold winter.
examples.cn: 鸟儿在秋天向[南]飞，以逃避寒冷的冬天。

examples.cn: 冬天，中国[南部]比北部更温暖。

examples.cn: 她在海边的一个小[南方]城镇长大。

examples.cn: 我们的教室朝[南]，所以阳光充足。

examples.en: Follow this road [south] for five kilometres to reach the village.
examples.cn: 沿这条路向[南]走五公里就到村庄了。

words.translation: n. 南方人, 男风\na. 向南方的, 来自南方的
words.definition: a. in or characteristic of a region of the United States south of (approximately) the Mason-Dixon line\na. situated in or coming from regions of the south

examples.en: The [southern] part of the country has a warm tropical climate.
examples.cn: 这个国家的[南部]地区气候温暖，属热带气候。

examples.en: [Southern] cooking is known for its spicy and flavourful dishes.
examples.cn: [南方]烹饪以其辛辣美味的菜肴而闻名。

examples.en: The [southern] coast is popular with tourists during the summer.
examples.cn: [南部]海岸在夏季很受游客欢迎。

examples.cn: 他们向[南方]驾驶，驶向更温暖的地区。

examples.cn: 她有一口与当地方言不同的[南方]口音。

words.translation:

vi. 留间隔

words.definition:
n. the unlimited expanse in which everything is located
n. an empty area (usually bounded in some way between things)
n. an area reserved for some particular purpose
n. a blank character used to separate successive words in writing or printing

examples.en: Astronauts travel to [space] to conduct scientific experiments.
examples.cn: 宇航员前往[太空]进行科学实验。

examples.cn: 教室里没有足够的[空间]放所有新桌子。

examples.en: Please write your answer in the [space] provided on the answer sheet.
examples.cn: 请在答题纸上提供的[空白处]写下你的答案。

examples.cn: 她想成为一名宇航员，有一天探索[太空]。

examples.cn: 写字时每个单词之间要留一个[空隙]。

words.translation:
n. 剩余, 备用品, 备件, 备用零件, 备用轮胎

vi. 节约, 省掉, 宽恕
vt. 节约, 省用, 剩下, 饶恕, 赦免

n. a score in tenpins; knocking down all ten after rolling two balls
v. refrain from harming
v. save or relieve from an experience or action
v. give up what is not strictly needed

examples.en: She uses her [spare] time to read books and draw pictures.
examples.cn: 她利用[空闲]时间阅读书籍和画画。

examples.en: Could you [spare] a few minutes to help me with this exercise?
examples.cn: 你能[抽出]几分钟帮我做这道练习题吗？

examples.en: He kept a [spare] pen in his bag in case the first one ran out of ink.
examples.cn: 他在书包里放了一支[备用]笔，以防第一支没墨了。

examples.en: Please [spare] me the long explanation and just tell me the answer.
examples.cn: 请[省去]冗长的解释，直接告诉我答案。

examples.en: The cyclist carried a [spare] tyre in case she had a puncture.
examples.cn: 骑车者带了一个[备用]轮胎，以防爆胎。

words.translation: vi. 说, 说话, 演说, 发言\nvt. 说, 讲, 说出
words.definition: v. use language\nv. make a characteristic or natural sound

examples.en: She was asked to [speak] clearly and slowly during her presentation.
examples.cn: 她被要求在演示中[说话]清晰缓慢。

examples.en: He can [speak] three languages: Chinese, English and French.
examples.cn: 他会[说]三种语言：中文、英语和法语。

examples.cn: 校长将在集会上向全校[发言]。

examples.cn: 请[大声说]——大厅后面的我们听不到你说话。

examples.cn: 我可以[找]老师[谈谈]我的考试成绩吗？

words.translation: n. 说话人, 讲演者, 发言人, 喇叭, 扬声器\n[计] 扬声器
words.definition: n. someone who expresses in language; someone who talks (especially someone who delivers a public speech or someone especially garrulous)\nn. the presiding officer of a deliberative assembly

examples.en: The [speaker] gave an inspiring talk about protecting the environment.
examples.cn: [演讲者]发表了关于保护环境的励志演讲。

examples.en: The [speaker] paused for a moment and then continued.
examples.cn: [讲话者]停顿了一下然后继续说。

examples.en: She connected her phone to the wireless [speaker] to play music.
examples.cn: 她把手机连接到无线[音箱]播放音乐。

examples.cn: 英语母语[使用者]可以帮助你提高发音。

examples.cn: 议会[议长]在辩论中维持了秩序。

words.translation: n. 专辑, 专车, 号外, 特别的东西, 负有特别任务的人员\na. 特别的, 专门的, 特殊的, 额外的, 附加的, 特别亲密的
words.definition:

n. a dish or meal given prominence in e.g. a restaurant

s. for a special service or occasion

examples.cn: 她的生日对全家人来说是一个[特别的]日子。

examples.en: The school has a [special] programme for students who love science.
examples.cn: 学校为热爱科学的学生提供[专门的]课程。

examples.en: He made a [special] effort to help the new student settle in.
examples.cn: 他[特别]努力帮助新同学安顿下来。

examples.cn: 今天食堂的[特色]菜是红烧肉配米饭。

examples.cn: 每个人都是[独特的]，拥有独特的才能和能力。

words.translation: n. 演讲, 说话, 谈话, 言语, 引语, 民族语言\n[医] 言语, 语言

examples.cn: 她在学校毕业典礼上发表了精彩的[演讲]。

examples.cn: [言语]是人类最重要的交流方式之一。

examples.cn: 比赛获胜者发表了简短的[演讲]感谢大家。

examples.cn: 她把学校话剧的[台词]一字不差地背下来了。

words.translation:

examples.cn: 火车的[速度]让所有乘客都感到惊讶。

words.translation:

examples.cn: 好消息在学校社区里[传播]得很快。

words.translation:

words.translation:
