words.translation: n. 故事, 小说, 传奇, 描述, 阅历, 经历, 层
words.definition: n. a piece of fiction that narrates a chain of related events

examples.en: She told the children a bedtime [story] about a brave little dragon.
examples.cn: 她给孩子们讲了一个关于勇敢小龙的睡前[故事]。

examples.en: He shared the [story] of how he first came to love reading.
examples.cn: 他讲述了他最初爱上阅读的[经历]。

examples.en: The [story] about the school's science project appeared in the local newspaper.
examples.cn: 关于学校科学项目的[报道]出现在当地报纸上。

examples.en: She lives on the third [story] of the apartment building.
examples.cn: 她住在公寓楼的三[层]。

examples.en: The [story] of the film was so moving that many viewers cried.
examples.cn: 这部电影的[故事情节]如此感人，许多观众都哭了。

words.translation: a. 奇怪的, 陌生的, 生疏的, 不熟悉的, 不可思议的, 外行的, 外地的, 异乡的
words.definition: a. being definitely out of the ordinary and unexpected; slightly odd or even a bit weird\ns. not known before

examples.en: There was a [strange] noise coming from the basement.
examples.cn: 地下室里传来一种[奇怪的]声音。

examples.en: She felt nervous in the [strange] city where she knew nobody.
examples.cn: 在这个陌生的城市里，她感到紧张，没有认识的人。

examples.en: He had a [strange] habit of humming while he solved maths problems.
examples.cn: 他有一个[奇特的]习惯，解数学题时会哼歌。

examples.en: The weather today is [strange] — sunny but very cold at the same time.
examples.cn: 今天的天气很[怪异]——晴朗但同时非常冷。

examples.en: It [strange]ly happened that both twins chose the same career.
examples.cn: [奇怪的]是，这对双胞胎都选择了同样的职业。

words.translation: n. 陌生人, 门外汉\n[法] 局外人, 非当事人, 第三者
words.definition: n. anyone who does not belong in the environment in which they are found\nn. an individual that one is not acquainted with

examples.en: Children are taught never to accept gifts from [strangers].
examples.cn: 教导孩子们不要接受[陌生人]的礼物。

examples.en: As a [stranger] in the city, she asked for directions to the school.
examples.cn: 作为城市里的[外来者]，她询问去学校的方向。

examples.en: The kind [stranger] helped her find her lost dog in the park.
examples.cn: 那位善良的[陌生人]帮她在公园里找到了丢失的狗。

examples.en: He is no [stranger] to hard work — he has always given his best.
examples.cn: 他对努力工作并不[陌生]——他一直尽力而为。

examples.en: Always be polite but careful when speaking to [strangers].
examples.cn: 与[陌生人]交谈时要礼貌但谨慎。

words.translation: n. 草莓
words.definition: n. sweet fleshy red fruit\nn. any of various low perennial herbs with many runners and bearing white flowers followed by edible fruits having many small achenes scattered on the surface of an enlarged red pulpy berry\nn. a soft red birthmark

examples.en: She picked fresh [strawberries] from the garden for the fruit salad.
examples.cn: 她从花园里摘了新鲜的[草莓]做水果沙拉。

examples.en: [Strawberry] ice cream is her favourite flavour in summer.
examples.cn: [草莓]冰淇淋是她夏天最喜欢的口味。

examples.en: He planted a row of [strawberry] plants along the garden fence.
examples.cn: 他沿花园篱笆种了一排[草莓]植株。

examples.en: The cake was decorated with fresh [strawberries] and whipped cream.
examples.cn: 蛋糕用新鲜[草莓]和奶油装饰。

examples.en: [Strawberries] are rich in vitamin C and are good for your health.
examples.cn: [草莓]富含维生素C，有益健康。

words.translation:
n. 水流, 小河, 流出, 趋势, 人潮
vt. 流出, 流动, 展开
vi. 流, 涌, 飘扬
[计] 流
words.definition:
n. a natural body of running water flowing on or under the earth
n. dominant course (suggestive of running water) of successive events or ideas
n. something that resembles a flowing stream in moving continuously
v. to extend, wave or float outward, as if in the wind

examples.en: The children paddled in the cool [stream] on the hot summer day.
examples.cn: 炎热的夏天，孩子们在凉爽的[小溪]里趟水玩。

examples.en: A [stream] of students filed out of the classroom at break time.
examples.cn: 一[股]学生在课间依次走出教室。

examples.en: Light [streamed] through the window and lit up the whole room.
examples.cn: 阳光[流]过窗户，照亮了整个房间。

examples.en: He sat by the [stream] and watched the fish swimming.
examples.cn: 他坐在[溪流]旁，看着鱼儿游动。

examples.en: Tears [streamed] down her face when she heard the happy news.
examples.cn: 听到这个好消息时，泪水[流]过她的脸颊。

words.translation: n. 街道, 马路, 街区\na. 街道的
words.definition:
n. a thoroughfare (usually including sidewalks) that is lined with buildings
n. the part of a thoroughfare between the sidewalks; the part of the thoroughfare on which vehicles travel
n. the streets of a city viewed as a depressed environment in which there is poverty and crime and prostitution and dereliction
n. a situation offering opportunities

examples.en: The school is located on a quiet [street] near the park.
examples.cn: 学校位于公园附近一条安静的[街道]上。

examples.en: She walked down the busy [street] and admired the shop windows.
examples.cn: 她走在繁忙的[街道]上，欣赏着橱窗展示。

examples.en: Children should always look both ways before crossing the [street].
examples.cn: 孩子们过[马路]前应该两边都看看。

examples.en: The [street] market near the school sells fresh fruit and vegetables.
examples.cn: 学校附近的[街边]市场出售新鲜水果和蔬菜。

examples.en: Our new flat is on a tree-lined [street] in the old part of the city.
examples.cn: 我们的新公寓在城市老城区一条种满树木的[街道]上。

words.translation: a. 严厉的, 绝对的, 详尽的, 严格的, 精确的\n[法] 严格的, 精确的, 绝对的
words.definition:
s rigidly accurate; allowing no deviation from a standard
s (of rules) stringently enforced
a characterized by strictness, severity, or restraint
s incapable of compromise or flexibility
s severe and unremitting in making demands

examples.en: The maths teacher is very [strict] about handing in homework on time.
examples.cn: 数学老师对按时交作业非常[严格]。

examples.en: The school has [strict] rules about the use of mobile phones in class.
examples.cn: 学校对在课堂使用手机有[严格的]规定。

examples.en: She followed a [strict] study schedule to prepare for the exams.
examples.cn: 她遵循[严谨的]学习计划备考。

examples.en: Although [strict], the teacher was also fair and encouraging.
examples.cn: 虽然[严厉]，但老师也公平而鼓励学生。

examples.en: In the [strict] sense of the word, this is not a complete sentence.
examples.cn: 从这个词的[严格]意义上说，这不是一个完整的句子。

words.translation: a. 强壮的, 坚固的, 坚强的, 强烈的, 有力的, 优良的\nadv. 强劲地, 有力地, 猛烈地
words.definition:
a. having strength or power greater than average or expected
s. not faint or feeble
s. of verbs not having standard (or regular) inflection
s. freshly made or left

examples.en: He is very [strong] and can carry heavy boxes easily.
examples.cn: 他非常[强壮]，可以轻松搬运重箱子。

examples.en: She showed how [strong] she was by never giving up during hard times.
examples.cn: 她在困难时期从不放弃，展示了自己多么[坚强]。

examples.en: The [strong] smell of the flowers filled the room.
examples.cn: 花朵[浓烈]的香味充满了房间。

examples.en: The fence was [strong] enough to keep the animals inside.
examples.cn: 围栏[牢固]得足以把动物关在里面。

examples.en: She has a [strong] desire to become a doctor and help others.
examples.cn: 她有[强烈的]愿望成为一名医生并帮助他人。

words.translation: n. 学生, 研究者, 学者
words.definition: n. a learner who is enrolled in an educational institution

examples.en: Every [student] in the class worked hard to pass the final exam.
examples.cn: 班上每位[学生]都努力通过期末考试。

examples.en: She is an excellent [student] who always completes her work on time.
examples.cn: 她是一位优秀的[学生]，总是按时完成作业。

examples.en: He became a university [student] after finishing high school.
examples.cn: 高中毕业后他成为了大学[生]。

examples.en: She is a dedicated [student] of classical music.
examples.cn: 她是古典音乐的忠实[学习者]。

examples.en: The [students] raised their hands when they knew the answer.
examples.cn: [学生们]知道答案时举起了手。

words.translation: n. 学习, 研究, 学科, 论文, 求学, 书房, 试作\nvt. 学习, 读书, 研究, 考虑, 计划\nvi. 学习, 思索
words.definition:
n. applying the mind to learning and understanding a subject (especially by reading)
n. a state of deep mental absorption
n. a room used for reading and writing and studying
n. someone who memorizes quickly and easily (as the lines for a part in a play)

examples.en: She [studies] for two hours every evening to prepare for her exams.
examples.cn: 她每天晚上[学习]两小时备考。

examples.en: A new [study] shows that music helps students concentrate better.
examples.cn: 一项新[研究]表明，音乐有助于学生更好地集中注意力。

examples.en: He does his homework in the [study] where it is quiet.
examples.cn: 他在安静的[书房]做作业。

examples.en: She [studied] the map carefully before setting off on the journey.
examples.cn: 她出发前仔细[研究]了地图。

examples.en: Social [studies] is one of the core subjects at her school.
examples.cn: 社会[科学]是她学校的核心科目之一。

words.translation: a. 愚蠢的, 麻木的
words.definition: n. a person who is not very bright\na. lacking or marked by lack of intellectual acuity

examples.en: It was [stupid] of him to forget his textbook on exam day.
examples.cn: 他在考试那天忘带教科书，真是[愚蠢]。

examples.en: Making the same [stupid] mistake twice is something you should avoid.
examples.cn: 你应该避免犯两次同样的[愚蠢]错误。

examples.en: She found the film [stupid] and left the cinema early.
examples.cn: 她觉得电影很[无聊]，提前离开了电影院。

examples.en: Do not call someone [stupid] just because they make a mistake.
examples.cn: 不要仅仅因为别人犯错就叫他们[笨]。

examples.en: He felt [stupid] when he could not answer a simple question.
examples.cn: 当他回答不了一个简单问题时，感到自己很[迟钝]。

words.translation: vi. 成功, 继承, 继续\nvt. 继承, 接替
words.definition: v. attain success or reach a desired goal\nv. be the successor (of)

examples.en: She worked very hard and finally [succeeded] in passing the difficult exam.
examples.cn: 她非常努力，终于[成功]通过了这次难考试。

examples.en: The young manager [succeeded] the director who had retired.
examples.cn: 年轻的经理[接替]了已退休的总监。

examples.en: If you want to [succeed], you must be willing to work hard every day.
examples.cn: 如果你想要[成功]，你必须愿意每天努力工作。

examples.en: He [succeeded] in convincing the teacher to give the class more time.
examples.cn: 他[成功地]说服老师给全班更多时间。

examples.en: She kept trying until she finally [succeeded] in solving the puzzle.
examples.cn: 她一直尝试，终于[成功]解出了谜题。

words.translation: n. 成功, 成就, 胜利
words.definition: n. an event that accomplishes its intended purpose\nn. an attainment that is successful\nn. a state of prosperity or fame

examples.en: Hard work and determination are the keys to [success].
examples.cn: 努力和决心是[成功]的关键。

examples.en: The school play was a great [success] and everyone enjoyed it.
examples.cn: 学校话剧非常[成功]，大家都很喜欢。

examples.en: She celebrated her [success] in the competition with her family.
examples.cn: 她和家人庆祝了在比赛中取得的[成功]。

examples.en: [Success] does not come overnight — it requires patience and effort.
examples.cn: [成功]不会一蹴而就——它需要耐心和努力。

examples.en: The new school canteen has been a [success] and students love it.
examples.cn: 新学校食堂大获[成功]，学生们都喜欢它。

words.translation: a. 成功的, 一帆风顺的, 顺利的\n[经] 成功的
words.definition: a. having succeeded or being marked by a favorable outcome

examples.en: She became a [successful] doctor after years of hard study.
examples.cn: 经过多年的刻苦学习，她成为了一名[成功的]医生。

examples.en: The school trip was very [successful] — everyone had a wonderful time.
examples.cn: 学校旅行非常[顺利]——每个人都玩得很开心。

examples.en: The [successful] students shared their study methods with the class.
examples.cn: [成功的]学生们与全班分享了他们的学习方法。

examples.en: To be [successful], you need both talent and a willingness to learn.
examples.cn: 要想[成功]，你需要天赋和学习的意愿。

examples.en: The team's [successful] defence of the championship impressed everyone.
examples.cn: 该队[成功地]卫冕冠军给所有人留下了深刻印象。

words.translation: a. 如此的, 这样的
words.definition: s. of so extreme a degree or extent\nr. to so extreme a degree

examples.en: She is [such] a kind person that everyone in school loves her.
examples.cn: 她是[如此]善良的人，学校里的每个人都喜欢她。

examples.en: I have never seen [such] beautiful artwork before.
examples.cn: 我以前从未见过[如此]美丽的艺术品。

examples.en: It was [such] a hard exam that only half the class passed.
examples.cn: 考试[如此]难，以至于只有一半的学生通过了。

examples.en: She enjoys outdoor activities [such] as hiking, cycling and swimming.
examples.cn: 她喜欢户外活动，[例如]远足、骑车和游泳。

examples.en: No [such] rule exists — you made that up.
examples.cn: 不存在[那种]规定——你是编的。

words.translation: n. 突然, 忽然\na. 突然的, 意外的, 快速的
words.definition: a. happening without warning or in a short space of time

examples.en: The [sudden] noise scared everyone in the quiet library.
examples.cn: [突然的]声音吓到了安静图书馆里的每个人。

examples.en: A [sudden] change in the weather forced the sports day to be cancelled.
examples.cn: 天气[突如其来的]变化迫使运动会被取消。

examples.sense: adj. 突然的（all of a sudden）
examples.en: All of a [sudden], the lights went out and the room became dark.
examples.cn: [突然之间]，灯熄灭了，房间变暗了。

examples.en: The [sudden] rise in temperature surprised everyone.
examples.cn: 气温[突然]上升让所有人都感到惊讶。

examples.en: She made a [sudden] decision to join the drama club.
examples.cn: 她做出了加入戏剧俱乐部的[突然]决定。

words.translation: n. 糖, 糖块, 甜言蜜语\nvt. 加糖于, 使甜蜜, 粉饰, 美化\nvi. 制成糖
words.definition: n. a white crystalline carbohydrate used as a sweetener and preservative\nv. sweeten with sugar

examples.en: She added one spoonful of [sugar] to her morning coffee.
examples.cn: 她在早晨的咖啡里加了一勺[糖]。

examples.en: Eating too much [sugar] can cause tooth decay and weight problems.
examples.cn: 吃太多[糖]会导致蛀牙和体重问题。

examples.en: The recipe calls for two cups of [sugar] to make the cake sweet.
examples.cn: 食谱要求加两杯[糖]使蛋糕变甜。

examples.en: Fruit contains natural [sugar] which is healthier than processed sugar.
examples.cn: 水果含有天然[糖分]，比加工糖更健康。

examples.en: She [sugared] the doughnuts before serving them to her family.
examples.cn: 她在给家人吃之前在甜甜圈上[撒了糖]。

words.translation: vt. 提议, 建议, 促成, 暗示, 启发, 使人想起\n[法] 建议, 提出, 提议
words.definition: v. imply as a possibility\nv. call to mind

examples.en: The teacher [suggested] that students read for thirty minutes each evening.
examples.cn: 老师[建议]学生每天晚上阅读三十分钟。

examples.en: The results [suggest] that more students prefer science to history.
examples.cn: 结果[表明]更多学生喜欢科学胜过历史。

examples.en: Could you [suggest] a good book for me to read during the holiday?
examples.cn: 你能[推荐]一本假期适合我读的好书吗？

examples.en: She [suggested] going to the park after finishing the homework.
examples.cn: 她[建议]完成作业后去公园。

examples.en: His behaviour [suggests] that he is not happy with the decision.
examples.cn: 他的行为[说明]他对这个决定不满意。

words.translation: n. 提议, 意见\n[医] 暗示
words.definition:
n. an idea that is suggested
n. a proposal offered for acceptance or rejection
n. persuasion formulated as a suggestion
n. the sequential mental process in which one thought leads to another by association

examples.en: The teacher welcomed any [suggestions] for improving the class.
examples.cn: 老师欢迎任何改进课堂的[建议]。

examples.en: His [suggestion] to hold the party outdoors was a great idea.
examples.cn: 他关于在户外举行聚会的[建议]是个好主意。

examples.en: Could I make a [suggestion]? Maybe we should start earlier.
examples.cn: 我能提个[建议]吗？也许我们应该早点开始。

examples.en: There was a [suggestion] in her tone that she was not pleased.
examples.cn: 她的语气中有一种[暗示]，她并不高兴。

examples.en: The students put their [suggestions] for the school trip into a box.
examples.cn: 学生们把关于学校旅行的[建议]放进一个箱子里。

words.translation: n. 夏季, 全盛时期\nvi. 避暑, 过夏天\n[计] 加法器
words.definition: n. the warmest season of the year; in the northern hemisphere it extends from the summer solstice to the autumnal equinox\nn. the period of finest development, happiness, or beauty\nv. spend the summer

examples.en: She loves [summer] because she can swim and enjoy the sunshine.
examples.cn: 她喜欢[夏天]，因为可以游泳和享受阳光。

examples.en: He spent the [summer] reading books and visiting his grandparents.
examples.cn: 他度过了[暑假]，阅读书籍并拜访祖父母。

examples.en: The school holds a [summer] fair every year to raise money for charity.
examples.cn: 学校每年举办[夏季]义卖活动为慈善机构筹款。

examples.en: [Summer] in China can be very hot and humid.
examples.cn: 中国的[夏天]可以非常炎热潮湿。

examples.en: She signed up for a [summer] language course to improve her English.
examples.cn: 她报名参加了一个[暑期]语言课程，以提高英语水平。

words.translation: n. 太阳, 日, 日光, 阳光\nvt. 晒\nvi. 晒太阳
words.definition:
n. the star that is the source of light and heat for the planets in the solar system
n. a person considered as a source of warmth or energy or glory etc
n. any star around which a planetary system revolves
v. expose one's body to the sun

examples.en: The [sun] rose early and warmed the cold morning air.
examples.cn: [太阳]早早升起，温暖了寒冷的清晨空气。

examples.en: She sat in the [sun] and read her book on the balcony.
examples.cn: 她坐在[阳光]下，在阳台上读书。

examples.en: The [sun] sets in the west every evening without exception.
examples.cn: [太阳]每天傍晚毫无例外地从西边落下。

examples.en: Plants need [sun]light and water to grow properly.
examples.cn: 植物需要[日光]和水才能正常生长。

examples.en: Children should wear hats to protect themselves from the strong [sun].
examples.cn: 孩子们应该戴帽子保护自己免受强烈[日晒]。

words.translation: n. 星期日\na. 星期日的, 业余的\nvi. 度星期日
words.definition: n. first day of the week; observed as a day of rest and worship by most Christians\nn. United States evangelist (1862-1935)

examples.en: Most families spend [Sunday] together doing activities they enjoy.
examples.cn: 大多数家庭[周日]在一起做他们喜欢的活动。

examples.en: She goes to the market every [Sunday] morning to buy fresh vegetables.
examples.cn: 她每个[周日]早上去市场买新鲜蔬菜。

examples.en: The library is closed on [Sunday] and re-opens on Monday.
examples.cn: 图书馆[星期天]关闭，周一重新开放。

examples.en: He uses [Sunday] afternoons to prepare for the upcoming school week.
examples.cn: 他利用[周日]下午准备即将到来的学校周。

examples.en: The school play takes place on [Sunday] evening at seven o'clock.
examples.cn: 学校话剧在[星期日]晚上七点上演。

words.translation: a. 阳光充足的, 乐观的, 快乐的, 像太阳的
words.definition: s bright and pleasant; promoting a feeling of cheer

examples.sense: adj. 晴朗的，阳光充足的
examples.en: It was a bright and [sunny] day, perfect for the school picnic.
examples.cn: 这是一个明亮[晴朗]的日子，非常适合学校野餐。

examples.en: The classroom on the south side is always [sunny] and warm.
examples.cn: 南侧的教室总是[阳光充足]且温暖。

examples.en: She has a [sunny] personality that brightens up the whole room.
examples.cn: 她有着[开朗]的性格，照亮了整个房间。

examples.en: We had five [sunny] days in a row during the school trip.
examples.cn: 学校旅行期间我们连续有五天[晴天]。

examples.en: She chose a [sunny] spot in the garden to sit and do her homework.
examples.cn: 她在花园里选了一个[向阳的]地方坐下来做作业。

words.translation: n. 超级市场\n[经] 超级市场, 自助售货商店
words.definition: n. a large self-service grocery store selling groceries and dairy products and household goods

examples.en: She went to the [supermarket] after school to buy ingredients for dinner.
examples.cn: 她放学后去[超市]买晚餐的食材。

examples.en: The [supermarket] near our school sells fresh fruit and vegetables.
examples.cn: 我们学校附近的[超市]出售新鲜水果和蔬菜。

examples.en: He pushed the trolley around the [supermarket] while his mother chose food.
examples.cn: 他推着购物车在[超市]里走来走去，他妈妈挑选食物。

examples.en: The large [supermarket] stocks thousands of different products.
examples.cn: 这家大型[超市]储备了数千种不同的商品。

examples.en: She used a shopping list so she would not forget anything at the [supermarket].
examples.cn: 她用购物清单，这样在[超市]就不会忘记任何东西。

words.translation: n. 晚餐
words.definition: n. a light evening meal; served in early evening if dinner is at midday or served late in the evening at bedtime\nn. a social gathering where a light evening meal is served

examples.en: The family sat down together for [supper] at seven o'clock.
examples.cn: 全家人七点坐在一起吃[晚饭]。

examples.en: She made a simple [supper] of rice and steamed fish.
examples.cn: 她做了一顿简单的[晚餐]，有米饭和蒸鱼。

examples.en: After finishing homework, he sat down to enjoy [supper] with his parents.
examples.cn: 完成作业后，他坐下来和父母一起享用[晚饭]。

examples.en: The school offers [supper] for students who stay for evening activities.
examples.cn: 学校为参加晚间活动的学生提供[晚餐]。

examples.en: She had a light [supper] of soup and bread before going to bed.
examples.cn: 睡前她吃了一顿清淡的[夜宵]，有汤和面包。

words.translation: n. 补给, 供给, 供应品\nvt. 补给, 供给, 提供, 补充\nvi. 替代
words.definition: n. an amount of something available for use\nn. offering goods and services for sale\nv. give something useful or necessary to

examples.en: The school [supplies] all the books and stationery students need.
examples.cn: 学校[提供]学生所需的所有书籍和文具。

examples.en: There is a good [supply] of fresh water available in this area.
examples.cn: 这个地区有充足的淡水[供应]。

examples.en: She packed all her [supplies] for the camping trip.
examples.cn: 她打包了露营旅行所需的所有[物资]。

examples.en: The farm [supplies] vegetables to several schools in the area.
examples.cn: 这家农场为该地区的几所学校[供应]蔬菜。

examples.en: She bought new school [supplies] including pencils, rulers and erasers.
examples.cn: 她购买了新的学校[用品]，包括铅笔、尺子和橡皮。

words.translation: vt. 推想, 假设, 以为, 想像, 假定\nvi. 料想
words.definition: v. express a supposition

examples.en: I [suppose] she will be late again because of the traffic.
examples.cn: 我[猜]她又会因为堵车迟到了。

examples.en: You are [supposed] to arrive at school before eight o'clock.
examples.cn: 你[应该]在八点前到达学校。

examples.en: He [supposed] the test would be difficult, so he studied extra hard.
examples.cn: 他[推测]考试会很难，所以他格外努力学习。

examples.en: [Suppose] you forgot your homework — what would you say to the teacher?
examples.cn: [假设]你忘了作业——你会对老师说什么？

examples.en: I [supposed] the meeting was on Wednesday, but it is actually on Thursday.
examples.cn: 我[以为]会议是周三，但实际上是周四。

words.translation: a. 确信, 必然的, 必定的\nadv. 当然, 确实地, 无疑地
words.definition:
s. physically secure or dependable
s. (of persons) worthy of trust or confidence
s. infallible or unfailing
s. certain not to fail

examples.en: Are you [sure] you locked the classroom door before leaving?
examples.cn: 你[确定]离开前锁了教室门吗？

examples.en: This is a [sure] way to improve your vocabulary — read every day.
examples.cn: 这是提高词汇量的[可靠]方法——每天阅读。

examples.en: [Sure] enough, the bus arrived late as usual.
examples.cn: [果然]，公共汽车像往常一样晚到了。

examples.en: I am [sure] she will do well in the exam — she has worked so hard.
examples.cn: 我[肯定]她会在考试中表现好——她努力了那么多。

examples.en: One thing is for [sure]: hard work always pays off in the end.
examples.cn: 有一件事可以[确定]：努力工作最终总会有回报。

words.translation:
n. 面, 表面, 水面, 外表, 平面
a. 表面的, 外观的, 肤浅的, 水面上的
vt. 使成平面, 使浮出水面
vi. 浮出水面, 呈现, 在地面上工作
words.definition:
n. the outer boundary of an artifact or a material layer constituting or resembling such a boundary
n. the extended two-dimensional outer boundary of a three-dimensional object
n. the outermost level of the land or sea
n. a superficial aspect as opposed to the real nature of something

examples.en: The [surface] of the lake was perfectly calm in the early morning.
examples.cn: 清晨，湖面[表面]非常平静。

examples.en: She wiped the [surface] of the desk clean before starting her homework.
examples.cn: 她在开始做作业前擦干净了桌子[表面]。

examples.en: After a long search, the truth finally [surfaced].
examples.cn: 经过长时间的搜寻，真相终于[浮现]了。

examples.en: The kitchen has a large [surface] area for preparing food.
examples.cn: 厨房有宽大的操作台[面积]用于食物准备。

examples.en: On the [surface], the problem looks simple, but it is actually quite complex.
examples.cn: 从[表面上]看，这个问题看起来简单，但实际上相当复杂。

words.translation: n. 惊奇, 奇袭, 诧异\nvt. 使惊奇, 撞见, 奇袭
words.definition:
n. the astonishment you feel when something totally unexpected happens to you
n. a sudden unexpected event
n. the act of surprising someone
v. cause to be surprised

examples.en: They planned a [surprise] party for her birthday and she was delighted.
examples.cn: 他们为她的生日策划了一个[惊喜]派对，她非常高兴。

examples.en: Her excellent exam results [surprised] even the teacher.
examples.cn: 她优秀的考试成绩甚至让老师也感到[惊讶]。

examples.en: To everyone's [surprise], the youngest student won first prize.
examples.cn: 令所有人[惊讶]的是，最小的学生获得了一等奖。

examples.en: He [surprised] his parents by cleaning the whole house by himself.
examples.cn: 他独自打扫了整个房子，让父母感到[惊讶]。

examples.en: She was [surprised] to find a letter waiting for her on her desk.
examples.cn: 她发现桌上有一封等候她的信，感到很[惊讶]。

words.translation: n. 毛衣, 毛线衫, 运动衫, 出汗者\n[化] 发汗器
words.definition: n. a crocheted or knitted garment covering the upper part of the body

examples.en: She put on a thick [sweater] because it was cold outside.
examples.cn: 她穿上了一件厚[毛衣]，因为外面很冷。

examples.en: He wore a blue [sweater] over his school shirt on the cold day.
examples.cn: 寒冷的日子里他在校服衬衫外套了一件蓝色[毛衫]。

examples.en: Her grandmother knitted a warm [sweater] for her birthday.
examples.cn: 她的祖母为她的生日织了一件温暖的[毛衣]。

examples.en: The school sells [sweaters] with the school logo on the front.
examples.cn: 学校出售正面印有学校标志的[套头衫]。

examples.en: She folded her [sweater] and put it in her bag before leaving.
examples.cn: 她把[毛衣]叠好放进包里再离开。

words.translation: n. 扫除, 打扫, 肃清, 视野, 范围, 全胜\nvt. 扫除, 掸去, 猛拉, 扫荡, 肃清, 冲走, 刮起, 环视, 掠过, 扫射\nvi. 扫, 打扫, 袭击, 席卷, 扫视, 掠过
words.definition:
n. a wide scope
n. a long oar used in an open boat
n. a movement in an arc
v. move with sweeping, effortless, gliding motions

examples.en: She [swept] the classroom floor before the headteacher arrived.
examples.cn: 她在校长到来前[扫]了教室地板。

examples.en: A new fashion [swept] through the school in just one week.
examples.cn: 一股新时尚在短短一周内[席卷]了整个学校。

examples.en: The wind [swept] the leaves across the school playground.
examples.cn: 风把树叶[吹过]了学校操场。

examples.en: She [swept] her eyes across the room to find her missing friend.
examples.cn: 她[扫视]了整个房间，寻找不见踪影的朋友。

examples.en: The school team [swept] all the prizes at the regional competition.
examples.cn: 学校队在地区比赛中[横扫]了所有奖项。

words.translation: n. 甜蜜, 糖果, 情人\na. 甜的, 芳香的, 悦耳的, 漂亮的, 和蔼的, 不咸的, 灵活的, 轻快的
words.definition:
n. English phonetician; one of the founders of modern phonetics (1845-1912)
n. a food rich in sugar
n. the taste experience when sugar dissolves in the mouth
a. having or denoting the characteristic taste of sugar

examples.en: The mango was very [sweet] and juicy when she tasted it.
examples.cn: 她品尝时，芒果非常[甜]而多汁。

examples.en: The little girl gave a [sweet] smile to everyone she met.
examples.cn: 这个小女孩对遇到的每个人都露出[可爱的]微笑。

examples.en: She bought a bag of [sweets] to share with her classmates.
examples.cn: 她买了一袋[糖果]与同学分享。

examples.en: The [sweet] sound of the violin filled the concert hall.
examples.cn: 小提琴[悦耳的]声音充满了音乐厅。

examples.en: The [sweet] smell of flowers floated through the open window.
examples.cn: 花朵[芳香的]气味从打开的窗户飘进来。

words.translation: n. 游泳, 漂浮, 潮流, 眩晕\nvi. 游泳, 游, 漂浮, 浸, 覆盖, 充溢, 大量拥有, 旋转, 眩晕\nvt. 游过, 使浮起
words.definition:
v. travel through water
v. be dizzy or giddy
v. be covered with or submerged in a liquid
v. move as if gliding through water

examples.en: She [swims] every morning before school to stay fit.
examples.cn: 她每天早上上学前[游泳]以保持健康。

examples.en: He learned to [swim] when he was only five years old.
examples.cn: 他在五岁时就学会了[游泳]。

examples.en: The ducks [swam] peacefully across the pond in the park.
examples.cn: 鸭子们在公园的池塘里安静地[游过]。

examples.en: She went for a [swim] in the school pool after the lesson.
examples.cn: 她在课后去学校游泳池[游了泳]。

examples.en: His head [swam] with excitement after winning the first prize.
examples.cn: 获得一等奖后，他的头因兴奋而[晕眩]。

words.translation: n. 游泳, 眩晕
words.definition: n. the act of swimming

examples.en: [Swimming] is one of the best forms of exercise for your whole body.
examples.cn: [游泳]是对全身最好的锻炼方式之一。

examples.en: She won a gold medal in the [swimming] competition last month.
examples.cn: 她上个月在[游泳]比赛中获得了金牌。

examples.en: The [swimming] pool at our school is open every afternoon.
examples.cn: 我们学校的[游泳]池每天下午开放。

examples.en: He takes [swimming] lessons every Saturday to improve his technique.
examples.cn: 他每个周六上[游泳]课以提高技术。

examples.en: Regular [swimming] is great for building strength and stamina.
examples.cn: 定期[游泳]对增强力量和体力非常有益。

words.translation:
n. 摇摆, 振幅, 音律, 节奏, 涨落, 秋千, 旋转, 行动自由
vi. 摇摆, 悬挂, 旋转, 大摇大摆地走, 转向
vt. 挥舞, 使旋转, 使转向, 悬挂, 吊运
a. 旋转的, 悬挂的, 强节奏爵士音乐的
words.definition:
n. a state of steady vigorous action that is characteristic of an activity
n. mechanical device used as a plaything to support someone swinging back and forth
n. a sweeping blow or stroke
n. changing location by moving back and forth

examples.en: The children [swung] on the swings in the playground happily.
examples.cn: 孩子们快乐地在操场上[荡]秋千。

examples.en: She loves playing on the [swing] in the garden after school.
examples.cn: 她喜欢放学后在花园里玩[秋千]。

examples.en: The cricket player [swung] the bat and hit the ball far.
examples.cn: 板球运动员[挥动]球棒，把球打得很远。

examples.en: There was a big [swing] in public opinion after the news came out.
examples.cn: 新闻出来后，舆论发生了很大的[转变]。

examples.en: She [swung] around quickly when she heard her name called.
examples.cn: 听到有人叫她名字时，她迅速[转身]。

words.translation: n. 符号, 象征, 代号, 信条\n[计] 符号; 码元
words.definition: n. an arbitrary sign (written or printed) that has acquired a conventional significance\nn. something visible that by association or convention represents something else that is invisible

examples.en: The dove is a [symbol] of peace in many cultures around the world.
examples.cn: 鸽子在世界许多文化中是和平的[象征]。

examples.en: In mathematics, the plus sign is a [symbol] for addition.
examples.cn: 在数学中，加号是加法的[符号]。

examples.en: The national flag is a powerful [symbol] of a country's identity.
examples.cn: 国旗是一个国家身份的有力[象征]。

examples.en: The dragon is an important cultural [symbol] in China.
examples.cn: 龙是中国重要的文化[象征]。

examples.en: Each [symbol] on the map represents a different type of feature.
examples.cn: 地图上的每个[符号]代表不同类型的地物。

words.translation: n. 圆领汗衫, T恤
words.definition: n a close-fitting pullover shirt

examples.en: He wore a white [T-shirt] and jeans to the casual school event.
examples.cn: 他穿着白色[T恤衫]和牛仔裤参加了学校的休闲活动。

examples.en: She bought a [T-shirt] with her favourite band's name printed on it.
examples.cn: 她买了一件印有最喜爱乐队名字的[T恤]。

examples.en: The sports team wears matching [T-shirts] during competitions.
examples.cn: 运动队在比赛中穿着配套的[T恤衫]。

examples.en: A plain [T-shirt] is easy to wear with many different outfits.
examples.cn: 一件简单的[T恤]很容易和许多不同的服装搭配。

examples.en: She designed a special [T-shirt] for the school fundraising event.
examples.cn: 她为学校筹款活动设计了一件特别的[T恤衫]。

words.translation: n. 桌子, 餐桌, 工作台, 铭文, 表格, 表, 高原, 平地层\nvt. 搁置, 嵌合, 制表, 把...列入议事日程\n[计] 表格, 模拟运算表
words.definition:
n. a set of data arranged in rows and columns
n. a piece of furniture having a smooth flat top that is usually supported by one or more vertical legs
n. a piece of furniture with tableware for a meal laid out on it
n. a company of people assembled at a table for a meal or game

examples.en: Please clear the [table] before we start eating dinner.
examples.cn: 请在我们开始吃晚饭前清理[桌子]。

examples.en: She organised the data into a [table] to make it easier to read.
examples.cn: 她把数据整理成一个[表格]，使其更容易阅读。

examples.en: All students should learn their multiplication [tables] by heart.
examples.cn: 所有学生都应该熟记乘法[表]。

examples.en: The family sits around the [table] for meals every evening.
examples.cn: 家人每天晚上围坐在[餐桌]旁用餐。

examples.en: She put the trophy on the [table] in the school entrance hall.
examples.cn: 她把奖杯放在学校入口大厅的[台]上。

words.translation:
n. 尾部, 后部, 辫子, 随员, 特务, 燕尾服, 踪迹, 限定继承(权)
a. 在后面的, 从后面而来的, 限定继承的, 尾部的, 后部的
vt. 为...装尾, 附于其后, 尾随, 使搭牢, 跟踪, 监视
vi. 跟踪, 船尾搁浅
words.definition:
n. the posterior part of the body of a vertebrate especially when elongated and extending beyond the trunk or main part of the body
n. any projection that resembles the tail of an animal
n. a spy employed to follow someone and report their movements
n. (usually plural) the reverse side of a coin that does not bear the representation of a person's head

examples.en: The dog wagged its [tail] excitedly when its owner came home.
examples.cn: 主人回家时，狗兴奋地摇着[尾巴]。

examples.en: She sat at the [tail] end of the queue and waited patiently.
examples.cn: 她坐在队伍的[末尾]耐心等候。

examples.en: The detective [tailed] the suspect through the busy streets.
examples.cn: 侦探在繁忙的街道上[跟踪]嫌疑人。

examples.en: He flipped the coin and it landed on [tails].
examples.cn: 他抛起硬币，落下时是[反面]。

examples.en: The kite had a long colourful [tail] that flew in the wind.
examples.cn: 风筝有一条长长的彩色[尾部]在风中飘动。

words.translation: vt. 拿, 取, 抓, 带领, 获得, 就座, 接受, 吃, 吸引, 采取, 乘, 需要, 花费\nvi. 吃掉对方棋子, 抓住, 起作用, 依法获得财产\nn. 拿, 取, 收成, 奏效
words.definition:
n. the act of photographing a scene or part of a scene without interruption
v. carry out
v. require (time or space)
v. get into one's hands, take physically

examples.en: Please [take] a copy of the worksheet from the front desk.
examples.cn: 请从前台[取]一张练习题。

examples.en: She [took] her little brother to school on his first day.
examples.cn: 她在弟弟第一天上学时[带]他去了学校。

examples.en: The journey [takes] about twenty minutes by bus.
examples.cn: 乘公共汽车大约[花]二十分钟。

examples.en: He will [take] his driving test next week for the first time.
examples.cn: 他下周将[参加]他的第一次驾驶考试。

examples.en: She [took] the teacher's advice and started reviewing her notes daily.
examples.cn: 她接受了老师的建议，开始每天复习笔记。

words.translation: n. 故事, 谎言, 谣言, 陈述, 叙述\n[法] 虚语, 诽语, 谣言
words.definition: n a message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events; presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program\nn a trivial lie

examples.en: The teacher read the children a fairy [tale] about a sleeping princess.
examples.cn: 老师给孩子们讲了一个关于沉睡公主的童话[故事]。

examples.en: He told a funny [tale] about getting lost on his first day at school.
examples.cn: 他讲述了一个关于第一天上学迷路的有趣[故事]。

examples.en: Many ancient [tales] have been passed down from generation to generation.
examples.cn: 许多古老的[传说]已经代代相传。

examples.en: She loves reading adventure [tales] set in faraway places.
examples.cn: 她喜欢阅读发生在遥远地方的冒险[故事]。

examples.en: Nobody believed his tall [tale] about seeing a dragon in the park.
examples.cn: 没有人相信他关于在公园里看到龙的[谎话]。

words.translation:
n. 谈话, 交谈, 会谈, 讲话, 演讲, 空谈, 谣言, 方言, 语言
vi. 讲话, 演讲, 说话, 谈话, 交流, 闲聊, 说闲话
vt. 讲, 说, 讨论, 谈论
[计] 对话类, 聊天
words.definition:
n. an exchange of ideas via conversation
n. discussion; (`talk about' is a less formal alternative for `discussion of')
n. the act of giving a talk to an audience
n. idle gossip or rumor

examples.en: They [talked] for hours about their favourite books and films.
examples.cn: 他们[交谈]了几个小时，聊他们最喜欢的书和电影。

examples.en: The scientist gave an interesting [talk] about space exploration.
examples.cn: 科学家做了一场关于太空探索的有趣[演讲]。

examples.en: Let us [talk] about what you want to do after finishing school.
examples.cn: 让我们[讨论]一下你完成学业后想做什么。

examples.en: There has been a lot of [talk] about the upcoming school changes.
examples.cn: 关于即将到来的学校变化有很多[议论]。

examples.en: She [talked] her friend into joining the school drama club.
examples.cn: 她[说服]朋友加入了学校戏剧俱乐部。

words.translation: a. 高的, 长的, 夸大的\nadv. 夸大地
words.definition: n. a garment size for a tall person\na. great in vertical dimension; high in stature\ns. impressively difficult

examples.en: He is the [tallest] student in the class and plays basketball well.
examples.cn: 他是班上[最高的]学生，篮球打得很好。

examples.en: The [tall] building near the school can be seen from far away.
examples.cn: 学校附近那栋[高]楼从很远就能看见。

examples.en: She grew two centimetres [taller] over the summer holiday.
examples.cn: 她在暑假期间长[高了]两厘米。

examples.en: Finishing all the work by tomorrow is a [tall] order, but we will try.
examples.cn: 明天前完成所有工作是个[难]任务，但我们会尽力。

examples.en: The sunflowers in the garden grew very [tall] during the warm summer.
examples.cn: 花园里的向日葵在温暖的夏天长得非常[高]。

words.translation: n. 带子, 录音带, 磁带, 窄带, 卷尺\nvt. 以带子绑起, 测量, 录音\n[计] 带
words.definition:
n. a long thin piece of cloth or paper as used for binding or fastening
n. a recording made on magnetic tape
n. the finishing line for a foot race
n. measuring instrument consisting of a narrow strip (cloth or metal) marked in inches or centimeters and used for measuring lengths

examples.en: She used [tape] to stick the poster on the classroom wall.
examples.cn: 她用[胶带]把海报贴在教室墙上。

examples.en: The teacher played a [tape] of the dialogue for the listening exercise.
examples.cn: 老师播放了一段对话的[录音带]用于听力练习。

examples.en: He [taped] the broken page of his textbook carefully.
examples.cn: 他仔细地用[胶带]粘好了教科书破损的页面。

examples.en: The runner broke through the finishing [tape] and won the race.
examples.cn: 跑步者冲过终点线的[带子]，赢得了比赛。

examples.en: She [taped] the school concert to show her parents later.
examples.cn: 她[录制]了学校音乐会，稍后给父母看。

words.translation: n. 工作, 任务, 作业, 困难的工作\nvt. 派给...工作, 使辛劳\n[计] 任务
words.definition: v. assign a task to

examples.en: The teacher gave each student a different [task] to complete.
examples.cn: 老师给每位学生分配了不同的[任务]去完成。

examples.en: Cleaning the whole school was a big [task] that took all day.
examples.cn: 打扫整个学校是一项花了一整天的大[工作]。

examples.en: She completed each [task] on her list before taking a break.
examples.cn: 她在休息前完成了清单上的每项[任务]。

examples.en: Learning a new language is a challenging [task] that requires patience.
examples.cn: 学习一门新语言是一项需要耐心的具有挑战性的[任务]。

examples.en: It is the monitor's [task] to take attendance at the start of class.
examples.cn: 班长的[职责]是在课开始时点名。

words.translation: n. 味道, 品味, 味觉, 感受, 体验, 爱好, 审美, 少量\nvt. 尝, 察觉...的味道, 体会\nvi. 品尝, 察觉味道, 有某种味道
words.definition:
n. the sensation that results when taste buds in the tongue and throat convey information about the chemical composition of a soluble stimulus
n. delicate discrimination (especially of aesthetic values)
n. a brief experience of something
n. a small amount eaten or drunk

examples.en: She [tasted] the soup and added more salt because it was not flavourful enough.
examples.cn: 她[尝]了汤，又加了更多盐，因为味道不够。

examples.en: The [taste] of the freshly baked bread was wonderful.
examples.cn: 新鲜烤面包的[味道]非常美妙。

examples.en: She has very good [taste] in music and always recommends great songs.
examples.cn: 她对音乐有很好的[品味]，总是推荐好歌曲。

examples.en: The cake [tastes] like chocolate even though it looks plain.
examples.cn: 蛋糕[尝起来]像巧克力味，尽管看起来很普通。

examples.en: She got a [taste] of what life as a doctor was like during the visit.
examples.cn: 她在参观中[体验了]一下医生生活是什么样的。

words.translation: n. 出租车\nvi. 乘出租车\nvt. 用出租车送
words.definition: v. travel slowly\nv. ride in a taxicab

examples.en: She called a [taxi] to take her to the airport on time.
examples.cn: 她打了一辆[出租车]准时赶到机场。

examples.en: He took a [taxi] home from school because it was raining heavily.
examples.cn: 因为雨下得很大，他打[的士]从学校回家。

examples.en: They [taxied] across town to reach the conference hall quickly.
examples.cn: 他们[乘出租车]穿过城镇，迅速到达会议厅。

examples.en: The [taxi] driver was very friendly and told them about local attractions.
examples.cn: [出租车]司机非常友好，向他们介绍了当地景点。

examples.en: Taking a [taxi] is more expensive but faster than the bus.
examples.cn: 坐[出租车]比乘公共汽车贵，但更快。

words.translation: n. 茶, 茶叶\n[医] 茶, 茶剂, 浸剂
words.definition:
n. a beverage made by steeping tea leaves in water
n. a light midafternoon meal of tea and sandwiches or cakes
n. a tropical evergreen shrub or small tree extensively cultivated in e.g. China and Japan and India; source of tea leaves
n. a reception or party at which tea is served

examples.en: She made a pot of green [tea] for her parents after dinner.
examples.cn: 她在晚饭后为父母泡了一壶绿[茶]。

examples.en: Drinking [tea] without sugar is better for your health.
examples.cn: 喝不加糖的[茶]对健康更好。

examples.en: They enjoyed [tea] and biscuits in the garden on a sunny afternoon.
examples.cn: 他们在晴朗的下午在花园里享用[下午茶]和饼干。

examples.en: [Tea] is one of the most popular drinks in China and the UK.
examples.cn: [茶]是中国和英国最受欢迎的饮料之一。

examples.en: Come home for [tea] at six o'clock — I am cooking your favourite meal.
examples.cn: 六点回家吃[晚饭]——我在做你最喜欢的菜。

words.translation: vt. 教, 讲授, 教导, 教育\nvi. 教书, 教学, 可以教
words.definition: n. an English pirate who operated in the Caribbean and off the Atlantic coast of North America (died in 1718)\nv. impart skills or knowledge to\nv. accustom gradually to some action or attitude

examples.en: She [teaches] English at a primary school in the city.
examples.cn: 她在城市的一所小学[教]英语。

examples.en: His father [taught] him how to ride a bicycle when he was six.
examples.cn: 他父亲在他六岁时[教]他骑自行车。

examples.en: The experience [taught] her to be more careful in future.
examples.cn: 这次经历[让]她在将来更加小心。

examples.en: She [teaches] the students to think critically about what they read.
examples.cn: 她[教]学生批判性地思考他们所读的内容。

examples.en: The mistake [taught] him a valuable lesson about the importance of preparation.
examples.cn: 这个错误给他上了关于准备重要性的宝贵一课。

words.translation: n. 教师, 老师, 导师
words.definition: n. a person whose occupation is teaching\nn. a personified abstraction that teaches

examples.en: The [teacher] explained the grammar rule clearly and the students understood.
examples.cn: [老师]清楚地解释了语法规则，学生们都理解了。

examples.en: She has been a [teacher] for twenty years and loves her job.
examples.cn: 她做了二十年[教师]，热爱自己的工作。

examples.en: The [teacher] gave stars to students who worked hard.
examples.cn: [老师]给努力学习的学生发小星星。

examples.en: Good [teachers] not only teach subjects but also inspire students.
examples.cn: 好[老师]不仅教授学科知识，还激励学生。

examples.en: Experience is the best [teacher] — you learn most from what you do.
examples.cn: 经验是最好的[老师]——你从实践中学到最多。

words.translation: n. 队, 组\nvt. 把马(牛)套在同一辆车上, 把...编成一组\nvi. 驾驶卡车, 协作
words.definition: n. a cooperative unit (especially in sports)\nn. two or more draft animals that work together to pull something\nv. form a team

examples.en: Our school football [team] won the regional championship this year.
examples.cn: 我们学校的足球[队]今年赢得了地区锦标赛。

examples.en: A strong [team] works together and supports each other.
examples.cn: 强大的[团队]共同合作，互相支持。

examples.en: She [teamed] up with two classmates to complete the science project.
examples.cn: 她与两位同学[合作]完成了科学项目。

examples.en: The teacher divided the class into four [teams] for the quiz.
examples.cn: 老师把班级分成四个[小组]参加知识竞赛。

examples.en: He is proud to be part of the school athletics [team].
examples.cn: 他为成为学校田径[队]的一员而感到自豪。

words.translation: n. 技术, 工业技术, 术语\n[医] 技术学, 工艺学
words.definition: n. the practical application of science to commerce or industry

examples.en: Modern [technology] has made communication much faster and easier.
examples.cn: 现代[科技]使通信变得更快更容易。

examples.en: The school uses the latest [technology] to help students learn.
examples.cn: 学校使用最新的[技术]帮助学生学习。

examples.en: She is interested in [technology] and wants to study computer science.
examples.cn: 她对[科技]感兴趣，想学习计算机科学。

examples.en: New [technology] in medicine has saved millions of lives.
examples.cn: 医学新[技术]拯救了数百万人的生命。

examples.en: [Technology] changes very quickly, so it is important to keep learning.
examples.cn: [科技]变化非常快，所以持续学习很重要。

words.translation: n. 电话, 电话机\nv. 打电话
words.definition: n. electronic equipment that converts sound into electrical signals that can be transmitted over distances and then converts received signals back into sounds\nn. transmitting speech at a distance

examples.en: She picked up the [telephone] and called her mother.
examples.cn: 她拿起[电话]打给了妈妈。

examples.en: The [telephone] rang several times before anyone answered it.
examples.cn: [电话]响了好几声才有人接。

examples.en: He [telephoned] the school to explain why his daughter was absent.
examples.cn: 他[打电话]给学校，解释为什么他的女儿缺席。

examples.en: Before mobile phones existed, people used a home [telephone] to communicate.
examples.cn: 在手机出现之前，人们用家庭[电话]进行交流。

examples.en: She keeps a [telephone] number list in case of emergencies.
examples.cn: 她保存着一份[电话]号码列表，以备紧急情况使用。

words.translation: n. 电视\n[电] 电视
words.definition: n. broadcasting visual images of stationary or moving objects\nn. a telecommunication system that transmits images of objects (stationary or moving) between distant points

examples.en: The family watched the national parade on [television] together.
examples.cn: 一家人一起在[电视]上观看国庆阅兵式。

examples.en: She limits her [television] time to one hour per day.
examples.cn: 她把每天看[电视]的时间限制在一小时以内。

examples.en: The school installed a new [television] in the common room for students.
examples.cn: 学校在公共休息室为学生安装了一台新[电视机]。

examples.en: [Television] programmes about science can make learning fun.
examples.cn: 关于科学的[电视]节目可以让学习变得有趣。

examples.en: She appeared on [television] to talk about her award-winning project.
examples.cn: 她上了[电视]谈论她获奖的项目。

words.translation: vt. 告诉, 说, 吩咐, 断定, 知道\nvi. 讲述, 泄密, 告发, 表明
words.definition:
n. a Swiss patriot who lived in the early 14th century and who was renowned for his skill as an archer; according to legend an Austrian governor compelled him to shoot an apple from his son's head with his crossbow (which he did successfully without mishap)
v. let something be known
v. narrate or give a detailed account of
v. discern or comprehend

examples.en: She [told] her parents about the good news as soon as she got home.
examples.cn: 她一回家就[告诉]了父母这个好消息。

examples.en: Can you [tell] the difference between these two words?
examples.cn: 你能[分辨]这两个词的区别吗？

examples.en: The teacher [told] the students to put their phones away.
examples.cn: 老师[命令]学生把手机收起来。

examples.en: The long hours of study are beginning to [tell] on her health.
examples.cn: 长时间学习开始[影响]她的健康了。

examples.en: She [told] a funny story that made everyone in the class laugh.
examples.cn: 她[讲述]了一个有趣的故事，让全班人都笑了。

words.translation: n. 温度, 发烧, 热度\n[化] 温度
words.definition: n. the degree of hotness or coldness of a body or environment (corresponding to its molecular activity)\nn. the somatic sensation of cold or heat

examples.en: The [temperature] dropped to below zero last night.
examples.cn: 昨晚[气温]降到了零度以下。

examples.en: The nurse took the patient's [temperature] to check for a fever.
examples.cn: 护士给病人量了[体温]以检查是否发烧。

examples.en: The [temperature] of the oven must be set correctly for baking.
examples.cn: 烘烤时必须正确设置烤箱的[温度]。

examples.en: In summer, the [temperature] can reach thirty-eight degrees in this city.
examples.cn: 这座城市夏天[气温]可以达到三十八度。

examples.en: She had a high [temperature] and stayed home from school to rest.
examples.cn: 她[发高烧]，留在家里休息没有上学。

words.translation: num. 十, 十个
words.definition: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one; the base of the decimal system\ns. being one more than nine

examples.en: She counted to [ten] before starting the race.
examples.cn: 她数到[十]才开始比赛。

examples.en: The library closes at [ten] o'clock every evening.
examples.cn: 图书馆每晚[十]点关闭。

examples.en: He scored [ten] out of ten in the spelling test.
examples.cn: 他在拼写测试中得了满分[十]分。

examples.en: There are [ten] students in the advanced maths group.
examples.cn: 高级数学小组有[十]名学生。

examples.en: A perfect score of [ten] was given to her dance performance.
examples.cn: 她的舞蹈表演获得了满分[十]分。

words.translation: n. 网球
words.definition: n. a game played with rackets by two or four players who hit a ball back and forth over a net that divides the court

examples.en: She plays [tennis] every Saturday morning at the sports centre.
examples.cn: 她每个周六早上在运动中心打[网球]。

examples.en: He is learning to play [tennis] and practises his serve every day.
examples.cn: 他正在学打[网球]，每天练习发球。

examples.en: [Tennis] is a popular sport that people of all ages can enjoy.
examples.cn: [网球]是一项各年龄段的人都可以享受的流行运动。

examples.en: She watched the [tennis] final on television and cheered for her favourite player.
examples.cn: 她在电视上观看了[网球]决赛，为她最喜欢的球员加油。

examples.en: The school's [tennis] team has won the regional competition three years in a row.
examples.cn: 学校的[网球]队连续三年赢得了地区比赛。

words.translation: n. 帐篷, 帷幕, 住处, 塞条, 塞子\nvi. 住帐蓬, 宿营, 暂时居住\nvt. 用帐篷遮盖, 使住帐篷, 用塞条嵌入
words.definition: n. a portable shelter (usually of canvas stretched over supporting poles and fastened to the ground with ropes and pegs)\nn. a web that resembles a tent or carpet

examples.en: They set up their [tent] beside the river for the camping trip.
examples.cn: 他们在河边搭起了[帐篷]进行露营旅行。

examples.en: It rained all night but they stayed dry inside their [tent].
examples.cn: 整晚都在下雨，但他们在[帐篷]里保持干燥。

examples.en: The music festival had a large [tent] where performers played.
examples.cn: 音乐节有一个大[帐篷]，供表演者演出。

examples.en: She packed the [tent] carefully so it would not get damaged.
examples.cn: 她仔细收拾了[帐篷]，以免损坏。

examples.en: Six students shared one [tent] during the outdoor education trip.
examples.cn: 六名学生在户外教育旅行中共住一个[营帐]。

words.translation: num. 第十, 十分之一
words.definition: n. position ten in a countable series of things\ns. coming next after the ninth and just before the eleventh in position

examples.en: She finished in [tenth] place in the maths competition.
examples.cn: 她在数学竞赛中获得了[第十]名。

examples.en: Today is the [tenth] of October — a very important date.
examples.cn: 今天是十月[十日]——一个非常重要的日子。

examples.en: Only a [tenth] of the students chose the outdoor activity option.
examples.cn: 只有[十分之一]的学生选择了户外活动选项。

examples.en: October is the [tenth] month of the year.
examples.cn: 十月是一年中的[第十]个月。

examples.en: He was the [tenth] person to hand in his completed exam paper.
examples.cn: 他是[第十]个交完考试卷的学生。

words.translation: n. 术语, 专有名词, 期限, 学期, 任期, 条件, 价钱, 关系, 地位, 项, 界石\nvt. 称, 呼\n[计] 检索词; 项
words.definition:
n. a word or expression used for some particular thing
n. a limited period of time
n. any distinct quantity contained in a polynomial
n. one of the substantive phrases in a logical proposition

examples.en: The school year is divided into three [terms] of roughly equal length.
examples.cn: 学年分为三个大致等长的[学期]。

examples.en: She did not understand the technical [term] the scientist used.
examples.cn: 她不理解科学家使用的那个专业[术语]。

examples.en: The class president serves for one [term] of one school year.
examples.cn: 班长任职一个[任期]，即一个学年。

examples.en: In [terms] of progress, she has improved more than any other student.
examples.cn: 就[进步]方面而言，她比其他任何学生都进步更多。

examples.en: The two schools agreed on the [terms] of the sports exchange programme.
examples.cn: 两所学校就体育交流项目的[条款]达成了一致。

words.translation: a. 可怕的, 令人恐惧的, 极坏的
words.definition:
s causing fear or dread or terror
s exceptionally bad or displeasing
s intensely or extremely bad or unpleasant in degree or quality
s extreme in degree or extent or amount or impact

examples.en: The [terrible] storm damaged many buildings in the city.
examples.cn: [可怕的]暴风雨损坏了城市里许多建筑物。

examples.en: She felt [terrible] after forgetting to study for the important test.
examples.cn: 忘记复习重要考试后她感觉[糟糕透了]。

examples.en: The food at the cafeteria was [terrible] and no one wanted to eat it.
examples.cn: 食堂的食物[非常差]，没有人想吃。

examples.en: He had a [terrible] headache and could not concentrate in class.
examples.cn: 他头疼[得厉害]，无法在课堂上集中注意力。

examples.en: She was a [terrible] singer but always sang with great enthusiasm.
examples.cn: 她是个[非常差劲的]歌手，但总是充满热情地唱歌。

words.translation: n. 测试, 试验, 化验, 检验, 考验, 甲壳\nvt. 测试, 试验, 化验\nvi. 接受测验, 进行测试
words.definition:
n. any standardized procedure for measuring sensitivity or memory or intelligence or aptitude or personality etc
n. the act of undergoing testing
n. the act of testing something
n. a hard outer covering as of some amoebas and sea urchins

examples.en: The students have a vocabulary [test] every Friday morning.
examples.cn: 学生们每周五早上有一次词汇[测验]。

examples.en: The teacher [tested] the class on the grammar points from last week.
examples.cn: 老师[测试]了全班上周学的语法要点。

examples.en: The machine passed every safety [test] before it was used.
examples.cn: 这台机器在使用前通过了所有安全[测试]。

examples.en: Difficult situations [test] our character and reveal who we really are.
examples.cn: 困难的处境[考验]我们的品格，揭示我们真正的样子。

examples.en: She read through the whole [test] carefully before starting.
examples.cn: 她在开始前仔细通读了整份[试卷]。

words.translation: n. 文本, 正文, 课文, 主题, 圣经文句, 乐谱\n[计] 电文; 文本; 正文
words.definition: n. the words of something written\nn. a passage from the Bible that is used as the subject of a sermon\nn. the main body of a written work (as distinct from illustrations or footnotes etc.)

examples.en: The [text] of the article was clear and easy to understand.
examples.cn: 这篇文章的[正文]清晰易懂。

examples.en: She sent a [text] message to tell her mother she would be late.
examples.cn: 她发了一条[短信]告诉妈妈她会晚到。

examples.en: He [texted] his friend the address of the meeting place.
examples.cn: 他[发短信]给朋友，告知了见面地点的地址。

examples.en: The [text] in the English book is interesting and not too difficult.
examples.cn: 英语书里的[课文]很有趣，难度也不大。

examples.en: She analysed the [text] carefully to understand the author's meaning.
examples.cn: 她仔细分析了[原文]，理解作者的意思。

words.translation: conj. 比, 除...外\nprep. 比
words.definition:
conj. A particle expressing comparison, used after certain
   adjectives and adverbs which express comparison or diversity, as more,
   better, other, otherwise, and the like. It is usually followed by the
   object compared in the nominative case. Sometimes, however, the object
   compared is placed in the objective case, and than is then considered
   by some grammarians as a preposition. Sometimes the object is expressed
   in a sentence, usually introduced by that; as, I would rather suffer
   than that you should want.
adv. Then. See Then.

examples.en: She runs faster [than] anyone else in the class.
examples.cn: 她跑得比班里任何人都[快]。

examples.en: Learning to swim is harder [than] most people think.
examples.cn: 学游泳比大多数人想象的要难得多。

examples.en: Reading is more interesting [than] watching television.
examples.cn: 阅读比看电视更有趣。

examples.en: More [than] half the class passed the difficult maths exam.
examples.cn: 超过一半的班级学生通过了这次难数学考试。

examples.en: She chose to study rather [than] play games on the weekend.
examples.cn: 她选择学习而[不是]在周末玩游戏。

words.translation: n. 谢意, 感谢\nvt. 谢谢, 感谢
words.definition: v. express gratitude or show appreciation to

examples.en: She [thanked] the teacher for helping her improve her writing.
examples.cn: 她[感谢]老师帮助她提高了写作水平。

examples.en: He [thanked] everyone for coming to support him at the competition.
examples.cn: 他[感谢]所有人来比赛现场支持他。

examples.en: She wrote a card to express her [thanks] to the school librarian.
examples.cn: 她写了一张卡片向学校图书管理员表达[感谢]。

examples.en: [Thank] you for lending me your notes — they were very helpful.
examples.cn: [谢谢]你借给我笔记——非常有帮助。

examples.en: [Thanks] to the teacher's help, she finally understood the concept.
examples.cn: [多亏]老师的帮助，她终于理解了这个概念。

words.translation:
a. 那, 那个
conj. 以致, 因为
pron. 那
adv. 那么, 那样
words.definition:
pron., a., conj., &  As a demonstrative pronoun (pl. Those),
   that usually points out, or refers to, a person or thing previously
   mentioned, or supposed to be understood. That, as a demonstrative, may
   precede the noun to which it refers; as, that which he has said is
   true; those in the basket are good apples.
pron., a., conj., &  As an adjective, that has the same
   demonstrative force as the pronoun, but is followed by a noun.
pron., a., conj., &  As a relative pronoun, that is
   equivalent to who or which, serving to point out, and make definite, a
   person or thing spoken of, or alluded to, before, and may be either
   singular or plural.
pron., a., conj., &  As a conjunction, that retains much of
   its force as a demonstrative pronoun.
pron., a., conj., &  To introduce a clause employed as the
   object of the preceding verb, or as the subject or predicate nominative
   of a verb.
pron., a., conj., &  To introduce, a reason or cause; --
   equivalent to for that, in that, for the reason that, because.
pron., a., conj., &  To introduce a purpose; -- usually
   followed by may, or might, and frequently preceded by so, in order, to
   the end, etc.
pron., a., conj., &  To introduce a consequence, result, or
   effect; -- usually preceded by so or such, sometimes by that.
pron., a., conj., &  In an elliptical sentence to introduce
   a dependent sentence expressing a wish, or a cause of surprise,
   indignation, or the like.
pron., a., conj., &  As adverb: To such a degree; so; as, he
   was that frightened he could say nothing.

examples.en: [That] student in the front row always answers questions correctly.
examples.cn: 前排[那位]学生总是正确回答问题。

examples.en: She said [that] she would bring her project the next day.
examples.cn: 她说[她]第二天会带来她的项目。

examples.en: I did not know the exam was [that] difficult until I sat it.
examples.cn: 我不知道考试[那么]难，直到我参加才知道。

examples.en: The book [that] she recommended turned out to be fantastic.
examples.cn: 她推荐的[那本]书结果非常精彩。

examples.en: The music was so loud [that] the students could not concentrate.
examples.cn: 音乐[那么]响，以至于学生们无法集中注意力。

words.translation: art. 那
words.definition:
v. i. See Thee.
definite article. A word placed before nouns to limit or
   individualize their meaning.
adv. By that; by how much; by so much; on that account; -- used
   before comparatives; as, the longer we continue in sin, the more
   difficult it is to reform.

examples.en: Please open [the] window — it is getting warm in here.
examples.cn: 请打开[那扇]窗户——这里越来越热了。

examples.en: [The] sun rises in the east every morning.
examples.cn: [太阳]每天早上从东方升起。

examples.sense: art. 定冠词（用于最高级）
examples.en: She is [the] most hardworking student in the whole school.
examples.cn: 她是全校[最]勤奋的学生。

examples.en: She plays [the] piano and [the] violin in the school orchestra.
examples.cn: 她在学校乐团演奏[钢琴]和[小提琴]。

examples.en: [The] teacher is one of the most important people in society.
examples.cn: [教师]是社会上最重要的人之一。

words.translation: n. 戏院, 电影院, 剧场, 全体观众, 戏剧, 戏剧效果, 阶梯式讲堂, 场所
words.definition: n a building where theatrical performances or motion-picture shows can be presented\nn the art of writing and producing plays\nn a region in which active military operations are in progress

examples.en: The school took the students to the [theatre] to watch a Shakespeare play.
examples.cn: 学校带学生去[剧院]观看了一部莎士比亚戏剧。

examples.en: She has been passionate about [theatre] since performing in her first play.
examples.cn: 自从在第一部戏剧中表演以来，她就对[戏剧]充满热情。

examples.en: The patient was taken to the [theatre] for the operation.
examples.cn: 病人被送进[手术室]进行手术。

examples.en: The city's famous [theatre] has been performing plays for over a hundred years.
examples.cn: 该城市著名的[剧场]已经上演戏剧超过一百年了。

examples.en: He preferred going to the [theatre] rather than watching films at home.
examples.cn: 他宁愿去[影院]也不愿在家看电影。

words.translation: pron. 他们的
words.definition: pron. & a. The possessive case of the personal pronoun they;\n   as, their houses; their country.

examples.sense: pron. 他们的/她们的/它们的
examples.en: The students put [their] bags under the desks before the lesson.
examples.cn: 学生们在上课前把[他们的]书包放在桌子下面。

examples.en: The birds returned to [their] nests at sunset.
examples.cn: 鸟儿在日落时回到了[它们的]巢穴。

examples.en: Both teams played well but [their] styles were very different.
examples.cn: 两支队伍都表现出色，但[他们的]风格非常不同。

examples.en: Each student was proud of [their] own work and progress.
examples.cn: 每位学生都为[自己的]工作和进步感到自豪。

examples.en: The children helped [their] parents prepare for the New Year celebration.
examples.cn: 孩子们帮助[他们的]父母为新年庆典做准备。

words.translation: pron. 他们的

examples.en: Our classroom is on the second floor and [theirs] is on the third.
examples.cn: 我们的教室在二楼，[他们的]在三楼。

examples.en: Our project was good, but [theirs] was even more impressive.
examples.cn: 我们的项目不错，但[他们的]更令人印象深刻。

examples.en: She accidentally took the wrong bag — it was [theirs], not hers.
examples.cn: 她不小心拿了错的包——是[他们的]，不是她的。

examples.en: Both teams played well, but the trophy belongs to [theirs].
examples.cn: 两支队伍都表现出色，但奖杯属于[他们]。

examples.en: We finished our work on time; now let us help them with [theirs].
examples.cn: 我们按时完成了我们的工作；现在让我们帮他们完成[他们的]。

words.translation: pron. 他们, 她们, 它们
words.definition: pron. The objective case of they. See They.

examples.sense: pron. 他们，她们，它们（宾格）
examples.en: The teacher called the students and asked [them] to sit down.
examples.cn: 老师叫学生们让[他们]坐下。

examples.en: She made sandwiches and gave [them] to her classmates.
examples.cn: 她做了三明治，分给了[他们]——她的同学们。

examples.en: There are many books on the shelf — please put [them] back after reading.
examples.cn: 书架上有很多书——阅读后请把[它们]放回去。

examples.en: The teacher praised [them] for working so hard during the term.
examples.cn: 老师因[他们]在学期中如此努力而称赞了[他们]。

examples.en: If anyone has lost their key, ask [them] to come to the office.
examples.cn: 如果有人丢失了钥匙，让[他们]来办公室。

words.translation: pron. 他们自己, 她们自己, 它们自己
words.definition: pron. The plural of himself, herself, and itself. See\n   Himself, Herself, Itself.

examples.en: The students cleaned the classroom by [themselves] without being asked.
examples.cn: 学生们主动[自己]打扫了教室，没有人要求。

examples.en: They built the model rocket [themselves] using recycled materials.
examples.cn: 他们用回收材料[亲自]建造了模型火箭。

examples.en: Young children should not be left to do dangerous tasks by [themselves].
examples.cn: 年幼的孩子不应该[独自]被留着做危险的任务。

examples.en: They need to believe in [themselves] in order to succeed.
examples.cn: 他们需要相信[自己]才能取得成功。

examples.en: The team organised the farewell party [themselves] as a surprise.
examples.cn: 团队[自己]组织了告别派对，作为一个惊喜。

words.translation: adv. 然后, 当时\nconj. 然后, 当时\nn. 那时
words.definition:
n. that time; that moment
s. at a specific prior time
r. subsequently or soon afterward (often used as sentence connectors)
r. in that case or as a consequence

examples.en: Finish your homework first and [then] you can watch TV.
examples.cn: 先完成作业，[然后]你可以看电视。

examples.en: He was only seven [then] and did not understand the rules.
examples.cn: 他[那时]才七岁，不懂规则。

examples.en: If you study hard, [then] you will do well in the exam.
examples.cn: 如果你努力学习，[那么]你会在考试中表现好。

examples.en: She spoke Chinese, and [then] switched to English for the foreign students.
examples.cn: 她先说中文，[然后]为外国学生切换到英语。

examples.en: If you are ready, [then] let us start the lesson now.
examples.cn: 如果你准备好了，[那么]我们现在就开始上课吧。

words.translation: adv. 在那里
words.definition:
n. a location other than here; that place
r. in or at that place
r. in that matter
r. to or toward that place; away from the speaker

examples.en: The school library is over [there] — just past the main hall.
examples.cn: 学校图书馆在[那里]——就在大厅旁边。

examples.en: [There] is a new student joining our class tomorrow.
examples.cn: 明天[有]一位新同学加入我们班。

examples.en: She walked [there] in ten minutes because it was not far.
examples.cn: 她步行[到那里]只用了十分钟，因为不远。

examples.en: [There]! I told you she would come first in the race.
examples.cn: [你看]！我告诉过你她会在比赛中得第一名。

examples.en: I disagree with you [there] — I think the rules are fair.
examples.cn: 我在这一点上不同意你——我认为规则是公平的。

words.translation: pron. 这些
words.definition: pron. The plural of this. See This.\npl.  of This

examples.en: [These] books on the shelf are for students in Year Two.
examples.cn: 书架上[这些]书是给二年级学生的。

examples.en: [These] exercises will help you practise the new grammar rules.
examples.cn: [这些]练习将帮助你练习新语法规则。

examples.en: Could you hand out [these] worksheets to everyone in the class?
examples.cn: 你能把[这些]练习题发给班里每个人吗？

examples.en: [These] days, many students use tablets instead of textbooks.
examples.cn: [如今]，许多学生使用平板电脑而不是教科书。

examples.en: Are [these] yours or did they belong to someone else?
examples.cn: [这些]是你的还是属于别人的？

words.translation: pron. 他们, 它们
words.definition: obj. The plural of he, she, or it. They is never used\n   adjectively, but always as a pronoun proper, and sometimes refers to\n   persons without an antecedent expressed.

examples.en: [They] arrived at school early to prepare for the exam.
examples.cn: [他们]早早到学校准备考试。

examples.en: The flowers in the garden are beautiful — [they] bloom every spring.
examples.cn: 花园里的花很美——[它们]每年春天都会盛开。

examples.en: [They] practised the song many times before the school concert.
examples.cn: 在学校音乐会之前，[他们]练习了这首歌很多次。

examples.en: [They] say that practice makes perfect, and I believe it is true.
examples.cn: [人们]说熟能生巧，我相信这是真的。

examples.en: The new student has not arrived yet — I hear [they] are very talented.
examples.cn: 新同学还没到——我听说[他们]非常有才华。

words.translation:
a. 厚的, 粗壮的, 浓的, 迟钝的, 浑浊的, 多雾的, 过分的, 口齿不清的
adv. 厚地, 密地, 浓浓地
n. 最浓处, 最厚处, 最密集处
[计] 暗, 粗线
words.definition:
a. not thin; of a specific thickness or of relatively great extent from one surface to the opposite usually in the smallest of the three solid dimensions
s. having component parts closely crowded together
a. relatively dense in consistency
s. (of darkness) very intense

examples.en: She wrapped herself in a [thick] blanket because it was very cold.
examples.cn: 她裹上了一条[厚]毯子，因为非常冷。

examples.en: The forest was [thick] with trees and difficult to walk through.
examples.cn: 森林里树木[茂密]，很难穿行。

examples.en: The [thick] fog made it impossible to see across the road.
examples.cn: [浓]雾使人无法看清对面的道路。

examples.en: She drew the line with a [thick] marker so it could be seen easily.
examples.cn: 她用[粗]记号笔画线，这样容易看清。

examples.en: He wore [thick] gloves to keep his hands warm in the snow.
examples.cn: 他戴了[厚]手套在雪中保暖。

words.translation:
a. 薄的, 细的, 瘦的, 稀疏的, 稀薄的, 淡的, 弱的, 空洞的
vt. 使变薄, 使变细, 使稀少, 使淡
vi. 变薄, 变细, 变少, 变淡
adv. 薄地, 稀疏地, 微弱地
n. 细小部分
words.definition:
v. lose thickness; become thin or thinner
v. make thin or thinner
a. of relatively small extent from one surface to the opposite or in cross section
a. lacking excess flesh

examples.en: She wore a [thin] jacket and felt cold in the winter wind.
examples.cn: 她穿了一件[薄]夹克，在冬风中感到很冷。

examples.en: He was very [thin] as a child but grew stronger after taking more exercise.
examples.cn: 他小时候非常[瘦]，多锻炼后变得更强壮了。

examples.en: She drew a [thin] line across the page with a sharp pencil.
examples.cn: 她用一支尖铅笔在页面上画了一条[细]线。

examples.en: The mountain air was [thin] and the climbers found it hard to breathe.
examples.cn: 山上空气[稀薄]，登山者发现呼吸困难。

examples.en: The [thin] soup needed more vegetables and seasoning to taste good.
examples.cn: 这碗[稀薄的]汤需要更多蔬菜和调料才好喝。

words.translation: n. 事物, 东西, 物, 用品, 事, 事件, 情况, 行为, 特征
words.definition:
n. a special situation
n. an action
n. a special abstraction
n. an artifact

examples.en: She had a lot of [things] to do before the end of the school term.
examples.cn: 她在学期结束前有很多[事情]要做。

examples.en: He forgot to pack some important [things] for the camping trip.
examples.cn: 他忘记为露营旅行打包一些重要的[物品]。

examples.en: The best [thing] about weekends is having time to relax and read.
examples.cn: 周末最好的[事]就是有时间放松和阅读。

examples.en: The [thing] is, she studied very hard but still did not pass the test.
examples.cn: [问题是]，她学习很努力但还是没通过测试。

examples.en: Learning new [things] every day keeps your mind active and curious.
examples.cn: 每天学习新[事物]使你的思维保持活跃和好奇。

words.translation:
vt. 想, 考虑, 想起, 想像, 打算, 认为
vi. 思考, 料想
n. 想法
a. 思想的
words.definition:
n. an instance of deliberate thinking
v. judge or regard; look upon; judge
v. expect, believe, or suppose
v. use or exercise the mind or one's power of reason in order to make inferences, decisions, or arrive at a solution or judgments

examples.en: I [think] the answer to this question is twenty-four.
examples.cn: 我[认为]这道题的答案是二十四。

examples.en: She [thought] carefully before giving her answer to the teacher.
examples.cn: 她在给老师答案之前仔细[思考]了一番。

examples.en: [Think] about what you want to do before making a decision.
examples.cn: 在做决定之前[考虑]一下你想做什么。

examples.en: I cannot [think] of a better way to solve this problem.
examples.cn: 我想不出比这更好的解决问题的方法了。

examples.en: When I [think] of my primary school, I always smile.
examples.cn: 当我[回想]小学时，我总是微笑。

words.translation: num. 第三, 三分之一\n[机] 第三; 第三的
words.definition:
n. following the second position in an ordering or series
n. the musical interval between one note and another three notes away from it
s. coming next after the second and just before the fourth in position
r. in the third place

examples.en: She came in [third] place in the school running competition.
examples.cn: 她在学校跑步比赛中获得了[第三]名。

examples.en: March is the [third] month of the year.
examples.cn: 三月是一年中的[第三]个月。

examples.en: He ate a [third] of the pizza and saved the rest for later.
examples.cn: 他吃了三分之一的披萨，把剩下的留着以后吃。

examples.en: Their classroom is on the [third] floor of the school building.
examples.cn: 他们的教室在学校楼的[第三]层。

examples.en: Winning [third] place is still a great achievement to be proud of.
examples.cn: 获得[第三名]仍然是值得骄傲的伟大成就。

words.translation: a. 口渴的, 渴望的, 干燥的
words.definition: s. needing moisture\na. feeling a need or desire to drink\ns. able to take in large quantities of moisture

examples.en: She felt very [thirsty] after running in the hot sun for an hour.
examples.cn: 在烈日下跑了一个小时后，她感到非常[口渴]。

examples.en: He is [thirsty] for knowledge and reads every book he can find.
examples.cn: 他[渴望]知识，读他能找到的每一本书。

examples.en: The students were [thirsty] after the long PE lesson.
examples.cn: 长时间的体育课后，学生们都[口渴]了。

examples.en: The [thirsty] plants in the garden needed watering immediately.
examples.cn: 花园里[干渴的]植物需要立即浇水。

examples.en: She was [thirsty] for success and worked harder than anyone else.
examples.cn: 她[渴望]成功，比其他人都更加努力工作。

words.translation: num. 十三, 十三个
words.definition: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of twelve and one\ns. being one more than twelve

examples.en: She will be [thirteen] years old on her next birthday.
examples.cn: 她下次生日就满[十三]岁了。

examples.en: There are [thirteen] students in the advanced art class.
examples.cn: 高级美术班有[十三]名学生。

examples.en: He scored [thirteen] points in the basketball match yesterday.
examples.cn: 他昨天在篮球比赛中得了[十三]分。

examples.en: The school play has [thirteen] characters with speaking roles.
examples.cn: 学校话剧有[十三]个有台词的角色。

examples.en: She can count from one to [thirteen] in four different languages.
examples.cn: 她能用四种不同语言从一数到[十三]。

words.translation: num. 三十, 三十个
words.definition: n. the cardinal number that is the product of ten and three\ns. being ten more than twenty

examples.en: The exam lasts for [thirty] minutes and has twenty questions.
examples.cn: 考试持续[三十]分钟，有二十道题。

examples.en: She reads for [thirty] minutes every evening before going to sleep.
examples.cn: 她每天晚上睡前阅读[三十]分钟。

examples.en: The teacher has been working at this school for [thirty] years.
examples.cn: 这位老师在这所学校工作了[三十]年。

examples.en: There are [thirty] students in our class this school year.
examples.cn: 本学年我们班有[三十]名学生。

examples.en: The bus journey to the museum takes about [thirty] minutes.
examples.cn: 乘公共汽车去博物馆大约需要[三十]分钟。

words.translation: pron. 这, 本\na. 这, 本\nadv. 这么
words.definition:
pron. & a. As a demonstrative pronoun, this denotes something
   that is present or near in place or time, or something just mentioned,
   or that is just about to be mentioned.
pron. & a. As an adjective, this has the same demonstrative
   force as the pronoun, but is followed by a noun; as, this book; this
   way to town.

examples.en: [This] book is very interesting — I recommend it to everyone.
examples.cn: [这]本书非常有趣——我向所有人推荐。

examples.en: We have a school trip [this] Friday that everyone is excited about.
examples.cn: [这]周五我们有一次令所有人兴奋的学校旅行。

examples.en: [This] is my favourite subject because the teacher is very inspiring.
examples.cn: [这]是我最喜欢的科目，因为老师非常有启发性。

examples.en: I did not know the weather would be [this] cold today.
examples.cn: 我不知道今天天气会[这么]冷。

examples.en: [This] generation of students uses technology in new and exciting ways.
examples.cn: [这]一代学生以新颖而令人兴奋的方式使用科技。

words.translation: pron. 那些
words.definition: pron. The plural of that. See That.

examples.en: [Those] students at the back of the class need to pay more attention.
examples.cn: 坐在教室后面的[那些]学生需要更加注意听讲。

examples.en: Could you pass me [those] books on the top shelf, please?
examples.cn: 你能把[那些]书架最上层的书递给我吗？

examples.en: [Those] were the happiest days of her school life.
examples.cn: [那些]是她学校生活中最快乐的日子。

examples.en: [Those] who work hard will always find a way to succeed.
examples.cn: [那些]努力工作的人总会找到成功的方法。

examples.en: She remembered [those] kind words for the rest of her life.
examples.cn: 她余生都记得[那些]善意的话语。

words.translation: adv. 然而, 可是\nconj. 虽然, 纵然
words.definition: r. (postpositive) however

examples.en: She kept smiling [though] she was feeling very nervous inside.
examples.cn: [尽管]内心非常紧张，她还是保持微笑。

examples.en: He finished the race [though] his leg was hurting badly.
examples.cn: [虽然]腿很疼，他还是跑完了比赛。

examples.en: The film was long. The ending was great, [though].
examples.cn: 这部电影很长。不过，结局很精彩。

examples.en: [Though] she was new to the school, she made friends quickly.
examples.cn: [尽管]她刚转来这所学校，她很快就交到了朋友。

words.translation: prep. 到, 向, 趋于\nadv. 向前
words.definition:
prep. The preposition to primarily indicates approach and arrival,
   motion made in the direction of a place or thing and attaining it,
   access; and also, motion or tendency without arrival; movement toward;
   -- opposed to from.
prep. Hence, it indicates motion, course, or tendency toward a
   time, a state or condition, an aim, or anything capable of being
   regarded as a limit to a tendency, movement, or action; as, he is going
   to a trade; he is rising to wealth and honor.
prep. In a very general way, and with innumerable varieties of
   application, to connects transitive verbs with their remoter or
   indirect object, and adjectives, nouns, and neuter or passive verbs
   with a following noun which limits their action. Its sphere verges upon
   that of for, but it contains less the idea of design or appropriation;
   as, these remarks were addressed to a large audience; let us keep this
   seat to ourselves; a substance sweet to the taste; an event painful to
   the mind; duty to God and to our parents; a dislike to spirituous
   liquor.
prep. As sign of the infinitive, to had originally the use of last
   defined, governing the infinitive as a verbal noun, and connecting it
   as indirect object with a preceding verb or adjective; thus, ready to
   go, i.e., ready unto going; good to eat, i.e., good for eating; I do my
   utmost to lead my life pleasantly. But it has come to be the almost
   constant prefix to the infinitive, even in situations where it has no
   prepositional meaning, as where the infinitive is direct object or
   subject; thus, I love to learn, i.e., I love learning; to die for one's
   country is noble, i.e., the dying for one's country. Where the
   infinitive denotes the design or purpose, good usage formerly allowed
   the prefixing of for to the to; as, what went ye out for see? (Matt.
   xi. 8).
prep. In many phrases, and in connection with many other words, to
   has a pregnant meaning, or is used elliptically.
prep. Extent; limit; degree of comprehension; inclusion as far as;
   as, they met us to the number of three hundred.
prep. Effect; end; consequence; as, the prince was flattered to
   his ruin; he engaged in a war to his cost; violent factions exist to
   the prejudice of the state.
prep. Apposition; connection; antithesis; opposition; as, they
   engaged hand to hand.
prep. Accord; adaptation; as, an occupation to his taste; she has
   a husband to her mind.
prep. Comparison; as, three is to nine as nine is to twenty-seven;
   it is ten to one that you will offend him.
prep. Addition; union; accumulation.
prep. Accompaniment; as, she sang to his guitar; they danced to
   the music of a piano.
prep. Character; condition of being; purpose subserved or office
   filled.

examples.en: He has [tons] of energy and never seems to get tired.
examples.cn: 他精力[充沛]，似乎永远不会疲倦。

words.translation: n. 舌, 语言能力, 讲话方式, 语言\nvt. 舔, 斥责, 发...的音\nvi. 使用舌头, 吹管乐器
words.definition:
n. a mobile mass of muscular tissue covered with mucous membrane and located in the oral cavity
n. any long thin projection that is transient
n. a manner of speaking
n. the tongue of certain animals used as meat

examples.cn: 医生让他张开嘴，伸出[舌头]。

examples.cn: 她的母[语]是粤语，但她也能流利地说普通话。

examples.en: She burned her [tongue] on the hot soup because she ate too fast.
examples.cn: 她因为吃得太快，被热汤烫了[舌头]。

examples.cn: 学习一门外[语]为年轻人打开了许多大门。

examples.cn: 他运动鞋的[鞋舌]滑到了一边。

words.translation: n. 今晚, 今夜\nadv. 今晚, 今夜
words.definition: n. the present or immediately coming night\nr. during the night of the present day

examples.cn: 学校话剧[今晚]七点在大厅上演。

examples.cn: [今晚]她要复习所有笔记，为明天的考试做准备。

examples.cn: [今晚]会很冷，所以记得关上窗户。

examples.en: [Tonight]'s homework is to read chapter five and answer the questions.
examples.cn: [今晚]的作业是阅读第五章并回答问题。

examples.en: She cannot come to the party [tonight] because she is not feeling well.
examples.cn: 她[今晚]不能来参加聚会，因为她感觉不舒服。

words.translation: adv. 也, 非常, 太

examples.en: She likes science and her brother does [too].
examples.cn: 她喜欢科学，她哥哥[也]是。

examples.en: The bag was [too] heavy to carry up the stairs by herself.
examples.cn: 这个包[太]重了，她一个人搬不上楼梯。

examples.en: He finished his homework and tidied his room, [too].
examples.cn: 他完成了作业，[也]整理了房间。

examples.cn: 不要[太]担心考试——你已经准备充分了。

examples.cn: 今天学校食堂的食物[太]好吃了，让人忍不住多吃。

words.translation: n. 工具, 机床, 傀儡\nvt. 用工具加工\nvi. 使用工具
words.definition:
n. an implement used in the practice of a vocation
v. drive
v. furnish with tools

examples.cn: 铅笔和直尺是几何课绘图的必备[工具]。

examples.cn: 阅读是扩展知识的有力[手段]。

examples.cn: 木匠用了许多不同的[工具]来制作书架。

examples.en: The internet is an excellent [tool] for research and learning.
examples.cn: 互联网是研究和学习的出色[工具]。

examples.en: He felt like a [tool] being used by others rather than a true teammate.
examples.cn: 他感觉自己像是被别人利用的[工具]，而不是真正的队友。

words.translation: n. 牙齿, 齿状物, 爱好\nvt. 装以齿, 将...切成齿状\nvi. 啮合
words.definition:
n. hard bonelike structures in the jaws of vertebrates; used for biting and chewing or for attack and defense
n. something resembling the tooth of an animal

n. a means of enforcement

examples.cn: 她六岁时掉了第一颗[牙齿]。

examples.cn: 每天刷两次[牙]以保持健康洁净。

examples.cn: 牙医告诉她每天晚上要用牙线清洁[牙齿]。

examples.cn: 锯子的[锯齿]非常锋利，很容易锯穿木头。

examples.cn: 他咬硬糖时崩了一颗[牙]。

examples.cn: 他因为[牙疼]无法在课堂上集中注意力。

examples.cn: 吃太多糖果导致她[牙痛]。

examples.cn: [牙疼]让他彻夜难眠，直到他去看了牙医。

examples.cn: [牙痛]是有问题需要治疗的信号。

words.translation: n. 牙刷

examples.cn: 她从药店买了一把软毛的新[牙刷]。

examples.cn: 你应该每三个月更换一次[牙刷]。

examples.cn: 他去学校旅行时忘记打包[牙刷]了。

examples.cn: 使用适量牙膏的[牙刷]效果最好。

examples.cn: 她总是在书包里备一把备用[牙刷]以防万一。

words.translation: n. 牙膏\n[化] 牙膏
words.definition: n. a dentifrice in the form of a paste

examples.cn: 她在牙刷上挤了少量[牙膏]。

examples.cn: 儿童应使用含氟[牙膏]保护牙齿。

examples.cn: 他的[牙膏]用完了，不得不去超市再买。

examples.cn: [牙膏]的薄荷味帮助她在早晨清醒过来。

examples.cn: 每天使用[牙膏]两次有助于预防蛀牙和牙龈疾病。

words.translation:
