examples.cn: 我们乘[火车]从北京到上海花了五个小时。

examples.en: The coach [trains] the team every morning before school.
examples.cn: 教练每天早上在上学前[训练]球队。

examples.en: She is [training] to become a professional swimmer.
examples.cn: 她正在接受[训练]，立志成为一名职业游泳运动员。

examples.en: A [train] of thought led him to the solution.
examples.cn: 一[连串]的思路引导他找到了解决方案。

examples.en: The photographer [trained] his camera on the bird.
examples.cn: 摄影师将相机[对准]了那只鸟。

words.translation: n. 训练, 培养\n[医] 训练
words.definition: n. activity leading to skilled behavior

examples.en: The athletes go through months of [training] before the competition.
examples.cn: 运动员在比赛前要经过数月的[训练]。

examples.en: She attended a [training] course to improve her computer skills.
examples.cn: 她参加了一个[培训]课程来提高电脑技能。

examples.en: Daily [training] helped him build strength and endurance.
examples.cn: 每日[训练]帮助他增强了力量和耐力。

examples.en: Teacher [training] programs help prepare people for the classroom.
examples.cn: 教师[培训]项目帮助人们为课堂教学做好准备。

examples.en: The new employee is still in [training] and learning the job.
examples.cn: 这名新员工仍在[培训]中，正在学习工作。

words.translation: vt. 翻译, 解释, 转化, 转变为, 调动\nvi. 翻译, 被译\n[计] 转换
words.definition:
v. restate (words) from one language into another language
v. change from one form or medium into another
v. bring to a certain spiritual state
v. change the position of (figures or bodies) in space without rotation

examples.en: Can you [translate] this sentence from English into Chinese?
examples.cn: 你能把这个句子从英语[翻译]成中文吗？

examples.en: She [translated] the speech for the foreign guests.
examples.cn: 她为外国客人[翻译]了这篇演讲。

examples.en: Hard work doesn't always [translate] into success immediately.
examples.cn: 努力工作不总是立即[转化]为成功。

examples.en: The teacher [translated] the difficult concept into simple language.
examples.cn: 老师把这个难懂的概念[转化]为简单的语言。

examples.en: The novel was [translated] into more than twenty languages.
examples.cn: 这部小说被[翻译]成二十多种语言。

words.translation: n. 旅行, 游历, 行进\nvi. 旅行, 行进, 移动, 被传播\nvt. 旅行, 通过, 使移动
words.definition:
n. the act of going from one place to another
v. change location; move, travel, or proceed, also metaphorically
v. undertake a journey or trip
v. make a trip for pleasure

examples.en: She loves to [travel] to new places during her holidays.
examples.cn: 她喜欢在假期[旅行]去新地方。

examples.en: [Travel] broadens your mind and helps you understand different cultures.
examples.cn: [旅行]开阔视野，帮助你了解不同文化。

examples.en: News [travels] fast in the age of the internet.
examples.cn: 在互联网时代，消息[传播]得很快。

examples.en: Light [travels] faster than sound.
examples.cn: 光的[传播]速度比声音快。

examples.en: His [travels] took him to many countries in Asia and Europe.
examples.cn: 他的[旅途]带他去了亚洲和欧洲的许多国家。

words.translation: n. 宝物, 财富\nvt. 珍爱, 重视, 秘藏
words.definition: n. accumulated wealth in the form of money or jewels etc.\nn. any possession that is highly valued by its owner\nn. a collection of precious things

examples.en: The pirates buried their [treasure] on a remote island.
examples.cn: 海盗把他们的[宝藏]埋在一个偏远的岛上。

examples.en: This old photo is a [treasure] that she keeps close to her heart.
examples.cn: 这张旧照片是她珍藏在心中的[珍宝]。

examples.en: He [treasures] every moment he spends with his family.
examples.cn: 他[珍惜]与家人共度的每一刻。

examples.en: The museum displays many national [treasures] from ancient times.
examples.cn: 博物馆展示了许多古代[国宝]。

examples.en: She [treasures] her friendship with her childhood best friend.
examples.cn: 她[珍视]与儿时最好朋友的友谊。

words.translation: n. 治疗, 待遇, 处理\n[医] 疗法, 治疗; 处理
words.definition: n. care provided to improve a situation (especially medical procedures or applications that are intended to relieve illness or injury)\nn. the management of someone or something\nn. a manner of dealing with something artistically

examples.en: The doctor recommended a new [treatment] for the patient's illness.
examples.cn: 医生为病人推荐了一种新的[治疗]方法。

examples.en: All students deserve equal [treatment] regardless of their background.
examples.cn: 所有学生无论背景如何都应受到平等[对待]。

examples.en: The [treatment] of the problem was very professional.
examples.cn: 对这个问题的[处理]方式非常专业。

examples.en: She is receiving [treatment] at the local hospital.
examples.cn: 她正在当地医院接受[治疗]。

examples.en: The [treatment] of water makes it safe for people to drink.
examples.cn: 对水的[处理]使其适合人们饮用。

words.translation: n. 树, 木料, 树状物\nvt. 把...赶上树\n[计] 树; DOS外部命令:显示指定磁盘驱动器的目录结构
words.definition:
n. a tall perennial woody plant having a main trunk and branches forming a distinct elevated crown; includes both gymnosperms and angiosperms
n. a figure that branches from a single root
n. English actor and theatrical producer noted for his lavish productions of Shakespeare (1853-1917)
v. plant with trees

examples.en: The children climbed the big [tree] in the park.
examples.cn: 孩子们爬上了公园里那棵大[树]。

examples.en: Apple [trees] blossom beautifully in spring.
examples.cn: 苹果[树]在春天开出美丽的花。

examples.en: She drew a family [tree] to show her relatives.
examples.cn: 她画了一棵家谱[树]来展示她的亲戚。

examples.en: Many [trees] were cut down to build the new houses.
examples.cn: 许多[树木]被砍倒用来建新房子。

examples.en: They decorated the Christmas [tree] with colorful lights and ornaments.
examples.cn: 他们用彩灯和装饰品装饰了圣诞[树]。

words.translation: n. 旅行, 绊倒, 摔倒, 失足, 差错, 旅程\nvt. 使跌倒, 使犯错, 使失败\nvi. 轻快地走, 绊倒, 失误, 犯错, 结巴, 旅行, 远足
words.definition:
n. a journey for some purpose (usually including the return)
n. a hallucinatory experience induced by drugs
n. an exciting or stimulating experience
n. a light or nimble tread

examples.en: We went on a school [trip] to the science museum last week.
examples.cn: 上周我们去科学博物馆进行了一次学校[旅行]。

examples.en: The [trip] from our city to the coast takes about three hours.
examples.cn: 从我们城市到海岸的[旅程]大约需要三个小时。

examples.en: He [tripped] over a stone on the path and fell down.
examples.cn: 他在小路上被一块石头[绊倒]了。

examples.en: She [tripped] lightly down the stairs in her new shoes.
examples.cn: 她穿着新鞋轻快地跑下楼梯。

examples.en: One small [trip] in his speech made the audience laugh.
examples.cn: 演讲中一个小小的[失误]让观众笑了起来。

words.translation: n. 烦恼, 麻烦, 困难, 动乱, 故障\nvt. 困扰, 麻烦, 使烦恼, 折磨\nvi. 烦恼, 费心
words.definition:
n. a source of difficulty
n. an event causing distress or pain
n. an effort that is inconvenient
n. an unwanted pregnancy

examples.en: He got into [trouble] at school for talking in class.
examples.cn: 他因在课堂上讲话而在学校惹上了[麻烦]。

examples.en: The mechanic found the [trouble] with the car engine quickly.
examples.cn: 机械师很快找到了汽车发动机的[问题]。

examples.en: I'm sorry to [trouble] you, but could you help me?
examples.cn: 对不起[打扰]您了，您能帮助我吗？

examples.en: She shared her [troubles] with her best friend.
examples.cn: 她向最好的朋友倾诉了她的[烦恼]。

examples.en: The bad news [troubled] him for days.
examples.cn: 这个坏消息让他[担忧]了好几天。

words.translation: pl. 裤子, 长裤
words.definition: n (usually in the plural) a garment extending from the waist to the knee or ankle, covering each leg separately\nn a garment (or part of a garment) designed for or relating to trousers

examples.en: He wore smart black [trousers] to the interview.
examples.cn: 他穿着整洁的黑色[裤子]去面试。

examples.en: She bought a new pair of [trousers] at the department store.
examples.cn: 她在百货公司买了一条新[长裤]。

examples.en: The mechanic wore dirty [trousers] covered in oil stains.
examples.cn: 机械师穿着满是油渍的脏[裤子]。

examples.en: He changed into his casual [trousers] after coming home from work.
examples.cn: 他下班回家后换上了休闲[长裤]。

examples.en: These [trousers] are too long and need to be shortened.
examples.cn: 这条[裤子]太长了，需要改短一些。

words.translation: n. 卡车, 货车, 对...进行交易, 来往, 实物工资, (供应市场的)蔬菜, 废物, 废话\nvt. 对...进行交易, 交往, 以卡车运输\nvi. 驾驶卡车, 以物易物
words.definition: n. an automotive vehicle suitable for hauling\nv. convey (goods etc.) by truck

examples.en: A large [truck] delivered the furniture to our new apartment.
examples.cn: 一辆大[卡车]把家具送到了我们的新公寓。

examples.en: The [truck] driver worked long hours to meet the deadline.
examples.cn: [卡车]司机为了赶上截止日期而长时间工作。

examples.en: Farmers often use pick-up [trucks] to carry crops.
examples.cn: 农民经常使用皮卡[卡车]运载庄稼。

examples.en: The fire [truck] arrived at the scene within minutes.
examples.cn: 消防[车]几分钟内就到达了现场。

examples.en: The goods were [trucked] across the country to the warehouse.
examples.cn: 货物被[卡车运送]到全国各地的仓库。

words.translation: a. 真实的, 正确的, 忠诚的, 可靠的, 纯粹的, 正式的\nn. 真实, 准确\nadv. 真实地, 准确地
words.definition:
n. proper alignment; the property possessed by something that is in correct or proper alignment
v. make level, square, balanced, or concentric
a. consistent with fact or reality; not false
s. accurately placed or thrown

examples.en: Is it [true] that you won first prize in the contest?
examples.cn: 你在比赛中获得了一等奖，这是[真的]吗？

examples.en: A [true] friend will stand by you in difficult times.
examples.cn: [真正的]朋友会在困难时期支持你。

examples.sense: adj. 准确的；符合事实的
examples.en: Everything he said about the accident was [true].
examples.cn: 他说的关于事故的一切都是[真实的]。

examples.en: She is a [true] artist who puts her heart into every painting.
examples.cn: 她是一位[真正的]艺术家，把心血倾注在每幅画上。

examples.en: The arrow flew [true] and hit the center of the target.
examples.cn: 箭飞得[准确]，击中了目标的中心。

words.translation:
n. 信任, 信赖, 相信, 受托, 职责, 信心, 托拉斯
a. 信托的, 托拉斯的
vt. 信赖, 信任, 相信, 盼望, 赊卖给
vi. 相信, 信赖, 依靠
[计] 委托, 信任
words.definition:
n. something (as property) held by one party (the trustee) for the benefit of another (the beneficiary)
n. the trait of believing in the honesty and reliability of others
n. a consortium of independent organizations formed to limit competition by controlling the production and distribution of a product or service
v. have confidence or faith in

examples.en: You can [trust] him to keep your secret safe.
examples.cn: 你可以[信任]他来保守你的秘密。

examples.en: Building [trust] between students and teachers takes time.
examples.cn: 在学生和老师之间建立[信任]需要时间。

examples.en: She [trusts] her instincts when making difficult decisions.
examples.cn: 她在做困难决定时[依靠]自己的直觉。

examples.en: The money was held in [trust] for the children until they grew up.
examples.cn: 这笔钱被[托管]给孩子们，直到他们长大。

examples.en: I [trust] that you will arrive on time for the meeting.
examples.cn: 我[希望]你能准时到达会议。

words.translation: n. 事实, 实情\n[法] 真实, 真相, 事实
words.definition:
n. a fact that has been verified
n. conformity to reality or actuality
n. a true statement
n. United States abolitionist and feminist who was freed from slavery and became a leading advocate of the abolition of slavery and for the rights of women (1797-1883)

examples.en: Please tell me the [truth] about what happened.
examples.cn: 请告诉我发生了什么事的[真相]。

examples.en: Scientists search for [truth] through careful experiments and observation.
examples.cn: 科学家通过仔细的实验和观察来寻找[真理]。

examples.en: In [truth], he had never been to that city before.
examples.cn: [实际上]，他以前从未去过那个城市。

examples.en: The [truth] is that we don't have enough time to finish the project.
examples.cn: [事实]是我们没有足够时间完成这个项目。

examples.en: Telling the [truth] is always better than telling a lie.
examples.cn: 说[真话]总比撒谎好。

words.translation: n. 尝试, 试验, 审理, 审判\nvt. 试, 尝试, 试验, 考验, 审问, 提炼\nvi. 尝试, 试图
words.definition:
v. make an effort or attempt
v. give pain or trouble to
v. test the limits of
v. melt (fat or lard) in order to separate out impurities

examples.en: She [tried] her best to solve the difficult math problem.
examples.cn: 她[尽力]解决这道难题。

examples.en: You should [try] this new restaurant — the food is amazing.
examples.cn: 你应该[试试]这家新餐厅——食物很好吃。

examples.en: It was a good [try], even though he didn't succeed.
examples.cn: 虽然他没有成功，但这是一次很好的[尝试]。

examples.en: The man was [tried] in court for theft.
examples.cn: 那名男子在法庭上因盗窃罪受[审]。

examples.en: [Try] to speak English as often as possible to improve your skills.
examples.cn: [尽量]尽可能多地说英语以提高你的技能。

words.translation: n. 星期二
words.definition: n. the third day of the week; the second working day

examples.en: Our English class meets every [Tuesday] and Thursday.
examples.cn: 我们的英语课每[周二]和周四上课。

examples.en: She has a doctor's appointment on [Tuesday] afternoon.
examples.cn: 她[周二]下午有个医生预约。

examples.en: The exam is scheduled for next [Tuesday].
examples.cn: 考试定在下[周二]。

examples.en: On [Tuesdays] he usually goes to the library after school.
examples.cn: 每[周二]他通常在放学后去图书馆。

examples.sense: n. 星期二（历史上的某天）
examples.en: The meeting took place on a [Tuesday] in March last year.
examples.cn: 会议是在去年三月的一个[周二]举行的。

words.translation: n. 转弯, 转动, 旋转, 翻转, 一圈, 顺次, 改动, 变化, 性格, 特色, 形状, 转折\nvt. 使旋转, 转弯, 转动, 使转向, 驱赶, 阻挡, 兑换, 改写, 使作对, 绕过, 使流通\nvi. 转动, 转弯, 转向, 翻转, 回转, 改变, 转身, 变成, 变质, 晕眩, 易脱手
words.definition:
n. the act of changing or reversing the direction of the course
n. (game) the activity of doing something in an agreed succession
n. an unforeseen development
n. the act of turning away or in the opposite direction

examples.en: [Turn] left at the traffic lights to reach the school.
examples.cn: 在交通灯处向左[转]就能到达学校。

examples.en: The leaves [turn] yellow and red in autumn.
examples.cn: 树叶在秋天[变成]黄色和红色。

examples.en: It's your [turn] to wash the dishes tonight.
examples.cn: 今晚轮到你[洗]碗了。

examples.en: Please [turn] to page twenty in your textbook.
examples.cn: 请[翻]到课本第二十页。

examples.en: Take the first [turn] on the right and you'll see the park.
examples.cn: 在第一个[转弯]处向右转，你就会看到公园。

words.translation: 电视\n[计] 电视, 转移向量
words.definition: n broadcasting visual images of stationary or moving objects\nn an electronic device that receives television signals and displays them on a screen

examples.en: They watched a nature documentary on [TV] last night.
examples.cn: 他们昨晚在[电视]上看了一部自然纪录片。

examples.en: There is nothing interesting on [TV] tonight.
examples.cn: 今晚[电视]上没有什么有趣的节目。

examples.en: We bought a new flat-screen [TV] for the living room.
examples.cn: 我们为客厅买了一台新的平板[电视]。

examples.en: The news was broadcast on [TV] stations across the country.
examples.cn: 这条新闻在全国各[电视]台播出。

examples.en: Children should not spend too much time in front of the [TV].
examples.cn: 孩子们不应该在[电视]前花太多时间。

words.translation: num. 第十二, 十二分之一
words.definition: n. position 12 in a countable series of things\ns. coming next after the eleventh and just before the thirteenth in position

examples.sense: num. 第十二；十二分之一
examples.en: Her birthday is on the [twelfth] of May.
examples.cn: 她的生日是五月[十二]日。

examples.en: He finished in [twelfth] place in the running race.
examples.cn: 他在跑步比赛中获得了第[十二]名。

examples.en: One [twelfth] of the year is spent in the month of January.
examples.cn: 一年的十二[分之一]是在一月份度过的。

examples.en: The meeting is set for the [twelfth] of next month.
examples.cn: 会议定在下个月[十二]号。

examples.en: She was the [twelfth] student to arrive at school that morning.
examples.cn: 那天早上她是第[十二]个到达学校的学生。

words.translation: num. 十二, 十二个
words.definition: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of eleven and one\ns. denoting a quantity consisting of 12 items or units

examples.en: There are [twelve] months in a year.
examples.cn: 一年有[十二]个月。

examples.en: She started learning the piano when she was [twelve] years old.
examples.cn: 她[十二]岁时开始学习钢琴。

examples.en: The clock struck [twelve] at midnight.
examples.cn: 时钟在午夜敲响了[十二]下。

examples.en: He bought [twelve] eggs at the market this morning.
examples.cn: 他今天早上在市场买了[十二]个鸡蛋。

examples.en: Lunch break starts at [twelve] o'clock every day.
examples.cn: 午休时间每天[十二]点开始。

words.translation: num. 第二十, 二十分之一
words.definition: n. position 20 in a countable series of things\ns. coming next after the nineteenth in position

examples.sense: ord. 第二十；二十分之一
examples.en: Today is the [twentieth] of October, a national holiday.
examples.cn: 今天是十月[二十]日，是个国家假日。

examples.en: She was the [twentieth] person to sign up for the competition.
examples.cn: 她是第[二十]个报名参加比赛的人。

examples.en: One [twentieth] of the students received scholarships.
examples.cn: 二十[分之一]的学生获得了奖学金。

examples.en: The project deadline is the [twentieth] of this month.
examples.cn: 项目截止日期是本月[二十]号。

examples.en: Many important inventions happened in the [twentieth] century.
examples.cn: 许多重要发明发生在[二十]世纪。

words.translation: num. 二十, 二十个
words.definition: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of nineteen and one\ns. denoting a quantity consisting of 20 items or units

examples.en: There are [twenty] students in our English class.
examples.cn: 我们英语班有[二十]名学生。

examples.en: She went to university when she was [twenty] years old.
examples.cn: 她[二十]岁时上了大学。

examples.en: He saved [twenty] yuan each week to buy a new book.
examples.cn: 他每周存[二十]元买新书。

examples.en: The bus departs at [twenty] minutes past eight.
examples.cn: 公共汽车在八点[二十]分出发。

examples.en: Life in the [twenties] of the last century was very different from today.
examples.cn: 上世纪[二十]年代的生活与今天截然不同。

words.translation: adv. 两次, 两倍
words.definition: r. two times

examples.en: I have read this book [twice] and I still enjoy it.
examples.cn: 我已经读了这本书[两次]，我仍然很喜欢它。

examples.en: He earns [twice] as much money as his sister.
examples.cn: 他赚的钱是他姐姐的[两倍]。

examples.en: She goes to the gym [twice] a week to stay fit.
examples.cn: 她每周去健身房[两次]来保持身材。

examples.en: Think [twice] before you make an important decision.
examples.cn: 在做重要决定之前要[三思]。

examples.en: The teacher explained the grammar rule [twice] for the students.
examples.cn: 老师为学生[两次]解释了语法规则。

words.translation: num. 二, 二个
words.definition: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one or a numeral representing this number\ns. being one more than one

examples.en: I have [two] brothers and one sister.
examples.cn: 我有[两]个哥哥和一个姐姐。

examples.en: The library closes at [two] o'clock in the afternoon.
examples.cn: 图书馆下午[两]点关门。

examples.en: It takes [two] to play a game of table tennis.
examples.cn: 打乒乓球需要[两]个人。

examples.en: Platform [two] is where the train to Shanghai departs.
examples.cn: 开往上海的火车从第[二]站台出发。

examples.en: The baby is only [two] years old but can already say many words.
examples.cn: 这个婴儿只有[两]岁，但已经会说很多单词了。

words.translation: a. 丑陋的, 邪恶的, 险恶的, 不祥的\nn. 丑陋的人(或物)
words.definition: a. displeasing to the senses

examples.en: The [ugly] duckling in the story grew up to be a beautiful swan.
examples.cn: 故事中那只[丑]小鸭长大后变成了一只美丽的天鹅。

examples.sense: adj. 不好看的；令人不快的
examples.en: He thought the old building was [ugly] compared to the new ones.
examples.cn: 他认为那栋旧楼与新楼相比很[难看]。

examples.sense: adj. 令人厌恶的；险恶的
examples.en: The situation turned [ugly] when people started arguing loudly.
examples.cn: 当人们开始大声争吵时，局面变得[难看]起来。

examples.en: Dark clouds gathered, signaling [ugly] weather ahead.
examples.cn: 乌云聚集，预示着前方天气[恶劣]。

examples.en: Littering is an [ugly] habit that harms the environment.
examples.cn: 乱扔垃圾是一种有害环境的[不雅]习惯。

words.translation: n. 伞, 雨伞, 保护伞\na. 伞的, 包罗万象的\nvt. 用伞遮掩
words.definition:
n. a lightweight handheld collapsible canopy
n. a formation of military planes maintained over ground operations or targets
n. having the function of uniting a group of similar things
s. covering or applying simultaneously to a number of similar items or elements or groups

examples.en: Don't forget to bring your [umbrella] — it might rain today.
examples.cn: 别忘了带[雨伞]——今天可能会下雨。

examples.en: She sat under a beach [umbrella] to protect herself from the sun.
examples.cn: 她坐在沙滩[伞]下遮阳。

examples.en: The organization serves as an [umbrella] for many smaller charities.
examples.cn: 这个组织充当许多小型慈善机构的[保护伞]。

examples.en: He kept a small folding [umbrella] in his school bag.
examples.cn: 他在书包里放了一把小折叠[雨伞]。

examples.en: She opened her [umbrella] as soon as the rain started.
examples.cn: 雨一开始，她就打开了[雨伞]。

words.translation: n. 叔父, 伯父, 姨丈
words.definition: n. the brother of your father or mother; the husband of your aunt\nn. a source of help and advice and encouragement

examples.en: My [uncle] taught me how to ride a bicycle when I was young.
examples.cn: 我小时候，[叔叔]教我骑自行车。

examples.en: Her [uncle] on her mother's side lives in Shanghai.
examples.cn: 她母亲那边的[舅舅]住在上海。

examples.en: [Uncle] Wang is my father's older brother and visits us every spring.
examples.cn: [王伯伯]是我父亲的哥哥，每年春天都来看我们。

examples.en: The children called the friendly neighbor [uncle] as a sign of respect.
examples.cn: 孩子们亲切地叫这位友善的邻居[叔叔]以示尊重。

examples.en: My [uncle] married my aunt ten years ago and they have two kids.
examples.cn: 我[姑父]十年前和我姑姑结婚，他们有两个孩子。

words.translation: prep. 在...之下, 低于\na. 下面的, 从属的\nadv. 在下面
words.definition:
s. lower in rank, power, or authority
r. down to defeat, death, or ruin
r. through a range downward
r. into unconsciousness

examples.en: The cat is hiding [under] the bed.
examples.cn: 猫藏在床[下面]。

examples.en: Children [under] twelve can enter the museum for free.
examples.cn: 十二岁[以下]的儿童可以免费进入博物馆。

examples.en: The team performed well [under] the new coach.
examples.cn: 球队在新教练的[带领下]表现出色。

examples.sense: prep. 正在经历；处于……状态
examples.en: The road is [under] construction and will be finished next month.
examples.cn: 这条路正在[施工]，下个月完工。

examples.en: [Under] the school rules, students must wear uniforms every day.
examples.cn: [根据]学校规定，学生每天必须穿校服。

words.translation: n. 地下, 地铁, 地道, 秘密活动\na. 地下的, 秘密的\nadv. 在地下, 秘密地
words.definition: n. a secret group organized to overthrow a government or occupation force\nr. in or into hiding or secret operation\nr. beneath the surface of the earth

examples.en: Miners work in [underground] tunnels to dig for coal.
examples.cn: 矿工在[地下]隧道中挖煤。

examples.en: Taking the [underground] is faster than driving during rush hour.
examples.cn: 在高峰时段乘坐[地铁]比开车更快。

examples.en: The roots of the tree grow deep [underground].
examples.cn: 树根在[地下]深处生长。

examples.en: The [underground] organization worked quietly to help refugees.
examples.cn: 这个[秘密]组织悄悄地帮助难民。

examples.en: The bunker was built [underground] to protect people from bombs.
examples.cn: 掩体建在[地下]以保护人们免受炸弹袭击。

words.translation: vt. 理解, 了解, 领会, 听说, 懂\nvi. 懂得, 认为
words.definition:
v. know and comprehend the nature or meaning of
v. perceive (an idea or situation) mentally
v. make sense of a language
v. believe to be the case

examples.en: Do you [understand] the instructions for this exercise?
examples.cn: 你[明白]这道练习的说明吗？

examples.en: It took her a while to [understand] how to use the new software.
examples.cn: 她花了一段时间才[弄懂]如何使用新软件。

examples.en: A good friend always tries to [understand] your feelings.
examples.cn: 好朋友总是试图[理解]你的感受。

examples.en: I [understand] that the school trip has been cancelled.
examples.cn: 我[得知]学校旅行已经取消了。

examples.en: She [understands] three languages and can speak them all fluently.
examples.cn: 她[懂]三种语言，都能流利地说。

words.translation: n. 单位, 分队, 部队, 单元, 部件, 装置\na. 单位的, 单元的\n[计] 单元常数; 部件
words.definition:
n. an individual or group or structure or other entity regarded as a structural or functional constituent of a whole
n. an organization regarded as part of a larger social group
n. a single undivided whole
n. a single undivided natural thing occurring in the composition of something else

examples.en: We finished [unit] three of the textbook last week.
examples.cn: 我们上周完成了课本第三[单元]。

examples.en: The metre is the basic [unit] of length in the metric system.
examples.cn: 米是公制系统中长度的基本[单位]。

examples.en: The medical [unit] arrived quickly to help the injured.
examples.cn: 医疗[队]迅速赶到帮助伤者。

examples.en: Each student has a computer [unit] on their desk.
examples.cn: 每个学生的桌上都有一台电脑[设备]。

examples.en: They rented a small [unit] near the school.
examples.cn: 他们在学校附近租了一个小[住宅单元]。

words.translation: n. 大学
words.definition: n. the body of faculty and students at a university\nn. establishment where a seat of higher learning is housed, including administrative and living quarters as well as facilities for research and teaching\nn. a large and diverse institution of higher learning created to educate for life and for a profession and to grant degrees

examples.en: She dreams of studying medicine at a top [university].
examples.cn: 她梦想在顶尖[大学]学习医学。

examples.en: The [university] offers many courses in science and technology.
examples.cn: 这所[大学]提供许多科学技术课程。

examples.en: He made many good friends during his time at [university].
examples.cn: 他在[大学]期间交了很多好朋友。

examples.en: The [university] campus covers a large area with many buildings.
examples.cn: [大学]校园占地面积很大，有许多建筑。

examples.en: Going to [university] requires hard work and dedication in high school.
examples.cn: 进入[大学]需要在高中阶段努力学习和付出。

words.translation: conj. 除非\nprep. 除...之外
words.definition:
conj. Upon any less condition than (the fact or thing stated
   in the sentence or clause which follows); if not; supposing that not;
   if it be not; were it not that; except; as, we shall fail unless we are
   industrious.

examples.en: [Unless] you study hard, you won't pass the exam.
examples.cn: [除非]你努力学习，否则你不会通过考试。

examples.en: Don't go out [unless] you have finished your homework.
examples.cn: [除非]你完成了作业，否则不要出去。

examples.en: [Unless] it rains, we will have the sports day outside.
examples.cn: [除非]下雨，否则我们将在室外举行运动日。

examples.en: She won't speak in class [unless] she is sure of the answer.
examples.cn: [除非]她确定答案，否则她不会在课堂上发言。

examples.en: [Unless] something urgent comes up, I'll see you tomorrow.
examples.cn: [除非]有紧急情况，否则我明天见你。

words.translation: prep. 直到, 在...以前\nconj. 直到...时, 在...以前
words.definition:
prep. To; unto; towards; -- used of material objects.
prep. To; up to; till; before; -- used of time; as, he staid
   until evening; he will not come back until the end of the month.
conj. As far as; to the place or degree that; especially, up to
   the time that; till. See Till, conj.

examples.en: She waited [until] midnight for her parents to come home.
examples.cn: 她等到午夜[才]等到父母回家。

examples.en: Keep stirring the mixture [until] it becomes smooth.
examples.cn: 不断搅拌混合物[直到]它变得顺滑。

examples.en: Don't open the present [until] your birthday.
examples.cn: [直到]你生日[才能]打开礼物。

examples.en: He practiced the piano [until] he could play the song perfectly.
examples.cn: 他练习钢琴[直到]能够完美地演奏这首歌。

examples.en: The library is open [until] nine o'clock in the evening.
examples.cn: 图书馆开放[到]晚上九点。

words.translation: a. 向上的, 起床的, 涨的\nadv. 向上, 上涨\nprep. 在...上面, 向...的较高处
words.definition:
v. raise
a. being or moving higher in position or greater in some value; being above a former position or level
s. extending or moving toward a higher place
s. (usually followed by `on' or `for') in readiness

examples.en: The balloon floated [up] into the sky.
examples.cn: 气球[向上]飘向天空。

examples.en: She woke [up] early to prepare for the exam.
examples.cn: 她早早起[来]准备考试。

examples.en: They walked [up] the hill to enjoy the view.
examples.cn: 他们沿着山坡[向上]走去欣赏风景。

examples.en: The price of vegetables has gone [up] this month.
examples.cn: 这个月蔬菜价格[上涨]了。

examples.en: He ate [up] all the food on his plate without leaving anything.
examples.cn: 他把盘子里的食物全都吃[完]了，没有剩下任何东西。

words.translation: prep. 在...之上, 迫近, 紧接着
words.definition: prep. On; -- used in all the senses of that word, with which it\n   is interchangeable.

examples.en: She placed the crown [upon] the king's head.
examples.cn: 她把王冠放在国王的头[上]。

examples.en: [Upon] hearing the good news, everyone cheered loudly.
examples.cn: [一]听到好消息，大家都大声欢呼。

examples.en: The decision depends [upon] the results of the test.
examples.cn: 这个决定取决[于]测试的结果。

examples.en: The summer holidays are [upon] us already.
examples.cn: 暑假已经[到来]了。

examples.en: [Upon] finishing the task, she took a long rest.
examples.cn: [完成]任务后，她休息了很长时间。

words.translation: a. 楼上的\nadv. 在楼上, 向楼上, 处于更高地位\nn. 楼层
words.definition:
n. the part of a building above the ground floor
a. on or of upper floors of a building
r. on a floor above
r. with respect to the mind

examples.en: She went [upstairs] to get her schoolbag.
examples.cn: 她[上楼]去取她的书包。

examples.en: The [upstairs] bedroom has a nice view of the garden.
examples.cn: [楼上]的卧室可以看到花园的美景。

examples.en: The family uses the [upstairs] as a study room.
examples.cn: 这家人把[楼上]用作书房。

examples.en: Please take these books [upstairs] to the reading room.
examples.cn: 请把这些书[拿到楼上]阅览室去。

examples.en: My grandparents sleep [upstairs] while we sleep downstairs.
examples.cn: 我的祖父母睡在[楼上]，而我们睡在楼下。

words.translation: pron. 我们\n[经] 美国
words.definition:
n North American republic containing 50 states - 48 conterminous states in North America plus Alaska in northwest North America and the Hawaiian Islands in the Pacific Ocean; achieved independence in 1776
n a base containing nitrogen that is found in RNA (but not in DNA) and derived from pyrimidine; pairs with adenine
n a heavy toxic silvery-white radioactive metallic element; occurs in many isotopes; used for nuclear fuels and nuclear weapons
n the 21st letter of the Roman alphabet

examples.en: The teacher told [us] to open our books to page ten.
examples.cn: 老师告诉[我们]翻到课本第十页。

examples.en: It was [us] who came up with the idea for the project.
examples.cn: 是[我们]想出了这个项目的主意。

examples.en: She gave [us] some helpful advice about the exam.
examples.cn: 她给了[我们]一些关于考试的有用建议。

examples.en: Our parents are proud of [us] for working so hard.
examples.cn: 我们的父母为[我们]如此努力而感到自豪。

examples.en: The coach said he was happy with [us] after the game.
examples.cn: 教练说比赛后他对[我们]很满意。

words.translation: n. 使用, 习惯, 使用价值, 用法, 使用权\nvt. 使用, 利用, 运用, 耗费\nvi. 惯常
words.definition:
n. the act of using
n. a particular service
n. (law) the exercise of the legal right to enjoy the benefits of owning property
v. put into service; make work or employ for a particular purpose or for its inherent or natural purpose

examples.en: You can [use] a calculator for the math test.
examples.cn: 你可以在数学考试中[使用]计算器。

examples.en: The [use] of mobile phones in class is not allowed.
examples.cn: 课堂上[使用]手机是不允许的。

examples.en: We [used] up all the paint before finishing the mural.
examples.cn: 我们在完成壁画之前[用完]了所有油漆。

examples.en: What's the [use] of worrying about things you can't change?
examples.cn: 为无法改变的事情担心有什么[用处]？

examples.en: She [used] her language skills to help the foreign tourist.
examples.cn: 她[运用]自己的语言能力帮助了外国游客。

words.translation: a. 使用过的, 二手的, 习惯的
words.definition: a. employed in accomplishing something

examples.en: He bought a [used] bicycle because it was cheaper than a new one.
examples.cn: 他买了一辆[二手]自行车，因为它比新车便宜。

examples.en: She [used to] walk to school every day when she was young.
examples.cn: 她小时候[过去常常]每天步行上学。

examples.en: He is [used to] getting up early after years of practice.
examples.cn: 经过多年的练习，他已经[习惯]早起了。

examples.en: The classroom is [used] for both teaching and meetings.
examples.cn: 这间教室[被用于]教学和会议。

examples.en: They donated [used] clothes to the charity drive.
examples.cn: 他们把[旧]衣服捐给了慈善活动。

words.translation: a. 有用的, 有益的\n[机] 有用的, 有效的
words.definition: a. being of use or service

examples.en: A dictionary is a very [useful] tool for learning new words.
examples.cn: 字典是学习新单词非常[有用]的工具。

examples.en: Her advice was [useful] in helping me solve the problem.
examples.cn: 她的建议对帮助我解决问题很[有益]。

examples.en: This old phone is still [useful] for making calls.
examples.cn: 这部旧手机打电话还是很[好用]的。

examples.en: Learning to cook is a [useful] skill for life.
examples.cn: 学会烹饪是一项[实用]的生活技能。

examples.en: The library provides [useful] resources for students.
examples.cn: 图书馆为学生提供[有用]的资源。

words.translation: a. 平常的, 通常的
words.definition: a. occurring or encountered or experienced or observed frequently or in accordance with regular practice or procedure

examples.en: She took her [usual] seat at the front of the classroom.
examples.cn: 她坐在了教室前排的[惯常]座位上。

examples.en: He woke up later than [usual] because he forgot to set the alarm.
examples.cn: 他因忘记设闹钟而比[平常]起得晚。

examples.en: The [usual] opening time of the library is eight in the morning.
examples.cn: 图书馆的[常规]开放时间是早上八点。

examples.en: As [usual], they had dinner together as a family.
examples.cn: 像[往常]一样，他们全家一起吃晚饭。

examples.en: As [usual], the bus arrived five minutes late.
examples.cn: 像[往常]一样，公共汽车晚了五分钟到达。

words.translation: n. 假期, 休假\n[法] 假期, 停审期, 休庭期
words.definition: n. leisure time away from work devoted to rest or pleasure\nn. the act of making something legally void\nv. spend or take a vacation

examples.en: Our family went to Hainan for our summer [vacation].
examples.cn: 我们全家去海南度过暑[假]。

examples.en: She used her [vacation] to learn a new language.
examples.cn: 她利用[假期]学习一门新语言。

examples.en: They planned a two-week [vacation] in Europe.
examples.cn: 他们计划了一次为期两周的欧洲[假期]之旅。

examples.en: After months of hard work, everyone needed a [vacation].
examples.cn: 经过几个月的努力工作，每个人都需要一次[休假]。

examples.sense: n. 空缺；腾出（较少用法）
examples.en: The [vacation] of the old office building took place last weekend.
examples.cn: 旧办公楼的[腾空]工作上周末进行了。

words.translation: n. 价值, 价格, 购买力, 评价, 估价, 计算结果\nvt. 评价, 估价, 重视\n[计] 计算结果
words.definition:
n. a numerical quantity measured or assigned or computed
n. the quality (positive or negative) that renders something desirable or valuable
n. the amount (of money or goods or services) that is considered to be a fair equivalent for something else
n. relative darkness or lightness of a color

examples.en: The [value] of the old painting increased over the years.
examples.cn: 那幅旧画的[价值]随着岁月的流逝而增加。

examples.en: Exercise has great [value] for maintaining good health.
examples.cn: 锻炼对保持良好健康有很大的[价值]。

examples.en: She [values] her education and works hard every day.
examples.cn: 她[珍视]自己的教育，每天努力学习。

examples.en: Honesty and kindness are important [values] in life.
examples.cn: 诚实和善良是生活中重要的[价值观]。

examples.en: The expert [valued] the antique at five thousand yuan.
examples.cn: 专家将这件古董[估价]为五千元。

words.meaning: 可变电容二极体的简写
words.translation: [电] 可变电容二极体的简写

examples.en: They used to watch movies on [VCD] before streaming services existed.
examples.cn: 在流媒体服务出现之前，他们过去常用[VCD]看电影。

examples.en: He had a large collection of [VCD] discs of his favourite films.
examples.cn: 他收藏了很多他最喜欢的电影[VCD]碟片。

examples.en: The old [VCD] player in the living room no longer works.
examples.cn: 客厅里那台旧[VCD]播放机不能用了。

examples.en: Many Chinese families owned a [VCD] player in the 1990s.
examples.cn: 许多中国家庭在1990年代拥有一台[VCD]播放机。

examples.en: She borrowed a [VCD] of the classic movie from the library.
examples.cn: 她从图书馆借了一张经典电影的[VCD]碟片。

words.translation: n. 蔬菜, 植物, 无精打采之人\na. 蔬菜的, 植物的
words.definition: n. edible seeds or roots or stems or leaves or bulbs or tubers or nonsweet fruits of any of numerous herbaceous plant\nn. any of various herbaceous plants cultivated for an edible part such as the fruit or the root of the beet or the leaf of spinach or the seeds of bean plants or the flower buds of broccoli or cauliflower

examples.en: Eating more [vegetables] is good for your health.
examples.cn: 多吃[蔬菜]对你的健康有好处。

examples.en: They planted a [vegetable] garden in their backyard.
examples.cn: 他们在后院种了一个[蔬菜]园。

examples.en: The market is full of fresh [vegetables] every morning.
examples.cn: 市场每天早上都有新鲜[蔬菜]出售。

examples.en: She added [vegetables] like carrots and spinach to the soup.
examples.cn: 她在汤里加了胡萝卜和菠菜等[蔬菜]。

examples.en: The stir-fried [vegetables] smelled wonderful when cooking.
examples.cn: 炒[蔬菜]在烹饪时散发出美妙的香味。

words.translation: n. 交通工具, 车辆, 传播媒介\n[化] 载体; 运载体; 漆料
words.definition: n. a conveyance that transports people or objects\nn. a medium for the expression or achievement of something\nn. any substance that facilitates the use of a drug or pigment or other material that is mixed with it

examples.en: Bicycles and cars are both [vehicles] used for transportation.
examples.cn: 自行车和汽车都是用于交通的[交通工具]。

examples.en: All [vehicles] must stop at the red traffic light.
examples.cn: 所有[车辆]必须在红灯处停车。

examples.en: A spacecraft is a [vehicle] designed to travel in outer space.
examples.cn: 航天器是设计用于在外太空旅行的[运载工具]。

examples.en: Art can be a [vehicle] for expressing one's feelings.
examples.cn: 艺术可以成为表达个人感情的[媒介]。

examples.en: Music is often used as a [vehicle] to send important messages.
examples.cn: 音乐常被用作传递重要信息的[载体]。

words.translation: a. 真正的, 恰好的, 十足的, 特有的\nadv. 非常, 完全
words.definition: s. precisely as stated\nr. used as intensifiers; `real' is sometimes used informally for `really'; `rattling' is informal\nr. precisely so

examples.en: She was [very] happy when she heard the good news.
examples.cn: 她听到好消息时[非常]高兴。

examples.en: The weather is [very] cold in the north during winter.
examples.cn: 冬天北方天气[非常]寒冷。

examples.en: That is the [very] book I was looking for.
examples.cn: 那[正是]我一直在找的书。

examples.en: He worked [very] hard to pass his driving test.
examples.cn: 他[非常]努力地学习以通过驾驶考试。

examples.en: She answered every question with [very] clear explanations.
examples.cn: 她用[非常]清晰的解释回答了每个问题。

words.translation: n. 胜利, 战胜, 克服
words.definition: n. a successful ending of a struggle or contest

examples.en: The team celebrated their [victory] with great excitement.
examples.cn: 球队兴奋地庆祝他们的[胜利]。

examples.en: After hard work and practice, [victory] was finally theirs.
examples.cn: 经过努力和练习，[胜利]终于属于他们了。

examples.en: Her [victory] in the speech contest made her parents very proud.
examples.cn: 她在演讲比赛中的[胜利]让父母非常自豪。

examples.sense: n. 克服困难后的成功
examples.en: Finishing the marathon was a personal [victory] for him.
examples.cn: 完成马拉松对他来说是个人的[胜利]。

examples.en: The general led his soldiers to a complete [victory] in the battle.
examples.cn: 将军带领士兵在战斗中取得了全面[胜利]。

words.translation: n. 影像, 电视\na. 图像的, 电视的
words.definition: n. the visible part of a television transmission\nn. (computer science) the appearance of text and graphics on a video display

examples.en: She posted a [video] of her singing on the internet.
examples.cn: 她在网上发布了一段自己唱歌的[视频]。

examples.en: They watched a [video] about ocean life in science class.
examples.cn: 他们在科学课上观看了一段关于海洋生物的[录像]。

examples.en: He spends too much time playing [video] games after school.
examples.cn: 他放学后花太多时间玩[电子]游戏了。

examples.en: The school held a [video] conference with students from another country.
examples.cn: 学校与另一个国家的学生举行了[视频]会议。

examples.en: The [video] of their school trip brought back many memories.
examples.cn: 他们学校旅行的[录像]唤起了许多回忆。

words.translation: n. 村庄\na. 乡村的, 村庄的
words.definition: n. a community of people smaller than a town\nn. a settlement smaller than a town

examples.en: She grew up in a small [village] in the mountains.
examples.cn: 她在山里的一个小[村庄]长大。

examples.en: Life in the [village] is quieter than in the city.
examples.cn: [乡村]生活比城市里安静。

examples.en: The whole [village] gathered to celebrate the harvest festival.
examples.cn: 全[村]人聚集在一起庆祝丰收节。

examples.en: The [village] school has only two classrooms and thirty students.
examples.cn: 这所[村]里的学校只有两间教室和三十名学生。

examples.en: A [village] of fishermen lived along the coast.
examples.cn: 一个渔民[村落]沿着海岸居住。

words.translation: n. 小提琴
words.definition: n. bowed stringed instrument that is the highest member of the violin family; this instrument has four strings and a hollow body and an unfretted fingerboard and is played with a bow

examples.en: She has been learning to play the [violin] since she was five.
examples.cn: 她从五岁起就开始学习拉[小提琴]。

examples.en: The [violin] is one of the most important instruments in an orchestra.
examples.cn: [小提琴]是管弦乐队中最重要的乐器之一。

examples.en: His [violin] performance at the concert was truly beautiful.
examples.cn: 他在音乐会上的[小提琴]演奏真的很美。

examples.en: The first [violin] in the orchestra led the other musicians.
examples.cn: 管弦乐队中的首席[小提琴]手带领其他音乐家演奏。

examples.en: The sweet sound of the [violin] filled the concert hall.
examples.cn: [小提琴]甜美的声音充满了音乐厅。

words.translation: n. 拜访, 访问, 游览, 视察\nvt. 拜访, 访问, 参观, 视察, 降临\nvi. 访问, 参观, 闲谈
words.definition:
n. the act of going to see some person or place or thing for a short time
n. a meeting arranged by the visitor to see someone (such as a doctor or lawyer) for treatment or advice
n. the act of visiting in an official capacity (as for an inspection)
n. the act of going to see some person in a professional capacity

examples.en: We [visited] the Palace Museum during our trip to Beijing.
examples.cn: 我们在北京之行中[参观]了故宫博物院。

examples.en: She [visits] her grandparents every Sunday afternoon.
examples.cn: 她每个周日下午都去[探望]祖父母。

examples.en: Their [visit] to the science exhibition was very educational.
examples.cn: 他们对科学展览的[参观]很有教育意义。

examples.en: During his [visit] to the hospital, he brought flowers and fruit.
examples.cn: 在[探视]医院期间，他带了鲜花和水果。

examples.en: Millions of people [visit] the website every day.
examples.cn: 每天有数百万人[访问]这个网站。

words.translation: n. 参观者, 游客, 访客\n[法] 视察人, 检视人, 检查员
words.definition: n. someone who visits

examples.en: The museum welcomed over ten thousand [visitors] last month.
examples.cn: 博物馆上个月迎接了超过一万名[参观者]。

examples.en: We had an unexpected [visitor] at our home this morning.
examples.cn: 今天早上我们家来了一位意外的[客人]。

examples.en: Foreign [visitors] are always amazed by the beauty of Guilin.
examples.cn: 外国[游客]总是被桂林的美景所惊叹。

examples.en: The number of [visitors] to our website has increased greatly.
examples.cn: 我们网站的[访问者]数量大幅增加。

examples.en: Hospital [visitors] must follow the rules about visiting hours.
examples.cn: 医院的[探视者]必须遵守探视时间规定。

words.translation: n. 声音, 嗓音, 嗓子, 愿望, 发言权, 表达, 喉舌, 语态\nvt. 表达, 吐露, 调音
words.definition:
n. the distinctive quality or pitch or condition of a person's speech
n. the sound made by the vibration of vocal folds modified by the resonance of the vocal tract
n. a sound suggestive of a vocal utterance
n. a means or agency by which something is expressed or communicated

examples.en: She has a beautiful singing [voice] that everyone admires.
examples.cn: 她有一副让所有人都羡慕的美妙歌唱[嗓音]。

examples.en: Every student should have a [voice] in classroom decisions.
examples.cn: 每位学生在课堂决策中都应有发言[权]。

examples.en: I heard a familiar [voice] calling my name from the hallway.
examples.cn: 我听到走廊里有一个熟悉的[声音]在叫我的名字。

examples.en: Writing can be a powerful [voice] for sharing your ideas.
examples.cn: 写作可以是分享你想法的有力[表达途径]。

examples.en: She [voiced] her concerns about the new school rule to the teacher.
examples.cn: 她向老师[表达]了她对新校规的担忧。

words.translation: n. 排球
words.definition: n. a game in which two teams hit an inflated ball over a high net using their hands\nn. an inflated ball used in playing volleyball

examples.en: Our school team won the regional [volleyball] championship.
examples.cn: 我们学校队赢得了地区[排球]冠军。

examples.en: He kicked the [volleyball] by mistake instead of a football.
examples.cn: 他不小心踢了[排球]，而不是足球。

examples.en: She practises [volleyball] three times a week after school.
examples.cn: 她每周放学后练习三次[排球]。

examples.en: The [volleyball] match between the two classes was very exciting.
examples.cn: 两个班之间的[排球]比赛非常精彩。

examples.en: Beach [volleyball] is a popular sport in coastal cities.
examples.cn: 沙滩[排球]是沿海城市流行的运动。

words.translation:
n. 等待, 等候
vt. 等候, 期待, 延缓, 伺候, 推迟
vi. 等, 等候, 耽搁, 伺候用餐
[计] 等待
words.definition:
n. the act of waiting (remaining inactive in one place while expecting something)
v. stay in one place and anticipate or expect something
v. wait before acting
v. serve as a waiter or waitress in a restaurant

examples.en: Please [wait] here while I go and get the tickets.
examples.cn: 请在这里[等候]，我去取票。

examples.en: The meeting will have to [wait] until everyone arrives.
examples.cn: 会议必须[等到]每个人都到达后才能开始。

examples.en: There was a long [wait] at the hospital before seeing the doctor.
examples.cn: 在医院看医生前[等候]了很长时间。

examples.en: The children could hardly [wait] for the school trip.
examples.cn: 孩子们迫不及待地[等待]学校旅行。

examples.en: The waiter [waited] on the guests with great care and attention.
examples.cn: 服务员[服务]客人时非常细心周到。

words.translation: vt. 叫醒, 激发\nvi. 醒来, 醒着, 觉醒, 活跃起来\nn. 守侯, 守夜, 尾迹, 痕迹
words.definition:
n. the wave that spreads behind a boat as it moves forward
n. a vigil held over a corpse the night before burial
v. be awake, be alert, be there
v. make aware of

examples.en: She [woke] up at six o'clock every morning to exercise.
examples.cn: 她每天早上六点[醒来]锻炼。

examples.en: Please [wake] me up at seven tomorrow morning.
examples.cn: 请明天早上七点[叫醒]我。

examples.en: The documentary [woke] people up to the problem of pollution.
examples.cn: 这部纪录片[唤醒]了人们对污染问题的意识。

examples.en: In the [wake] of the storm, many streets were flooded.
examples.cn: 在风暴[之后]，许多街道被淹没了。

examples.en: The sudden noise made him [wake] and look around nervously.
examples.cn: 突然的声音让他[惊醒]，紧张地四处张望。

words.translation: n. 走, 散步, 步行, 行走的路程, 竞走, 散步场所\nvi. 走路, 步行, 处世\nvt. 走过, 遛, 使走, 护送...走
words.definition:
n. the act of traveling by foot
n. manner of walking
n. the act of walking somewhere
n. a path set aside for walking

examples.en: They [walked] to school together every morning.
examples.cn: 他们每天早上一起[步行]去学校。

examples.en: Let's go for a [walk] in the park after dinner.
examples.cn: 晚饭后我们去公园[散步]吧。

examples.en: She [walks] her dog along the river every evening.
examples.cn: 她每天傍晚带狗沿河[散步]。

examples.en: The school is only a five-minute [walk] from our house.
examples.cn: 学校离我们家只有五分钟的[步行路程]。

examples.en: He [walked] his little sister home safely after school.
examples.cn: 他放学后[送]妹妹安全回家。

words.translation:
n. 墙, 墙壁, 垣, 内壁, 分界物, 屏障
a. 墙的
vt. 给...建墙, 禁闭, 用墙围住
[计] 背景墙
words.definition:
n. an architectural partition with a height and length greater than its thickness; used to divide or enclose an area or to support another structure
n. anything that suggests a wall in structure or function or effect
n. (anatomy) a layer (a lining or membrane) that encloses a structure
n. a difficult or awkward situation

examples.en: She hung several pictures on the [wall] of her bedroom.
examples.cn: 她在卧室[墙]上挂了几幅画。

examples.en: The Great [Wall] of China stretches for thousands of kilometres.
examples.cn: 中国长[城]绵延数千公里。

examples.en: Language differences can be a [wall] between people.
examples.cn: 语言差异可能成为人们之间的[隔阂]。

examples.en: The [walls] of the cave were covered with ancient paintings.
examples.cn: 洞穴的[壁]上覆盖着古代画作。

examples.en: The garden was [walled] to keep animals out.
examples.cn: 花园被[围]上了墙以防动物进入。

words.translation: n. 需要的东西, 缺乏, 贫困, 需要\nvt. 要, 希望, 应该, 缺少\nvi. 生活困苦, 需要, 缺少
words.definition:
v. have need of
v. hunt or look for; want for a particular reason
v. wish or demand the presence of
v. be without, lack; be deficient in

examples.en: She [wants] to become a doctor when she grows up.
examples.cn: 她长大后[想]成为一名医生。

examples.en: The garden [wants] watering — it hasn't rained for a week.
examples.cn: 花园[需要]浇水——已经一周没下雨了。

examples.en: He [wants] nothing more than to spend time with his family.
examples.cn: 他最[渴望]的就是和家人在一起。

examples.en: The charity helps children in [want] of food and shelter.
examples.cn: 慈善机构帮助[缺乏]食物和住所的儿童。

examples.en: The criminal is [wanted] by the police in three cities.
examples.cn: 这名罪犯被三个城市的警察[通缉]。

words.translation: n. 战争, 战争状态, 战术, 军事, 冲突, 斗争, 竞争\nvi. 进行战争, 作战, 打仗, 战斗\na. 战争的, 战时用的
words.definition:
n. the waging of armed conflict against an enemy
n. a legal state created by a declaration of war and ended by official declaration during which the international rules of war apply
n. an active struggle between competing entities
n. a concerted campaign to end something that is injurious

examples.en: World [War] II ended in 1945 after years of fighting.
examples.cn: 第二次世界大[战]经过多年战斗于1945年结束。

examples.en: The government launched a [war] against poverty in rural areas.
examples.cn: 政府在农村地区发起了一场反贫困的[战争]。

examples.en: There has been a long [war] between the two rival companies.
examples.cn: 两家竞争公司之间存在长期的[竞争]。

examples.en: During the [war], many families had to leave their homes.
examples.cn: [战争]期间，许多家庭不得不离开家园。

examples.en: The two nations [warred] against each other for many years.
examples.cn: 这两个国家相互[交战]了许多年。

words.translation:
a. 暖和的, 暖的, 温暖的, 热烈的, 兴奋的, 激烈的, 多情的, 色情的
vt. 使温暖, 弄热, 使兴奋, 使充满仇恨
vi. 变暖和, 变温暖, 取暖, 激动, 同情, 爱好
n. 暖, 保暖物
words.definition:
v. get warm or warmer
v. make warm or warmer
a. having or producing a comfortable and agreeable degree of heat or imparting or maintaining heat
a. psychologically warm; friendly and responsive

examples.en: The spring sunshine made the day feel [warm] and pleasant.
examples.cn: 春日的阳光让这一天感觉[温暖]而愉快。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a [warm] welcome on the first day of school.
examples.cn: 老师在开学第一天给了我们[热情]的欢迎。

examples.en: She [warmed] the soup on the stove before dinner.
examples.cn: 她在晚饭前在炉子上[加热]了汤。

examples.en: The room was decorated in [warm] colours like red and orange.
examples.cn: 房间用红色和橙色等[暖]色调装饰。

examples.en: The athletes [warmed] up before the competition began.
examples.cn: 运动员在比赛开始前[热身]。

words.translation: vt. 警告, 提醒, 通知\nvi. 发出警告
words.definition:
v. notify of danger, potential harm, or risk
v. admonish or counsel in terms of someone's behavior
v. ask to go away
v. notify, usually in advance

examples.en: The teacher [warned] the students not to run in the corridors.
examples.cn: 老师[警告]学生不要在走廊里跑步。

examples.sense: v. 预先告知；提醒注意
examples.en: The weather forecast [warned] of heavy rain tomorrow.
examples.cn: 天气预报[警告]明天会有大雨。

examples.en: Her parents [warned] her to be careful when crossing the street.
examples.cn: 她的父母[告诫]她过马路时要小心。

examples.en: The alarm [warned] everyone to leave the building quickly.
examples.cn: 警报[警告]所有人迅速离开大楼。

examples.en: The sign [warns] drivers to slow down near the school.
examples.cn: 标志[警告]司机在学校附近减速。

words.translation: n. 洗, 洗涤, 冲洗, 洗的衣服, 冲积物, 洼地\nvt. 洗, 洗涤, 洗清, 用水冲洗, 流过, 弄湿, 粉刷, 镀金属薄层于\nvi. 洗涤, 洗澡, 被冲蚀, 漂浮
words.definition:
n. a thin coat of water-base paint
n. the work of cleansing (usually with soap and water)
n. the dry bed of an intermittent stream (as at the bottom of a canyon)
n. a watercolor made by applying a series of monochrome washes one over the other

examples.en: You should [wash] your hands before eating every meal.
examples.cn: 每次饭前你都应该[洗]手。

examples.en: She [washed] her clothes on Sunday evening.
examples.cn: 她周日晚上[洗]了衣服。

examples.en: The car needs a good [wash] after the muddy drive.
examples.cn: 经过泥泞的驾驶后，这辆车需要好好[洗]一下。

examples.en: The heavy rain [washed] away the mud from the path.
examples.cn: 大雨[冲走]了小路上的泥土。

examples.en: Give the dishes a quick [wash] before putting them away.
examples.cn: 把碗碟收好前先快速[洗]一下。

words.translation:
n. 浪费, 废物, 损耗, 消耗, 荒地, 垃圾, 地面风化物
a. 废弃的, 荒芜的, 多余的
vt. 浪费, 消耗, 使荒芜
vi. 浪费, 消耗, 变消瘦
words.definition:
n. any materials unused and rejected as worthless or unwanted
n. useless or profitless activity; using or expending or consuming thoughtlessly or carelessly
n. (law) reduction in the value of an estate caused by act or neglect
v. spend thoughtlessly; throw away

examples.en: Don't [waste] food — eat everything on your plate.
examples.cn: 不要[浪费]食物——把盘子里的东西都吃完。

examples.en: Throwing away good food is a terrible [waste].
examples.cn: 扔掉好食物是极大的[浪费]。

examples.en: The factory must dispose of its [waste] carefully.
examples.cn: 工厂必须妥善处理其[废物]。

examples.en: She [wasted] too much time playing games instead of studying.
examples.cn: 她[浪费]了太多时间玩游戏而不是学习。

examples.en: The [waste] ground near the school has been turned into a park.
examples.cn: 学校附近的[荒废]土地已经变成了公园。

words.translation: n. 观察, 手表, 看守, 守护, 监视, 值班人\nvt. 看, 注视, 照顾, 看守, 守护, 监视\nvi. 观看, 注视, 守侯
words.definition:
n. a small portable timepiece
n. a period of time (4 or 2 hours) during which some of a ship's crew are on duty
n. a purposeful surveillance to guard or observe
n. the period during which someone (especially a guard) is on duty

examples.en: They [watched] the fireworks display from their rooftop.
examples.cn: 他们从屋顶[观看]烟花表演。

examples.en: He checked his [watch] and realised he was late for class.
examples.cn: 他看了看[手表]，发现上课迟到了。

examples.en: [Watch] your step on the wet floor or you might slip.
examples.cn: [注意]湿地板上的脚步，否则你可能会滑倒。

examples.en: Could you [watch] my bag for a moment while I buy a drink?
examples.cn: 我去买饮料时，你能帮我[看]一下包吗？

examples.en: The guard kept [watch] throughout the night.
examples.cn: 警卫整夜[值班]守望。

words.translation:
n. 水, 雨水, 海水, 水位, 水面, 流水
vt. 给...浇水, 供以水, 注入水, 使湿
vi. 流泪, 流口水, 加水
a. 水的, 水上的, 水生的, 含水的
words.definition:
n. binary compound that occurs at room temperature as a clear colorless odorless tasteless liquid; freezes into ice below 0 degrees centigrade and boils above 100 degrees centigrade; widely used as a solvent
n. once thought to be one of four elements composing the universe (Empedocles)
n. a liquid necessary for the life of most animals and plants
v. supply with water, as with channels or ditches or streams

examples.en: Please drink at least eight glasses of [water] every day.
examples.cn: 请每天至少喝八杯[水]。

examples.en: She [watered] the plants in the garden every morning.
examples.cn: 她每天早上给花园里的植物[浇水]。

examples.en: The boat drifted slowly across the calm [water] of the lake.
examples.cn: 船在平静的湖面[水]上慢慢漂流。

examples.en: The strong onion smell made her eyes [water].
examples.cn: 强烈的洋葱味让她眼睛[流泪]。

examples.en: The [water] from the waterfall was crystal clear.
examples.cn: 瀑布流下的[水]清澈见底。

words.translation: n. 西瓜
words.definition: n. an African melon\nn. large oblong or roundish melon with a hard green rind and sweet watery red or occasionally yellowish pulp

examples.en: A cold slice of [watermelon] is perfect on a hot summer day.
examples.cn: 在炎热的夏天，一片冰凉的[西瓜]是最完美的。

examples.en: They bought a big [watermelon] at the market to share with the family.
examples.cn: 他们在市场买了一个大[西瓜]与家人分享。

examples.en: [Watermelon] vines spread across the ground in the farmer's field.
examples.cn: 农民田地里的[西瓜]藤蔓铺满地面。

examples.en: She drank a cup of fresh [watermelon] juice at breakfast.
examples.cn: 她在早餐时喝了一杯新鲜的[西瓜]汁。

examples.en: The [watermelon] seeds were roasted and eaten as a snack.
examples.cn: [西瓜]子被烤过后当零食吃。

words.translation:
pron. 什么
interj. 怎么, 多么
a. 什么的
adv. 到什么程度
words.definition:
pron., a., & adv. As an interrogative pronoun, used in asking
   questions regarding either persons or things; as, what is this? what
   did you say? what poem is this? what child is lost?
pron., a., & adv. As an exclamatory word: -- (a) Used absolutely
   or independently; -- often with a question following.
pron., a., & adv. Used adjectively, meaning how remarkable, or
   how great; as, what folly! what eloquence! what courage!
pron., a., & adv. Sometimes prefixed to adjectives in an
   adverbial sense, as nearly equivalent to how; as, what happy boys!
pron., a., & adv. As a relative pronoun
pron., a., & adv. Used substantively with the antecedent
   suppressed, equivalent to that which, or those [persons] who, or those
   [things] which; -- called a compound relative.
pron., a., & adv. Used adjectively, equivalent to the . . .
   which; the sort or kind of . . . which; rarely, the . . . on, or at,
   which.
pron., a., & adv. Used adverbially in a sense corresponding to
   the adjectival use; as, he picked what good fruit he saw.
pron., a., & adv. Whatever; whatsoever; what thing soever; --
   used indefinitely.
pron., a., & adv. Used adverbially, in part; partly; somewhat;
   -- with a following preposition, especially, with, and commonly with
   repetition.
n. Something; thing; stuff.
interrog. adv. Why? For what purpose? On what account?

examples.en: The [wheat] was stored in large silos after the harvest.

words.translation: n. 轮子, 车轮, 轮, 方向盘, 旋转, 机构, 重要人物\nvt. 使旋转, 转动, 使转向\nvi. 旋转, 转弯, 盘旋
words.definition:
n. a simple machine consisting of a circular frame with spokes (or a solid disc) that can rotate on a shaft or axle (as in vehicles or other machines)
n. forces that provide energy and direction
n. a circular helm to control the rudder of a vessel
v. change directions as if revolving on a pivot

examples.en: The bicycle has a flat tyre on the back [wheel].
examples.cn: 自行车后[轮]爆胎了。

examples.en: She gripped the [wheel] tightly when driving on the slippery road.
examples.cn: 她在湿滑的路上开车时紧握[方向盘]。

examples.en: The birds [wheeled] through the sky in a graceful circle.
examples.cn: 鸟儿在天空中优雅地[盘旋]。

examples.en: The [wheels] of the machine turned smoothly without any noise.
examples.cn: 机器的[轮]子转动平稳，没有任何噪音。

examples.en: The nurse [wheeled] the patient to the examination room.
examples.cn: 护士将病人[推]到检查室。

words.translation:
conj. 当...的时候
adv. 何时, 什么时候
pron. 什么时侯
n. 时间
words.definition:
adv. At what time; -- used interrogatively.
adv. At what time; at, during, or after the time that; at or
   just after, the moment that; -- used relatively.
adv. While; whereas; although; -- used in the manner of a
   conjunction to introduce a dependent adverbial sentence or clause,
   having a causal, conditional, or adversative relation to the principal
   proposition; as, he chose to turn highwayman when he might have
   continued an honest man; he removed the tree when it was the best in
   the grounds.
adv. Which time; then; -- used elliptically as a noun.

examples.en: [When] does the school bus arrive in the morning?
examples.cn: 早上学校巴士[什么时候]到达？

examples.en: [When] she arrived at school, the class had already started.
examples.cn: [当]她到达学校时，课已经开始了。

examples.en: [When] you don't understand something, raise your hand.
examples.cn: [如果]你不明白某事，请举手。

examples.en: She remembers the day [when] she first learnt to ride a bike.
examples.cn: 她记得她第一次学骑自行车的那[天]。

examples.sense: adv. 在什么时候（宾语从句）
examples.en: He asked me [when] the library would close.
examples.cn: 他问我图书馆[什么时候]关门。

words.translation: conj. 每当\nadv. 不论何时, 每逢
words.definition: adv. & conj. At whatever time.

examples.en: [Whenever] she feels sad, she listens to her favourite music.
examples.cn: [每当]她感到悲伤时，她就听自己最喜欢的音乐。

examples.en: Call me [whenever] you need help with the homework.
examples.cn: [无论何时]你需要帮助做作业，都可以打电话给我。

examples.en: You are [whenever] welcome to visit us.
examples.cn: 你[随时]都欢迎来拜访我们。

examples.en: [Whenever] it rains, the children play indoors.
examples.cn: [每当]下雨时，孩子们就在室内玩耍。

examples.en: [Whenever] she sees a dog, she stops to pet it.
examples.cn: [每当]她看到狗，就会停下来抚摸它。

words.translation: adv. 在哪里\npron. 哪里\nn. 地点
words.definition:
pron. & conj. Whether.
adv. At or in what place; hence, in what situation, position,
   or circumstances; -- used interrogatively.
adv. At or in which place; at the place in which; hence, in the
   case or instance in which; -- used relatively.
adv. To what or which place; hence, to what goal, result, or
   issue; whither; -- used interrogatively and relatively; as, where are
   you going?
conj. Whereas.
n. Place; situation.

examples.en: [Where] did you put my English dictionary?
examples.cn: 你把我的英语词典放到[哪里]去了？

examples.en: This is the park [where] we played as children.
examples.cn: 这就是我们小时候玩耍的[那个]公园。

examples.sense: adv. 在什么地方（宾语从句）
examples.en: She didn't know [where] the post office was.
examples.cn: 她不知道邮局在[哪里]。

examples.en: Go [where] you feel most comfortable and happy.
examples.cn: 去你感觉最舒适快乐的[地方]。

examples.en: [Where] possible, students should do extra reading.
examples.cn: [在可能的情况下]，学生应该进行额外阅读。

words.translation: conj. 是否, 不论\npron. 两个中的哪一个
words.definition:
pron. Which (of two); which one (of two); -- used
   interrogatively and relatively.
conj. In case; if; -- used to introduce the first or two or
   more alternative clauses, the other or others being connected by or, or
   by or whether. When the second of two alternatives is the simple
   negative of the first it is sometimes only indicated by the particle
   not or no after the correlative, and sometimes it is omitted entirely
   as being distinctly implied in the whether of the first.

examples.en: She wasn't sure [whether] she had passed the exam.
examples.cn: 她不确定自己[是否]通过了考试。

examples.en: [Whether] you like it or not, you have to follow the rules.
examples.cn: [无论]你是否喜欢，你都必须遵守规则。

examples.en: I can't decide [whether] to study science or arts at university.
examples.cn: 我无法决定在大学里学理科[还是]文科。

examples.en: He asked [whether] anyone wanted extra help after class.
examples.cn: 他问了[是否]有人在课后需要额外帮助。

examples.en: [Whether] it's hot or cold, she always exercises outdoors.
examples.cn: [不管]天气是热是冷，她总是在户外锻炼。

words.translation: pron. 哪一个, 那一个
words.definition:
a. Of what sort or kind; what; what a; who.
a. A interrogative pronoun, used both substantively and
   adjectively, and in direct and indirect questions, to ask for, or refer
   to, an individual person or thing among several of a class; as, which
   man is it? which woman was it? which is the house? he asked which route
   he should take; which is best, to live or to die? See the Note under
   What, pron., 1.
pron. A relative pronoun, used esp. in referring to an
   antecedent noun or clause, but sometimes with reference to what is
   specified or implied in a sentence, or to a following noun or clause
   (generally involving a reference, however, to something which has
   preceded). It is used in all numbers and genders, and was formerly used
   of persons.
pron. A compound relative or indefinite pronoun, standing for
   any one which, whichever, that which, those which, the . . . which, and
   the like; as, take which you will.

examples.en: [Which] book would you like to borrow from the library?
examples.cn: 你想从图书馆借[哪本]书？

examples.en: She chose the red dress, [which] looked very elegant.
examples.cn: 她选了那件红裙子，[它]看起来非常优雅。

examples.en: [Which] subjects do you enjoy most at school?
examples.cn: 你在学校最喜欢[哪些]科目？

examples.en: The film [which] we watched last night was very exciting.
examples.cn: 我们昨晚看的那部电影[非常]精彩。

examples.en: Can you tell me [which] road leads to the train station?
examples.cn: 你能告诉我[哪条]路通往火车站吗？

words.translation: n. 一会儿, (一段)时间\nconj. 当...的时候, 虽然\nvt. 消磨
words.definition: n. a period of indeterminate length (usually short) marked by some action or condition

examples.en: She read a book [while] waiting for the bus.
examples.cn: 她在等公共汽车的[时候]看书。

examples.en: [While] he likes basketball, his sister prefers swimming.
examples.cn: [虽然]他喜欢篮球，但他妹妹更喜欢游泳。

examples.en: They chatted for a [while] before class started.
examples.cn: 他们在课开始前聊了[一会儿]。

examples.en: She studies every evening, [while] her brother rarely opens his books.
examples.cn: 她每天晚上学习，[而]她哥哥很少打开书本。

examples.en: Please wait for a [while] — I'll be back soon.
examples.cn: 请等一[会儿]——我很快就回来。

words.translation: n. 白色, 洁白, 眼白, 白种人, 蛋白\na. 白色的, 纯洁的, 白种的, 苍白的, 空白的, 幸运的
words.definition:
n. a member of the Caucasoid race
n. the quality or state of the achromatic color of greatest lightness (bearing the least resemblance to black)
n. United States jurist appointed chief justice of the United States Supreme Court in 1910 by President Taft; noted for his work on antitrust legislation (1845-1921)
n. Australian writer (1912-1990)

examples.en: She wore a [white] dress to the graduation ceremony.
examples.cn: 她穿着[白色]裙子参加毕业典礼。

examples.en: The walls of the hospital are painted in pure [white].
examples.cn: 医院的墙壁漆成纯[白色]。

examples.en: The [white] snow covered the mountain from top to bottom.
examples.cn: [白色]的雪从上到下覆盖了整座山。

examples.en: She only used the [white] of the egg in the recipe.
examples.cn: 她在食谱中只使用了鸡蛋的[蛋白]。

examples.en: The clouds looked [white] and fluffy against the blue sky.
examples.cn: 云朵在蓝天的映衬下显得[洁白]而蓬松。

words.translation: pron. 谁
words.definition: n a United Nations agency to coordinate international health activities and to help governments improve health services

examples.en: [Who] is the new student in our class?
examples.cn: 我们班里的新同学是[谁]？

examples.en: She is the teacher [who] helped me most in primary school.
examples.cn: 她是[在]小学时最帮助我的老师。

examples.en: I don't know [who] left this bag on the desk.
examples.cn: 我不知道是[谁]把这个包留在桌上的。

examples.en: [Who] is calling at this late hour?
examples.cn: 这么晚[谁]在打电话？

examples.sense: pron. 那个人（非限制性定语从句）
examples.en: My uncle, [who] works as a doctor, lives in Beijing.
examples.cn: 我的叔叔[他]是一名医生，住在北京。

words.translation: n. 全部, 全体, 整体, 完全之体系\na. 所有的, 完整的, 完全的, 纯粹的
words.definition:
n. all of something including all its component elements or parts
n. an assemblage of parts that is regarded as a single entity
a. including all components without exception; being one unit or constituting the full amount or extent or duration; complete
a. (of siblings) having the same parents

examples.en: She spent the [whole] afternoon working on her project.
examples.cn: 她花了[整个]下午做她的项目。

examples.en: The [whole] of the story needs to be read carefully.
examples.cn: 这个故事的[全部]内容都需要仔细阅读。

examples.en: He ate a [whole] pizza by himself at the party.
examples.cn: 他在聚会上独自吃了[整个]比萨。

examples.en: The situation is a [whole] different matter from what we expected.
examples.cn: 情况与我们预期的[完全]不同。

examples.en: The [whole] class cheered when the teacher announced the class trip.
examples.cn: 当老师宣布班级旅行时，[全班]都欢呼起来。

words.translation: pron. 谁
words.definition: pron. The objective case of who. See Who.

examples.en: To [whom] should I address this letter?
examples.cn: 我应该把这封信寄给[谁]？

examples.en: The man [whom] we met yesterday is our new neighbour.
examples.cn: 我们昨天遇到的那个人[他]是我们的新邻居。

examples.en: She is the person to [whom] I owe the most thanks.
examples.cn: 她是我最应该感谢的[那个人]。

examples.en: I couldn't remember [whom] I had spoken to about the problem.
examples.cn: 我不记得我曾与[谁]谈论过这个问题。

examples.sense: pron. 关系代词（非限制性）
examples.en: My teacher, [whom] I admire greatly, retired last year.
examples.cn: 我非常敬佩的老师[他]去年退休了。

words.translation: pron. 谁的
words.definition: pron. The possessive case of who or which. See Who, and Which.

examples.en: [Whose] pencil is this on the floor?
examples.cn: 地板上这支铅笔是[谁的]？

examples.sense: pron. 的（关系代词所有格）
examples.en: The student [whose] essay was best received the prize.
examples.cn: 论文写得最好的学生获得了奖品，[他的]论文受到了最好的评价。

examples.en: Can anyone tell me [whose] turn it is to clean the classroom?
examples.cn: 有人能告诉我现在轮到[谁]打扫教室了吗？

examples.en: The book, [whose] cover was torn, was still readable.
examples.cn: 这本书虽然封面破损，但仍然可以阅读，[它的]内容完好无损。

examples.en: She couldn't find out [whose] bicycle was blocking the gate.
examples.cn: 她搞不清楚是[谁的]自行车堵住了大门。

words.translation: adv. 为什么\nn. 原因, 理由
words.definition: n. the cause or intention underlying an action or situation, especially in the phrase `the whys and wherefores'

examples.en: [Why] are you so late for school today?
examples.cn: 你今天[为什么]上学这么晚？

examples.en: She explained [why] she had missed the exam.
examples.cn: 她解释了她[为什么]缺席考试。

examples.en: I don't understand [why] he was so angry.
examples.cn: 我不明白他[为什么]那么生气。

examples.en: [Why], that's the most beautiful painting I've ever seen!
examples.cn: [哎]，那是我见过的最美的画！

examples.en: She always wants to know the [why] behind every rule.
examples.cn: 她总是想知道每条规则背后的[原因]。

words.translation: a. 宽的, 广阔的, 普遍的, 宽阔的, 广泛的, 一般的\nadv. 广阔地, 遍及各处地, 广泛地\nn. 大千世界
words.definition:
a. having great (or a certain) extent from one side to the other
a. great in degree
s. having ample fabric
s. not on target

examples.en: The [wide] road in front of the school has six lanes.
examples.cn: 学校前面[宽阔]的道路有六条车道。

examples.en: She has a [wide] knowledge of history and geography.
examples.cn: 她对历史和地理有[广泛]的了解。

examples.en: The window was open [wide] to let in fresh air.
examples.cn: 窗户[大开]着让新鲜空气进来。

examples.en: His first shot missed the target by a [wide] margin.
examples.cn: 他的第一枪[大幅]偏离了目标。

examples.en: The news spread [wide] and soon everyone knew.
examples.cn: 消息[广泛]传播，很快每个人都知道了。

words.translation: n. 妻子, 太太, 夫人\n[法] 妻子, 已婚妇女
words.definition: n. a married woman; a man's partner in marriage

examples.en: His [wife] is a doctor at the local hospital.
examples.cn: 他的[妻子]是当地医院的医生。

examples.en: The [wife] prepared a delicious meal for the whole family.
examples.cn: [妻子]为全家准备了一顿美味的饭菜。

examples.en: The president arrived with his [wife] at the ceremony.
examples.cn: 总统与[夫人]一起出席了典礼。

examples.en: She gave up her job to be a stay-at-home [wife] and mother.
examples.cn: 她辞去工作，成为全职[主妇]和母亲。

examples.en: They have been husband and [wife] for twenty-five years.
examples.cn: 他们做了二十五年的夫[妻]。

words.translation:
n. 意志, 决心, 意愿, 意向, 干劲, 遗嘱
vt. 用意志的力量驱使, 决意, 愿意, 立遗嘱
vi. 下决心, 愿意
aux. 将, 愿意, 必须
words.definition:
n. a fixed and persistent intent or purpose
n. a legal document declaring a person's wishes regarding the disposal of their property when they die
v. decree or ordain
v. determine by choice

examples.en: She [will] graduate from high school next year.
examples.cn: 她明年[将]从高中毕业。

examples.en: [Will] you help me carry these heavy books?
examples.cn: 你[愿意]帮我搬这些重书吗？

examples.en: With strong [will], he managed to overcome all the difficulties.
examples.cn: 凭借坚强的[意志]，他克服了所有困难。

examples.en: The old man wrote a [will] to leave his house to his grandchildren.
examples.cn: 老人写了一份[遗嘱]，把房子留给他的孙子们。

examples.en: If you practise every day, you [will] improve quickly.
examples.cn: 如果你每天练习，你[一定会]迅速进步。

words.translation: vt. 赢得, 打胜, 成功\nvi. 获胜, 达到, 影响\nn. 胜利, 赢, 收益
words.definition: n. a victory (as in a race or other competition)\nv. be the winner in a contest or competition; be victorious

examples.en: Our school team [won] the basketball championship this year.
examples.cn: 我们学校队今年[赢得]了篮球冠军。

examples.en: She [won] first prize in the national piano competition.
examples.cn: 她在全国钢琴比赛中[获得]了一等奖。

examples.en: After three losses, the team finally got their first [win].
examples.cn: 经过三次失利，球队终于获得了第一场[胜利]。

examples.en: He tried to [win] his parents over with his good grades.
examples.cn: 他试图用好成绩来[争取]父母的支持。

examples.en: Hard work and dedication helped him [win] a scholarship.
examples.cn: 努力和奉献帮助他[赢得]了奖学金。

words.translation: n. 风, 气息, 气味, 呼吸, 风声, 趋势, 空谈, 卷绕, 弯曲\nvt. 使通风, 嗅出, 使喘气, 吹号角, 上发条, 缠绕, 包, 绞起, 吊起, 使弯曲, 使迂回\nvi. 嗅出猎物, 吹响号角, 卷曲, 蜿蜒, 迂回, 缠绕
words.definition:
n. air moving (sometimes with considerable force) from an area of high pressure to an area of low pressure
n. a tendency or force that influences events
n. breath
n. empty rhetoric or insincere or exaggerated talk

examples.en: The strong [wind] blew the leaves off the trees.
examples.cn: 强[风]把树上的叶子吹落了。

examples.en: The long run left him out of [wind] for a few minutes.
examples.cn: 长跑使他好几分钟都上气不接下气，[气]喘不过来。

examples.en: She [wound] the wool around the needles carefully.
examples.cn: 她小心地把毛线[缠绕]在针上。

examples.en: The river [winds] slowly through the green valley.
examples.cn: 河流在绿色山谷中[蜿蜒]缓慢流淌。

examples.en: He [wound] up the old clock before going to bed.
examples.cn: 他睡觉前给旧钟[上]了[发条]。

words.translation: n. 窗户, 窗子, 窗口\nvt. 给...开窗\n[计] 窗口
words.definition:
n. a framework of wood or metal that contains a glass windowpane and is built into a wall or roof to admit light or air
n. a transparent opening in a vehicle that allow vision out of the sides or back; usually is capable of being opened
n. a transparent panel (as of an envelope) inserted in an otherwise opaque material
n. an opening that resembles a window in appearance or function

examples.en: She opened the [window] to let some fresh air into the room.
examples.cn: 她打开[窗户]让新鲜空气进入房间。

examples.en: This scholarship is a [window] of opportunity for her future.
examples.cn: 这份奖学金是她未来发展的[机会之窗]。

examples.en: The shop [window] displayed beautiful clothes for the new season.
examples.cn: 商店[橱窗]展示了新季节的漂亮衣服。

examples.en: She opened a new browser [window] to search for information.
examples.cn: 她打开了一个新的浏览器[窗口]来搜索信息。

examples.en: Reading books opens a [window] to the world for children.
examples.cn: 读书为孩子们打开了一扇了解世界的[窗口]。

words.translation: a. 多风的, 风强的, 腹胀的, 吹牛的
words.definition: s. resembling the wind in speed, force, or variability

examples.en: It was a cold and [windy] day, perfect for flying kites.
examples.cn: 那是一个寒冷[有风]的天气，非常适合放风筝。

examples.en: The [windy] weather made it difficult to walk along the coast.
examples.cn: [大风]天气使得沿海岸行走十分困难。

examples.en: Chicago is known as the [windy] city because of its strong winds.
examples.cn: 芝加哥因其强风而被称为[多风]之城。

examples.en: They chose a sheltered spot away from the [windy] hilltop.
examples.cn: 他们选择了一个远离[风大]山顶的避风处。

examples.en: The [windy] conditions at sea made sailing very challenging.
examples.cn: 海上的[大风]条件使帆船航行非常具有挑战性。

words.translation: n. 葡萄酒, 果酒, 暗红色\nv. (请)喝酒
words.definition:
n. fermented juice (of grapes especially)
n. a red as dark as red wine
v. drink wine
v. treat to wine

examples.en: France is famous for producing high-quality [wine].
examples.cn: 法国以生产高质量[葡萄酒]而闻名。

examples.en: They toasted with a glass of red [wine] at the celebration dinner.
examples.cn: 他们在庆祝晚宴上用一杯红[葡萄酒]举杯祝贺。

examples.en: Traditional Chinese [wine] is often made from rice or sorghum.
examples.cn: 传统中国[酒]通常由大米或高粱酿制。

examples.en: They [wined] and dined their guests to celebrate the occasion.
examples.cn: 他们[以美酒佳肴]款待客人以庆祝这个场合。

examples.en: She decorated the room in deep [wine] red and gold colours.
examples.cn: 她用深[葡萄酒]红色和金色装饰了房间。

words.translation: n. 翅膀, 翼, 机翼, 派别\nvt. 给...装上翼, 飞过, 使飞, 空运, 增加...速度\nvi. 飞行
words.definition:
n. a movable organ for flying (one of a pair)
n. one of the horizontal airfoils on either side of the fuselage of an airplane
n. a stage area out of sight of the audience
n. a unit of military aircraft

examples.en: The eagle spread its [wings] and soared high into the sky.
examples.cn: 老鹰展开[翅膀]，高飞入天空。

examples.en: The pilot checked the [wings] of the plane before takeoff.
examples.cn: 飞行员在起飞前检查了飞机的[机翼]。

examples.en: The new [wing] of the hospital will open next year.

examples.cn: 该党的左[翼]支持更多社会项目。

words.translation: n. 胜利者, 优胜者\n[法] 取胜者
words.definition: n. the contestant who wins the contest\nn. a gambler who wins a bet

examples.cn: 他的科学项目结果证明是真正的[成功之作]。

examples.cn: [获胜者]将代表学校参加全国比赛。

examples.en: All [winners] will receive their prizes at the ceremony next week.
examples.cn: 所有[获奖者]将在下周的典礼上领取奖品。

words.translation:

examples.cn: 我们城市每年[冬天]都会下大雪。

examples.cn: 她穿着厚厚的[冬季]外套保暖。

examples.en: They spent the [winter] holidays visiting relatives in the south.
examples.cn: 他们度过了去南方探亲的[冬]假。

examples.en: Many birds fly south to [winter] in warmer places.
examples.cn: 许多鸟儿飞往南方在温暖的地方[越冬]。

examples.en: The poem described the [winter] of his life with great sadness.
examples.cn: 这首诗以极大的悲伤描述了他生命的[暮年]。

words.translation:
