words.definition:
n. a way of doing or being
n. United States Jewish leader (born in Hungary) (1874-1949)
n. United States religious leader (born in Bohemia) who united reform Jewish organizations in the United States (1819-1900)
a. having or prompted by wisdom or discernment

examples.en: It is [wise] to save some money for unexpected expenses.
examples.cn: 为意外支出存一些钱是[明智]的。

examples.sense: adj. 有见识的；经验丰富的
examples.en: The [wise] old teacher gave valuable advice to his students.
examples.cn: 这位[睿智]的老教师给学生们提供了宝贵的建议。

examples.en: She made a [wise] decision to study harder before the exam.
examples.cn: 她做出了一个[明智]的决定，在考试前更加努力学习。

examples.en: He became [wise] through years of reading and experience.
examples.cn: 他通过多年的阅读和经验变得[博学]。

examples.en: The [wise] fox in the fable always found a way to escape danger.
examples.cn: 寓言中[聪明]的狐狸总是能找到逃脱危险的方法。

words.translation: n. 希望, 愿望, 祝愿, 命令, 请求\nvt. 愿, 想要, 希望, 祝愿\nvi. 希望
words.definition:
n. a specific feeling of desire
n. an expression of some desire or inclination
n. the particular preference that you have
v. hope for; have a wish

examples.en: She [wishes] she could travel to every country in the world.
examples.cn: 她[希望]自己能游遍世界上的每个国家。

examples.en: His greatest [wish] was to become a famous scientist.
examples.cn: 他最大的[愿望]是成为一名著名的科学家。

examples.en: We [wish] you all the best in your new school.
examples.cn: 我们[祝]你在新学校一切顺利。

examples.en: Please send my best [wishes] to your parents.
examples.cn: 请代我向你的父母传达最诚挚的[祝福]。

examples.en: He [wished] for a bicycle as his birthday present.
examples.cn: 他[希望]得到一辆自行车作为生日礼物。

words.translation: prep. 和...在一起, 以, 由于
words.definition:
n. See Withe.
prep. With denotes or expresses some situation or relation of
   nearness, proximity, association, connection, or the like.
prep. To denote a close or direct relation of opposition or
   hostility; -- equivalent to against.
prep. To denote association in respect of situation or
   environment; hence, among; in the company of.
prep. To denote a connection of friendship, support, alliance,
   assistance, countenance, etc.; hence, on the side of.
prep. To denote the accomplishment of cause, means, instrument,
   etc; -- sometimes equivalent to by.
prep. To denote association in thought, as for comparison or
   contrast.
prep. To denote simultaneous happening, or immediate succession
   or consequence.
prep. To denote having as a possession or an appendage; as, the
   firmament with its stars; a bride with a large fortune.

examples.en: She went to the library [with] her best friend.
examples.cn: 她[和]她最好的朋友一起去了图书馆。

examples.en: He wrote the letter [with] a blue pen.
examples.cn: 他用蓝色钢笔[写]了这封信。

examples.en: She is a student [with] a strong interest in science.
examples.cn: 她是一个对科学有浓厚兴趣的学生。

examples.en: The teacher was pleased [with] the students' performance.
examples.cn: 老师对学生的表现感到满意。

examples.en: [With] practice, her English improved a lot.
examples.cn: [随着]练习，她的英语进步了很多。

words.translation: prep. 没有, 不, 在...之外\nadv. 在外面, 户外\nn. 外面, 外部
words.definition:
prep. On or at the outside of; out of; not within; as,
   without doors.
prep. Out of the limits of; out of reach of; beyond.
prep. Not with; otherwise than with; in absence of,
   separation from, or destitution of; not with use or employment of;
   independently of; exclusively of; with omission; as, without labor;
   without damage.
conj. Unless; except; -- introducing a clause.
adv. On or art the outside; not on the inside; not within;
   outwardly; externally.
adv. Outside of the house; out of doors.

examples.en: She left the house [without] her umbrella and got wet.
examples.cn: 她出门[没带][雨伞]，被淋湿了。

examples.en: He finished the exam [without] making any mistakes.
examples.cn: 他[没有]犯任何错误地完成了考试。

examples.en: Life [without] books and music would be very boring.
examples.cn: [没有]书籍和音乐的生活会非常无聊。

examples.en: The children played [without] supervision for a while.
examples.cn: 孩子们在[没有]监督的情况下玩了一会儿。

examples.en: She could not fall asleep [without] reading first.
examples.cn: 她[没有]先读书就无法入睡。

words.translation: n. 狼, 残忍贪婪之人, 极度穷困\nvt. 狼吞虎咽, 大吃
words.definition:
n. any of various predatory carnivorous canine mammals of North America and Eurasia that usually hunt in packs
n. Austrian composer (1860-1903)
n. German classical scholar who claimed that the Iliad and Odyssey were composed by several authors (1759-1824)
n. a man who is aggressive in making amorous advances to women

examples.en: The [wolf] howled at the moon on the cold winter night.
examples.cn: [狼]在寒冷的冬夜对着月亮嚎叫。

examples.en: In the fairy tale, the [wolf] tried to blow down the three pigs' house.
examples.cn: 在童话故事中，[狼]试图吹倒三只小猪的房子。

examples.en: His parents warned him to be careful of the [wolf] in sheep's clothing.
examples.cn: 他的父母警告他要小心[披着羊皮的狼]。

examples.en: He [wolfed] down his lunch and rushed back to class.
examples.cn: 他[狼吞虎咽]地吃完午餐，然后冲回教室。

examples.en: [Wolves] live and hunt in packs in the wild.
examples.cn: [狼]在野外群居和群体捕猎。

words.translation: n. 女人, 妇女, 女仆\na. 女用的, 女性的, 妇女的\nvt. 贬称...为女人, 使成女人腔
words.definition: n. an adult female person (as opposed to a man)\nn. a female person who plays a significant role (wife or mistress or girlfriend) in the life of a particular man

examples.en: The brave [woman] saved the child from the burning building.
examples.cn: 这位勇敢的[女人]把孩子从燃烧的建筑物中救了出来。

examples.en: She became a confident and capable [woman] after years of hard work.
examples.cn: 经过多年努力，她成为了一个自信、有能力的[女人]。

examples.en: Every [woman] in the village gathered to celebrate the harvest.
examples.cn: 村里的每位[女人]都聚集在一起庆祝丰收。

examples.en: She was the first [woman] to lead the company as CEO.
examples.cn: 她是公司第一位担任CEO的[女性]。

examples.en: Both men and [women] deserve equal opportunities in the workplace.
examples.cn: 男性和[女性]在工作场所都应该享有平等的机会。

words.translation: n. 奇迹, 惊奇, 惊愕\nvt. 惊奇, 想知道\nvi. 惊讶, 怀疑
words.definition:
n. the feeling aroused by something strange and surprising
n. something that causes feelings of wonder
v. have a wish or desire to know something
v. place in doubt or express doubtful speculation

examples.en: She [wonders] why the sky changes colour at sunset.
examples.cn: 她[好奇]为什么天空在日落时会变色。

examples.en: The children looked at the snow with great [wonder].
examples.cn: 孩子们带着极大的[惊奇]看着雪。

examples.en: The pyramids of Egypt are one of the [wonders] of the ancient world.
examples.cn: 埃及金字塔是古代世界的[奇迹]之一。

examples.en: He [wondered] at the beauty of the night sky full of stars.
examples.cn: 他对满天繁星的夜空之美感到[惊叹]。

examples.en: It's no [wonder] she feels tired after working so hard.
examples.cn: 难[怪]她在如此努力工作后感到疲惫。

words.translation: a. 令人惊奇的, 奇妙的, 极好的
words.definition: s extraordinarily good or great; used especially as intensifiers

examples.en: We had a [wonderful] time at the school party last Friday.
examples.cn: 上周五我们在学校聚会上度过了[美好]的时光。

examples.en: The view from the top of the mountain was absolutely [wonderful].
examples.cn: 从山顶俯瞰的景色绝对令人[惊叹]。

examples.en: She is a [wonderful] teacher who makes every lesson interesting.
examples.cn: 她是一位[出色]的老师，让每节课都有趣。

examples.en: He received [wonderful] news about his university application.
examples.cn: 他收到了关于大学申请的[好]消息。

examples.en: The [wonderful] world of science amazed all the students.
examples.cn: 科学的[奇妙]世界让所有学生都感到惊叹。

words.translation: n. 木材, 木制品\nvt. 植林于, 给...添加木柴\nvi. 收集木材
words.definition:

n. English conductor (1869-1944)

examples.cn: 木匠用[木材]建造了一个漂亮的书架。

examples.cn: 这张桌子由实[木]制成，非常耐用。

words.definition:
n. a unit of language that native speakers can identify
n. a brief statement
n. a verbal command for action

examples.cn: 她在词典里查找这个[单词]的含义。

examples.cn: 在困难的考试期间没有人说一[句话]。

examples.cn: 有没有关于结果何时公布的[消息]？

examples.cn: 他[承诺]会按时完成项目。

words.translation: n. 工作, 劳动, 职业, 行为, 功, 作品, 成果, 产品, 工程\nvi. 工作, 劳动, 做, 运转, 起作用, 被加工\nvt. 使工作, 使转动, 开动, 使用, 经营, 使逐渐变得, 造成
words.definition:
n. activity directed toward making or doing something

examples.cn: 她每天在医院[工作]，担任护士。

examples.cn: 毕业后找[工作]可能很有挑战性。

examples.cn: 这台旧洗衣机不再正常[运转]了。

examples.cn: 博物馆收藏了著名艺术家的[作品]。

examples.cn: 他[努力]提高自己的英语口语能力。

words.translation: n. 工人, 劳动者\n[经] 工人, 劳工, 劳动者

examples.cn: 这家公司公平对待[员工]并给予良好的报酬。

examples.cn: 她是一个勤劳的[工作者]，从不放弃困难的任务。

examples.en: The social [worker] helped the family find better housing.
examples.cn: 社会[工作者]帮助这家人找到了更好的住所。

words.translation: n. 世界, 地球, 宇宙, 万物, 世人, 人间, 领域, 世事, 世故, 社会生活, 大量\n[法] 世界, 地球, 世人

n. a part of the earth that can be considered separately

examples.cn: 她梦想有一天环游[世界]。

examples.cn: 科学[世界]充满了令人兴奋的发现。

examples.en: The whole [world] was watching the Olympic Games.
examples.cn: 全[世界]都在观看奥运会。

examples.en: He felt as if a new [world] had opened up before him.
examples.cn: 他感到一个新[世界]在他面前展开。

examples.en: She broke the [world] record for the 100-metre sprint.
examples.cn: 她打破了100米短跑的[世界]纪录。

words.translation: n. 担心, 烦恼, 忧虑, 苦恼, 撕咬\nvt. 使烦恼, 使焦虑, 使苦恼, 困扰, 折磨, 撕咬\nvi. 烦恼, 担心, 撕咬
words.definition:
n. a strong feeling of anxiety
v. be worried, concerned, anxious, troubled, or uneasy
v. be concerned with

examples.cn: 不要太[担心]考试——只需尽力而为。

examples.en: Passing the exam was her biggest [worry] that semester.
examples.cn: 通过考试是她那学期最大的[担忧]。

examples.en: His late arrival [worried] his parents greatly.
examples.cn: 他的迟到让父母非常[担心]。

examples.sense: n. 烦恼事；令人担心的事

examples.cn: 经济问题是他那年的主要[烦恼]。

examples.en: She [worried] herself sick over the results of the medical test.
examples.cn: 她为医学检查的结果[担忧]得生了病。

words.translation: n. 价值, 财产\na. 值...的, 值得的

n. an indefinite quantity of something having a specified value

s. having a specified value

examples.cn: 这本书[值得]阅读——你会从中学到很多。

examples.en: The old painting has a [worth] of several million yuan.
examples.cn: 这幅旧画的[价值]达到了几百万元。

examples.en: The antique vase is [worth] more than ten thousand yuan.
examples.cn: 这个古董花瓶[价值]超过一万元。

examples.en: The [worth] of education cannot be measured in money alone.

examples.cn: 与亲人共度的每一刻都[值得]珍惜。

words.translation: aux. 将, 愿意

imp. of Will
v. t. Commonly used as an auxiliary verb, either in the past

n. See 2d Weld.

examples.cn: 她说她[会]在八点前到达学校。

examples.cn: 你[能]把音乐调小一点吗？

examples.cn: 我们小时候每天下午都[会]去公园玩。

examples.en: If I had more time, I [would] read more books.
examples.cn: 如果我有更多时间，我[会]读更多书。

examples.en: He [would] do anything to make his parents proud.
examples.cn: 他[愿意]做任何事情让父母感到自豪。

words.translation:

words.translation: vt. 书写, 著述, 写, 写满, 写信给\nvi. 写, 写字, 写信, 写作, 作曲\n[计] 书写器
words.definition:
v. produce a literary work
v. communicate or express by writing
v. communicate (with) in writing
v. communicate by letter

examples.en: She [writes] in her diary every night before going to sleep.
examples.cn: 她每晚睡觉前都[写]日记。

examples.en: He [wrote] his first short story when he was twelve years old.
examples.cn: 他十二岁时[写]了他的第一篇短篇小说。

examples.en: She [wrote] to her pen pal in France every month.
examples.cn: 她每个月都给法国的笔友[写信]。

words.translation: a. 错误的, 不正当的, 失常的\nadv. 错误地

n. that which is contrary to the principles of justice or law
n. any harm or injury resulting from a violation of a legal right
v. treat unjustly; do wrong to
a. contrary to conscience or morality or law

examples.cn: 她给出了[错误]的答案，不得不再试一次。

examples.en: She answered the question [wrong] because she misunderstood it.
examples.cn: 她因误解了问题而[错误]地回答了它。

examples.en: It's important to admit your [wrongs] and apologise.
examples.cn: 承认自己的[错误]并道歉是很重要的。

examples.en: Something is [wrong] with the computer — it won't start.
examples.cn: 电脑出了[问题]——它无法启动。

words.translation: a. X射线的\nvt. 用X光检查, 照X光\nvi. 使用X光
words.definition: v. examine by taking x-rays\nv. take an x-ray of something or somebody

examples.en: The doctor took an [x-ray] of his broken arm.
examples.cn: 医生给他骨折的手臂拍了[X光片]。

examples.en: The patient had an [x-ray] to check for any lung problems.
examples.cn: 病人进行了[X光]检查以查看是否有任何肺部问题。

examples.en: Security staff [x-rayed] the bags at the airport entrance.
examples.cn: 安全人员在机场入口处对行李进行了[X光]检查。

examples.en: The [x-ray] showed that the bone had healed completely.
examples.cn: [X光片]显示骨骼已经完全愈合。

examples.en: [X-ray] technology has revolutionised modern medicine.
examples.cn: [X射线]技术彻底改变了现代医学。

words.translation: n. 码, 庭院, 工场\n[化] 堆置场
words.definition:
n. a unit of length equal to 3 feet; defined as 91.44 centimeters; originally taken to be the average length of a stride
n. the enclosed land around a house or other building
n. a tract of land enclosed for particular activities (sometimes paved and usually associated with buildings)
n. a tract of land where logs are accumulated

examples.en: The children played in the [yard] after school.
examples.cn: 孩子们放学后在[院子]里玩耍。

examples.en: The fabric she bought was three [yards] long.
examples.cn: 她买的布料长三[码]。

examples.en: The school [yard] was full of students during lunch break.
examples.cn: 午休时学校[操场]上挤满了学生。

examples.en: Old cars were stored in the scrap [yard] at the edge of town.
examples.cn: 废旧汽车被存放在镇边的废品[场]。

examples.en: She grew vegetables in her back [yard] during the summer.
examples.cn: 她夏天在[后院]种蔬菜。

words.translation: n. 年, 年度, 年龄\n[经] 年度
words.definition: n. a period of time containing 365 (or 366) days\nn. a period of time occupying a regular part of a calendar year that is used for some particular activity\nn. the period of time that it takes for a planet (as, e.g., Earth or Mars) to make a complete revolution around the sun

examples.en: This [year] is very special because our school turns one hundred.
examples.cn: 今[年]非常特别，因为我们学校迎来了一百周年。

examples.en: She worked hard throughout the school [year] to get good grades.
examples.cn: 她在整个学[年]中努力学习以取得好成绩。

examples.en: It took him a [year] to learn how to play the guitar well.
examples.cn: 他花了一[年]时间学会了弹好吉他。

examples.en: He has been studying English for three [years].
examples.cn: 他已经学习英语三[年]了。

examples.en: The [years] he spent at this school were the happiest of his life.
examples.cn: 他在这所学校度过的那些[年]是他一生中最快乐的时光。

words.translation: n. 黄色\na. 黄色的
words.definition:
n. yellow color or pigment; the chromatic color resembling the hue of sunflowers or ripe lemons
v. turn yellow
s. of the color intermediate between green and orange in the color spectrum; of something resembling the color of an egg yolk
s. changed to a yellowish color by age

examples.en: She wore a bright [yellow] jacket that everyone noticed.
examples.cn: 她穿着一件醒目的[黄色]夹克，每个人都注意到了。

examples.en: [Yellow] is the colour of sunshine and happiness.
examples.cn: [黄色]是阳光和幸福的颜色。

examples.sense: adj. 金黄色的（形容成熟）
examples.en: The fields turned [yellow] as the wheat ripened in summer.
examples.cn: 随着小麦在夏天成熟，田野变成了[金黄色]。

examples.en: Slow down when you see the [yellow] traffic light.
examples.cn: 看到[黄色]交通灯时要减速。

examples.en: She mixed [yellow] and blue paint together to make green.
examples.cn: 她把[黄色]和蓝色颜料混合在一起制成绿色。

words.translation: adv. 是\nn. 是, 同意\nv. 同意
words.definition: n. an affirmative

examples.en: Did you finish your homework? — [Yes], I did it this afternoon.
examples.cn: 你完成作业了吗？——[是的]，我今天下午做完了。

examples.en: [Yes]! We won the game! Everyone cheered loudly.
examples.cn: [好]！我们赢了比赛！大家大声欢呼。

examples.en: [Yes], I agree with your suggestion about the project.
examples.cn: [是的]，我同意你关于这个项目的建议。

examples.en: The teacher called her name and she answered '[yes]'.
examples.cn: 老师叫了她的名字，她回答'[到]'。

examples.en: [Yes], she confirmed that the meeting was moved to Thursday.
examples.cn: [是的]，她确认会议改在周四举行。

words.translation: n. 昨天\nadv. 昨天
words.definition:
n. the day immediately before today
n. the recent past
r. on the day preceding today
r. in the recent past; only a short time ago

examples.en: She forgot to bring her homework because she was sick [yesterday].
examples.cn: 她因为[昨天]生病而忘记带作业。

examples.en: [Yesterday] was a holiday, so the school was closed.
examples.cn: [昨天]是假日，所以学校关门了。

examples.en: The song reminded him of the happy [yesterdays] of his childhood.
examples.cn: 这首歌让他想起了童年快乐的[往昔]。

examples.en: I saw him only [yesterday] and he looked perfectly fine.
examples.cn: 我[昨天]刚见到他，他看起来完全没问题。

examples.en: [Yesterday] afternoon, they had a group discussion about the project.
examples.cn: [昨天]下午，他们就这个项目进行了小组讨论。

words.translation: adv. 还, 尚, 仍然, 已经, 然而\nconj. 然而
words.definition: r. up to the present time\nr. within an indefinite time or at an unspecified future time

examples.en: Have you finished your science project [yet]?
examples.cn: 你[还]没完成你的科学项目吗？

examples.en: She studied hard, [yet] she didn't pass the exam.
examples.cn: 她努力学习，[然而]没有通过考试。

examples.en: He hasn't returned from the library [yet].
examples.cn: 他[还]没有从图书馆回来。

examples.en: Is she [yet] working on her essay?
examples.cn: 她[仍然]在写她的文章吗？

examples.en: The next challenge will be [yet] more difficult than this one.
examples.cn: 下一个挑战将[更加]困难。

words.translation: pron. 你, 你们
words.definition: dat. & obj. The pronoun of the second person, in the nominative,\n   dative, and objective case, indicating the person or persons addressed.\n   See the Note under Ye.

examples.en: [You] did a great job on your presentation today.
examples.cn: [你]今天的演讲做得很好。

examples.en: [You] are all welcome to join the after-school club.
examples.cn: [你们]都欢迎加入课外俱乐部。

examples.en: [You] should always be kind to others, no matter what.
examples.cn: [人]应该始终对他人善良，无论如何。

examples.en: The teacher gave [you] the highest score on the test.
examples.cn: 老师给了[你]考试最高分。

examples.en: Is this [you] in the photo from five years ago?
examples.cn: 照片里这是[你]五年前的样子吗？

words.translation: a. 年轻的, 无经验的, 朝气蓬勃的\nn. 青年们, 幼小动物, 崽
words.definition:
n. any immature animal
n. United States film and television actress (1913-2000)
n. United States civil rights leader (1921-1971)
n. British physicist and Egyptologist; he revived the wave theory of light and proposed a three-component theory of color vision; he also played an important role in deciphering the hieroglyphics on the Rosetta Stone (1773-1829)

examples.en: She is a [young] and talented musician who plays the violin.
examples.cn: 她是一位[年轻]有才华的音乐家，演奏小提琴。

examples.en: [Young] children need a lot of sleep to grow and develop.
examples.cn: [幼小]的孩子需要大量睡眠来成长和发育。

examples.en: The [young] generation uses technology in creative ways.
examples.cn: [年轻]一代以富有创意的方式使用技术。

examples.en: The lion was protecting her [young] in the den.
examples.cn: 母狮在巢穴里保护她的[幼崽]。

examples.en: The company is a [young] startup with many innovative ideas.
examples.cn: 这家公司是一家[年轻]的初创企业，拥有许多创新想法。

words.translation: pron. 你的, 你们的
words.definition: pron. & a. The form of the possessive case of the personal\n   pronoun you.

examples.en: Please put [your] name on the front page of the exam paper.
examples.cn: 请在试卷封面写上[你的]名字。

examples.en: Is this [your] classroom, or do you share it with another class?
examples.cn: 这是[你们的]教室，还是与另一个班共用？

examples.en: Don't forget to hand in [your] homework by Friday.
examples.cn: 别忘了在周五前交[你的]作业。

examples.en: Is this [your] first visit to our school?
examples.cn: 这是[您]第一次来我们学校吗？

examples.en: Exercise is good for [your] health and mental wellbeing.
examples.cn: 运动对[你的]健康和心理健康有益。

words.translation: pron. 你的(东西), 你们的(东西)
words.definition: pron. See the Note under Your.

examples.en: Is this pencil case [yours] or does it belong to someone else?
examples.cn: 这个铅笔盒是[你的]还是别人的？

examples.en: These seats near the front are [yours] for today's performance.
examples.cn: 前排这些座位是[你们的]，用于今天的演出。

examples.en: The decision is entirely [yours] — we will support whatever you choose.
examples.cn: 这个决定完全是[你的]——我们会支持你的任何选择。

examples.en: She signed the letter with 'Sincerely [yours]'.
examples.cn: 她在信末签上了'[你]真诚的'。

examples.en: Our team won, but [yours] played really well too.
examples.cn: 我们队赢了，但[你们的]队打得也非常好。

words.translation: pron. 你自己
words.definition:
pron. An emphasized or reflexive form of the pronoun of the
   second person; -- used as a subject commonly with you; as, you yourself
   shall see it; also, alone in the predicate, either in the nominative or
   objective case; as, you have injured yourself.

examples.sense: pron. 你自己；您自己（反身）
examples.en: You should be proud of [yourself] for working so hard.
examples.cn: 你应该为[自己]如此努力而感到自豪。

examples.en: Did you make this cake [yourself]? It's delicious!
examples.cn: 这个蛋糕是你[自己]做的吗？太好吃了！

examples.en: You can solve this problem by [yourself] if you think carefully.
examples.cn: 如果你仔细思考，你可以[自己]解决这个问题。

examples.en: Be [yourself] and don't try to imitate others.
examples.cn: 做[你自己]，不要试图模仿别人。

examples.en: Help [yourself] to more food — there is plenty!
examples.cn: 请[自己]多吃点——有很多！

words.translation: pron. 你们自己
words.definition: pl.  of Yourself

examples.en: Please help [yourselves] to the snacks on the table.
examples.cn: 请[自己]取桌上的零食。

examples.en: Did you build this model plane [yourselves]? It looks amazing!
examples.cn: 这个模型飞机是你们[自己]做的吗？看起来太棒了！

examples.en: You will have to decide [yourselves] which route to take.
examples.cn: 你们必须[自己]决定走哪条路。

examples.en: Be [yourselves] at the interview and show your true personalities.
examples.cn: 在面试中做[你们自己]，展示你们真实的个性。

examples.en: Take good care of [yourselves] during the winter months.
examples.cn: 在冬季要好好照顾[你们自己]。

words.translation: n. 斑马
words.definition: n. any of several fleet black-and-white striped African equines

examples.en: The [zebra] is known for its black and white stripes.
examples.cn: [斑马]以其黑白条纹而闻名。

examples.en: We saw a herd of [zebras] drinking at the waterhole.
examples.cn: 我们看到一群[斑马]在水坑旁饮水。

examples.en: Always use the [zebra] crossing when crossing a busy road.
examples.cn: 过繁忙道路时要使用[斑马]线。

examples.en: The [zebra] pattern on her bag was very fashionable.
examples.cn: 她包上的[斑马]纹图案非常时尚。

examples.en: [Zebras] live on the grasslands of Africa.
examples.cn: [斑马]生活在非洲草原上。

words.translation:
n. 零, 零点, 零度, 无, 乌有, 最低点
a. 零的, 没有的
vt. 调零, 对(炮火等)作协调校正
[计] 零
words.definition:
n. a mathematical element that when added to another number yields the same number
n. the point on a scale from which positive or negative numerical quantities can be measured
n. the sight setting that will cause a projectile to hit the center of the target with no wind blowing
v. adjust (an instrument or device) to zero value

examples.en: The temperature dropped to [zero] degrees last night.
examples.cn: 昨晚气温降到了[零]度。

examples.en: The number [zero] was an important invention in mathematics.
examples.cn: [零]这个数字是数学中的重要发明。

examples.en: The new medication showed [zero] side effects in the tests.
examples.cn: 新药在测试中显示[零]副作用。

examples.en: They had to start from [zero] when building the new business.
examples.cn: 他们在建立新业务时不得不从[零]开始。

examples.en: Don't call yourself a [zero] — everyone has special talents.
examples.cn: 不要称自己为[一无是处]——每个人都有特别的才能。

words.translation: n. 动物园
words.definition: n the facility where wild animals are housed for exhibition

examples.en: The class visited the [zoo] to learn about different animals.
examples.cn: 班级参观了[动物园]以了解不同的动物。

examples.sense: n. 动物园（形容词用法）
examples.en: She bought a [zoo] guidebook to read about all the animals.
examples.cn: 她买了一本[动物园]指南来了解所有动物。

examples.en: The classroom was a [zoo] when the teacher was absent.
examples.cn: 老师不在时，教室变成了一个[乱糟糟的地方]。

examples.en: Modern [zoos] are designed to protect endangered species.
examples.cn: 现代[动物园]的设计旨在保护濒危物种。

examples.en: The new panda enclosure at the [zoo] attracted thousands of visitors.
examples.cn: [动物园]新建的熊猫馆吸引了数千名游客。
